The protocol tests runtime viability, consistency with task-local data, fidelity of the initial rendering to the reference screenshot, and interaction-induced state changes in a sandboxed browser. A rubric-guided MLLM judge evaluates task-specific items for the three scored dimensions using the collected browser observations and achieves an overall item-level F1 score of 0.8844 against adjudicated human labels. We also propose TRAIL, a trajectory-guided dual-agent framework for interactive chart code generation. An Inspector derives task-specific inspection checks, executes them in the browser, and uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures and produce structured repair feedback. Averaged across four MLLMs, TRAIL improves the four evaluation dimensions over direct prompting by 7.89, 4.98, 3.45, and 4.47 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出IChart2Code基准与TRAIL框架，用于交互式图表代码生成及浏览器评估。
AI.motivation: 现有图表到代码基准只关注静态输出，缺乏交互规范、浏览器执行与交互后验证的任务表示和评估协议。
AI.method: 构建IChart2Code基准（377任务、20种图表、13类数据、1209条交互需求）；设计基于浏览器的评估协议（Executability门槛+Data Fidelity、Static Visual Correctness、Interaction Correctness三维度）；提出TRAIL双智能体框架（Inspector生成检查、浏览器执行、轨迹诊断与修复反馈）。
AI.result: MLLM评判者对人工标注的条目级F1达0.8844；TRAIL在四个评估维度上较直接提示分别提升7.89、4.98、3.45、4.47个百分点（四种MLLM平均）。
AI.conclusion: IChart2Code与TRAIL为交互式图表代码生成提供了可执行的评估标准和有效的改进框架。

title: LLM-Guided Ontology-Driven Knowledge Graph Construction from Unstructured Text
summary: Ontology-driven knowledge graph construction from industrial text remains challenging due to the domain specificity of documents, the scarcity of annotated resources, and the complexity of ontology engineering workflows. This paper presents and investigates the applicability of an ontology learning pipeline that combines compact open-source Large Language Models (LLMs), reusable prompting strategies, and open knowledge bases to support the extraction, structuring, enrichment, and evaluation of knowledge from textual corpora. The approach is tested and evaluated on a private French corpus of power-grid incident reports, using locally deployable open-source LLMs ranging from 7B to 32B parameters. Starting from unstructured reports, the approach extracts entities and relations, generates RDF triples, constructs related OWL ontology, enriches it using external knowledge sources, assesses the quality of the ontology, and subsequently constructs a populated knowledge graph grounded in the resulting ontology schema. Experiments on 80 manually annotated private reports show that schema-guided prompting significantly improves extraction quality, while quantized models provide an effective trade-off between performance and computational cost. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transforming domain-specific industrial text into ontology-based knowledge graphs using locally deployed open-source LLMs, while supporting the generalization of the extraction process through reusable prompting strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个本体学习流水线，结合紧凑开源LLM、可复用提示策略与开放知识库，从工业文本构建知识图谱，并在法国电网事故报告语料上验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 从工业文本构建知识图谱面临三大挑战：文档的领域特异性、标注资源稀缺，以及本体工程流程的复杂性。
AI.method: 采用7B–32B可本地部署的开源LLM，结合可复用提示策略与开放知识库，实现实体与关系抽取、RDF三元组生成、OWL本体构建、外部知识增强、本体质量评估，并最终构建以本体为模式的填充式知识图谱。
AI.result: 在80份人工标注的私有法语电网事故报告上实验表明：模式引导提示（schema-guided prompting）显著提升抽取质量；量化模型在性能与计算成本间取得有效平衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了使用本地部署开源LLM将领域特定工业文本转化为基于本体的知识图谱的可行性，同时通过可复用提示策略支持抽取过程的泛化。

title: Cross-Dataset Transfer and Unknown-Class Detection in Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
summary: Ship classification from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery is a critical computer vision task, yet the robustness of models under deployment shifts remains unclear. While models are often trained on one dataset and deployed on another, we lack a comprehensive understanding of their cross-dataset generalization. To address this, we evaluate six pretrained models on two SAR ship datasets in three settings: in-domain classification, cross-dataset transfer, and unknown-class detection. For unknown detection, we hold out all classes one at a time. In-domain, SARDet100K gives the best balanced accuracy on both datasets (73.4\% on FUSARShip and 53.2\% on OpenSARShip). In cross-dataset transfer, we observe strong failures: some models show moderate accuracy but near-chance balanced accuracy (for example, 64.5\% accuracy but 33.3\% balanced accuracy for OpenSARShip to FUSARShip). In unknown detection, performance depends on the held-out class and dataset, while MC-dropout variance is often close to random. These findings show that cross-dataset generalization in SAR remains limited and that task-specific uncertainty scores are often more informative than MC-dropout variance for held-out-class detection, although their relative ranking depends on the dataset and held-out class.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了6个预训练模型在2个SAR舰船数据集上的域内分类、跨数据集迁移和未知类检测，发现跨数据集泛化能力有限，MC-dropout方差在未知类检测中常接近随机。
AI.motivation: SAR图像舰船分类是重要任务，但模型在部署偏移下的鲁棒性尚不清晰，缺乏对跨数据集泛化能力的全面理解。
AI.method: 在2个SAR舰船数据集上，对6个预训练模型进行三种设置评估：域内分类、跨数据集迁移、未知类检测（逐一留出一类）。
AI.result: 域内：SARDet100K在FUSARShip(73.4%)和OpenSARShip(53.2%)上取得最佳平衡准确率。跨数据集迁移严重失败，如OpenSARShip→FUSARShip准确率64.5%但平衡准确率仅33.3%（接近随机）。未知检测性能依赖留出类与数据集，MC-dropout方差常接近随机。
AI.conclusion: SAR跨数据集泛化仍然有限，任务特定不确定性分数在留出类检测中通常比MC-dropout方差更有信息量，但相对排序依赖数据集和留出类。

title: The Complexity of Nash Equilibrium in Network Congestion and Coordination Games
summary: We show that computing a Nash equilibrium is CLS-complete for linear network congestion and network coordination games. As a result, finding a KKT point of a bilinear polynomial is CLS-complete.

AI.tldr: 本文证明线性网络拥堵博弈与网络协调博弈中计算纳什均衡是CLS完全的，进而将求解双线性多项式的KKT点也归为CLS完全问题。
AI.motivation: 研究者希望厘清不同博弈中纳什均衡计算问题的精确复杂度归属，特别是线性网络拥堵与网络协调博弈，以及双线性多项式KKT点求解的复杂度类别。
AI.method: 通过复杂性理论中的归约技术，证明计算线性网络拥堵博弈与网络协调博弈的纳什均衡属于CLS完全；并利用等价归约将求解双线性多项式KKT点问题纳入同一复杂度类。
AI.result: 线性网络拥堵博弈和网络协调博弈的纳什均衡计算是CLS完全的；双线性多项式KKT点的求解同样是CLS完全的。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果精确刻画了上述问题的复杂度下界，表明它们在CLS类中具有代表性的完全性地位。

title: Re:Cognize -- Open-Set Comic Character Re-Identification
summary: A manga reader meets a character on one page and knows them on sight a hundred pages later, without ever being handed a cast list. Re-identifying comic characters demands the same, open-set and sequential: pages arrive as a stream in reading order, new faces appear before anyone names them, and the cast is assembled as the story is read. $\textbf{Re:Cognize}$ evaluates recognition as the story is read, not against a cast handed over in advance: four protocols on one query stream, from closed-set retrieval to a cast the model must build and grow itself. The surprise is where models fail. Recognising is close to solved: one reference image per character already ranks as well as a gallery built in advance. Knowing what to believe is not: a model that adds its own matches makes its cast worse, while the same growth with correct labels would gain over twenty points of top-1 accuracy. The bottleneck is acceptance, not vision, and one comparison decides it: an addition pays exactly when it is right more often than the cast already was on the queries it takes over. The comparison has nothing to fit, and measured on half of a new corpus it calls the other half correctly. $\textbf{ReCast}$ puts it to work with nothing fitted on data: a cast sheet of one running average per character, grown only where the page itself vouches for a crop. It recovers a third to two thirds of what perfect labels would, depending on whether the cast starts from random examples or from first appearances. Re:Cognize measures whether a model can read along; ReCast is a cast that does. Our claims are on identity maintenance, recognising characters already met; the emergence of new ones is measured as a diagnostic under a fixed reference rule, and we propose no method for it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Re:Cognize 基准与 ReCast 方法，将漫画角色识别定义为开放集、顺序进行的"边读边认"任务，发现瓶颈在于"是否接纳新匹配"而非视觉识别本身。
AI.motivation: 真实阅读漫画时，角色随阅读顺序逐步出现，没有预先给定的角色清单；现有识别评测多用预先构建的封闭集 gallery，与真实场景不符，需要新的评测范式。
AI.method: Re:Cognize 在单一 query 流上设计四个协议，从封闭集检索到模型自行构建并扩充的 cast；并据此提出 ReCast——无需训练，用每个角色一个滑动平均表示，仅在页面自身为裁剪提供佐证时才扩展 cast。
AI.result: 识别本身接近解决（每角色一张参考图即可媲美预建 gallery）；但模型自行添加匹配会损害 cast，若标签正确则可提升 20+ 点 top-1。ReCast 可恢复完美标签收益的 1/3 到 2/3，其接纳判据在新语料一半上测得的判断可正确迁移到另一半。
AI.conclusion: 身份维护（识别已遇角色）是核心贡献；新角色涌现仅作为固定参考规则下的诊断指标，论文不提出相应方法。

title: Age-Adaptive Handwriting Reconstruction from an IMU-Based Digital Pen through Shared Representations and Domain-Specific Heads
summary: Digital pens are widely used to capture handwriting on digital devices, enabling precise trace recording and enhancing human-computer interaction. However, most are bundled with tablets and lack cross-brand compatibility. Recent digital pens equipped with kinematic sensors have emerged, designed for use on any surface. This especially opens significant potential for supporting handwriting acquisition in classrooms.  Handwriting reconstruction from such an IMU-equipped pen poses a challenge due to the significant variability in sensor signals between adults and children. Even when producing visually similar traces, variations in writing dynamics, motor control, pen holding, and user confidence introduce substantial discrepancies in the captured signals. Additionally, the high variability in children's handwriting requires collecting large amounts of data, which is not feasible to implement in a school environment at scale. Furthermore, models trained exclusively on adult data fail to generalize to children's handwriting, and conversely, models trained on children's data perform poorly on adult writers. This crosspopulation degradation highlights the need for a unified model that can be deployed directly on the pen, without any user-specific adaptation. To address this issue, we propose a cross-domain learning, using an original neural network architecture based on a Temporal Convolutional Network and multiple prediction heads. The model is designed to be robust across age groups by leveraging shared features while effectively handling variability induced by differences in graphomotor development. This approach aims to improve handwriting trace reconstruction from sensor data, where each domain benefits from additional data provided by the other domain.

AI.tldr: 提出跨域学习+TCN多预测头的神经网络，解决IMU数字笔在成人与儿童笔迹重建中跨群体泛化差的问题。
AI.motivation: IMU数字笔可跨表面书写，适合课堂笔迹采集，但成人与儿童在书写动态、运动控制等方面差异大，导致信号分布不同；儿童数据难大规模采集，且成人/儿童单域模型互相泛化差，需无需用户适配的统一模型。
AI.method: 采用跨域学习策略，设计基于时序卷积网络（TCN）与多预测头的原始神经网络架构；通过共享特征提升跨年龄组鲁棒性，同时处理因书写运动发展差异带来的变异性。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果，仅指出该方法旨在利用两域互补数据提升传感器数据的笔迹轨迹重建效果。
AI.conclusion: 跨域学习结合TCN与多预测头可望构建无需用户特定适配的统一笔迹重建模型，缓解成人—儿童跨群体性能退化问题。

title: Concepts Complement Dense Semantics: Learning Compact Sparse Spaces for Text-Image Retrieval
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at KEIR@CIKM 2026
summary: Cross-modal retrieval has been advanced by vision-language pre-trained models that encode images and texts into a shared dense embedding space. While dense representations effectively capture overall semantic similarity, they often obscure fine-grained visual-textual information needed for precise cross-modal matching. Recent methods introduce a learned sparse branch to complement dense matching with lexical evidence, but they rely on a redundant language-model token space and lack explicit grounding for sparse dimensions. We propose GRASP, a compact and grounded sparse learning framework that mines visual-textual concepts from the corpus. A lightweight sparse head is trained to predict concepts relevant to each image or text, yielding interpretable concept-level evidence that complements dense semantic matching. Extensive experiments show that GRASP improves retrieval accuracy over the state-of-the-art dense-sparse baselines while yielding a more compact and grounded sparse space.

AI.tldr: GRASP是一个紧凑且有依据的稀疏学习框架，通过从语料中挖掘视觉-文本概念来改进跨模态检索的稠密-稀疏匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态检索中，稠密表示虽能捕捉整体语义相似性，但模糊了精确匹配所需的细粒度视觉-文本信息；近期引入的稀疏分支依赖冗余的语言模型词元空间，且稀疏维度缺乏显式依据。
AI.method: 提出GRASP框架，从语料中挖掘视觉-文本概念，训练轻量级稀疏头预测与每张图像或文本相关的概念，产生可解释的概念级证据以补充稠密语义匹配。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GRASP在检索准确率上优于最先进的稠密-稀疏基线，同时得到更紧凑、更有依据的稀疏空间。
AI.conclusion: GRASP通过有依据的概念级稀疏学习，在提升跨模态检索精度的同时实现更紧凑且可解释的稀疏表示。

title: How AI Changes DevOps Performance: A Mechanism-Based Simulation
summary: Context. AI tools for software development have progressed from code completion to autonomous agents, yet evidence on their effects on DORA performance is mixed, mostly cross-sectional, and often conflates AI-generated code (AGC) with agentic AI (AGT). Objective. We examine how AGC and AGT, separately and jointly, affect deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, recovery time, and deployment rework rate. Method. We audit the evidence, formalise a two-construct model with four capability moderators, and implement a discrete-event simulation of a delivery pipeline. Six experiments include a factorial design, Shapley decompositions, sensitivity analysis over 600 parameter draws, a fixed-demand robustness test, and a staggered-adoption panel of 5,000 simulated teams with counterfactuals. Results. AGC increased failure rate, rework, and recovery time in both capability profiles. When AI increased change volume, AGC shortened lead time only where review capacity was spare (-13%) and lengthened it once review saturated; in the low-capability team, its deployment-frequency gain came entirely from unplanned rework. AGT improved deployment frequency (+31% to +34%), lead time (-8% to -22%), and recovery time (-29% to -38%), but its stability effect depended on autonomous CI repair masking defects, and escaped defects increased in the high-capability team. Capability reduced AGC's absolute failure-rate penalty (7.9 vs. 1.5 points) but not its relative penalty (+34% vs. +84%). Two-way fixed effects underestimated adoption effects by 8-16%; detecting the modelled stability effect required about 50 teams, and its capability moderation about 400. Conclusions. Within the model, DORA metrics respond to AI through queueing, batching, and oversight, not only code quality. We derive measurement rules, guardrails for agentic remediation, and a sample-size-informed field-validation protocol.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过系统性证据审计、双构念模型与离散事件仿真，区分AI生成代码(AGC)与智能体AI(AGT)对DORA绩效的影响，发现两者效应机制不同且高度依赖团队能力与审查容量。
AI.motivation: 现有关于AI对软件开发绩效(如DORA指标)影响的证据观点不一、多为横截面研究，且常将AI生成代码(AGC)与智能体AI(AGT)混为一谈，缺乏对二者独立及联合效应的因果性与机制性理解。
AI.method: 审计现有证据；形式化含四个能力调节变量的双构念模型；实现交付流水线的离散事件仿真；开展六项实验——因子设计、Shapley分解、600次参数抽样敏感性分析、固定需求稳健性测试，以及含反事实的5,000个模拟团队的错时采纳面板分析。
AI.result: AGC在两种能力情境下均增加失败率、返工与恢复时间；仅在审查容量有冗余时缩短交付周期(-13%)，审查饱和后反而延长，低能力团队的部署频率提升完全来自非计划返工。AGT提升部署频率(+31%~+34%)、缩短交付周期(-8%~-22%)与恢复时间(-29%~-38%)，但其稳定性依赖自主CI修复掩盖缺陷，高能力团队逃逸缺陷增加。能力降低了AGC失败率的绝对惩罚(7.9 vs 1.5个百分点)而非相对惩罚(+34% vs +84%)。双向固定效应低估采纳效应8-16%；检测稳定性效应约需50个团队，检测能力调节约需400个。
AI.conclusion: 在模型内，DORA指标对AI的响应通过排队、批处理与监督机制而非仅代码质量实现。论文据此提出测量规则、智能体修复的护栏措施，以及基于样本量的实地验证方案。

title: What Drives Dialectal Jailbreaks? An Ablation of Surface Form, Cultural Framing, and Strategy Banks
comment: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2026, 15 pages, 12 tables
summary: Recent work suggests that obscure language registers can weaken large language model refusal behavior, especially when paired with black-box prompt optimization. It remains unclear whether failures stem from non-standard surface form, culturally grounded framing, or optimization over an expressive prompt-strategy space. We study Chinese registers by extending a classical-Chinese red-teaming framework to Shanghainese and Cantonese and running a 36-cell ablation across surface forms, strategy-bank variants, and two target models. The main finding is corrective: dialectal surface form is neither necessary nor sufficient for high attack success. Non-optimized English, Mandarin, and naive dialect translations remain below 8\% attack success rate, whereas all conditions that retain an optimizer-controlled strategy bank reach 98--100\%. A culture-neutral generic strategy bank reaches the same ceiling at near-single-query cost, further indicating that strategy-bank expressiveness, rather than dialectal or cultural content, accounts for most of the observed effect. Dialect choice still affects query efficiency and response severity, and qualitative coding identifies recurring high-level mechanisms such as semantic glossing and procedural scaffolding. We qualify the absolute ceiling-level attack success rate by showing sensitivity to judge calibration and noting that the design does not fully separate one-shot strategy construction from iterative search.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过将古典中文红队框架扩展到上海话和粤语，进行36格消融实验，发现方言表面形式并非高攻击成功率的关键；主要驱动因素是优化器控制的策略库的表达能力，而非方言或文化内容。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明晦涩语言寄存器可削弱大语言模型拒绝行为，尤其结合黑盒提示优化时，但不清楚失败源于非标准表面形式、文化框架还是策略空间优化。论文旨在厘清这些因素。
AI.method: 扩展古典中文红队框架至上海话和粤语，运行36格消融实验，涵盖表面形式、策略库变体和两个目标模型。
AI.result: 非优化英语、普通话和朴素方言翻译的攻击成功率低于8%；所有保留优化器控制策略库的条件达到98-100%。文化中立的通用策略库以近乎单查询成本达到相同上限。方言选择影响查询效率和响应严重度，定性编码识别出语义注解和程序性脚手架等机制。结果对评判校准敏感，设计未完全分离一次性策略构建与迭代搜索。
AI.conclusion: 策略库表达能力而非方言或文化内容解释了大部分观察到的效应。方言表面形式对高攻击成功率既非必要也非充分。

title: ForensicZoom: Adaptive Visual Inspection with Multimodal LLMs for Industrial-Grade Face Forgery Detection
summary: Reliable face forgery detection is critical to the security of online identity verification systems, where missed attacks compromise security and excessive false positives disrupt legitimate users. Specialized forensic detectors achieve strong detection performance but provide limited interpretability, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer strong semantic understanding and interpretable reasoning yet remain substantially weaker for face forgery detection. We argue that a key limitation lies in how visual evidence is acquired: subtle forensic artifacts may be poorly represented at standard resolution, while uniformly processing all cases at higher resolution is computationally inefficient. We therefore introduce ForensicZoom, an industrial-grade MLLM framework for adaptive visual inspection. ForensicZoom first equips a general-purpose MLLM with forensic-aware visual representations and aligns the language model with these features. Its central mechanism, NEED_ZOOM, enables the model to autonomously request magnified views of suspicious regions when the initial evidence is insufficient, turning fixed-pass classification into adaptive multi-round forensic reasoning. The zoom behavior is learned through reward shaping that balances detection accuracy with unnecessary visual inspection, concentrating additional computation on difficult cases. A final attribution optimization stage improves natural-language forensic reports while preserving detection performance. On large-scale industrial identity verification data, ForensicZoom achieves over 97% TPR at 0.1% FPR, substantially outperforming both specialized detectors and existing MLLM-based methods while producing actionable forensic attributions. These results demonstrate that ForensicZoom can provide an effective path toward accurate, interpretable, and scalable MLLM-based face forgery detection.

AI.tldr: ForensicZoom 是一个工业级 MLLM 框架，通过自适应放大可疑区域实现高精度、可解释的人脸伪造检测。
AI.motivation: 专用取证检测器性能强但可解释性差；MLLM 语义理解与推理可解释，但人脸伪造检测能力弱。关键限制在于视觉证据获取方式：固定分辨率难以表征细微伪造痕迹，统一高分辨率又计算低效。
AI.method: 为通用 MLLM 配备取证感知视觉表示并对齐语言模型；核心机制 NEED_ZOOM 让模型在初始证据不足时自主请求放大可疑区域，将固定单次分类转为自适应多轮取证推理；通过奖励塑形学习缩放行为，平衡检测精度与不必要的视觉检查；最后用归因优化阶段提升自然语言取证报告质量。
AI.result: 在大规模工业身份验证数据上，0.1% FPR 下 TPR 超过 97%，显著优于专用检测器和现有 MLLM 方法，同时生成可操作的取证归因。
AI.conclusion: ForensicZoom 为准确、可解释、可扩展的 MLLM 人脸伪造检测提供了有效路径。

title: Fair Share Allocations for Almost All Agents
summary: We study fair allocation of indivisible goods among agents with additive valuations. Our main result guarantees every agent her exact AnyPrice Share (APS) whenever the total entitlement is at most $1-\varepsilon$ and each individual entitlement is sufficiently small. For equal entitlements, this yields a $1$-out-of-$(n+O(\sqrt{n\log n}))$ maximin share (MMS) allocation. We also establish two best-of-both-worlds guarantees that preserve proportionality in expectation: each agent receives her full MMS with probability at least $1-O((\log n/n)^{1/3})$, or every agent receives her $1$-out-of-$(n+O(n^{2/3}(\log n)^{1/3}))$ MMS in every outcome. Both guarantees extend to sufficiently small unequal entitlements, with APS replacing MMS. Quantitatively, our deterministic result allows an entitlement cap of order $\varepsilon^2/\log(1/\varepsilon)$, while an impossibility construction shows that any universally sufficient cap must be $O(\varepsilon)$.

AI.tldr: 研究不可分物品的公平分配，给出每个代理人获得精确APS的保证，并导出等额时的MMS近似与两个best-of-both-worlds结果。
AI.motivation: 在可加估值下追求更强的公平保证：让每个代理人达到其精确的AnyPrice Share（APS），并同时兼顾确定性与期望比例性。
AI.method: 在总权利至多1-ε且单个权利足够小时，构造分配保证每个代理人获得精确APS；对等额情形导出1/(n+O(√(n log n)))的MMS分配；并给出两个best-of-both-worlds保证及不可行性构造。
AI.result: 等额时得到1-out-of-(n+O(√(n log n))) MMS；best-of-both-worlds下，每个代理人以至少1-O((log n/n)^{1/3})概率获得完整MMS，或每个结果中每人获1-out-of-(n+O(n^{2/3}(log n)^{1/3})) MMS。确定性结果允许权利上限约ε²/log(1/ε)，而不可行性表明通用充分上限必须为O(ε)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强化了APS/MMS在不可分物品公平分配中的保证，并给出了权利上限的上下界；结果可扩展到足够小的不等权利情形，用APS替代MMS。

title: SyncRA: Learning Temporal Correspondence in Omni-Modal Models
summary: Recent omni-modal models demonstrate strong perception of audio and visual inputs, yet often struggle to connect what they hear with what they see at the same moment. This weakness in temporal correspondence can cause models to associate spoken cues with the wrong visual scenes, producing plausible answers grounded in incorrect audio-visual pairings. We diagnose this problem through controlled temporal swaps, revealing that model answers do not reliably follow changes in these pairings. To address it, we propose Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment (SyncRA), a lightweight method for strengthening temporal correspondence between audio and vision. Specifically, SyncRA contrasts intermediate audio-visual representations within each video, aligning matching moments while separating mismatched ones to capture local temporal correspondence within a shared global context. The objective derives supervision directly from existing input timing, requiring no additional annotations and leaving inference unchanged. We evaluate SyncRA across four open omni-modal models spanning different sizes and architectures on five public video benchmarks. SyncRA consistently outperforms answer-only fine-tuning across all model-benchmark combinations, while substantially improving the ability to track changing audio-visual pairings in controlled evaluations. These results demonstrate that lightweight, targeted supervision can effectively strengthen temporal correspondence and translate into broad improvements in audio-visual question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SyncRA，一种轻量级方法，通过对齐音视频中间表征来增强时序对应关系，在四种全模态模型和五个视频基准上均超越仅答案微调。
AI.motivation: 全模态模型虽具备音视频感知能力，但难以将同一时刻所听与所见联系起来，时序对应薄弱，会将语音线索错误关联到视觉场景，导致答案看似合理但基于错误的音视频配对。
AI.method: 通过受控时间交换诊断问题；提出SyncRA，在每个视频内对比中间音视频表征，对齐匹配时刻、分离不匹配时刻，从而在共享全局上下文中捕捉局部时序对应。监督直接来自现有输入时序，无需额外标注，推理过程不变。
AI.result: 在四种不同规模和架构的开放全模态模型、五个公开视频基准上评估，SyncRA在所有模型-基准组合中一致优于仅答案微调，并在受控评估中大幅提升跟踪变化音视频配对的能力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量、有针对性的监督可有效增强时序对应关系，并转化为音视频问答的广泛性能提升。

title: Unsupervised spiking feature learning for event-based pedestrian crossing detection: approaching supervised accuracy without labelled training data
summary: Event cameras are well suited to pedestrian crossing detection, and spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process their output natively, but current SNN detectors are trained with supervised backpropagation and therefore require costly frame-level crossing labels. We investigate crossing detection with no labels in feature learning and report the first unsupervised results on the recent DVS-PedX pedestrian-crossing benchmark. A single spiking layer trained with winner-take-all spike-timing-dependent plasticity learns a dictionary from unlabelled event-frame patches; frames are encoded by cosine similarity to the learned filters with spatial pooling and read out by a linear classifier, the only supervised component. On the 24,454-frame test split the method attains 90.3% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.936, compared with 92.0% and 0.943 for a supervised spiking network trained end-to-end on the same frames; under adverse weather the AUROC is 0.913. The result is insensitive to the choice of plasticity rule but depends strongly on the readout protocol: with the classical neuron-assignment readout the same network attains only 0.70 AUROC. On the benchmark's real converted portion, a readout refit lifts performance from chance (0.53) to 0.67 AUROC, within the published supervised range. These findings indicate that the accuracy cost of removing labels from feature learning is small on this benchmark, and that reported weaknesses of unsupervised spiking networks may be attributable to the readout protocol rather than to the learning rule.

AI.tldr: 首次在DVS-PedX行人过街基准上实现无监督SNN检测，AUROC达0.936，接近有监督水平。
AI.motivation: 现有SNN检测器依赖监督反向传播，需要昂贵的帧级过街标签，作者希望探索特征学习阶段无需标签的过街检测方案。
AI.method: 用单层脉冲网络结合WTA-STDP从无标签事件帧patch中学习字典；帧通过余弦相似度编码、空间池化，仅由线性分类器（唯一的监督部分）读出。
AI.result: 在24,454帧测试集上达到90.3%准确率和0.936 AUROC，对比有监督SNN的92.0%和0.943；恶劣天气AUROC为0.913。结果对可塑性规则不敏感，但强依赖读出协议——经典神经元分配读出仅0.70 AUROC；真实转换部分经读出重拟合从0.53提升至0.67。
AI.conclusion: 在该基准上，去掉特征学习标签的精度代价很小；无监督脉冲网络的表现弱点可能源于读出协议而非学习规则本身。

title: RandSlot: Learning Compact Visual Document Representations with Random Soft Tokens
summary: Visual document retrieval requires expressive representations to match queries with evidence distributed across text, tables, and page layouts. Multi-vector representations capture fine-grained information, but storing and comparing many vectors introduces substantial retrieval costs. In this paper, we introduce RandSlot, a simple approach to learn compact visual document representations with random soft tokens. During training, we append independently-sampled random unit vectors to query and document input sequences and resample them at every use, without introducing learnable soft-token parameters. The encoder contextualizes these auxiliary inputs with the original content to produce a small set of retrieval vectors. A standard late-interaction objective trains the encoder to extract relevant information under varying input conditions. Experiments with different backbone models show that RandSlot improves retrieval quality over alternative readout strategies under the same vector budget. Further analysis shows that these gains can persist when random soft tokens are replaced with zeros at inference, demonstrating that random inputs during training can improve compact retrieval representations even when inference no longer requires sampling.

AI.tldr: RandSlot 通过在训练时向查询和文档序列追加随机软令牌，学习紧凑的多向量视觉文档表示，提升检索质量且降低存储与比较成本。
AI.motivation: 视觉文档检索需匹配分散在文本、表格和页面布局中的证据。多向量表示能捕获细粒度信息，但存储和比较多向量带来高昂检索成本。本文旨在学习紧凑的视觉文档表示以缓解该问题。
AI.method: 提出 RandSlot：训练时向查询与文档输入序列追加独立采样的随机单位向量，每次使用重新采样，不引入可学习软令牌参数；编码器将其与原始内容上下文化，产生少量检索向量；用标准 late-interaction 目标训练，使编码器在不同输入条件下抽取相关信息。
AI.result: 在不同骨干模型上，RandSlot 在相同向量预算下优于其他 readout 策略，提升检索质量。进一步分析表明，推理时将随机软令牌替换为零，增益仍可保持。
AI.conclusion: 训练时使用随机输入可以改善紧凑检索表示，即使推理阶段不再需要采样，这为降低多向量检索成本提供了简单有效途径。

title: Beyond the Model: Demystifying Harness Effects in Software Engineering Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used for software engineering tasks, yet their performance is not determined by the base model alone. The agent harness substantially shapes how SE agents interact with repositories, execute actions, and validate solutions. However, the role of harness design remains insufficiently understood, especially across different models, tasks, and harness components. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical study of harness effects in SE agents. We first evaluate two representative harnesses, mini-SWE-agent and OpenCode, with ten models from two prominent open-weight model families, Qwen and DeepSeek, on three benchmarks: SWE-bench Pro, ProgramBench, and GitTaskBench. We then construct NanoHarness, a lightweight modular harness built on top of mini-SWE-agent, and use it to analyze five representative harness components: tool registry, context compression, explicit planning, subagents, and lazy skills. Experimental results show that harness effectiveness depends jointly on model capability and task type. Complex harnesses provide diminishing marginal gains on SWE-style issue repair as model capability improves, but can benefit stronger models on more complex and open-ended repository-level tasks. Component-level analysis on ProgramBench further shows that structured tool use and task-specific subagents provide the most stable improvements, while context compression and general subagents can hurt repository-generation performance. When combined, NanoHarness improves over mini-SWE-agent by 7.37 and 6.21 percentage points on Qwen3.7-Max and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, respectively, recovering most of the gains of product-level harnesses. These findings highlight harness design as a first-class factor in SE-agent performance and provide insights for building more effective and efficient coding agents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了SE智能体中harness设计的作用：评估两种harness在十种模型、三个基准上的表现，构建NanoHarness分析五个组件，发现harness效果依赖模型能力与任务类型。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在软件工程任务中的表现不仅取决于基础模型，harness对交互、执行和验证有重大影响，但harness设计的作用尚缺乏系统理解，尤其跨模型、任务和组件维度。
AI.method: 评估mini-SWE-agent和OpenCode两种harness，用Qwen和DeepSeek两大家族共十个模型，在SWE-bench Pro、ProgramBench、GitTaskBench三个基准测试；构建轻量模块化harness NanoHarness，分析工具注册、上下文压缩、显式规划、子智能体、懒加载技能五个组件。
AI.result: harness效果依赖模型能力与任务类型；复杂harness在SWE类问题修复上随模型增强收益递减，但在复杂开放式仓库任务上利好强模型；结构化工具使用和任务特定子智能体提升最稳定，上下文压缩和通用子智能体可能损害仓库生成性能；NanoHarness在Qwen3.7-Max和DeepSeek-V4-Pro上分别比mini-SWE-agent提升7.37和6.21个百分点，追回大部分产品级harness收益。
AI.conclusion: harness设计是SE智能体性能的一等因素，为构建更有效、高效的编程智能体提供了洞见。

title: Learning Steadily: Accumulating Relative Point Margin Scores for Face Image Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Biometrics, Behavior, and Identity Science
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment determines the suitability of captured face images for automated face recognition (FR), a critical capability for reliable biometric systems. Existing state-of-the-art FR-integrated FIQA methods suffer from temporal instability: as the feature space evolves during training, single-epoch quality estimates fluctuate, creating a moving target that undermines reliable quality prediction. We introduce CARPM-FIQA, a stabilization strategy for FR-integrated FIQA that accumulates relative point margin measurements, the ratio between intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, across the entire training trajectory rather than relying on single-epoch estimates. This cumulative averaging approach provides theoretically grounded advantages: reduced variance in quality estimates, improved mean squared error, and enhanced ranking stability with convergence guarantees as training progresses. Through controlled experiments on the SynFIQA dataset with labeled quality groups, we demonstrate that cumulative averaging achieves superior discriminative ability, and ablation studies across different training configurations confirm consistent improvements. Evaluated against twelve FIQA methods on eight challenging benchmarks with four FR models at two FMR thresholds, CARPM-FIQA places 4th (CARPM-FIQA(L)) and 6th (CARPM-FIQA(S)) of 17 compared methods by pAUC-EDC and AUC-EDC averaged across FR models and, after per-benchmark normalization, across benchmarks, staying within a few percent of the best method's normalized average for every FR model, providing a principled solution to training instability while maintaining the performance benefits of FR integration. More broadly, our work demonstrates that temporal aggregation strategies can stabilize training objectives in deep learning systems where target values inherently fluctuate due to evolving feature representations.

AI.tldr: 提出 CARPM-FIQA，通过在整个训练过程中累积相对点间隔测量来稳定 FR 集成的 FIQA，缓解单epoch质量估计波动问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 FR 集成的 FIQA 方法存在时间不稳定性：特征空间随训练演化导致单epoch质量估计波动，形成移动目标，损害可靠的质量预测。
AI.method: 累积相对点间隔测量（类内紧凑度与类间分离度之比），跨越整个训练轨迹进行累积平均，而非依赖单epoch估计；提供理论收敛保证，减少方差、改善MSE、增强排序稳定性。
AI.result: 在 SynFIQA 数据集上验证了更优的区分能力；在八个基准、四个FR模型、两个FMR阈值下与十二种FIQA方法对比，CARPM-FIQA(L)排名第4、CARPM-FIQA(S)排名第6（共17种），各FR模型归一化平均接近最佳方法几个百分点内。
AI.conclusion: 为训练不稳定性提供了有原则的解决方案，同时保持FR集成的性能优势；证明时间聚合策略可稳定目标值因特征表示演化而波动的深度学习系统训练目标。

title: When Privacy Moves ML-Mediated Decisions On Device: Information and Incentive Misalignment in Auctions
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Previously submitted to the Economics for Machine Learning (EconML) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/sarkar-dipankar/on-device-auction-audit
summary: Moving ML-mediated decision making onto privacy-preserving clients decentralises the economic decision along with the inference. Shared budget constraints then depend on information that cannot be globally current, creating an information-structure failure that conventional pacing is not designed to solve. We study this information misalignment in an auction-logic-faithful on-device simulation with 36 campaigns and 50 devices. Accounting is in dimensionless integer score units; no currency semantics are claimed. Across 30 paired demand paths, proportional Even pacing overspends 17.77% after one tick of staleness and 1,669.31% after 50 ticks under the original 20-times budget pressure. The effect does not depend on that severe a budget: at two-times pressure, 50-tick overspend remains 106.95%. A visible-budget no-sale guard makes zero-lag compliance exact at this score-unit granularity, yet leaves 11.88% overspend at one tick because other devices' debits remain invisible. A declared bursty, heterogeneous-device sweep retains a strictly increasing mean lag curve. We derive a finite-window expected excess-debit bound under conditional charge caps and find positive paired slack in every bounded-value cell. A second, incentive misalignment arises when the ML/pacing score transformation is allowed to change payment units: 98.23% of rival auctions at one tick admit a profitable deviation. An executable implementation-level counterexample isolates the runner-up's multiplier in the winner's price. Critical-base-bid payment is per-auction DSIC conditional on current multipliers, but does not establish dynamic truthfulness and does not repair base-value ranking disagreement.

AI.tldr: 在去中心化设备上进行竞价式预算投放时，信息不同步导致节流机制严重超支，且ML评分转换会引入激励错位。
AI.motivation: 将ML决策推理下放到隐私保护客户端后，共享预算约束依赖无法全局实时的信息，造成传统节流无法解决的信息结构失配。
AI.method: 在忠于拍卖逻辑的端上模拟（36个广告系列、50台设备、30条需求路径、无量纲整数评分单位）中研究信息错位，并提出基于条件收费上限的有限窗口期望超额借记界。
AI.result: 比例Even节流在1跳后超支17.77%、50跳后1,669.31%（20倍压力）；2倍压力下50跳超支106.95%。可见预算的no-sale守卫在零延迟下精确合规，但1跳仍有11.88%超支。允许ML/节流评分转换改变支付单位时，98.23%的对手拍卖在1跳存在有利可图偏离。临界基础出价支付在给定当前乘数下逐拍卖DSIC，但不保证动态真实性，也不修复基础价值排序分歧。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化预算节流存在信息与激励双重错位，现有节流和DSIC条件无法解决动态真实性与排序分歧，需新的机制设计。

title: Joint and Cross-Modal Video-Audio Generation and Editing: A Unified Formulation and Design Taxonomy
summary: Video and audio are perceived together, yet most generative models treat them in isolation. We examine methods that model the two modalities jointly, generate one from the other, or edit them in a coupled manner, organized around a single question: how is the output kept coherent across modalities in time and semantics? A unified formulation casts joint generation, cross-modal generation, and joint editing as three problems defined on a single distribution over audio-visual pairs, and a taxonomy compares methods along five design axes. To our knowledge, this is the first overview to systematically taxonomize joint audio-visual editing, which we map as nine edit categories spanning 28 edit types. We describe methods, datasets, and metrics for each setting and close with the open problems we view as most consequential.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于音视频联合生成与编辑的综述，提出统一形式化和五维分类法，首次系统梳理联合音视频编辑（9大类、28种类型），并总结方法、数据集、指标与开放问题。
AI.motivation: 音视频在感知中是协同的，但多数生成模型将其孤立处理，缺乏跨模态一致性的系统梳理。
AI.method: 以"如何在时间与语义上保持跨模态输出一致性"为核心问题，将联合生成、跨模态生成、联合编辑统一建模为音视频对分布上的三类问题；用五条设计轴对方法进行对比分类，并系统归纳联合音视频编辑为9类编辑、28种类型。
AI.result: 形成统一形式化框架与分类法，覆盖各任务的方法、数据集与评价指标，并首次对联合音视频编辑进行系统分类。
AI.conclusion: 为音视频联合生成与编辑提供统一视角与分类体系，并指出最具价值的开放问题。

title: LukeNet: A lightweight CNN integrated with an XAI model for Smart acute lymphoblastic leukemia detection and management
summary: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) patients require early, accurate detection to enable timely treatment and effective patient management. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is well-suited for creating an end-to-end enabling environment for ALL detection and classification. However, most CNN-based ALL detection systems are theoretical and unsuitable for deployment on edge devices due to high computational demands. The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT)-enabled devices offer an opportunity to monitor ALL patients in real time. Wearables that track temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and activity can deliver critical data to support timely clinical intervention and improve patient outcomes. In smart IoMT environments, a lightweight CNN is essential because connected devices often operate under limited computational power, memory, and latency constraints. To address this need, this study proposes LukeNet, a lightweight CNN integrated with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) for an IoMT-based SMART Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Detection and Management System. Trained on three (3) ALL datasets and five-fold cross-validation, LukeNet achieved an impressive 99% model accuracy as well as 99% unseen test accuracy, which is higher than six state-of-the-art (SOTA) CNNs, such as DenseNet121, MobileNet, ResNet50, InceptionV3, Xception, and VGG16, as well as transfer learning models. Furthermore, LukeNet was compared with two ensemble models. In addition, explainable AI methods are integrated to highlight relevant regions in microscopic images. The novelty of this study lies in the architecture of LukeNet, which balances model depth and computational efficiency by using depthwise separable convolutions, mitigates the risk of gradient loss in deeper layers, and provides strong global and local feature extraction capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级CNN模型LukeNet，结合XAI用于IoMT环境下的急性淋巴细胞白血病(ALL)检测与管理，在三个数据集上达到99%准确率，优于六种SOTA CNN及集成模型。
AI.motivation: ALL需早期准确检测以支持及时治疗。多数CNN-based ALL检测系统计算量大、偏理论，难以部署于边缘设备；而IoMT可穿戴设备算力、内存、延迟受限，因此需要轻量级CNN实现实时监测。
AI.method: 提出LukeNet——一个集成可解释AI(XAI)的轻量级CNN，用于IoMT的SMART ALL检测与管理系统。采用深度可分离卷积平衡网络深度与计算效率，缓解深层梯度消失问题，增强全局与局部特征提取。基于3个ALL数据集和五折交叉验证训练，并与6种SOTA CNN及迁移学习、2种集成模型对比。
AI.result: LukeNet达到99%模型准确率和99%未见测试准确率，优于DenseNet121、MobileNet、ResNet50、InceptionV3、Xception、VGG16等6种SOTA CNN以及迁移学习模型；与两种集成模型对比亦占优。XAI方法可高亮显微图像中的相关区域。
AI.conclusion: LukeNet通过轻量架构在IoMT环境下实现高效准确的ALL检测与管理，兼顾性能与计算效率，并提供可解释性，适合边缘设备部署。

title: Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation
comment: RecSys '26: 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems
summary: Recommender systems rely heavily on heterogeneous behavioral feedback to infer user preference. Although abundant, these signals are imperfect measurements: the same observed behavior can arise from different underlying states, such as genuine enjoyment, passive consumption, or inattention. The challenge is especially acute in short-form video, where watch-based signals are strongly affected by measurement confounders such as video duration - the same watch time can imply different levels of preference for videos of different lengths, while ratio-based metrics can systematically favor short videos. As a result, optimizing raw engagement can amplify measurement artifacts rather than improving user value. We propose a Factorized Latent Value Model (FLVM) for measuring user preference from heterogeneous behavioral feedback. The model treats observed behaviors as noisy measurements of a low-dimensional, factorized latent value state and uses structured output heads to model heterogeneous feedback signals. A restricted baseline path captures predictable variation from measurement-confounding features such as video duration, user propensity, and session context, while a routed latent path estimates preference-relevant value advantage. The resulting latent value score can be integrated into an existing recommender system as a ranking feature or ranking score. On YouTube Shorts, a major short-form video platform, this model improves offline metrics and lifts a primary viewer enjoyment metric by 2.67% in online A/B tests.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Factorized Latent Value Model (FLVM)，将异构行为反馈视为低维、因子化潜在价值状态的噪声测量，分离测量混淆因素与真实偏好，在YouTube Shorts上提升离线指标并使主要观看享受指标在线提升2.67%。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统依赖异构行为反馈推断偏好，但观察到的行为是不完美的测量：相同行为可能源于真实喜爱、被动消费或注意力缺失等不同状态。短视频场景中问题尤为突出，观看类信号受视频时长等测量混淆因素强烈影响（相同时长对长短视频含义不同），比率类指标系统性偏好短视频，直接优化原始参与度会放大测量伪影而非提升用户价值。
AI.method: 提出FLVM，将观察行为视为低维因子化潜在价值状态的噪声测量，用结构化输出头建模异构反馈信号；包含受限基线路径（捕捉视频时长、用户倾向、会话上下文等测量混淆特征带来的可预测变化）和路由潜在路径（估计与偏好相关的价值优势）。所得潜在价值分数可作为排序特征或排序分数集成到现有推荐系统中。
AI.result: 在YouTube Shorts上，模型改善了离线指标，并在在线A/B测试中将主要观看享受指标提升2.67%。
AI.conclusion: FLVM能有效从异构行为反馈中测量用户偏好，将测量混淆因素与真实偏好解耦，可无缝集成到现有推荐系统，并在大规模短视频平台取得显著在线收益。

title: Evolution of Deprecated APIs and Their Replacements in Python Libraries
summary: Context: API deprecation is common in library evolution, but migration requires finding replacements and adapting calls. Prior studies examine deprecation, replacement identification, and client migration separately, leaving deprecated API-replacement API relationships across releases and lifecycle states insufficiently understood. Objective: We examine replacement locality, parameter-interface differences, changes in replacement rankings across versions, and post-deprecation lifecycles from source-definition and original-invocation perspectives. Method: We construct 830 maintainer-specified mappings from 33 Python libraries, covering classes, functions, and methods. We compare definitions, track similarity-based rankings under two migration scenarios, and identify lifecycle events through source inspection and release-by-release execution. Results: Same-module replacements account for 39.1%, 55.6%, and 79.9% of class, function, and method mappings, respectively. Most mappings have no parameter changes, but function mappings show more frequent and diverse changes. Rankings vary across releases and code representations, and the applicable methods agree on the overall trend in only about 60% of cases. Other-candidate effects are dominant or mixed in 49.0% of key versions. After deprecation, 56.4% of mappings retain the source definition and 68.6% retain an executable original invocation. Among 753 mappings with at least one observed ending event, 25.2% are source-first or invocation-first rather than same-release. Of these cases, 77.4% are source-first. Conclusions: Deprecated API-replacement API relationships depend on API granularity, release context, code representation, candidate competition, and lifecycle state. These results support evolution-aware replacement API recommendation and automated API migration.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Python库中弃用API与替代API的关系，构建33个库的830个映射，从替换局部性、参数差异、跨版本排名变化及弃用后生命周期四方面分析。
AI.motivation: 既有研究将弃用、替换识别与客户端迁移分开考察，对跨版本及生命周期状态的弃用API-替代API关系理解不足。
AI.method: 构建830个维护者指定的映射（涵盖类、函数、方法），比较定义、在两种迁移场景下追踪基于相似度的排名，并通过源代码检查与逐版本执行识别生命周期事件。
AI.result: 同模块替换在类/函数/方法中分别占39.1%、55.6%、79.9%；多数映射无参数变化但函数变化更频繁多样；排名随版本和代码表示变化，适用方法仅在约60%情况下趋势一致；其他候选效应在49.0%关键版本中主导或混合；弃用后56.4%保留源定义、68.6%保留可执行原始调用；753个映射中25.2%非同期结束，其中77.4%为源优先。
AI.conclusion: 弃用API-替代API关系取决于API粒度、版本上下文、代码表示、候选竞争与生命周期状态，可支持演化感知的替换推荐与自动API迁移。

title: An Evaluation of AI-Supported Evidence-Based Learning for Public Speaking Skill Development
comment: Proceedings of the 54th Annual Conference of the European Society for Engineering Education (SEFI 2026)
summary: Public speaking is an essential skill in academic and professional contexts, but it often causes anxiety. Although several AI-based speech coaching tools exist, they typically provide generic feedback and lack model speeches for learning. This study addresses these gaps by developing a system that incorporates speech context into evaluation criteria, enabling more tailored feedback. It also generates improved model speeches in both text and audio formats to support example-based learning. The system was evaluated in a pilot study with seven undergraduate students over one to three weeks. Participants used the system repeatedly and practiced the same speech at least three times. Results showed improvements in public speaking performance for all participants. Filler word usage decreased, and anxiety levels dropped by 15.3% to 34.4%. Participants found the context-aware feedback and revised speeches useful and confidence-building. These findings suggest that context-aware feedback and model speeches can enhance public speaking skills and reduce anxiety. Future studies could explore video-based analysis of physical behavior during speeches.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个将演讲情境纳入评价标准的AI演讲辅导系统，可提供个性化反馈并生成改进的示例演讲稿（文本与音频），初步实验表明能提升演讲表现、减少填充词并降低焦虑。
AI.motivation: 公开演讲是学业与职业中的关键技能，但常引发焦虑。现有AI演讲辅导工具多提供通用反馈，且缺乏可供学习的示范演讲，存在明显缺口。
AI.method: 系统将演讲情境纳入评价标准以实现定制化反馈，并生成文本与音频两种形式的改进示范演讲以支持示例学习。对7名本科生开展1至3周的试点研究，参与者重复使用系统并就同一演讲练习至少3次。
AI.result: 所有参与者的演讲表现均有提升；填充词使用减少，焦虑水平下降15.3%至34.4%；参与者认为情境感知反馈与修订后的演讲有用且有助于建立信心。
AI.conclusion: 情境感知反馈与示范演讲能提升公开演讲能力并减轻焦虑；未来可探索对演讲中身体行为的视频分析。

title: Language-Augmented Video Action Anticipation: Design Fundamentals, Benchmarks, and Open Challenges
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Review article. Supplementary material, machine-readable data, and public artifacts are available at https://github.com/mahsa7290/language-augmented-action-anticipation
summary: Action anticipation predicts future human actions from partial video under incomplete context and temporal uncertainty. Recent systems introduce large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), or language-derived semantics at different stages, but reported gains are difficult to interpret when task formulation, visual pretraining, supervision, decoder design, and evaluation code change simultaneously. The central contribution of this review is an evidence-aware design map that crosses task regime with the point at which language-derived information intervenes. We characterise task regimes along six axes. These axes organise the literature into five broad task families: single-action, sequence, object-interaction, cross-view, and planning-oriented settings. C1-C3 locate interventions in context construction, goal/intention modelling, and future decoding, while C4 is treated as an adjacent, emerging grounding/executability extension. Unlike a generic processing pipeline, the map links each intervention to an appropriate counterfactual, failure diagnosis, and permissible evidence claim. Supporting contributions include a protocol-level audit of Ego4D-LTA and EPIC-KITCHENS-100, a multidimensional evidence profile, and the Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol (BCAP). The unresolved EK-100 record is treated as a reporting-comparability case study and is not used as a leaderboard. Evidence for LLM benefits, goal ambiguity, and horizon effects is therefore formulated as testable hypotheses requiring matched validation, not as causal conclusions. The accompanying package contains the coded evidence, source locators, protocol metadata, and versioned catalogue used in the review.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于动作预测（action anticipation）的综述，提出以"任务设定×语言信息介入点"为核心的证据感知设计地图，整合五个任务家族与C1-C4介入类别，并附带协议审计与证据包。
AI.motivation: 近期动作预测系统引入LLM、VLM或语言语义后报告的增益难以解释，因为任务设定、视觉预训练、监督、解码器设计与评测代码常同时变化，缺乏可比较的证据框架。
AI.method: 构建证据感知设计地图，将任务设定沿六个轴刻画，分为单动作、序列、物体交互、跨视角、规划导向五大家族；用C1-C3定位上下文构建、目标/意图建模、未来解码中的介入，C4作为新兴的grounding/可执行性扩展；并将每种介入对应到反事实、失败诊断与允许的证据主张。配套贡献包括Ego4D-LTA与EPIC-KITCHENS-100的协议级审计、多维证据档案和BCAP（骨干感知比较与消融协议）。
AI.result: 给出协议级审计、多维证据档案与BCAP；将EK-100未解决记录作为报告可比性案例而非排行榜；将LLM收益、目标歧义与时间跨度效应表述为需匹配验证的可检验假设。
AI.conclusion: 本综述提供设计地图与配套证据包（编码证据、来源定位、协议元数据、版本化目录），强调语言信息增益应通过匹配验证而非因果结论来主张。

title: Gaps and Augmentations in Bayesian Scheduling
summary:
The recent resolution of the Nisan--Ronen conjecture~\cite{NR,CKK} establishes that the optimal worst-case approximation ratio of deterministic truthful mechanisms for makespan on m unrelated machines is exactly m. We ask how prior information, Bayesian incentive compatibility (BIC), randomization, and machine-side resource augmentation change this barrier.
  We obtain three main results. First, we prove an asymptotic 4/3 lower bound for randomized BIC mechanisms with two machines, strengthening the previous 1.2 deterministic-BIC lower bound~\cite{MS}. Second, in the prior-free setting for two machines, randomization improves the known truthful ratio from 2 to 7/4~\cite{NR}. We show that randomized BIC scheduling mechanisms are likewise strictly more powerful than their deterministic counterparts, exhibiting an asymptotic BIC-integrality gap of 8/7. Thus, optimality in prior-dependent BIC scheduling can strictly require randomization. This parallels the role of lotteries in multidimensional revenue maximization, where randomization can strictly improve revenue~\cite{MV,BCKW}. Third, we show that when job assignments are sufficiently well spread across machines (more formally, when the pairwise collision parameter $Δ_r$ is bounded by a constant independent of both the number of machines m and the number of sampled layers r), then $O(m/\varepsilon)$ sampled layers suffice for the standard truthful MinWork mechanism to achieve a $1+\varepsilon$-approximation to the original first-best benchmark. Equivalently, $O(m/\varepsilon)$ sampled replicas per machine suffice. This resource-augmentation result parallels the Bulow--Klemperer perspective~\cite{BK,EFFTW}. As a by-product, in the standard unaugmented model, MinWork achieves a $(1+\frac{Δ_1(m-1)}{2})$-approximation to the first-best benchmark for every prior.

AI.tldr: 研究贝叶斯激励相容、随机化与机器端资源增强如何改变无关机器调度makespan的m近似障碍，证明随机BIC机制可严格优于确定性机制，并给出资源增强采样层结果。
AI.motivation: Nisan--Ronen猜想解决后，确定性真实机制的最优最坏近似比为m；作者希望考察先验信息、BIC、随机化和资源增强是否能突破该障碍。
AI.method: 结合机制设计与调度理论，分析两机器下随机BIC机制、先验/先验无关情形，以及带采样层和碰撞参数Δ_r的MinWork机制。
AI.result: 1）两机器随机BIC渐近下界4/3；2）两机器先验无关随机化将真实比分从2改进到7/4，并显示随机BIC相对确定性BIC的渐近积分间隙8/7；3）当Δ_r为常数时，O(m/ε)采样层使MinWork达到1+ε首优近似，且无增强时MinWork逼近1+Δ_1(m-1)/2。
AI.conclusion: 随机化在先验依赖BIC调度中可严格必要，类似多维收益最大化中的彩票作用；资源增强可在分散分配条件下显著逼近首优基准。

title: Timeline-Bench: Evaluating Agents on Realistic Video-Editing Tasks, from Raw Footage to Final Cut
comment: Preprint, under review. 9 pages main text, 27 pages total; 9 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://timelinebench.tensortest.com
summary: AI agents increasingly carry out long-horizon professional work, but their evaluations rarely require a finished creative deliverable. To this end, we introduce Timeline-Bench, a benchmark of 56 real video-editing tasks, each asking an agent to turn raw production material into a finished video. Tasks range from selecting dialog takes and shaping interview footage into a story to cutting commercials from product shots, voiceovers and graphics. Every task provides a brief, source assets, a container and a set of tests. A task is resolved when the output passes every test. The tests check the delivery format, the content and the brief's explicit requirements, and include a quality test calibrated on 2,582 blind judgments by 43 video editors. We evaluate 16 agents that pair frontier models with coding-agent harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode. The best, GPT-6 Astra in Codex with curated editorial guidance, resolves only 15 of the 56 tasks (26.8%), and the average agent resolves 14.0%. Human editors prefer the reference edit in 83.5% of judgments. Most unresolved runs (562 of 771) fail only the quality test: agents perceive footage through stills and transcripts and check their renders for defects, not craft. We release the tasks, verifier and per-run results at https://timelinebench.tensortest.com.

AI.tldr: 提出 Timeline-Bench，包含 56 个真实视频剪辑任务，评估 16 个 AI agent。最佳 agent 仅完成 26.8% 任务，主要失败在质量测试。
AI.motivation: AI agent 越来越多承担长周期专业工作，但现有评估很少要求完成创意成品，缺乏对真实创作交付物的考核。
AI.method: 构建 56 个真实视频剪辑任务，覆盖选段、叙事剪辑、广告制作等。每个任务提供简报、素材、容器和测试；任务需通过格式、内容、明确要求和质量测试，其中质量测试基于 43 名剪辑师的 2,582 次盲评校准。评估 16 个组合前沿模型与 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等 coding-agent 框架的 agent。
AI.result: 最佳 agent（Codex 中 GPT-6 Astra 加人工编辑指导）仅解决 15/56（26.8%），平均仅 14.0%。人类剪辑师在 83.5% 的判断中偏好参考剪辑。771 次未解决运行中有 562 次仅未通过质量测试。
AI.conclusion: 现有 agent 难以完成专业创意交付，主要瓶颈是质量问题：它们通过静帧和文字稿理解素材、只检查渲染缺陷，缺乏剪辑工艺能力。基准与验证器已公开。

title: Analog-Friendly Predictive Coding without Activation Derivatives
summary: Predictive coding (PC) is a local, energy-based alternative to backpropagation (BP) whose iterative inference dynamics make it attractive for implementation on analog hardware. However, standard nonlinear PC requires evaluating the derivative of the activation function during both inference and learning, which can be difficult to realise physically. Here, we introduce \textit{activation-matched Bregman PC}, replacing standard squared-error energies with Bregman divergences matched to the activation function. This formulation eliminates activation derivatives and, when combined with inference via mirror descent, yields local inference and learning rules requiring only weighted sums, local prediction errors, state integration, and the activation function. In digital experiments, Bregman PC performs comparably to standard PC and BP on classification and generative tasks, while preserving characteristic learning dynamics of PC and its convergence to BP under stable large-model parameterisations. These results provide a more analog-friendly formulation of nonlinear PC while retaining its key computational properties.

AI.tldr: 提出activation-matched Bregman PC，用与激活函数匹配的Bregman散度替代平方误差，消除激活导数，配合镜像下降得到仅需加权和、局部预测误差、状态积分和激活函数的局部推理与学习规则，适配模拟硬件。
AI.motivation: 标准非线性预测编码(PC)在推理和学习时都需计算激活函数导数，物理上难以在模拟硬件实现，限制了其作为反向传播(BP)局部能量替代方案的硬件吸引力。
AI.method: 用与激活函数匹配的Bregman散度替代标准平方误差能量；结合镜像下降(mirror descent)进行推理，得到局部推理与学习规则，仅需加权和、局部预测误差、状态积分和激活函数，无需激活导数。
AI.result: 数字实验中，Bregman PC在分类和生成任务上与标准PC和BP表现相当，同时保留PC的特征学习动态，并在稳定大模型参数化下收敛到BP。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非线性PC提供了更适配模拟硬件的公式化形式，同时保留了其关键计算特性。

title: PILAR: A Page-Grounded Unified Evidence Representation via an Entity-Linked Assertion Graph for Open-Domain QA Agents over Multimodal Document Corpora
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 25 pages, 5 figures, 24 tables
summary: Open-domain question answering (ODQA) over multimodal document corpora requires linking evidence scattered across text, tables, and figures. Existing systems often store these sources separately or retrieve only coarse pages, which weakens global evidence linking. We present PILAR, a page-grounded unified evidence representation instantiated as an entity-linked assertion graph. PILAR maps sentence-, table-, and figure-derived facts into a common assertion space and uses the graph as a controlled linking layer over robust page retrieval. In a shared-reader evaluation with four agent frameworks, fourteen retrieval backends, and two benchmarks, PILAR achieves the best end-to-end EM/ANLS. Gains are largest on compositional, cross-document, and multimodal questions, with a single-shot improvement of +1.6 EM over flat retrieval, rising to +2.9 on compositional and +5.9 on 3-hop questions. Ablations show that current gains are driven mainly by the text-instantiated slice of the framework, while visual assertions help only after locality-aware filtering. We therefore position PILAR as a unified evidence representation for multimodal ODQA rather than a standalone visual-reasoning module.

AI.tldr: PILAR是一种面向多模态文档语料库的页面级统一证据表示，以实体链接断言图的形式实现，在开放域问答中显著提升了端到端性能，尤其擅长组合、跨文档和多跳问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态开放域问答系统通常将文本、表格和图形分别存储，或仅检索粗粒度页面，导致全局证据链接能力较弱。
AI.method: PILAR将句子、表格和图形派生的事实映射到一个共同的断言空间，构建实体链接断言图，作为鲁棒页面检索之上的受控链接层。
AI.result: 在共享阅读器评估中，结合四种智能体框架、14种检索后端和两个基准，PILAR取得最优端到端EM/ANLS。相比扁平检索单次提升+1.6 EM，组合问题提升+2.9，3跳问题提升+5.9。消融实验表明当前增益主要来自文本实例化部分，视觉断言仅在局部感知过滤后有帮助。
AI.conclusion: PILAR应被定位为多模态开放域问答的统一证据表示，而非独立的视觉推理模块。

title: AsynCodeBench: Benchmarking Collaboration of Asynchronous Multi-Agent Systems in Software Engineering
summary: Multi-agent coding has emerged as an increasingly active direction in software engineering, where complex development tasks are decomposed across multiple specialized agents working on different parts of the problem. Despite the shift from individual problem solving to distributed collaboration, multi-agent systems still lack a direct measure of collaboration and are largely evaluated through task-level outcomes inherited from single-agent coding, conflating individual coding capability with cross-agent coordination. We introduce AsynCodeBench, a dependency-centric benchmark for asynchronous multi-agent software engineering that represents each task with an explicit dependency graph and executable Dependency Checkers. Through this dependency-tracking process, we propose two complementary measures: Asynchronous Dependency Pass Rate (ADPR), which measures how many cross-agent dependencies are ultimately satisfied, and Dependency Resolution Step (DRS), which measures when each dependency first becomes satisfied during execution. AsynCodeBench comprises 19 tasks from real-world repositories, exposing 52 directed dependencies as explicit units for evaluating cross-agent collaboration. Experiments across model families, scales, and generations reveal a clear gap between coding and collaboration capability: improvements in coding performance do not necessarily translate into stronger collaboration, and task-level metrics can diverge substantially from dependency-level collaboration measures. Dependency-trajectory analysis further reveals that successful coordination often emerges not gradually, but through concentrated bursts in which many dependencies become resolved over a short portion of the execution trajectory, a pattern we term a hopping window.

AI.tldr: 提出AsynCodeBench，以依赖图为中心的异步多智能体编码基准，用ADPR和DRS两项指标直接衡量跨智能体协作，揭示编码能力与协作能力的分离。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体编码系统缺乏对协作的直接度量，仍沿用单智能体任务级指标评估，混淆了单个编码能力与跨智能体协调能力。
AI.method: 构建以显式依赖图和可执行Dependency Checkers表示任务的异步多智能体基准，包含19个真实仓库任务、52条有向依赖；提出ADPR（跨智能体依赖最终满足比例）与DRS（依赖首次满足时机）两项互补指标，并进行依赖轨迹分析。
AI.result: 跨模型家族、规模与代际的实验显示编码性能提升未必带来更强协作，任务级指标与依赖级协作度量可能显著背离；成功的协调常非渐进发生，而是在执行轨迹短区间内集中解决大量依赖，称为hopping window。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体编码需以依赖级协作指标评估，AsynCodeBench为异步协作提供了直接、可执行的度量方式，并揭示协作涌现的集中爆发模式。

title: The Temporal Tug-of-War: Visualizing and Detecting RAG Conflicts in Diffusion Models via Trajectory Variance
comment: Accepted at the UncertaiNLP Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces a specific failure mode in discrete diffusion language models: when retrieved context contradicts parametric knowledge, the iterative denoising process becomes a visible battleground between competing knowledge sources. We identify temporal semantic divergence as an observable for detecting these conflicts and introduce the Trajectory Variance Score (TVS), a simple and interpretable measure of this divergence. TVS computes the mean pairwise cosine distance of answer embeddings across independent stochastic denoising trajectories, capturing the temporal tug of war between parametric and contextual attractors. Requiring as few as two parallel inference runs, TVS is computationally lightweight. Across four diverse datasets (Synthetic, SciQ, PopQA, and CounterFact), a simple Logistic Regression classifier using TVS achieves $70.10\%$ accuracy and $0.7647$ AUROC on LLaDA. On Dream 7B, increasing the number of trajectories from two to five improves accuracy from $63.91\%$ to $69.62\%$. More complex sequential models provide only marginal improvements over the linear classifier. Evaluation across LLaDA and Dream 7B demonstrates that conflict-induced trajectory dynamics and their key properties transfer across distinct diffusion architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹方差分数（TVS），用于检测离散扩散语言模型在RAG中检索上下文与参数知识冲突时产生的时序语义分歧，方法轻量且可解释。
AI.motivation: RAG在离散扩散语言模型中引入特定失效模式：当检索上下文与参数知识矛盾时，迭代去噪过程成为两种知识源的"战场"，需要一种可观测指标来检测这些冲突。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory Variance Score（TVS），计算独立随机去噪轨迹间答案嵌入的平均成对余弦距离，捕捉参数与上下文吸引子之间的时序拉锯；最少只需两次并行推理，计算轻量。
AI.result: 在Synthetic、SciQ、PopQA、CounterFact四个数据集上，基于TVS的Logistic Regression分类器在LLaDA上达到70.10%准确率和0.7647 AUROC；Dream 7B上轨迹数从2增至5，准确率从63.91%提升至69.62%。
AI.conclusion: 冲突诱导的轨迹动态及其关键属性可在LLaDA与Dream 7B等不同扩散架构间迁移；复杂序列模型相比线性分类器仅有边际提升。

title: Query-aligned video frame selection for long video understanding
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process multimodal inputs by converting text, images, and videos into token sequences that are subsequently processed by a backbone language model. While MLLMs have achieved excellent performance in understanding the content of individual images, video understanding remains significantly more difficult because videos contain large number of video frames. MLLMs typically process only a subset of these frames, usually ranging from 8 to 64. MLLMs usually sample frames uniformly, regardless of their relevance to the question being answered. To address this limitation, several training-free, model-agnostic methods for selecting question-relevant frames have recently been proposed.
  In this work, we introduce a frame-selection method designed specifically for multiple-choice questions. We extend the query text by appending semantic cues derived from the answer choices and employ a direct query-frame alignment scoring mechanism. To the best of our knowledge, our method is the first to directly utilize answer choices as inference-time cues for selecting frames relevant to answering a question. The method first constructs a compact candidate pool by subsampling video frames at a fixed rate. The frames are then scored according to their maximum cosine similarity across all question-answer pairs to identify the most relevant frames for a given query. This approach preserves a fixed token budget while improving the relevance of the visual evidence provided to the downstream MLLM.
  We evaluate the effectiveness of our frame-selection method on the MLVU, Video-MME, and LongVideoBench benchmarks using three MLLMs: LLaVA-Mini, Qwen2-VL, and LLaVA-Video. Experimental results demonstrate that answer-aware frame selection generally outperforms uniform sampling and existing training-free frame-selection methods under the same frame budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多选题的免训练、模型无关的视频帧选择方法，利用答案选项作为推理时语义线索进行查询-帧对齐打分，在相同帧预算下优于均匀采样和现有方法。
AI.motivation: MLLM处理视频时需将大量帧转为token序列，但通常只均匀采样8-64帧，忽略了帧与问题的相关性，导致视频理解困难。现有免训练帧选择方法尚未直接利用答案选项作为推理线索。
AI.method: 针对多选题，将答案选项的语义线索附加到查询文本中，先以固定速率下采样构建紧凑候选帧池，再根据帧与所有问答对的余弦相似度最大值进行打分，选出最相关帧，保持固定token预算。
AI.result: 在MLVU、Video-MME、LongVideoBench三个基准上，使用LLaVA-Mini、Qwen2-VL、LLaVA-Video三种MLLM评估，答案感知的帧选择在相同帧预算下总体优于均匀采样和现有免训练帧选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 答案感知的帧选择能有效提升视觉证据相关性，改善下游MLLM视频理解性能，且保持免训练、模型无关和固定token预算。

title: Profit Reallocation Mechanisms in Tree-based Data Trading
summary:
Markets for data promise to unlock its economic value, yet in practice they remain far less active than expected---one reason is that those who supply data are not rewarded for the value it creates downstream. A defining feature of data is its \emph{replicability}: a buyer can refine purchased data into a new product and resell it to \emph{many} downstream buyers, so a single source seeds a branching cascade of resales that naturally forms a \emph{tree}. Because an upstream seller captures none of this downstream value, its incentive to trade is weakened. Existing works propose \emph{profit reallocation}---returning part of downstream revenue to upstream contributors---as a natural remedy. But whether profit reallocation works on the tree-structured markets that replicable data actually induces has remained open.
  To bridge this gap, we develop a principled framework for profit reallocation on tree-structured data markets. We introduce a sequential trading game on a tree and a general class of budget-feasible profit reallocation mechanisms (PRMs) over it. We derive efficient algorithms to compute the induced equilibria---a polynomial-time exact algorithm for discrete valuations and a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme (FPTAS) for continuous ones---via a subtree decomposition technique that tames the potential coupling across a seller's children. We then prove that, under mild assumptions, \emph{any} budget-feasible PRM weakly expands the trades that occur in equilibrium, and any budget-balanced PRM additionally weakly improves social welfare, relative to the baseline that reallocates nothing. Experiments on synthetic markets confirm that these benefits are substantial, persist even when the assumptions fail, and grow with the depth and branching of the tree.

AI.tldr: 本文研究树形数据结构化数据市场中的利润再分配机制（PRM），提出序贯交易博弈框架，给出计算均衡的高效算法，并证明预算可行PRM能扩大交易、预算平衡PRM能提升社会福利。
AI.motivation: 数据具有可复制性：买家可将数据加工后转售给众多下游买家，形成树状转售级联。上游卖家无法获取下游价值，导致交易激励不足。已有工作提出利润再分配作为补救，但其在树形市场中的有效性尚属未解问题。
AI.method: 在树上建立序贯交易博弈，定义一类预算可行的利润再分配机制（PRM）。通过子树分解技术化解卖家各子节点间的耦合，设计多项式时间精确算法（离散估值）与FPTAS（连续估值）来计算均衡。
AI.result: 证明在温和假设下，任何预算可行PRM都能弱扩展均衡中的交易量；任何预算平衡PRM还能弱改善社会福利（相对不进行再分配的基线）。合成市场实验表明收益显著，即使假设不成立时仍存在，并随树的深度与分支增加而增大。
AI.conclusion: 利润再分配在可复制数据诱导的树形市场中是可行且有效的，为数据市场机制设计提供了理论基础与算法工具。

title: SignFLIP: A Unified Model for Sign Language Translation and Generation via Stage-wise Alignment at Scale
summary: Sign language translation and generation share the goal of bidirectional alignment between text and sign representations. However, existing approaches either treat them as isolated tasks or are only verified on limited datasets, limiting effective modeling between modalities. In this paper, we propose SignFLIP, a unified LLM-centered framework for translation and generation. To enable bidirectional mapping between text and sign, SignFLIP adopts a symmetric architecture together with a stage-wise training strategy built on large-scale data. The shared sign--text representation is progressively refined: pre-alignment facilitates subsequent SLT, while the SLT-adapted representation further benefits SLG. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SignFLIP shows competitive performance compared with task-specific models on both translation and generation tasks, as well as strong transferability to sign language recognition.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SignFLIP，一个以LLM为中心的对称框架，利用分阶段训练策略在大规模数据上统一手语翻译(SLT)与生成(SLG)，实现文本与手语表示的双向对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有方法或将SLT与SLG视为孤立任务，或仅在有限数据集上验证，限制了模态间有效建模。
AI.method: 采用对称架构与基于大规模数据的分阶段训练策略，逐步精炼共享的手语-文本表示：预对齐促进SLT，SLT适配的表示进一步惠及SLG。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，翻译与生成任务均与专用模型表现相当，并对SLR展现出良好迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 统一的LLM中心框架可有效实现文本与手语的双向对齐，SLT与SLG可相互促进并具跨任务迁移能力。

title: RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision
summary: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike.

AI.tldr: RIPE-MambaSpike通过将分辨率相关的投影层替换为固定通道宽度的多分辨率桥接结构，大幅降低Spiking-Mamba混合模型的参数量，实现分辨率无关且参数高效的事件视觉识别。
AI.motivation: 现有Spiking-Mamba混合模型精度高但参数量巨大（数千万），且大部分成本来自脉冲前端到状态空间骨干的连接方式而非架构本身。例如某代表模型中单个分辨率相关投影层就占36.25M参数中的33.55M。
AI.method: 提出RIPE-MambaSpike：用固定通道宽度的层次化多分辨率桥接替代分辨率相关投影；并采用重参数化脉冲阶段、时间解耦调制以及动态凸包约束的双流膜电位注意力在紧凑设计下保持精度。
AI.result: 部署参数量仅0.870M，且在43倍输入面积范围内保持恒定；在CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101、DailyDVS-200上达到帕累托最优；8.04M配置在DailyDVS-200上取得45.7% top-1，为该基准最佳脉冲结果，且比密集ANN少3.0-15.1倍参数。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性的事件识别不需要随分辨率增长的参数量，验证了分辨率无关参数增长设计的可行性与优势。

title: Social3Source: Connecting Social Provenance, Societal Qualities, and Social Purpose on an Open-Source Software Foundation
summary: The speed at which software can be created and deployed today has increased dramatically. But what is the point of all this software if it does not contribute to society? The ultimate goal of building software should be bettering human lives and society. And this goes beyond publishing the software as open source; it requires considering how it is developed, the societal qualities it embodies, and the purposes it serves. This is what I call Social3Source. This paper presents the concept, principles, and initial discussion for the implementation of Social3Source, illustrating how it integrates social considerations into open-source software development. We have never generated as much software as we do today. Let's make sure it counts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Social3Source"概念，主张软件开发不仅应开源，更应将社会价值、社会品性与服务目的融入开源软件开发全过程，并阐述了其概念、原则与初步实现讨论。
AI.motivation: 当前软件创建与部署速度空前提升，但若软件无益于社会便失去意义。作者认为构建软件的终极目标应是改善人类生活与社会，而仅将软件开源并不足够，还需考虑其开发方式、所体现的社会品性及其服务目的。
AI.method: 论文以概念性、立场性方式展开：界定Social3Source的内涵，提出其核心原则，并对如何实现进行初步讨论，说明如何将社会考量整合进开源软件开发过程。
AI.result: 作为概念与立场论文，未报告实证结果，主要贡献是提出Social3Source的理念框架、原则及初步实施思路。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁在软件产量空前庞大的时代，应确保软件真正产生社会价值，通过Social3Source将社会性融入开源开发，使软件"算数"。

title: Verification of PETSc with CIVL using LLM-generated ACSL contracts and deterministic driver generation
summary: Parallel numerical libraries such as PETSc are widely used in science and engineering applications where wrong results can have costly consequences. Despite this, numerical libraries are rarely formally verified. One of the challenges is the need for an expert to hand-write a specification and manually apply a verification tool, often requiring the development of a harness or driver, all of which can contain additional bugs that lead to false positives or false negatives during verification. With recent advancements in large language models (LLMs), it is tempting to generate such drivers and reference models automatically, but one-shot generation based on a simple prompt is brittle and leads to additional unverified code that needs to be audited. In this paper, we present an approach to use LLMs in a limited setting to generate a small, human-certifiable ACSL contract from the function's documentation, combined with a deterministic toolchain that supports a restricted ACSL profile and generates a driver that uses the CIVL verifier to check the implementation against the contract and, when available, an existing reference model. We demonstrate the pipeline end-to-end on three PETSc functions: MatAXPY (reference model already exists), MatAYPX (no reference model, so the certified contract is the sole oracle), and the non-compressing mode of MatFilter (no reference model, with more complex, conditional behavior). With this pipeline, we were able to discover a bug in PETSc's MatAYPX function that was previously undiscovered and had been present in the code since 1997.

AI.tldr: 提出用LLM生成小规模可人工认证的ACSL契约，配合确定性工具链和CIVL验证器，对PETSc函数进行形式化验证，并发现MatAYPX中自1997年以来未发现的bug。
AI.motivation: 并行数值库（如PETSc）广泛用于科学工程，错误结果代价高昂，但很少被形式化验证。主要原因包括：需要专家手写规范、手动应用验证工具、开发测试驱动/harness，这些过程本身可能引入bug导致误报或漏报。LLM虽可自动生成驱动和参考模型，但一次性生成脆弱且产生需额外审计的未验证代码。
AI.method: 在受限设定下使用LLM：从函数文档生成小型、可人工认证的ACSL契约；结合支持受限ACSL子集的确定性工具链，自动生成driver，用CIVL验证器检查实现是否符合契约，并在可用时对照已有参考模型。在三个PETSc函数上端到端演示：MatAXPY（已有参考模型）、MatAYPX（无参考模型，契约作为唯一oracle）、MatFilter非压缩模式（无参考模型，行为更复杂有条件的）。
AI.result: 该流程成功发现PETSc的MatAYPX函数中一个此前未被发现、自1997年就存在的bug。在三个函数上完成了端到端验证演示。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM限制在生成可人工认证的契约这一小范围任务，配合确定性验证工具链，可在避免LLM生成代码不可信问题的同时，有效对数值库进行形式化验证，并具备发现长期潜伏bug的实际价值。

title: One-Step Is Optimal: Unconditional Rectified Flows are Noise2Noise Denoisers, and Multi-Step Integration Provably Hurts---A Benchmark and Task-Based Detectability Study on Low-Dose CT
summary: Iterative and generative denoisers are increasingly used under the assumption that multi-step refinement outperforms a single regression pass. We show the opposite for \emph{label-free} denoising. An \emph{unconditional} rectified flow trained on two noisy observations of the same signal, as in Noise2Noise, has a minimiser whose one-step readout is exactly the MMSE denoiser without requiring clean targets. In contrast, multi-step integration provably departs from the MMSE solution because the flow terminates at the noisy data distribution rather than the clean-signal distribution. This departure is exact in a tractable Gaussian model and is confirmed experimentally: one-step flow matches a direct regressor, whereas multi-step Euler integration progressively reduces fidelity. Counterintuitively, the degradation increases with training quality, as a better velocity field more faithfully transports samples toward the noisy terminal law. The key ingredient is therefore the decorrelated \emph{pairing}, not the flow machinery: a one-step regressor trained on matched noisy pairs gives our best label-free result ($+1.99$,dB). We evaluate these findings on \textbf{CTDenoiser}, a controlled low-dose CT benchmark spanning five architectures and supervised, similarity-based, blind-spot, and per-image methods. Among label-free approaches, only correlated-noise-aware Noise2Sim improves over the noisy baseline, while Noise2Void is flat-to-negative because CT noise violates its pixel-independence assumption. Finally, although supervised denoisers gain approximately $4$,dB PSNR, a channelized Hotelling observer shows reduced low-contrast lesion detectability, revealing clinically relevant degradation missed by PSNR and SSIM.

AI.tldr: 无标签去噪中，单步读出（配对噪声回归）优于多步迭代/生成式精修；多步流终止于噪声分布，反而偏离MMSE。
AI.motivation: 普遍假设多步迭代/生成式精修优于单步回归，但作者要检验其在无标签去噪中是否成立。
AI.method: 分析在同一信号的两个噪声观测上训练的无条件rectified flow，并与Noise2Noise/Gaussian模型对比；提出CTDenoiser低剂量CT基准，覆盖五种架构及监督、相似度、盲点、逐图方法。
AI.result: 单步流读出等价于MMSE去噪器；多步Euler积分随训练质量提升反而降低保真度。配对单步回归达最佳无标签结果(+1.99 dB)。无标签法中仅Noise2Sim超越噪声基线，Noise2Void持平或负向。监督去噪约+4 dB PSNR，但通道化Hotelling观察者显示低对比病灶可检测性下降。
AI.conclusion: 关键在于去相关配对而非流机制；PSNR/SSIM会掩盖临床相关退化，需用任务导向指标评估。

title: SMARtCARE: Privacy-Preserving Agentic AI Systems for Bounded-Autonomy Clinical Decision Support
comment: Paper accepted to, and to appear in, the 2026 IEEE HealthCom Conference
summary: Long-context clinical AI systems can miss relevant patient history when prior admissions fall outside the active reasoning context. In ICU monitoring, this can cause early vital-sign drift to appear nonspecific even when it resembles a prior deterioration pattern. SMARtCARE addresses this gap through a four-state clinical decision-support architecture: Stable, Meta-cognitive, Assisted, and Regulated (Revoked). Rather than automatically retrieving prior records, SMARtCARE uses a lossy six-channel fingerprint of the patient's prior trajectory. When current drift matches that fingerprint and the prior record is absent from context, the system raises a Meta-cognitive escalation for clinician review; full retrieval occurs only through clinician action in the Assisted state. A patient-identity guard is designed to enforce correct attribution across data loading, logging, and audit layers. Evaluation combines a synthetic Monte Carlo study that validates the state-transition logic and estimator stability, not clinical performance, with real-data runs on both the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos. On MIMIC-III, one prior-pattern recurrence was identified among 14 two-admission patients; on MIMIC-IV, the same pipeline produced no fingerprint matches among 9 two-admission patients, which illustrates a key limitation of a fixed canonical pattern library. Across both runs all logged decisions were fully traceable and correctly attributed. The results support SMARtCARE as a traceable, privacy-aware mechanism for surfacing middle-context risk; they are not a clinical efficacy claim.

AI.tldr: SMARtCARE是一种四状态（Stable/Meta-cognitive/Assisted/Regulated）临床决策支持架构，通过"有损六通道指纹"在患者既往记录不在上下文时触发元认知升级提醒医生，实验在合成数据与MIMIC-III/IV上验证状态转换逻辑与可追溯性，非临床疗效主张。
AI.motivation: 长上下文临床AI在既往入院记录超出推理上下文时可能遗漏相关病史，导致ICU早期生命体征漂移看似非特异，即使其与既往恶化模式相似，此即"middle-context risk"缺口。
AI.method: 四状态架构（Stable、Meta-cognitive、Assisted、Regulated/Revoked）；不自动检索既往记录，而使用患者既往轨迹的有损六通道指纹，当当前漂移匹配指纹且既往记录缺失时触发元认知升级供医生审查，仅在Assisted状态下由医生操作进行完整检索；并设患者身份守卫以跨数据加载、日志与审计层强制正确归属。评估含合成蒙特卡洛研究验证状态转换逻辑与估计器稳定性，以及MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV Demo真实数据运行。
AI.result: MIMIC-III中14名两次入院患者里识别出1例既往模式复发；MIMIC-IV中9名两次入院患者无指纹匹配，暴露固定典型模式库的局限；两次运行中所有记录决策均可完整追溯且归属正确。
AI.conclusion: SMARtCARE作为可追溯、隐私感知的机制，支持暴露middle-context风险，但结果不构成临床疗效主张。

title: Nearly Group-Separable Elections
summary: We study the problem of computing how close a given election is to being group-separable, measuring proximity by swaps of adjacent candidates in the votes. We also consider several other domains, including caterpillar group-separable, balanced group-separable, single-peaked, and single-crossing ones. Our problem is generally intractable, but we find practical FPT algorithms parameterized by the number of candidates or swaps. For the latter case, our algorithm applies to all domains characterized by finite forbidden subelections, resolving a well-established open problem. We supplement our theoretical findings with experimental analysis.

AI.tldr: 研究选举结果与群可分等偏好域的距离问题，以相邻候选交换为距离度量，给出FPT算法并辅以实验。
AI.motivation: 衡量给定选举与群可分（及caterpillar群可分、平衡群可分、单峰、单交叉等）偏好域的接近程度，是理解选举结构的重要问题，但该问题通常难解，需要寻找高效算法。
AI.method: 以相邻候选交换次数作为接近度度量；针对候选数或交换数为参数设计实用的FPT算法；对以有限禁用子选举刻画的域，交换数为参数时算法均适用。
AI.result: 问题一般不可解（intractable），但给出以候选数或交换数为参数的实用FPT算法；后者适用于所有有限禁用子选举刻画的域，并解决了相关长期开放问题；补充了实验分析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多种偏好域的接近度计算提供了FPT算法框架，解决了一个重要开放问题，并通过实验验证了实用性。

title: MTLiquid: Enabling Efficient Multi-Task Learning using Liquid Neural Networks for Lightweight Healthcare Monitoring Systems
summary: Continuous-time sensing and monitoring with timely and accurate decision-making are critical for many real-world applications. In healthcare monitoring systems, physiological signals are often available or sampled at irregular time intervals, hence requiring continuous-time processing to provide accurate prediction. Moreover, such systems often need to solve multiple detection/prediction tasks to provide a comprehensive patient review from different physiological aspects for more accurate decision-making. To solve this, continuous-time neural networks (CTNNs) can be employed. However, state-of-the-art works typically solve only one task at each network, thereby limiting their efficiency gains. To address this limitation, we propose MTLiquid, a novel methodology to enable efficient multi-task learning in continuous-time processing for healthcare monitoring systems through effective network design and training strategy. MTLiquid employs: (1) multiple input and output heads to accommodate different tasks, while sharing the same backbone network across tasks; as well as (2) an effective training strategy that leverages a loss-weighting technique to balance learning updates across different tasks and a proportional data presentation technique to address imbalanced dataset sizes.
