Experimental results for mortality prediction (P12) and sepsis early detection (P19) tasks for ICU patients show that, MTLiquid achieves strong performance (AUROC: 0.84 for P12 and 0.94 for P19) comparable to the state-of-the-art single-task learning in both continuous-time networks (AUROC: 0.84 for P12 and 0.95 for P19) and discrete-time networks (AUROC: 0.79-0.82 for P12 and 0.92-0.94 for P19), while incurring significantly smaller memory cost by 44%-94%. These results highlight the potential of our MTLiquid methodology to enable lightweight continuous-time healthcare monitoring systems for better decision-making.

AI.tldr: MTLiquid：面向医疗监测的连续时间多任务学习方法，通过共享骨干网络和多头设计实现轻量高效的多任务处理。
AI.motivation: 医疗监测中生理信号常以不规则时间间隔采样，需连续时间处理；且需同时解决多个检测/预测任务以提供全面评估。现有连续时间神经网络每个网络仅解决单一任务，限制了效率增益。
AI.method: MTLiquid采用：(1) 多个输入和输出头以适应不同任务，同时跨任务共享同一骨干网络；(2) 有效训练策略——利用损失加权技术平衡不同任务的学习更新，并用比例数据呈现技术解决数据集规模不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在ICU患者死亡率预测(P12)和脓毒症早期检测(P19)任务上，MTLiquid性能强劲（AUROC: P12为0.84，P19为0.94），与最先进单任务学习在连续时间网络（P12 0.84，P19 0.95）和离散时间网络（P12 0.79-0.82，P19 0.92-0.94）中相当，同时内存开销显著降低44%-94%。
AI.conclusion: MTLiquid方法有望实现轻量级连续时间医疗监测系统，支持更好的决策。

title: Inspire: Benchmarking Scientific Literature Search for Open Research Problems
summary: Scientific literature search often begins with an open research problem rather than a known target paper or a fixed candidate set. We introduce INSPIRE, a benchmark for evaluating agents that search prior literature to make progress on solution-redacted research problems. Each instance pairs a research brief with a target-specific cutoff three months before a later paper and evaluates ranked outputs against graded cited antecedents from that paper's realized research lineage. Search proceeds over an open corpus, while the identity of the target paper and membership of its cited antecedents remain hidden from the agent. Beyond end-to-end retrieval quality, INSPIRE uses logged search trajectories to distinguish three coupled stages: resource exposure, whether useful antecedents are surfaced during search; selection, whether exposed antecedents are retained; and ranking, how effectively retained papers are ordered. Across 476 computer-science targets under a shared search interface and budget, the strongest evaluated agent achieves 0.284 nDCG@10. Results show that current agents more readily recover an isolated antecedent than assemble a broader portfolio of relevant prior work. The stagewise analysis identifies resource exposure as the largest observed bottleneck, with further losses in selection and ranking. We additionally construct replay-valid hindsight demonstrations and show that they improve held-out search without changing test-time information, establishing that the benchmark provides an actionable learning signal. INSPIRE therefore enables both end-to-end comparison and stage-resolved diagnosis in a setting where the agent must construct its own working criterion of relevance.

AI.tldr: INSPIRE是一个评估智能体在开放语料库中通过文献检索解决"隐藏答案"研究问题能力的基准，通过三阶段诊断（资源暴露、选择、排序）揭示当前智能体的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 科学文献检索常始于开放研究问题而非已知目标论文或固定候选集，而现有基准缺乏对这种"从零构建检索标准"场景的评估。
AI.method: 每个实例将研究简报与目标专属截止时间（目标论文发表前三个月）配对，对智能体进行开放语料库搜索，将排序输出与目标论文真实研究谱系中的分级引用前驱进行比对，同时隐藏目标论文身份及其引用前驱。基于搜索轨迹区分三个耦合阶段：资源暴露、选择、排序；并构建可回放的事后演示作为学习信号。
AI.result: 在476个计算机科学目标上，最强智能体仅达到0.284 nDCG@10；当前智能体更易恢复单个孤立前驱而非组装更广泛的相关先行工作组合；资源暴露是最大瓶颈，选择和排序也存在进一步损失；可回放演示能在不改变测试时信息的前提下提升留出搜索性能。
AI.conclusion: INSPIRE支持端到端比较与阶段化诊断，适用于智能体必须自行构建相关性标准的研究场景。

title: What Does a Skill Actually Do? Estimands and Evaluation Validity for Tool and Skill Use in LLM Agents: A Critical Review
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly draw on external tools and reusable skills selected at run time from libraries that hold thousands of entries. Reports that a retriever, router, or skill library "improves" an agent may refer to retrieval recall, the success change from enabling a library, a paired contrast restricted to triggered tasks, or a gain under an approximate budget constraint. This critical review asks what each design compares and under which assumptions. Building on estimand-based approaches to agent evaluation, we describe tool and skill designs along six axes: treatment contrast, target population, outcome, budget constraint, summary measure, and identification assumptions. Thirteen core empirical studies anchor the evidence synthesis, supplemented by related methodological work and design-level reading of the wider literature. Our contribution is to make explicit distinctions that some source authors already acknowledge through a decomposition of trigger-conditioned pairing, analytic counterexamples, and comparisons across studies. Pairing on the task does not by itself identify an invocation effect; paired gain and regression counts measure protocol-specific discordance rather than the share of tasks whose expected outcomes worsen; and total effects of module deployment answer a different question from budget-constrained efficiency. We compare curated skill provision with retriever replacement, triggered subsets with all-task outcomes, and observed cost reductions with budget-constrained comparisons. A reporting checklist and worked examples connect these distinctions to information that studies can report. The review runs no new experiments; empirical results come from the cited studies, and numerical toy examples are analytical illustrations.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇批判性综述，基于估计量（estimand）视角审视LLM agent中工具/技能库评估设计，沿六个轴（处理对比、目标人群、结果、预算约束、汇总度量、识别假设）区分不同"改进"含义，指出配对增益、触发子集分析等常见做法无法识别调用效应，并给出报告清单。
AI.motivation: LLM agent常从数千条目的工具/技能库中动态选择工具，但"检索器/路由/技能库提升了agent"这类说法含义模糊——可能指检索召回率、启用库带来的成功率变化、仅限触发任务的配对对比，或近似预算约束下的收益。作者希望厘清每种设计究竟在比较什么、依赖何种假设。
AI.method: 构建于估计量（estimand）方法之上，沿六个轴刻画工具/技能设计：处理对比、目标人群、结果、预算约束、汇总度量、识别假设。以13项核心实证研究为证据基础，辅以相关方法学工作与对更广文献的设计层面解读，通过触发条件配对分解、解析反例、跨研究比较来说明区分。
AI.result: 配对于任务本身无法识别调用效应；配对增益与回归计数衡量的是协议特定的不一致性，而非期望结果恶化的任务占比；模块部署的总效应与预算约束下的效率回答的是不同问题。比较了精选技能供给与检索器替换、触发子集与全任务结果、观测成本削减与预算约束对比等设计差异。
AI.conclusion: 综述不开展新实验，实证结果均来自所引研究，数值玩具例子仅作分析性说明。贡献在于明确这些常被含糊处理的区分，并提供报告清单与示例，将上述区分连接到研究可报告的信息上。

title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Self-Supervised Fine-Tuning for Coverage
summary: In verifiable domains such as math and coding, finding one correct solution among many attempts can matter more than the pass rate of each attempt. Post-training can concentrate large language model outputs around a few modes, while increasing sampling temperature has limited effectiveness. We introduce Don't Repeat Yourself Supervised Fine-Tuning (DRY-SFT), a post-training method that increases output diversity and coverage: the probability of at least one correct solution among many attempts. DRY-SFT has two stages. First, for each problem, sequentially generate K solutions, showing the model all prior attempts and asking for a different solution. Second, fine-tune on each attempt independently, removing prior attempts from the context. The process uses no reward, verifier, or correctness filter. On HumanEval+, MBPP+, and DS-1000, DRY-SFT raises pass@100 by 10.8, 12.5, and 12.4 percentage points, respectively, at a small cost to pass@1. Structural diversity, measured by abstract syntax tree edit distance among passing solutions, rises significantly on all three benchmarks. DRY-SFT also solves 244 of 600 problems that the base model did not solve in the same 200 attempts. Across nine open-weight models, lower structural diversity of the base model significantly predicts larger DRY-SFT gains, indicating that the method is especially effective on more mode-collapsed models.

AI.tldr: DRY-SFT 是一种无需奖励或验证器的后训练方法，通过多轮去重式生成与独立微调，显著提升大模型在数学和代码任务中的输出多样性与覆盖率（pass@k）。
AI.motivation: 在许多可验证领域（如数学和编程），在多次尝试中找到至少一个正确解比单次通过率更重要。然而后训练常使模型输出集中在少数模式上，且提高采样温度效果有限，因此亟需提升输出多样性与覆盖率的方法。
AI.method: DRY-SFT 分两阶段：第一阶段对每个问题顺序生成 K 个解，每次都展示模型先前的所有尝试并要求给出不同的解；第二阶段对每次尝试独立微调，并将先前尝试从上下文中移除。整个过程不使用奖励、验证器或正确性过滤。
AI.result: 在 HumanEval+、MBPP+ 和 DS-1000 上，pass@100 分别提升 10.8、12.5 和 12.4 个百分点，pass@1 仅小幅下降。结构多样性（通过解之间的 AST 编辑距离衡量）显著提升。DRY-SFT 在相同 200 次尝试中解决了基模型未能解决的 600 题中的 244 题。在九个开源模型中，基模型结构多样性越低，DRY-SFT 增益越大。
AI.conclusion: DRY-SFT 能有效提升模型输出多样性与覆盖率，尤其在模式坍缩更严重的模型上效果更显著，是一种简单且无需外部反馈的后训练方案。

title: OMP-MoE: Efficient Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs via Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling of large language models but face critical deployment challenges due to massive memory requirements. Existing pruning methods either incur prohibitive search costs or neglect the dynamic interdependencies between experts. To address these challenges, we present OMP-MoE, a novel training-free compression framework for reducing expert redundancy in MoE-based LLMs. Based on observations of expert contribution patterns, we reformulate the pruning problem as a sparse signal reconstruction task solved through Orthogonal Matching Pursuit. Specifically, our method first treats individual expert contributions as dictionary atoms and selects experts that greedily minimize reconstruction error with linear computational complexity. Then, we optimize cross-layer expert allocation through a water-filling strategy that accounts for both reconstruction quality and routing stability. Finally, we introduce OMP-MoE†, an adaptive inference mechanism that dynamically adjusts expert activation based on energy prediction. Comprehensive experiments on Qwen, DeepSeek-V2, GPT-OSS, and Mixtral MoE demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods at 25-50% pruning ratios. For Qwen3-30B-A3B at 50% compression, we retain 93.3% of original performance, achieving 33$\times$ faster search and 1.55$\times$ inference speedup. Codes will be available after acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出 OMP-MoE，一种无需训练的 MoE 压缩框架，通过正交匹配追踪与注水策略减少专家冗余，实现高效剪枝与加速。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型内存需求巨大，现有剪枝方法搜索成本高，且忽视专家间的动态依赖关系。
AI.method: 将专家贡献视为字典原子，用正交匹配追踪以线性复杂度贪心选择专家；用注水策略优化跨层专家分配；引入 OMP-MoE† 基于能量预测动态调整专家激活。
AI.result: 在 Qwen、DeepSeek-V2、GPT-OSS、Mixtral 上 25-50% 剪枝比率下持续优于现有方法；Qwen3-30B-A3B 50% 压缩保留 93.3% 性能，搜索快 33 倍，推理加速 1.55 倍。
AI.conclusion: OMP-MoE 以无需训练方式有效压缩 MoE 大模型，兼顾性能保留、搜索效率与推理速度。

title: Witeness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families
summary: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, or correlation statistics. Symmetric pairwise comparisons can detect relatedness, but they cannot by themselves orient relationship between checkpoints A and B. We therefore introduce a local geometric comparison: instead of comparing two checkpoints directly, we add a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compare the geometry around each candidate endpoint. Direction is inferred by asking which candidate behaves more like a branching parent. Motivated by this idea, and by the empirically observed asymmetry between parent-anchored and child-anchored witness-overlap distributions, we propose Witness Overlap, a prompt-free, training-free white-box test for directional provenance. On 176 LLM checkpoints from 16 families, our one-witness test orients 95.3\% of parent-child decisions using Frobenius cosine. We further evaluate root identification, sibling discrimination, generalizations to VLM and diffusion families, and chain-structured ordering. The signal is robust to weight noise and sparse pruning, with a proposed SVD weight reduction variant showing greater robustness than Frobenius cosine.

AI.tldr: 提出 Witness Overlap，一种无需提示、无需训练的白盒测试，通过引入同族"见证"检查点比较局部几何，实现模型检查点父子方向判定，在176个LLM上达95.3%准确率。
AI.motivation: 开放权重模型频繁微调、合并、重发布，溯源审计不仅需判断检查点是否相关，还需确定先后顺序。已有方法多为 base-known 设置，证据本质上对称，无法定向 A 与 B 的父子关系。
AI.method: 引入第三个同族检查点作为见证，比较各候选端点周围几何，判断哪个更像分支父节点。基于父子锚定见证重叠分布的观测不对称性，提出 Witness Overlap：无需提示、无需训练、白盒，使用 Frobenius 余弦，并提出基于 SVD 权重降维的变体。
AI.result: 在16个家族176个LLM检查点上，单见证测试用 Frobenius 余弦定向95.3%的父子决策；进一步评估根识别、兄弟区分、向VLM与扩散家族的泛化及链式排序；对权重噪声和稀疏剪枝鲁棒，SVD变体鲁棒性更强。
AI.conclusion: 通过非对称的局部几何比较可将"相关性检测"升级为"方向性溯源"，Witness Overlap 提供有效且鲁棒的方向性来源审计方案。

title: On best of both worlds allocations with subadditive valuations
summary:
We consider allocation of indivisible goods to agents with equal entitlements and subadditive valuations. As an ex-post fairness notion we consider the maximin share (MMS), and as an ex-ante fairness notion we consider the maximum expectation share (MES), which is always at least as large as the MMS, and sometimes much larger. We present a simple transformation that for every $0 < ρ\le 1$, given any algorithm that produces $ρ$-MMS allocations, transforms it into a randomized allocation algorithm that offers $ρ$-MMS ex-post simultaneously with $η$-MES ex-ante. We prove several new properties of MES, and use them to show that $η\ge \min[\fracρ{2 + ρ}, \frac{1}{4}]$. We also present cases in which the transformation results in a higher value of $η$.
  Applying our transformation to currently known allocation algorithms shows for subadditive valuations the existence of randomized allocations that are simultaneously $Ω(\frac{1}{\log\log n})$-MES ex-ante and $Ω(\frac{1}{\log\log n})$-MMS ex-post, and for XOS valuations the existence of randomized allocations that are simultaneously $\frac{4}{27}$-MES ex-ante and $\frac{4}{17}$-MMS ex-post.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不可分割物品在等权代理与子加性估值下的公平分配，提出一种将 ex-post ρ-MMS 算法转化为同时满足 ex-post ρ-MMS 与 ex-ante η-MES 的随机分配算法，并给出 η 的下界与具体估值类下的存在性结果。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多关注 MMS 这类 ex-post 公平性，而 ex-ante 公平性（MES）研究较少；作者希望把已有的 MMS 保证与更强的 ex-ante MES 保证结合起来。
AI.method: 提出一个简单变换：给定任意产生 ρ-MMS 分配的算法，对每个 0<ρ≤1 构造随机分配算法，使其在 ex-post 上保持 ρ-MMS，同时在 ex-ante 上满足 η-MES；并证明 MES 的新性质以推出 η 的下界。
AI.result: 证明 η ≥ min[ρ/(2+ρ), 1/4]，并给出某些情形下 η 更高的例子；应用于现有算法：子加性估值下存在同时 Ω(1/log log n)-MES 与 Ω(1/log log n)-MMS 的随机分配；XOS 估值下存在同时 4/27-MES 与 4/17-MMS 的随机分配。
AI.conclusion: 该变换可将 ex-post MMS 保证升级为同时具备 ex-ante MES 保证的随机分配，从而为子加性与 XOS 估值给出新的同时公平性存在性结果。

title: APEX: An Extensible Model for Agent-Assisted Production Scheduling
summary: Production scheduling requires realistic models that reflect operational constraints and efficient methods that balance competing goals. Putting these methods into use also requires data integration, model adaptation and specialist expertise. We present APEX, an extensible production scheduling framework built around a general model and hybrid multiobjective search. Agent assistance supports both scheduling and model refinement: agents prepare data and explore scenarios in natural language, while coding agents help implement and test new constraints and objectives. Shared construction and checking procedures connect these adaptations to the scheduling core. We benchmark eight APEX configurations against NSGA-II, SPEA2, MOEA/D and SMS-EMOA on 69 public job-shop, flexible job-shop and permutation flow-shop instances, assessing workload completion time (makespan), total job flowtime and computation time. Hybrid configurations achieve the best aggregate solution quality, although the leading method depends on the problem class and objective. A separate synthetic workflow study uses OpenAI's GPT-6-astra as an interaction layer between the human planner and the algorithmic core, testing rule additions, plan and objective changes, and what-if comparisons. All 24 sessions completed the requested changes and passed independent checks of saved models and schedules. A separate coding evaluation produced six native implementations of an additional objective or hard constraint through predefined extension hooks. All passed independent checks without modifying the core.

AI.tldr: APEX是一个可扩展生产调度框架，基于通用模型与混合多目标搜索，并引入智能体辅助。
AI.motivation: 生产调度需要真实约束建模、高效多目标方法及数据集成与专家知识，现有方法落地困难。
AI.method: 采用通用模型与混合多目标搜索；调度与模型细化由智能体辅助，编码智能体实现新约束/目标；共享构建与检查流程连接扩展与核心。
AI.result: 在69个作业车间、柔性作业车间和流水车间实例上对比NSGA-II、SPEA2、MOEA/D、SMS-EMOA，混合配置综合解质量最佳；24次GPT-6-astra工作流全部完成变更并通过检查；6个编码扩展通过检查且未修改核心。
AI.conclusion: APEX证明混合多目标搜索与智能体辅助可有效支持调度建模、扩展和使用。

title: What Gets Measured Gets Managed: Sign-aware Recommendation Needs Sign-aware Evaluation
summary: Sign-aware recommender systems have recently been developed to leverage negative feedback for a deeper understanding of user preferences. However, our empirical diagnosis reveals that state-of-the-art graph-based sign-aware recommender systems are paradoxically valence-blind. Even though they explicitly incorporate sign information during training, they consistently fail to differentiate liked items from disliked ones at the ranking stage, frequently infiltrating top-K recommendations with disliked content. Through linear probing, we show that while valence information exists in the learned embeddings, it remains inaccessible to the inner-product scoring function. This widespread failure remains entirely undetected because conventional evaluation metrics, such as Recall, HR, and NDCG, assign a uniform utility of zero to both negative and unobserved items, creating a systematic evaluation blind spot. To bridge this gap, we propose a family of signed metrics, Signed Recall, Signed HR, and Signed NDCG, that explicitly penalize the recommendation of disliked content. Systematic re-evaluation under our proposed metrics fundamentally reshapes the established performance landscape, revealing that methods ranked highly under conventional metrics often fail to protect users from disliked content. Finally, through a proof-of-concept auxiliary loss, we confirm that the proposed metrics provide actionable training signals, guiding models toward valence-aware behavior without sacrificing conventional relevance. For transparency, our source code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/signed-rec-benchmark-07E4

AI.tldr: 本文揭示基于图的符号感知推荐系统在排序阶段"价态盲"，提出Signed Recall/HR/NDCG三类符号指标并验证其可作为训练信号。
AI.motivation: 现有符号感知推荐系统虽在训练中引入负反馈，但仍将不喜欢物品推荐给用户；传统指标（Recall、HR、NDCG）对负反馈与未观测项统一赋零效用，形成系统性评估盲点，导致该问题被长期忽视。
AI.method: 通过实证诊断与线性探针分析学习到的嵌入中价态信息可达性；提出Signed Recall、Signed HR、Signed NDCG系列指标对推荐不喜欢内容施加惩罚；在统一基准上重新评估现有方法，并设计概念验证辅助损失验证指标的训练指导作用。
AI.result: 线性探针显示价态信息存在于嵌入中但内积打分函数无法获取；在符号指标下原有排名格局被重塑，传统指标高分方法常无法保护用户免受不喜欢内容干扰；辅助损失证明所提指标可提供有效训练信号，在不牺牲常规相关性的前提下引导价态感知行为。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的符号感知推荐系统存在被传统评估掩盖的"价态盲"缺陷；所提符号指标既揭示该问题，又能作为可操作的训练信号，推动真正价态感知的推荐。

title: WideSWE: Can Coding Agents Coordinate Changes Across Repositories?
summary: Coding-agent evaluation has progressed from resolving individual issues to carrying out long-horizon development, yet task completion is still largely assessed within a single codebase. In software ecosystems, many features and bug fixes require coordinated changes across multiple repositories. We introduce WideSWE to evaluate coding agents on such cross-repository tasks. Mining and reviewing changes across 103 software ecosystems yields 120 real-world tasks, balanced between 60 bug fixes and 60 features. We derive prompts from related issues and pull requests. We systematically review and adapt hidden tests to support diverse correct implementations while preserving required behavior and regression checks. Across seven agent configurations, full task success ranges from 10.83% to 42.50%, with the configuration pairing Codex CLI with GPT-5.6-sol achieving the highest rate. Trajectories show agents failing to identify necessary changes, recognizing changes but leaving them unfinished, or modifying the required repositories without fully satisfying the request. To examine whether working on one repository at a time can alleviate these difficulties, we compare it with joint execution under identical prompts. Independent execution mainly recovers omitted work and is less effective at correcting previously attempted but unsuccessful implementations. Joint execution can use information from related repositories to guide implementation and verification. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-ACES-ISE/WideSWE.

AI.tldr: 提出WideSWE基准，评估编码智能体跨多仓库协调开发能力，含120个真实任务，最佳成功率仅42.50%。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体评估多局限于单一代码库，而软件生态中许多功能与修复需跨多个仓库协同修改，缺少相应评测基准。
AI.method: 挖掘并审核103个软件生态的变更，构建120个真实跨仓库任务（60个bug修复、60个功能）。提示词源自相关issue与PR，并对隐藏测试系统化审核与适配，以兼容多样正确实现、同时保留必要行为与回归检查。对比7种智能体配置，并比较独立（逐仓库）执行与联合执行。
AI.result: 7种配置的完整任务成功率介于10.83%至42.50%，Codex CLI搭配GPT-5.6-sol最高。失败模式包括未识别必要修改、识别但未完成、修改了仓库却未满足需求。独立执行主要弥补遗漏工作，对纠正已尝试但失败的实现效果较弱；联合执行可利用相关仓库信息指导实现与验证。
AI.conclusion: 跨仓库任务是当前编码智能体的显著挑战，联合执行优于逐仓库独立执行，WideSWE为相关评测提供基准。

title: The Ongiini-Eval-OW Benchmark: A Concept Paper for the Planned Benchmarking of Machine Translation and Large Language Models on Oshindonga and Oshikwanyama
comment: 14 pages, 6 tables. Concept paper for a planned benchmark; first public dataset release targeted for Q4 2026. Dataset CC-BY-4.0, code MIT
summary: Oshiwambo -- a cluster of mutually intelligible Bantu languages spoken by over a million people across northern Namibia and southern Angola, and the home language of roughly half of Namibian households -- has, to our knowledge, no published machine-translation evaluation benchmark. Major commercial services (Google Translate, DeepL, Microsoft Translator), open multilingual MT models (NLLB-200, MADLAD-400), and the open Masakhane checkpoint collection all lack coverage of either standardised dialect, Oshindonga or Oshikwanyama. We announce Ongiini-Eval-OW, a planned 600-item English-Oshindonga and English-Oshikwanyama benchmark with native-speaker references from two independent translators, a 30-item inter-translator agreement set, an 11-tag phenomenon-tagged stratification (at least 30 items per tag), a deterministic 30% blind split, and a reproducible scoring protocol over chrF++, BLEU, and COMET-22, supplemented by a 50-item human-evaluation round. We document the empirical coverage gap, the dataset composition, the launch-leaderboard model matrix across American, European, and Chinese frontier and open-weight systems, and the contribution pipeline. The dataset is targeted for first public release in Q4 2026; this v1.0 concept paper announces the design and the call for participation. Data and code will be released under CC-BY-4.0 and MIT respectively.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇概念论文，宣布为Oshiwambo语言构建首个机器翻译评测基准Ongiini-Eval-OW。
AI.motivation: Oshiwambo（纳米比亚和安哥拉超百万使用者的班图语）缺乏已公开的机器翻译评测基准，主流商用和开源MT系统均未覆盖其标准方言Oshindonga和Oshikwanyama。
AI.method: 设计一个600条英-Oshindonga和英-Oshikwanyama基准，含两位独立译者的母语参考、30条译者间一致性集、11个现象标签分层（每标签≥30条）、30%确定性盲划分、基于chrF++/BLEU/COMET-22的可复现评分协议及50条人工评测。
AI.result: 记录了经验性覆盖缺口、数据集构成、涵盖美欧中前沿及开源权重系统的启动排行榜模型矩阵，以及贡献流程。
AI.conclusion: 数据集计划于2026年Q4首次公开发布，本文为v1.0概念论文宣布设计与征集参与；数据以CC-BY-4.0、代码以MIT许可发布。

title: A Comparative Transfer-Learning Study of CNN Backbones for Partial Face Recognition on the SoF Dataset
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, accepted at The 6th International Conference on Electrical, Computer, Communications and Mechatronics Engineering (ICECCME 2026)
summary: Face recognition is widely deployed in surveillance, access control, and forensic workflows, yet accuracy degrades sharply once the face is occluded by accessories, foreground objects, or the frame edge. Because most faces in the wild are partial, robust partial face recognition (PFR) remains open. This paper compares three pretrained convolutional backbones, ResNet-50, VGG-16, and FaceNet, fine-tuned for PFR by transfer learning under identical preprocessing, splitting, and optimization protocols on the Specs-on-Faces (SoF) dataset. All three arms use a common 160x160 input and a frozen backbone with a trainable head under a fixed epoch budget and no per-backbone hyperparameter search. The FaceNet configuration, denoted PFN (Partial FaceNet), substantially outperforms the other two, reaching 97.4% test accuracy with macro-averaged 87.04% precision, 84.61% recall, and 84.17% F1 over the 112 identity classes, the highest accuracy and recall reported on SoF.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Specs-on-Faces数据集上比较ResNet-50、VGG-16和FaceNet三种预训练骨干进行部分人脸识别(PFR)迁移学习，FaceNet配置(PFN)以97.4%测试准确率显著领先，为SoF上最高。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别在监控、门禁和取证中广泛部署，但被配件、前景物体或画面边缘遮挡时精度急剧下降。野外多数人脸为部分人脸，因此鲁棒的部分人脸识别(PFR)仍是未解决问题。
AI.method: 在Specs-on-Faces (SoF)数据集上，以相同预处理、划分与优化协议，对ResNet-50、VGG-16、FaceNet三个预训练卷积骨干进行微调。三者均采用160x160输入、冻结骨干加可训练头部、固定epoch预算，且不做逐骨干超参搜索。
AI.result: FaceNet配置(记为PFN，Partial FaceNet)显著优于另两者，在112个身份类别上达到97.4%测试准确率，宏平均精确率87.04%、召回率84.61%、F1 84.17%，为SoF上报告的最高准确率与召回率。
AI.conclusion: 在统一协议下，FaceNet骨干在部分人脸识别上明显优于ResNet-50和VGG-16，PFN在该数据集上取得最优准确率和召回率。

title: EEGAgentBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Short- and Long-Horizon EEG Analysis
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis is evolving from short-segment classification toward long-horizon interpretation that demands iterative evidence accumulation, multi-step reasoning, and coordinated use of specialized signal-processing tools. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise as autonomous agents for EEG analysis, existing EEG agentic evaluations remain fragmented, covering limited tasks over narrow temporal horizons with inconsistent protocols, and providing no comprehensive assessment of agents' reasoning, tool-use, and workflow construction capabilities. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{EEGAgentBench}, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM agents on short- and long-horizon EEG analysis. EEGAgentBench spans six representative EEG applications ranging from knowledge question answering to sleep staging. It encompasses signal durations from 2 seconds to nearly 23 hours, with prediction targets ranging from class labels to event intervals and epoch-level sequences. This design supports unified evaluation across knowledge reasoning, short-horizon interpretation, long-horizon event detection, and sequential understanding. The benchmark further provides 10 deterministic EEG analysis tools that expose only task-relevant signal measurements. Agents must therefore select tools autonomously, accumulate evidence iteratively, and construct multi-step workflows. For evaluation, we benchmark 29 frontier LLMs from 15 model families. Results demonstrate that EEGAgentBench effectively distinguishes agent capabilities beyond model scale and inference cost, while revealing substantial limitations of current LLM agents in long-horizon EEG analysis, particularly in sustained evidence accumulation and multi-step reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EEGAgentBench，一个统一评估LLM智能体在短时与长时EEG分析任务上的基准，涵盖六类应用、2秒至23小时信号、10种确定性工具，并对29个前沿LLM进行评测。
AI.motivation: EEG分析正从短片段分类转向长时程解读，需要迭代证据积累与多步推理；但现有EEG智能体评测零散、任务有限、协议不一致，缺乏对推理、工具使用与工作流构建能力的全面评估。
AI.method: 构建EEGAgentBench统一基准：覆盖六类代表性EEG应用（从知识问答到睡眠分期），信号时长2秒至近23小时，预测目标含类别标签、事件区间和逐epoch序列；提供10种确定性EEG分析工具（仅暴露任务相关的信号测量），要求智能体自主选工具、迭代积累证据并构建多步工作流；统一评估知识推理、短时解读、长时事件检测与序列理解。对15个模型家族的29个前沿LLM进行评测。
AI.result: EEGAgentBench能有效区分模型规模与推理成本之外的智能体能力，并揭示当前LLM智能体在长时程EEG分析上的显著不足，尤其在持续证据积累和多步推理方面。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为EEG智能体提供了统一、系统的评估框架，凸显长时程EEG分析仍是当前LLM智能体的主要瓶颈，为后续研究指明方向。

title: CP-Agent: A Harness-Engineered Agent for Crystal Plasticity Simulation Workflows
summary: Crystal plasticity (CP) simulations predict the mechanical behavior of polycrystalline metals, yet their routine use is hindered by the manual effort of configuring heterogeneous tools, orchestrating multi-step data pipelines, and calibrating constitutive parameters against experiments. These bottlenecks impede productivity in systematic parameter studies, motivating interest in automated workflows. This study presents CP-Agent, a harness-engineered LLM-based agent that autonomously executes complete CP modeling workflows from natural-language tasks. Operating under the ReAct paradigm, the agent reasons about tool selection and sequencing while delegating numerical search to established optimizers. The harness comprises a minimal system prompt, typed tool definitions, a dispatcher, and a safety-bounded iteration loop, encoding domain knowledge through tool schemas rather than hard-coded logic. CP-Agent is demonstrated on four case studies: calibrating four slip parameters of additively manufactured stainless steel 316L against tensile data; validating the workflow against published copper benchmarks, reproducing stress-strain and texture evolution; recovering the initial crystallographic texture of copper, where the agent correctly identifies a diffuse initial texture; and reproducing the multi-pass rolling texture evolution of a Mg-Zn-Ca alloy, where the agent chains five deformation passes and recovers the experimentally observed weakened, split basal texture. In all cases, the agent inferred the correct execution sequence from the task statement, robustly across repeated runs, and delivered physically interpretable results. This work establishes harness engineering as a systematic approach to automating CP modeling workflows while maintaining physical interpretability and auditability through visible reasoning traces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CP-Agent，一个基于 harness engineering 的 LLM 智能体，能在 ReAct 范式下自主完成晶体塑性建模全流程，并在四个案例中验证了其可靠性与物理可解释性。
AI.motivation: 晶体塑性（CP）模拟虽能预测多晶金属力学行为，但工具配置、数据流程编排和本构参数标定依赖大量人工，阻碍了系统性参数研究，因此需要自动化工作流。
AI.method: CP-Agent 采用 ReAct 范式，智能体负责工具选择与时序推理，将数值搜索交给已有优化器。其 harness 包含精简系统提示、类型化工具定义、调度器和安全受限迭代循环，通过工具 schema 而非硬编码逻辑编码领域知识。
AI.result: 四个案例：标定增材制造 316L 的四个滑移参数；用已发表铜基准验证工作流并复现应力-应变与织构演化；恢复铜的初始晶体织构（正确识别为弥散织构）；复现 Mg-Zn-Ca 合金五道次轧制织构演化并再现基面织构弱化与分裂。所有案例中智能体均能推断正确执行顺序，重复运行稳定，结果物理可解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了 harness engineering 作为自动化 CP 建模工作流的系统方法，并通过可见推理轨迹保持物理可解释性与可审计性。

title: On the Geographic Incentives of Multiple Concurrent Proposers
summary: We study whether systems with multiple concurrent proposers (MCP) incentivize the geographic decentralization of proposers. In our model, concurrent proposers strategically choose their locations to maximize their captured market share of users, who decide where to send transactions by comparing each proposer's time to inclusion. The time to inclusion between a user and a proposer consists of two terms: the distance between them, and the distance between the proposer and her nearest quorum of attesters, the latter of which we term the quorum radius. We formally prove that proposers' quorum radii are the determinant of their incentives: proposers optimally choose where to locate in order to minimize their quorum radii. We obtain as a result co-location when proposers also serve as attesters, but geographic diversity when these roles are separate. We also examine pre-confirmations and faster intervalidator connections, showing that they attenuate the influence of the quorum radius and further destabilize co-location incentives.

AI.tldr: 研究多并发提议者(MCP)是否激励提议者地理去中心化，证明quorum半径是激励决定因素。
AI.motivation: 探讨MCP机制能否促进提议者的地理去中心化，理解其激励机制。
AI.method: 建立模型，提议者策略性选择位置以最大化市场份额，用户根据包含时间选择交易发送对象；包含时间含用户到提议者距离及提议者到最近attester quorum的距离(quorum半径)，并形式化证明。
AI.result: 提议者最优选择是最小化quorum半径；提议者兼任attester时出现共址，角色分离时出现地理多样性；预确认和更快的验证者互联会削弱quorum半径影响并进一步破坏共址激励。
AI.conclusion: quorum半径是MCP提议者选址激励的核心决定因素，机制设计需考虑其对地理去中心化的影响。

title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
summary: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, \emph{The Harness of Harnesses}, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an \emph{All-Domain Collaboration Network}, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.

AI.tldr: Raven 提出"Harness of Harnesses"多智能体生态系统，自动构建并进化面向特定模型与领域的模块化 harness，通过 All-Domain 协作网络实现跨域长时程任务编排。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体正从孤立、特定领域的任务转向长时程、跨域工作流，带来两大挑战：harness 复杂度上升使手工设计难以扩展；与特定领域紧耦合限制了单一 harness 的通用性。核心问题从"如何为单一领域设计更强 harness"转向"如何自主构建、经验进化并跨域编排专用 harness"。
AI.method: 开源多智能体生态系统 Raven，将每个"模型-harness 对"视为可组合的智能单元。Host Agent 负责分解目标、匹配子任务到专用智能体、协调执行依赖并整合结果；host archive 与 EverOS 跨任务保存经验；Skill Forge 将经验转化为可复用流程。同时从理论上给出充分条件，证明在共享资源预算下此组合能扩展可靠任务覆盖范围。
AI.result: 在复杂、长时程任务上，Raven 显著优于当前最先进的智能体系统，推进了可组合智能体智能的边界。
AI.conclusion: Raven 通过自动构建与进化模块化 harness 及跨域编排，为可组合、可扩展的智能体智能提供了新范式与理论支撑。

title: From PDF to Evidence: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Clinical Practice Guidelines
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Guideline documents are published as unstructured PDFs whose evidence is locked in visual structures---tables, flowcharts, and graded recommendations---that standard retrieval pipelines flatten into fixed-size text chunks. We cast evidence access as a document image analysis problem: parse each page image into typed structural elements, then retrieve structure-aware evidence units that follow the document's own layout (sections, table rows, flowchart paths, graded recommendations), each keeping its structural context so a result points to a specific element rather than a page. On 26 clinical practice guidelines from 9 sources (3,619 pages, Chinese and English) with 199 evidence queries, structure-aware units rank the gold element first under BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval (hybrid Element Hit@1 of 0.382), with a significant element-level ranking gain over per-element OCR text (MRR_e +0.107, p=0.002; the Hit@5 gain is directional, p=0.17), while matching page-level recall (Page Hit@5 0.879 vs. 0.889, p=0.75) at 3.8x less context and clearly outperforming a ColPali visual-RAG baseline (PH@5 0.497).

AI.tldr: 将指南PDF证据获取视为文档图像分析问题，解析页面为带类型的结构元素并按文档自身布局（章节、表格行、流程图路径、分级推荐）检索结构感知证据单元。在26部指南（3,619页，中英文）199条查询上，结构感知单元在BM25/稠密/混合检索下均将金标准元素排第一（混合Element Hit@1=0.382），元素级排名较逐元素OCR文本显著提升（MRR_e +0.107, p=0.002），在文本量少3.8倍下匹配页面级召回率（Page Hit@5 0.879 vs 0.889），并大幅超越ColPali视觉RAG基线（PH@5 0.497）。
AI.motivation: 指南文档以非结构化PDF发布，证据被锁定在表格、流程图和分级推荐等视觉结构中，标准检索流水线将其压平为固定大小文本块，丢失了结构上下文，导致检索结果只能指向页面而非具体元素。
AI.method: 将证据获取构建为文档图像分析问题：先把每个页面图像解析为带类型的结构元素，再检索遵循文档自身布局的结构感知证据单元，如章节、表格行、流程图路径和分级推荐，每个单元保留其结构上下文，使结果指向具体元素而非页面。
AI.result: 在来自9个来源的26部临床实践指南（3,619页，中英文）和199条证据查询上，结构感知单元在BM25、稠密和混合检索下均将金标准元素排在第一，混合检索Element Hit@1为0.382；相较逐元素OCR文本有显著的元素级排名提升（MRR_e +0.107, p=0.002；Hit@5提升为方向性, p=0.17），同时匹配页面级召回率（Page Hit@5 0.879 vs 0.889, p=0.75）且上下文量少3.8倍，并明显优于ColPali视觉RAG基线（PH@5 0.497）。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的证据检索能在保持页面级召回率的同时显著提升元素级排名精度、降低所需上下文，并优于视觉RAG基线，表明以文档图像分析方式获取指南证据是有效的。

title: Graph-Guided Repository Environment Construction
summary: Coding agents now increasingly rely on execution to validate their solutions, making the construction of reliable execution environments a critical enabling capability. However, repository environment construction is challenging because execution requirements are fragmented across repository artifacts and may only become apparent during execution. Existing agent-based approaches address this problem through iterative interaction, but information about the current construction state, including discovered requirements, satisfied and unresolved prerequisites, and their dependencies, can remain distributed across the interaction history. We present Graph2Env, an agent-based approach centered on DepGraph, a typed dependency graph that explicitly represents the environment requirements needed for repository execution, their dependency relations, and their states. Graph2Env uses DepGraph to guide environment construction and continuously refines it with execution feedback, while persisting successful repairs into a replayable construction procedure. The resulting artifacts are then applied in a fresh environment to verify that the constructed environment can be reproduced. We evaluate Graph2Env on a benchmark of 200 Python repositories drawn from RATBench and EnvBench, against a static dependency-inference baseline (pipreqs), three specialized environment-construction systems (Repo2Run, RAT, and SetupX), and two general-purpose coding agents (SWE-agent and Claude Code). Graph2Env achieves an 81.0% Environment Build Success Rate (EBSR) and a 59.3% Environment Setup Success Rate (ESSR), outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.5 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: Graph2Env：以DepGraph（类型化依赖图）为中心的智能体方法，显式表示仓库执行的环境需求、依赖关系与状态，并借助执行反馈持续精化，最终持久化为可复现的构建流程。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体依赖执行验证方案，可靠的执行环境构建成为关键能力。但仓库环境构建困难：执行需求分散在仓库各类工件中，且部分需求只有在实际执行时才暴露。现有基于智能体的方法通过迭代交互解决，但构建状态信息（已发现需求、已满足/未解决前置条件及其依赖）分散在交互历史中，缺乏统一表示。
AI.method: 提出Graph2Env，核心为DepGraph——一种类型化依赖图，显式表示仓库执行所需环境需求、依赖关系及状态。Graph2Env以DepGraph指导环境构建，并利用执行反馈持续精化该图；同时将成功修复持久化为可重放的构建过程（construction procedure）。生成的产物在全新环境中重放，以验证环境可复现性。
AI.result: 在来自RATBench与EnvBench的200个Python仓库基准上评测，对比静态依赖推断基线pipreqs、三个专用环境构建系统（Repo2Run、RAT、SetupX）及两个通用编码智能体（SWE-agent、Claude Code）。Graph2Env达到81.0%环境构建成功率（EBSR）与59.3%环境搭建成功率（ESSR），分别超出最强基线9.5和9.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以显式类型化依赖图统一管理仓库环境构建的状态与依赖，并结合执行反馈迭代精化与可复现流程持久化，能显著提升环境构建与搭建成功率，优于现有专用系统与通用智能体。

title: Omni-IO Skills: Harnessing Your Agent Omni-Native
summary: General-purpose agents can plan, reason, and act over long horizons, yet their production capabilities remain fragmented across text, images, audio, video, documents, 3D assets, and code. Extending a foundation model to additional modalities ties capability growth to costly model updates, while assembling specialist models and tools leaves unresolved how procedures, dependencies, intermediate assets, and cross-turn revisions should be coordinated. We present Omni-IO Skills, a plug-and-play Agent Harness that makes existing agents omni-native through hierarchical Skills, a standardized multimodal execution interface, dependency-aware orchestration, and a persistent Asset Registry. Multi-asset workflows are represented as Declare Execution Graphs, which schedule independent operations concurrently and register successful outputs for downstream and cross-turn reuse across replaceable execution backends. Its 27 Skills cover 38 representative tasks spanning seven artifact modalities and four capability families: understanding, generation, reasoning, and retrieval. On UniM-90, the harness raises the input-support rates of GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5 from 40.00% and 38.89% to 100%, while increasing relative Semantic--Quality Coupled Score from 26.99 to 74.94 and from 27.82 to 77.78, respectively; Strict Structure Score reaches 100.00 and 99.78. These results establish harness-level capability composition as a practical route to broad, evolvable Omni systems without changing the host agent's reasoning core.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Omni-IO Skills,一个即插即用的 Agent Harness,通过分层 Skills、标准化多模态执行接口、依赖感知编排和持久化 Asset Registry,让现有通用 agent 无需改动推理核心即可变为"全能原生",在 90 项多模态任务上大幅提升输入支持率与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 通用 agent 虽能长程规划与推理,但其生产能力仍碎片化于文本、图像、音频、视频、文档、3D 资产和代码等模态。扩展基础模型到新模态需昂贵更新,而组装专家模型和工具又缺乏对流程、依赖、中间资产和跨轮修订的协调机制。
AI.method: 提出 Omni-IO Skills:即插即用 Agent Harness,包含分层 Skills、标准化多模态执行接口、依赖感知编排、持久化 Asset Registry。多资产工作流建模为 Declare Execution Graphs,可并发调度独立操作并将成功输出注册供下游及跨轮复用,且支持可替换执行后端。共 27 个 Skills,覆盖 7 种产物模态、4 类能力(理解、生成、推理、检索)的 38 项代表性任务。
AI.result: 在 UniM-90 上,GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude Sonnet 5 的输入支持率从 40.00% 和 38.89% 提升至 100%;相对语义-质量耦合得分分别从 26.99、27.82 提升至 74.94、77.78;严格结构得分达 100.00 与 99.78。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明,harness 层面的能力组合是在不改变宿主 agent 推理核心的前提下,构建广泛且可演化全能系统的可行路径。

title: Toward AI-Assisted Poultry Coccidiosis Diagnosis: Evaluating Gemini and BiomedParse on Eimeria Microscopy Images
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at IEEE International Conference on Sustainability, Innovation and Technology (ICSIT 2026)
summary: Coccidiosis caused by Eimeria parasites is a major economic burden in poultry production, and effective control depends on accurate species-level diagnosis. This study evaluates whether a general-purpose multimodal large language model can support such diagnosis. Google Gemini was assessed on 4,225 mi- croscopy images covering the seven fowl-infecting Eimeria species under two prompting conditions, one without candidate labels and one with a predefined class list, and was further tested for pathology-report generation, while BiomedParse was examined for parasite segmentation. Without candidate labels, the model produced broad and taxonomically inconsistent outputs. With candidate labels, overall accuracy reached only 14.9%, with a strong bias toward E. tenella at 74% and no correct classifications for E. acervulina, E. mitis and E. praecox. Generated treatment reports were coherent but unverified, and segmentation was only partial. Current multimodal models are therefore not yet reliable for standalone Eimeria diagnosis without domain-specific fine- tuning and expert validation.

AI.tldr: 评估通用多模态大模型(Gemini)诊断家禽艾美耳球虫的能力，结果显示其无法可靠完成物种级诊断。
AI.motivation: 球虫病是家禽养殖的重大经济负担，有效防控依赖准确的物种级诊断，但通用模型在该领域的适用性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在4,225张显微图像（涵盖7种感染家禽的艾美耳球虫）上评测Google Gemini，设两种提示条件（无候选标签、有预定义类别列表），并测试病理报告生成；用BiomedParse检验寄生虫分割。
AI.result: 无候选标签时输出宽泛且分类不一致；有候选标签时总体准确率仅14.9%，严重偏向E. tenella（74%），对E. acervulina、E. mitis和E. praecox无正确分类；报告连贯但未经核实，分割仅部分成功。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型在未经领域微调和专家验证前，尚不可靠用于独立的艾美耳球虫诊断。

title: Enhancing generalization in endwall film cooling prediction: Incorporating the superposition principle into transformer-based neural operators
comment: Author manuscript updated to align core methods and results with the published article; 29 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables
summary: In this study, a physics-enhanced neural operator framework is proposed to enhance the generalization prediction ability of the cooling layout of a turbine endwall with variable number of film holes. Specifically, inspired by the film cooling superposition principle, we propose a film cooling prediction model, namely superposition-based deep neural operator (SDNO), that divides the endwall temperature field prediction into two stages. In the first stage, the cooling layout of a turbine endwall is divided into several sub-parts with randomly assigned film holes, and a Transformer-based neural operator network, namely Calculate Net, is designed to predict the temperature field of each sub-part. Then, in the second stage, another neural operator network, i.e., Super Net, is trained to combine the temperature fields predicted by Calculate Net for each sub-part and obtain the superposed temperature field of the full cooling layout. Additionally, instead of directly taking the film cooling contours as pixel plots, a signed distance function (SDF) which is sensitive to the variable locations of cooling holes, is designed to encode the location information of cooling holes. Furthermore, the proposed endwall film cooling prediction model is trained with the samples that changing the number of film holes from 1-5 with variable locations. Then, the trained prediction shows excellent generalization prediction ability, which can accurately predict the film effectiveness of the cooling layout with 10-20 film cooling holes that are unseen in the training samples. The proposed SDNO also improves prediction accuracy relative to the fully supervised baseline. With the above, the effectiveness of our proposed prediction model has been well demonstrated.

AI.tldr: 提出物理增强神经算子框架SDNO，通过两阶段预测实现涡轮端壁气膜冷却布局的泛化预测。
AI.motivation: 提升涡轮端壁冷却布局在气膜孔数量变化时的泛化预测能力。
AI.method: 受气膜冷却叠加原理启发，将温度场预测分为两阶段：第一阶段将端壁冷却布局划分成随机分配气膜孔的子部分，用Transformer神经算子Calculate Net预测各子部分温度场；第二阶段用Super Net组合各子部分温度场得到全布局叠加温度场；并采用对孔位置敏感的SDF编码孔位信息。
AI.result: 用1-5个孔（位置可变）的训练样本训练后，模型能准确预测训练中未见的10-20孔冷却布局的气膜效率，且比全监督基线精度更高。
AI.conclusion: SDNO框架有效增强了端壁气膜冷却的泛化预测能力。

title: ConflictVLA-Bench: Benchmarking Behavioral Responses of Vision-Language-Action Models to Premise Conflicts
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform strongly on manipulation tasks, their responses to invalid task premises remain underexplored. Existing evaluations of premise conflicts often focus on terminal task outcomes, yet task failure alone cannot distinguish behavioral disengagement from continued pursuit followed by an execution error. We call the latter pattern Failed Persistence. To study this phenomenon, we introduce ConflictVLA-Bench, which pairs conflict rollouts with premise-consistent reference rollouts and evaluates both outcomes and execution processes. Built on LIBERO, the benchmark contains 2,826 prompt-conditioned conflict tasks spanning four conflict families, four structural configurations, and two prompt conditions. Across all eight VLAs, invalid premises reduce original goal completion by at least 17.3 percentage points, with the reduction reaching 56.2 percentage points for OpenVLA. Crucially, even when models succeed on premise-consistent tasks and fail on their matched conflict tasks, they often continue to approach the original targets, retain early trajectory structure, and show limited action magnitude suppression. Failed Persistence therefore recurs across the evaluated models. Explicit premise checking does not consistently produce selective and coordinated behavioral changes. These findings show that terminal failure alone establishes neither behavioral disengagement nor refusal and that outcomes alone are insufficient for VLA evaluation. Experimental data and additional details are available on the project page: https://github.com/EmbodiedAISurvey/ConflictVLA-Bench

AI.tldr: 论文提出ConflictVLA-Bench基准，研究VLA模型面对无效任务前提时的"失败坚持"（Failed Persistence）现象，发现仅评估最终结果不足以判断模型是否真正放弃任务。
AI.motivation: 现有对VLA模型前提冲突的评估多聚焦于终端任务结果，但任务失败无法区分"行为脱离"与"继续追求后执行出错"（即Failed Persistence），缺乏对执行过程的评估。
AI.method: 构建ConflictVLA-Bench，基于LIBERO，将冲突rollout与前提一致的参考rollout配对，同时评估结果与执行过程；包含2,826个前提条件化冲突任务，覆盖4类冲突、4种结构配置、2种提示条件。
AI.result: 在8个VLA模型上，无效前提使原目标完成率至少下降17.3个百分点，OpenVLA下降达56.2个百分点；即使模型在一致任务成功、冲突任务失败，仍常继续接近原目标、保留早期轨迹结构、动作幅度抑制有限；显式前提检查无法稳定产生选择性、协调的行为变化。
AI.conclusion: 终端失败既不能证明行为脱离也不能证明拒绝，仅用结果评估VLA模型是不充分的。

title: Tight Efficiency Guarantees for Strategyproof Linear Regression
summary: We study the trade-off between squared-error accuracy and incentive compatibility in linear regression. Agents report private labels associated with publicly known features and prefer predictions close to their true labels. Ordinary least squares (OLS) need not elicit truthful reports. For regression with $d$ parameters, we design a deterministic group-strategyproof mechanism achieving a $(d+1)$-approximation to the least-squares optimum and prove optimality even among universally strategyproof randomized mechanisms, answering an open question of Chen et al. (EC 2018). Relaxing universal strategyproofness to strategyproofness in expectation reveals a sharp separation: squared individual loss retains the factor $d+1$, while absolute individual loss admits the tight ratio $2-1/(\lceil d/2\rceil+1)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线性回归中平方误差精度与激励相容性的权衡，设计了确定性组策略防御机制，达到(d+1)近似并证明其最优性。
AI.motivation: 在回归任务中，代理会报告与公开特征相关的私有标签，并偏好接近真实标签的预测；普通最小二乘（OLS）无法保证真实报告，因此需研究精度与激励相容之间的权衡。
AI.method: 针对含d个参数的回归，设计确定性组策略防御机制；进一步将普遍策略防御放松为期望策略防御，分析平方个体损失与绝对个体损失。
AI.result: 该机制达到对最小二乘最优解的(d+1)近似，并证明其在普遍策略防御随机机制中最优，回答了Chen等人（EC 2018）的开放问题；放松后出现清晰分离：平方个体损失保持d+1因子，绝对个体损失达到紧确比率2-1/(⌈d/2⌉+1)。
AI.conclusion: 在线性回归中，精度与策略防御存在可刻画的权衡，(d+1)近似是普遍策略防御下的最优保证，而期望策略防御下不同损失函数导致不同紧确比率。

title: Program-Verified Self-Evolution for Vision-Language Models
summary: Self-evolving vision-language models train on questions they generate from unlabeled images. Since these questions have no gold answers, prior methods label them by majority vote over sampled answers or by a model judge. In a human evaluation, we find that 24\% of majority-vote labels and 18\% of model-judge labels produced during self-evolution are wrong. To address this problem, we present Verifiable QA Generation for Self-Evolving Models (VQS), which changes how the model judges answers. Instead of voting on an answer, the model parses each image into a structured record, such as a scene graph, a chart table, or a diagram graph. Fixed programs then write a question from the record and compute its answer. The model still acts as a visual checker, but it only confirms the individual facts the program reads, one short claim at a time. These claim-level checks select the parser's training targets, so the parser also improves without labels. Human raters find 94\% of VQS answers correct, against 76\% for majority voting. Across ten benchmarks, VQS improves Qwen3-VL by up to 3.18 points at the 2B, 4B, and 8B scales and outperforms the strongest self-evolving baseline at each. Gains keep growing over three training rounds, reaching 3.84 points at 2B. Code is released at https://github.com/ahmedheakl/VQS

AI.tldr: VQS 通过将图像解析为结构化记录并用固定程序生成问答，替代自演化VLM中的投票打标，显著提升标签正确率与下游性能。
AI.motivation: 自演化视觉语言模型在无标注图像上自生成问题，但无标准答案，常用多数投票或模型评判打标，人工评估显示这些标签错误率高达24%和18%。
AI.method: 提出VQS：模型将图像解析为结构化记录（场景图、图表表格、示意图图），固定程序据记录写问题并计算答案；模型仅作为视觉校验器逐条确认程序读取的短事实声明，这些声明级检查用于选择解析器的训练目标，实现无标签自改进。
AI.result: 人工评估VQS答案94%正确，优于多数投票的76%；在十个基准上，Qwen3-VL在2B/4B/8B规模最高提升3.18分，超过最强自演化基线，三轮训练后增益达3.84分（2B）。
AI.conclusion: VQS用可验证的程序化问答生成取代不可靠的答案投票打标，有效降低标签噪声并持续提升自演化模型性能。

title: Beyond the Beam: Constructive Repair and Candidate Completion for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommenders retrieve items by generating identifiers, but a valid identifier can remain outside the beam after catalog expansion. This raises two connected questions: which failures can identifier assignment repair, and how should retrieval proceed beyond the initial beam? We characterize assignment repair with a fixed generator and retained old identifiers. Output-invariance certificates identify failures shared by all admissible assignments. Under a common effective prefix, coupled support and ranking constraints give the exact feasible interval of new-item counts for target recovery. Building on this characterization, Beyond the Beam (BB) obtains minimum-replacement repairs through an integral flow formulation, selects a shared map and adapts the generator. At inference, generative likelihood and collaborative evidence define one score for ranking, candidate priority and stopping. Retained prefix bounds guide candidate completion and certify its global Top-$K$ when the stopping condition is met. Exhaustive finite-catalog evaluation confirms construction in every feasible case. Across three Amazon Reviews categories and three random seeds, the full T5 procedure improves mean Recall@10 by 15.5--46.3% and NDCG@10 by 15.2--44.4% over the best-performing evaluated generative baseline for each dataset and metric. Matched controls show that shared construction and adaptation improve new-target ranking and certification efficiency on Beauty and Toys. Combined scoring and candidate completion improve NDCG@10 across all three datasets with both T5 and decoder-only LC-Rec.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式推荐中标识符分配修复与beam外检索问题，提出Beyond the Beam (BB)框架，通过整数流进行最小替换修复、共享映射与生成器适配，并在推理时结合生成似然与协同信号统一打分与候选补全。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐器通过生成标识符检索物品，但目录扩展后有效标识符可能落在beam之外，导致检索失败。需要回答两个问题：标识符分配能修复哪些失败，以及超出初始beam后检索应如何进行。
AI.method: 在固定生成器并保留旧标识符下刻画分配修复；用输出不变性证书识别所有可行分配共有的失败；在共同有效前缀下，用耦合的支持与排序约束给出新物品数量恢复目标的精确可行区间。基于此，BB用整数流求解最小替换修复，选择共享映射并适配生成器；推理时用生成似然与协同证据定义统一分数用于排序、候选优先与停止，并用保留前缀界指导候选补全及全局Top-K认证。
AI.result: 穷举有限目录评估确认在所有可行情况下均能构造。在三个Amazon Reviews类别和三个随机种子上，完整T5流程相比最佳生成式基线将平均Recall@10提升15.5–46.3%，NDCG@10提升15.2–44.4%。匹配控制实验显示共享构造与适配提升了Beauty和Toys上的新目标排序与认证效率；组合打分与候选补全在三个数据集上提升了T5和decoder-only LC-Rec的NDCG@10。
AI.conclusion: 通过刻画标识符分配修复的可行性边界并提出BB框架，可有效修复beam外检索失败并提升生成式推荐性能，且统一打分与候选补全具有广泛适用性。

title: Path2Spec: Path-Aware Specification Generation via Large Language Models
summary: Formal specifications are critical for program verification, comprehension, and maintenance. However, manually writing them is costly and difficult to scale. Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) are promising for automated specification generation, but existing methods suffer from quality issues. We analyze a state-of-the-art approach and find that at least 34.6% of successfully verified specifications actually fail to meaningfully capture the program's distinct behavior, which is a quality issue not captured by metrics that only measure verification success. We further found that a major factor contributing to such hidden quality issues stems from the design of existing methods: these methods treat a program as a single unit, resulting in overly general, coarse-grained constraints. To this end, we introduce Path2Spec, a divide-and-conquer framework that addresses these limitations through systematic path-based reasoning. Path2Spec leverages LLMs to extract all execution paths from an input program, generates path-specific specifications for each, and merges them into a comprehensive overall specification. For complex programs where path-based generation struggles, Path2Spec employs a decompose-then-retry strategy that recursively breaks a program into smaller subprograms based on logical branches, generates specifications for each, and merges them back. We evaluate Path2Spec on two public benchmarks: SG-Bench (120 programs) and SV-COMP (265 programs). Results show that Path2Spec can outperform the state-of-the-art baseline SpecGen: 87.5% versus 66.7% on SG-Bench, and 83.0% versus 44.2% on SV-COMP. Human evaluation further validates that Path2Spec generates higher-quality specifications with precise semantic alignment to the code.

AI.tldr: Path2Spec：用分而治之+路径推理提升LLM自动生成形式化规格的质量，在SG-Bench和SV-COMP上显著超越SpecGen。
AI.motivation: 手工编写形式化规格成本高、难扩展；现有LLM方法虽能通过验证，但质量差——至少34.6%通过验证的规格并未真正刻画程序独特行为，根因是它们把程序当作单一整体，产生过于笼统、粗粒度的约束。
AI.method: 提出Path2Spec分而治之框架：先用LLM提取程序所有执行路径，为每条路径生成路径特定规格，再合并为整体规格；对复杂程序采用"先分解后重试"策略，按逻辑分支递归拆成子程序，分别生成规格再合并。
AI.result: 在SG-Bench（120程序）和SV-COMP（265程序）上：SG-Bench 87.5% vs SpecGen 66.7%；SV-COMP 83.0% vs 44.2%。人工评估证实Path2Spec生成的规格质量更高、与代码语义更精确对齐。
AI.conclusion: 基于路径的分而治之推理能有效缓解LLM生成规格中的隐蔽质量问题，产出与代码语义高度对齐的高质量形式化规格。

title: Agents Can Use Base Models to Evade AI Detection
summary: We show that coding agents equipped with a base language model can successfully assemble responses from its samples to evade detection. Base models have been shown to evade commercial detectors, however, prior "humanization" techniques rely on using these models to paraphrase AI outputs over several iterations, which invariably results in semantic drift. In contrast, equipping coding agents to directly orchestrate the writing process by stitching text samples from a base model allows it to produce outputs that are coherent, task-specific and generally high quality. We find that Claude Opus 5 operating in a Claude Code harness effectively orchestrates a local 32B parameter OLMo-2 base LM and sacrifices little task accuracy across benchmarks spanning creative writing, factual grounding, health QA and instruction following, while using up to 90% base LM tokens. Responses constructed in this manner reduce the effectiveness of both post-hoc detectors (Pangram v4 detection rate drops from 77% to 24%) and soft watermarking applied a priori to the agent's generations (down to a simulated 10% detection at low FPR). While effective, this evasion requires a significantly larger number of input and output tokens from the agent, increasing the dollar cost per query up to 30x at API-pricing. Overall, this work demonstrates the effectiveness of a new class of adversarial attacks against AI text detection, and urges post-hoc detection providers to include outputs of base models in their training.

AI.tldr: 编码代理通过编排基础语言模型的样本来组装文本，可有效规避AI检测与软水印，但API成本大幅上升。
AI.motivation: 现有"人类化"规避技术依赖多轮改写AI输出，易造成语义漂移。需要一种既能保持文本连贯与高质量、又能规避检测的新方法。
AI.method: 让配备基础语言模型的编码代理直接编排写作过程，将基础模型的文本样本拼接组装成回应。实验中Claude Opus 5（运行于Claude Code框架）编排本地32B参数OLMo-2基础模型。
AI.result: 在创意写作、事实性、健康QA和指令遵循等基准上准确率损失很小，基础模型token使用率高达90%。Pangram v4检测率从77%降至24%，软水印检测率降至模拟10%。但代理的输入输出token显著增加，单次查询成本最高增加30倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一类针对AI文本检测的新型对抗攻击，建议事后检测提供商将基础模型输出纳入训练数据。

title: Devanagari Handwritten Character Recognition Using TrOCR: A Transformer-Based Model with Real-Time Web Deployment
comment: Presented and accepted at the 16th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT), 2025
summary: Devnagari is a one of the ancient language of the Indian subcontinent consisting of 36 vowels, 14 consonants and 10 numerals. The accurate recognition of handwritten Devnagari characters is challenging due to high complexity of Devnagari scripts. This paper presents a method to fine tune the pre trained TrOCR model to accurately recognize Devanagari handwritten characters. The Methodology consists of a preprocessing mechanism where input images are standardized into RGB format, tokenized in batches and integrated with Hugging Face Dataset. The pre-trained microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten model is fine-tuned over a dataset of nearly 5000 character images that are uniformly partitioned in the ratio 8:1:1 for training, evaluation and testing. Further optimization is done is the training process through mixed precision training, gradient checkpointing, and early stopping mechanism. The model achieves a character error rate (CER) of 3.95% and a character-level accuracy of 96.05%, outperforming the previous CNN based models. A scalable web application is developed using Vite.js, Golang, and FastAPI which practically deploys the OCR model and serves character recognition task with a latency less than 5 seconds per request. This study demonstrates the use of TrOCR model to build a scalable handwritten Devnagari character recognition system and also a foundation to future research on Devnagari Script Recognition using Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文微调预训练TrOCR模型识别手写天城文（Devanagari）字符，达到CER 3.95%和字符级准确率96.05%，并开发了低延迟Web应用。
AI.motivation: 天城文包含36个元音、14个辅音和10个数字，书写复杂，手写字符精确识别难度大，传统CNN模型性能有限，需要更优的Transformer方案。
AI.method: 采用预处理将图像标准化为RGB格式并分批tokenize，集成Hugging Face Dataset；对microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten预训练模型在约5000张字符图像（8:1:1划分）上微调，结合混合精度训练、梯度检查点和早停优化。并用Vite.js、Golang和FastAPI开发可扩展Web应用进行部署。
AI.result: 字符错误率（CER）3.95%，字符级准确率96.05%，优于此前基于CNN的模型；Web应用每请求延迟低于5秒。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明TrOCR可用于构建可扩展的手写天城文字符识别系统，并为未来基于Transformer的天城文识别研究奠定基础。

title: Symmetry-quotient Flatness and Generalization
comment: Accepted to 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026) as an extended abstract. This version is the full paper
summary: This paper develops a theorem-level pipeline in symmetry-quotient settings: quotient linear stability implies quotient flatness, quotient flatness implies input smoothness, and input smoothness yields generalization under local covering assumptions. Flatness is often associated with generalization, and Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is frequently viewed as implicitly biased toward flat solutions. However, standard flatness measures are typically defined in the raw parameter space and are therefore not invariant under function-preserving symmetries such as positive rescaling. We develop a symmetry-aware theory of quotient flatness, quotient linear stability, input smoothness, and generalization on quotient spaces of neural-network parameters. For square loss and models equipped with function-preserving group actions, we define quotient flatness as the trace of the Hessian of the empirical loss on the regular quotient manifold. We show that quotient flatness controls input smoothness through a quotient-space analogue of the flatness-to-smoothness argument. We also prove that one-step mean-square quotient linear stability of the linearized SGD dynamics implies an explicit quotient-flatness bound in terms of the batch size and learning rate, and extend this analysis to higher-order tensor moments. Finally, under local covering and boundedness assumptions, we derive population generalization bounds in terms of quotient flatness and, consequently, in terms of quotient linear stability.

AI.tldr: 本文在对称商空间上建立理论框架：商线性稳定性⇒商平坦性⇒输入平滑性⇒泛化，并给出SGD批次与学习率相关的商平坦界及总体泛化界。
AI.motivation: 标准平坦性度量在原始参数空间中定义，对正缩放等保函数对称性不变，因此需要对称感知的商平坦性理论来刻画SGD的隐式偏置与泛化。
AI.method: 在平方损失和具保函数群作用的模型上，将商平坦性定义为经验损失Hessian在正则商流形上的迹；证明商平坦性通过商空间平坦-平滑类比控制输入平滑性；证明线性化SGD的一步均方商线性稳定性蕴含显式商平坦界，并推广到高阶张量矩。
AI.result: 建立商平坦性⇒输入平滑性⇒泛化的定理链；给出以批次大小和学习率表示的商平坦界；在局部覆盖与有界假设下得到以商平坦性和商线性稳定性表示的总体泛化界。
AI.conclusion: SGD的隐式平坦偏置可在商空间中严格刻画，商平坦性与商线性稳定性可作为对对称性不变的泛化预测指标。

title: Working with AI: A Design Framework for Human-AI Collaboration
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly GenAI, is becoming an increasingly important part of modern work. In industrial settings, AI can support decision-making, automate routine activities, assist humans, and improve productivity. However, successful AI adoption depends on more than what the technology can do. It also depends on how people experience and work with it. This raises an important question: how should human-AI collaboration be designed so that it works well for both people and organisations? This white paper addresses that question by presenting a practical framework for designing human-AI collaboration. The framework considers the human, the AI system, the task, the organisation, and the wider societal environment. It explains what effective collaboration looks like, what conditions influence it, what requirements should be met, and what design decisions organisations should consider. The report also includes a human-AI collaborative assembly system with cobot use case to demonstrate how the framework can be applied in practice. The use case shows how design requirements can be translated into specific collaboration features and evaluated through a case study. The aim of this white paper is to provide a clear and practical guide for designing human-AI collaboration that is effective, human-centred, and responsible.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份白皮书，提出一个用于设计人机（尤其生成式AI）协作的实践框架，涵盖人、AI系统、任务、组织及社会环境五个维度，并通过协作装配/协作机器人案例展示框架的落地应用。
AI.motivation: AI（尤其GenAI）在现代工作中日益重要，可辅助决策、自动化常规任务并提升生产力，但成功应用不仅取决于技术能力，还取决于人的体验与协作方式，因此需要解决"如何设计对人类和组织都有效的人机协作"这一问题。
AI.method: 提出一个实践性设计框架，从人、AI系统、任务、组织及更广社会环境的多个维度出发，阐述有效协作的表现、影响因素、应满足的需求及组织应考虑的设计决策；并纳入一个含协作机器人（cobot）的人机协作装配系统用例，将设计需求转化为具体协作特性，通过案例研究进行评估。
AI.result: 该用例展示了设计需求如何被转化为具体的协作特性，并通过案例研究加以评估，说明框架在实践中具备可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 本文旨在为设计有效、以人为本且负责任的人机协作提供清晰且实用的指导。

title: The Double-Edged Sword of Information: Revealed versus Hidden Lotteries in School Choice
summary: In school choice, a lottery number is often used by the matching mechanism to break ties when there are more students who prefer the same school than the number of seats available. There has been growing theoretical and empirical interest in understanding the impact of revealing the lottery number to students. In practice, in recent years, the NYC Public Schools started revealing the lottery number to students to improve transparency. Theoretical findings from prior literature also suggest that revealing the lottery number strictly improves the number of matches under the deferred acceptance algorithm. However, these theoretical results are based on the over-simplifying assumption that all students share the same preference ranking for schools. In this work, we relax this assumption and allow students to have heterogeneous preference rankings. Under a game-theoretic model where student strategies form a Bayesian Nash equilibrium, we characterize scenarios where revealing the lottery number can either improve or worsen the matching outcome, measured by two metrics of match rate and social welfare. We further consider revealing partial information about the lottery, and demonstrate non-monotonic effects in the amount of information available to students. These results together illustrate complex tradeoffs induced by the lottery revealing policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究学校选择中公开彩票号码对学生匹配结果的影响，放松了学生偏好同质的假设，在异质偏好和贝叶斯纳什均衡下刻画了公开彩票号码可能改善或恶化匹配的情形，并发现公开部分信息存在非单调效应。
AI.motivation: 已有理论和实证研究表明，向学生公开彩票号码可提高透明度，并在延迟接受算法下严格增加匹配数量。然而这些结论依赖"所有学生对学校偏好排序相同"的过度简化假设，现实中偏好是异质的，因此需要放松该假设重新评估公开彩票号码政策的效果。
AI.method: 作者采用博弈论模型，允许学生具有异质偏好排序，并将学生策略建模为贝叶斯纳什均衡。在此框架下分析公开彩票号码对匹配结果的影响，使用匹配率和社会福利两个指标衡量结果，并进一步分析公开部分彩票信息的情形。
AI.result: 研究刻画了公开彩票号码可能改善也可能恶化匹配结果的具体情形（分别以匹配率和社会福利衡量）。同时发现，若仅公开部分彩票信息，信息量对结果的影响呈现非单调性。
AI.conclusion: 在异质偏好下，公开彩票号码政策带来复杂的权衡取舍，并非总能改善匹配结果；部分信息公开的效果也非单调。这些结果说明该政策的影响比以往同质偏好模型所预测的更为复杂。

title: Hidden Activations are not Enough I: Knowledge Matrices as Higher Representations
comment: 86 pages, main text 35 pages, appendices 51 pages
summary: We study the knowledge matrix of a trained feedforward network as a higher representation of its inputs. A network is a pair $(W,f)$, a thin representation $W$ of its quiver and an activation $f$; its function factorizes through the space of quiver representations, each input $x$ inducing a representation, and the knowledge matrix $M(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times(d+1)}$ is the contraction of that representation to one matrix whose rows sum exactly to the logits. At one trained network we ask what determines it, what it is invariant to, what it determines, and what its geometry measures. Under (LCS), a locally constant slope diagonal, as for ReLU, the matrix at a regular input is a function of the realized germ; its stabilizer among encodings regular there is exactly the germ stabilizer at inputs with no vanishing coordinate, neuron permutation a special case; and it recovers the germ, whereas hidden activations, gauge-covariant and germ-incomplete, are not enough. Under (LCS) it equals per-class gradient$\times$input plus an exact aggregate bias attribution, grounding it in attribution theory and computing it by $C$ vector-Jacobian products instead of probing. The fixed shape gives an alignment-free per-sample distance between ResNet-152, DenseNet-121 and GoogLeNet; the row-sum identity gives an exact visible/invisible displacement decomposition whose unit-free coherence $A=(d_Ψ/d_M)^2$ puts adversarial germ motion at median $A\le 0.23$, with an attack-family ordering concordant across six architectures (Kendall $W=0.921$; $0.97$ on the three networks at full scale). Two honest negatives: on AlexNet/CIFAR-10 penultimate features win 5 of 6 detectors and all 16 attacks, and a matrix-direction counterfactual fails 0/54.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"知识矩阵"作为训练后前馈网络输入的高层表示，研究其在局部常斜率(LCS)下的性质、归因联系、几何度量及跨架构应用。
AI.motivation: 作者希望找到一种比隐层激活更完整、对编码不变、能刻画训练网络行为的高层表示，并回答它由什么决定、对什么不变、能决定什么以及其几何度量什么。
AI.method: 将网络视为(quiver的薄表示W, 激活f)，定义知识矩阵M(x)∈R^{C×(d+1)}，是输入诱导的quiver表示收缩后行和恰为logits的矩阵；在(LCS)假设下分析其不变性与可恢复性，并证明其等于逐类梯度×输入加精确聚合偏置归因。
AI.result: 在(LCS)下，正规输入处的M是已实现芽的函数，其编码稳定子恰为无消失坐标输入处的芽稳定子(神经元置换为特例)，并能恢复芽，而隐层激活不足。M可由C次向量-雅可比积计算，无需探测。固定形状给出ResNet-152、DenseNet-121、GoogLeNet间无需对齐的逐样本距离；行和恒等式给出可见/不可见位移分解，单位无关一致性A=(d_Ψ/d_M)^2使对抗芽运动中位数A≤0.23，攻击族排序在六个架构上一致(Kendall W=0.921，全尺度三网络0.97)。两个负面结果：AlexNet/CIFAR-10上倒数第二层特征在6个检测器中赢5个、16种攻击全胜；矩阵方向反事实0/54失败。
AI.conclusion: 知识矩阵为训练网络提供了理论扎实、可高效计算的高层表示，在归因、跨架构度量和对抗分析中有价值，但也存在特征优势与反事实失效等局限。

title: STITCH-RAG: Spatio-Temporal Influence Tracing over Topic Hypergraphs for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation requires a retriever to connect evidence distributed across documents while preserving a concise, faithful generation context. Existing indexes leave two complementary gaps: chunk-based RAG can break cross-passage evidence chains, whereas an unlabeled pairwise projection without generating-topic provenance cannot jointly preserve topic-level co-participation and per-occurrence entity descriptions. We propose STITCH-RAG, a hypergraph-based framework with three coupled components. First, a semi-merged topic hypergraph encodes multi-entity co-participation as topic-summary hyperedges while retaining per-chunk entity states linked by canonical-name equivalence. Second, spatio-temporal influence bridging propagation (STIBP) combines topic-space propagation with deterministic chunk-index linkage across name-equivalent states under frequency-adaptive decay. Third, continuous STIBP scores replace binary entity-match seeds in localized Personalized PageRank (PPR). We characterize the condition under which this prior assigns more PPR mass to ground-truth evidence than a binary prior. Under the reported protocol, STITCH-RAG attains the highest reported Contain-Acc and LLM-Acc point estimates among the compared methods on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultiHopQA, and higher Recall@8 than the methods included in the standardized retrieval comparison. Results on the mixed-domain benchmark remain auxiliary preference-based evidence because only LLM-judged accuracy is available.

AI.tldr: 提出 STITCH-RAG，基于超图的多跳检索框架，通过主题超边与时空影响传播提升跨文档证据连接。
AI.motivation: 多跳RAG需连接跨文档证据并保持简洁忠实的生成上下文。现有索引存在两类缺陷：分块RAG会切断跨段落证据链；无标签成对投影缺乏生成主题来源，无法同时保留主题级共参与与单次实体描述。
AI.method: STITCH-RAG含三个耦合组件：(1) 半融合主题超图，用主题摘要超边编码多实体共参与，并保留由规范名等价链接的逐块实体状态；(2) 时空影响桥接传播(STIBP)，在频率自适应衰减下结合主题空间传播与确定性块索引链接；(3) 用连续STIBP分数替换局部PPR中的二值实体匹配种子，并刻画该先验优于二值先验的条件。
AI.result: 在报告的协议下，STITCH-RAG在HotpotQA与2WikiMultiHopQA上取得所比较方法中最高的Contain-Acc与LLM-Acc点估计，并在标准化检索比较中取得更高Recall@8；混合领域基准结果仅为辅助偏好证据，因其只有LLM判定的准确率。
AI.conclusion: STITCH-RAG通过超图主题结构与连续影响先验有效改善多跳检索证据连接与生成上下文质量。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Indirect-Call Analysis under Opaque Pointers
summary: Resolving indirect calls is central to call-graph construction for C. Scalable type-based analyses such as MLTA use type information in LLVM IR to associate indirect calls with functions assigned to the corresponding structure fields. However, a single pointee type often misrepresents the memory a pointer addresses, and LLVM 17 removed pointee types in favor of opaque pointers. Therefore, field-sensitive analyses lose their matching key. Recovering the erased types restores the matching key but still misses the relation that the type encoded: which functions the program assigns to the field. We present Facet, to our knowledge the first analysis that reconstructs this dispatch relation over opaque IR. Facet identifies the structure field from which an indirect call loads its function pointer. It separately recovers the functions assigned to that field through initializers, stores, and aggregate copies. It then joins the two by field identity, without requiring an end-to-end value-flow path. Facet classifies proposed call-graph changes under distinct evidence rules for edge addition and removal and records the assumption behind each refinement. An LLM decides only the residual cases among symbolically bounded candidates. One analysis yields both a recall-preserving call graph and a refined call graph. On 14 C programs, Facet reduces the mean target-set size from 25.9 to 5.2 and raises observed recall from 0.79 to 0.99. Its recovered field identities agree with typed IR at 98.1% of jointly resolved sites. Applied to bug detection, the refined call graph found 17 deep bugs in C software from nginx to the Linux kernel, three of them latent for over a decade; 12 are confirmed.

AI.tldr: Facet是一种针对不透明LLVM IR的分析方法，通过识别间接调用加载函数指针的结构体字段，并独立恢复赋给该字段的函数，再按字段身份关联二者，从而重建分发关系，生成兼具召回保持与精化的调用图。
AI.motivation: C语言的间接调用解析是调用图构建的核心。MLTA等可扩展的基于类型分析依赖LLVM IR中的类型信息，将间接调用与赋给相应结构体字段的函数关联。然而单一指向类型常无法准确表示指针所指向的内存，且LLVM 17移除了指向类型改用不透明指针，使字段敏感分析失去匹配键。恢复被擦除的类型只能找回匹配键，却仍缺失类型所编码的关系：程序将哪些函数赋给了该字段。
AI.method: Facet首先识别间接调用从其加载函数指针的结构体字段；再通过初始化器、存储和聚合拷贝分别恢复赋给该字段的函数；然后按字段身份将两者连接，无需端到端的值流路径。Facet针对边添加与删除采用不同的证据规则对调用图变更进行分类，并记录每次精化背后的假设。仅对符号化有界候选中的残余情况由LLM决定。
AI.result: 在14个C程序上，Facet将平均目标集大小从25.9降至5.2，观测召回率从0.79提升至0.99。其恢复的字段身份在98.1%的共同解析点上与类型化IR一致。应用于缺陷检测时，精化后的调用图在从nginx到Linux内核的C软件中发现17个深层缺陷，其中3个潜伏超过十年，12个已确认。
AI.conclusion: Facet是首个在不透明IR上重建分发关系的分析，单次分析即可同时产出召回保持的调用图和精化调用图，显著缩小间接调用目标集并提升召回，且在真实软件缺陷检测中成效显著。

title: Transformer MLP Gate Thresholds Are Couplings to a Carried Reference Direction
comment: 18 pages, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/EvidentSolutions/llm-interp/tree/main/background. An earlier version of this paper is archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21498411; this version supersedes it and corrects several reported values
summary: The corpus-mean direction of a transformer's residual stream is a component shared across all inputs, and is commonly removed by mean-centering before representational analysis. We present evidence that it is a functional component: the reference against which the MLP gate population sets its operating point. In Phi-2, an exact decomposition of resting gate pre-activations shows that at mid-stack layers the resting inhibition of >99.9% of gates is carried by the coupling $w \cdot b_L$ to the carried mean direction, at 48-56$\times$ the explicit bias parameter, and the coupling is direction-specific: a random direction at matched norm orders the population's firing rates at Spearman $ρ\leq 0.09$ where the reference reaches 0.95. (That 0.95 is near-tautological on its own; the paper derives its null.) Causally, removing the stream's projection on the reference multiplies above-threshold firing by about 9$\times$, dose-monotonically, at 23-59$\times$ a norm-matched control; a random-initialised twin is flat, and replacement tests show that the direction carries the function and the magnitude does not. A direction-matched control makes the same point: noise injected along the reference costs 8-42$\times$ the same energy along a random direction. The decomposition replicates on four further families spanning both gate types (GELU with an explicit gate bias, bias-free SwiGLU), and the dose-response on two of them. Across an eight-model scan the mechanism is present in every GELU and SiLU family and absent only in OPT, where an opposing LayerNorm bias cancels the carried reference. Gate thresholds are implemented as couplings to a constant the network builds for the distribution it is reading, with the bias parameters contributing little; how much of that constant is carried in the stream and how much in parameters depends on the architecture.

AI.tldr: Transformer残差流的语料均值方向并非冗余偏移，而是MLP门控群体设置工作点的功能性参考基准。
AI.motivation: 均值方向通常被视作需去除的共享偏移，本文质疑其是否仅为分析噪声，探索其是否承载MLP门控的功能性角色。
AI.method: 在Phi-2上对静息门控预激活做精确分解，分析w·b_L耦合；用随机方向、随机初始化孪生、方向匹配噪声注入等对照，做因果与剂量响应实验，并跨多模型族扫描。
AI.result: 中等层中>99.9%门控的静息抑制由耦合均值方向承担，达显式偏置的48-56倍；移除该投影使超阈放电增约9倍（对照23-59倍），方向特定性强。结论在四个模型族及两个门控类型上复现，八模型扫描中除OPT外均存在，OPT因LayerNorm偏置抵消而不显。
AI.conclusion: 门控阈值实为对网络为所读分布构建的常量的耦合，偏置参数贡献甚微；该常量在流与参数间的分配取决于架构。

title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
summary: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives. The effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and also proposed a model for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows that MobileNetV2 achieved 96.35% accuracy with the smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The proposed model achieved 97.67% accuracy, 0.9756 AUC with longest inference time (13.17 ms). The larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, the proposed model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and inference time. The GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME shade explainable AI (XAI) insights of the model.

AI.tldr: 该论文探索多种深度学习模型用于疟疾血涂片检测，MobileNetV2以最小体积和最快推理达到96.35%准确率，提出的模型达97.67%准确率，并结合剪枝与XAI方法提升性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 疟疾在80多国流行并造成大量死亡，早期准确诊断至关重要；传统显微镜诊断依赖专家和专用设备，成本高、劳动强度大，因此需要自动化、高效的深度学习方法。
AI.method: 基于NIH疟疾数据集的血涂片，评估ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19，并提出一个新模型；采用模型剪枝优化，并使用GRAD-CAM、SHAP、LIME进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: MobileNetV2达96.35%准确率、8.49 MB大小、1.35 ms推理；提出模型达97.67%准确率、0.9756 AUC、13.17 ms推理；剪枝后准确率与推理时间略有改善；更大架构模型体积大而准确率中等。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习可用于疟疾血涂片自动检测；轻量模型适合快速部署，提出模型在准确率上更优，剪枝和XAI有助于性能提升与临床可信度。

title: What Next-Event Accuracy Cannot See: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Emergency Department Trajectory Simulators
summary: Clinical trajectory models are usually evaluated by next-event accuracy on observed histories. Simulation is different: models must condition on their own generated events, allowing errors to compound. Although this problem is well known in sequence modelling, it has not been systematically quantified for clinical trajectory simulators. We developed EDSim-Bench to evaluate this failure mode using 425,028 MIMIC-IV-ED stays, with external replication on MC-MED, and release the evaluation protocol and scoring code. Starting from held-out visit prefixes, models generate the remainder of each visit and are evaluated on termination, event composition, timing, conditional fidelity, and occupancy forecasting, with a train-only order-3 n-gram as a reference baseline. Despite next-event accuracies within 0.001, three neural architectures behaved very differently under rollout. Across seeds, one Transformer recipe ranged from 0.43 to 0.96 in termination score and from 4.2- to 137-fold the divergence of the n-gram; no prefix-trained neural model approached the n-gram on termination or event composition. Inference-time interventions improved termination but did not jointly recover composition and timing. Supervising every eligible sequence position rather than only the final prefix position was associated with one to two orders of magnitude lower divergence across Transformer, GRU, and LSTM models, with the pattern persisting under model scaling, temporal shift, and external-site evaluation. Nevertheless, even the best model generated visits approximately half as long as observed, and model rankings reversed on occupancy forecasting, a downstream quantity relevant to bed management. These results show that next-event accuracy is insufficient to evaluate clinical trajectory simulators and motivate closed-loop evaluation across seeds, rollout criteria, and downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EDSim-Bench评估临床轨迹模拟器在自回归生成下的误差累积问题，发现即使next-event精度相同，不同模型在rollout下表现差异巨大，且next-event精度不足以评估模拟器。
AI.motivation: 临床轨迹模型通常用观测历史下的next-event精度评估，但模拟时模型需基于自身生成的事件进行条件推断，误差会不断累积。这一问题在序列建模中已知，但尚未对临床轨迹模拟器进行系统量化。
AI.method: 开发EDSim-Bench，基于425,028条MIMIC-IV-ED就诊记录，并在MC-MED上外部复现。从留出就诊前缀出发，让模型生成剩余就诊序列，从终止、事件组成、时间、条件保真度、占用预测五方面评估，以仅训练集order-3 n-gram为参考基线。
AI.result: 尽管next-event精度差异在0.001以内，三种神经网络架构在rollout下差异显著：某Transformer配方跨种子终止分数0.43–0.96，发散度达n-gram的4.2–137倍；无前缀训练模型在终止和事件组成上接近n-gram。推理时干预可改善终止但无法同时恢复组成与时间。对每个可用序列位置而非仅最终前缀位置监督，可使Transformer、GRU、LSTM的发散度降低1–2个数量级，且该模式在模型扩展、时间偏移和外部站点下持续存在。但最佳模型生成的就诊长度约为观测的一半，模型排名在占用预测上反转。
AI.conclusion: next-event精度不足以评估临床轨迹模拟器，需采用闭环评估，跨种子、rollout准则和下游任务进行评测。

title: DriveHierarchy: A Benchmark for Diagnosing VLM Driving Capabilities from Open-Loop Understanding to Closed-Loop Execution
summary: Evaluating VLM-based autonomous driving remains difficult because driving competence is composite, where a capable system must ground traffic participants and hazards, integrate context across views and time, reason about future evolution, and act appropriately under closed-loop interaction. Existing benchmarks usually assess either open-loop understanding or closed-loop driving but provide limited structure for explaining how these abilities are organized, how they relate, and how they may inform model diagnosis and improvement.
