We present \textsc{DriveHierarchy}, a hierarchical benchmark that organizes VLM-based autonomous driving into four ranks, spanning perceptual grounding, contextual memory, mental reasoning, and closed-loop execution. To instantiate this hierarchy, we integrate multiple open-source autonomous-driving datasets into a unified open-loop benchmark with 76,798 question-answer pairs over 84,279 frames and develop a closed-loop simulation platform with interactive scenario construction on a real-world road network, from which 100 driving scenarios are curated for embodied evaluation. Experiments on 15 VLMs show that \textsc{DriveHierarchy} captures structured but non-redundant capability variation, relates open-loop understanding to closed-loop driving, and provides a practical basis for diagnosis and benchmark-guided optimization. \textsc{DriveHierarchy} therefore serves as a unified framework for evaluating and improving VLM-based autonomous driving systems. An anonymized project has been released on https://github.com/PerfectXu88/DriveHierarchy

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DriveHierarchy，一个将 VLM 自动驾驶能力分为感知接地、上下文记忆、心理推理和闭环执行四个层级的层次化基准，用于统一评估与诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有基准要么评估开环理解，要么评估闭环驾驶，缺乏对各项驾驶能力如何组织、关联及用于模型诊断的结构化框架。
AI.method: 整合多个开源自动驾驶数据集，构建包含 84,279 帧、76,798 个问答对的开环基准；并开发基于真实道路网络的闭环仿真平台，构建 100 个交互式驾驶场景用于具身评估。
AI.result: 在 15 个 VLM 上的实验表明，DriveHierarchy 能捕捉结构化但非冗余的能力差异，关联开环理解与闭环驾驶，并为诊断和基准引导优化提供依据。
AI.conclusion: DriveHierarchy 可作为统一框架，用于评估和改进基于 VLM 的自动驾驶系统。

title: Nash Equilibria in Auctions with Pacing Strategies: Complexity and Inefficiency
comment: 29 pages, to appear in The 22nd Conference on Web and Internet Economics (WINE 2026)
summary: We introduce and study Auctions with Pacing Strategies (APS) games, a full-information model in which utility-maximizing bidders compete across many simultaneous first-price auctions, each choosing a single pacing multiplier that uniformly scales their values into bids. We settle three central questions. First, we show that there are instances that admit no approximate pure Nash equilibria. Then, we prove that the problem of deciding whether an APS game admits an (approximate) equilibrium is NP-complete in general, but can be solved in polynomial time if either the number of bidders or the number of items is fixed. Finally, when an equilibrium does exist, we characterize its inefficiency exactly, showing that both the Price of Anarchy and the Price of Stability equal $\frac{e}{e-1}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究"带节奏策略的拍卖"（APS）博弈：全信息下多个同时进行的一价拍卖，每位投标人选择一个统一的节奏乘数缩放其估值。文章解决三个核心问题：存在无近似纯纳什均衡的实例；判定均衡存在性一般NP完全，但投标人数或商品数固定时多项式可解；均衡存在时，Price of Anarchy与Price of Stability均精确等于 e/(e-1)。
AI.motivation: 现实中投标人常跨多个同时进行的拍卖竞争，并用统一节奏（pacing）控制预算与出价，但这一模型的理论性质（均衡存在性、计算复杂度、效率损失）尚不清晰。
AI.method: 建立全信息APS博弈模型：多场同时一价拍卖，每个投标人选择单一pacing乘数统一缩放其估值成出价；随后分析纯纳什均衡的存在性、判定问题的计算复杂度（NP完全性与参数化可解性），并刻画均衡的无效率上界。
AI.result: 1) 存在不承认近似纯纳什均衡的实例；2) 判定APS博弈是否存在（近似）均衡一般NP完全，但当投标人数或商品数固定时可在多项式时间内求解；3) 均衡存在时，Price of Anarchy与Price of Stability均精确等于 e/(e-1)。
AI.conclusion: APS博弈的均衡性质复杂：并非总存在近似均衡，判定问题计算困难但具参数化可解性；一旦均衡存在，其效率损失有精确常数界 e/(e-1)。

title: Deep Learning Methods in Neuroscience: From Modeling Molecular Mechanisms to Classifying States of Consciousness
summary: A critical analysis of contemporary approaches to the study of conscious states. The review focuses on methods of classification, clustering, modeling of brain states under anesthesia and identification of measurable neurobiological characteristics of brain function. A comparative analysis was conducted in the following three major areas: automatic detection of states of consciousness using neural networks based on EEG and fMRI data; modeling of the structural-functional dynamics of the brain under the effects of anesthetics; and detection of neurophysiological indicators which correlate with the level of consciousness. The obtained conclusions demonstrate the growing effectiveness of deep neural models in the classification and prediction of brain states and the analysis of dynamic structural-functional connectivity. Nonetheless, significant limitations were also identified, including the limited interpretability of the models, the lack of standardized metrics, and the problem of the specificity of consciousness markers. Our findings support the need for developing hybrid, generalizible, physiologically grounded architectures. Furthermore, such approaches may improve the translational potential of computational models in clinical neuroscience. Diverse methods of machine and computational modeling have demonstrated their effectiveness in tasks of automatic clustering and classification of brain states, the development of multilevel models and the identification of connectivity patterns correlated with levels of consciousness. A larger-scale analysis and a larger dataset, as well as the implementation of model interpretability approaches are required for the practical application of the analyzed models. The models based on EEG and LFP are the most promising for clinical application due to their availability and the possibility of real-time monitoring.

AI.tldr: 综述麻醉下意识状态分类、建模与神经标志物检测的现状，指出现有模型有效但存在可解释性差、指标不统一等问题，呼吁发展可泛化、生理基础的混合架构。
AI.motivation: 整合并批判性评估当代意识状态研究方法，厘清各方法（分类、聚类、麻醉脑状态建模、意识神经标志物识别）的有效性与局限，推动计算模型在临床神经科学中的转化应用。
AI.method: 对三大领域进行比较分析：(1) 基于EEG与fMRI用神经网络自动检测意识状态；(2) 麻醉作用下脑结构-功能动力学建模；(3) 与意识水平相关的神经生理指标检测。
AI.result: 深度神经模型在脑状态分类预测及动态结构-功能连接分析中效果日益提升；但存在模型可解释性有限、缺乏标准化评价指标、意识标志物特异性不足等明显局限。EEG与LFP模型因易获取且可实时监测而最具临床应用前景。
AI.conclusion: 需发展混合式、可泛化、具生理基础的架构，并扩大数据集规模、引入模型可解释性方法，以提升计算模型在临床神经科学中的实际应用与转化潜力。

title: RidgeRank: Efficient Visual Document Reranking via Score Fusion and a Shallow Linear Readout
summary: Multimodal language models rerank visual document retrieval results accurately, but scoring every candidate page at full cost makes them slow. Some methods that compress these rerankers need relevance labels to regain accuracy, and they rank by the reranker score alone. RidgeRank measures how much relevance signal the reranker score lacks and recovers it from the retriever score through a closed-form fusion rule. Maximizing a correlation objective gives the optimal fusion weight, along with the exact condition under which the reranker score by itself cannot reach that optimum. The reranker is further corrected by a single vector applied to an intermediate hidden state, obtained through one centered ridge regression onto the same model's full-depth scores on uncompressed pages. On 12 datasets drawn from ViDoRe 2 and ViDoRe 3, evaluated with two retrievers and two language model backbones, RidgeRank brings NDCG@5 to within 1.2 pp of a full cross encoder with speedups of up to 48 times, advancing the accuracy and latency Pareto frontier for visual document reranking.

AI.tldr: RidgeRank：面向视觉文档重排序的无标签压缩重排框架，通过闭式融合检索分数与隐状态校正，在显著加速下逼近全量交叉编码器精度。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型重排视觉文档检索结果准确但计算昂贵，逐页全成本打分导致速度慢；已有压缩重排方法需要相关性标签恢复精度，且仅依赖重排分数排序。
AI.method: RidgeRank度量重排分数缺失的相关性信号，并从检索分数中通过闭式融合规则恢复；通过最大化相关性目标求最优融合权重，并给出重排分数单独无法达到最优的精确条件；再用一个作用于中间隐状态的单一向量校正重排器，该向量通过对未压缩页面的同模型全深度分数做一次中心化岭回归获得。
AI.result: 在ViDoRe 2和ViDoRe 3的12个数据集上，使用两种检索器和两种语言模型骨干评估，NDCG@5与全量交叉编码器相差在1.2个百分点以内，最高实现48倍加速，推进了精度-延迟帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: RidgeRank无需相关性标签即可有效压缩视觉文档重排，兼顾高精度与低延迟，提升了视觉文档重排的帕累托前沿。

title: Beyond the Prompt: Linking What Developers Ask, Do, and Understand with Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents can now change code for developers, who describe goals, supply context, and respond to the agent's work. Yet prompts, screen activity, and task success each tell only part of this story. We present Say, Do, Understand, an end-to-end workflow for analyzing what developers write to an agent, what they do while it works, and what they can explain afterwards. The workflow has five stages (Capture, Prepare, Analyze, Integrate, and Interpret) and three instruments: a prompt codebook, a scheme for coding screen-recorded activities and events, and separate rubrics for explaining the process and the solution. We applied it in an observational study of ten experienced developers who used GitHub Copilot on an unfamiliar codebase. Crossing task performance with understanding produced four personas. The two measures agreed for eight developers but split for two: one passed most tests but could not explain the solution, and another passed few tests but explained it well. In this sample, the personas that most often asked the agent to check its work spent the least time testing on their own. These patterns are descriptive and do not generalize beyond the sample. We recommend the workflow to computing educators, industry practitioners, and researchers to adapt and evaluate human--AI communication in software engineering.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Say, Do, Understand"端到端工作流，用于分析开发者与编码智能体交互中的提示、屏幕行为与事后理解。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅通过提示、屏幕活动或任务成功率中的单一维度来理解人机协作，无法全面反映交互全貌，需要整合多维度分析方法。
AI.method: 工作流包含五个阶段（Capture、Prepare、Analyze、Integrate、Interpret）与三种工具：提示编码手册、屏幕录制活动编码方案、过程与解决方案解释评分量表。应用于10名经验开发者使用GitHub Copilot处理陌生代码库的观察性研究。
AI.result: 任务绩效与理解度交叉得出四种人物画像：8名开发者两项指标一致，2名分化（一人测试通过多但无法解释，另一人测试通过少但解释良好）；频繁要求智能体自检的开发者自行测试时间最少。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流可供计算教育者、行业从业者与研究者改编使用，以评估软件工程中的人机沟通。结论仅为描述性，不具泛化性。

title: IndicFDB: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents across Indian Languages
summary: Full-duplex voice agents must handle pauses, take turns, backchannel, and respond to user interruptions in real time. Full-Duplex-Bench evaluates these behaviors, but its English-only corpus and reliance on word-timestamped ASR and an English-prompted LLM judge make it difficult to extend to Indian languages. We introduce IndicFDB, which extends it to ten languages spoken in India with 12,350 samples, nearly 17 times as many as the original. We address three challenges: finding conversational events in multilingual speech, evaluating their timing without reliable word-level alignment, and judging responses across languages. We mine pause handling, turn taking, and backchanneling samples from roughly 50,000 hours of channel-separated conversations using voice activity detection (VAD), and construct human-validated synthetic user interruption samples. Language-independent VAD heuristics evaluate timing, while an open-weight transcription and translation pipeline converts responses to English for LLM ratings of relevance and quality. Across seven voice agents, commercial APIs show unexpectedly consistent behavior across languages but are either fast or robust to pauses, never both, while monolingual open full-duplex models expose further tradeoffs among backchanneling, response quality, and latency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出IndicFDB，将全双工语音代理评测基准扩展到印度十种语言，样本量增至12,350条（约原基准的17倍），并解决多语言对话事件检测、时序评测和跨语言评级三大难题。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音代理需实时处理停顿、轮次转换、反馈和用户打断，但现有Full-Duplex-Bench仅限英语，且依赖带词级时间戳的ASR和英语提示的LLM评判，难以扩展到印度语言。
AI.method: 从约5万小时声道分离对话中，用VAD挖掘停顿处理、轮次转换和反馈样本，并构建人工验证的合成用户打断样本；采用语言无关的VAD启发式评测时序，用开放权重转录与翻译流水线将回复转为英语，供LLM评估相关性和质量。
AI.result: 评测七种语音代理发现，商业API在不同语言间行为出乎意料地一致，但要么快、要么能抗停顿，无法兼得；单语开放全双工模型则在反馈、回复质量和延迟之间存在更多权衡。
AI.conclusion: IndicFDB为多语言全双工语音交互提供了大规模、可扩展的评测基准，揭示了现有代理在跨语言场景中速度与鲁棒性难以兼顾的核心局限。

title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Human-Readable XAI in Industrial Object Detection
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions are essential for building trust in AI technologies and their integration in real manufacturing lines. However, most existing methods are tailored to technical experts, limiting their accessibility to diverse user groups such as blue-collar workers in manufacturing lines who use AI for quality control. In this work, we introduce an XAI interface for object detection in industrial manufacturing based on a fine-tuned vision-language model, designed to generate intuitive explanations for non-expert users. We benchmark existing vision-language models and demonstrate that out-of-the-box models often fall short in delivering clear, context-relevant explanations for non-expert users. To address this, we fine-tune a vision-language model and integrate it into our interface, enabling contextualized, accessible explanations for non-expert users. We demonstrate improvements in explanation clarity, instruction adherence, image groundedness, and contextual awareness over GPT 4o-mini on proprietary and public robotics dataset. This approach advances the accessibility and usability of AI explanations, making them more intuitive and applicable in manufacturing domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于微调视觉语言模型的XAI界面，为制造业非专家用户（如蓝领工人）生成直观、易懂的物体检测解释，效果优于GPT-4o-mini。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法多面向技术专家，普通制造业工人难以理解和使用，阻碍了AI在生产线质检中的信任与应用。
AI.method: 引入面向工业制造物体检测的XAI界面，先基准测试现有视觉语言模型，再微调一个视觉语言模型并集成到界面中，生成情境化、可访问的解释。
AI.result: 在专有和公开机器人数据集上，相比GPT-4o-mini，在解释清晰度、指令遵循、图像依据性和情境感知方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提升了AI解释的可访问性与可用性，使其在制造业中更直观、更实用。

title: Grounding Vision-Language Models in Driving Semantics: A Multi-Dataset Predicate Framework for Explainable Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used for driving-scene understanding, yet the semantic relations expressed in their outputs are often difficult to verify against the underlying traffic situation. This paper introduces a deterministic multi-dataset predicate framework that derives driving-scene semantics from measurable geometric, kinematic, temporal, map, and traffic-control evidence. Dataset-specific interfaces are used only to recover the required scene information, while predicate definitions remain unchanged across nuPlan and nuScenes and are materialised in a common Predicate Knowledge Graph. Quantitative semantic validation against manually annotated predicate relations on 200 scenarios from each dataset yields macro F1 scores of 0.94 on nuPlan and 0.93 on nuScenes, with an average cross-dataset difference of 0.02 across the shared predicates. The Predicate KG is further evaluated using a frozen LLaVA-OneVision-7B model on the nine NuPlanQA subtasks. Predicate grounding achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated visual-input conditions in seven of nine NuPlanQA subtasks, including Traffic Light (53.2% to 71.5%), Situation Assessment (76.2% to 86.1%), and Action Recommendation (82.9% to 89.0%). Weather/Lighting remains essentially unchanged (89.4% vs. 88.8%), consistent with the absence of corresponding predicates, while Predicate KG only input outperforms metadata-only input in eight of nine subtasks. The results show that deterministic predicates provide a consistent and traceable semantic representation and, under oracle grounding, can reduce visual dependence for reasoning tasks covered by the predicate vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出确定性多数据集谓词框架，从几何/运动/时间/地图/交规证据推导驾驶场景语义，构建Predicate KG，在nuPlan/nuScenes实现高一致性语义验证，并提升NuPlanQA推理任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型输出的驾驶场景语义关系难以验证，缺乏可测量、可追溯的语义表示。
AI.method: 定义跨nuPlan和nuScenes不变的确定性谓词，由几何、运动、时间、地图和交通控制证据推导；通过数据集专属接口提取场景信息，统一物化为Predicate Knowledge Graph。
AI.result: 200场景/数据集上的语义验证macro F1：nuPlan 0.94、nuScenes 0.93，跨数据集平均差异0.02。用冻结LLaVA-OneVision-7B在NuPlanQA九个子任务评测，谓词grounding在7/9子任务中准确率最高，如Traffic Light 53.2%→71.5%、Situation Assessment 76.2%→86.1%、Action Recommendation 82.9%→89.0%；Weather/Lighting基本不变（89.4% vs 88.8%）；仅Predicate KG输入在8/9子任务优于仅metadata。
AI.conclusion: 确定性谓词提供一致且可追溯的语义表示，在oracle grounding下可减少谓词覆盖范围内推理任务对视觉输入的依赖。

title: LLM Judge Validation Under Sparse Overlap: From Inference to Design
summary: Validating an LLM-as-a-judge requires estimating its agreement with humans, yet annotation budgets rarely allow every item to be multiply labeled. We prove that this \emph{overlap sparsity} is the first-order determinant of wrong deployment decisions: at 5\% pairwise overlap, wrong-decision rates reach 25\% and the probability of selecting the wrong best judge among ten candidates is 65\%. The two actionable levers are overlap \emph{quantity} and \emph{allocation}. For quantity, we derive a minimum-overlap formula showing $ρ\geq 0.25$ suffices for non-borderline judges while borderline cases remain fundamentally hard. For allocation, a zero-cost stratified scheme halves false-rejection rates relative to random sampling when strata are informative. We validate on 10 LLM judges across four evaluation matrices spanning visual assessment, causal reasoning, and summarization.

AI.tldr: 验证 LLM-as-a-judge 需要估计其与人类的一致性，但标注预算限制了多项标注。本文证明重叠稀疏性是导致错误部署决策的主导因素，并给出重叠数量与分配两个改进方向。
AI.motivation: 验证 LLM 评判者需估计其与人类的一致性，但标注预算通常不足以为每个样本进行多次标注，导致重叠稀疏性问题，而该问题对决策结果的影响此前缺乏系统分析。
AI.method: 将重叠稀疏性形式化为错误部署决策的一阶决定因素；推导最小重叠量公式；提出零成本分层分配方案，并与随机抽样对比。
AI.result: 在 5% 成对重叠率下，错误决策率达 25%，在十个候选者中选错最佳评判者的概率为 65%。ρ≥0.25 可满足非边界评判者，边界情形本质上困难。分层方案在分层信息有效时可将错误拒绝率减半。
AI.conclusion: 重叠的数量与分配是改进 LLM-as-a-judge 验证的两个可操作杠杆；增加最小重叠并结合分层分配能显著降低错误决策率。

title: Settling the Complexity Landscape of Multi-Agent Contracts with Binary Actions
summary:
We study the computational complexity of optimal contract design in the multi-agent binary-action model, focusing on gross-substitutes reward functions and related classes. While additive rewards admit an FPTAS and general submodular rewards admit only constant-factor approximation, the complexity within the intermediate class of gross substitutes has remained largely open.
  We uncover a fine-grained approximation landscape within this class. We first show that the optimal contract problem is APX-complete even for OXS rewards - a strict subclass of gross substitutes rewards, ruling out a PTAS for gross substitutes unless $\mathsf{P}=\mathsf{NP}$. In contrast, for weighted matroid rank functions (WMRFs) - another natural subclass of gross substitutes - we obtain an EPTAS and show that no randomized FPTAS exists in general. We further identify the special case of partition (weighted) matroid rank functions, for which we obtain an FPTAS. This stands in contrast to the multi-agent multi-action setting, where no PTAS exists even for unweighted partition matroid rank functions.
  Finally, we consider the broader class of ultra reward functions. While ultra rewards retain the tractability of gross substitutes in a related combinatorial contract model with a single agent, we show a sharp contrast in the multi-agent model: no polynomial-time randomized algorithm using value queries can achieve a $2^{o(n)}$-approximation in expectation. Together, our results reveal several qualitatively distinct computational regimes within and beyond gross substitutes, and identify submodularity as a crucial ingredient for the approximability of multi-agent contracts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体二元动作合同设计中gross substitutes奖励函数的计算复杂性，揭示其内部细粒度近似景观：OXS为APX-完全、WMRF有EPTAS但无随机FPTAS、partition WMRF有FPTAS，而ultra rewards在多智能体下近似极难。
AI.motivation: 最优合同问题在加性奖励下有FPTAS、一般次模奖励仅有常数近似，而作为中间类的gross substitutes的复杂性此前基本未解，本文旨在刻画该类的精细近似图景。
AI.method: 从复杂性角度分析多智能体二元动作合同模型，围绕gross substitutes及其子类（OXS、加权拟阵秩函数WMRF、partition WMRF）和ultra rewards，通过归约与近似算法构造，建立APX-完全性、EPTAS、FPTAS及查询模型下不可近似性等结果。
AI.result: 1) 即使对OXS（gross substitutes的严格子类），最优合同问题为APX-完全，排除PTAS（除非P=NP）；2) 对WMRF得到EPTAS，且一般情形不存在随机FPTAS；3) 对partition（加权）拟阵秩函数得到FPTAS，与多动作设置中即使无权重partition拟阵秩函数也无PTAS形成对比；4) 对ultra rewards，多智能体模型下任何使用值查询的多项式时间随机算法无法期望达到2^{o(n)}近似。
AI.conclusion: gross substitutes内外存在多个定性不同的计算区间，并指出次模性是决定多智能体合同可近似性的关键要素。

title: EvE: An Alternate Optimizer to Adam
summary: Adam and its variants dominate neural network training, but a single run only reveals whether a configuration works well after most of its budget is spent, a poor fit for hyperparameter or architecture search, where configurations must be ranked cheaply and pruned early. We introduce EvE (Evolutionary Explorer), a steady-state, population-of-four differential evolution (DE) optimizer with a targeted Adam fallback: each iteration proposes one candidate via DE, running a short burst of gradient descent only if the DE step fails to improve on the incumbent. Selection is greedy, so on a deterministic objective the best-so-far value is provably monotone non-increasing, and since gradients are used only as a targeted rescue, per-iteration cost stays within a constant factor of a single Adam step regardless of dimension. Under a fixed, evaluation-cost-matched budget, EvE wins or ties Adam on 76% of 70 (problem, dimension) cells across seven scalable benchmarks up to one million variables. On three real neural-network tasks (an MLP on MNIST, and LoRA fine-tuning of a 1.5B-parameter language model on two datasets) EvE finishes the same charged budget 1.7-3.9x faster, at a modest cost in final quality (about one accuracy point on MNIST, 9-11% higher relative test loss on the two fine-tuning tasks; on GSM8K, Adam is about 5 accuracy points more accurate, and fine-tuning lowers accuracy below the base model for both). Inside successive halving on UCI Adult, EvE completes hyperparameter and architecture searches 3.1-3.5x faster, ranking configurations about as consistently with Adam as Adam does with itself across seeds (Kendall's tau 0.66-0.69). EvE is not a total replacement for Adam as a final-stage trainer, but a fast, gradient-aware proxy for the search-heavy, budget-constrained regime one level up.

AI.tldr: EvE是一种四人稳态差分进化优化器，带有针对性Adam回退机制，在评估成本匹配的预算下多数基准上追平或超过Adam，训练速度快1.7-3.9倍，适合超参/架构搜索等预算受限场景。
AI.motivation: Adam及其变体主导神经网络训练，但单次运行只有在花费大部分预算后才能揭示配置好坏，不适合需要廉价排序配置、提前剪枝的超参或架构搜索。
AI.method: EvE（Evolutionary Explorer）：稳态、四人口差分进化（DE）优化器，配有针对性的Adam回退。每次迭代用DE提出一个候选，仅当DE步未能改进现任解时，才运行短促的梯度下降爆发。选择采用贪婪策略，因此在确定性目标上best-so-far可证明单调非增；梯度仅作针对性救援，每次迭代成本保持在单次Adam步的常数倍内，且与维度无关。
AI.result: 固定评估成本匹配预算下，在7个可扩展基准、最多百万变量的70个（问题，维度）单元中，EvE在76%上胜出或追平Adam。三个真实神经网络任务（MNIST上的MLP、两个数据集上1.5B参数语言模型的LoRA微调）中，EvE以1.7-3.9倍更快完成相同计费预算，最终质量略有代价（MNIST约1个准确点，两个微调任务相对测试损失高9-11%；GSM8K上Adam约高5个准确点，且两者微调均使准确率低于基座模型）。在UCI Adult的逐次减半中，EvE完成超参与架构搜索快3.1-3.5倍，配置排序一致性接近Adam自身跨种子水平（Kendall's tau 0.66-0.69）。
AI.conclusion: EvE并非Adam的完全替代品（不宜作最终阶段训练器），而是面向搜索密集、预算受限的上一层场景的快速、梯度感知代理。

title: Measuring and Mitigating Identity-Cue Preference Drift in LLM-based Recommender Systems
summary: In large language model-based recommender systems, identity cues embedded in prompts can steer recommendations toward group-level patterns even when the underlying behavioral evidence remains unchanged. We introduce PromptShift, an interpretable, training-free framework for quantifying and mitigating such identity-cue preference drift. We define Drift as the divergence, in both item membership and ranking order, between a recommendation list generated under an identity-cued prompt and the reference list produced from the same user's interaction history alone. SliceShift then measures the extent to which a cued list gravitates, relative to the history-only reference, toward items that are more popular within the cued slice than among the global user population. Beyond conventional accuracy, we propose DifHitRate, a difficulty-weighted hit metric that credits only relevant items, assigning higher credit to hits that are less popular within the cued slice and ranked higher in the list. All components are supported by an identity-slice-by-item table constructed from positive interactions, which further enables an adaptive post-hoc reranking strategy: the reranker interpolates between the original LLM ranking and inverse slice-popularity, with personalized interpolation weight. Experiments on two datasets with three LLMs show that identity-cued prompts incur higher mean Drift than identity-free paraphrase controls, an effect beyond generic wording sensitivity, and that SliceShift is positive across all six dataset-model settings. PromptShift consistently reduces both Drift and SliceShift, lowering macro-mean SliceShift by 62.42%, while improving DifHitRate, HitRate and MRR. These results demonstrate that identity-cue preference drift can be measured and mitigated without any model training, albeit with a modest, metric-dependent utility cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PromptShift，一个无需训练、可解释的框架，用于量化并缓解 LLM 推荐系统中身份提示词引发的偏好漂移。实验表明身份提示词会显著提升 Drift 与 SliceShift，而 PromptShift 能有效降低二者并提升部分指标。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型推荐系统中，提示词里嵌入的身份线索会引导推荐偏向群体模式，即使行为证据未变。这种身份线索导致的偏好漂移需要被量化与缓解。
AI.method: 定义 Drift（身份提示列表与仅基于历史参考列表在条目成员与排序上的差异）与 SliceShift（衡量提示列表相对历史参考向被提示切片内更热门条目偏移的程度）。提出难度加权的 DifHitRate 指标，仅对相关条目计分，切片内越不热门、排名越高的命中得分越高。基于正交互构建身份切片-条目表，并据此设计自适应后验重排：在原始 LLM 排序与逆切片流行度之间以个性化权重插值。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、三个 LLM 上实验：身份提示相比无身份改述对照产生更高的平均 Drift（超越一般措辞敏感性），且 SliceShift 在全部六种数据集-模型设置中为正。PromptShift 一致降低 Drift 与 SliceShift，使宏观平均 SliceShift 下降 62.42%，同时提升 DifHitRate、HitRate 与 MRR。
AI.conclusion: 身份线索偏好漂移可以在无需任何模型训练的情况下被度量与缓解，但存在适度的、依指标而变的效用代价。

title: RAISE: Reinforcing Access Control Policy Synthesis in LLMs via Symbolic Evaluation
summary: Translating natural-language access-control requirements into policies requires careful reasoning about permissions, constraints, and exceptions, and even frontier LLMs often produce policies that violate the intended authorization semantics. We construct CedarInstruct, to our knowledge the first dataset that supports both training and semantic evaluation for formally verifiable Cedar policy synthesis. It contains 5,800 scenarios across 44 domains and 1,408 representing a single synthetic organization, each with a verified target policy and an executable verification plan. On this data we introduce RAISE, which trains policy synthesizers from formal verification in two stages, verified supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by a reinforcement learning (RL) stage that learns from verifier signal. We find that SFT succeeds largely by letting models express authorization logic they already have, since untrained models rarely write valid Cedar but often reason correctly when they do. After SFT, how the verifier's information is used matters more than how much of it is used. Of six RL instantiations that consume progressively richer verifier signal, only RAISE-OC improves meaningfully on SFT; it turns failed checks and symbolic counterexamples into guided exploration and learns from the result with off-context GRPO. With about 5.4K verified scenarios and LoRA fine-tuning, RAISE-OC trains Qwen3.5-9B to surpass zero-shot GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 by 13.33 and 16.26 percentage points in semantic success on held-out scenarios, and training transfers to the independently constructed CedarBench.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了CedarInstruct数据集并提出RAISE方法（SFT+RL），用于从自然语言需求合成可形式化验证的Cedar策略，其中RAISE-OC通过利用验证器信号显著提升语义成功率。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言访问控制需求翻译为策略需要谨慎推理权限、约束与例外，而现有LLM常生成违反授权语义的策略，缺乏支持训练与语义评估的数据集和方法。
AI.method: 构建CedarInstruct数据集（5,800个场景、44个领域、1,408个合成组织场景，含已验证目标策略与可执行验证计划）；提出RAISE两阶段训练：验证式SFT后接基于验证器信号的RL；比较六种RL实例，最优为RAISE-OC，将失败检查与符号反例转化为引导探索，用off-context GRPO学习。
AI.result: SFT主要让模型表达已有的授权逻辑；SFT后验证器信号的使用方式比使用量更重要；仅RAISE-OC显著超越SFT。用约5.4K验证场景和LoRA微调，RAISE-OC使Qwen3.5-9B在留出场景的语义成功率上超过zero-shot GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5分别13.33和16.26个百分点，并迁移至CedarBench。
AI.conclusion: 形式化验证信号的有效利用（而非数量）是策略合成提升的关键，RAISE-OC实现了可迁移的强性能，为可验证策略合成提供了新数据集与训练范式。

authors: Ana Paula Wernz da Cunha Müller
title: Extraction of clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports: a comparison between specialists and Artificial Intelligence
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
summary: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death among women in Brazil, and the time between the request and the release of mammography reports directly influences adherence to screening, making the agility in processing these reports a critical factor for early diagnosis. In this context, this study compares the performance of a Large Language Model (LLM) with manual extraction performed by a team of health researchers in identifying clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports written in Brazilian Portuguese. Named Entity Recognition (NER) was applied through Prompt Engineering using a few-shot strategy, employing the Gemini 2.5 Flash model, selected from preliminary exploratory tests with four candidate models. The Gemini 2.5 Flash model demonstrated the best performance, achieving a Macro F1 of 0.91 and a Micro F1 of 0.98. The subjective validation, in which 29 exams of different formats were evaluated by health researchers using a Likert scale, yielded an agreement index of 93.1%. The model outperformed human extraction in overall Macro F1 (0.91 vs. 0.72), as in four reports the model correctly identified information that had been omitted or incorrectly recorded during manual extraction, demonstrating its potential as a complementary verification tool alongside specialists. The results confirm the hypothesis that LLMs, when instructed through Prompt Engineering, can achieve performance comparable to or superior to manual extraction by health professionals.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash）与人工团队从巴西葡萄牙语乳腺X线和超声报告中提取临床发现的表现，LLM在NER任务上达到Macro F1 0.91、Micro F1 0.98，优于人工提取（Macro F1 0.72）。
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌是巴西女性癌症死亡的首要原因，乳腺X线报告从申请到发布的时长直接影响筛查依从性，因此加快报告处理对早期诊断至关重要。
AI.method: 采用Prompt Engineering与few-shot策略进行命名实体识别（NER），使用Gemini 2.5 Flash模型（经四个候选模型初步探索测试选出）；再由29份不同格式的检查由健康研究人员以Likert量表进行主观验证。
AI.result: Gemini 2.5 Flash表现最佳，Macro F1为0.91、Micro F1为0.98；主观验证一致率为93.1%；模型整体Macro F1超过人工提取（0.91 vs. 0.72），并在4份报告中正确识别出人工提取遗漏或记录错误的信息。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实了假设：经Prompt Engineering指导的LLM可达到与健康专业人员人工提取相当或更优的表现，具备作为专家补充核查工具的潜力。

title: Architecture-aware Robustness Evaluation of Explainable Deep Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has become essential in medical image analysis to ensure transparency of deep learning (DL)-based diagnostic systems. However, selecting appropriate XAI techniques for breast cancer recognition remains largely ad hoc, with limited systematic evaluation across different DL architectures. This study presents a systematic architecture-aware evaluation protocol to assess the effectiveness of nine widely used XAI techniques across four categories of DL models: very deep, lightweight, transformer-based and hybrid neural networks. The evaluation is conducted on a breast ultrasound dataset comprising 780 images using clinically aligned spatial metrics, including Pointing Game, Intersection over Union and Mean Coverage, to quantify agreement between generated explanations and expert-annotated lesion regions. Results indicate that explanation quality is primarily influenced by the interaction between model architecture and XAI method, rather than any single technique consistently outperforming others. Hybrid architectures produce more spatially coherent explanations, while lightweight and transformer-based models exhibit greater variability across methods. The findings show that no single technique generalises across architectures and evaluation criteria, emphasising the need for joint selection of DL models and XAI techniques. Explainability depends on both model design and explanation strategy and should not be considered independently. This work provides a structured evaluation protocol and practical guidance for selecting XAI techniques in breast cancer diagnosis, supporting more transparent clinical decision-support systems. \textcolor{blue}{Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Nishan-Charlie/Explainable-AI}

AI.tldr: 本文提出架构感知的XAI系统评估协议，在乳腺超声数据集上评估9种XAI技术跨4类DL架构的有效性，发现解释质量取决于架构与XAI方法的交互，无单一技术普遍最优。
AI.motivation: XAI在医学图像分析中至关重要，但乳腺癌症识别的XAI技术选择多为临时决定，缺乏跨不同DL架构的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建系统化架构感知评估协议，覆盖4类DL模型（超深、轻量、Transformer、混合网络），评估9种常用XAI技术；在780张乳腺超声图像上使用临床对齐的空间指标（Pointing Game、IoU、Mean Coverage）量化解释与专家标注病灶区域的一致性。
AI.result: 解释质量主要由模型架构与XAI方法的交互决定，而非某单一技术持续占优。混合架构解释空间更连贯，轻量与Transformer模型跨方法变异性更大；无单一技术能跨架构和评估指标普遍适用。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性依赖模型设计与解释策略，不应独立看待，需联合选择DL模型与XAI技术。本工作提供了结构化评估协议与实用选型指南，支持更透明的临床决策支持系统，代码已公开。

title: FIDAL: Diversity-Aware Federated Active Learning Under Real-World Distribution Shifts
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across institutions without centralizing data, yet high annotation costs, domain shifts, and class imbalance remain major obstacles, especially when irrelevant out-of-distribution (OOD) samples dilute the labeled data. Existing active learning methods target uncertainty or diversity within in-distribution (ID) data and overlook unknown samples in federated clinical settings. We propose FIDAL, an open-set federated active learning framework that combines calibrated global-local evidential uncertainty, support-set diversity weighting, and adaptive OOD rejection. The rejection gate thresholds a foundation-model Gaussian-coverage signal per client and per round with Otsu's criterion, so that highly informative ID samples are queried while irrelevant outliers are excluded without any hand-tuned threshold. Evaluated on three multi-center medical imaging benchmarks (dermatology, histopathology, and mammography with organically occurring artifacts) in realistic open-set scenarios, FIDAL outperforms detector-based open-set methods by up to about 12 percentage points of balanced accuracy and is the only method on the accuracy-ID purity Pareto front of all three benchmarks. At an equal query budget it spends at least 1.3 times fewer annotations on OOD samples than every accuracy-matched baseline, saving an estimated 7-29 hours of expert reading on the mammography benchmark. By labeling only a fraction of the data pool, it matches or exceeds fully supervised performance across modalities. These results highlight the value of integrating uncertainty, diversity, and OOD rejection in open-set federated active learning for medicine.

AI.tldr: 提出FIDAL开放集联邦主动学习框架，结合证据不确定性、支持集多样性加权与自适应OOD拒绝，在多个医学影像基准上显著优于检测器类方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习面临标注成本高、域偏移和类别不平衡问题，且无关的分布外(OOD)样本会稀释标注数据；现有主动学习仅关注分布内数据，忽略联邦临床场景中的未知样本。
AI.method: FIDAL整合标定的全局-局部证据不确定性、支持集多样性加权与自适应OOD拒绝；拒绝门基于基础模型高斯覆盖信号，用Otsu准则逐客户端、逐轮自适应设定阈值，无需手工调参。
AI.result: 在皮肤科、组织病理学和乳腺X线三个多中心开放集基准上，平衡准确率比基于检测器的开放集方法高约12个百分点，且是唯一在三基准的准确率-ID纯度Pareto前沿上的方法；同等查询预算下OOD标注少1.3倍以上，乳腺基准节省约7-29小时专家阅读时间。
AI.conclusion: 在开放集联邦主动学习中融合不确定性、多样性与OOD拒绝具有重要价值，仅标注少部分数据即可匹配或超越全监督性能。

title: Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals
summary: Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. Hierarchical extensions attempt to bridge this gap by learning a macro planner to predict intermediate latent sub-goals to guide the micro planner. In this work, we demonstrate that unconstrained latent sub-goal prediction is fundamentally flawed. A rigorous evaluation reveals that a leading state-of-the-art macro planner routinely emits physically unrealisable sub-goals. To resolve this, we introduce Metro-WM, a hierarchical framework that issues sub-goals by retrieving genuine states from prior experience rather than generating ungrounded latent vectors. Specifically, Metro-WM constructs a graph whose vertices are observed frames from offline expert demonstrations or random-action trajectories, allowing frames from different episodes to be connected and stitched into routes to the goal. Planning over the full graph also makes the system highly robust to execution errors: if the micro planner drifts off course, Metro-WM instantly finds a new optimal path from the current state. Our experiments show that Metro-WM achieves superior long-horizon success rates of up to 37.33 percentage points over the next best hierarchical approach while being up to 10.9 times faster, requiring both 13-56 times less offline compute and fewer tuned hyperparameters. Additional analysis reveals that Metro-WM finds shorter paths than the offline demonstrations, outperforms an oracle relying on the query's own demonstration, and maintains robust performance under extremely sparse dataset conditions.

AI.tldr: 层级世界模型规划器中无约束潜子目标预测不可靠会产出物理不可行子目标；Metro-WM 改为从经验帧中检索真实状态作为子目标，并在图上规划路径，实现更强长程规划。
AI.motivation: JEPA 式模型预测控制是有效的零样本目标达成规划器，但仅适用于短规划视野。现有层级方法用宏观规划器预测中间潜子目标来引导微观规划器，作者指出这种无约束潜子目标预测存在根本缺陷：前沿宏观规划器常生成物理上不可实现的子目标。
AI.method: Metro-WM 构建一个图，顶点为离线专家演示或随机动作轨迹中观测到的帧，允许不同回合的帧相连并拼接成通往目标的路线；子目标通过检索真实状态而非生成无依据的潜向量得到。在整图上的规划使系统对执行误差鲁棒，微观规划器偏离时能即时从当前状态找新最优路径。
AI.result: 长程成功率比次优层级方法最多高 37.33 个百分点，速度快至 10.9 倍，离线计算量少 13–56 倍且需调超参更少。额外分析显示 Metro-WM 能找到比离线演示更短的路径，优于依赖查询自身演示的 oracle，并在极稀疏数据条件下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 用检索真实状态替代无约束潜子目标生成，是解决层级 JEPA 规划长程不可行性的有效方案；Metro-WM 在成功率、速度、计算开销与鲁棒性上全面优于现有层级方法。

title: Synthesizing Update Schedules with Game-Based Extension of Bounded Model Checking
summary: Ensuring safe software updates in safety-critical systems without interrupting operation and without provisioning and activating cold spare hardware poses a fundamental challenge due to the conflict between system availability and update execution. In this paper, we present a bounded SMT encoding for synthesizing fixed global-time update schedules for timed-games with linear update automata and a fixed number of update transitions. We model the interaction between the system and the update as a two-player timed game. Our key contribution is the synthesis of global time points that define a fixed update schedule which guarantees safe and complete deployment of the update independently of the autonomous system behavior. To this end, we reduce the scheduling problem to a reachability and safety objective and encode it as a quantified SMT problem. We demonstrate it on an example system of a trajectory planner for autonomous driving, showing that the synthesized schedule ensures safe deployment under all admissible executions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种有界SMT编码方法，为带线性更新自动机和固定更新转换数量的时间博弈合成固定全局时间的更新调度，以保证安全关键系统在不中断运行、无冷备硬件情况下安全完成软件更新。
AI.motivation: 安全关键系统的软件更新需在不中断运行、不提供并激活冷备硬件的情况下进行，这与系统可用性和更新执行之间存在根本冲突，因此需要合成能保证安全、完整部署的更新调度。
AI.method: 将系统与更新的交互建模为双人时间博弈，使用带线性更新自动机和固定数量更新转换的时间博弈；把调度问题归约为可达性与安全性目标，并编码为量化的有界SMT问题，以合成定义固定更新调度的全局时间点。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶轨迹规划器示例系统上进行了验证，结果表明合成的调度在所有可接受执行下都能保证安全部署。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够为安全关键系统合成独立于系统自主行为的固定全局时间更新调度，确保软件更新安全且完整地部署。

title: Arbitrary-Accuracy Neural Approximation with Optimal Neuron Count and Near-Optimal Bit Complexity
summary: We study the minimum number of hidden neurons required for arbitrary-accuracy approximation of multivariate Hölder-continuous functions on $[0,1]^d$ and the associated encoding complexity. For $d\geq 2$, we construct a fixed, explicitly defined activation function for which a closed-form network with two hidden layers of widths $d$ and $1$ achieves arbitrary accuracy in the uniform norm. We prove that $d+1$ is the exact minimum total number of hidden neurons among standard feedforward networks with locally integrable activations and affine outputs. We further give a simpler construction using a single elementary activation that combines the floor and exponential functions. This construction requires three hidden layers of widths $d$, $1$, and $2$, only two neurons above the minimum. If a skip connection is allowed, widths $d$, $1$, and $1$ suffice. These constructions use explicit grid addressing and integer encoding of quantized function values. For a bounded $α$-Hölder class, they require $O(\varepsilon^{-d/α}\log(1/\varepsilon))$ bits, matching the metric-entropy lower bound up to a logarithmic factor.

AI.tldr: 研究多元 Hölder 连续函数在 [0,1]^d 上任意精度逼近所需的最少隐藏神经元数及编码复杂度。
AI.motivation: 探究多元 Hölder 连续函数逼近的隐藏神经元下界与编码复杂度，为神经网络逼近理论提供精确最小神经元数刻画。
AI.method: 构造固定显式激活函数，用两层隐藏层宽度 d 和 1 的闭式网络逼近；证明 d+1 为最小总隐藏神经元数；另用 floor+exp 单激活构造三层网络，或用跳跃连接。
AI.result: d+1 是精确最小隐藏神经元数；简化构造需 d,1,2 三层，仅比最小值多两个；允许跳跃连接时 d,1,1 足够；编码需 O(ε^{-d/α}log(1/ε)) 比特。
AI.conclusion: 网络编码复杂度与度量熵下界匹配至对数因子，给出最小神经元数的精确刻画。

title: SPRINT: Single-Step Generative Recommendation via Average Probability Velocity
summary: Semantic ID (SID) based generative recommendation represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens, and recommends by generating the SID of the item a user would like to interact with. Both dominant paradigms in this domain generally pay for generation token by token: autoregressive models decode the tokens left-to-right, while non-autoregressive models decode in parallel yet still need multiple rounds of refinement to stay competitive. Therefore, both generally spend multiple forward passes per item, a cost that is prohibitive in latency-sensitive recommender systems. We ask whether an item can be generated in a single forward pass, and answer it through a new perspective which we call average probability velocity. We view SID generation as a flow of token generation probabilities and characterize it by its average velocity over the whole generation process. We prove that this average velocity is fully determined by the average generation probability of each token. Therefore, we directly parameterize and learn the probabilities of all tokens in a single forward pass with a bidirectional Transformer. As these probabilities are generated independently across positions and the coherence among tokens is lost, we further design a dual-level flow contrastive objective to restore the coherence among an item's tokens. It contrasts the target SID against negative SIDs at both the token and SID levels. The token level ranks the generation probabilities of the target tokens above those of negative SIDs, while the SID level scores the tokens of each SID as a whole item for capturing token coherence of each item. Extensive experiments show that our model not only generates recommendations far more efficiently ($8.39-10.04\times$ speedup over the second-fastest AR/NAR method) but also attains superior recommendation accuracy ($7.77\%$ average improvement over the second-best.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"平均概率速度"视角，证明SID生成的平均速度由各token平均生成概率决定，从而实现单次前向传播的生成式推荐，并设计双层流对比目标恢复token连贯性。
AI.motivation: 现有SID生成式推荐（自回归逐token解码、非自回归多轮精炼）都需多次前向传播，在延迟敏感场景下代价高昂。作者希望实现单次前向传播完成整条SID生成。
AI.method: 提出"平均概率速度"概念，将SID生成视为token概率流，证明其平均速度由各token平均生成概率完全决定；据此用双向Transformer一次前向直接参数化并学习所有token概率；为弥补位置独立导致的token连贯性缺失，设计双层流对比目标，在token级和SID级分别对比正负样本。
AI.result: 相比第二快的AR/NAR方法实现8.39–10.04倍加速，推荐精度平均提升7.77%（相对第二名）。
AI.conclusion: 单次前向传播即可完成高质量SID生成，兼顾高效与高精度，证明了平均概率速度视角的有效性。

title: Identical Runs, Different Results: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents on Open-Weight Models
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/earino/identical-runs-different-results
summary: Repeated runs of the same coding agent are known to give different benchmark scores. We ask what that variation means for a team running an agent on its own task, by intensive replication on one machine-learning task: an agent improves the training code of an XGBoost classifier for airline delays, and a holdout it never sees scores the result. Across 584 runs, we compare six agents on six open-weight model endpoints, run six agent-model pairings 52 times each under fixed settings, and repeat three of them on a larger model from the same family. Identical runs of one pairing varied more than the pairings differed from one another, so comparisons of a few runs ranked them unreliably; resolving the agent differences we observed would take tens to more than a hundred runs of each. Runs on the larger model scored clearly higher, but by less than one run-to-run standard deviation, and the gap was more than twice as large with one agent as with the others. Fewer than one run in twenty broke the task's data rules, but those runs held the highest scores. Rejecting those runs first and keeping the best compliant result among a few attempts reliably improved the delivered model, even though a few runs could not rank the agents. On flights from a later year, the delivered models kept only a third of their gain over the starting code. At list prices, cost differed more than twentyfold between two agents on the same model, mostly through the prompt cache. Agents and models should be evaluated as pairings, over repeated attempts, with compliance reported beside quality. Data, code and every delivered program: https://github.com/earino/identical-runs-different-results

AI.tldr: 对同一 ML 任务做 584 次重复运行，发现同一配对的运行波动大于不同配对间差异，故少次运行无法可靠排名智能体；但通过拒绝违规运行并取最佳合规结果可稳定提升交付模型。
AI.motivation: 作者想探究：同一编码智能体重复运行的分数波动，对一个在自有任务上使用智能体的团队意味着什么。核心问题是重复运行差异是否会影响智能体/模型选择的可靠性。
AI.method: 在航空延误 XGBoost 分类器训练代码改进这一任务上做密集复现：共 584 次运行，比较 6 个智能体 × 6 个开放权重模型端点；其中 6 个智能体-模型配对各重复 52 次（固定设置），另取 3 个配对于同族更大模型上重复；用智能体从未见过的 holdout 评分。
AI.result: 同一配对重复运行间的波动大于配对之间的差异，少次运行无法可靠排名；要分辨所观察到的智能体差异需数十至上百次运行。更大模型得分更高，但差距不足一个运行间标准差，且不同智能体间差距相差两倍以上。不到二十分之一的运行违反数据规则，却获得最高分。去掉违规后取少数几次尝试中的最佳合规结果，可稳定改善交付模型；但换到更晚年份的航班数据时，交付模型仅保留约三分之一的相对起始代码的增益。同模型上不同智能体的列表价格成本相差逾 20 倍，主要来自 prompt 缓存。
AI.conclusion: 应将智能体与模型作为“配对”来评估，并基于重复尝试进行；报告质量指标时应同时报告合规性。少次运行不足以可靠排名智能体，但“筛除违规+取最佳合规”能可靠提升实际交付效果。

title: Toward Embedding-Based Psychometrics: Structural Modeling of Assessment-Item Semantics With Contextual Scores
summary: Contextual scores represent assessment items through their similarities to reference words in an external corpus. We examine the semantic structure of scores for 40 TIMSS mathematics scored units using a partially specified two-step factor procedure. A search across factor counts identifies a persistent seven-group structure under the featured construction. Subsequent comparisons consistently favor a general dimension alongside group associations, although individual group memberships remain sensitive to some specification choices. Item examples distinguish recurring, cross-domain, sensitive, and imposed associations. Simpler and unrestricted references clarify the contribution and limits of the anchored representation: it improves on a single factor but does not achieve the lowest working Bayesian information criterion (BIC). A separate response benchmark compares three initial Q constructions and their Hull-PVAF revisions under higher-order and saturated attribute distributions. Among these diagnostic models, BIC favors the official content framework and the Akaike information criterion (AIC) favors its direct four-factor augmentation, but a matched unidimensional two-parameter logistic model has lower AIC and BIC than all twelve conditions. These findings support a conditional semantic representation while limiting direct diagnostic interpretation. We discuss learned text-assisted response calibration as a prospective application requiring a larger calibrated item bank and independent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文用部分指定的两步因子方法，分析40个TIMSS数学评分单元的语境分数语义结构，发现稳定的七组结构及一个一般维度，并讨论文本辅助的作答校准应用。
AI.motivation: 语境分数以外部语料参考词相似度表征测评题目，但这类表征的语义结构尚不清楚，需要检验其维度构成及作为诊断工具的可行性。
AI.method: 对40个TIMSS数学评分单元采用部分指定的两步因子程序，搜索因子数；比较一般维度与组关联；用更简单和无限制的参考词检验锚定表征；并以单独作答基准比较三种初始Q构造及其Hull-PVAF修订，在高阶和饱和属性分布下评估模型。
AI.result: 发现稳定的七组结构，且倾向支持一个一般维度加组关联；锚定表征优于单因子，但未达到最低BIC；在诊断模型中，BIC支持官方内容框架，AIC支持其直接四因子扩展，但匹配的单维2PL模型AIC和BIC优于所有十二种条件。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持条件性语义表征，但限制其直接诊断解释；文本辅助的作答校准是有前景的应用，需更大校准题库和独立评估。

title: Disentangle and Drop: Robust Universal Removal of Image Watermarks via Reconstructive Grayscale Residual Decomposition
summary: Invisible image watermarks are commonly evaluated against benign postprocessing operations such as compression, resizing, blur, and color changes. These tests leave out a different threat: a learned remover that preserves semantic image content while discarding residual evidence that carries the payload. We propose Disentangle and Drop (DnD), an attack that is agnostic to the watermark method and treats watermark removal as a representation routing problem. DnD decomposes a watermarked image into a semantic grayscale carrier and an auxiliary residual branch, and then suppresses the residual branch to reduce watermark evidence. The model is trained with latent spectral perturbations and low-strength diffusion exposure so that the drop operation remains stable under adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on seven representative watermark families show that one shared operating setting gives competitive removal with high visual fidelity. Operating scans and ablations separate usable attacks from image-damaging settings: stronger noise or diffusion can raise removal scores by damaging the image, while the practical regime comes from dropping the residual latent. These results argue for evaluating watermark robustness against learned removal at the representation level, not only against conventional image edits.

AI.tldr: 提出DnD攻击，将水印去除视为表征路由问题，通过分解语义灰度载体与残差分支并抑制残差分支，实现与具体水印方法无关的高效去除。
AI.motivation: 现有水印评估只测试压缩、缩放、模糊等良性后处理，忽略了学习型去除器这一威胁：它保留语义内容却丢弃水印证据。
AI.method: DnD将带水印图像分解为语义灰度载体和辅助残差分支，抑制残差分支以减少水印证据；训练时引入潜在频谱扰动和低强度扩散暴露，使丢弃操作在自适应重建下保持稳定。
AI.result: 在七类代表性水印家族上，单一共享设置即取得有竞争力的去除效果和高视觉保真度；扫描与消融表明更强噪声或扩散虽提高去除分数却损害图像，实际可用区间来自丢弃残差潜在。
AI.conclusion: 水印鲁棒性评估应从表征层面考察对学习型去除的抵抗，而非仅针对传统图像编辑。

title: Energy-aware frugal Bayesian optimization
comment: Published in MATEC Web of Conferences 422, 02009. 7th International Conference on Engineering Optimization
summary: Modern design optimization frameworks aim first and foremost for models with the most accurate predictions without balancing computational overhead. It remains a reason why scaled architecture and multidisciplinary design optimization problems are difficult to address, even with sample-efficient Bayesian optimizers. In this paper, a metric quantifying the computational energy footprint is introduced within a Bayesian optimization framework to guide the parameter setting of a model towards configurations that balance both performance and frugality. The computer experiments highlighted existing tradeoffs between optimum convergence and the underlying energy footprint, and sometimes resulted in both a better-found optimum and lower energy consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文在贝叶斯优化框架中引入计算能耗足迹度量，引导模型配置在性能与节约之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有设计优化框架优先追求最高预测精度，忽视计算开销，导致大规模架构和多学科设计优化问题难以处理，即使使用样本高效的贝叶斯优化器也收效有限。
AI.method: 在贝叶斯优化框架内引入一个量化计算能耗足迹的度量，用于指导模型参数设置，使配置同时兼顾性能与节约。
AI.result: 计算机实验揭示了最优收敛与能耗足迹之间存在的权衡，有时能同时获得更优的最优点和更低的能耗。
AI.conclusion: 将能耗度量纳入贝叶斯优化可有效平衡性能与计算代价，为高开销优化问题提供更节约的解决路径。

title: IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement
comment: Technical Report, 56 pages, 6 figures. Model weights and configs available at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM
summary: Industrial procurement requires language models to bridge informal buyer jargon, sparse marketplace attributes, and authoritative engineering standards under strict safety tolerances. We present IndustryLLM, an open-weight industrial language model trained from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base (35B total parameters with ~3B activated per token, with the vision encoder frozen). Rather than relying on generic text scaling, we introduce a failure-driven adaptation recipe spanning continued pre-training (CPT) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). CPT leverages a curated ~100B-token corpus integrating 5B tokens of national standards (e.g., GB/T) and technical archives, 10B tokens of de-identified real-world industrial transaction and inquiry records, and 60B tokens of general replay. To overcome register mismatch and factual brittleness, we systematically reconstruct an estimated 20B-token domain subset via multi-register rewriting across 10 genres and 8 writing styles, confidence-routed minimal factual editing, and error-targeted QA synthesis (resolving colloquial typos like '42-luo-mu' -> 42CrMo, expanding ambiguous codes like '16674' -> GB/T 16674, and clarifying conflicting dimensional specs). For downstream deployment, we formalize an evidence-gated constraint-evaluation interface enforcing three-valued logic where unverified product evidence remains unknown rather than satisfied. Offline evaluations demonstrate consistent gains on procurement-query structuring (+2.97 percentage points in exact match, 95% CI [2.11, 3.86] in No-Think mode), while randomized online A/B experiments in production yield substantial improvements (+4.25% GMV, +8.3% satisfied inquiries) alongside a latency reduction from 6-7 s to 1.5 s. Model weights and configs are released at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM.

AI.tldr: IndustryLLM：面向工业采购的开源语言模型，基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 训练，采用失败驱动的 CPT+SFT 适配方案，结合证据门控三值逻辑接口，在离线与在线 A/B 中均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 工业采购场景存在非正式买家术语、稀疏市场属性与权威工程标准之间的鸿沟，且安全容错要求严格，通用文本扩展难以满足。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base（35B 总参、每 token 激活约 3B，视觉编码器冻结）为基础；采用 CPT+SFT 失败驱动方案：CPT 使用约 100B token 语料（5B 国标 GB/T 与档案、10B 去标识真实交易与询价、60B 通用回放）；重构约 20B token 领域子集：多语域改写（10 种体裁、8 种风格）、置信度路由最小事实编辑、错误靶向 QA 合成（如 '42-luo-mu'→42CrMo、'16674'→GB/T 16674、冲突尺寸澄清）；下游用证据门控约束评估接口，采用三值逻辑（未验证证据记为 unknown 而非 satisfied）。
AI.result: 离线：采购查询结构化 +2.97 个百分点精确匹配（95% CI [2.11, 3.86]，No-Think 模式）。在线随机 A/B：GMV +4.25%，满意询价 +8.3%，延迟从 6–7s 降至 1.5s。
AI.conclusion: 失败驱动的领域适配与证据门控三值逻辑可有效提升工业采购任务的精度、业务指标与响应速度，模型权重与配置已开源。

title: Does AI Help or Harm? Endogenous Information Acquisition with AI Advice
summary: AI advice increasingly enters human decision workflows before costly information acquisition and final action. This paper studies how such advice affects decision quality, measured by the gross utility of the final action. Advice shifts beliefs before the decision maker chooses an acquisition experiment with uniformly posterior-separable (UPS) costs. The analysis characterizes gross effects through the continuation gross value generated by net-optimal acquisition. Convexity of this value function is necessary and sufficient for every AI signal to weakly improve gross utility at every prior, while nonconvexity allows a binary signal to cause gross harm. The criterion gives tight state-space results. Every AI signal is weakly gross-improving in binary-state problems under arbitrary actions, payoffs, and UPS costs. A minimal three-state problem can generate gross harm through concentrated shutdown, where valuable acquisition stops. For classification problems with Shannon acquisition costs, the criterion becomes an active-set slope test. It guarantees weak gross improvement for homogeneous classification and all three-state weighted classification problems, while a minimal four-state failure arises from attention dilution, where acquisition shifts away from high-stake distinctions. Along a Blackwell-increasing mixture path, gross utility can first decrease and then increase. With endogenous interpretation, cheaper interpretation can reduce gross utility.

AI.tldr: 研究AI建议在昂贵信息获取前如何影响决策质量（最终行动的毛效用）。用"净最优获取"的连续毛价值函数凸性刻画：凸性则任意AI信号在所有先验下弱改善毛效用；非凸则二值信号可致毛损害。给出紧的状态空间结果，并在分类问题中化为活跃集斜率检验。
AI.motivation: AI建议日益进入人类决策流程，且往往出现在昂贵的信息获取与最终行动之前。既有研究多关注建议对最终决策的直接影响，但建议会先改变信念，进而改变决策者选择何种信息获取实验，这一间接渠道对决策质量的净影响尚不清楚。论文旨在刻画这种"信念先移—再选实验—后行动"结构下，AI建议何时改善、何时损害决策的毛效用。
AI.method: 构建模型：AI建议在决策者选择获取实验之前改变其信念，实验成本为"一致后验可分离"（UPS）成本类。以"net-optimal acquisition"（净最优获取）产生的连续毛价值为核心对象，用其凸性作为判据：凸性对"任意AI信号在所有先验下弱改善毛效用"是充要条件，非凸性则允许二值信号造成毛损害。并针对状态空间给出紧的结果，对香农获取成本的分类问题将判据简化为活跃集斜率检验。
AI.result: 1）二状态问题下，任意行动、收益与UPS成本，任意AI信号均弱改善毛效用。2）最小三状态问题即可通过"集中式关停"（有价值的获取被停止）产生毛损害。3）香农成本分类问题中，判据为活跃集斜率检验：同质分类与所有三状态加权分类问题保证弱改善，而最小四状态反例源于"注意力稀释"（获取从高利害区分上转移）。4）沿Blackwell递增的混合路径，毛效用可先降后升；在内生解释下，更便宜的解释反而可能降低毛效用。
AI.conclusion: AI建议对决策质量的毛效用影响并非单调有利，其符号由净最优获取的毛价值函数凸性决定。二状态总是安全，但三状态起可出现系统性损害，机制为获取的关停或注意力稀释；即使信息更多（Blackwell递增）或解释更便宜，也不保证毛效用提升。这为评估AI建议、设计信息获取流程提供了可操作的判据。

title: Correcting to Predict: Pseudo-Value Correction for Multimodal Attribute Value Extraction
comment: Accepted by CIKM2026 Oral Full Paper
summary: Product attribute value extraction (AVE) is a fundamental task in e-commerce, aiming to identify specific values of predefined attributes from multimodal product profiles such as text and images. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown promise for AVE, they face challenges in extracting implicit attributes that require joint reasoning over visual and textual cues, often confusing semantically similar values. However, existing methods often fail to resolve such ambiguities because the correct value often depends on subtle multimodal cues that are easy to miss or override. To address this challenge, we propose Correcting to Predict (C2P), a framework that treats attribute extraction as a correction process. Given an initial pseudo-value such as a retrieved candidate or placeholder, the model learns to correct it using multimodal evidence. During training, diverse pseudo-values help the model learn evidence-based correction behavior, and a self-consistency refinement stage further reduces sensitivity to pseudo-value perturbations. At inference, a fixed placeholder triggers the learned correction behavior, enabling efficient single-pass prediction without online retrieval or iterative refinement. We evaluate C2P on a public benchmark and a large-scale industrial dataset. Offline results show that C2P outperforms strong baselines, with notable gains on ambiguous attributes. Online A/B tests on AliExpress further show consistent improvements in seller adoption, attribute completeness, and user engagement, validating C2P's effectiveness and efficiency in real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出C2P框架，将商品属性值抽取视为纠错过程，用多模态证据修正伪值，在离线基准和AliExpress在线A/B测试上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在抽取需视觉与文本联合推理的隐式属性时易混淆语义相近的值，因正确值依赖细微且易被忽略或覆盖的多模态线索，现有方法难以解决此类歧义。
AI.method: C2P将属性抽取重构为纠错任务：给定初始伪值（检索候选或占位符），模型学习用多模态证据进行修正；训练中引入多样化伪值以学习基于证据的纠错行为，并通过自一致性精炼阶段降低对伪值扰动的敏感性；推理时用固定占位符触发纠错行为，实现高效单次预测，无需在线检索或迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在公开基准和大规模工业数据集上，C2P优于强基线，在歧义属性上提升尤为明显；AliExpress在线A/B测试显示卖家采纳率、属性完整度和用户参与度均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: C2P有效且高效，能解决多模态属性抽取中的歧义问题，并已在真实部署中验证其实际价值。

title: Counterfactual Rollout Replay: Forkable Environments as Free Process Rewards for Software Engineering Agents
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Includes additional experiments and analysis
summary: Outcome-only reinforcement learning gives software engineering (SWE) agents a terminal success signal but little direct guidance about intermediate decisions. We introduce Counterfactual Rollout Replay (CRR), a training-time procedure that uses forkable executable environments to obtain step-level return contrasts. CRR selects a small set of decision points, restores each state, samples an alternative action, and rolls the branch forward under the policy. It retains the realised training trajectory and replaces the advantage at selected steps with the difference between its terminal return and the sampled counterfactual return. The method needs no human process labels or learned process reward model; free refers to those supervision costs, not replay compute. With a 14B policy, CRR improves pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Live, and SWE-rebench, and combines with process-reward and trajectory-search methods. On SWE-bench Verified, an equal-wall-clock comparison on the same hardware yields 41.7% versus 36.7% for extended outcome-only GRPO, a 5.0-point gain with fork overhead included. These results apply to environments with affordable, reliable state restoration; stochastic continuations and expensive or imperfect replay remain limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实回放（CRR），用可分叉环境获得步级回报对比来训练SWE智能体，无需人工过程标签或过程奖励模型，在SWE-bench上提升pass@1。
AI.motivation: 仅结果奖励的强化学习只提供终端成功信号，对中间决策缺乏直接指导。
AI.method: CRR选择少量决策点，恢复状态、采样替代动作并前向回放分支；保留真实轨迹，将选定步骤的优势替换为终端回报与反事实回报之差。
AI.result: 14B策略在SWE-bench Verified、Live、rebench上提升pass@1；Verified上与延长GRPO等时对比为41.7%对36.7%，提升5.0点。可与过程奖励和轨迹搜索方法结合。
AI.conclusion: 适用于状态恢复可靠且低成本的环境；随机延续、昂贵或不完美的回放仍是局限。

title: Communication between Frozen Large Language Models via Prompt Optimization in a Referential Game
summary: We study communication between two frozen large language models from different providers, with different tokenizers, accessed through their API endpoints. The two play a referential game: one sees an object and describes it in a short fixed-length message over a small alphabet; the other must pick that object out of a candidate set. Neither model's weights are updated. Each agent's prompt is rewritten by an isolated prompt optimizer whose reflection model reads that agent's scored interactions. In the positional setting, optimized prompts carry a shared code that generalizes to held-out objects above a measured no-codebook baseline, including when the memory window is removed. In a second setting, independent per-letter blocks no longer fit within the message, although a whole-object place value code does. The base system fails to establish reliable communication: the sender struggles to retain an injective rule, and the receiver has too few confirmed examples in view. A sender collision penalty, retention of successful interactions, and sequential optimization enable successful place value communication in some runs. Outcomes vary across runs and reflection models. In successful runs, the protocol is written into the optimized prompts, where it can be read and audited directly.

AI.tldr: 两个来自不同厂商、tokenizer不同、仅通过API访问的冻结LLM通过提示优化在指称游戏中建立通信协议，成功时协议写在优化提示中可审计。
AI.motivation: 研究不同厂商、不同tokenizer的冻结大模型能否在权重不更新的情况下，通过API交互自发建立可靠的通信约定。
AI.method: 构建双模型指称游戏：发送方看物体并生成短定长小字母表消息，接收方从候选集中选出目标。两侧提示由独立的提示优化器重写，其反思模型读取该智能体的打分交互。测试位置编码设置及每位独立块、整体位值编码等变体。
AI.result: 位置设置下优化提示携带共享代码，对未见过物体泛化超过无码本基线，即使移除记忆窗口仍成立。基础系统难以建立可靠通信（发送方难保持单射规则、接收方确认样本不足）；加入发送方碰撞惩罚、保留成功交互和顺序优化后，部分运行实现位值通信，但结果随运行和反思模型波动。
AI.conclusion: 冻结异构LLM可通过提示优化涌现出可泛化的通信协议，且协议显式存在于提示中、可被读取与审计，但成功依赖优化策略且稳定性不足。

title: RemTraceNet: Few-Shot Forensic Detection of Invisible Watermark Attacks
summary: Removing an invisible watermark and concealing the forensic evidence are distinct objectives: successfully disrupting the embedded watermark does not imply that the removal process is forensically undetectable. When verification fails, removal traces can provide complementary evidence for provenance and ownership verification, whereas their absence leaves the cause of the failure ambiguous. Existing methods are typically evaluated by watermark suppression and perceptual quality, while forensic stealth is rarely considered. We therefore study watermark-attack-specific few-shot forensics: for each known pipeline, a specialist can separate its outputs from paired clean and unattacked watermarked controls. Separate Attack-vs-Clean and Attack-vs-Watermarked evaluations prevent watermark-presence shortcuts. Image-aligned and prompt-matched controls are used for post-hoc and generator-integrated schemes, respectively. In this work, we introduce RemTraceNet, which fuses constrained residuals, local relations, FFT/Haar statistics, and block-DCT evidence at native resolution. Across 23 removal pipelines and 10 watermark configurations, we evaluate native 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 inputs. With 100 attacked training images per pipeline, the three-seed TPR@1%FPR, macro-averaged over attacks and watermark configurations, ranges from 82.75% to 88.17% across resolutions and control types. Under the condition of same labels and protocol, RemTraceNet outperforms retrained SRNet, ZhuNet, and SiaStegNet baselines by 10.80--15.68 percentage points. Extensive experimental results show that erasing a watermark and erasing evidence of its removal are distinct challenges, and that removal traces remain learnable under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文研究水印去除过程的取证痕迹检测，提出RemTraceNet，在少样本条件下检测去除痕迹，表明去除水印与消除去除证据是两个不同问题。
AI.motivation: 去除不可见水印与隐藏取证证据是不同目标：成功破坏水印不代表去除过程不可检测。现有方法只评估水印抑制和感知质量，忽略取证隐蔽性。验证失败时，去除痕迹可提供溯源证据，其缺失则使失败原因模糊。
AI.method: 研究水印攻击特定的少样本取证：对每个已知流程，用干净与未攻击水印对照样本区分其输出。分离Attack-vs-Clean和Attack-vs-Watermarked评估以避免水印存在性捷径。采用图像对齐和提示匹配控制。提出RemTraceNet，融合约束残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar统计和块DCT证据，保持原生分辨率。
AI.result: 在23种去除流程和10种水印配置下评估原生256x256和512x512输入。每流程100张攻击训练图像时，三种子TPR@1%FPR宏平均为82.75%–88.17%。相同标签与协议下，RemTraceNet比重新训练的SRNet、ZhuNet和SiaStegNet基线高10.80–15.68个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明擦除水印与擦除去除证据是不同挑战，且在有限监督下去除痕迹仍可学习。

title: When Does Domain Adaptation Help on Physical Vibration Sensors? A Held-Out-Bearing Study of Neural-Operator and Convolutional Models
summary: Diagnosing rolling-element bearing faults from vibration is a canonical physical-sensing task and a widely used benchmark for domain adaptation under operating-condition shift. Accuracies above 99 percent are commonly reported, but under evaluation splits that place the same physical bearing in both training and test. We revisit the task under a held-out-bearing protocol, assigning every bearing unit entirely to either the training or the test set, and find that source-only transfer is far weaker than such numbers suggest: on a change of shaft speed it reaches only $0.36$, against a target-supervised ceiling of 0.97. We then study what governs transfer. Treating computed order tracking, a shaft-angle resampling that places fault frequencies at fixed shaft orders independent of running speed, as a controlled change of representation, we find that a Fourier Neural Operator raises source-only transfer from $0.36$ to $0.61$ on the speed shift, where the fault peaks move, while a convolutional network of matched feature dimension stays near chance in both representations. The representation also decides whether unsupervised alignment can work: with the same normalized RBF-MMD loss and no target labels, the operator reaches 0.71 in the frequency domain but 0.95 in the order domain, within 0.02 of the target-supervised ceiling and above $0.86$ on every held-out bearing fold. Once the representation is right, a small label budget adds little. These results indicate that, for this task, the input representation rather than the alignment method decides whether adaptation helps. A second dataset, whose held-out units are fault diameters rather than bearings, shows that the same protocol exposes failures that even a target-supervised model cannot avoid.

AI.tldr: 在留出轴承(held-out-bearing)协议下，滚动轴承故障诊断的跨工况迁移远弱于99%的常见报告；输入表征比对齐方法更决定迁移成败。
AI.motivation: 现有轴承故障诊断报告的超高精度（>99%）多来自同一物理轴承同时出现在训练和测试集的划分方式，掩盖了真实的跨工况泛化能力，需要更严格的评测协议来揭示真实迁移性能。
AI.method: 采用留出轴承协议（每个轴承整体归入训练或测试）；将计算阶次跟踪（按轴角重采样，使故障频率落在固定轴阶）作为受控的表征变换；对比Fourier Neural Operator与匹配特征维度的卷积网络；用归一化RBF-MMD无监督对齐，在频率域与阶次域进行对比。
AI.result: 变速工况下，源域单独迁移仅0.36（目标监督上限0.97）；FNO将源域单独迁移从0.36提升到0.61；匹配维度的CNN两表征下均接近随机。无监督对齐下，频率域达0.71，阶次域达0.95（距上限0.02，各留出折均>0.86）。表征正确后，少量标签收益有限。第二数据集（留出单位为故障直径）显示该协议能暴露连目标监督模型也无法避免的失败。
AI.conclusion: 对该任务而言，决定迁移是否有效的是输入表征而非对齐方法；表征选对后无监督对齐即可接近目标监督上限，少量标签帮助不大。

title: COUNTERMEM: World-Model Verified Counter-Factual Memory for Language Agents
summary: Existing agent memory frameworks mainly create memory through an agent's interaction with the factual world, e.g., remembering feedback from actions taken to improve performance on future tasks. However, these frameworks seldom ask the "what if" question during memory construction: what if a different action had been taken, would the feedback have changed, and how could this feedback become useful memory? Obtaining such feedback directly in an active environment can be expensive and can alter the state needed for comparison. In this work, we introduce COUNTERMEM, a reinforcement-learning framework for constructing and using verified counterfactual memory across tasks. After a failed action, COUNTERMEM evaluates local alternatives from a copy or reset of the original state using executable world models, such as tests, proof checkers, and solvers. It stores improvements with the original and corrected actions, checked outcomes, and conditions for reuse. A learned memory-use policy selects a retrieved record or skips memory to balance task success and interaction cost, while the base LLM remains fixed. Both memory and policy are frozen during held-out evaluation. We evaluate COUNTERMEM on 12 benchmark settings across six domains. With gpt-oss-120b, COUNTERMEM improves both ReAct and Reflexion on all 12 benchmarks across six domains, averaging a gain of 12.6 percentage points over their unaugmented versions. In the four-domain comparison across two backbones, task-run tokens decrease by 7.7-42.0%, excluding offline selector-training costs. Further analyses show that removing verification or persistent storage weakens the gains, while applying verified corrections to unsuitable decisions can reverse them. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: COUNTERMEM是一个强化学习框架，通过构造和利用已验证的反事实记忆来提升智能体性能。它从失败动作出发评估局部替代方案，存储改进及条件，并用学习到的记忆使用策略平衡成功率与交互成本。在六个领域12个基准上，相比ReAct和Reflexion平均提升12.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆框架主要通过与真实世界交互构建记忆，很少考虑"如果当时采取不同动作会怎样"这一问题。在活跃环境中直接获取此类反事实反馈成本高且会改变用于比较的状态。
AI.method: COUNTERMEM在动作失败后，基于原始状态的副本或重置，用可执行世界模型（测试、证明检查器、求解器）评估局部替代方案；存储原始与修正动作、已验证结果及复用条件。学习一个记忆使用策略选择检索记录或跳过记忆，以平衡任务成功与交互成本，基础LLM保持固定，评估时记忆与策略冻结。
AI.result: 在六个领域12个基准上，使用gpt-oss-120b时COUNTERMEM使ReAct和Reflexion全面提升，平均增益12.6个百分点。两骨干四领域对比中，任务运行token减少7.7%-42.0%（不含离线选择器训练成本）。分析显示去除验证或持久存储会削弱效果，将已验证修正应用于不适宜决策会带来反效果。
AI.conclusion: 构造并利用经过验证的反事实记忆能有效提升智能体跨任务表现，同时降低交互成本，但验证、存储及正确应用条件是关键。

title: Envy-Free Decompositions of Random Assignments: Settling Four Agents, and What Lies Beyond
comment: 11 pages; code and computational results in ancillary files
summary:
A random assignment of n indivisible objects to n agents is specified by its assignment matrix and implemented by drawing a deterministic assignment from a Birkhoff-von Neumann decomposition. Kawase et al. observed that the choice of decomposition matters for fairness: a matrix that is envy-free in the sense of stochastic dominance (SD-EF) can be decomposed so that some agent envies another with probability close to 1. They call a decomposition Dec-EF if every agent envies every other agent with probability at most 1/2, proved that every SD-EF matrix admits a Dec-EF decomposition when n <= 3 or when there are at most two distinct preferences, and left the general case open.
  We settle the first open case: every SD-EF matrix with four agents admits a Dec-EF decomposition. The worst case over the SD-EF polytope of a profile is attained at a vertex, and our computer-aided proof enumerates all 26,927 vertices for the 762 profiles up to symmetry in exact arithmetic and certifies each by a rational decomposition. The same method settles five agents with at most four distinct preferences and the probabilistic serial rule for all five-agent profiles, and adversarial search up to seven agents finds no counterexample.
  For general n, an envy-budget identity shows that 1/2 is the best possible threshold. We prove that every SD-EF matrix with at most two distinct rows admits a Dec-EF decomposition, and that the maximum-entropy decomposition is Dec-EF whenever all agents but two share a preference; the latter proof rests on a new monotonicity lemma for weighted least-squares rankings. In general, natural decompositions fail: greedy Birkhoff-von Neumann can come arbitrarily close to envy probability (n-1)/n, and maximum entropy fails at n = 4 when all preferences differ. Deciding whether an arbitrary random assignment, not necessarily SD-EF, admits a Dec-EF decomposition is strongly NP-complete.

AI.tldr: 论文研究随机分配中Birchhoff-von Neumann分解对公平性的影响，证明四人情形下每个SD-EF矩阵都存在Dec-EF分解，并给出多智能体与一般情形的若干结果及NP难结论。
AI.motivation: 同一SD-EF分配矩阵的不同BvN分解可能导致截然不同的嫉妒概率，Kawase等人提出Dec-EF概念并解决n≤3或至多两种偏好情形，但一般情形（尤其n=4）悬而未决，本文旨在填补该空白并刻画阈值与算法边界。
AI.method: 利用SD-EF多面体最坏情形在顶点取到的性质，对4个agent的762个对称类、共26,927个顶点在精确算术下枚举并给出有理分解证书；用同一方法处理5个agent至多4种偏好及所有5-agent的PS规则；对一般n证明嫉妒预算恒等式、至多两种不同行的SD-EF矩阵可Dec-EF分解、最大熵分解在特定条件下Dec-EF，并给出加权最小二乘排序的单调性引理；通过对抗搜索（至7个agent）寻找反例，并证明一般随机分配判定问题的强NP完全性。
AI.result: 证明每个4个agent的SD-EF矩阵都有Dec-EF分解；同样方法解决5个agent至多4种偏好及所有5-agent的PS规则；对抗搜索至7个agent无反例；证明1/2是可达阈值下界的最优界；证明至多两种不同行的SD-EF矩阵可Dec-EF分解，最大熵分解在除两人外所有agent偏好相同时Dec-EF；发现贪心BvN可逼近(n-1)/n嫉妒概率，最大熵在n=4且所有偏好不同时失败；判定任意随机分配是否Dec-EF为强NP完全。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决Kawase等人提出的n=4开放问题，并部分推广到更多agent与偏好结构，同时揭示自然分解方法的局限和问题的计算复杂性，表明Dec-EF分解的存在性紧密依赖偏好结构与分解选择。

title: Relevance-Resolution Transfer via Scale-Decomposable Fractional Diffusion for Multi-Length Cross-Modal Hash Retrieval
summary: Cross-modal hashing enables efficient retrieval by encoding heterogeneous data into compact binary codes. Recent methods exploit fine-grained relations encoded in multi-label training structure, yet none of them constrains how those relations survive as consistent candidate rankings in finite, multi-length Hamming spaces, which we term the relevance resolution bottleneck (RRB). To address the RRB, we propose MultiBit, which transfers relevance resolution from multi-label structure to multi-length Hamming spaces. MultiBit first constructs a scale-decomposable fractional relation teacher from dataset-level label co-occurrence and label specificity, and models dependencies from local to long-range over continuous diffusion scales. It then maps the discretized diffusion scales and their quadrature weights to scale-aware bit subblocks of the maximum-length code, organizes the target code lengths as nested prefixes, and aligns their Hamming candidate rankings with the teacher relations. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate improved retrieval accuracy. Code is available in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 提出MultiBit方法，将相关性分辨率从多标签结构迁移到多长度汉明空间，缓解"相关性分辨率瓶颈"，提升跨模态哈希检索精度。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态哈希方法利用多标签训练结构中的细粒度关系，但未约束这些关系在有限、多长度汉明空间中如何保持一致的候选排序，即"相关性分辨率瓶颈"(RRB)。
AI.method: MultiBit首先基于数据集级标签共现与标签特异性构建可尺度分解的分数关系教师，并在连续扩散尺度上建模从局部到长程的依赖；随后将离散化扩散尺度及其求积权重映射到最大长度码的尺度感知比特子块，把目标码长组织为嵌套前缀，并使其汉明候选排序与教师关系对齐。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上实验表明检索精度有所提升，代码见补充材料。
AI.conclusion: 通过将相关性分辨率迁移至多长度汉明空间，MultiBit有效缓解RRB问题并提升跨模态检索性能。

title: Green AI: Cost of LLM-Based Code Completion
summary: Code completion is one of the most widely used applications of large language models (LLMs) in software development. Open-weight LLMs are increasingly adopted for locally deployed code completion systems, partly due to privacy concerns. Despite advances in LLM accuracy, the energy cost of inference remains underexplored, particularly under large-context workloads and across programming languages. This study investigates the trade-off between accuracy and energy consumption in LLM-based code completion and how workload characteristics, context size, and model scale influence inference energy usage. We evaluate 25 open-weight LLMs on two workloads: repository-level next-line completion with varying context sizes on RepoBench, and fill-in-the-middle (FIM) code completion across Python, Java, and Rust on McEval. We analyze the influence of input tokens, output tokens, model size, and their interactions on energy consumption using correlation analysis and cluster-robust linear regression. Our findings show that the dominant drivers of energy consumption depend strongly on task structure. In RepoBench, energy consumption is primarily influenced by input context size and its interaction with model scale, whereas in McEval, output generation and its interaction with active parameter count dominate. Output generation is more energy-intensive per token than prompt processing. Across both benchmarks, smaller and heavily quantized models frequently achieve Pareto-optimal trade-offs, often providing accuracy comparable to larger FP16 models while consuming substantially less energy. Increasing model size or context length does not necessarily lead to proportionally better completion quality, while quantization can substantially improve energy efficiency with limited accuracy degradation. These findings support more energy-aware deployment strategies for sustainable AI-assisted software development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM代码补全中准确率与能耗的权衡，评估25个开源模型，发现能耗主导因素随任务结构变化，小型/量化模型常达帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 开源LLM广泛用于本地代码补全，但推理能耗在大上下文、多语言场景下研究不足，缺乏对准确率-能耗权衡及影响因素的系统分析。
AI.method: 评估25个开源权重LLM，在RepoBench（仓库级下一行补全，变化上下文）和McEval（Python/Java/Rust的FIM补全）两工作负载上，用相关分析和聚类稳健线性回归分析输入token、输出token、模型规模及其交互对能耗的影响。
AI.result: 能耗主导因素依任务结构而异：RepoBench中主要为输入上下文大小及其与模型规模的交互；McEval中为输出生成及其与活跃参数量的交互。输出生成每token能耗高于提示处理。小型和重度量化模型常达帕累托最优，性能接近大FP16模型但能耗大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 增大模型或上下文长度不必然带来成比例的质量提升，量化可显著提升能效且精度损失有限，支持面向可持续AI辅助软件开发的能耗感知部署策略。

title: Before the Rollout Ends: Early Terminal Reward Prediction for Long-horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents receive verifiable rewards only after completing expensive sequences of tool calls. This increases inference cost, amplifies early wrong hypotheses, and can lead to sparse terminal reward and unstable training. We introduce Contextual Early Reward (CER), which predicts terminal reward through behavioral evidence in a trajectory prefix. CER synthesizes adaptive rubrics specific to the current task and stage through experiences summarized from related historical tasks. In test-time scaling on SWE-bench Verified, CER improves RM@8 over the strongest baseline by 4.2 percentage points (pp) on Nemotron 3 Ultra and 2.0 pp on Qwen 3.6 27B; on Nemotron, it takes only 15.3% tokens to match the best baseline performance. In RL training experiments, CER exceeds full-rollout TMax by 1.9 pp while using 52.7% fewer online policy-and-judge tokens. Together, CER provides an interpretable, efficient, and dense evaluation method for long-horizon coding agents.

AI.tldr: CER通过轨迹前缀中的行为证据预测终局奖励，利用历史任务经验合成自适应评分标准，实现长程编码智能体的高效、可解释、稠密评估。
AI.motivation: 长程编码智能体仅在完成昂贵的工具调用序列后才获得可验证奖励，导致推理成本高、错误假设被放大、终端奖励稀疏及训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出Contextual Early Reward（CER），从相关历史任务中总结经验，针对当前任务与阶段合成自适应评分标准，并通过轨迹前缀中的行为证据预测终局奖励。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified测试时扩展中，CER的RM@8相比最强基线在Nemotron 3 Ultra上提升4.2个百分点、在Qwen 3.6 27B上提升2.0个百分点；在Nemotron上仅用15.3%的token即达到最佳基线性能。RL训练中，CER超过全rollout的TMax 1.9个百分点，且在线策略与评判token减少52.7%。
AI.conclusion: CER为长程编码智能体提供了一种可解释、高效且稠密的评估方法。

title: Video Captioning in Low-Light Conditions through Efficient Uncertainty-Aware Caption Correction
summary: Low-light conditions can significantly degrade the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to accurately describe human actions in videos. In this work, I propose an efficient uncertainty-aware representation correction framework for improving captions generated by VideoChat2 under real-world low-light conditions. Instead of fine-tuning the underlying VLM, the proposed framework introduces a lightweight sparse Gaussian process-based error estimation module between the projection layer and the language model to correct the intermediate representation. The correction module learns to estimate the residual between the original projected representation and a verified target representation, which is then adaptively scaled using a newly formulated uncertainty-aware coefficient and added to the original representation. To further improve residual estimation, I introduce a partitioned combined-kernel design. The correction model is trained separately using only 44 samples from the ARID dataset and requires only a small additional computational overhead during inference. The effectiveness of the proposed correction is evaluated through quantitative residual prediction and qualitative analysis of the generated captions. Although VideoChat2 is used in my experiments, the proposed framework is designed to be applicable to other compatible VLM architectures. \textbf{Code Availability: The implementation accompanying this work is publicly available at}:\href{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知的稀疏高斯过程表示校正框架，通过轻量级误差估计模块修正VideoChat2在低光视频中的中间表示，仅用44个样本训练即可提升字幕生成质量。
AI.motivation: 低光条件显著削弱视觉语言模型（VLM）准确描述视频中人类动作的能力。传统方案需微调底层VLM，代价高、不灵活，因此需要一种高效、可迁移的表示修正方法。
AI.method: 在投影层与语言模型之间插入轻量级稀疏高斯过程误差估计模块，学习原始投影表示与已验证目标表示之间的残差；用新提出的不确定性感知系数自适应缩放残差并叠加到原表示上；引入分区组合核设计提升残差估计，模块可单独训练。
AI.result: 仅用ARID数据集的44个样本训练，推理时附加计算开销很小；通过定量残差预测与生成字幕的定性分析验证了校正有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需微调VLM即可改善低光条件下的视频字幕生成，且设计上可适用于其他兼容的VLM架构，代码已公开。

title: Measure Learning at Steady State: A BIRD-SQL Formula 1 Case Study
summary: Continual Learning Bench scores learning as short-horizon gain versus a reset baseline and finds naive full-context ICL strongest among the memories it tested. We treat ICL as one learning system and score it on a longer shared-world schedule. Steady-state learning is the gap versus baseline on a pre-set late window (last 40 of 174 BIRD-SQL formula-1 questions). We split the score into exploration efficiency (SQL probes), task reward (hits), and delivery cost (API dollars and context size). On gpt-5.6-luna, late probes fall from 4.6-5.6 to 0.95 while hits rise only modestly and ICL context grows to about 95k tokens with cost roughly doubling. Short-horizon gain understates the late probe saving and misses the cost inversion, so we find that unbounded ICL is a poor candidate for the learning mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文将ICL视为一个学习系统，在更长的共享世界日程上评分，发现无限ICL并非理想的学习机制。
AI.motivation: 现有Continual Learning Bench以前缀短视增益评分，且发现朴素全上下文ICL最强，但可能低估长期探索节省并忽略成本问题。
AI.method: 将ICL作为单一学习系统，在更长的共享世界日程上评分；用预置晚期窗口（174道BIRD-SQL F1题的最后40题）的基准差距定义稳态学习，并将得分拆为探索效率（SQL探针）、任务奖励（命中）和交付成本（API美元与上下文大小）。
