AI.result: 在gpt-5.6-luna上，晚期探针从4.6-5.6降至0.95，命中仅小幅上升，ICL上下文增长至约95k tokens，成本约翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 短视增益低估了晚期探针节省且漏掉了成本反转，因此无限ICL是较差的学习机制候选。

title: Context-dependent agent evaluation with orthogonal equilibrium learning
summary: Many applications require to evaluate agents under contextual information (e.g., a prompt, task, or user group). We study how to perform such context-dependent agent evaluation from offline feedback. Existing score-based models for this purpose (e.g., Bradley-Terry) impose a transitive preference ordering, which fails to reflect collective preferences when human judgements are heterogeneous. Inspired by social choice theory, we frame evaluation as a contextual game between two players, each selecting a distribution over agents as the strategy to receive greater collective preference than the other. Then, the support of the Nash equilibrium defines a context-specific set of winners. However, learning context-specific equilibria from offline logs is difficult because each context reveals human feedback on only a subset of agents, and, hence, a naive plug-in estimator can therefore be biased. To address these challenges, we propose NashEval, a general framework for robust contextual equilibrium learning. NashEval first constructs debiased estimates of the contextual payoff matrix that characterizes the game. NashEval then learns the context-to-equilibrium mapping with a tailored orthogonal loss, which avoids the need to solve a separate game for each context. We show theoretically that errors in estimating the nuisance functions underlying the payoff matrix affect the risk of the learned equilibrium (i.e., exploitability) only through higher-order terms. Across various experiments, NashEval improves robustness of equilibrium learning and consistently identifies the set of top-performing agents across contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NashEval 框架，将 context-dependent 的 agent 评估建模为两玩家博弈，利用社会选择理论思想从离线反馈中学习 context-specific 的 Nash 均衡，从而识别每个 context 下的优胜 agent 集合。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分数的评估模型（如 Bradley-Terry）假设偏好具有传递性，无法反映人类判断异质时的集体偏好，因此需要一种能刻画 context-dependent 且异质偏好的评估方法。
AI.method: 将评估建模为两玩家博弈，每个玩家选择 agent 上的分布作为策略以获取更强集体偏好，Nash 均衡的支撑集定义 context-specific 的 winner 集合。为从离线日志学习，提出 NashEval：先构造去偏的 context payoff matrix 估计，再用定制的 orthogonal loss 学习 context-to-equilibrium 映射，避免逐 context 求解博弈。
AI.result: 理论上证明 payoff matrix 中 nuisance 函数的估计误差仅通过高阶项影响学习均衡的风险（即 exploitability）；实验表明 NashEval 提升了均衡学习的鲁棒性，并稳定识别各 context 下的 top-performing agents。
AI.conclusion: NashEval 为 context-dependent agent 评估提供了一种鲁棒且可泛化的均衡学习框架，能有效应对异质偏好与离线反馈偏差问题。

title: Truthful-in-Expectation MMS Allocations for Chores
summary: We study truthful-in-expectation (TIE) mechanisms for allocating indivisible chores alongside ex-post maximin share (MMS) guarantees. For goods, Bu and Tao (FOCS 2025) established a (1/n)-approximation for TIE mechanisms, and this was substantially improved by Babaioff, Feige, and Manaker Morag (FOCS 2026), who established an Ω(1/\log n) approximation, where n is the number of agents. The corresponding problem for chores has received less attention. The best-known result is due to Aziz, Li, and Wu (MAPR 2024), who gave a TIE mechanism with an O(\sqrt{\log n}) MMS approximation guarantee that holds only in expectation. They also established a 6/5 lower bound for TIE mechanisms for two agents. In this paper, we present the first TIE mechanism for chores that achieves a constant ex-post MMS approximation guarantee. Specifically, our mechanism guarantees an ex-post ratio of 1.97 for any number of agents n, which improves to 4/3 for n=2 and 3/2 for n=3. On the hardness side, we tighten the two-agent lower bound to 4/3, showing that our mechanism is optimal for n=2. More generally, we establish a lower bound of 13/12 on the ex-post MMS approximation ratio achievable by TIE mechanisms for every n\ge 3.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不可分任务的真实期望(TIE)机制与事后MMS保证，首次给出了常数级事后MMS近似保证的TIE机制（任意n下1.97，n=2时4/3，n=3时3/2），并改进了下界（n=2为4/3，n≥3为13/12）。
AI.motivation: 物品分配问题中TIE机制已有较好结果（如Ω(1/log n)近似），但任务（chores）分配研究较少，最好结果仅为期望意义下O(√log n)近似，缺乏常数级事后保证。
AI.method: 设计一种新的TIE机制用于不可分任务分配，结合事后MMS保证分析；并通过构造性下界论证分析机制达到的近似比极限。
AI.result: 机制在任意n下获得事后近似比1.97，n=2时4/3，n=3时3/2；下界方面，将两agent下界收紧至4/3（证明n=2时机制最优），并对所有n≥3建立13/12的下界。
AI.conclusion: 首次实现任务分配中常数级事后MMS的TIE机制，且在两agent情形下达到最优，同时收紧了一般情形的下界。

title: Eval4DiRec: A Unified and Systematic Evaluation Framework for Diffusion-based Recommender Systems
comment: Accepted by ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data (TKDD)
summary: Leveraging the strong generative capabilities and stable training dynamics of diffusion models, diffusion-based recommender systems (RSs) have recently emerged as a novel recommendation paradigm, attracting increasing attention from both academia and industry. However, despite the rapid growth of diffusion-based RSs, a critical issue has emerged: the lack of a unified and systematic quantitative evaluation benchmark, which often results in irreproducible experimental results and unfair comparisons across studies due to inconsistent data processing, training configurations, inference procedures, and evaluation protocols. To address this challenge, we propose Eval4DiRec, the first unified and open-source evaluation framework specifically designed for diffusion-based RSs. Eval4DiRec supports 14 representative diffusion-based RS models across five different recommendation scenarios, providing consistent and reproducible experimental settings to systematically assess their performance. Built upon this framework, we conduct extensive empirical studies to benchmark these models under unified protocols. The results highlight the strong potential of diffusion models for recommendation while also revealing key factors and practical challenges that substantially affect their performance, thereby establishing a solid foundation to facilitate fair evaluation and guide future research in this promising field. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/wangcong2001/Eval4DiRec.

AI.tldr: 提出Eval4DiRec，首个面向扩散推荐系统的统一开源评测框架，支持14个模型、5类场景，并给出基准实证研究。
AI.motivation: 扩散推荐系统虽发展迅速，但缺乏统一系统的定量评测基准，导致数据处理、训练配置、推理流程和评测协议不一致，实验难以复现、比较不公平。
AI.method: 构建Eval4DiRec统一开源评测框架，涵盖14个代表性扩散推荐模型和5种推荐场景，提供一致且可复现的实验设置，并在此基础上开展大规模实证基准研究。
AI.result: 在统一协议下对14个模型完成系统性基准评测，验证了扩散模型在推荐中的强潜力，同时揭示影响性能的关键因素与实际挑战。
AI.conclusion: Eval4DiRec为扩散推荐领域建立了公平评测基础，有助于推动未来研究；代码与数据已开源。

title: Maat: Independent Deterministic Contract-Based Governance for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Benchmarks: https://github.com/Lorelys/maat-benchmarks ; CrewAI integration demo: https://github.com/Lorelys/maat-crewai-demo
summary: Large-language-model multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) introduce a characteristic reliability problem: an error produced by one agent can be accepted as context by downstream agents and propagate across the workflow. Many proposed safeguards rely on learned or LLM-based judges whose verdicts are themselves probabilistic; we ask whether a deterministic layer can instead stop contract-detectable handoff defects. We present Maat, a runtime governance layer that validates agent-to-agent handoffs against a versioned workflow contract, or anchor, with no language model in the validation or scoring path. We evaluate it in six controlled domain workflows (6-15 agents, 522 trials) with injected data-level defects and a deterministic seven-check rubric. Version 1 reported gains in all six workflows (2.9-26.5%). A post-publication audit found that three benchmark scorers credited any early halt as a prevented defect. On paired trials where the governed run completed or halted on a finding attributable to a verified defect, the rubric score changes by +7.7% to +29.1% in five workflows and is flat in software development; model-call cost falls 17-53% where attributable halts occur early. A hand review of all 94 governed-arm halts found 35 false alarms (37%), caused by validator defects rather than model behaviour; counting those halts as failed work, the governed arm scores below the ungoverned arm in four of six workflows. The results support deterministic handoff validation for contract-expressible defects and show that validator configuration and halt attribution must themselves be tested; they do not establish universal correctness, hallucination detection, or model-independent effectiveness.

AI.tldr: Maat 是一个无语言模型参与的确定性运行时治理层，通过版本化工作流契约验证多智能体交接。初版报告六个工作流均有提升，但后续审计发现评分缺陷；按配对试验修正后五个工作流仍有 +7.7%~29.1% 提升，但 37% 的治理中止为误报，若计为失败则四个工作流反而不如无治理方案。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统中，单个智能体的错误会被下游当作上下文接受并沿工作流传播。现有防护依赖学习型或 LLM 评判器，其判定本身具有概率性，因此作者探究能否用确定性层拦截可由契约检测的交接缺陷。
AI.method: 提出 Maat：一个对智能体间交接做验证的运行时治理层，依据版本化工作流契约（anchor）进行检查，验证与评分路径中不含任何语言模型。在六个受控领域工作流（6-15 个智能体、522 次试验）中，注入数据级缺陷，并用确定性七项检查评分表评估。
AI.result: 初版报告六个工作流均有 2.9-26.5% 提升，但审计发现三个评分器把任何提前中止都记为已阻止缺陷。在配对试验（治理运行完成，或中止归因于经验证缺陷）中，五个工作流评分提升 +7.7% 至 +29.1%，软件开发工作流持平；可归因的早期中止使模型调用成本降低 17-53%。人工复核全部 94 次治理中止发现 35 次误报（37%），源于验证器缺陷而非模型行为；若把这些中止计为失败，六个工作流中有四个治理表现低于无治理。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对可契约表达的缺陷采用确定性交接验证，并表明验证器配置与中止归因本身也必须被测试；但该研究并未证明通用正确性、幻觉检测能力或与模型无关的有效性。

title: Quantization Thresholds Replicate, Failure Modes Do Not: A Three-Model Study of Agentic Tool Use in Polish from 8-bit to 2-bit
comment: 34 pages, 1 figure, 21 tables. Code, tasks, trajectories and analysis scripts: https://github.com/JakubPrejzner/polagentbench
summary: We ask how GGUF quantization affects agentic tool use in Polish and whether the effects generalize across models. We introduce PolAgentBench, a deterministic benchmark with Polish prompts and English tool schemas: a 67-task main suite (15 adversarial probes, 52 hard-tier tasks) and a 46-task arithmetic isolation ladder. Three models span two axes of variation: Bielik-11B-v3.0 and its pruned, distilled child Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0 isolate model compression, and Llama-PLLuM-8B adds a change of pretraining family. Each is measured at six precisions, Q8_0 to Q2_K. Only the collapse threshold replicates. (1) All three models fall off a cliff between 3-bit and 2-bit (11B 0.716 to 0.045, 7B 0.463 to 0.149, PLLuM 0.224 to 0.015; paired McNemar p < 0.001 in each), across a fourfold capability spread and both axes. (2) Failure modes do not replicate: at 2-bit the 7B fails long (median 9.1k tokens, 4 steps) while the 11B mostly answers at the first step with a confabulated final answer (37 of 64 failures); PLLuM fails on content across precisions (71.8-92.0% of steps parse). (3) On the arithmetic ladder the unscaffolded rung is a floor, left standing by a rerun that states the no-tool rule; four explicit calls lift the 8-bit 11B from 1/10 to 9/10 and the 7B from 0/10 to 7/10 after format-only failures with the gold value are forgiven, an exploratory effect with eight distinct baseline inputs that does not survive multiplicity correction, while the order-trap arm separates the models at 8-bit (11B 6/6, 7B 0/6). (4) The Polish-versus-English gap is associated with degradation or with task family. We document four artifacts that shaped our conclusions (rounding-hostile gold values, strict answer typing, a no-tool rule the prompt never stated, priority-ordered failure labels), report affected results in strict and corrected form, and release the benchmark, trajectories and commit-stamped artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出 PolAgentBench（波兰语提示+英语工具schema的确定性基准），研究 GGUF 量化对波兰语 agentic 工具使用的影响。三模型跨六精度测试：仅"崩塌阈值"可复现（3-bit到2-bit间骤降），失败模式不通用；并记录四个影响结论的伪影。
AI.motivation: 探究 GGUF 量化如何影响波兰语 agentic 工具使用，以及该影响是否跨模型泛化（跨模型压缩与预训练家族两个变化轴）。
AI.method: 构建 PolAgentBench：67题主套件（15对抗探针、52困难任务）+46题算术隔离阶梯；波兰语提示、英语工具schema。三模型：Bielik-11B-v3.0、其剪枝蒸馏子模型Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0（隔离压缩）、Llama-PLLuM-8B（换预训练家族）；每模型测六个精度（Q8_0至Q2_K）。
AI.result: (1)三模型均在3-bit到2-bit间崩塌(11B 0.716→0.045,7B 0.463→0.149,PLLuM 0.224→0.015,McNemar p<0.001)。(2)失败模式不复现:2-bit下7B"长失败"(中位9.1k token,4步),11B多首步臆造终答(64中37),PLLuM为内容失败(71.8–92.0%步可解析)。(3)算术阶梯:无脚手架为地板;四次显式调用使8-bit 11B从1/10→9/10、7B从0/10→7/10(探索性,未过多重校正);顺序陷阱臂8-bit区分模型(11B 6/6,7B 0/6)。(4)波兰语-英语差距与退化或任务族相关。
AI.conclusion: 仅崩塌阈值跨模型轴泛化，失败机制不泛化。记录四个塑造结论的伪影（舍入不利金值、严格答案类型、提示未述的无工具规则、优先级失败标签），以严格与校正形式报告受影响结果，并开源基准、轨迹与带提交戳的工件。

title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
summary: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).

AI.tldr: 提出 Residual Patch Adapter (RPA)，利用 ViT 中间层全部 patch token 进行 M/EEG-图像对齐，在两个数据集上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 M/EEG 视觉解码方法仅将脑信号对齐到预训练视觉编码器的单一全局嵌入，可能丢失中间 patch 表示所含的更丰富、更细粒度的视觉信息。
AI.method: RPA 是一个轻量、模块化的适配器，采用 ViT 中间层的所有 patch token 进行对齐；通过消融分析（池化/掩码 patch、CLS token）及六项定量特征分析验证设计；提供可替换为卷积、注意力或 ConvNeXt 的即插即用接口。
AI.result: THINGS-EEG2 上被试内 Top-1 95.4%、跨被试 35.5%；THINGS-MEG 上 65.2% 和 6.7%，两数据集均达 SOTA；用预训练 EEG 基础模型等替代脑编码器仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 保留全部 patch token 对 EEG 对齐很重要，CLS token 信息有限；高层语义与低层视觉特征（如颜色、纹理）均为对齐所需；研究为利用视觉编码器潜在空间确立了设计原则，推动脑-图像对齐与 BCI 发展。

title: Product-Aware Deterministic Rounding for Quantized Matrix Multiplication
summary:
Scalar rounding decisions interact through matrix multiplication. We study deterministic
  product-aware rounding after scales, clipping bounds, and grids are fixed, with each active
  scalar choosing between adjacent levels. For dynamic activation rounding, null-space
  reduction preserves the relaxed product while leaving at most $r$ fractional decisions, where
  $r$ is the rank of the active gap-weighted weight block. Conditional-expectation completion
  gives a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm with squared product error at most $
  \mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{dyn}}+rν_{\max}^2/4$, where $\mathrm{OPT}_{\mathrm{dyn}}$ is the best
  admissible error and $ν_{\max}$ is the largest row norm of that block. For reusable static
  weights, the exact expected product-loss metric is the uncentered input second moment with
  fixed output bias; free bias recalibration yields the centered covariance. Exact optimization
  is NP-hard even at rank one. In balanced blocks with $K=1024$ and $r=16$, conditional-
  expectation completion attains a dither-normalized median error of $0.010$, compared with
  $0.899$ for round-to-nearest. Clipping-aware initialization reduces median normalized error
  by a factor of $43.4$ at ten-percent clipping. Held-out Digits experiments show that
  retaining the input mean or correcting the output bias improves median product error over
  round-to-nearest in all four tested bit-width and calibration-size settings.

AI.tldr: 研究量化中标量舍入决策通过矩阵乘法相互作用的问题，提出确定性的"乘积感知"舍入方法，并给出多项式时间算法与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 传统逐标量舍入（如 round-to-nearest）忽略了矩阵乘法中各标量舍入决策之间的耦合，导致乘积误差并非最优。本文希望在尺度、裁剪边界与网格固定后，通过考虑乘积结构来降低整体量化误差。
AI.method: 1) 动态激活量化：利用零空间约简保持松弛乘积，仅保留至多 r 个分数决策（r 为活跃 gap 加权权重块的秩）；再用条件期望补全给出确定性多项式时间算法。2) 静态权重：将精确期望乘积损失刻画为未中心化输入二阶矩（固定输出偏置），自由偏置重校准则给出中心化协方差；并证明即使秩为 1 时精确优化也是 NP-hard。同时提出裁剪感知的初始化。
AI.result: 条件期望补全的平方乘积误差上界为 OPT_dyn + rν_max²/4（ν_max 为该块最大行范数）。在 K=1024、r=16 的平衡块中，抖动归一化中位误差为 0.010，而 round-to-nearest 为 0.899；10% 裁剪下裁剪感知初始化将中位归一化误差降低 43.4 倍。Held-out Digits 实验在全部四种位宽与校准规模设置下，保留输入均值或校正输出偏置均优于 round-to-nearest。
AI.conclusion: 乘积感知的确定性舍入可显著降低量化乘积误差，理论上有近似保证，实验上大幅优于传统舍入；静态权重情形下精确优化困难（NP-hard），需依赖近似与偏差校正策略。

title: Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization
summary: AI agents can now formalize entire textbooks and major theorems in proof assistants such as Lean, but current efforts are typically centralized: a single team runs all agents and bears the full computational cost. We introduce Choir, an open protocol for distributed formalization. Choir decomposes a project into tasks that can be completed by independent contributors, each running their own agent with their own LLM subscription, while coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository. To support open participation, every contribution is checked by a deterministic gate before merge. Choir supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq, and is open source and modular, allowing projects to replace individual components or extend the protocol.

AI.tldr: Choir 是一个面向形式化数学的开放分布式协议，将项目拆解为可由独立贡献者完成的子任务，各自运行自有 AI agent 并通过 GitHub 仓库协调，依靠确定性验证门控保证质量，支持 Lean 4、Isabelle 和 Rocq。
AI.motivation: 当前用 AI agent 在 Lean 等证明助手中形式化教材和定理的工作多为集中式：单一团队运行所有 agent 并承担全部算力成本，限制了可扩展性与参与度。
AI.method: 提出 Choir 协议：将形式化项目分解为可独立完成的任务；贡献者各自运行 agent（使用自己的 LLM 订阅）；全程仅通过项目 GitHub 仓库协调；每次贡献在合并前需通过确定性检查门控（deterministic gate）；协议开放源码、模块化，支持替换组件或扩展协议。
AI.result: 该工作以系统/协议形式呈现，支持 Lean 4、Isabelle 和 Rocq 三种证明助手，具备开源与模块化特性，允许项目替换单独组件或扩展协议。
AI.conclusion: Choir 通过开放协议与分布式协作，将形式化的算力成本与执行分散给独立贡献者，为大规模形式化提供了可扩展、低门槛的协作范式。

title: Reverse Sequential Proportional Approval Voting Rule: Proportionality and Approximation Guarantees
summary: We study the Reverse Sequential Proportional Approval Voting Rule (RevSeqPAV) in approval-based committee elections. Despite its historical prominence and practical use, its properties and guarantees are much less understood than those of Sequential PAV. We analyze it along two dimensions: proportional representation (measured by Extended Justified Representation, its approximations, and proportionality degree) and approximation of the maximum PAV score of instances. We first establish strong negative results for general, unrestricted election instances and then identify settings in which the rule provides meaningful fairness and optimization guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文研究逆向序列比例批准投票规则（RevSeqPAV），分析其比例代表性与对最大PAV分数的近似保证，先在一般情形给出强负面结果，再识别其具有公平与优化保证的特定场景。
AI.motivation: RevSeqPAV历史上重要且有实际应用，但其性质与保证远不如SeqPAV被理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 沿两个维度分析：比例代表性（用EJR、其近似及比例度衡量）与对实例最大PAV分数的近似。先分析一般无限制选举取得强负面结果，再寻找正结果场景。
AI.result: 在一般无限制选举实例上得到强负面结果；同时识别出一类规则能提供有意义的公平性与优化保证的场景。
AI.conclusion: RevSeqPAV整体保证有限，但在受限或特定结构下仍具备可用的比例代表性与近似保证。

title: EvoSkillRec: Skill-Genome Evolution for Recommender Architecture Discovery
summary: Modern recommender systems advance not only by scaling data and parameters, but also by encoding task-specific inductive biases through architecture, including sparse feature interactions for click-through rate (CTR) prediction, temporal attention for sequential recommendation, and expert routing for multi-task learning. However, these biases are typically human expert designed or searched within predefined operator spaces. Although Recent LLM-driven code evolution expands this space, unconstrained edits often produce invalid or ineffective architectures, underuse established architecture design knowledge, and fail to preserve successful innovations for reuse. We introduce EvoSkillRec, a promotion-and-reuse framework for cumulative recommender architecture evolution. It first decomposes recommenders into atomic executable skills and represents architectures as typed skill genomes, with each skill equipped with input--output types, semantic annotations, and implementation code. We then evolve models with different tasks through two coupled spaces: a constrained skill--space that mutates, recombines, specializes, and reuses validated skills, and an open-ended code--space in which LLM planners and synthesizers invent new skill modules using prior evolution traces and accumulated experience. An autoresearch controller evaluates candidates, diagnoses failures, retrieves relevant skills, promotes validated innovations into the skill library, and adaptively allocates the proposal budget between the two spaces. Extensive experiments on CTR prediction, multi-task learning, and multi-domain learning, including resource-constrained co-optimization of predictive quality and model FLOPs utilization in generative ranking models, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed EvoSkillRec.

AI.tldr: EvoSkillRec 提出一种"提升-复用"框架，用于推荐系统架构的累积式进化：将推荐模型分解为原子可执行技能并表示为带类型的技能基因组，在受限技能空间与开放代码空间协同进化，并通过自研控制器评估、诊断、检索与提升创新，在 CTR、多任务、多域学习等任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统的任务特定归纳偏置多靠人工设计或在预定义算子空间内搜索；LLM 驱动的代码进化虽扩展了空间，但无约束编辑常产生无效或低效架构，未充分利用已有架构设计知识，也无法保留并复用成功创新。
AI.method: 提出 EvoSkillRec：1) 将推荐模型分解为原子可执行技能，架构表示为带类型的技能基因组（含输入-输出类型、语义标注、实现代码）；2) 在耦合的双空间中进化：受限技能空间对已验证技能进行变异、重组、特化与复用，开放代码空间由 LLM 规划器与合成器利用历史进化轨迹与经验发明新技能模块；3) 自动研究控制器评估候选、诊断失败、检索相关技能、将验证过的创新提升进技能库，并自适应在两个空间间分配提议预算。
AI.result: 在 CTR 预测、多任务学习和多域学习等任务上的大量实验（包括生成式排序模型中预测质量与模型 FLOPs 利用率的资源受限协同优化）一致表明 EvoSkillRec 有效。
AI.conclusion: EvoSkillRec 通过技能化表示与双空间协同进化、创新的自动提升与复用机制，实现了累积式的推荐架构进化，克服了无约束 LLM 代码编辑的局限。

title: JET: Judge-Guided Evolution at Test Time for Agent Programs
summary: An agent's executable program governs how it uses tools, processes observations, and responds to failures. Evolving this program at test time can help adaptation, but deciding which changes to retain is difficult when true rewards are unavailable. Execution traces provide evidence of agent behavior, yet interpreting that evidence requires a judge that remains useful as tasks and candidate programs change. We introduce Judge-Guided Evolution at Test Time (JET), which evolves an executable judge on labeled source trajectories, then freezes and transfers it to guide target-side program evolution. The judge supplies scores and diagnostic feedback without target evaluator access or model-weight updates. On unseen WebShop tasks, JET achieves approximately 13% higher mean reward than fixed-rubric guidance when evolution begins from an unevolved program (cold start) and 4% higher when it begins from one already optimized on source tasks (warm start), with a 36% relative improvement in cold-start exact success. An exact-judge control on PushT, where the judge reconstructs the scoring rule from observations, shows that without judge error, program search becomes the bottleneck. Analyses identify useful reward-prediction logic in the evolved code and show that better final selection alone cannot explain the gains. These results support executable judge transfer for program adaptation under evaluator-preserving task shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出JET方法：在源任务上进化可执行评判器，冻结后迁移到目标任务指导程序进化，无需目标评测器或模型权重更新。
AI.motivation: 测试时进化智能体程序可助适应，但真值奖励不可得时难以决定保留哪些改动；执行轨迹需评判器解读，且评判器须随任务与候选程序变化而保持有效。
AI.method: 在有标注的源轨迹上进化出可执行评判器，随后冻结并迁移到目标侧，为程序进化提供分数与诊断反馈，不使用目标评测器、不更新模型权重。
AI.result: 未见WebShop任务上，冷启动平均奖励较固定评分标准引导高约13%、热启动高4%，冷启动精确成功率相对提升36%；PushT上用精确评判器对照显示，无评判误差时程序搜索成为瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 进化代码中含有效奖励预测逻辑，且增益不能仅由最终选择更好解释；支持在保持评测器不变的任务偏移下用可执行评判器迁移实现程序适应。

title: mu-bench: A Multilingual Utterance Transcription Benchmark
comment: 5 pages, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sierra-research/mu-bench . Code: https://github.com/sierra-research/mu-bench/tree/icassp-2027 . Leaderboard: https://research.sierra.ai/mubench/
summary: Voice agents depend on accurate automatic speech recognition (ASR) to act on what callers say, yet ASR is evaluated on read, English-centric speech with word error rate (WER), which penalizes surface rather than semantic differences. We introduce mu-bench, a dataset of 4,270 caller utterances from 250 phone calls to an AI banking agent in English, Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Mandarin, centered on form-field inputs such as names, email addresses, and confirmation codes. We release Utterance Error Rate (UER), an LLM judge of whether a transcript preserves meaning, calibrated against human raters, together with an LLM normalizer that makes WER comparable across providers' output formats. On 1,847 human-rated transcripts, UER agrees with annotators at $κ$ = 0.78, versus 0.53 for exact-match WER on normalized text. We rank six commercial providers on a public leaderboard; the best reaches 11.9% UER, and Mandarin is hardest for all six.

AI.tldr: 提出 mu-bench 数据集与 Utterance Error Rate (UER) 指标,用于评估语音代理 ASR 的语义准确性;UER 与人工标注一致度(κ=0.78)显著优于 WER,并公开六家商业供应商排行榜。
AI.motivation: 现有 ASR 评估依赖朗读式、英语中心的语音数据和 WER 指标,惩罚表层差异而非语义差异,无法反映语音代理在真实场景中对姓名、邮箱、验证码等表单输入的理解能力。
AI.method: 构建 mu-bench:来自 250 通 AI 银行代理电话的 4,270 条用户话语,涵盖英语、西班牙语、土耳其语、越南语、普通话,聚焦表单字段输入。提出 UER(基于 LLM 判断转录是否保留语义,并以人工评分校准)及 LLM 归一化器,使跨供应商输出格式的 WER 可比。
AI.result: 在 1,847 条人工评分转录上,UER 与标注者一致度 κ=0.78,而归一化文本上的精确匹配 WER 仅为 0.53。对六家商业供应商排名(公开排行榜),最佳者 UER 为 11.9%,普通话对六家均为最难。
AI.conclusion: UER 与 mu-bench 为语音代理 ASR 提供了更贴合语义的评估范式,揭示多语言真实场景下的性能差距,尤其普通话是普遍瓶颈。

title: Modernising the Compressed-Domain Video Captioner: A Controlled Study of SigLIP2 and GPT-2 Substitutions
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code, configurations and the exact commit for every run: https://github.com/nepalashim/compressed-video-captioning-ablation-cocap-siglip2-gpt2
summary:
Compressed-domain video captioning avoids full video decoding by operating directly on I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, trading a small amount of accuracy for a large gain in inference speed. CoCap established this pipeline using a CLIP vision encoder and a shallow BERT-style multimodal decoder. Both components predate substantially stronger alternatives. We ask a narrow, controlled question: how much of CoCap's accuracy is limited by these two components, and which of the two is the binding constraint?
  We replace the CLIP I-frame encoder with SigLIP2 and the BERT-style decoder with GPT-2, and evaluate three configurations (the original pairing, the encoder substitution alone, and both substitutions together) under identical data, sampling budget and optimisation schedule. All comparisons are made against our own reproduction of CoCap rather than its published numbers, because we train on a 4,999-clip subset of VATEX at a reduced sampling budget; absolute values are therefore not comparable with the original work.
  Our reproduction tracks the published result closely: CIDEr and METEOR run slightly above it (54.9 against 52.7; 23.4 against 23.2), BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L slightly below (29.7 against 31.4; 48.9 against 49.4). We attribute the differences to our evaluation subset rather than to any improvement in either direction. We find the two substitutions pull in opposite directions: SigLIP2 alone improves every metric (+4.5 CIDEr), while adding GPT-2 on top erodes that gain, because a pretrained decoder overfits 4,999 clips within two epochs. We additionally report inference latency for each configuration, since speed is the property that motivates compressed-domain captioning in the first place, and an accuracy gain purchased at a latency cost should be reported as such.

AI.tldr: 本文以受控实验探究 CoCap 压缩域视频描述模型的两个组件（CLIP I 帧编码器与 BERT 式解码器）对精度的限制程度，尝试用 SigLIP2 和 GPT-2 替换，发现 SigLIP2 单独替换提升所有指标，但加入 GPT-2 后因过拟合反而侵蚀增益。
AI.motivation: CoCap 的压缩域视频描述流程依赖 CLIP 编码器与浅层 BERT 式解码器，二者均已过时。作者希望回答一个受控问题：CoCap 的精度有多少受限于这两个组件，其中哪一个才是瓶颈。
AI.method: 将 CLIP I 帧编码器替换为 SigLIP2，将 BERT 式解码器替换为 GPT-2，在相同数据、采样预算和优化计划下评估三种配置（原始配对、仅换编码器、两者同换）；全部对比基于作者自己对 CoCap 的复现，使用 VATEX 的 4,999 片段子集和缩减采样预算训练。
AI.result: 复现结果与原文接近：CIDEr 54.9（原文 52.7）、METEOR 23.4（原 23.2）略高，BLEU-4 29.7（原 31.4）、ROUGE-L 48.9（原 49.4）略低。两项替换方向相反：单独 SigLIP2 提升所有指标（CIDEr +4.5），再叠加 GPT-2 后增益被侵蚀，因预训练解码器在两个 epoch 内过拟合 4,999 片段。还报告了各配置的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 编码器而非解码器是当前更紧的约束：升级 I 帧编码器可稳定提升精度，而更强的预训练解码器在数据量有限时反而有害。同时，鉴于速度是压缩域描述的核心动机，任何以延迟代价换来的精度增益都应如实报告。

title: Information Design Against Gaming and Learning Adversaries
summary: A principal who deploys a binary classifier with an abstention option must decide which queries the mechanism abstains on. The right choice depends on the adversary. A gaming adversary already knows the classifier and tries to manipulate features across the boundary, so the principal does best by abstaining on queries close to that boundary. The same boundary-localizing rule is the worst possible choice against a learning adversary who does not know the classifier: each abstention now tells the adversary that the boundary is nearby, which is enough to drive a binary search. We analyze this tension. The two natural defenses, abstaining at a fixed rate and abstaining near the boundary, are Blackwell-incomparable: neither can be simulated by post-processing the other's responses. The number of queries needed to reconstruct the boundary to error $\eps$ is $\tildeΘ(d/\eps)$ under the first defense and $Θ(d \log(1/\eps))$ under the second, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the classifier family and $\tildeΘ$ suppresses factors polylogarithmic in $d$ and $1/\eps$. The first rate is a worst case over query distributions; no reconstruction algorithm can close the gap at the distributions that attain it. We characterize the Pareto frontier between the two defense objectives, and confirm both rates on seven binary-classification tasks spanning tabular, image, and language-model-feature inputs: label-plus-counterfactual access extracts the boundary with up to $200\times$ fewer queries than a published label-only baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文分析二元分类器弃权策略在对抗性操纵与学习性攻击之间的张力，证明固定弃权率与边界附近弃权两种防御Blackwell不可比，并给出边界重构查询复杂度及Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 部署带弃权选项的二元分类器时，弃权查询的选择取决于对手类型：游戏型对手已知分类器并试图越界操纵特征，宜在边界附近弃权；学习型对手不知分类器，每次弃权泄漏边界邻近信息，同样规则反而最差。
AI.method: 理论分析两种自然防御（固定弃权率、边界附近弃权）的可比性与查询复杂度；刻画两种防御目标间的Pareto前沿；在7个二元分类任务（表格、图像、语言模型特征）上验证。
AI.result: 两防御Blackwell不可比；误差ε重构边界所需查询数：固定率防御Î(d/ε)，边界防御Θ(d log(1/ε))，d为VC维；前者为查询分布最坏情况且在该分布上无法缩小差距；标签加反事实访问比公开的仅标签基线少用最多200倍查询。
AI.conclusion: 弃权策略设计需权衡对手类型，不存在普适最优；边界附近弃权利于游戏型对手但有害于学习型对手，固定弃权率在特定分布下达到最坏情况下界，Pareto前沿刻画了两目标的权衡。

title: EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks
summary: Enterprise email agents must combine information retrieval, structured state changes, temporal reasoning, and multi-step coordination. Recent agent benchmarks include productivity tasks, but few center on typed email workflows in a self-contained environment. We introduce EmailBench, a benchmark of 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories. The benchmark couples a typed email API specification with provider-neutral naming, a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus, and a scenario suite whose topic selection was informed by aggregate task-intent telemetry from an interactive prototype. Its hybrid evaluation protocol combines 258 executable static assertions with 211 LLM rubrics. We evaluate eight LM configurations on a fixed single-user corpus. The best-performing configuration passes only 33.5% of scenarios despite 99.7% of its tool calls completing without an observed API failure, with pass rates varying substantially across task categories. This gap shows that valid tool execution is not equivalent to task completion. EmailBench provides a self-contained environment for end-to-end email-agent evaluation, with broader tool coverage, multi-persona testing, and repeated-run evaluation as future work areas.

AI.tldr: 提出 EmailBench，一个包含 206 个邮件与生产力场景、16 类任务的智能体基准，评估邮件智能体的检索、状态修改、时序推理与多步协调能力。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准少有聚焦于自包含环境中的类型化邮件工作流，缺乏端到端的邮件智能体评测环境。
AI.method: 结合类型化邮件 API 规范（供应商中立命名）、确定性合成 Enron 风格语料库，以及基于交互原型任务意图遥测设计的场景套件；采用混合评估协议，融合 258 条可执行静态断言与 211 条 LLM 评分规则。
AI.result: 在固定单用户语料上评估 8 种 LM 配置，最佳配置仅通过 33.5% 场景，而 99.7% 的工具调用无 API 失败；各类任务通过率差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 有效的工具执行不等于任务完成；EmailBench 提供了自包含的端到端邮件智能体评测环境，未来将扩展工具覆盖、多人设测试与重复运行评估。

title: Online Resource Allocation with Replenishable Budgets
summary: Online Resource Allocation (ORA) is a fundamental framework for sequential decision-making problems under budget constraints. Classical ORA models typically assume that resources are monotonic, meaning that selecting actions can only decrease the available budget. In this work, we study a more general setting with replenishable budgets, in which actions may either consume or replenish resources over time. This extension is necessary to capture scenarios such as inventory systems or energy markets in which capacity can be actively recovered. We develop a dual-based algorithm that recovers best-of-both-worlds guarantees for standard ORA when the replenishment factor $β= 0$, and improves them when $β> 0$. In particular, our algorithm attains $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret in the stochastic setting and $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{T})$ $α$-regret in the adversarial setting, where $α$ depends on the per-round budget and on the replenishment factor of the void action. Moreover, the algorithm ensures strict satisfaction of the budget constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文将在线资源配置(ORA)推广到可补充预算场景，提出基于对偶的算法，在随机与对抗环境下均达到近优遗憾并严格满足预算约束。
AI.motivation: 经典ORA假设资源单调递减，无法刻画库存系统、能源市场等容量可恢复的场景，因此需要研究预算可消费也可补充的更一般设定。
AI.method: 提出基于对偶(dual-based)的算法，引入补充因子β。当β=0时恢复标准ORA的最优双世界保证，β>0时进一步改进；算法使用void action的补充特性。
AI.result: 随机环境下达到Õ(√T)遗憾；对抗环境下达到Õ(√T)的α-遗憾，α取决于每轮预算与void action的补充因子；同时严格满足预算约束。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将ORA扩展到可补充预算，统一并改进了标准情形下的保证，为库存、能源等可恢复资源场景提供了理论支撑。

title: No Attention, No Problem: Rethinking Session-based Recommendation with Pure Convolution
summary: Session-based recommendation (SBR) predicts the next choice in a session by analyzing recent interactions. Transformer-based models are widely used because of their ability to capture long-range dependencies through self-attention mechanisms. In contrast, traditional convolutional models, although more efficient, are often limited by their weak global modeling capabilities and are losing ground in SBR tasks. In this work, we propose a Next-generation Pure Convolutional Framework (NextConvRec) for SBR tasks, aiming to balance efficiency and performance. NextConvRec uses a Structural and Positional Convolutional Encoder (SPCE) for preprocessing, combining learnable convolutional positional biases with session-level structural signals extracted through GCN layers. Its backbone convolutional module effectively expands the effective receptive field through depthwise convolutions and pointwise convolutions, enabling robust long-range preference modeling without attention mechanisms. Extensive experiments on 4 benchmark datasets show that NextConvRec outperforms several state-of-the-art baselines by around 1.73% on average, and reduces the average inference time per session by 16.7%. The convolutional architectures remain a promising direction for efficient and accurate session-based recommendations.

AI.tldr: 提出纯卷积框架NextConvRec用于会话推荐，平衡效率与性能。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型虽能捕捉长程依赖但效率低，传统卷积模型效率高但全局建模能力弱，需兼顾效率与性能。
AI.method: 采用结构位置卷积编码器(SPCE)预处理，结合可学习卷积位置偏置与GCN提取的会话结构信号；主干用深度卷积和逐点卷积扩大有效感受野，无需注意力机制实现长程偏好建模。
AI.result: 在4个基准数据集上平均超越多个SOTA基线约1.73%，每会话平均推理时间减少16.7%。
AI.conclusion: 卷积架构仍是高效准确会话推荐的有前景方向。

title: The Construction of an Empirical Dataset of Incomplete Software Changes from Open Source Projects
summary: During software development, a modification to a software component may propagate across the system, requiring precise identification and correct revision of all affected components. This is a complex task, and developers often (45.7%) miss related changes. To address this, several methods have been developed to extract co-change rules from files that are frequently changed together in the revision history. However, previous research evaluated the methods using artificially created incomplete changes, which may not be representative of real-world data. To solve this problem, we construct a dataset by mining incomplete changes from a collection of open-source software, using information about induced bugs and their respective fixes from an issue tracking platform. We also analyze the characteristics of incomplete changes using this constructed dataset and found that 89.4% of missed changes involved five or fewer files. Finally, we re-evaluate LCExtractor, an existing co-change rule extraction method, on our constructed dataset, and we identify the optimal sorting criterion and the impact of the number of used commits.

AI.tldr: 本文针对软件修改遗漏问题，构建了基于真实开源项目缺陷修复的不完整变更数据集，并重新评估现有共变更规则提取方法。
AI.motivation: 开发中45.7%的开发者会遗漏相关变更，而以往评估共变更规则提取方法时使用的是人工构造的不完整变更，可能无法代表真实世界数据。
AI.method: 利用问题跟踪平台中诱发缺陷及其修复信息，从开源软件集合中挖掘不完整变更，构建数据集，并分析其特性，最后在数据集上重新评估LCExtractor方法。
AI.result: 89.4%的遗漏变更涉及五个或更少的文件；识别出最优排序准则以及使用提交数量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 真实数据集能更准确评估共变更规则提取方法，并为改进此类方法提供依据。

title: Using LMs to Model the Effects of Context and Coreference during Sentence Comprehension
summary: Language models (LMs) are often used as a tool to model human language processing. Recent studies suggest that severely restricting LMs' context window improves their fit to human psycholinguistic data by simulating human working memory constraints. However, it is possible that this strict memory-decay approach overlooks humans' reliance on long-range structural representations, such as discourse structre. In this work, we systematically vary the context window size of GPT-2 across four large-scale naturalistic English reading-time datasets and observe a U-shaped relationship: Although restricted contexts (< 20 tokens) successfully capture local memory limitations, expanded contexts (500--1,000 tokens) ultimately yield the highest overall psycholinguistic fit. To investigate the mechanism driving this benefit, we conduct a counterfactual inference-time experiment that disrupts cross-sentential entity chains by pronominalizing repeated discourse entities. Obscuring these structural linkages significantly degrades the predictive power of larger context windows by 20% to 40%. Our experiments demonstrate that tracking long-range coreference relations is one important factor for the alignment between LM surprisal and human reading behavior, and approximate the extent to which human comprehenders use global discourse relations during language processing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统改变GPT-2上下文窗口大小，跨越四个大型英语阅读时间数据集，发现其与心理语言学拟合度呈U形关系；扩展上下文（500-1000词）整体拟合最佳，通过破坏跨句实体链实验证明长距离指代关系是关键机制。
AI.motivation: 近期研究认为严格限制语言模型上下文窗口能通过模拟人类工作记忆约束改善其与心理语言学数据的拟合，但该记忆衰减思路可能忽视人类对长距离结构表征（如篇章结构）的依赖。本文旨在检验长距离结构表征在人类语言处理中的作用。
AI.method: 在四个大规模自然主义英语阅读时间数据集上系统变化GPT-2的上下文窗口大小；并开展反事实推理时实验，通过将重复的篇章实体代词化来破坏跨句实体链。
AI.result: 上下文窗口与心理语言学拟合呈U形关系：受限上下文（<20词）能捕捉局部记忆限制，但扩展上下文（500-1000词）整体拟合最佳。代词化破坏结构联结后，大上下文窗口的预测能力显著下降20%-40%。
AI.conclusion: 追踪长距离共指关系是语言模型惊讶度与人类阅读行为对齐的重要因素，并近似估计了人类理解者使用全局篇章关系的程度。

title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework Designed on Hybrid Optimization Strategies for Automated Health Detection and Analysis in Silkworms
summary: A Hybrid Residual Attention Network is proposed for accurately classifying silkworm images into six different classes, including healthy and diseased states. It uses residual blocks for deep feature extraction and attention to focus on disease related features. A novel Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer was introduced to enhance convergence and improve training efficiency. The dataset of silkworm images underwent preprocessing techniques such as normalization, resizing, and noise reduction, along with augmentation strategies to improve data quality and diversity. It is optimized using IAMO, achieved an accuracy of 98.67%.The integration of spatial and channel wise attention mechanisms, coupled with IAMO, significantly enhanced the model ability to recognize subtle differences between classes. Results indicate that HRAN can be used to detect disease at an early stage in sericulture, and future work will enhance scalability and efficiency in different environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合残差注意力网络(HRAN)用于蚕图像六分类，并引入集成自适应动量优化器(IAMO)，准确率达98.67%。
AI.motivation: 蚕业中疾病早期检测对生产至关重要，需要准确区分健康与患病蚕的细微特征差异，同时提升训练收敛效率。
AI.method: 采用残差块进行深层特征提取，融合空间与通道注意力机制聚焦疾病相关特征；并提出集成自适应动量优化器(IAMO)提升收敛与训练效率。数据经归一化、缩放、降噪及增强处理。
AI.result: 在蚕图像六类分类任务上，使用IAMO优化后准确率达到98.67%。
AI.conclusion: HRAN可用于蚕业疾病的早期检测，未来将提升模型在不同环境下的可扩展性与效率。

title: MaD-RL: Matching Distributions for Calibrating LLMs with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used in language-model post-training to maximize rewards assigned to individual model outputs, such as scores from binary verifiers or reward models trained on human feedback. However, applications such as synthetic-data generation, fairness-related constraint satisfaction, and policy exploration require controlling the distribution of outputs across model generations rather than only maximizing expected reward. We propose a general RL-based framework for \textit{Distribution Matching} allowing matching the distribution of a latent categorical attribute of model outputs to a specified target distribution. Empirically, we demonstrate that dominant post-training recipes such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) reduce output diversity by concentrating policy probability towards a single mode. Entropy regularization and sampling temperature can improve the spread of the distribution but have constrained effectiveness, limited to apply only in token space and toward uniform distributions. We show that prior work in this area is a specific case of Distribution Matching involving the $L_2$ divergence. We then propose reward functions for other divergences such as KL and Jensen-Shannon and motivate them with theoretical justification. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on a set of experiments involving mathematical reasoning and programming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于强化学习的分布匹配（Distribution Matching）框架，可将模型输出中潜类别属性的分布匹配到指定目标分布，并通过KL、JS等散度奖励函数在数学推理与编程任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有RL后训练（如GRPO）通常只优化单个输出的期望奖励，导致输出多样性下降、分布坍缩到单一模式；而合成数据生成、公平性约束、策略探索等场景需要控制输出的分布而非仅最大化奖励。熵正则与采样温度只能在token空间、趋向均匀分布，效果受限。
AI.method: 提出通用的RL分布匹配框架：为输出潜类别属性设计奖励函数，使其分布逼近目标分布。证明已有工作是该框架下L2散度的特例，并进一步提出KL和Jensen-Shannon散度的奖励函数，给出理论依据。
AI.result: 实验表明GRPO等主流后训练方法会降低输出多样性；熵正则与温度调节改善有限；所提基于KL、JS散度的分布匹配奖励函数在数学推理与编程任务上有效。
AI.conclusion: 分布匹配为需要控制输出分布的RL后训练提供了通用且有效的框架，优于仅靠熵正则或温度调节的现有做法。

title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.

AI.tldr: 提出MedCode框架，通过训练LLM生成嵌入式可执行代码来完成医学计算任务，并引入wDPO，在多个模型上实现20-30个百分点的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: LLM在医学考试和问答基准上表现良好，但在需要精确数值输出的医学计算任务（如药物剂量、器官功能评估、预后评分）上仍不可靠，而这类计算事关高风险临床决策，小错误也会造成严重后果。
AI.method: MedCode让模型根据临床上下文识别相关计算器、抽取输入变量并生成脚本，将算术运算委托给确定性解释器执行，返回计算结果、解释及单位。基于MedCalc基准构建SFT和偏好数据集，并额外构建ICU计算任务数据集；提出加权DPO（wDPO），自适应强调模型难以区分的偏好对。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B上实验，绝对准确率提升20–30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入式代码生成对医学计算任务有效，能显著提升LLM在精确数值计算场景下的可靠性。

title: Binary $k$-Center under a Hard Threshold with Applications to Delegated Voting
summary: We study the problem of covering binary strings of the same length, possibly with missing entries, by a fixed number of center strings, such that each input string is within a given relative distance of the closest center. The problem has applications in binary $k$-center clustering and bioinformatics, but our main motivation comes from computational social choice. In the setting of multi-issue approval voting, we consider an algorithmic question that precedes any election: how should representatives be designed so that as many voters as possible are willing to delegate? We study the problem in two dimensions, namely the number of centers and the agreement threshold, parameters that are application-specific, and provide a complete picture of its computational complexity when entries may be missing. For the special case without missing entries, we extend our hardness results to any number of centers and large values of threshold, leaving a narrow range of thresholds unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文将多议题批准投票中的代表设计问题建模为用固定数量的中心串覆盖允许缺失项的二元串，并在中心数与一致阈值两个维度上给出完整复杂性刻画。
AI.motivation: 该问题源于计算社会选择：在选举前，如何设计代表（中心串）使尽可能多的选民愿意委托，同时问题也关联二元k中心聚类与生物信息学。
AI.method: 以固定数量中心串覆盖同长二元串，允许缺失项，要求每个输入串与最近中心的相对距离不超过阈值；围绕中心数量和一致阈值两个参数分析计算复杂性，并对无缺失项情形扩展硬度结果。
AI.result: 在允许缺失项时，对中心数量和阈值给出了完整的计算复杂性图景；在无缺失项的特例中，将硬度结果扩展到任意中心数量和较大的阈值，仅留下一个较窄的阈值范围未解决。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统刻画了代表设计/中心覆盖问题的复杂性边界，主要未决问题是无缺失项情形下狭窄阈值区间的复杂性。

title: ColNanoVDR: Document-Free Query Distillation for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval via Optimal Transport
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/Ryenhails/NanoVDR ; Models: https://huggingface.co/nanovdr
summary: Multi-vector retrievers built on vision-language models lead visual document retrieval (VDR), but they run a multi-billion-parameter query encoder on every search. Distilling this encoder into a small student that queries the teacher's existing index would remove the bottleneck. The standard recipe, however, matches the teacher's MaxSim scores and so requires encoding and caching every training page, which can reach terabytes of page tokens. NanoVDR avoids pages entirely by training on the teacher's query embeddings alone, but only for single-vector retrievers. We present ColNanoVDR, to our knowledge the first framework to bring this document-free distillation to multi-vector VDR. Its objective, OTW (Optimal Transport with Learned Weights), aligns the student's query tokens with the teacher's by entropic optimal transport, with a learned weight for each student token, and needs no correspondence between the two tokenizations. We prove that the resulting alignment cost bounds the MaxSim score difference on every page. Distilled from five state-of-the-art teachers, the 149M text-only students retain about 95% of their teachers' NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1-v3 while encoding queries up to 26x faster. Under identical training, OTW matches score distillation while encoding no page and reading 12.6x less cached teacher data.

AI.tldr: ColNanoVDR首次实现多向量VDR的无文档蒸馏，用OTW目标对齐查询token，无需页面数据即可蒸馏学生模型。
AI.motivation: 多向量检索器依赖数十亿参数的查询编码器，推理成本高。标准蒸馏需缓存海量页面token（可达TB级），而现有无文档方法仅支持单向量检索。
AI.method: 提出OTW目标（Optimal Transport with Learned Weights），通过熵最优传输对齐学生与教师查询token，为每个学生token学习权重，无需两种tokenization间的对应关系，并证明其对齐代价界定了每页MaxSim分数差。
AI.result: 从五个SOTA教师蒸馏的149M纯文本学生在ViDoRe v1-v3上保留约95% NDCG@5，查询编码提速最高26倍；相同训练下OTW匹配分数蒸馏效果，且不编码页面、读取缓存教师数据少12.6倍。
AI.conclusion: ColNanoVDR是首个将无文档蒸馏引入多向量VDR的框架，显著降低训练与推理成本，同时保持检索性能。

title: The Last Mile Is the File: OfficeEditBench for Preservation-Aware Office Editing
summary: A small Office edit creates two obligations: propagate every required update and leave protected state untouched. Updating too little leaves dependencies inconsistent; updating too much changes content the user did not authorize. We introduce OfficeEditBench, a 170-task benchmark for change-scoped maintenance of spreadsheets, presentations, and documents. Task contracts specify required updates, protected state, native structures, and applicable interaction requirements. Across 510 archived task-system outcomes from WorkBuddy, Doubao, and Codex, we distinguish file delivery, target completion, and verifier-defined acceptance. Hard package-valid delivery ranges from 92% to 100%, yet no selected output satisfies the complete contract. Case analysis highlights why local correctness is insufficient: an updated value can lose its generating formula, a revised rule can fail to reach related conclusions, and a new deadline can omit a retained prerequisite. These mechanisms connect artifact-level checks to the continued maintainability of Office files. We analyze maintenance failures while distinguishing frozen automatic verdicts from human acceptability. OfficeEditBench provides a testbed for completing required changes while preserving the logic and scope of existing work.

AI.tldr: 提出 OfficeEditBench 基准（170 个任务），用于评估 Office 文件（表格/演示/文档）中"变更范围维护"能力：既传播所有必需更新，又不破坏受保护状态。测试 510 个来自三大系统的结果，发现包级别交付成功率高（92%–100%），但无一满足完整契约。
AI.motivation: 小型 Office 编辑会产生双重义务：传播所有必要的更新，同时保持受保护状态不变。更新过少会导致依赖关系不一致；更新过多则会改动用户未授权的内容。现有评估难以刻画这种"局部正确但整体不足"的问题。
AI.method: 构建 OfficeEditBench：170 个任务，覆盖表格、演示与文档。任务契约明确指定必需更新、受保护状态、原生结构与交互要求。收集 WorkBuddy、Doubao、Codex 共 510 个归档任务-系统结果，并从三个层面区分评估：文件交付、目标完成、验证器定义的验收。
AI.result: 硬性可打开的有效交付率为 92%–100%，但没有一个选定输出满足完整契约。案例分析揭示了局部正确为何不足：更新后的数值可能丢失生成公式；修订的规则无法传导至相关结论；新增截止日期可能遗漏保留下来的前提条件。
AI.conclusion: 这些机制将制品级检查与 Office 文件的持续可维护性联系起来。论文在区分"冻结的自动判定"与"人类可接受性"的基础上分析维护失败。OfficeEditBench 为在保留既有工作逻辑与范围的前提下完成变更提供了测试平台。

title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
comment: 25 pages, 8 tables. Corpus: 28 arXiv papers (19-24 September 2026); arXiv versions listed in Appendix A. Ancillary file: per-paper corpus sheet (versions and headline results)
summary: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent accuracy advantage over comparable label-probability readouts. Jev's clearest gains are in latency and cost, while accuracy gaps remain on harder tasks. In practical deployments, confidence is often used to decide when to defer to a stronger model or a human. We use recurring weaknesses in these studies to derive a 14-item evaluation checklist for future TDM work. Because the evidence covers only the first nine days after the release of one hosted model, the review should be read as an early evidence map rather than a settled assessment of the model class.

AI.tldr: 综述Jev发布后9天内的28篇论文，发现类型化读出未显示独立精度优势，主要优势在延迟和成本。
AI.motivation: TypeSafe于2026年9月发布商用类型化决策模型Jev，短期内出现大量评估与复现工作，需要及时梳理早期证据。
AI.method: 回顾2026年9月19日至24日发布的28篇论文，并将其发现与标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、校准和模型级联等早期工作关联。
AI.result: 类型化读出本身未显示出相对可比标签概率读出的独立精度优势；Jev最明显的增益在延迟和成本，但较难任务上仍存在精度差距。
AI.conclusion: 基于这些研究的共性弱点，提出面向未来TDM工作的14项评估清单；由于证据仅覆盖单一托管模型发布后9天，应将其视为早期证据地图而非定论。

title: CLC-YOLO: A Compact Channel-Gated Prototype Network for Real-Time Leakage-Aware Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
summary: Reliable breast ultrasound lesion segmentation requires accurate boundaries and evaluation that prevents patients or duplicate images from crossing data splits. We propose Channel Local Contrast (CLC), a compact refinement of the YOLO26 segmentation prototype head. CLC adds a fixed local high-pass residual controlled by 64 zero-initialized, bounded channel gates. Baseline and CLC were compared in five matched folds on each of four breast ultrasound datasets. BUS-BRA used patient-disjoint outer tests with separate inner validation. BUS-UCLM and BrEaST used patient-grouped validation folds; BUSI used duplicate-component groups because patient identifiers are unavailable. Group-macro Dice increased by 1.68, 3.11, 1.12, and 2.45 percentage points on BUS-BRA, BUS-UCLM, BUSI, and BrEaST, respectively. Only the BUS-BRA paired 95% confidence interval excluded zero. CLC adds 64 parameters and 0.0049 giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs). At 640 pixels, single-T4, batch-one, 16-bit floating-point (FP16) TensorRT graph times were 2.1478 ms for CLC and 2.0512 ms for baseline, excluding preprocessing and postprocessing. CLC increased group-macro Dice across all four datasets with a measured T4 forward-pass overhead of 0.0966 ms. Code: https://github.com/mfazrinizar/CLC-YOLO

AI.tldr: 提出 Channel Local Contrast (CLC)，在 YOLO26 分割头加入 64 个零初始化有界通道门控的固定高通残差，四个乳腺超声数据集的 group-macro Dice 均提升，但仅 BUS-BRA 的置信区间不含零。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声病灶分割需要准确边界，且评估时必须避免患者或重复图像跨越数据划分，现有评估常忽视分组泄漏问题。
AI.method: CLC 对 YOLO26 分割原型头做紧凑改进，加入由 64 个零初始化、有界通道门控控制的固定局部高通残差。在四个数据集（BUS-BRA、BUS-UCLM、BUSI、BrEaST）上做五折匹配对比，分别采用患者不交叉外部测试、患者分组验证折，以及因缺少患者标识而使用重复组分组的折。
AI.result: group-macro Dice 在 BUS-BRA、BUS-UCLM、BUSI、BrEaST 上分别提升 1.68、3.11、1.12、2.45 个百分点，仅 BUS-BRA 配对 95% 置信区间不含零。CLC 仅增加 64 参数和 0.0049 GFLOPs；640 像素、单 T4、batch-one、FP16 TensorRT 图耗时 2.1478 ms（基线 2.0512 ms），前向开销 0.0966 ms。
AI.conclusion: CLC 在四个数据集上均提高 group-macro Dice，开销极小（0.0966 ms），但统计显著性仅在 BUS-BRA 上成立，代码已公开。

title: STAR: Adaptive Spatial-Temporal Normalization for Unified Microservice Incident Management
summary: Automated incident management in large-scale microservice systems relies on learning robust representations from multimodal observability data, including metrics, logs, and traces. Although recent self-supervised frameworks enable unified modeling for anomaly detection (AD), failure triage (FT), and root cause localization (RCL), they often struggle with non-stationary temporal dynamics and heterogeneous service dependency structures. In this paper, we propose STAR, a Spatial-Temporal Adaptive Representation learning framework that explicitly addresses these challenges through adaptive normalizations. STAR introduces two tightly coupled mechanisms: Temporal Adaptive Normalization (TAN), which dynamically normalizes multivariate time series using multi-scale temporal context, and Spatial Adaptive Normalization (SAN), which performs structure-aware normalization over service dependency graphs. Unlike prior methods that treat normalization as static or task-agnostic, STAR formulates it as a learnable, context-conditioned transformation aligned with the intrinsic properties of microservice systems. The resulting adaptive representations are integrated into a unified self-supervised framework, enabling end-to-end unsupervised support for AD, FT, and RCL tasks. Extensive experiments on two real-world microservice benchmarks demonstrate that STAR consistently outperforms all state-of-the-art baselines, yielding significant and stable improvements across all three tasks. Our results highlight adaptive normalization as a principled and effective mechanism for robust multimodal representation learning in complex software systems.

AI.tldr: STAR：一种空间-时间自适应表示学习框架，通过自适应归一化应对微服务系统中的非平稳时序动态和异构服务依赖结构，统一支持异常检测、故障分诊和根因定位。
AI.motivation: 大规模微服务系统的自动化事件管理依赖多模态可观测数据（指标、日志、追踪）的鲁棒表示学习。现有自监督框架虽能统一建模AD、FT、RCL，但难以处理非平稳时序动态和异构服务依赖结构。
AI.method: 提出STAR框架，包含两个紧密耦合机制：时间自适应归一化（TAN），利用多尺度时间上下文动态归一化多变量时间序列；空间自适应归一化（SAN），在服务依赖图上进行结构感知归一化。将归一化建模为可学习、上下文条件化的变换，并整合进统一自监督框架，端到端无监督支持AD、FT、RCL三项任务。
AI.result: 在两个真实微服务基准上，STAR持续优于所有最先进基线，在三项任务上均取得显著且稳定的提升。
AI.conclusion: 自适应归一化是复杂软件系统中鲁棒多模态表示学习的一种有原则且有效的机制。

title: BioDyad: Synchronize Biomedical Discovery and Machine Learning Engineering
summary: Agentic biomedical machine learning (ML) draws on complementary advances in biomedical evidence acquisition and executable program search. Existing systems connect aspects of these capabilities, but coordinating them throughout program search remains challenging. New evidence must guide candidate construction, execution outcomes must inform subsequent discovery and reuse, and validation demands must fit the search budget. We introduce BioDyad, which couples biomedical discovery and ML engineering through two hierarchies within Monte Carlo graph search. Its scientific hierarchy combines prior biomedical guidance with iterative discovery, then links biomedical plans to execution outcomes in memory for reuse across candidates. Its engineering hierarchy moves candidate programs from smoke execution, through train/validation evaluation, to full-data retraining. We evaluate BioDyad on the 76-task BioXArena benchmark under a two-hour per-task budget with three matched LLM backends. It achieves the highest penalized all-task score and task success rate among four agent methods and a one-shot baseline under each backend. These results support coordinating biomedical discovery and ML engineering to integrate external knowledge into executable programs across heterogeneous biomedical tasks.

AI.tldr: BioDyad 通过蒙特卡洛图搜索中的两个层次结构耦合生物医学发现与 ML 工程，在 BioXArena 基准上取得最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体生物医学 ML 系统虽整合了证据获取与程序搜索能力，但难以在整个搜索过程中协调二者：新证据需指导候选构建、执行结果需反哺后续发现与复用，且验证需求须契合搜索预算。
AI.method: 提出 BioDyad，在蒙特卡洛图搜索内构建两个层次：科学层次结合先验生物医学指导与迭代发现，并将生物医学计划与执行结果链接至记忆以供跨候重复用；工程层次使候选程序从冒烟执行，经训练/验证评估，到全数据重训练。
AI.result: 在 76 任务 BioXArena 基准、每任务两小时预算、三种匹配 LLM 后端下，BioDyad 在四种智能体方法和一个单次基线中取得最高的惩罚全任务得分与任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持协调生物医学发现与 ML 工程，以将外部知识整合为可执行程序，适用于异构生物医学任务。

title: Truthful-in-Expectation Mechanism with Constant Maximin-Share Guarantee
summary:
We study the truthful and fair allocation of indivisible goods to $n$ strategic agents with additive valuations. Babaioff, Feige, and Manaker Morag [FOCS 2026] gave a randomized mechanism that uses only the agents' rankings of the goods, is truthful in expectation (TIE), and guarantees every agent $1/(H_{n-1}+2)=Θ(1/\log n)$ of her maximin share (MMS) in every realized allocation, where $H_{n-1}$ is the $(n-1)$th harmonic number; this is nearly the best possible with rankings alone. They conjectured that cardinal information allows TIE mechanisms to achieve a constant ex-post MMS guarantee. We confirm this conjecture: our TIE mechanism guarantees every agent at least $1/7$ of her MMS in every realized allocation; moreover, the mechanism is ex-ante envy-free and can be implemented in polynomial time.
  Our mechanism has two key technical ingredients, both of which may be of independent interest. The first is a truthful fractional allocation rule specifying each agent's probability of receiving each good: it favors each agent on her top $n-1$ goods and reduces her probability of receiving a good for each other agent who also ranks it among her top $n-1$ goods. The second is the balanced edge coloring: we decompose these probabilities into equally likely matchings from agents to high-value goods, those that alone meet an agent's guarantee, and balance these matchings in a fine-grained way without changing any marginal probability, so that every agent who receives no high-value good can obtain sufficient value from the remaining goods without over-allocating any good.

AI.tldr: 本文确认了 Babaioff 等人的猜想：利用基数信息可以设计出多项式时间、真实期望（TIE）且事前无嫉妒的机制，在每次实现中都保证每个代理人至少获得其 MMS 的 1/7。
AI.motivation: Babaioff、Feige 和 Manaker Morag [FOCS 2026] 给出的仅使用排序信息的随机机制只能保证 Θ(1/log n) 的 MMS，并猜想基数信息能够让 TIE 机制达到常数级 ex-post MMS 保证。本文旨在证实该猜想。
AI.method: 机制包含两个关键技术：(1) 一个真实的分数分配规则，规定每个代理人获得每件物品的概率，偏向其排名前 n-1 的物品，并随其他将其列入前 n-1 的代理人数而降低概率；(2) 平衡边着色，将概率分解为等概率的代理到高价值物品的匹配，并在不改变边际概率的前提下细粒度地平衡匹配，使未获得高价值物品的代理人能从剩余物品中获得足够价值而不超配任何物品。
AI.result: TIE 机制保证每个代理人在每次实现中至少获得其 MMS 的 1/7；机制还是事前无嫉妒的，并可在多项式时间内实现。
AI.conclusion: 基数信息足以使 TIE 机制在不可分物品分配中实现常数级 ex-post MMS 保证，证实了已有猜想，且分数分配规则与平衡边着色两项技术可能具有独立价值。

title: PEAR: Progressive Evidence-Based AutoResearch for Industrial Search Systems
summary: AutoResearch improves systems through iterative experimentation: agents propose candidate modifications, evaluate them, and use the results to guide subsequent exploration. Applying this paradigm to industrial search presents two challenges. (1) Common AutoResearch approaches follow a keep-if-better rule, retaining the highest-scoring candidate for subsequent experiments. Under non-stationary traffic, transient gains may be mistaken for persistent improvements, impairing reliable accumulation of search knowledge. (2) Candidate modifications can be evaluated at multiple fidelity levels, from low-cost proxies to online validation, differing in cost, objective alignment, and statistical reliability. Existing methods rely on individual signals or task-specific procedures, lacking a unified basis for using evidence across levels to guide search. We introduce Progressive Evidence-Based AutoResearch (PEAR) with two complementary components. Evidence-driven AutoResearch maintains an independent, hypothesis-guided research state for each strategy task within a predefined objective and intervention scope. Each state evolves through a Plan-Execute-Evaluate-Update transition that links experimentation to context-aware evidence interpretation and hypothesis revision. Confidence-Gated Verifier Ladder organizes evaluation into four levels of increasing fidelity: Offline Replay, Shadow-Traffic Evaluation, Rapid Online Evaluation, and Decision-Grade Online Evaluation. A unified confidence-based gate promotes candidates only when evidence supports a statistically significant positive effect, enabling broad low-cost exploration while reserving costly online experiments for promoted candidates. In a real-world industrial search system, strategies optimized with PEAR significantly increased Main Order/DAU by 2.7336% and 3.2957% relative to their respective baselines in two A/B experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出PEAR框架，用证据驱动的假设迭代与置信门控的多级验证，改善工业搜索的非平稳流量下自动研究。
AI.motivation: 将AutoResearch用于工业搜索面临两大挑战：(1)常见的keep-if-better规则在非平稳流量下会把瞬态收益误判为持续改进，损害搜索知识的可靠积累；(2)候选修改可在从低成本代理到在线验证的多种保真度上评估，差异在成本、目标对齐、统计可靠性，现有方法依赖单一信号或特定任务流程，缺乏统一证据依据。
AI.method: PEAR含两个互补组件：证据驱动AutoResearch为每个策略任务在既定目标与干预范围内维护独立、假设引导的研究状态，经由Plan-Execute-Evaluate-Update状态迁移，将实验与上下文感知的证据解释和假设修正关联；置信门控验证阶梯把评估组织为四个递增保真度级别：离线回放、影子流量评估、快速在线评估、决策级在线评估，统一基于置信度的门控仅在证据支持统计显著正效应时提升候选，实现低成本广探索并保留昂贵在线实验。
AI.result: 在真实工业搜索系统中，用PEAR优化的策略在两个A/B实验中相较各自基线将Main Order/DAU分别提升2.7336%和3.2957%。
AI.conclusion: PEAR通过证据驱动研究与分级置信验证，缓解非平稳流量下的知识累积问题，并统一多保真评估，已在真实工业搜索取得显著在线收益。

title: From Noisy Telemetry to Actionable Warnings: GPU Failure Prediction in Industrial Clusters
comment: GPU cluster, failure prediction, event-level evaluation, fault-specific modeling
summary: GPU clusters are critical infrastructure for AI services, but accurate and actionable GPU failure prediction remains a problem in production settings. We study ticket-linked telemetry from a ByteDance GPU cluster and identify three obstacles: workload-confounded telemetry, heterogeneous fault precursors, and the gap between window-level predictions and actionable alerts. These findings motivate Falcon, a fault-specific warning framework combining missingness-aware temporal and peer-relative features, fault-specific learner selection, and an event policy based on thresholding, persistence, and cooldown. On the test set, Falcon achieves the highest F1 among four baselines and reaches 70.6% F1 on the best-performing fault type. Detected cases provide median lead times of 17.34-35.57 hours. We further report a production deployment, where Falcon is calibrated toward high-precision alerts to reflect false-positive costs. Together, these results show that fault-specific modeling improves early warning from noisy production GPU telemetry.

AI.tldr: Falcon：面向GPU故障的专用预警框架，结合缺失感知时序+同伴相对特征、故障专用学习器与事件策略，测试集F1最高，最佳故障类型达70.6%，中位提前17.34–35.57小时，并已生产部署。
AI.motivation: GPU集群是AI服务关键基础设施，但生产环境中准确且可执行的GPU故障预测仍未解决。基于字节跳动GPU集群的工单关联遥测，作者识别三大障碍：遥测受工作负载混淆、故障前兆异质、窗口级预测与可执行告警之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出Falcon故障专用预警框架，包含三部分：(1)缺失感知的时序特征与同伴相对特征；(2)针对具体故障类型选择学习器；(3)基于阈值、持续性与冷却期的事件策略，将窗口预测转化为告警。
AI.result: 测试集上Falcon在四个基线中F1最高，最佳故障类型F1达70.6%；检测到的案例中位提前时间为17.34–35.57小时；并报告了生产部署，按误报成本校准为高精度告警。
AI.conclusion: 故障专用建模能有效提升 noisy 生产GPU遥测的早期预警能力。

title: ScopeIF: Improving Scope-Aware Precise Instruction-Following in Large Language Models via Graded Reward Modeling
summary: Precise instruction-following is a fundamental ability of large language models (LLMs), requiring their outputs to strictly satisfy objective constraints in input instructions. In complex application scenarios, these constraints often possess diverse scopes that govern specific response segments rather than the entire output. However, existing optimization methods often neglect constraint scope during data construction and rely on binary per-constraint rewards, yielding limited data diversity and sparse supervision for complex constraints. To this end, we propose ScopeIF, a novel training framework for scope-aware precise instruction-following. We first introduce a unified schema that factorizes objective constraints into three decoupled dimensions: Scope, Target, and Range. Grounded in this schema, we construct ScopeInstruct, a large-scale instruction dataset with diverse scope-aware constraints, and combine tool-grounded verification with graded reward modeling to quantify the violation degree of each constraint, providing dense supervision for policy optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScopeIF consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex scope-aware constraints, while preserving general capabilities. Notably, it enables optimized Qwen3-4B and 8B models to rival or surpass strong frontier models such as Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, establishing an effective paradigm for advancing scope-aware instruction-following. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/ScopeIF.

AI.tldr: 提出ScopeIF训练框架，将约束分解为Scope、Target、Range三维度，实现scope-aware的精确指令跟随。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在数据构建时忽视约束范围(scope)，且依赖二元per-constraint奖励，导致数据多样性有限、对复杂约束监督稀疏。
AI.method: 设计统一Schema将客观约束分解为Scope/Target/Range三维；构建ScopeInstruct大规模数据集；结合工具化验证与分级奖励建模量化每个约束的违规程度，提供稠密监督进行策略优化。
AI.result: ScopeIF持续优于现有方法，尤其在复杂scope-aware约束上；使Qwen3-4B/8B媲美或超越Gemini-2.5-Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2等前沿模型，同时保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 建立了推进scope-aware指令跟随的有效范式，代码与数据已开源。

title: MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding: Replication-Aware Automatic Stopping for Subword Tokenization
comment: 15 pages, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Source code available online
summary:
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs subword vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but conventional BPE requires the number of merges or target vocabulary size to be specified externally. Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (SG-BPE) replaces frequency-only selection with a statistical criterion based on how strongly an observed pair exceeds its expected co-occurrence under an independence model.
  This paper introduces MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (MDL-SG), a three-stage procedure separating discovery, replication, and utility. Candidate pairs are ranked by Significance-Gain on a discovery partition, tested for replication on a separate partition using an exact one-sided hypergeometric test with per-iteration Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and then evaluated on a utility partition using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion. Merging stops automatically when no replicated candidate yields positive held-out MDL gain.
  On WikiText-103, MDL-SG stops at 209, 433, and 847 merges for 120K, 250K, and 500K-character tokenizer-training samples, respectively. At 500K characters, it selects a stored vocabulary of 1,017 tokens without prescribing the vocabulary size in advance. In a compute-matched TinyGPT experiment with identical 2,024,448-parameter models and 500 optimizer updates per language model, MDL-SG achieves validation/test BPC of 3.2612/3.2436, compared with test BPC of 3.2894 for SG-BPE and 3.3493 for frequency BPE. Frequency BPE achieves stronger raw compression, while MDL-SG achieves lower BPC, showing that compression-oriented merge selection and language-model utility need not coincide.

AI.tldr: 提出MDL-SG，一种三阶段BPE流程（发现/复制/效用），自动决定合并停止点，在TinyGPT上取得更低BPC。
AI.motivation: 传统BPE需外部指定合并次数或词表大小，且频率选择未必与语言模型效用一致。
AI.method: 三阶段：发现分区按Significance-Gain排序候选对；复制分区用单侧超几何检验+Benjamini-Hochberg校正；效用分区用MDL准则评估，无正增益即停止合并。
AI.result: WikiText-103上分别于209/433/847次合并自动停止；500K字符下词表1017。TinyGPT(2,024,448参数)测试BPC 3.2436，优于SG-BPE 3.2894与频率BPE 3.3493。
AI.conclusion: MDL-SG可自动确定词表规模；压缩导向的合并选择与语言模型效用并不一致。

title: Typed Temporal Interaction Features for Simulation-Backed Forecasting of Open-Source Game Release Incidents
summary: Open-source video-game quality depends on inter-actions among code, assets, configuration, tests, contributors, and issue workflows, yet conventional defect predictors usually flatten or omit these relations. We investigate release-level forecasting of a quality incident within thirty days using GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot, a typed temporal feature pipeline with calibrated risk estimates and effort-aware ranking. Because the accessible OS-SGameBench materials do not provide manually audited release dates and outbreak labels, the executed evaluation is explicitly simulation-backed rather than an empirical claim about real games. Five seeded worlds each contain 120 projects and 24 releases, with project-disjoint validation and future cross-project testing. The pilot obtains an AUPRC of 0.520, AUROC of 0.673, Brier score of 0.207, and 29.68% effort-aware recall at a twenty-percent testing budget. Its closest local comparator, Static-Hetero-Reimpl, reaches 0.522 AUPRC; the -0.002 difference is not statistically significant after Holm correction. Inference requires 0.023 milliseconds per release in the measured environment. Ablations and controlled missingness, drift, engine, project-size, alert-threshold, and attribution analyses expose where typed interactions help and where they fail. Results support the reproducibility of the proposed protocol, not deployment effectiveness. Real OSSGameBench release reconstruction, stratified label audits, and official graph-model comparisons remain mandatory before journal submission or operational use in practice. This boundary protects research integrity and supports credible evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot，一种带类型的时间特征流水线，用于开源游戏项目30天内质量事件的发布级预测，但评估基于模拟数据而非真实游戏，结果仅支持协议可复现性。
AI.motivation: 开源游戏质量依赖代码、资产、配置、测试、贡献者和issue工作流之间的交互关系，而传统缺陷预测器通常将这些关系扁平化或忽略。作者希望捕捉这些类型化交互关系来预测发布级质量事件。
AI.method: 构建GAMEQUALGRAPH-Pilot：类型化时间特征流水线，包含校准风险估计和努力感知排序。因缺乏人工审计的发布日期和爆发标签，采用模拟评估。五个随机种子世界，各含120个项目与24个发布，项目间独立验证与未来跨项目测试。
AI.result: AUPRC为0.520，AUROC为0.673，Brier为0.207，20%测试预算下努力感知召回为29.68%。最接近的本地对比方法Static-Hetero-Reimpl达到0.522 AUPRC，差异-0.002经Holm校正后不显著。推理每发布0.023毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅支持所提协议的可复现性，而非部署有效性。在期刊投稿或实际运营前，仍需真实OSSGameBench发布重建、分层标签审计和官方图模型比较。此举保护研究诚信并支持可信评估。

title: Symbolic Guidance for LLM Agents in Distributed Multiagent Coordination
comment: A preliminary version of this work was published as an extended abstract in the Proceedings of AAMAS 2026
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in multi-agent systems, yet their ability to reliably execute distributed coordination protocols remains poorly understood. While AgentsNet, a benchmark framework for distributed coordination among LLM agents, enables such coordination, granting full reasoning autonomy often leads to inconsistent or degraded performance in complex domains.
  We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出符号引导分类法(SGT),研究LLM多智能体分布式协调中的自主性调控问题。
AI.motivation: LLM作为自主智能体在多智能体系统中部署增多,但其可靠执行分布式协调协议的能力尚不明确。完全推理自主常导致复杂领域性能不稳定或下降。
AI.method: 提出符号引导分类法(SGT),刻画从开放式自然语言推理到完全规定算法执行的自主性谱系,中间层级提供部分伪代码引导。基于AgentsNet基准框架展开实验。
AI.result: 中间自主性层级持续优于无引导智能体和完全规定性规范。
AI.conclusion: 自主性调控是LLM分布式协调的关键设计原则。

title: On the Power of Determinism in Multi-Item Auctions
summary:
We study the classical multi-item monopoly setting with a single additive buyer and $m$ heterogeneous items whose values are independent but not necessarily identically distributed. Optimal truthful auctions may be randomized and complicated. We analyze the approximation ratios of three simple deterministic auctions: selling all items separately, selling them as a single grand bundle, and choosing the better of the two.
  Our technical cornerstone is a nonlinear mathematical programming formulation of the worst-case approximation ratio of selling separately, in discrete auctions where values lie in the grid $\{0,1/K,2/K,\dots ,1\}$. For two iid items, we construct novel tight Lagrangian dual certificates that determine this ratio exactly for any discretization parameter $K$. Taking $K\to\infty$, we obtain the tight bound $1+W(1/e)\approx 1.278$ in the continuous-valued setting, where $W$ denotes the Lambert-W function, closing the $[1.278,1.368]$ gap from the work of Hart and Nisan [EC'12, JET 2017].
  For $m\geq2$ independent items, a different dual construction gives an upper bound on the approximation ratio of selling separately in terms of basic statistics of the item values. Combining this bound with new inequalities relating optimal revenue (REV), separate-selling revenue (SREV), and grand-bundle revenue (BREV), we derive improved guarantees for all three auctions. Most notably, we prove \[REV\leq 3.5 \max\{SREV,BREV\},\] improving upon the $5.2$ factor of Ma and Simchi-Levi [AISTATS'21] and the $6$ factor of Babaioff, Immorlica, Lucier and Weinberg [FOCS'14, JACM 2020]. For iid items, we also prove $REV\leq 4.4534 BREV$.

AI.tldr: 研究单一加性买家、多件独立不同分布物品的垄断定价问题，分析分别出售、打包出售及取两者较优这三种简单确定性拍卖的近似比。核心用非线性规划刻画分别出售的最坏情形近似比，对两件iid物品给出紧的Lagrangian对偶证书，得到连续情形紧界1+W(1/e)≈1.278，并将一般多物品的近似比改进到REV≤3.5max{SREV,BREV}。
AI.motivation: 最优真实拍卖可能随机且复杂，难以实现与刻画；因此希望理解简单确定性拍卖（分别出售、打包、取较优）相对最优收益的近似程度，并弥合已知界之间的差距。
AI.method: 将分别出售的最坏情形近似比建模为非线性数学规划，针对网格取值{0,1/K,...,1}的离散拍卖；对两件iid物品构造紧的Lagrangian对偶证书精确求解任意K，并令K→∞；对m≥2独立物品采用不同的对偶构造，将分别出售近似比用价值基本统计量上界刻画，并结合REV、SREV、BREV的新不等式。
AI.result: 对两件iid物品，任意离散化K下精确确定分别出售近似比，连续情形取得紧界1+W(1/e)≈1.278，闭合Hart-Nisan的[1.278,1.368]间隙；一般情形证明REV≤3.5max{SREV,BREV}，优于Ma-Simchi-Levi的5.2和Babaioff等的6；对iid物品证明REV≤4.4534·BREV。
AI.conclusion: 通过非线性规划与对偶证书方法，给出了简单确定性拍卖近似比的更紧甚至紧的界，显著改进了多物品垄断定价中分别出售、打包出售及取较优拍卖的收益保证。

title: Recommendation Ranking Off-Policy Evaluation under Ranking-Dependent Examination via Examination-Relevance Decomposition
summary: Off-policy evaluation, which estimates evaluation policy performance from logged data, is key for recommender ranking policies. However, logged clicks cannot distinguish unexamined items from examined non-clicks, causing bias in existing estimators when the assumed examination structures fail. We propose two estimators based on the decomposition of clicks into examination and relevance. First, the latent-examination independent inverse propensity score (LE-IIPS) estimator corrects the IIPS bias using policy examination probability ratios. Second, the examination-decomposed doubly robust (ED-DR) estimator extends LE-IIPS to a doubly robust framework. ED-DR is unbiased if the examination probabilities are correct regardless of relevance accuracy, or under ranking-independent examination, even if both model estimates are inaccurate. Experiments show that ED-DR achieves a lower MSE than existing methods with large sample sizes, especially when the examination depends on ranking. We also highlight its limitations under small samples or cascade user behavior conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LE-IIPS和ED-DR两种离策略评估估计器，通过将点击分解为"检查"和"相关性"，缓解日志点击中未检查项与已检查未点击项无法区分导致的偏差，ED-DR在大样本下MSE更低。
AI.motivation: 推荐排序策略的离策略评估依赖日志数据，但日志点击无法区分"未被检查的项"与"被检查但未点击的项"，当假设的检查结构失效时，现有估计器会产生偏差。
AI.method: 提出两个估计器：（1）LE-IIPS（潜在检查独立逆倾向得分），利用策略检查概率比修正IIPS偏差；（2）ED-DR（检查分解双重稳健），将LE-IIPS扩展为双重稳健框架。
AI.result: ED-DR在检查概率正确（不论相关性准确与否）或在排序无关检查下（即使两个模型估计均不准确）时无偏；实验显示大样本下MSE低于现有方法，尤其当检查依赖排序时。
AI.conclusion: ED-DR在大样本下优于现有方法，但在小样本或级联用户行为条件下存在局限。

title: CLAD: Constrained Abstract Domain for Neural Network Verification
summary: Neural network verification (NNV) formally verifies that a network satisfies a specified property for all inputs within a defined region. Modern NNV tools employ abstract domains to compute a sound over-approximation of the network's behavior from the given input region, thus the tightness of these abstractions essentially determines efficiency. A long line of increasingly precise domains has been developed, but they all describe the valid input region in the same restrictive way, e.g., an Lp-norm ball. A practical input region is rarely a simple Lp ball, but rather a combination Lp ball with additional constraints. Verifying a network over such a region with existing abstraction produces a loose over-approximation, which results in either failing to verify a property or spurious counterexamples. We introduce Constrained Lagrangian Abstract Domain (CLAD), a new abstract domain that computes a sound over-approximation of neural networks over input regions defined by a combination of convex constraints. CLAD propagates these constraints and tightens bounds over the true feasible region. However, bounding a neuron over the intersection of these constraints has no closed-form solution, so CLAD relaxes each constraint into the objective with a Lagrange multiplier and solves the resulting max-min problem with a projected primal-dual method, alternating a projected gradient step on the input with a multiplier update. CLAD supports any convex constraint with a subgradient, e.g., from automatic differentiation. We evaluate CLAD on 1,944 instances across four convolutional networks with motion-blur structured perturbations with halfspace or L2-ball constraints. On standard unconstrained Linf property, CLAD verifies as many instances as GCPCROWN at a similar runtime. On constrained properties, CLAD verifies 60\% more instances than GCPCROWN on L2-ball properties, and 22% more in total.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Constrained Lagrangian Abstract Domain (CLAD)，用于在由凸约束组合定义的输入区域上对神经网络进行可靠的过近似验证，通过拉格朗日乘子与投影原始-对偶方法求解，提升了约束性质验证的性能。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络验证工具的抽象域通常只用 Lp 范数球描述输入区域，但实际输入区域常是 Lp 球与其他约束的组合。这种限制会导致过近似过于宽松，从而无法验证性质或产生伪反例。
AI.method: CLAD 将与凸约束组合相关的约束传播并收紧可行区域上的边界。由于在约束交集上对神经元求边界没有闭式解，CLAD 将每个约束以拉格朗日乘子形式松弛进目标函数，并用投影原始-对偶方法求解 max-min 问题，交替执行输入的投影梯度步与乘子更新。方法支持任何带次梯度的凸约束，例如来自自动微分。
AI.result: 在 1,944 个实例、四个卷积网络、运动模糊结构化扰动以及 halfspace 或 L2-ball 约束下评估。标准无约束 Linf 性质上，CLAD 与 GCPCROWN 验证实例数相当且运行时间相似；在约束性质上，CLAD 在 L2-ball 性质上比 GCPCROWN 多验证 60% 的实例，总体多 22%。
AI.conclusion: CLAD 能有效处理组合凸约束输入区域，在保持标准性质验证效率的同时，显著提升约束性质下的验证成功率。

title: The Judge Is Not Its Twin: Post-training makes a model's writing more predictable but barely moves its taste, as a judge, toward predictable writing
summary: Language models are now routinely graded by other language models.
