If post-training makes a model's own writing more predictable, it may also teach the same model, acting as a judge, to reward predictable writing, so that progress on creativity would be invisible to automated evaluation. We follow two open model families, OLMo-2 and Zephyr (7B parameters each), through their public training stages and measure every stage twice, as a writer of short stories and as a judge of pairs of stories. As writers, the models drift as feared: each family's fully trained model finds the stories of its base, supervised fine-tuned (SFT) and preference-trained (DPO) stages progressively more familiar, in all ten prompts, and a model from the other family finds the trained stories 7.0 to 9.2 percent (OLMo-2) and 24 to 25 percent (Zephyr) less surprising per token. As judges, they barely move toward predictable writing. Asked which story is better, a question every judge can use to tell a story from its own words in scrambled order, no trained judge's estimated tilt toward the more predictable story grows by as much as one point in the probability of picking it. A post hoc one-sided 95% upper bound on that growth is 2.7 points on an average pair, about the size of the untrained OLMo-2 judge's own tilt. Asked which is more creative, no trained judge's estimate favors the predictable story more than its base's does. Training instead strengthens a preference for longer stories when the question is creativity, and for one answer slot, and it breaks "more creative" as a question: trained judges asked it no longer reliably prefer a story to its scrambled words. A follow-up could not build pairs that differ in predictability but not in quality, because the routes that made this writer's stories less predictable also broke some of them, often enough to fail a quality floor set in advance.

AI.tldr: 该论文追踪OLMo-2和Zephyr两个开源模型家族的训练阶段，检验后训练是否使模型自身写作更可预测，以及这种可预测性偏好是否被其作为裁判时奖励，从而掩盖创造力进步。结果显示：作为写作者，模型越来越"熟悉"自己各训练阶段的文本；但作为裁判时，对可预测性的偏好几乎没有增长，训练更多强化了对长文本和某一答案位置的偏好，甚至破坏了"更有创造力"这一问题的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地被其他语言模型评分。如果后训练使模型写作更可预测，可能同时教会它作为裁判奖励可预测的写作，从而使创造力方面的进步在自动化评估中不可见。
AI.method: 追踪OLMo-2和Zephyr（各7B）的公开训练各阶段，对每个阶段做两次测量：作为短故事写作者、以及作为成对故事裁判。用意外度/熟悉度衡量写作可预测性；用判优任务衡量裁判偏好，包括"哪个更好""哪个更有创造力"及打乱词序的对照问题。
AI.result: 写作者：全训练模型对base、SFT、DPO阶段的文本逐级更"熟悉"，在全部十个提示上成立；另一家族模型发现训练后文本每token意外度下降7.0–9.2%（OLMo-2）和24–25%（Zephyr）。裁判：几乎没有向可预测写作倾斜；单侧95%上界为2.7个百分点/平均对，约等于未训练OLMo-2裁判自身的倾斜；"更有创造力"问题下，训练后裁判并不比base更偏爱可预测故事；训练反而强化了对长文本和某一答案位置的偏好，并破坏了"更有创造力"问题（训练后裁判不再可靠地偏好真实故事而非打乱词序版本）。
AI.conclusion: 后训练确实使模型写作更可预测，但并未（显著）使其作为裁判奖励可预测性，因此自动化评估未必会掩盖创造力进步；不过训练引入了长度和位置等干扰偏好。后续尝试构建"仅可预测性不同而质量相同"的故事对失败，因为降低可预测性的路径同时损害了故事质量，常低于预设质量下限。

title: Can't Find Waldo: Evaluating VLMs' Sensitivity to Image Resolution and Detail Level
summary: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes. While several approaches address this limitation, a systematic understanding of why models fail at high resolutions is lacking. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations. We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability. Through comprehensive experiments across 5 model families and 5 benchmarks, we identify three primary failure modes: (1) information loss from downsampling at vision token limits, (2) tokenization artifacts from patch boundary shifts and positional encoding fragility under non-standard aspect ratios, and (3) attention dilution as token counts increase. Our analysis reveals that even state-of-the-art models suffer from performance drops when processing high-resolution images, with degradation patterns varying systematically by architectural family. We provide actionable insights for model architecture design and data augmentation strategies to mitigate these limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个受控评估框架，通过语义保持变换解耦分辨率相关的性能退化与任务难度，并提出AUSC和PVS两个指标，识别出VLM在高分辨率下的三种主要失效模式。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在高分辨率输入（关键信息位于小区域或复杂场景）下表现不佳，现有方法虽多，但缺乏对高分辨率失效原因的系统性理解。
AI.method: 提出受控评估框架，用语义保持变换分离分辨率退化与任务难度；提出两个指标：AUSC（曲线下面积，量化与基线准确率无关的缩放鲁棒性）和PVS（预测方差分数，衡量分辨率导致的预测不稳定性）。在5个模型家族和5个基准上做实验。
AI.result: 识别三种主要失效模式：(1) 视觉token上限导致的下采样信息损失；(2) patch边界偏移的tokenization伪影与非标准宽高比下的位置编码脆弱性；(3) token数增加导致的注意力稀释。即使最先进模型也出现性能下降，且退化模式随架构家族系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 为缓解这些局限，提供了关于模型架构设计和数据增强策略的可操作建议。

title: Energy Vision--Language--Action: A Controlled Multimodal Benchmark for Intent-Conditioned Residential Energy Management
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are studied mainly in robotics, where visual observations and language instructions are mapped to physical actions. This paper introduces Energy Vision-Language-Action (EVLA), a controlled multimodal benchmark for intent-conditioned residential energy management. EVLA frames battery scheduling as a multimodal trajectory-prediction problem in which an RGB energy-field representation, a numerical operating state, and a natural-language objective are mapped to a 16-step battery-action trajectory generated by a finite-horizon sampling-based reference generator. Source windows are derived from public residential electrical-load data, while electricity price, battery state of charge, indoor temperature, and time of day are generated benchmark metadata. A hidden operating regime is encoded only through energy-field texture, enabling paired visual changes while the explicit numerical state is fixed. Crossing 439,203 retained base windows with three hidden regimes and five language objectives yields 6,588,045 multimodal instances. An initial study evaluates 36 configurations over three training seeds using fixed subsets of 5,000 training, 500 validation, and 500 test instances. In the MobileNet-family comparison, removing processed language increases trajectory mean-squared error from 0.3856 +/- 0.0039 to 0.8628 +/- 0.0001, whereas removing vision yields 0.3843 +/- 0.0013, comparable to the full model. The results show strong asymmetry in modality use: the processed-language pathway is strongly associated with prediction quality, while the current RGB pathway provides no aggregate error advantage. These results characterize the fixed pilot subset and executed protocol rather than full-benchmark training. EVLA provides a controlled setting for studying how semantic intent and latent context influence residential energy-action prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 EVLA，一个受控的多模态基准，用于意图条件化的住宅能源管理，并将电池调度建模为多模态轨迹预测问题。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型主要在机器人领域研究，本文将视觉-语言-动作范式引入住宅能源管理，探索语义意图与潜在上下文如何影响能源动作预测。
AI.method: 将 RGB 能量场表示、数值运行状态和自然语言目标映射为 16 步电池动作轨迹，由有限时域采样参考生成器产生。源窗口来自公共住宅负载数据，价格、SOC、室温和时间作为元数据；隐藏运行机制仅编码在能量场纹理中。439,203 个基础窗口×3 隐藏机制×5 语言目标，共 6,588,045 个多模态实例。
AI.result: 在 36 种配置、3 个训练种子上评测（5,000 训练/500 验证/500 测试）。移除语言使 MSE 从 0.3856±0.0039 升至 0.8628±0.0001；移除视觉为 0.3843±0.0013，与完整模型相当。语言通路对预测质量影响显著，当前 RGB 通路未带来总体误差优势。
AI.conclusion: EVLA 为研究语义意图与潜在上下文对住宅能源动作预测的影响提供了受控环境；但结果仅针对固定试点子集和已执行协议，非全基准训练。

title: Goal-Persistent Coding Agents as Scientific Performance Engineers: A Fixed-Radius Nearest-Neighbor Case Study
summary: Coding agents can pursue persistent objectives across many tool-use turns, but evidence that general-purpose agents can conduct rigorous scientific performance engineering remains limited. We present a repository-scale case study in which off-the-shelf Codex and Claude Code agents optimize fixed-radius nearest-neighbor (FRNN) search for particle tracking. Starting from a PyTorch-dependent CUDA implementation, the agents follow an executable goal that specifies exact-correctness tests, profiling requirements, and acceptance criteria without prescribing code transformations. In the primary sequential trajectory, they autonomously remove the PyTorch dependency and conduct hypothesis-driven optimization experiments. The resulting standalone C++/CUDA library exactly reproduces the targeted reference result. Its synchronous NumPy interface achieved 1.6-fold speedup over the original GPU-resident PyTorch interface, despite including host transfers. Similar speedups were observed across different GPU architectures and software stacks. An independent optimization rerun followed a different sequence of hypotheses and reached even better performance on the target workload. These results show that goal-persistent coding agents can act as experimental performance engineers, and that executable scientific contracts are needed both to guide and to validate their optimization.

AI.tldr: 一个仓库级案例研究显示，通用编程代理（Codex、Claude Code）能自主将依赖 PyTorch 的 CUDA FRNN 搜索实现改写为独立 C++/CUDA 库，在保证精确正确性的同时实现约 1.6 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 编程代理能跨多轮工具使用追求持续目标，但通用代理能否进行严谨的科学性能工程仍缺乏证据。
AI.method: 以粒子追踪中的固定半径最近邻（FRNN）搜索为对象，给定含精确正确性测试、性能剖析要求和验收标准的可执行目标（不指定代码变换），让代理自主移除 PyTorch 依赖并进行假设驱动的优化实验。
AI.result: 产出的独立 C++/CUDA 库精确复现参考结果；同步 NumPy 接口（含主机传输）比原 GPU 常驻 PyTorch 接口快 1.6 倍，在不同 GPU 架构和软件栈上结果相似；独立重跑采用不同假设序列，取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 目标持久的编程代理可作为实验性性能工程师，且需要可执行科学契约来引导并验证其优化过程。

title: Mitigating Popularity Bias in Recommendation with Global Listwise Learning and Progressive Bi-Weighting
summary: In recommender systems, user feedback typically follows a long-tail distribution, which leads many recommendation algorithms to exacerbate popularity bias by disproportionately favoring popular items. To mitigate this issue, recent studies have employed Inverse Propensity Scoring (IPS) to rebalance training data via reweighting user-item interactions. However, the effectiveness of IPS-based approaches is often constrained by locally unbiased objectives and inaccurate propensity estimation. In this paper, we propose Multinomial Likelihood with Bi-Weighting (Mult-BiW) to address these limitations. First, we introduce a debiasing framework, termed Mult-IPS, which integrates multinomial likelihood with IPS to capture global and unbiased user preferences over the entire item set. Second, we develop a Bi-Weighting (BiW) strategy that jointly leverages propensity scores and a collection model, incorporating a smoothing mechanism to enhance the robustness of propensity estimation. We further provide theoretical analyses that establish an upper bound on the empirical bias and characterize the optimal form of the collection model. Third, to mitigate the adverse effects of aggressive reweighting on representation learning, we design a Progressive Bi-Weighting strategy that gradually transitions from discriminative representation learning to popularity debiasing. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that Mult-BiW consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mult-BiW，将多项式似然与 IPS 结合（Mult-IPS），并设计 Bi-Weighting 与渐进式重加权策略，以缓解推荐系统中的流行度偏差。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统用户反馈呈长尾分布，算法偏向热门物品加剧流行度偏差。现有基于 IPS 的重加权方法受限于局部无偏目标和倾向性估计不准确的问题。
AI.method: 提出 Mult-BiW：(1) Mult-IPS 框架，将多项式似然与 IPS 结合，捕捉全局无偏用户偏好；(2) Bi-Weighting 策略，联合倾向性分数与收集模型，并引入平滑机制提升估计稳健性，同时给出经验偏差上界与最优收集模型形式；(3) 渐进式 Bi-Weighting，从判别式表示学习逐步过渡到去偏。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，Mult-BiW 持续优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Mult-BiW 通过全局无偏目标和稳健重加权有效缓解流行度偏差，并兼顾表示学习质量，性能优于现有方法。

title: Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents
summary: Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path. Because a partial program cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space of interdependent choices, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program reasoning. Puzzles are synthesized from scratch via semantic reification, so fresh puzzles of controllable complexity can be generated on demand, each with a witness that guarantees solvability. We evaluate five frontier models on 300 puzzles through a coding agent free to use any tool within a fixed budget. Small puzzles already challenge open-weight models, whereas even proprietary models solve only about half of the large ones. Codoku thus offers a renewable testbed for program reasoning that can keep pace with rapidly improving coding agents. GitHub: https://github.com/connglli/Codoku.

AI.tldr: 提出 Codoku，一种可再生的程序推理基准：求解器需在部分程序中填入类型化代码单元以满足全局静态与动态约束。部分程序不可执行、合法解稀疏，避免工具执行与枚举；谜题按需合成并附解见证。
AI.motivation: 现有基准假设被编码代理打破：代理可通过执行程序而非推理得到答案；固定任务集易被污染且更新成本高。需要不可执行、可再生的程序推理基准。
AI.method: 将程序推理转化为"代码数独"：在部分程序的类型化单元中填空，满足如指定控制流图、执行路径等全局静态/动态约束；谜题经语义具体化从零合成，可控复杂度，并附保证可解性的见证。
AI.result: 在300个谜题上以固定工具预算评估五个前沿模型：小谜题已难倒开源权重模型，大谜题即使专有模型也仅解出约一半。
AI.conclusion: Codoku 提供可随编码代理能力快速更新、防污染且不可用执行或枚举替代的再生程序推理测试平台。

title: Generalization and Memorization along the Learning Trajectory of Neural Language Models: A Geometric Account of Categorization
comment: 5 figures in main text, 9 page main text
summary: We investigate how generalization and memorization develop along the learning trajectory of neural language models. Using controlled synthetic grammars, we examine both the geometry of representation space and model behaviour over training. We find that continuous regions of representation space not occupied by observed tokens become systematically structured from the earliest stages of learning, forming category-level geometric organization that supports generalization to unattested combinations. Generalization therefore emerges from the beginning of learning rather than only after extensive memorization. With prolonged training, larger models increasingly distinguish observed from unobserved grammatical combinations. At the same time, the continuous geometric structure supporting category-level generalization is gradually destructed. Together, these results suggest that neural language models initially learn through categorization-based generalization, followed by a gradual transition toward more exemplar-specific memorization.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究神经语言模型在学习轨迹中泛化与记忆的演变，发现模型最初依赖类别化泛化，随后逐渐转向样例特定记忆。
AI.motivation: 理解神经语言模型在训练过程中泛化与记忆如何发展，以及表征空间几何结构如何影响这一过程。
AI.method: 使用受控的合成语法，考察训练过程中表征空间的几何结构以及模型行为的变化。
AI.result: 未被观测词元占据的连续表征区域从学习早期就被系统化结构化，形成支持泛化的类别级几何组织；随着训练延长，更大模型越来越能区分已观测与未观测的语法组合，同时支持类别级泛化的连续几何结构逐渐被破坏。
AI.conclusion: 神经语言模型初期通过基于类别化的泛化进行学习，随后逐渐转向更具样例特定性的记忆。

title: Cross-Dataset Generalization of Bangladeshi Rice Leaf Disease Classifiers: Benchmark, Diagnosis, and Mitigation
summary: Cross-dataset transfer in rice leaf disease classification remains a significant challenge, with models trained on one image collection performing substantially worse when deployed on another. We conduct a systematic benchmark across three Bangladeshi rice leaf disease datasets (5,419 images, 6 transfer pairs, 3 CNN backbones, 3 random seeds) to characterize and diagnose this failure. Strong augmentation recovers a mean cross-dataset macro-F1 improvement of +0.070 (Wilcoxon p < 0.001, 15 of 18 transfer pairs positive). Removing non-leaf image content via segmentation shows directional benefit (mean +0.066, p = 0.062, n = 36 paired observations) that is consistent across two independent segmentation methods but does not reach conventional significance. A self-supervised ViT control (DINOv2 linear probe) exhibits equivalent cross-dataset collapse to CNNs, ruling out architecture inductive bias as the primary driver and pointing to acquisition-condition shift. Adaptive batch normalization uniformly harms transfer performance, with harm magnitude correlating with source-target label-prior divergence and model depth (Spearman rho = 0.621, p = 0.009). Grad-CAM attribution analysis on 12 sampled predictions does not distinguish correct from incorrect cross-domain predictions (p = 0.462), indicating that common attribution proxies are insufficient for diagnosing shift at practical sample sizes. We document all frozen results, prespecified analysis criteria, and reproducibility artifacts in a public repository with SHA-256 integrity verification. This work establishes a rigorous empirical baseline for understanding cross-dataset generalization in agricultural computer vision and identifies both effective (augmentation) and ineffective (AdaBN) adaptation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文对孟加拉国水稻叶病分类的跨数据集迁移进行系统基准测试，发现强增强有效、AdaBN有害、归因分析不足以诊断域偏移。
AI.motivation: 跨数据集的叶病分类模型在部署到新数据集时性能显著下降，需系统诊断这一失败的原因（架构偏置还是采集条件偏移）。
AI.method: 在3个孟加拉国水稻叶病数据集（5,419张图像、6个迁移对、3种CNN骨干、3个随机种子）上做基准；测试强增强、分割去除非叶片内容、DINOv2自监督ViT线性探针、AdaBN与Grad-CAM归因分析，并预设分析标准。
AI.result: 强增强使跨数据集macro-F1平均+0.070（p<0.001，18个迁移对中15个为正）；分割有方向性收益（+0.066，p=0.062）；DINOv2与CNN表现同等崩溃，排除架构偏置；AdaBN一致有害，其危害与标签先验差异及模型深度相关（rho=0.621，p=0.009）；Grad-CAM无法区分正确与错误预测（p=0.462）。
AI.conclusion: 主因是采集条件偏移而非架构；增强是有效策略，AdaBN无效；归因代理在实际样本量下不足以诊断域偏移，并提供了可复现的实证基线。

title: From Phase Transition to Systemic Failure: A Decoupled Analytics Framework for GNN Robustness
summary: Data quality is a major bottleneck for the reliable deployment of graph neural networks (GNNs) in real-world graph mining tasks. Among various sources of degradation, label noise and feature distribution shift (hereafter referred to as distribution shift) are two common yet fundamentally different challenges. To study their effects under controlled conditions, this paper constructs a synthetic homophilic graph regression benchmark in which the two factors can be manipulated separately. A total of 41 configurations and 410 runs are conducted to evaluate the behavior of representative GNN models under varying noise and shift conditions. The results show two distinct patterns. First, under additive label corruption, performance remains relatively stable over a broad range of noise settings and begins to deteriorate sharply only after an observed transition region around the 50 percent noise ratio. Second, under extreme feature distribution shift, all tested models suffer substantial degradation, with test MSE increasing by 48 times to 316 times and correlation dropping by 73 percent to 89 percent. These findings suggest that, in the present controlled setting, GNNs are considerably more tolerant to moderate label perturbation than to severe distribution mismatch. The study provides a controlled empirical baseline for understanding how data quality affects GNN-based graph mining systems and offers practical implications for deployment-oriented monitoring and model maintenance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过合成同质图回归基准，分别操控标签噪声与特征分布偏移，发现GNN对中等标签噪声容忍度高，而对严重分布偏移极为脆弱。
AI.motivation: 数据质量是GNN在实际图挖掘中部署可靠性的主要瓶颈，其中标签噪声和特征分布偏移是两种常见但本质不同的退化来源，缺乏在受控条件下单独研究的基准。
AI.method: 构建可分别操控两种因素的合成同质图回归基准，运行41种配置、共410次实验，评估代表性GNN模型在不同噪声与偏移条件下的表现。
AI.result: 加性标签损坏下性能在较宽噪声区间内保持稳定，约50%噪声比后才急剧下降；极端特征分布偏移下所有模型严重退化，测试MSE增加48至316倍，相关性下降73%至89%。
AI.conclusion: 在此受控设定下，GNN对中等标签扰动远比严重分布失配更具容忍性；研究为理解数据质量对GNN图挖掘系统的影响提供了受控实证基线，并为部署监控与模型维护提供实践启示。

title: CSI-Agent: LLM-Assisted Few-Shot Adaptation for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi CSI Sensing
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to INFOCOM
summary: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) has enabled device-free sensing applications such as human activity recognition. However, CSI sensing models remain brittle in cross-domain deployment, where changes in users or environments can produce incorrect predictions. Existing solutions usually treat this problem as an offline model-design problem, by pretraining a stronger representation or applying one fixed adaptation method to the entire target domain. In practice, labeled target data are scarce and different classes may fail in different ways under the same domain shift. To address this, we propose CSI-Agent, an evidence-seeking LLM agent that reformulates cross-domain CSI adaptation as a deployment-time decision-making problem. Rather than processing raw CSI or making sample-level predictions, CSI-Agent summarizes target-domain behavior into sensing-grounded class-level evidence. It establishes a strong target-adaptive default from complementary CSI views and uses an LLM planner to determine whether each class should retain the default or invoke a specialized action. Deterministic verification and bounded execution further reduce unreliable interventions. We evaluate CSI-Agent on four public datasets using five cross-domain splits covering device, user, environment, and compositional shifts. Under 1-shot adaptation, CSI-Agent achieves the best target-domain performance across all splits and improves the average Macro-F1 by about 16\% compared to the strongest baseline method.

AI.tldr: 提出 CSI-Agent，将跨域 CSI 自适应重构为部署时决策问题，用 LLM 智能体按类别决定是否调用专门动作，在 1-shot 下平均 Macro-F1 提升约 16%。
AI.motivation: Wi-Fi CSI 无设备感知模型在跨域部署时脆弱，用户或环境变化会导致错误预测；现有方法多将其视为离线模型设计问题（预训练更强表征或对整个目标域应用固定自适应方法），但实际标注目标数据稀缺，且同一域偏移下不同类别可能以不同方式失败。
AI.method: CSI-Agent 是一个证据寻求型 LLM 智能体，把跨域 CSI 自适应重构为部署时决策问题。它不处理原始 CSI 或做样本级预测，而是将目标域行为总结为基于感知的类别级证据；先从互补 CSI 视角建立强目标自适应默认方案，再由 LLM 规划器判断每个类别是保留默认还是调用专门动作；并通过确定性验证与有界执行减少不可靠干预。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集、五种跨域划分（设备、用户、环境及组合偏移）上评估。1-shot 自适应设置下，CSI-Agent 在所有划分上取得最佳目标域性能，相比最强基线平均 Macro-F1 提升约 16%。
AI.conclusion: 将跨域 CSI 自适应视为部署时的类别级决策问题，并借助 LLM 智能体结合证据与验证，可有效缓解跨域部署脆弱性，在标注稀缺时显著优于固定自适应基线。

title: Modular Discovery of General Game-Playing Algorithms with Large Language Models
summary: General Game Playing across arbitrary games from rules alone remains challenging due to differing algorithmic requirements across game classes and strict decision-time constraints. Rather than hand-designing search heuristics for specific domains, can we leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to discover general game-playing algorithms? Because language models can propose and refactor structured code, they provide an expressive proposal engine for exploring the space of algorithmic designs. We introduce a multi-agent LLM meta-learning system to co-evolve game-agnostic procedural search mechanisms in C++ alongside domain heuristics synthesized directly from game rules. Controlling the compute budget, we benchmark the discovered mechanisms across more than 400 diverse environments, including OpenSpiel training and held-out games, procedural simulation engines, and games with deep neural policy-value representations trained via PPO. Evaluated via AlphaRank stationary distributions and Soft Condorcet Optimization (SCO) against 15 established MCTS baselines, the discovered search mechanisms consistently achieve top-tier ratings and pairwise ballot majorities over most baselines across independent evolutionary runs, generalizing to unseen human-designed and procedurally synthesized games and remaining competitive with baselines on frozen neural network representations.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体LLM元学习系统，联合演化C++通用博弈搜索机制与从规则合成的领域启发式，在400+环境中超越15种MCTS基线。
AI.motivation: 通用博弈（仅凭规则应对任意游戏）面临不同游戏类别的算法需求差异和严格决策时间约束，手工设计搜索启发式难以泛化。
AI.method: 构建多智能体LLM元学习系统，共同演化游戏无关的过程式搜索机制（C++实现）与直接从游戏规则合成的领域启发式，并控制计算预算进行探索。
AI.result: 在超400个多样环境（OpenSpiel训练与留出游戏、过程式模拟引擎、PPO训练的深度神经策略价值表示）中评测，独立演化运行下AlphaRank稳态分布与SCO评分均达顶尖水平，对多数基线取得成对投票多数，泛化到未见游戏，在冻结神经网络表示上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为表达性强的算法设计提案引擎，自动发现可泛化的通用博弈搜索算法，无需人工设计领域启发式。

title: RenderRank: Learning to Rerank Text with Compressed Visual Tokens
summary: Rendering document text as images allows vision-language models to encode documents as visual tokens, which can reduce input sequence length compared with text input. This reduction in input length is particularly useful for reranking, where each query involves scoring multiple candidate documents and token savings apply to each candidate evaluation. We introduce RenderRank, a reranker that learns query-dependent relevance scoring from compressed visual document representations instead of the text token sequences used by conventional text-based rerankers. Training first aligns relevance scores from visual inputs with those of a text-based teacher, then refines the relative scores of positive and negative documents for the same query. Across 11 datasets from BEIR, RenderRank uses 16.5-35.5% fewer input tokens while achieving an average NDCG@10 of 55.96, outperforming all evaluated text-based baselines below 4B parameters and some larger models. Across four long-document datasets, it achieves an average NDCG@10 of 88.27 with approximately half the average input token count of the evaluated text-based rerankers. In this setting, RenderRank delivers 1.70x the highest average throughput of the evaluated baselines. These results demonstrate that compressed visual representations can support accurate document relevance scoring, providing an alternative to text token representations for reranking.

AI.tldr: RenderRank 从压缩的视觉文档表示中学习查询相关的相关性评分，以更少输入 token 实现优于文本基线及部分更大模型的文档重排效果。
AI.motivation: 文本输入的长序列导致重排器计算开销大；将文档渲染为图像可用视觉 token 替代文本 token，缩短输入序列，且对多候选文档评分的重排任务收益更明显。
AI.method: 提出 RenderRank：从压缩视觉文档表示学习查询相关的相关性评分。训练分两阶段：先将视觉输入的相关性分数与文本教师模型对齐，再针对同一查询精炼正负文档的相对分数。
AI.result: 在 BEIR 的 11 个数据集上，输入 token 减少 16.5–35.5%，平均 NDCG@10 达 55.96，优于所有 4B 参数以下的文本基线及部分更大模型；在 4 个长文档数据集上平均 NDCG@10 为 88.27，输入 token 约为文本重排器的一半，平均吞吐量为最高基线的 1.70 倍。
AI.conclusion: 压缩视觉表示足以支持准确的文档相关性评分，可作为文本 token 表示的替代方案用于重排。

title: When Ambiguity Meets Atypicality: Dual-Perspective Test Input Prioritization for DNNs
summary: While Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable progress in cutting-edge domains, their inherent brittleness has become a growing concern. To ensure the reliability and safety of DNN-enabled software, DNN testing has emerged as an indispensable practice. Within this context, test input prioritization is essential for early fault detection and reducing labeling costs. However, it remains challenging to accurately identify failure-inducing inputs. Although decision ambiguity and distributional atypicality are two widely adopted perspectives for characterizing inter-class competition and intra-class typicality respectively, relying on either perspective in isolation inevitably introduces blind spots. In this paper, we propose DuFP (Dual perspective Feature space Prioritization), a KNN density-based test input prioritization approach for DNNs that jointly incorporates both inter-class and intra-class perspectives. The prioritization framework of DuFP is built upon class-conditional density estimation. Based on the estimation results, prediction correctness is characterized by an ambiguity score and an atypicality score, with the former reflecting decision ambiguity and the latter quantifying distributional atypicality. A hybrid uncertainty score is then constructed by integrating both scores to guide the final prioritization. We evaluate DuFP on prioritization and selection tasks across image and text datasets under clean, corrupted, and adversarial scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that DuFP effectively and efficiently prioritizes fault-inducing inputs and outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: DuFP：一种基于KNN密度的DNN测试输入优先级排序方法，联合类间与类内视角，在图像与文本、干净/损坏/对抗场景下优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: DNN存在脆弱性，需通过测试保障可靠性。测试输入优先级排序有助于早期故障发现并降低标注成本，但准确识别故障诱导输入仍具挑战。决策模糊性（类间竞争）与分布非典型性（类内典型性）各自单独使用存在盲区。
AI.method: 提出DuFP，基于类条件密度估计构建优先级框架：由KNN密度估计得到模糊性得分（反映决策模糊）与非典型性得分（量化分布非典型），并融合为混合不确定性得分，指导最终排序。
AI.result: 在图像与文本数据集上，于干净、损坏、对抗三种场景下进行优先级排序与选择任务评估，DuFP能有效且高效地优先识别故障诱导输入，性能优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 联合类间与类内双视角可弥补单一视角盲点，DuFP为DNN测试输入优先级排序提供了有效且高效的解决方案。

title: A model of rational interlocutors: Unification of comprehension and production
comment: A computational model of partner modeling in language comprehension and production. 62 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, including supplementary materials
summary: Who we communicate with influences both our interpretation of their utterances and the design of our own. Such adjustment to the conversational partner is studied as speaker modeling in comprehension and as audience design in production, with the two literatures having developed largely separately. We argue that both adjustments express one rational computation and propose the rational interlocutor (RI) model, a computational account unifying comprehension and production. An interlocutor maintains a model of their partner, defined by three parameters: an identity parameter Π sets the messages and forms expected from the partner; a fidelity parameter Φ sets how reliably messages and utterances map onto each other for them; a knowledge parameter Λ sets how knowledgeable the partner is believed to be. Comprehension and production are thus mirror-image modes of one computation over the partner model. Comprehension chooses the message the partner most likely intends to convey, weighing how well each candidate fits the utterance against how likely this partner is to mean it. Production chooses the utterance from which the partner will best recover the message, weighed against the effort of saying it. This explains why comprehenders appear to rely less on the forms produced by a linguistically less competent speaker, while producers tend to invest more effort in designing forms for them. We conjecture that perceived linguistic competence decomposes into two of these quantities: fidelity and knowledge. Their contrasting profiles across second-language (L2) adults, children, and artificial partners produce distinct and testable predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"理性对话者"(RI)模型，用统一的计算框架整合理解中的说话者建模与产出中的听众设计，将两者视为对伙伴模型的镜像计算。
AI.motivation: 理解研究(说话者建模)与产出研究(听众设计)长期各自发展、彼此分离。作者认为这两种对话者调整本质上表达的是同一个理性计算，因此需要一个统一的计算模型来解释它们。
AI.method: RI模型维护一个由三个参数定义的伙伴模型：身份参数Π(设定对伙伴的消息与形式的预期)、保真度参数Φ(消息与话语映射的可靠程度)、知识参数Λ(伙伴被认为的博学程度)。理解与产出是对该伙伴模型的镜像计算：理解选择伙伴最可能意图传达的消息(权衡候选与话语的契合度及伙伴表达该意的概率)；产出选择伙伴最能恢复消息的话语(权衡言说努力)。
AI.result: 该模型解释了为何理解者对语言能力较弱说话者所产形式的依赖更少，而产出者倾向于为这类伙伴投入更多努力设计形式。作者推测感知到的语言能力可分解为保真度与知识两个量，其在不同对象(二语成年人、儿童、人工伙伴)上的对比特征产生了可检验的预测。
AI.conclusion: RI模型为理解与产出提供了统一的计算解释，并将感知语言能力分解为保真度与知识，为二语者、儿童和人工伙伴产生可检验的预测。

title: Statistical Testing for Multiple Instance Learning via Selective Inference with Applications to Computational Pathology
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used in computational pathology because it enables weakly supervised analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) without requiring patch-level annotations. In attention-based MIL, instances with high attention scores are often interpreted as diagnostically important regions and used as visual explanations. However, attention scores alone cannot determine whether selected high-attention instances are significantly different from normal instances, limiting the reliability of attention-based explanations. In this paper, we formulate the evaluation of high-attention instances as a statistical hypothesis testing problem. Specifically, we assess whether a selected high-attention instance significantly deviates from a representative normal reference instance selected based on feature similarity. A major challenge is that both the target instance and the reference instance are selected through data-dependent procedures, rendering standard hypothesis testing invalid. To address this issue, we introduce a selective inference (SI) framework that explicitly accounts for the selection events induced by attention-based instance selection and adaptive reference selection, thereby enabling the computation of valid selective $p$-values conditional on these events. Experiments demonstrate Type-I error control on synthetic and MNIST-based data and practical applicability to pathological WSIs, with higher statistical power than the conventional over-conditioning approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对注意力MIL视觉解释的可靠性问题，将高注意力实例的评估形式化为统计假设检验，并提出选择性推断框架计算有效的选择性p值，实验验证了Type-I错误控制及优于过条件化方法的统计功效。
AI.motivation: 注意力MIL广泛用于病理WSI的弱监督分析，高注意力分数实例常被解释为诊断重要区域，但仅凭注意力分数无法判断所选高注意力实例是否显著偏离正常实例，限制了基于注意力的解释的可靠性。
AI.method: 将高注意力实例的评估形式化为统计假设检验问题，判断所选高注意力实例是否显著偏离基于特征相似度选出的代表性正常参考实例。由于目标实例与参考实例均经数据依赖过程选出会导致标准检验失效，引入选择性推断（SI）框架，显式建模注意力实例选择与自适应参考选择带来的选择事件，从而计算条件于这些事件的有效选择性p值。
AI.result: 在合成数据和基于MNIST的数据上实现了Type-I错误控制，并在病理WSI上展示了实际适用性，统计功效高于传统的过条件化（over-conditioning）方法。
AI.conclusion: 选择性推断框架能够为注意力MIL的高注意力实例提供有效的统计显著性评估，提升注意力解释的可靠性，具有病理WSI应用价值。

title: Cross-Material Support Transfer for Core-Loss Prediction Under Waveform Covariate Shift
summary: Power magnetic materials are characterized on the sinusoidal and triangular waveforms that excitation hardware conveniently produces, whereas deployed converters expose cores to trapezoidal, PWM-shaped flux trajectories, so loss models must predict exactly where their training data are thinnest. The final test of the MagNet Challenge embeds a deliberately extreme instance of this characterization-deployment mismatch: for material D, trapezoids form 16.4% of the test set but only 1.4% of the training set. The 95th-percentile relative error, hereafter p95, of the best submission, built on sequential transfer learning, stalled at 15.9%, the worst among the five materials. This paper shows that the obstacle is missing information under covariate shift rather than class imbalance, and that the missing support can be borrowed from sibling materials instead of being extrapolated. Controlled experiments first refute the imbalance reading: four standard remedies fail, and raising the trapezoidal share to the test-set level degrades accuracy further. The proposed material-identity support transfer, MIST, then trains one 2784-parameter predictor jointly on all five challenge materials. Material identity enters through feature-wise linear modulation, or FiLM, the scarce material's true-label loss is reweighted, and material D receives no fine-tuning, so that the bias of its trapezoid-free training set is never re-installed. MIST lowers the five-seed material-D p95 from 20.39+/-2.03% to 12.38+/-0.92% and the trapezoidal-class p95 from 37.4+/-8.8% to 15.16+/-1.69%, surpassing the best submission with one-sixth of its parameters and no fine-tuning stage; removing material identity at matched capacity inflates the error by an order of magnitude. These results argue that scarce materials should be characterized jointly with their siblings.

AI.tldr: 针对MagNet挑战中D材料梯形波训练数据稀缺导致的预测误差，论文指出瓶颈是协变量偏移下的信息缺失而非类别不平衡，并提出MIST方法，借助兄弟材料的知识迁移显著降低误差。
AI.motivation: 功率磁性材料常用正弦/三角波标定，但实际变换器暴露于梯形、PWM波形，导致标定-部署不匹配。挑战赛中D材料的梯形波在测试集占16.4%、训练集仅1.4%，最优提交的p95误差达15.9%，为五材料中最差。作者认为核心是协变量偏移下的信息缺失，而非类别不平衡。
AI.method: 通过控制实验先反驳不平衡解读（四种标准补救无效，提高梯形波比例反而更差）。提出MIST，联合训练一个2784参数的预测器覆盖全部五种材料；通过FiLM引入材料身份，对稀缺材料的真值损失重加权，且D材料不做微调，避免其无梯形训练集的偏差被重新引入。
AI.result: MIST将D材料的五种子p95从20.39+/-2.03%降至12.38+/-0.92%；梯形类p95从37.4+/-8.8%降至15.16+/-1.69%，以六分之一的参数量且无微调阶段超越最优提交；在同等容量下移除材料身份会使误差膨胀一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 稀缺材料应与兄弟材料联合表征，利用可借用的支撑信息替代外推，从而在协变量偏移下提升预测精度。

title: SenseAgent: An LLM Agent for Adaptive Cross-Domain IMU Sensing
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Plan to submit to SenSys Phase 2
summary: Deep learning has improved inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensing for mobile and wearable applications. However, an IMU model trained in one domain often becomes unreliable when it is used with a new user, device, or body position. Existing methods usually treat this problem as a static model-design task: they pretrain a stronger representation, add data augmentation, or select one adaptation method before deployment. In practice, the target domain is only gradually observed, labels are scarce, and different domain shifts require different sensing actions. This paper presents SenseAgent, an LLM-guided sensing agent for cross-domain IMU activity recognition. Instead of asking an LLM to classify raw IMU signals, SenseAgent uses the LLM as a runtime planner over sensing tools, source-domain experience memory, online target memory, and verifiers. The agent builds a label-free diagnosis report from the target stream and uses it to decide whether to keep raw inference or invoke specialized tools, including gravity-aware sensing, prototype transfer, and style normalization. Verifiers check source calibration, target-memory reliability, and no-harm criteria before accepting high-risk tool decisions. SenseAgent also supports scarce feedback without retraining the backbone or replacing the label-free route. This design converts cross-domain IMU sensing from a fixed inference pipeline into a closed-loop sensing process that diagnoses target shifts, selects suitable sensing actions, and rejects unsafe adaptations. We evaluate SenseAgent across multiple IMU datasets and deployment shifts. Results show that its verified route selection improves cross-domain sensing, especially under harder placement and compound shifts, and further benefits from limited user feedback.

AI.tldr: SenseAgent：用LLM作为运行时规划器，通过诊断报告选择传感工具，实现跨域IMU活动识别的闭环自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有跨域IMU识别方法多将问题视为静态模型设计任务（预训练更强表示、数据增强或部署前选定单一适配方法），但实际中目标域逐渐出现、标签稀缺，且不同域偏移需要不同传感动作。
AI.method: 不让LLM直接分类原始IMU信号，而是作为运行时规划器，基于传感工具、源域经验记忆、在线目标记忆和验证器工作。从目标流构建无标签诊断报告，据此决定保留原始推理或调用重力感知、原型迁移、风格归一化等工具；验证器检查源校准、目标记忆可靠性和无害准则；支持少量反馈而无需重训练骨干。
AI.result: 在多个IMU数据集和部署偏移上评估，验证后路由选择改善跨域传感，尤其在更难的位置偏移和复合偏移下，并受益于有限用户反馈。
AI.conclusion: 将跨域IMU传感从固定推理流水线转为闭环传感过程：诊断目标偏移、选择合适传感动作、拒绝不安全适配。

title: Signal or Noise? Modality Contribution and Cooperation in Multimodal GraphRAG
summary: Multimodal knowledge graphs (KGs) integrate information from text, figures, tables, and other modalities into a unified structured representation, with the promise that richer evidence enables better inference. In GraphRAG systems built over such graphs, it is commonly assumed that retrieving evidence from more modalities at inference time improves downstream performance. Yet, redundant or overlapping multimodal evidence may distract language models in question answering (QA), and whether each modality contributes equally across questions, models, and tasks remains poorly understood. In this work, we study how modality-aware retrieval affects downstream inference in a multimodal GraphRAG pipeline, using document visual question answering (DocVQA) as a testbed. We extend an existing KG-based QA framework to be modality-aware, leveraging the graph structure to track which modality supports which facts and to selectively filter evidence at the edge level. This enables us to investigate whether providing all available multimodal evidence at inference time benefits QA, and to evaluate the contribution and cooperation of modalities across question, task, and model characteristics. Through a controlled analysis within a state-of-the-art multimodal GraphRAG pipeline, five multimodal LLMs and two DocVQA benchmarks, we find that tables and text provide the strongest contributions, and that combining modalities frequently produces redundancy rather than synergy, particularly for pairs involving textual information. Positive cooperation appears mainly between non-text modalities and depends on question intent and task type. Our findings argue for selective, modality-aware retrieval in the design of more effective GraphRAG systems, where modalities are filtered according to the downstream task rather than retrieved uniformly.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多模态GraphRAG中模态感知检索对下游QA的影响，发现表格和文本贡献最大，多模态组合常产生冗余而非协同，提倡按任务选择性过滤模态。
AI.motivation: GraphRAG系统通常假设检索越多模态的证据，下游性能越好。但冗余或重叠的多模态证据可能干扰语言模型，且各模态在不同问题、模型、任务中的贡献是否相等尚不清楚。
AI.method: 扩展已有基于KG的QA框架使其模态感知，利用图结构追踪哪些模态支持哪些事实，并在边级别选择性过滤证据。以DocVQA为测试平台，在SOTA多模态GraphRAG流程中进行受控分析，涉及5个多模态LLM和2个DocVQA基准。
AI.result: 表格和文本贡献最强；多模态组合常产生冗余而非协同，尤其涉及文本信息的模态对；正向协同主要出现在非文本模态之间，并取决于问题意图和任务类型。
AI.conclusion: 主张在GraphRAG系统设计中采用选择性、模态感知的检索，根据下游任务过滤模态，而非统一检索所有模态。

title: Multi-SWT-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Reproduction Test Generation
summary: Reproduction test generation translates a natural-language issue description into executable tests that fail on the original code and pass after the issue is resolved, providing executable evidence for verifying candidate patches. Existing benchmarks are constructed for individual programming languages, preventing a unified evaluation across diverse programming ecosystems. To address this limitation, we introduce MULTI-SWT-BENCH, a multilingual benchmark for reproduction test generation consisting of 1,963 instances across eight programming languages: Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C, and C++. Using this benchmark, we conduct an empirical study of state-of-the-art LLMs with four representative methods (MSWE-agent, MOpenHands, Codex, and Claude Code) and perform a failure analysis across programming languages. Our evaluation reveals a systematic language gap. Across every evaluated method and LLM, the success rate on Python exceeds the aggregate success rate across all languages, while C++ exhibits particularly low success rates. Our failure analysis identifies both language-specific challenges arising from repository testing conventions and cross-language challenges in inferring implicit setup requirements and preserving the target behavior through iterative revisions. These findings demonstrate the importance of multilingual evaluation and provide actionable directions for developing reproduction test generation methods that generalize across software ecosystems and reliably capture issue-specific behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出多语言复现测试生成基准 MULTI-SWT-BENCH（8种语言，1963实例），揭示LLM存在系统性语言差距。
AI.motivation: 现有复现测试生成基准仅针对单一编程语言，无法跨生态统一评估。
AI.method: 构建含Python、Java、TypeScript、JavaScript、Go、Rust、C、C++八种语言的基准，用四种代表性方法（MSWE-agent、MOpenHands、Codex、Claude Code）对SOTA LLM进行实证研究及跨语言失败分析。
AI.result: 所有方法与LLM在Python上成功率均高于全语言平均成功率，C++成功率尤其低。
AI.conclusion: 失败源于语言特定挑战（仓库测试惯例）与跨语言挑战（隐式setup推断、迭代修订中保持目标行为）；多语言评估必要，为通用方法指明方向。

title: OptiArena: Can LLMs Improve Executable Algorithms under Fixed Resource Budgets?
summary: Static QA and code-generation benchmarks only partially capture the role that large language models (LLMs) now play as coding agents and research tools. We introduce OptiArena, a budget-controlled testbed for studying whether LLMs can improve executable game-playing algorithms through five rounds of code edits within a fixed minimal scaffold and under bounded evaluator feedback and fixed resource budgets. The testbed uses two optimization regimes, surface obfuscation controls, calibrated references, held-out/stress splits, and diagnostics for degradation and exceptional failures, with LLM API cost reported separately from local evaluator wall-clock. The empirical study asks three questions: whether models can close the calibrated gap between a designated weak starter and an editable competent baseline, whether they can refine editable competent baselines without damaging them, and whether gains survive surface obfuscation controls. Across twelve frontier LLMs and five games, models improve designated weak starters more consistently than they refine editable competent baselines, with substantial variation across games and models. OptiArena provides a practical testbed for measuring bounded-resource algorithm optimization within the five-edit, fixed-scaffold setting studied here. Code is available at https://github.com/WJ-Peng/OptiArena.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OptiArena，一个预算受控的测试平台，用于研究LLM能否在固定脚手架与有限反馈/资源下通过五轮代码编辑改进可执行的博弈算法，并在12个前沿LLM和5个游戏上进行了实证研究。
AI.motivation: 现有静态QA和代码生成基准只能部分反映LLM作为编码代理和研究工具的角色，缺乏对"有限资源下算法优化能力"的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建预算受控测试平台OptiArena，采用最小固定脚手架、五轮代码编辑、两种优化机制、表面混淆控制、校准参考、留出/压力划分，以及退化和异常失败诊断；LLM API成本与本地评估器墙钟时间分开报告。
AI.result: 在12个前沿LLM和5个游戏上，模型改进"指定弱启动器"比精炼"可编辑的胜任基线"更为稳定一致，且不同游戏和模型间差异显著；部分增益可在表面混淆控制下保持。
AI.conclusion: OptiArena为在五轮编辑、固定脚手架设定下测量有限资源算法优化提供了实用测试平台。

title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. We further review state space paradigms, learning paradigms, supervision signals, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open directions toward agentic-native temporal modeling and video-native agents. Project page: https://github.com/DXY0711/Awesome-Agentic-Video-Understanding

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于“视频理解智能体”的综述，形式化智能体循环，提出“挑战到设计”分类法，并综述状态空间、学习范式、监督信号、基准与评测，最后展望智能体原生时间建模与视频原生智能体方向。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM能处理更多模态和更长时序上下文，固定式视频-语言推理的局限显现，研究转向能主动决定检视、保留、验证与行动信息的智能体系统，故需系统梳理该领域。
AI.method: 综述方法：形式化视频理解的智能体循环；以“挑战到设计”分类法组织文献，将上下文瓶颈、证据稀疏、时序因果、多模态歧义分别关联到分层证据记忆、主动证据获取、状态与过程跟踪、角色专门化协同；并梳理状态空间范式、学习范式、监督信号、基准与评测协议。
AI.result: 给出统一的智能体循环形式化与四类挑战-设计映射框架；系统整理了状态空间、学习、监督、基准和评测的现有工作；指出开放方向。
AI.conclusion: 视频理解正从固定推理走向主动式智能体范式，未来方向是智能体原生时间建模与视频原生智能体。

title: Beyond the Graph: An Adaptive Meta-Learner Fuses Explainability, Weather, and Dynamics for Robust Bus ETA Prediction
summary: Accurate bus Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is vital for urban mobility, passenger satisfaction, and transit efficiency, yet existing models falter against nonlinear spatiotemporal dynamics, data sparsity, and factors such as weather. This paper proposes HYB(nm), an adaptive hybrid ensemble framework that dynamically fuses five complementary models - a historical baseline (MST-AV), periodical temporal pattern analysis (GDRN-DFT), Koopman Neural Operators for nonlinear dynamics (KOOP-NET), weather-integrated feature-engineered neural networks (FENN), and real-time graph convolutional networks (MGCN) - via a meta-learner attuned to real-time context. Evaluated on GPS and weather data from three Kolkata bus routes comprising more than 4,000 trips, the framework leverages the individual strengths of its components (for example, the low-latency explainability of MST-AV, the weather resilience of FENN, and the network-dynamics capture of MGCN) to deliver the superior robustness of HYB(2), state-of-the-art accuracy rivalling leading graph neural networks, and balanced trade-offs in stability and efficiency across prediction horizons and operating conditions. The extensible HYB(k) architecture equips transit agencies with flexible tools, ranging from economical single models to tailored high-fidelity hybrids, advancing predictive, equitable urban transport.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HYB(nm)自适应混合集成框架，动态融合五种互补模型（MST-AV、GDRN-DFT、KOOP-NET、FENN、MGCN），通过元学习器实现公交ETA精准预测，在加尔各答三条线路超4000次行程上达到媲美领先GNN的精度与更优鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 准确的公交到站时间（ETA）预测对城市出行、乘客满意度和公交效率至关重要，但现有模型难以应对非线性时空动态、数据稀疏以及天气等因素，导致预测不准。
AI.method: 提出HYB(nm)自适应混合集成框架，动态融合五种互补模型：历史基线(MST-AV)、周期性时序模式分析(GDRN-DFT)、Koopman神经算子非线性动态(KOOP-NET)、天气融合特征工程神经网络(FENN)、实时图卷积网络(MGCN)，并由感知实时上下文的元学习器进行融合。
AI.result: 在加尔各答三条公交线路、逾4000次行程的GPS与天气数据上评估，HYB(2)展现优越鲁棒性，精度媲美领先图神经网络，并在不同预测时域与运行条件下实现稳定性与效率的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的HYB(k)架构为公交机构提供从经济单模型到定制高保真混合模型的灵活工具，推动预测性与公平的城市交通发展。

title: What Does the Rank Buy? A Spectral and Distributional Analysis of Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: The rank $r$ in LoRA is widely treated as a capacity control: a smaller rank is assumed to yield a simpler model that generalizes better. We show that, under hard per-factor norm budgets---the idealization of the weight decay and norm control used in practice---this intuition breaks down. The reason is structural: under such budgets, the updates LoRA can reach are exactly the matrices of rank at most $r$ inside a nuclear-norm ball, and every complexity and displacement functional we analyze is maximized over this set by a rank-one update---so the rank cap never binds. The consequences follow directly. The linear-readout model class we study is identical for every $r \ge 1$, its Rademacher complexity carries no dependence on $r$, and the distance the adaptation can move the source distribution obeys a rank-independent upper bound that we show is sharp. If rank does not control capacity, where does it act? We identify two places. Statistically, replacing the per-factor budgets with a joint budget on the product restores a data-dependent, rank-sensitive complexity bound---though the gain appears only for well-spread feature distributions, and the worst case remains rank-free. Spectrally, rank sets the price of adaptation: canceling the leading singular directions of the pretrained weight requires both sufficient rank and sufficient budget. We bound the smallest rank achieving a desired source--target alignment, with upper and lower bounds that match under two-sided spectral decay. Together, these results recast rank as governing which updates are reachable and what cancellation costs---not how much capacity the model has.

AI.tldr: 在硬性逐因子范数预算下，LoRA 的秩 r 并不控制模型容量：可达更新恰为核范数球内的秩 ≤r 矩阵，且所有复杂度/位移泛函都被秩一更新最大化，因此秩上限从不生效。秩真正作用在于：联合预算下恢复秩敏感的复杂度界，以及决定消去预训练权重主导奇异方向的"代价"。
AI.motivation: LoRA 中秩 r 被普遍视为容量控制：秩越小模型越简单、泛化越好。作者要检验这一直觉在实践所用的权重衰减/范数控制（即硬性逐因子范数预算）下是否成立，并重新定位秩的真实作用。
AI.method: 理论分析。在硬性逐因子范数预算下刻画 LoRA 可达更新集合（核范数球内秩 ≤r 矩阵）；分析线性读出模型类的 Rademacher 复杂度与源分布位移；对比逐因子预算与乘积上的联合预算；分析秩对消去预训练权重主导奇异方向所需预算的影响，推导源-目标对齐的最小秩上下界。
AI.result: 可达更新集合对所有 r≥1 相同，Rademacher 复杂度不含 r，源分布位移有秩无关且紧的上界；改用乘积联合预算可恢复依赖数据的秩敏感复杂度界（但仅对特征分布分散时有效，最坏情况仍秩无关）；秩与预算共同决定消去主导奇异方向的代价，在双侧谱衰减下上下界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 秩不应被理解为容量控制，而应理解为"可达更新"的资格与"消去代价"的定价：它决定哪些更新可达到、以及抵消预训练主方向需付出多少秩与预算。

title: OSCC: Certified Observation-Safe Coupling Optimization for Gradient-Noise Control in Imperfect-Information Learning
summary: Coupled rollouts can reduce the noise of counterfactual action comparisons, but two issues prevent standard common-random-number constructions from serving as a general learning primitive in imperfect-information environments. First, an invalid coupling may expose hidden state, synchronize endogenous policy randomness, or misalign chance events after counterfactual histories diverge. Second, in multi-action policy optimization, lower return-contrast variance is not by itself the relevant objective: the optimizer depends on the return covariance matrix after projection through the local policy-gradient geometry. We introduce observation-safe counterfactual coupling (OSCC), a framework that defines an admissible class through marginal preservation, information-state safety, branch-local policy randomness, semantic event alignment, and trace-before-oracle replay. We derive a gradient-aware coupling criterion showing that, for marginal-preserving couplings, policy-gradient noise changes are determined by policy-Jacobian-weighted off-diagonal return covariance. This motivates OSCC-Select, a calibration-only selector that chooses among independent, root-only, continuation-only, and fully coupled rollouts using separate safety and gain certificates. Its gain target combines projected gradient noise with measured physical sampling cost and falls back to independent sampling whenever a simultaneous lower confidence bound does not certify improvement. On 100,000 fixed-root Leduc comparisons, the fully coupled CP-GRPO instantiation reduces return-contrast variance from 41.1158 to 18.1441, a 55.87% reduction, while preserving the declared branch marginals. With three actions, OSCC-Select chooses continuation coupling and attains gradient-noise trace 0.0783 versus 0.0917 for return-variance selection. Increasing calibration from 64 to 2,048 groups raises certification from 0.327 to 0.995.

AI.tldr: 提出观测安全反事实耦合(OSCC)框架及OSCC-Select选择器，用梯度感知准则替代单纯方差目标，在Leduc中降低返差方差55.87%并提升认证率。
AI.motivation: 反事实耦合可降噪，但在非完全信息环境中存在暴露隐藏状态、同步内生策略随机性、机会事件错位等问题；且多动作优化中低返差方差并非正确目标，优化器依赖经策略梯度几何投影后的回报协方差矩阵。
AI.method: 定义可接受耦合类，需满足边际保持、信息状态安全、分支局部策略随机性、语义事件对齐、先迹后oracle重放；推导梯度感知耦合准则，证明边际保持下策略梯度噪声变化由策略雅可比加权的非对角回报协方差决定；提出OSCC-Select，基于安全与增益证书在独立、仅根、仅延续、全耦合间选择，增益目标结合投影梯度噪声与物理采样成本，未通过同时下置信界认证时回退独立采样。
AI.result: 10万固定根Leduc对比中，全耦合CP-GRPO将返差方差从41.1158降至18.1441(降55.87%)并保持分支边际；三动作时OSCC-Select选延续耦合，梯度噪声迹0.0783优于返差方差选择的0.0917；校准组从64增至2048，认证率由0.327升至0.995。
AI.conclusion: OSCC为不完全信息环境提供了通用、安全的反事实耦合学习原语，梯度感知选择优于单纯方差准则，且校准规模显著提升认证可靠性。

title: Can Generative Retrievers Learn Semantic IDs Without Forgetting How to Speak?
summary: Generative retrieval (GR) enables end-to-end retrieval by generating document semantic identifiers (SIDs). However, retrieval-only fine-tuning can over-specialize pretrained language models to SID prediction, substantially distorting their natural-language distribution and limiting their suitability for interactive systems that must both retrieve documents and generate natural-language responses. We introduce SpeakGR, a dual-objective framework that learns SIDs while preserving language generation. It combines supervised SID learning with speak-preserving regularization: an on-policy distillation objective that aligns the current model with a frozen copy of the original model on student-generated prefixes using forward KL over the original text vocabulary. We further propose Adaptive SpeakGR, which dynamically adjusts the preservation strength based on observed language drift. Compared with SFT-only, SpeakGR reduces WikiText-2 forward KL by 81.3-93.8% on MS MARCO and 81.2-85.2% on Natural Questions (NQ) while retaining effective retrieval across three different LLMs. Adaptive SpeakGR further improves retrieval over SpeakGR in most settings while maintaining substantially lower language drift than SFT-only.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpeakGR 双目标框架，在学习文档语义标识符（SID）的同时保留语言生成能力，缓解生成式检索微调导致的语言分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索（GR）通过生成 SID 实现端到端检索，但仅针对检索的微调会让预训练语言模型过度特化于 SID 预测，严重扭曲其自然语言分布，使其不适合既要检索文档又要生成自然语言回复的交互式系统。
AI.method: SpeakGR 结合监督式 SID 学习与"speak-preserving"正则化：采用在策略蒸馏目标，在 student 生成的 prefix 上，用原始文本词表上的前向 KL 将当前模型与冻结的原始模型对齐。进一步提出 Adaptive SpeakGR，根据观测到的语言漂移动态调整保留强度。
AI.result: 相比仅用 SFT，SpeakGR 在 MS MARCO 上将 WikiText-2 前向 KL 降低 81.3-93.8%，在 NQ 上降低 81.2-85.2%，同时在三种不同 LLM 上保持有效检索性能。Adaptive SpeakGR 在多数设置下进一步提升检索表现，且语言漂移显著低于仅 SFT。
AI.conclusion: 通过保留自然语言生成分布的正则化，可有效平衡生成式检索与语言生成能力，且自适应调节策略能进一步优化检索与语言保持的平衡。

title: TraceLib: System-Call Bitmap Feedback Mechanism for Language-Agnostic Web Fuzzing
summary:
Coverage feedback is an important source of guidance for fuzzing. However, obtaining such feedback normally requires application-level instrumentation that is specific to the language and runtime of the application. Given that modern web applications span multiple languages and runtimes, this application-level instrumentation is costly to implement and maintain. Therefore, we present TraceLib, a system-call feedback mechanism for enabling language-agnostic web fuzzing. Our proposed approach observes the transitions of system calls, enriches selected transitions with bounded argument hashes, and converts them into a 65,536-position AFL-like bitmap. By using the generated bitmap, any web fuzzer can decide whether to retain requests that add previously unseen bitmap positions without consulting application code coverage.
  We integrate TraceLib into WebFuzz and evaluate it under five WebFuzz feedback modes: the two proposed TraceLib variants (one over every traced system call and one projected onto monitored file paths and recognized SQL buffers), the N-gram comparator adapted from Xiao et al. representing the most recent work to our knowledge, WebFuzz's Native grey-box feedback, and black-box fuzzing without feedback. We evaluate TraceLib on sixteen web applications under test (WUTs): eight PHP applications and eight further applications spanning Node.js, Ruby, Java, Go, and Python to demonstrate platform portability. The results show that our proposed TraceLib projected exceeds black-box on all eight PHP WUTs while exceeding Native on four: Joomla, Drupal, PrestaShop, and Bagisto. In addition, measured on an identical replayed request workload, the tracer costs approximately one millisecond of server-side latency per request. These results indicate that compact system-call feedback is a useful runtime-independent proxy for coverage guidance.

AI.tldr: TraceLib 提出一种语言无关的系统调用反馈机制用于 Web 模糊测试，将系统调用转换及有界参数哈希映射为 65,536 位 AFL 式位图，无需应用级插桩即可指导 Web 模糊器保留新覆盖请求。
AI.motivation: 传统覆盖反馈依赖特定语言和运行时的应用级插桩，而现代 Web 应用跨多语言与运行时，插桩成本高、难维护，因此需要语言无关的反馈方案。
AI.method: 观察系统调用转换，对选定转换加入有界参数哈希，生成 65,536 位的 AFL 式位图；集成到 WebFuzz，并设计两种 TraceLib 变体（全系统调用版与投影到监控文件路径及识别 SQL 缓冲区的投影版），与 N-gram 比较器、Native 灰盒反馈及黑盒模式对比。
AI.result: 在 16 个 Web 应用（8 个 PHP 及 Node.js、Ruby、Java、Go、Python 应用）上评估；TraceLib 投影版在全部 8 个 PHP 应用上超过黑盒，并在 Joomla、Drupal、PrestaShop、Bagisto 四个上超过 Native；相同重放负载下追踪器约增加 1ms 服务器端延迟。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的系统调用反馈可作为运行时无关的覆盖引导有效代理，实现语言无关的 Web 模糊测试。

title: KinyaMed: Seeds, Not Rows -- What a Corpus Requirement Written in the Wrong Unit Fails to Constrain
comment: 34 pages, 10 tables, 1 figure. Negative-results and methodology paper; no model performance claims are made
summary: Triage decides who is seen first. Building an urgency classifier for patient-voice Kinyarwanda, we found our specification could be met without producing anything it was meant to secure. We report that, and the instruments that detect it, instead of a classifier. Designed for the four languages a Rwandan health centre receives, with every instrument per-language: sentences are authored in all four arms and rows generate in one, because the frame slots those three need do not exist. Our requirement asked for one million examples; generation produced them in 130 seconds. It fails four of the nine quality gates in that specification, six when rows are attributed to their source sentence. The binding gate counts distinct authored seed phrases, not rows: at our 165, no corpus passes at any row count. Two shortfalls follow and differ: 2,835 further sentences to pass the seed-count gate, 19,835 to reach the stated million rows, because a separate gate caps a seed at 50 rows. Rows come from a machine at 7,700 per second; seeds from clinicians. A row count constrains the cheap quantity, leaves the expensive one free, and so does not constrain quality at all. Two further negatives follow. An evaluation set of 17,942 rows built from nine distinct sentences supports no verdict: our gate, which counts distinct sentences, refuses 38 of its cells and reports nothing. A model trained on a corpus of uniform surface form changes its predicted urgency for 31.5% of inputs under capitalisation and 21.0% under a single typo, reported as measurement and not attribution. A model directory shipped without its tokenizer loads without error and answers its class prior on input it cannot read, with well-formed probabilities. No figure here is evidence of model quality; the contribution is the apparatus and the negative results it produced, reproducible from a clean clone except where marked NOT REPRODUCIBLE.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一种检测工具,用于证伪患者语音基尼亚卢旺达语急诊分诊紧迫度分类器的质量规范;结果表明所生成语料的规格可在不产生其本应保障之物的情况下被满足,故作者报告该负面结果与检测工具而非分类器。
AI.motivation: 急诊分诊决定患者就诊顺序,作者尝试为卢旺达健康中心接收的四种语言(含患者语音基尼亚卢旺达语)构建紧迫度分类器。其动机是揭示:规范可被"形式满足"却未真正保障质量,从而警示语料与评测设计中的度量缺陷。
AI.method: 面向四种语言逐语言构建检测工具:句子在四语分支中撰写,而数据行仅在其中一分支生成(另三语所需槽位不存在)。规范要求一百万条样本,生成在130秒内完成。用九项质量门(quality gates)检验,并将其与"行归属到源句"版本对比;核心约束门统计的是不同撰写种子短语数而非行数。另构建评测集与训练模型,做大小写与拼写扰动测试,并测试缺少分词器时的模型加载行为。
AI.result: 生成语料在九项质量门中有四项不合格,若将行归属到源句则达六项不合格。关键的种子数门在165个种子下任何行数均不通过:距通过种子门还差2,835句,距百万行还差19,835句(另一门将单种子上限设为50行)。行由机器以每秒7,700条产出,种子来自临床医生。由9个不同句子构建的17,942行评测集无法给出结论:门拒绝其中38个单元且不报告任何结果。均匀表面形式训练的模型在大小写变化下对31.5%输入的紧迫度预测改变,单个拼写错误下为21.0%。不含分词器的模型目录可无错加载,并对无法读取的输入返回其类先验,且概率形式良好。
AI.conclusion: 行数约束的是廉价量(机器生成行),放任昂贵量(临床医生种子),因此根本不能约束质量。无数值可作为模型质量证据;本文贡献在于该检测工具及其产生的负面结果,除标注为不可复现处外均可从干净克隆复现。

title: OmniFysics-Captioner Technical Report: Grounding Omni-Modal Understanding in the Physical World for Better Captioning
summary: Building omni-modal models with physical intelligence requires fine-grained supervision that captures physical evidence such as contact, support, deformation, and state transitions. However, existing omni-modal captioners primarily model general audiovisual semantics and often overlook transient or spatially localized physical evidence. We present a unified framework for physics-aware audiovisual captioning spanning data construction, training, and evaluation. Firstly, we build a data construction pipeline that identifies physics-rich clips and leverages OmniFysics-Agent to coordinate audio, visual, and physical-perception tools for collecting spatiotemporally aligned and traceable cross-modal evidence; within the Agent, a physical perception model (PPM) fine-tuned on approximately 2M image-level samples serves as a dedicated tool for extracting object-interaction and state-change cues. Secondly, we build the Daily-Physics 50K dataset and introduce the evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC) benchmark to evaluate the recovery of physical and cross-modal evidence from generated captions. Finally, we train OmniFysics-Captioner from the resulting data. Our Captioner matches Gemini 3.1 Pro on audiovisual captioning, achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video-captioning benchmarks, and substantially outperforms other open-source models. Ablations show that PPM evidence improves physical coverage and produces finer-grained, more reliable cross-modal descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理感知的音视频字幕统一框架OmniFysics，涵盖数据构建、训练与评估，并训练出OmniFysics-Captioner模型。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态字幕模型主要建模通用音视频语义，忽视瞬态或空间局部的物理证据（如接触、支撑、形变、状态转换）。
AI.method: 构建识别物理丰富片段的流水线，用OmniFysics-Agent协调音频、视觉与物理感知工具采集时空对齐、可追溯的跨模态证据；其中物理感知模型(PPM)在约200万图像级样本上微调，用于提取物体交互与状态变化线索；构建Daily-Physics 50K数据集及证据驱动的OmniPhysCap(OPC)基准。
AI.result: Captioner在音视频字幕上媲美Gemini 3.1 Pro，在多个视频字幕基准上达SOTA，显著优于其他开源模型；消融显示PPM证据提升物理覆盖度，产生更细粒度、更可靠的跨模态描述。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架有效增强物理感知能力，验证了证据驱动方法在音视频字幕中的价值。

title: NanoForecast v0.5: Competitive Time Series Forecasting Through Training Pipeline Optimization
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://github.com/eulogik/NanoForecast
summary: We present NanoForecast v0.5, a 6.5M-parameter forecaster that competes with models 31x its size (TimesFM, 200M parameters) after training pipeline fixes and no architecture change. Retraining the v0.3 architecture with corrected loss-scope handling, tensor shape alignment, and wider augmentation coverage cuts overall Mean Absolute Scaled Error by 43.8% under one fixed protocol (MASE 3.030 to 1.704) on the same data and compute budget. NanoForecast v0.5 beats TimesFM on all three ETT datasets (MASE 0.676/1.110/0.287 vs. 0.705/1.360/0.545) and on exchange rate (4.317 vs. 4.383); TimesFM keeps a clear lead on the high-cardinality electricity and traffic sets. Against PatchTST (15M+ parameters, official configuration), v0.5 wins all three ETT sets. Training takes about 12 hours on a single cloud GPU (NVIDIA T4, Google Colab) and inference needs no GPU (measurements in this paper are on an Apple M4 CPU). We release all code, pretrained checkpoints, and evaluation framework under Apache 2.0 at https://github.com/eulogik/NanoForecast

AI.tldr: NanoForecast v0.5（6.5M参数）通过训练流程修复而非架构改动，与31倍大的TimesFM（200M）竞争，在三个ETT数据集和汇率上超越TimesFM，单块云端GPU训练约12小时，无需GPU推理。
AI.motivation: 展示小模型通过修正训练流程（损失范围处理、张量形状对齐、增强覆盖）即可大幅提升性能，无需改动架构，从而降低训练与推理成本。
AI.method: 在v0.3架构上重训，修复loss-scope处理、张量形状对齐并扩大数据增强覆盖，同一数据与算力预算，固定协议评估。
AI.result: 整体MASE下降43.8%（3.030→1.704）；在三个ETT数据集（0.676/1.110/0.287 vs 0.705/1.360/0.545）与汇率（4.317 vs 4.383）上超过TimesFM，也胜过PatchTST全部三个ETT集；但在高基数electricity和traffic上TimesFM仍领先。
AI.conclusion: 训练流程修正可让小模型具备竞争力，NanoForecast v0.5以Apache 2.0开源代码、预训练权重和评估框架。

title: Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Decentralized multi-agent path finding (MAPF) with communication requires agents to reach individual goals without collisions under partial observability. Learnable policies trained on expert data provide an effective approach to this problem. However, when several coordinated joint actions are valid in the same context, independently sampling from per-agent distributions can recombine locally valid choices into incompatible joint actions. This failure can arise from the final sampling mechanism even when the per-agent action distributions are learned correctly. DMM (Decentralized Master-Mind) addresses this by replacing one-shot action sampling with discrete, iterative refinement of action intents across communication rounds, inspired by denoising in diffusion models. Agents initialize random action intents and refine them through local communication, coupling their choices before commitment. DMM is pretrained with imitation learning on expert MAPF solutions and further optimized with MICPO, a critic-free group-relative reinforcement-learning method designed for multi-agent, multi-round action refinement. DMM generally achieves higher success rates and lower solution costs than the evaluated learnable baselines. On 1,600 MovingAI tasks, DMM fine-tuned with MICPO solves 1,598, the highest coverage among the evaluated methods, while achieving solution costs close to those of the strongest baselines. DMM also scales to over one million simultaneously acting agents in obstacle-rich environments. These results show that round-level intent refinement can improve joint-action coordination while preserving decentralized execution.

AI.tldr: DMM用迭代式动作意图精化替代一次性采样，解决去中心化MAPF中局部有效选择组合成不兼容联合动作的问题，并通过MICPO强化学习优化，在1,600个MovingAI任务上解出1,598个。
AI.motivation: 去中心化MAPF在部分可观测下需要无碰撞到达目标，学习型策略虽有效，但当同一情境存在多个协调联合动作时，逐智能体独立采样可能把局部有效的选择重组为不兼容的联合动作；该失败即便各智能体分布学习正确也会由最终采样机制引发。
AI.method: 提出DMM（Decentralized Master-Mind）：以离散、迭代的动作意图精化替代一次性采样，灵感来自扩散模型去噪。智能体初始化随机动作意图，经多轮局部通信逐步精化，在最终承诺前耦合各自选择。用模仿学习在专家MAPF解上预训练，再用MICPO（无critic的群体相对强化学习，面向多智能体多轮动作精化）进一步优化。
AI.result: 成功率与解成本普遍优于所评估的可学习基线。在1,600个MovingAI任务上，经MICPO微调的DMM解出1,598个，覆盖率为所评估方法中最高，解成本接近最强基线。可扩展至障碍密集环境中超过一百万个同时行动的智能体。
AI.conclusion: 轮级别的意图精化能够在保持去中心化执行的同时改善联合动作协调。

title: Compressing Value Predictions for Learning-Augmented Metrical Task Systems
summary: Learning-augmented algorithms for metrical task systems (MTS) can exploit predictions of canonical dual values, but existing formulations typically require a prediction for every state. We study whether these predictions can be compressed to a small set of representative states while retaining their algorithmic value. We introduce landmark-compressed value predictions, in which the predictor reports predicted dual values only at $m$ landmarks and the remaining values are reconstructed by a Lipschitz extension. Our algorithm achieves additive excess cost $O(T\,r(L) + \sum_t δ_t)$, where $r(L)$ is the covering radius of the landmarks and $δ_t$ measures prediction error up to additive shifts; local and value-dependent bounds refine this guarantee. For sparse landmark sets on unit-spaced finite lines, we prove a matching $Ω(T r_m)$ lower bound for every randomized algorithm using fixed landmarks, even with advance access to their entire exact absolute-value table. The prediction interface also matters: on two states with one landmark, exact absolute values permit horizon-independent excess, whereas exact relative values force worst-case expected excess linear in $T$. We give PAC guarantees for learning compressed prediction tables, with efficient empirical-risk minimization for fixed landmarks. Our results connect metric coverage, prediction interfaces, and learning guarantees for compressed predictions in online MTS.

AI.tldr: 研究metrical task systems的预测压缩：仅在m个landmark处给出对偶值预测，其余用Lipschitz扩展重建，并刻画其算法价值与理论极限。
AI.motivation: 已有learning-augmented MTS算法需要每个状态的对偶值预测，预测开销过大；本文探究能否将预测压缩到少量代表性状态（landmark）而保留算法的竞争/超额代价保证。
AI.method: 提出landmark-compressed value predictions：预测器只在m个landmark报告预测对偶值，其余状态由Lipschitz扩展重建；算法超额代价为O(T r(L) + Σ_t δ_t)，其中r(L)为landmark覆盖半径，δ_t为至多差常数偏移的预测误差，并给出局部与值依赖界。对固定landmark证明Ω(T r_m)下界，比较两种预测接口（绝对/相对值），并给出压缩预测表的PAC学习保证与高效ERM。
AI.result: 获得O(T r(L)+Σ_t δ_t)的超额代价上界；在单位间距有限直线上的稀疏landmark，证明所有使用固定landmark的随机算法均有Ω(T r_m)匹配下界，即使可预先获得完整精确绝对值表。两状态单landmark中，精确绝对值可获与时间视界无关的超额，而精确相对值导致最坏期望超额线性于T。并给出PAC学习保证和固定landmark下的高效经验风险最小化。
AI.conclusion: 预测可被压缩到少量landmark而保留算法价值，但性能受landmark覆盖半径与预测接口限制；结果将度量覆盖、预测接口与在线MTS压缩预测的学习保证联系起来。

title: Rubric-Calibrated Preferences: Cross-Query Calibration of LLM Judgments via Item Response Theory
summary: Rerankers decide which documents users and LLMs see, yet their standard metric, nDCG, relies on human relevance labels that are costly, sparse, noisy, and discretely graded. As rerankers approach each other in quality, nDCG on these labels therefore increasingly fails to separate them. LLM judges could supply dense labels. Relative judgments within one query tell even close candidates apart, yet their scores share no scale across queries. Absolute grades share one scale but are too coarse to distinguish documents of similar relevance. We propose Rubric-Calibrated Preferences (RCP), which combine both kinds of judgment. A listwise Bradley-Terry tournament orders each query's documents, and a rubric of yes/no criteria of increasing stringency provides an absolute standard. Item Response Theory (IRT), which scores test-takers based on their answers to common questions, then uses the shared criteria to put all queries' tournament scores on one scale. RCP's retrieval metric, RCP-nDCG, replaces nDCG's discrete labels with the resulting calibrated relevance probabilities. Against blind grades from 46 external annotators, calibration raises the correlation between a query's mean score and its mean human grade from 0.538 to 0.795. The probabilities rank a useful document above a non-useful one with probability 0.910 (AUC, chance 0.5), versus 0.651 for the benchmark labels. When the annotators' grades prefer one of two rerankers and exactly one metric agrees, that metric is RCP-nDCG in 72.4% of 185 comparisons (chance about 53%). On TREC-DL, RCP-nDCG sides with NIST assessors' grades on every reranker pair that these grades separate significantly. RCP-nDCG also resolves many of nDCG's ties and separates 1.9 times as many reranker pairs on NanoBEIR. Rubric calibration thus turns relative LLM judgments into dense relevance labels that are comparable across queries and agree with human judgment.

AI.tldr: 提出RCP方法，结合列表式Bradley-Terry锦标赛与严格性递增的评分标准(rubric)，用IRT将跨查询的相对LLM判断校准为统一尺度的稠密相关概率，形成新指标RCP-nDCG，比nDCG更好区分近似rerankers并对齐人类判断。
AI.motivation: nDCG依赖人工相关性标签，成本高、稀疏、有噪声且离散分级；当reranker质量接近时难以区分。LLM判断中，查询内相对判断能区分相近候选但跨查询无统一尺度，绝对评分有统一尺度但过粗。需要结合两者优势。
AI.method: RCP：1) 用列表式Bradley-Terry锦标赛对每个查询的文档排序；2) 用严格性递增的yes/no标准(rubric)提供绝对基准；3) 用Item Response Theory(IRT)以共享标准为桥梁，将所有查询的锦标赛分数映射到统一尺度，得到校准后的相关概率；4) 以该概率替换nDCG的离散标签，构成RCP-nDCG。
AI.result: 与46名外部标注者的盲评比较：校准将查询平均分与平均人工评分的相关性从0.538提升到0.795；区分有用/无用文档AUC为0.910（基准标签0.651，随机0.5）。当标注者偏好某reranker且仅一个指标一致时，185次比较中72.4%为RCP-nDCG（随机约53%）。TREC-DL上RCP-nDCG对所有被NIST显著区分的reranker对均与NIST一致；NanoBEIR上解决大量nDCG并列，区分的reranker对数达1.9倍。
AI.conclusion: Rubric校准可将相对LLM判断转化为跨查询可比、与人类判断一致的稠密相关标签，使RCP-nDCG成为更可靠的reranker评估指标。

title: Certified Compilation in the TELEPERM XS Nuclear Safety I&C Platform
summary: The large safety instrumentation & control (I&C) systems in civil nuclear power plants (NPPs) are mainly safe-shutdown systems (reactor protection) or limitation and control systems. Framatome's established TELEPERM XS (TXS Core) product family is a digital I&C system platform to cover all these applications. We illustrate the role of verification in the different stages of the software production toolchain, focus on the formal compilation process, and discuss the contribution of the CompCert certified compiler to the safety case of the product. Scrutinizing the object code produced by this compiler has exhibited suboptimal run-time performance in a certain simple but recurring generated code pattern. We explain how formal methods allow us to address this issue in the compiler while simultaneously reducing its trusted computing base (TCB), thereby strengthening the safety case rather than merely preserving it.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍Framatome核电站安全仪控系统TXS Core平台中形式编译的应用，重点讨论CompCert认证编译器在安全论证中的作用，并说明如何用形式化方法在修复代码生成性能问题的同时缩减可信计算基(TCB)。
AI.motivation: 民用核电站大型安全仪控系统(如紧急停堆系统)对可靠性要求极高，软件工具链尤其是编译过程的正确性直接影响安全论证。现有认证编译器虽提供形式保证，但其生成的某些重复代码模式运行时性能欠佳，需在维持甚至强化安全性的前提下解决。
AI.method: 阐述软件生产工具链各阶段中验证的作用，聚焦形式编译过程；分析CompCert认证编译器对产品安全案例的贡献；识别其目标代码中某类简单但反复出现的次优代码模式；运用形式化方法在编译器内解决该问题，同时缩减TCB。
AI.result: 发现CompCert生成的特定重复代码模式存在运行时性能次优问题；通过形式化方法在编译器层面加以改进，并成功缩减了可信计算基。
AI.conclusion: 形式方法不仅可用于修复认证编译器的性能缺陷，还能通过缩小TCB来加强而非仅仅维持安全论证，对核安全仪控产品具有实际价值。

title: Solving Every Step Is Not Enough: Milestone Oracles Reveal a Composition Gap in LLM Math Reasoning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 47 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can solve every intermediate step of a multi-step math problem on its own and still fail the full problem, even when given a roadmap of the steps and all of their answers. We introduce OracleLadder, a diagnostic evaluation that locates where LLM math reasoning fails by giving the model increasing levels of oracle help. For each problem, a teacher model writes a fixed roadmap of intermediate sub-goals (milestones), and a deterministic symbolic verifier grades every answer. Testing the model with no help, with the roadmap, with the roadmap plus the milestone answers, and on each milestone alone sorts each failure into one of five reasoning gaps. On 354 NuminaMath problems and six models from 8B to 671B parameters (Qwen3, gpt-oss, Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-V3.1), the largest gap for every model is the composition gap, a stricter form of the compositionality gap. It covers 33-48% of problems, and 24-37% after removing problems that an LLM review flags as grading errors. Accuracy and milestone-help recovery rank the two strongest models differently, and two RLVR runs with similar accuracy gains move problems differently. The roadmap effect replicates on MATH500 and AIME 2024/25, per-problem recovery agrees for 83-87% of problems under an independent second teacher, and the help ladder carries over to code generation. We release the data, roadmaps, prompts, and code at https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder.

AI.tldr: 提出 OracleLadder 诊断评估，通过逐级提供 oracle 帮助定位 LLM 数学推理失败环节，发现所有模型最大缺口为"组合缺口"。
AI.motivation: LLM 能解出多步数学题的每个中间步骤，却仍可能在给出步骤路线图及答案的情况下做不出整题，需要定位其推理失败的具体位置。
AI.method: 教师模型为每题写固定的里程碑（子目标）路线图，确定性符号验证器给分。在无帮助、仅路线图、路线图+里程碑答案、单里程碑四种条件下测试模型，将失败归为五类推理缺口。
AI.result: 在 354 道 NuminaMath 题与 6 个 8B–671B 模型上，最大缺口为"组合缺口"（更严格的组合性缺口），占 33–48% 题目，剔除评分错误后为 24–37%。准确率与里程碑恢复能对最强模型给出不同排序；两次 RLVR 训练对题目的影响不同。结论在 MATH500、AIME 2024/25 上复现，更换教师模型后 83–87% 题目恢复一致，并迁移至代码生成。
AI.conclusion: OracleLadder 能有效诊断 LLM 多步推理失败位置，揭示组合缺口是主要瓶颈，且评估手段具有良好的可复现性与迁移性。

title: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady Technical Report: Agentic Physical Simulation for Pragmatic 3D World Reconstruction
summary: Agentic recognition requires visual perception to move beyond static scene understanding and produce structured scene representations that support the perception--reasoning--action loop. Existing single-image 3D generation methods, however, mainly produce visually plausible object assets rather than simulation-ready scene states. When independently generated meshes are composed in a shared space, they may fail to align with the input camera, violate gravity, interpenetrate nearby objects, or become unstable under physics simulation. We present Fysiverse-3D-SimReady, a grounded refinement framework for reconstructing simulation-ready multi-object scenes from a single RGB image with instance and ground prompts. The method places generated object meshes into a shared gravity-aligned scene, refines their camera-space poses through differentiable rendering, and corrects scene-level supports and contacts for stable physical execution. The scene is then used by an agentic simulation workflow, which converts a scene-specific task goal into an executable physics rollout rendered from the original camera view. Experiments show that Fysiverse-3D-SimReady improves input-view alignment, contact plausibility, and physical stability over existing single-image reconstruction and scene generation baselines, while enabling goal-conditioned physical interactions from a single image.

AI.tldr: 提出了Fysiverse-3D-SimReady框架，从单张RGB图像重建可用于物理仿真的多物体场景，通过可微渲染优化位姿并修正接触与支撑关系，实现目标驱动的物理交互。
AI.motivation: 现有单图3D生成方法主要产出视觉上合理的物体资产，而非可直接仿真的场景状态。独立生成的网格组合到共享空间时，会出现与输入相机不对齐、违反重力、与邻近物体相互穿插、物理模拟下不稳定等问题。而智能体识别需要支持感知-推理-动作循环的结构化场景表示。
AI.method: 方法将生成的目标网格放入共享的重力对齐场景中，通过可微渲染细化其相机空间位姿，并修正场景级的支撑与接触以实现稳定的物理执行。随后，场景被智能体仿真工作流使用，将场景特定任务目标转换为可执行的物理仿真，并从原始相机视角渲染。
AI.result: 实验表明，Fysiverse-3D-SimReady在输入视角对齐、接触合理性和物理稳定性方面优于现有的单图重建与场景生成基线，同时能够从单张图像实现目标条件的物理交互。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了单图重建到可仿真场景的鸿沟，为从单张图像进行目标驱动的物理交互提供了可行方案。

title: Active Causal Discovery Benchmark: Evaluating LLM Agents Under Budgeted Interventions
summary: We introduce the Active Causal Discovery Benchmark (ACDB), an SCM-grounded environment for evaluating whether LLM agents recover causal graph structure from observations and budget-constrained hard interventions. ACDB pairs a linear-Gaussian world generator with a fixed observe-intervene-submit API and a three-layer scoring contract that separates skeleton recovery, DAG recovery, and intervention efficiency. On the current six-level ladder, PC with a greedy active orientation heuristic is the strongest non-oracle method (directed F1 42.7%, SHD 4.79), ahead of Claude Sonnet 4.6 raw active (31.7%, 7.25) and GPT-5.4 raw active (22.9%, 9.27). The most informative diagnostic is the precision-recall decomposition: PC under-commits with high precision, LLMs over-commit with lower precision, and statistical-tool access often increases abstention rather than useful intervention. A structure-blind random DAG baseline reaches 23.6% directed F1 on this dense v0 ladder; a density probe lowers this floor to 16.9%, motivating the v1 calibration pass. The current results should therefore be read as a benchmark audit and calibration report, not as evidence that current LLMs solve active causal discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACDB基准，用于评估LLM智能体在预算约束干预下恢复因果图结构的能力，并给出当前校准性审计结果。
AI.motivation: 现有工作缺乏一个以SCM为基础、能系统评估LLM主动因果发现能力的标准化环境，尤其在观测与预算受限干预场景下。
AI.method: 构建线性高斯世界生成器，配以固定observe-intervene-submit API与三层评分契约（骨架恢复、DAG恢复、干预效率），形成六层难度梯度。
AI.result: PC+贪心主动定向最强（directed F1 42.7%，SHD 4.79），优于Claude Sonnet 4.6（31.7%，7.25）和GPT-5.4（22.9%，9.27）；结构盲随机DAG基线达23.6%，密度探测可降至16.9%。
AI.conclusion: 当前结果应视为基准审计与校准报告，而非LLM已解决主动因果发现的证据；v1将进行校准改进。

title: A Benchmark for LLM's Understanding of Middle School and High School Science Topics
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into educational settings, yet educators lack robust, standards-aligned tools to evaluate their effectiveness in K-12 science contexts. Existing benchmarks predominantly assess general language or advanced scientific reasoning, leaving a critical gap in understanding LLMs' performance on content directly relevant to secondary science curricula. To address this gap, we developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for both middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Nine open-weight LLMs were systematically evaluated using this benchmark, indicating that several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types. Our findings indicate that model size did not consistently predict performance, emphasizing the importance of intentional model selection for educational deployment. We then incorporated a human reviewer into the loop, reviewing the items generated by the LLMs for alignment with NGSS standards.
