To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个大规模细粒度交互式CAPTCHA训练数据集CaptchaArena，并基于其训练统一的9B策略CaptchaAgent。
AI.motivation: 现有CAPTCHA数据集在类型覆盖、交互保真度和轨迹监督之间难以兼顾，交互式CAPTCHA对计算机使用智能体仍是难题。
AI.method: 构建CaptchaArena，含50K题、20种类型、5种交互模式，提供经执行的50K截图-动作轨迹（46K含推理标注、不规则目标像素掩码标注）；训练单一9B模型CaptchaAgent，采用SFT加RL，环境验证器直接提供RL奖励。
AI.result: SFT达到70.5 Pass@1，RL提升至71.7，并在两个外部基准上取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 大规模细粒度计算机使用监督对训练交互式CAPTCHA智能体具有重要价值，数据集与模型已开源。

title: Depth Laws for the Precision Floor of Trained Neural Networks: Amplification, Residual Scaling, and a Quantization-Aware Training Paradox
summary: How many bits does a network need before its accuracy collapses, and how does this grow with depth? We study the precision floor, the perturbation level or bit-width at which accuracy falls halfway to chance, in MLPs, CNNs, Vision Transformers and nine pretrained language models, under post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization- or noise-aware training (QAT). (i) A first-order theory sets the floor through one full-precision quantity, the predictive amplification $G$: $η_c=Λ/G$, and $G^2$ grows linearly in depth at a rate proportional to the squared residual branch scale. (ii) The predicted equality $α_{PTQ}=ρ$ of depth exponents holds within 95% intervals in twelve of thirteen trained architectures and in GPT-2 from 12 to 48 layers, with $Λ=1.45\pm14\%$ across trained architectures. (iii) Residual branches scaled by $1/\sqrt{D}$ and pre-normalisation remove the depth penalty, and each quantizer turns noise into bits at a rate fixed by its step rule, giving $b_c=(α/γ)\log_2 D+C$. (iv) A QAT paradox: noise-aware training roughly doubles the tolerable noise of shallow networks, but the gain decays with depth, so the depth law steepens ($α_{QAT}/α_{PTQ}=1.45$-$1.47$ on two datasets, ten seeds each). Decision margins, cross-layer error cancellation and heavy tails do not set the floor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经网络精度崩溃所需的比特数与深度的关系，提出“精度下限”概念，通过预测放大因子G建立一阶理论，并在MLP、CNN、ViT及九个预训练语言模型上验证。
AI.motivation: 网络在量化或扰动下精度何时崩溃，以及这一临界点如何随深度增长，是一个关键但未被系统理解的问题。作者希望揭示精度下限的底层机制。
AI.method: 提出一阶理论，用预测放大G刻画精度下限η_c=Λ/G，并预测G²随深度线性增长（速率与残差分支尺度平方成正比）。在PTQ和QAT下测试MLP、CNN、ViT和九个预训练语言模型，分析深度指数、残差缩放与预归一化、量化器步长规则等。
AI.result: (i) 理论预测η_c=Λ/G，G²随深度线性增长；(ii) 深度指数相等α_PTQ=ρ在13个架构中的12个及12-48层GPT-2上以95%区间成立，Λ=1.45±14%；(iii) 1/√D残差缩放和预归一化消除深度惩罚，比特下限b_c=(α/γ)log₂D+C；(iv) QAT悖论：噪声感知训练使浅层网络容忍噪声约翻倍，但增益随深度衰减，深度律变陡（α_QAT/α_PTQ=1.45-1.47）。决策边界、跨层误差抵消和重尾并非下限成因。
AI.conclusion: 精度下限由预测放大G统一支配，深度惩罚可通过残差缩放和预归一化消除，量化器决定噪声-比特转换率；QAT的收益随深度递减导致深度律更陡。

title: From Trajectories to Grounded Preferences: Process Preference Synthesis via Interaction Element Graphs for Web PRMs
summary: Comparative Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide critical step-level guidance for autonomous web agents by evaluating state-conditioned preferences between candidate actions. However, existing preference training data synthesized via multi-policy sampling suffers from a severe scarcity of Grounded Minimal Contrastive Pairs (GMCPs)-where competing candidates target genuine on-page elements with identical action types. In representative baselines preference data (namely, WebArbiter), GMCPs account for merely 24.19%, biasing PRMs during training to rely on shallow shortcuts (such as element hallucinations and action type mismatches) rather than acquiring genuine contextual decision semantics. To address these challenges, we propose SURFPRM, a graph-guided process preference synthesis framework for comparative Web PRMs. SURFPRM structures web demonstrations into a persistent Interaction Element Graph that acts as an environment-grounded negative action proposal mechanism, systematically synthesizing contrastive negative actions across spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal confusion axes. This elevates the GMCP proportion from 24.19% to 74.60%, producing the curated SURFPRM-DATA dataset. Across six open-source backbones (3B to 9B parameters), PRMs trained on SURFPRM-DATA outperform baseline-trained models on average on WEBPRMBENCH and rival leading proprietary LLMs. In downstream reward-guided trajectory search on WEBARENA-LITE, SURFPRM provides step-level guidance for both GPT-4o (+14.21%) and GPT-4o-mini (+12.83%) policies, yielding substantial improvements in complex web task success rates.

AI.tldr: SURFPRM利用交互元素图合成高质量的对比负样本，将GMCP比例从24.19%提升至74.60%，显著提升Web智能体过程奖励模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多策略采样合成的偏好训练数据严重缺乏Ground Minimal Contrastive Pairs (GMCPs)，仅占24.19%，导致PRMs依赖浅层捷径（如元素幻觉和动作类型不匹配）而非真正的上下文决策语义。
AI.method: 提出SURFPRM图引导的过程偏好合成框架，将web演示构建为持久化交互元素图，作为环境基础的负动作提议机制，沿空间、时间、时空混淆轴系统合成对比负样本。
AI.result: GMCP比例从24.19%提升至74.60%；在六个3B-9B开源骨干上训练的PRMs在WEBPRMBENCH上超越基线模型并媲美领先专有LLM；下游轨迹搜索中为GPT-4o(+14.21%)和GPT-4o-mini(+12.83%)提供步级指导。
AI.conclusion: SURFPRM通过图引导的偏好数据合成有效解决GMCP稀缺问题，显著提升Web智能体过程奖励模型的决策能力与复杂任务成功率。

title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
summary: When a large language model (LLM) agent executes the same task, token consumption can vary by over an order of magnitude across runs. The agent chooses its next steps based on tool feedback and intermediate results, while the growing context steadily inflates the input size of every subsequent call. The total consumption of a task is therefore hard to predict before execution and the prediction must be revised as the run unfolds. In this paper, we propose TokenCast, which learns a composable cost representation for each execution segment, recording its own consumption and the context growth it introduces. Composing adjacent segments yields a cumulative estimate that captures the extra input cost incurred when context from earlier segments is re-read by every later call. As execution unfolds, newly observed evidence refreshes the forecast, requiring no additional LLM calls and incurring a mean cumulative prediction time of 32.8 ms per run on SWE-bench Verified. Across 4 task suites and 6 agent models, TokenCast's mean absolute error reduction against the strongest comparator averages 14.5% over 96 evaluated combinations. In offline budget-control replay, TokenCast uses 21.3% fewer tokens on average than a fixed-budget policy at matched trace completion. The code is available at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/TokenCast.

AI.tldr: TokenCast 通过为每个执行片段学习可组合的成本表示，实现 LLM agent 任务 token 消耗的实时预测。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 执行同一任务时 token 消耗波动可达一个数量级，且随上下文增长难以在执行前预测，需要随执行动态修正。
AI.method: 为每个执行片段学习可组合的成本表示，记录自身消耗及引入的上下文增长；组合相邻片段得到累计估计，捕捉早期上下文被后续调用重复读取的额外输入成本；新证据可刷新预测，无需额外 LLM 调用。
AI.result: SWE-bench Verified 上平均累计预测时间 32.8 ms/run；4 个任务套件、6 个 agent 模型共 96 组中，MAE 较最强基线平均降低 14.5%；离线预算控制回放中，同等 trace 完成度下比固定预算策略平均少用 21.3% token。
AI.conclusion: TokenCast 提供了高效、准确且可动态更新的 agent token 消耗预测方法，并可改善预算控制。

title: C-HAT-Bench: Benchmarking Chinese AI-Text Detection Beyond Fully Generated Text
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly participate in writing by modifying or extending human drafts, causing machine involvement to vary in both form and extent. Yet most Machine-Generated Text (MGT) detectors are evaluated only on fully human-written versus fully AI-generated text. Because human--AI collaboration can weaken or redistribute cues associated with machine generation, strong performance under this binary setting may overstate detector reliability. This mismatch remains underexplored in Chinese: detection cues are shaped by tokenization and language-specific text distributions, yet controlled resources spanning production settings, domains, and generators remain limited. To fill this gap, we present a Chinese Human-AI Collaborative Text Detection Benchmark (C-HAT-Bench), a unified benchmark that links $5,000$ human-written source texts from five domains to more than $240,000$ variants produced using six generative models under Prefix-Conditioned Continuation as a reference setting and three collaborative production modes. We evaluate $21$ detectors through four protocols spanning zero-shot and pretrained supervised document-level detection, boundary localization, and cross-condition generalization. Relative to Prefix-Conditioned Continuation, mean AUROC across document-level detectors is $12.0\%$ lower on the collaborative production modes, with the largest detector-specific relative decrease reaching $44.4\%$. Transfer across collaborative production modes is also asymmetric, indicating that performance in a given production setting is not a reliable predictor of performance in other production settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出中文人机协作文本检测基准 C-HAT-Bench，揭示现有 MGT 检测器在人机协作场景下性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有机器生成文本检测器多只在"纯人类"与"纯AI"二元设定下评测，但现实中 LLM 更多是修改或续写人类草稿，人机协作会削弱或重新分布机器生成线索，导致二元设定下表现被高估；中文因分词与语言分布差异，检测线索不同，却缺乏受控资源。
AI.method: 构建 C-HAT-Bench：将 5 个领域的 5,000 篇人类原文，与 6 个生成模型在 Prefix-Conditioned Continuation 参考设定及三种协作生产模式下生成的超过 240,000 个变体相连接；用四种协议评测 21 个检测器，涵盖零样本与预训练监督的文档级检测、边界定位和跨条件泛化。
AI.result: 相比 Prefix-Conditioned Continuation，文档级检测器在协作生产模式上的平均 AUROC 低 12.0%，单一检测器最大相对下降达 44.4%；跨协作生产模式的迁移呈不对称性，说明某设定下的表现不能可靠预测其他设定下的表现。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作显著削弱中文 MGT 检测可靠性，二元评测会高估检测器能力；需要面向协作生产模式、具备跨条件泛化能力的检测方法与评测。

title: Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures, plus 25-page online appendix (included). Under review
summary: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

AI.tldr: 国会女议员在电视新闻中更常以分屏而非单人镜头出现，这种视觉框架在静态画面中会降低她们被感知的政治能力，但在动态视频中该惩罚消失，取而代之的是愤怒语言对女性温暖感知的更大损害。
AI.motivation: 女性在国会中的比例停滞在30%以下，电视新闻中的可见度也有限，而视觉呈现会影响感知的能力与权威。已有研究更多关注女议员是否出现，而非她们如何被视觉框架呈现。
AI.method: 对CNN和Fox News（2011-2021）695,464个图文片段进行面部识别分析；并开展两项预注册实验，共6,220名参与者，分别测试静态画面中的分屏框架效应和动态视频中愤怒语言的影响。
AI.result: 女议员在分屏镜头中比例过高；静态框架下分屏降低女议员的政治能力感知但不影响男议员；动态视频中能力惩罚消失，愤怒语言对女议员温暖感知的削弱约为男议员的三倍；女性观众观看女议员单人镜头后外部政治效能感更高的证据具有提示性（p = .057）。
AI.conclusion: 视觉框架既塑造了女议员在媒体中的可见性，也影响其被感知的能力，媒体呈现方式对女性政治代表具有实质性后果。

title: When Should a Human Take Back Control? Optimal Delegation under Turbulent AI Risk
summary: Deploying AI systems requires deciding when to delegate tasks and when humans should intervene to monitor and mitigate risk induced by AI operations. These decisions are challenging when failures cluster: a hallucination or harmful output can trigger further errors, creating periods of elevated risk. We introduce a continuous-time framework for learning adaptive human oversight under such turbulent AI risk. Existing oversight and delegation formulations condition on history but do not model incident clustering, or its suppression by supervision effort, jointly with the delegation decision and this study fixes this gap. The self-exciting dynamics capture how risk events increase the likelihood of subsequent events, making their timing and history central to decision-making. We formulate a stochastic control problem combining human actions, monitoring effort, and switching between human-AI-assisted operation and full AI delegation, balancing operational rewards against oversight costs, and cascading AI-failures and induced uncertainty. Human participation is an endogenous component of risk management: the policy determines both when oversight is needed and how much effort to allocate. We study a relaxed switching formulation and propose Hawkes-PPO, a policy-gradient method that uses a bank of exponential filters of observed incident times. In a synthetic environment it attains a higher risk-adjusted objective than either fixed regime and approaches an approximate full-information oracle. We illustrate our results with numerical simulations by examining how cascade risks influence intervention and delegation, connecting reinforcement learning with adaptive human oversight of AI systems. In particular, we illustrate the benefit of our switching strategy and Hawkes-PPO algorithm to monitor the project efficiently along time, reducing turbulent risks occurrences and costs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个连续时间框架，用自激（Hawkes）过程建模AI风险事件的聚集性，并学习自适应的人类监督与任务委托策略，提出Hawkes-PPO算法。
AI.motivation: 部署AI系统时需决定何时委托任务、何时由人类介入监控。当失败聚集时（一次幻觉或有害输出可能引发更多错误），产生风险升高的时段，现有监督与委托方法未联合建模事件聚集、监督抑制及委托决策。
AI.method: 用自激过程刻画风险事件相互激发；将问题建模为随机控制问题，联合人类行动、监控努力、AI辅助与完全AI委托间的切换，权衡运营收益、监督成本、级联失败与不确定性。提出松弛切换公式及Hawkes-PPO（使用观测事件时间的指数滤波器组的策略梯度方法）。
AI.result: 在合成环境中，该方法的风险调整目标高于固定策略，并接近近似全信息oracle。数值仿真展示了级联风险如何影响介入与委托决策。
AI.conclusion: 将强化学习与AI系统的自适应人类监督相连接，切换策略与Hawkes-PPO可高效持续监控项目，减少动荡风险的发生与成本。

title: AuthorityLens: Rethinking LLM-Based Agent Systems Through the Lens of Authority
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed with authority over consequential resources and decisions in real systems. These agents often operate alongside human and LLM-based participants who hold different forms of authority. Yet workflow roles, permission settings, and review mechanisms do not necessarily reflect the authority realized in practice. We introduce AuthorityLens, a framework for measuring a system's authority structure. Starting from an authority portfolio, we evaluate a system along three dimensions: what the system is authorized to do (System Authority), how much joint participation is required to exercise that authority (Authority Separation), and how much authority each participant holds (Principal Authority). We derive these measurements from the minimal combinations of participants sufficient to realize each outcome across admissible runtime states. We apply AuthorityLens to Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI across 13 operating configurations over a common portfolio of agent operations. We find that nominal configurations do not map cleanly onto realized authority. In Codex, Full Access changes System Authority only marginally while substantially concentrating authority in the executing Assistant. OpenCode's Build and Plan configurations have the same System Authority and Authority Separation despite different workflows and root-level permissions. In Gemini CLI, model-based review increases Authority Separation without changing System Authority. Principal Authority further distinguishes authority replication from authority separation: spawned or delegated agents can become alternative holders of the same authority without increasing the required joint participation. Together, these results demonstrate that AuthorityLens provides a unified framework for measuring and comparing realized authority structures across agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AuthorityLens框架，从系统权限、权限分离、主体权限三个维度度量LLM智能体系统实际实现的权限结构，并应用于Codex、OpenCode和Gemini CLI。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体常与人类及LLM参与者共同运行并持有不同权限，但工作流角色、权限设置与审查机制未必反映实际权限分配，缺乏量化系统权限结构的方法。
AI.method: 从权限组合出发，基于可实现各结果的最小参与者组合，沿三个维度测量系统：System Authority（系统被授权做什么）、Authority Separation（行使权限所需的联合参与度）、Principal Authority（各参与者持有的权限量）。
AI.result: 应用于Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI的13种配置：Codex的Full Access仅微增System Authority却显著集中权限于Assistant；OpenCode的Build与Plan配置虽工作流和root权限不同但System Authority与Authority Separation相同；Gemini CLI的模型审查提升Authority Separation而不改变System Authority。Principal Authority可区分权限复制与权限分离。
AI.conclusion: 名义配置并不清晰映射到实际权限，AuthorityLens提供统一框架以测量和比较智能体系统的实际权限结构。

title: On the Behavioral Traits of LLM Agents
summary: Users increasingly describe different AI agents as distinct colleagues to work with. AI personality research aims to quantify such impressions by attributing human-like "traits" to agents. However, existing measures fall short: models' self-reports (S-data) diverge from their actual behavior, while informant ratings from LLM judges (I-data) are costly to scale and cover few everyday scenarios. In this paper, we propose A-B-D to infer traits bottom-up from behavioral data (B-data), namely how agents act on their environment and communicate with users, as recorded in existing trajectories. From 345,667 real-world trajectories spanning 80 models, 12 tasks, and 50 harnesses, we extract 318 candidate features that capture both the actions an agent takes at each step (functional) and the language accompanying them (linguistic). We retain only features that show instance-level stability, cross-task consistency, and model discriminability. Factor analysis of the remaining 79 features uncovers six stable, model-attributable factors, two functional and four linguistic. For example, Kimi-K3 exhibits the most planfulness, whereas GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 are the least energetic. Moreover, we quantify the "knowledge-action gap" in the wild: these factors correlate only weakly with self-reported Big Five scores, even for conceptually matched pairs such as extroversion and energetic (r = 0.07, p = 0.58). Our work offers a new lens for understanding AI personality, with implications for users, developers, and researchers from both computer science and social science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-B-D方法，从真实行为轨迹（B-data）自下而上推断AI智能体的"人格特质"，避免自我报告偏差和高成本评判。基于345,667条轨迹、80个模型提取特征并经因子分析得到六个稳定特质，并揭示"知行差距"。
AI.motivation: 用户常将不同AI智能体视为"同事"，但现有AI人格测量存在不足：模型自我报告（S-data）与实际行为脱节，而LLM评判者提供的他评（I-data）成本高、覆盖场景少。
AI.method: 提出A-B-D方法，从已有轨迹中的行为数据（B-data）自下而上推断特质。从跨80模型、12任务、50框架的345,667条真实轨迹中提取318个候选特征（功能性与语言性），筛选出具备实例级稳定性、跨任务一致性和模型区分度的79个特征，再进行因子分析。
AI.result: 因子分析得到六个稳定且可归因于模型的因子（两个功能性、四个语言性）。例如Kimi-K3计划性最强，GPT-5.5与GPT-5.6活力最低。这些因子与自我报告的大五人格分数仅弱相关，即使概念匹配（如外向性与活力，r=0.07, p=0.58），量化了真实场景中的"知行差距"。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解AI人格提供新视角，对用户、开发者及计算机科学与社会科学研究均有启示。

title: Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks
summary: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制变量研究，隔离预训练目标，考察九种视觉-语言预训练目标在五种不同空间粒度的胸片任务上的影响，发现目标粒度与任务粒度在极端情况下对齐，不存在普遍最优的目标。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督的空间粒度上存在差异，但这一差异对胸片（chest X-ray）解读的影响尚缺乏深入研究。
AI.method: 固定编码器与预训练数据，仅改变预训练目标，训练九种目标：涵盖全局与局部对比学习、captioning 及其组合；并在五项空间粒度递增的胸片任务上进行评测。
AI.result: (i) 预训练粒度与任务粒度在极端情况下对齐，局部目标在异常检测上领先，全局目标在分类上领先；(ii) 局部目标在全局级生成与问答任务上出人意料地有竞争力；(iii) captioning 与对比学习在不同粒度上优劣反转；(iv) 组合中，captioning 与对比监督混合在分类和分布内生成上最强，两个 captioning 目标搭配在零样本报告生成上泛化最好。
AI.conclusion: 不存在普遍最优的预训练目标，目标类型、粒度与任务之间的交互共同决定下游性能。

title: Emergent One-Third Scaling Law as Attention Tries to Concentrate
summary: The neural scaling law relating longer training to better performance through a power law is central to today's large language models (LLMs), yet its origin remains debated. One recent proposal is that power laws can emerge from the strong non-linearity of a single softmax head learning peaked distributions. What happens with multiple softmax functions, as in LLMs, is unclear. Here, we show through toy models that any softmax learning peaked distributions, regardless of its position in the model, can develop logit magnitudes that grow in a power law with exponent $1/3$, becoming a training bottleneck whose loss contribution decays as a power law with the same exponent $1/3$. The overall loss therefore obeys $1/3$ scaling whenever at least one softmax learns peaked distributions. We confirm that many softmax functions in LLMs learn peaked distributions and that LLM loss scaling matches this $1/3$ prediction. Moreover, logit growth dynamics reveal that attention heads, rather than the language modeling head, are the bottleneck likely driving the $1/3$ loss scaling in LLMs. Attention trying to concentrate on specific information, which is the heart of Transformers, may therefore also be the heart of the neural scaling law of training.

AI.tldr: 论文通过玩具模型证明任意位置的softmax在学得尖峰分布时logit幅度以1/3幂律增长，成为训练瓶颈，使整体损失呈1/3幂律下降；并在LLM中验证该预测，指出注意力头（而非语言建模头）是驱动1/3损失缩放的关键。
AI.motivation: 神经缩放律（训练越久性能越好，呈幂律）是当今LLM的核心，但其起源仍有争议。已有工作提出幂律可能源于单个softmax头学习尖峰分布时的强非线性，但LLM中存在多个softmax，其行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建玩具模型分析多个softmax学习尖峰分布的情形，推导logit幅度增长与损失贡献的幂律指数；在真实LLM中检查多个softmax是否学得尖峰分布，并对比loss scaling是否符合1/3预测；通过logit增长动态定位瓶颈来源。
AI.result: 任意softmax无论处于模型何处，学得尖峰分布时logit幅度以指数1/3幂律增长，其损失贡献也以1/3幂律衰减；只要至少一个softmax学得尖峰分布，整体损失即服从1/3缩放。LLM中多个softmax确实学得尖峰分布，且LLM损失缩放与该1/3预测吻合；logit增长动态表明注意力头而非语言建模头是驱动1/3损失缩放的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 注意力机制努力聚焦特定信息（Transformer的核心）可能也是训练神经缩放律的核心，将缩放律起源与注意力集中行为联系起来。

title: Reward Hacking and Agent Containment Failure: A Monte Carlo Study Based on the 2026 Hugging Face Incident
comment: 14 pages, research paper, and two figures
summary: The July 2026 intrusion into Hugging Face production infrastructure showed how reward hacking can become an external cybersecurity incident when a capable agent encounters weak containment boundaries. This study develops a probabilistic risk model linking five stages: reward hacking, containment escape, usable access, persistence, and failure of detection. A Monte Carlo simulation evaluates 100,000 runs under each of four control configurations. Input distributions represent explicit uncertainty and are used for comparative analysis rather than real-world frequency prediction. Under the stated assumptions, layered controls reduce simulated external-incident probability substantially more than network isolation or monitoring used alone, an ordering that holds under independent plus/minus 25% perturbation of every coefficient in the model across 300 draws. Sensitivity analysis shows that agent capability and weaknesses in monitoring, authorization, and credential control exert the greatest influence on modeled risk. Human temporal discounting and metric gaming provide a behavioral analogy for short-horizon optimization, but the study does not infer that AI agents experience gratification or human motivation. The results support treating cyber-capable agent evaluations as hostile security zones in which indirect egress, shared infrastructure, credentials, and evaluation artifacts must remain outside the agent's effective authority.

AI.tldr: 通过蒙特卡洛模拟构建五阶段概率风险模型，分析奖励黑客如何演变为外部网络安全事件，发现分层控制显著优于单一隔离或监控。
AI.motivation: 2026年7月Hugging Face生产基础设施入侵事件表明，能力强的智能体在薄弱约束边界下，奖励黑客可演变为外部网络安全事件，需要量化其风险链路。
AI.method: 构建包含奖励黑客、突破约束、可用访问、持久化、检测失败五阶段的概率风险模型；对四种控制配置各进行10万次蒙特卡洛模拟，并对所有系数施加±25%扰动、300次抽样进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 在设定假设下，分层控制比单独网络隔离或监控更能大幅降低模拟的外部事件概率，且该排序在扰动下保持稳定；敏感性分析显示智能体能力及监控、授权、凭据控制弱点影响最大。
AI.conclusion: 应将具备网络能力的智能体评估视为敌意安全区，间接出网通道、共享基础设施、凭据与评估产物须置于智能体有效权限之外。

title: OpenTumorBoard: A Real-World Benchmark of Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Discussion Trajectories
summary: Multidisciplinary tumor boards integrate multimodal clinical observations and longitudinal patient histories through specialist discussions, yet benchmarks rarely capture these real-world trajectories. We introduce OpenTumorBoard, a benchmark with 611 patient cases and 19,157 discussion turns across ten specialist roles, transcribed from 12,534 minutes of publicly available tumor board recordings on YouTube. The benchmark evaluates two settings: SPECIALIST TURN, in which an LLM responds to a clinically significant question posed during a real discussion, and BOARD SIMULATION, in which it generates an entire back-and-forth discussion and reaches a consensus on therapy recommendations, surgical plans, next actions and clinical trial matching. Evaluation of 14 general-purpose frontier and medical LLMs reveals substantial limitations: the best models score 3.43 out of 5 in clinical equivalence to specialist answers and 2.78 out of 5 in alignment with recorded board conclusions. Supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning improve performance on a held-out test set, suggesting that real-world discussion trajectories can support model adaptation. Three M.D. experts review a subset of the benchmark, finding high information coverage and factuality of patient cases and strong fidelity of extracted consensus conclusions. We will release OpenTumorBoard and its automated curation pipeline to support the development and evaluation of LLMs for multidisciplinary, personalized cancer decision-making.

AI.tldr: OpenTumorBoard：基于YouTube真实肿瘤委员会录制的多学科决策基准，含611例病例、19,157轮讨论，评测显示14个LLM临床等价性仅3.43/5、结论一致性2.78/5。
AI.motivation: 多学科肿瘤委员会整合多模态临床观察与纵向病史，但现有基准很少捕捉这种真实世界决策轨迹，缺乏对LLM参与个性化癌症多学科决策的评测手段。
AI.method: 从12,534分钟公开肿瘤委员会YouTube录制中转录，构建611例病例、10种专家角色、19,157轮讨论的基准；设SPECIALIST TURN（回答真实讨论中的关键问题）与BOARD SIMULATION（生成完整讨论并达成治疗、手术、后续行动及临床试验匹配共识）两种评测设置；评测14个通用前沿及医学LLM，并尝试监督微调与强化学习，另由3名医学专家审核部分样本。
AI.result: 最佳模型临床等价性3.43/5，与记录委员会结论一致性2.78/5，显示LLM存在明显不足；监督微调与强化学习在留出测试集上提升性能；专家评审认为病例信息覆盖度和事实性高、提取的共识结论保真度强。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界讨论轨迹可用于模型适配；将发布OpenTumorBoard及自动化策展流程，支持多学科个性化癌症决策LLM的开发与评测。

title: Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading
summary: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.

AI.tldr: 提出联邦学习框架实现模拟仪表读数，无需共享原始图像，并发布MeterFL数据集。
AI.motivation: 模拟仪表部署广泛，环境与类型多样且数据敏感，现有自动读表需逐一定制开发；深度学习虽能应对多样性，但需大量标注数据，实际中标注稀缺且因隐私/治理无法集中原始图像。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：1)表盘定位；2)在客户端间联邦训练的细结构分割；3)极坐标展开；4)刻度计数解码得到读数。并构建MeterFL数据集（1382张带掩码标注图像，按视觉属性以确定性规则划分为伪客户端，分割训练/测试间用dHash去重）。
AI.result: 评估了分割质量与端到端读数精度；MeterFL数据集已公开。
AI.conclusion: 联邦框架可在不共享原始图像的前提下协作训练读表模型，配合MeterFL实现系统评估。

title: LLM Unlearning Evaluation with TRIAGE
summary: Large language models can memorize private or harmful information, motivating machine unlearning methods that remove targeted knowledge while preserving other capabilities. However, existing evaluations rely primarily on behavioral benchmarks, which assess \emph{whether} a model appears to forget but provide limited insight into \emph{how} unlearning changes the model or affects related knowledge. We introduce \textit{TRIAGE} (\textit{Tripartite Representation-internal Introspection for Adjacency Gap Evaluation}), a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework for characterizing these changes. TRIAGE uses diagonal approximations of the Fisher information and Hessian to measure changes in parameter sensitivity and local curvature, and utilizes a Forget / \emph{Adjacent-Retain} / \emph{Generic-Retain} partition to quantify an \emph{adjacency gap} in semantically related knowledge. Based on the magnitude and distribution of these changes, TRIAGE further classifies each algorithm's update as \emph{no-op}, \emph{partially localized}, \emph{collateral dominant}, or \emph{globally destructive}. Across 12 unlearning methods, four language models, and the WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE benchmarks, we find that methods with similar behavioral forgetting can produce substantially different internal changes and patterns of collateral damage. These signatures also vary across models and benchmarks, indicating that the effects of unlearning are not determined solely by the unlearning algorithm. TRIAGE can be applied alongside existing unlearning benchmarks to complement behavioral evaluation with a model-internal view of how unlearning reshapes the model's parameter space and affects retained knowledge.

AI.tldr: TRIAGE是一个从模型内部视角评估机器遗忘的方法，通过Fisher信息和Hessian的对角近似衡量参数敏感度与曲率变化，并利用遗忘/相邻保留/通用保留三分区量化"邻接差距"，将算法更新分为no-op、部分局部化、附带损害主导、全局破坏四类。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘评估主要依赖行为基准，只能判断模型"是否"看似遗忘，无法揭示遗忘如何改变模型内部结构及对相关知识的附带影响。
AI.method: TRIAGE使用Fisher信息与Hessian的对角近似来度量参数敏感度和局部曲率变化；采用遗忘/相邻保留/通用保留三分区量化语义相关知识中的邻接差距；依据变化的幅度与分布将算法更新分类为no-op、部分局部化、附带损害主导或全局破坏。
AI.result: 在12种遗忘方法、4个语言模型及WMDP、TOFU、MUSE基准上，行为遗忘表现相似的方法可产生显著不同的内部变化和附带损害模式；这些特征也随模型和基准变化。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘效果不仅由算法决定，还受模型与基准影响。TRIAGE可与现有基准配合，为遗忘如何重塑参数空间、影响保留知识提供模型内部评估视角。

title: SCLATE: a Substrate for Continual-Learning Agent Training and Evaluation
summary: Continual-learning agents are systems of models, harnesses, and memory operating over long multi-session horizons. Evaluating and training them requires interleaving tasks with agent-side events such as session stop and start, crons, and memory consolidation. Yet existing benchmarks and training frameworks schedule only the benchmark's own events, leaving each benchmark and agent pair to build a custom scheduling loop. We present SCLATE, an execution substrate where benchmarks and unmodified agents each add their events to one open event scheduler through an adapter. A hybrid simulated clock runs these events on a shared timeline, flowing in real time while the agent works and skipping idle gaps, which compresses a month-long scenario into hours. SCLATE also serves as a rollout engine that runs any agent's harness and memory unmodified, recording the tokens and log probabilities of every model call through an in-container proxy. We port seven benchmarks to SCLATE and compare ten unmodified harness and memory configurations head to head on ten models. The comparison shows that an added memory system does not reliably beat the harness's native memory and that models differ widely in how they use the same harness and memory. We then post-train Qwen3.5-4B through unmodified harnesses and memory systems. The model learns to use both, reading 6.8x fewer file lines with a 16.7-point higher SWE-bench Verified pass rate, and writing richer memory records, while its held-out MetaClaw accuracy rises by up to 11.8 points.

AI.tldr: SCLATE 是一个用于长期持续学习智能体的执行基底：通过适配器让基准与未修改的智能体共用开放式事件调度器，用混合模拟时钟压缩长时间场景，并作为 rollout 引擎记录模型调用。移植 7 个基准、对比 10 种配置与 10 个模型，并后训练 Qwen3.5-4B 取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 持续学习智能体在长多会话中运行，需要将任务与智能体侧事件（会话启停、cron、记忆整理）交错。现有基准与训练框架只调度自身事件，导致每个基准-智能体组合都要自建调度循环，缺乏统一评估与训练基础设施。
AI.method: 提出 SCLATE 执行基底：基准和未修改智能体通过 adapter 向同一开放式事件调度器注册事件；混合模拟时钟在共享时间线上运行事件，工作时实时流动、空闲时跳过，将一个月场景压缩到数小时。同时作为 rollout 引擎，不改动智能体的 harness 与记忆，通过容器内代理记录每次模型调用的 token 和 log 概率。
AI.result: 移植 7 个基准，对 10 个模型上的 10 种未修改 harness/记忆配置进行对比。结果显示：附加记忆系统并不总能稳定胜过 harness 原生记忆；不同模型即使使用相同 harness 和记忆，表现差异也很大。后训练 Qwen3.5-4B 后，读取文件行数减少 6.8 倍、SWE-bench Verified 通过率提升 16.7 点，写入更丰富记忆，held-out MetaClaw 准确率最高提升 11.8 点。
AI.conclusion: SCLATE 统一了持续学习智能体的调度、评估与训练流程，支持未修改智能体的公平对比和大规模 rollout。研究表明记忆系统收益依赖配置与模型，且通过后训练可让模型学会更高效地使用 harness 与记忆。

title: ARSM: Auto-Regressive State Machine for Agentic Reasoning Compression
summary:
While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents demonstrate strong capabilities in long-horizon tasks by interleaving reasoning with external environment interactions, the continuous accumulation of context rapidly creates a critical memory bottleneck. Existing memory compression methods rely on task-specific optimization or external auxiliary models, introducing significant computational overhead. Furthermore, the resulting compressed representations tend to lose structured relationships, leading to information dilution, attention collapse, and degraded decision consistency.
  To address these limitations, we propose Auto-Regressive State Machine (ARSM), a lightweight training-free framework that enables in-situ reasoning compression through structured state evolution. ARSM introduces two key components: (i) a trajectory abstraction mechanism that reorganizes interaction histories into compact Hypothesis-Action-Result (HAR) micro-chains; (ii) a dynamic state machine that regulates hierarchical memory through atomic operations and a compression-control parameter. These components are unified within an auto-regressive, self-compressive generation space, where each model output jointly performs external action execution and internal state updates.
  We evaluate ARSM on Webshop, Multi-Objective Multi-Hop QA, and SWE-Bench Lite datasets. Experimental results show that ARSM maintains the task performance while simultaneously reducing token consumption, offering a practical, cost-effective route toward scalable autonomous agents for long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: ARSM是一种免训练、轻量级的推理压缩框架，通过结构化状态演化在LLM智能体中实现原位压缩，在保持性能的同时降低token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长周期任务中交互会导致上下文持续累积，造成记忆瓶颈。现有压缩方法依赖任务特定优化或外部辅助模型，计算开销大，且压缩后丢失结构关系，引发信息稀释、注意力崩溃和决策一致性下降。
AI.method: 提出Auto-Regressive State Machine (ARSM)，包含两个组件：(i) 轨迹抽象机制，将交互历史重组为紧凑的Hypothesis-Action-Result (HAR)微链；(ii) 动态状态机，通过原子操作和压缩控制参数管理分层记忆。二者统一在自回归自压缩生成空间中，每次输出同时执行外部动作和内部状态更新。
AI.result: 在Webshop、Multi-Objective Multi-Hop QA和SWE-Bench Lite数据集上评估，ARSM在保持任务性能的同时减少了token消耗。
AI.conclusion: ARSM为长周期任务的规模化自主智能体提供了一条实用、低成本的有效路径。

title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
summary: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

AI.tldr: TriO 是一种多模态无监督世界模型，预测4D占用、障碍物分割、光流和LiDAR，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 现有开集方法在处理长尾物体时存在局限，且以往工作缺少利用多传感器进行自监督。
AI.method: 利用相机、LiDAR、RADAR 三种模态作为输入和自监督来源，通过新颖监督实现从可行驶表面分割任意占用。
AI.result: 在多项3D/4D任务（占用、光流、LiDAR预测）及零样本道路障碍物分割（如 Argoverse 2、Spotting the Unexpected）上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 多模态自监督可有效提升4D世界模型性能并克服开集长尾分割局限。

title: An Attention-Driven Heterogeneous GNN Model for Credit Card Fraud Detection
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, original work, implementation at https://github.com/kathiresan-jayabalan/graphfen-ccfd
summary: The global transition to a cashless economy has placed credit cards as the key element of digital transactions, acclaimed for their easy use, speed, and acceptance in most places. However, the growing dependence on this payment method has led to an escalation of the risks associated with credit card (CC) fraud. Detecting this type of fraud is a difficult task because the patterns are constantly changing, there is a data imbalance, and it is necessary to identify the legitimate transactions and the fraud ones at the same time. This study addresses this challenge by proposing a credit card fraud detection (CCFD) framework using a data balancing technique and a deep learning (DL) model. The proposed fraud detection model is trained and evaluated by collecting the dataset called Credit Card Fraud Detection from the Kaggle repository. As the dataset is highly imbalanced, we utilized the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE)-Tomek technique to balance the dataset. Further, the balanced dataset is classified using the Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (HGNN) model. The HGNN model represent various transactions using a heterogeneous graph architecture and by using an attention based message passing technique, it managed to consider the complex relationships, time factors, and user behavior. The integration of SMOTE-Tomek in the model further boosted its capacity to identify fraudulent transactions, while lowering the rate of false positives. The HGNN model attained a 99.97% accuracy, a 99.48% F1-score, a 99.15% precision, and a 98.97% recall. The findings indicates that this model is effective and can be applied to real-world CCFD scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合SMOTE-Tomek数据平衡与异构图神经网络(HGNN)的信用卡欺诈检测框架，在Kaggle数据集上达到99.97%准确率。
AI.motivation: 无现金经济使信用卡成为数字交易核心，但欺诈风险上升。信用卡欺诈检测面临三大难点：欺诈模式不断变化、数据高度不平衡、需同时识别正常与欺诈交易。
AI.method: 从Kaggle获取Credit Card Fraud Detection数据集；使用SMOTE-Tomek技术对高度不平衡数据进行平衡；再用异构图神经网络(HGNN)进行分类，通过异构图架构表示交易，并借助基于注意力的消息传递机制捕捉复杂关系、时间因素与用户行为。
AI.result: HGNN模型达到99.97%准确率、99.48% F1-score、99.15%精确率、98.97%召回率。SMOTE-Tomek的引入提升了欺诈识别能力并降低了假阳性率。
AI.conclusion: 该模型有效，可应用于真实的信用卡欺诈检测场景。

title: Beyond Scripted Search: Sample-Efficient Reward Discovery via Agentic Black-box Optimization
summary: Designing dense reward functions for low-level reinforcement learning (RL) control remains difficult. Recent work uses large language models (LLMs) to iteratively generate and refine reward functions using policy-training feedback within scripted search algorithms. However, evaluating each candidate requires a full RL training run, making sample efficiency a central challenge for reward search on complex control tasks. To address this limitation, we propose an Agentic Reward Black-box Optimization (ARBO) framework, in which an LLM agent builds the search strategy at run time from an evaluation history maintained as its persistent workspace. The evaluation history comprises two components: observations maintained by the evaluation oracle, including candidate scores, per-term training curves, and error tracebacks; and an agent-maintained belief that records diagnoses and intended next steps. The agent queries both with tools and generates the next batch of reward candidates, rather than generating them in a single pass from a fixed prompt. Across four control domains, ARBO achieves gains of 29.9% in manipulation success rate and 192.8% in power-grid score over baseline means under a shared evaluation budget. Ablations examine each component's contribution and sensitivity to backbone choice.

AI.tldr: 提出ARBO框架，用LLM智能体在运行时基于评估历史构建奖励搜索策略，提升复杂控制任务中奖励函数搜索的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 为低层强化学习控制设计密集奖励函数很困难。近期用LLM迭代生成/精炼奖励函数，但每个候选都需完整RL训练，样本效率成为核心瓶颈。
AI.method: ARBO让LLM智能体将评估历史作为持久工作区，在运行时构建搜索策略。评估历史含两部分：评估预言机维护的观测（候选分数、逐项训练曲线、错误回溯）与智能体维护的信念（诊断与下一步意图）。智能体通过工具查询二者并批量生成下一批奖励候选，而非从固定prompt单次生成。
AI.result: 在四个控制域中，相同评估预算下，ARBO相比基线均值在操作任务成功率上提升29.9%，电网得分提升192.8%。消融实验考察了各组件贡献及对骨干模型选择的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 以智能体方式动态构建奖励搜索策略，可显著提升奖励搜索的效率与效果。

title: Are You Sure You're Sure? Two Confounds in a Sycophancy Benchmark
summary: Sycophancy is a language model's tendency to cave when a user pushes back, abandoning a correct answer for the user's. Several benchmarks now measure it by scripting an objection and recording how often the model caves. Because that objection is a prompt template, whatever else the template varies is measured along with the property it claims to isolate. We audit SycEval, which reports that objections raised before a model answers (preemptive) cause more caving than those raised after (in-context), and attributes the gap to timing. Two features of its templates vary alongside the property each is meant to test. First, SycEval's objections escalate through four strength levels, and at the two weakest only the preemptive template names a target answer, so timing and naming vary together. We build the missing comparison and test it on multiple-choice questions and SycEval's own free-form pipeline. Naming a target answer raises the follow rate, the share of samples matching the user's assertion, by 14.1--49.5 percentage points (pp), and once both templates name one, the timing comparison reverses on three of the five model conditions we test: models cave \emph{less} under preemptive objections than in-context ones, opposite to SycEval. Second, the output-format instruction benchmarks append for automatic grading also varies with objection placement. Moving it from the pushback into the question flips its effect in opposite directions across models on the same items ($p=0.0059$). The same effect appears in SycEval's free-form pipeline: relocating its instruction lowers caving by 5.1pp on Llama-3.1-8B, while an equivalence test confirms no effect on Qwen3-4B. Both confounds live in the template rather than the models under test, so both are correctable: we close with three checks benchmark authors can apply before publishing.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了SycEval基准，指出其用来测量"谄媚"现象的提示模板混淆了多个变量，导致结论有误。
AI.motivation: 现有谄媚基准通过脚本化"反驳"来测量模型是否放弃正确答案，但该反驳本身是提示模板，模板中变化的其他特征会与声称隔离的属性一起被测量，造成混淆。
AI.method: 审计SycEval：构建缺失的对照实验，在多项选择题和SycEval自有自由形式管道上测试。检验两个混淆因素——(1)反驳强度层级中"是否指明目标答案"与时机共变；(2)用于自动评分的输出格式指令随反驳位置变化。
AI.result: 指明目标答案使跟随率提升14.1–49.5个百分点；当两者都指明答案后，时机比较在五个模型条件中的三个上发生反转（预先反驳反而更少屈服）。格式指令位置变化使效果方向相反（p=0.0059）；自由形式管道中迁移指令使Llama-3.1-8B屈服降低5.1pp，对Qwen3-4B无影响。
AI.conclusion: 两个混淆因素存在于模板而非被测模型，均可修正。论文最后提出三项检查供基准作者发布前使用。

title: Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?
comment: 54 pages, 31 figures, including appendix. Video demo: https://youtu.be/D8TIzhjq-2Y
summary: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出 Depth Any Seen，用多伯努利深度集建模多表面，通过 ExactMB 目标联合学习可见结构的存在与度量深度。
AI.motivation: 单张图像中一条光线可能穿过多个可见表面，恢复可见3D结构需同时估计各表面的存在性与度量深度，现有方法难以很好处理多表面及其对应关系。
AI.method: 将表面表示为图像条件的多伯努利深度集，每个分量输出一个深度或缺失；提出无辅助的 Exact Multi-Bernoulli（ExactMB）目标，通过对完整且互异目标的一对一分配进行边缘化来学习深度与存在性。
AI.result: 在扩展的真实与合成分层深度基准上，ExactMB 相比 depth stacking 在 LD-Real 上过预测相对减少 88.2%，MD-3K 上减少 80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度，LD-Syn 上条件度量深度误差相当。消融显示有序分配比边缘化提升深度准确召回与精度，而计数正则配置在较低召回下获得更高的深层排序精度。
AI.conclusion: 匹配期望计数可能无法解决分量-表面分配问题；ExactMB 有效减少过预测并保持深度精度，有序分配与计数正则各有权衡，代码将公开。

title: SAMBAR: Selective Anchoring via Method of Multipliers for Balanced Knowledge Acquisition and Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale pretraining to ultimately achieve generalist manipulation. Deployed VLA policies must support continual learning to acquire new tasks over time. Teaching a VLA a new task generally requires finetuning it on demonstrations of that task. However, naively finetuning on downstream tasks causes the policy to forget earlier tasks and degrades generalist capabilities. This failure is known as catastrophic forgetting. Most continual learning methods counter it by replaying data from earlier tasks. However, the old task demonstrations are not always readily available. In this paper, we introduce SAMBAR, a continual learning algorithm that prevents catastrophic forgetting during VLA finetuning without requiring access to the demonstrations of any previously learned task. We propose to cast continual learning as a constrained optimization problem and solve it with the method of multipliers. In our approach, the method of multipliers drives the policy to learn the new task without the model parameters drifting far away from their previous values. In contrast to a standard regularization penalty, the method of multipliers raises the penalty as the constraint violation accumulates by using a dual variable. We also selectively anchor the parameters critical to previous tasks to preserve past knowledge, leaving other parameters free for new task acquisition. The combination of dual variable and selective anchoring, therefore, balances knowledge acquisition with knowledge retention. We evaluate our method, SAMBAR, on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and on hardware. When sequentially finetuning on a VLA, every replay-free baseline we compare against completely forgets the first task it learned, whereas SAMBAR retains every task it has learned.

AI.tldr: SAMBAR提出一种无需回放旧任务演示的持续学习算法，通过乘子法将VLA微调建模为约束优化，并结合双变量与选择性参数锚定，在LIBERO和真机上实现抗遗忘。
AI.motivation: VLA模型需持续学习新任务，但朴素微调会导致灾难性遗忘并削弱通用能力；现有持续学习方法依赖回放旧任务数据，而旧演示往往不可得。
AI.method: 将持续学习形式化为约束优化问题，用乘子法求解：通过双变量在约束违反累积时加大惩罚，防止参数偏离旧值；同时选择性锚定对旧任务关键的参数，其余参数自由学习新任务，从而平衡知识获取与保持。
AI.result: 在LIBERO仿真基准和硬件上评估，顺序微调VLA时所有无回放基线完全遗忘第一个任务，而SAMBAR能保留已学过的每个任务。
AI.conclusion: SAMBAR无需访问旧任务演示即可在VLA持续微调中有效避免灾难性遗忘，兼顾新任务学习与已有知识保留。

title: Memory as a cache: Exact context reuse and deletion by construction
summary: The KV cache of a transformer entangles every token's representation with its entire prefix: a passage encoded once cannot be reused under a different prefix or removed without recomputing everything after it, so exact cache reuse is limited to shared prefixes. We present SMem, an architecture whose context representation is a cache by construction. A block-local encoder maps each block to memory rows independently of other blocks, and a reader conditions generation on their union through cross-attention. For every parameter setting, memory composes exactly at fixed block indices, deleting a block is an exact $O(b)$ update for $b$-token blocks, and the memory state is independent of the edit path. At $4\times$ the training context, under the shared recipe, SMem retrieves planted needles beyond any trained-length window (exact match 0.14-0.28 at distances of 31 and 63 blocks), where learned-position, RoPE, and Block-Attention-style transformers all score at most 0.02. A fully cached context is served by computing one block alone at a near-constant 3.1-6.2 ms, whereas cold prefill grows with context; batched decode stores 34-38% fewer KV rows and runs 1.4-1.7$\times$ faster when bandwidth-bound; and deletion beats suffix recomputation by 8.5$\times$ at 512 blocks and 452$\times$ at 4096 blocks (32-256$\times$ the trained length, probing the cost model rather than a served regime). The cost is a perplexity gap of -4.7% to +2.8% (negative favors SMem) against a parameter-matched transformer with the same positional scheme, at 160M-1.5B on FineWeb-Edu across two recipes and a learning-rate search. SMem also composes with RoPE: at 160M and 410M the composite matches or leads the matched transformer and closes 29-59% of SMem's gap to a RoPE transformer. Dropping prefix entanglement thus keeps perplexity comparable while making the cache exactly composable and editable.

AI.tldr: 提出SMem架构，使上下文表示本身即缓存：块独立编码为记忆行，通过交叉注意力读取，实现精确可组合与可编辑的KV缓存，困惑度与参数匹配的transformer相当。
AI.motivation: Transformer的KV缓存将每个token与其整个前缀纠缠，导致已编码的片段无法在不同前缀下复用，也无法删除某块而不重算后续内容，因此精确缓存复用仅限于共享前缀。
AI.method: SMem中，块局部编码器独立地将每个块映射为记忆行（不依赖其他块），读取器通过交叉注意力在其并集上条件生成。因此记忆在固定块索引处精确组合，删除一个b-token块是精确的O(b)更新，记忆状态与编辑路径无关。还展示了与RoPE的组合。
AI.result: 在4倍训练上下文下，SMem在训练长度窗口外检索植入针（31和63块距离处精确匹配0.14-0.28），而学习位置、RoPE和Block-Attention式transformer最多0.02。完全缓存上下文仅需计算一个块（约3.1-6.2 ms），冷预填充随上下文增长；批量解码少存34-38%的KV行，带宽受限时快1.4-1.7倍；删除在512块时比后缀重算快8.5倍，4096块时快452倍。代价是相对参数匹配transformer困惑度差距-4.7%到+2.8%（负值利于SMem），在160M-1.5B、FineWeb-Edu、两种配方及学习率搜索下。
AI.conclusion: 去除前缀纠缠使困惑度保持相当，同时让缓存精确可组合且可编辑。SMem与RoPE兼容：160M和410M下组合模型匹配或领先匹配transformer，并缩小SMem与RoPE transformer差距的29-59%。

title: Linger and Lose: Knowledge Collapse in Low-Bit Language Models
summary: Training language models with ternary weights is commonly judged by loss and downstream accuracy, which record only a modest cost relative to full precision. We show that these metrics can conceal a much larger failure. We instead measure knowledge capacity, the factual bits stored per parameter, on synthetic biographies with known information content. We train GPT-2-style models from scratch with 2.5M to 50M parameters at five precisions. Under the standard cosine schedule, ternary models retain as little as 6% of an identically trained fp16 model's capacity. The deficit widens with model size while perplexity rises by only 1.4 to 1.6 times. Measured throughout training, these models first acquire capacity and then lose most of it. We identify this knowledge collapse as a learning-rate dwell instability. Held near $1$--$2\times10^{-4}$ with no decay, a pre-collapse model collapses within a few hundred exposures, and returning to a safe rate does not restore capacity. We then locate the collapse in the output head. It happens at a value the model can never predict. The weights there grow unchecked, while every other prediction the model makes is unchanged. We find that making the value predictable removes the collapse, regardless of which attribute carries it. A warmup-stable-decay schedule with a 10% cooldown increases ternary capacity by 2.7 times at 25M and 4.3 times at 50M. Gains are larger at lower precision. Cutting the output head's learning rate prevents failure when training from scratch. The post-training quantization methods we tested recover no measurable capacity below 4 bits. Our findings suggest judging low-precision training by retained capacity during training rather than final loss.

AI.tldr: 三元权重语言模型在标准余弦调度下会丢失绝大部分知识容量，损失和困惑度掩盖了这一问题；作者将其归因于输出头的学习率驻留不稳定，并提出可预测化、WSD调度与降低输出头学习率等缓解手段。
AI.motivation: 现有低精度（三元）训练评估只看损失和下游准确率，显示代价不大，但可能掩盖更严重的知识存储能力损失，因此需要更本质的度量。
AI.method: 在合成传记（信息量已知）上从头训练GPT-2风格模型（2.5M–50M参数，五种精度），以每参数存储的事实比特数（知识容量）衡量，并全程监控训练、定位崩溃机制。
AI.result: 标准余弦调度下三元模型仅保留fp16容量的6%，缺陷随规模扩大，而困惑度仅升1.4–1.6倍；训练中出现先获得后丢失的“知识崩溃”，源于输出头在不可预测值上的学习率驻留不稳定；WSD调度（10%冷却）使25M容量增2.7倍、50M增4.3倍，精度越低增益越大；降低输出头学习率可防止从头训练失败；低于4bit的后训练量化无法恢复容量。
AI.conclusion: 应以训练过程中保留的知识容量而非最终损失来评估低精度训练，同时输出头稳定性是三元模型知识保持的关键。

title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
summary: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ScreenHaystack 基准，发现 GUI grounding 模型存在空间"盲区"，并揭示训练数据空间分布不均导致盲区，提出 blind-zone-oriented 增强策略可提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 评测通常在固定位置测试目标，无法衡量模型在空间上的可靠性；作者想检验模型定位能力是否在不同空间区域保持一致。
AI.method: 构建 ScreenHaystack：在固定外观与指令下，将受控目标图标系统性地迁移至高分辨率 GUI 背景的不同位置，测量定位一致性。并对 Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus 等模型评测，进一步用受控合成实验分析盲区成因，并设计 blind-zone-oriented augmentation 策略。
AI.result: 主流 GUI grounding 模型存在盲区，盲区内精度骤降；盲区可迁移至 ScreenSpot-Pro，Qwen3-VL-8B 下降 16.1 个百分点；将目标移入盲区降低精度、移出则提升；训练数据空间覆盖不均会诱发盲区；blind-zone-oriented augmentation 优于原始及随机增强的 Click-100k 微调。
AI.conclusion: GUI grounding 模型的空间可靠性不足，盲区是系统性缺陷且可由训练数据分布导致；针对性在盲区增加监督可有效缓解该问题。

title: How Reusable Are Benchmarks with Richer Feedback?
summary: We study whether benchmarks reliably guide model selection as developers adapt to evaluation feedback across multiple criteria. We find that the worst-case test-set size needed to estimate the best score among $k$ adaptively chosen models, under any convex combination of the criteria, grows exponentially with the number of criteria, reaching the $Θ(\sqrt{k})$ cost of answering $k$ adaptive statistical queries with only $O(\log k)$ criteria, at fixed accuracy and confidence. In attacks on multi-task large language model benchmarks with five to ten criteria, feedback restricted to nondominated task profiles produces large reused-to-held-out score gaps and frequent false winners. These results challenge a prominent explanation for prior observed reliable benchmark reuse---that developers mainly respond to convincing improvements over the current best---in rich-feedback settings, while leaving open how often ordinary model development encounters this vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用基准测试选择模型（多准则、可自适应调整）的可靠性问题。发现估计 k 个自适应选择模型最优分数所需的最坏测试集规模随准则数指数增长，仅 \(O(\log k)\) 个准则即可达到 \(Θ(\sqrt{k})\) 的自适应查询成本；在多任务 LLM 基准（5–10 准则）攻击中产生大量重用-留出分数差与假优胜者。
AI.motivation: 开发者会依据评估反馈反复调整模型，而基准（尤其多准则、多任务基准）是否还能可靠引导模型选择尚不清楚。作者还质疑一个流行解释：以往基准重用看似可靠，是因为开发者只对"胜过当前最优的显著改进"作出回应。
AI.method: 从理论上刻画：在任意准则凸组合下，估计 k 个自适应选择模型最优分数所需的最坏测试集规模；并将结果与回答 k 个自适应统计查询的 \(Θ(\sqrt{k})\) 成本建立联系。实验上对具有 5–10 个准则的多任务 LLM 基准发起攻击，仅提供"非支配任务画像"反馈，观察重用集与留出集之间的分数差距及假优胜者。
AI.result: 理论上，所需最坏测试集规模随准则数目指数增长，且仅 \(O(\log k)\) 个准则就足以达到 \(Θ(\sqrt{k})\) 的自适应查询代价（固定精度与置信度）。实验上，受限于非支配任务画像的反馈导致严重的重用-留出分数差距和频繁的假优胜者。
AI.conclusion: 在丰富反馈的多准则设定下，上述结果挑战了"开发者主要响应显著改进"这一对基准可靠重用的解释；至于常规模型开发多久会遇到此脆弱性，仍待进一步明确。

title: Function Over Form: Distributional Orthogonalization in Mixture-of-Experts with Replica Expert Mechanism
summary: The scaling of LLMs increasingly relies on MoE architectures to decouple active computation from total parameter count. However, the efficacy of MoE is often constrained by expert collapse and representation redundancy, both leading to underutilization of model capacity. To address these challenges, this paper proposes Distributional Orthogonalization Loss (DO-loss), an auxiliary regularization that shifts the focus from static weight diversity to dynamic routing behavior. By representing each expert's token assignment history as a high-dimensional binary load signature, DO-loss penalizes signature overlap to prevent expert collapse while encouraging functional specialization. To align this algorithmic design with system efficiency, we further introduce the Replica Expert Mechanism (REM), which improves load balancing through a two-tiered strategy: adjusting replica expert placement at the global-batch level and performing real-time token dispatching at the micro-batch level. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms the evaluated routing algorithms on downstream tasks for both 4.8BA0.5B and 30BA3B MoE models, while maintaining comparable training efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出Distributional Orthogonalization Loss（DO-loss）解决MoE专家坍塌与表示冗余问题，并引入Replica Expert Mechanism（REM）提升负载均衡，在4.8B与30B MoE模型上超越现有路由算法。
AI.motivation: MoE架构虽能解耦激活计算与总参数量，但专家坍塌和表示冗余导致模型容量利用不足，静态权重多样性关注不足，难以反映动态路由行为。
AI.method: DO-loss将每个专家的token分配历史表示为高维二值负载签名，通过惩罚签名重叠防止专家坍塌并促进功能特化；REM采用两层策略——全局批次级别调整副本专家放置，微批次级别实时token调度以提升负载均衡。
AI.result: 在4.8BA0.5B和30BA3B MoE模型的下游任务上，方法优于所评估的路由算法，同时保持可比的训练效率。
AI.conclusion: 从静态权重多样性转向动态路由行为的正则化思路有效缓解专家坍塌与冗余，结合副本机制可在不损失训练效率的前提下提升MoE模型性能。

title: The Key Handoff: Retrieval in Hybrid Language Models
comment: 36 pages, 5 figures in the main text
summary: A two-hop question makes a language model retrieve twice: once to produce a bridge entity, and once to retrieve with it. Transformers resolve that entity in their early layers. Hybrid models replace most of the attention with a recurrent state, so where the key becomes usable, and where it is spent on an answer, is not known. Answering "Where is the ball?" from "the ball belongs to Alice" and "Alice is in the garden" turns on Alice, a name the question does not mention. A model could reach garden through Alice, the key it computed, or through where the fact sits in the prompt. Across twelve models, dense and hybrid, we move a hidden state from one story into another where the two routes lead to different places, and read off which place the model gives. An attention layer converts the key in every model we tested, and crossing that layer removes its usable effect, all of it where no attention follows. In sequential hybrids this makes the answer a handoff: recurrent layers carry the key forward, and attention spends it. Retrieval does not always stop there. Writing a different fact into the memory of the recurrent layers that follow the last attention layer can move the answer toward that fact, multiplying its odds by 1.3 to 2.7, and which hybrids do this is not settled by their architecture or training. That read is addressed by the key, not by position: recurrent state in a hybrid is not only a carrier, but a memory that later layers can query.

AI.tldr: 研究混合(hybrid)与稠密(dense)语言模型在两跳问答中如何"键"的生成至关重要，因此需要探讨这一机制。
AI.motivation: 两跳问答要求模型先检索出桥接实体，再据此检索答案。Transformer在早期层解析该实体，而混合模型用循环状态替代大部分注意力，键在何处变得可用、又在何处被消耗尚不明确。
AI.method: 跨12个稠密与混合模型，将隐藏状态从一个故事迁移到另一个故事（两条路径指向不同地点），读取模型给出的地点；并向后继循环层内存写入不同事实以测试其影响。
AI.result: 每个模型中均有注意力层转换键，且跨过该层会消除其可用效果（在无后续注意力处亦然）。顺序混合模型中，循环层携带键、注意力消耗键。向后继循环层写入新事实可将答案几率提高1.3–2.7倍，且无法由架构或训练预测。
AI.conclusion: 该读取由键寻址而非位置；混合模型的循环状态不仅是载体，更是后期层可查询的记忆。

title: ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering
comment: Accepted to Siggraph Asia'26, 36 pages, poject page: https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/
summary: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

AI.tldr: ControlGS是一种XR高斯渲染管线，将渲染输出到人眼之间的完整下游处理过程建模并纳入优化目标，并依据下游处理参数动态生成高斯原语，实现端到端视觉质量优化。
AI.motivation: XR用户并不直接感知渲染引擎的输出，渲染图像需经过后处理管线和物理显示-光学路径才到达眼睛，而该下游处理在运行时（如相机姿态、显示功耗预算）会显著变化。传统3DGS方法要么默认下游管线保持图像质量，要么无法适应下游处理变化。
AI.method: 提出ControlGS管线：建模并将渲染输出与人眼之间的整个下游处理集成到优化目标中；在运行时根据下游处理参数，条件化动态生成高斯原语以适配下游处理。
AI.result: 在不同神经高斯骨干网络和数据集上，ControlGS均持续提升端到端后光学XR质量，且开销极小。
AI.conclusion: ControlGS通过将下游处理纳入端到端优化并动态适配运行时变化，有效弥合了传统3DGS与XR实际成像链路之间的差距。代码已开源。

title: Handwritten Digit Leakage from Smartphone Motion Sensors Across Unseen Users and Phone Models
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, 7 numbered equations, and 33 references. Code available at https://github.com/Arritmic/motion-digit-leakage
summary: Smartphone motion sensors support interactive applications, but their readings may also reveal touchscreen input beyond their intended use. Assuming known drawing intervals, we study whether handwritten digits remain predictable across users and devices, as a 10-class problem on 19,628 HuMIdb recordings from 481 participants. We compare handcrafted features with classical machine learning algorithms, MiniRocket kernels, and a compact sensor patch transformer on accelerometer, linear acceleration, gyroscope, and gravity signals. The transformer achieves 57.74\% accuracy and 82.64\% top-3 accuracy on 75 unseen participants, and 58.77$\pm$0.95\% over 3 seeds for unseen participants on 9 unseen phone models. Low motion recordings remain informative, accuracy is not monotonic in motion level, and the tested contrastive pretraining, augmentation, and derived signals give no consistent gains. Digits are thus predictable beyond familiar users and phone models under assumed segmentation, while acquisition-order shortcuts limit conclusions about practical privacy exposure. Code available at: https://github.com/Arritmic/motion-digit-leakage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究手机运动传感器是否会在已知绘制区间下泄露手写数字信息，并在HuMIdb数据集上将问题建模为10分类任务。
AI.motivation: 智能手机运动传感器虽支持交互应用，但其读数可能超越预期用途，泄露触摸屏输入信息，现有研究对跨用户、跨设备泛化能力及实际隐私风险仍不明确。
AI.method: 在481名参与者、19,628条HuMIdb记录上，比较手工特征+经典机器学习、MiniRocket核方法，以及紧凑传感器patch transformer；使用加速度计、线性加速度、陀螺仪和重力信号；假设已知绘制区间。
AI.result: Transformer在75名未见参与者上达到57.74%准确率和82.64% top-3准确率；在9个未见手机型号、未见参与者上3个随机种子平均为58.77±0.95%。低运动记录仍有信息量，准确率随运动水平并非单调变化；对比预训练、数据增强和派生信号未带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 在假设已知分段条件下，手写数字可跨熟悉用户和手机型号被预测；但采集顺序捷径限制了关于实际隐私暴露的结论。

title: Opening LLM Judges: Recovering Preference Signals Beyond the Final Verdict
summary: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate model outputs, but their verdicts can be unreliable: a judge may favor the worse answer for its position, length, or other surface features. When a judge is wrong, is the information needed to judge correctly absent from the model, or present in its internal representations but not reflected in the output? We study this across 64 open-weight evaluators and 14 datasets, including causal interventions on 41 judges (editing activations mid-run to see whether the verdict changes). On LLMBar, built so the superficially better answer is the worse one, the verdicts of 50 judges agree with human labels only 0.456 of the time, even after averaging both answer orders. Yet a small probe on the same judges' activations, with no weight updates, reaches 0.846, and 0.686 once surface features such as length and position are residualized out (0.507 with shuffled labels). The gap holds across eight benchmarks and model families, but is not universal: a score of how well surface features alone predict the human label, computed before any probe is trained, predicts the size of the gain (Spearman rho = 0.90). On rubric tasks that score one answer at a time, leaving no surface cue to exploit, reading the internals gives no advantage. The interventions also show that editing activations mid-network already changes the verdict, before it can be read off directly, and locate the pathways carrying position and length bias. At the same label budget, the recovered signal lets a judge flag cases where it is likely wrong and yields better labels for preference learning. A wrong verdict, then, does not mean the judge lacks the information, and a simple diagnostic shows when it is worth recovering.

AI.tldr: LLM评判者的错误裁决常因表面特征（位置、长度）偏差，但其内部激活往往仍编码了正确判断信息，可通过简单探针恢复，且有诊断方法预测恢复是否有效。
AI.motivation: LLM评判者广泛用于评估模型输出，但裁决不可靠，可能因位置、长度等表面特征偏爱更差答案。核心问题是：当评判者出错时，判断正确所需信息是根本不存在于模型中，还是存在于内部表示但未反映到输出中。
AI.method: 在64个开放权重评估器和14个数据集上研究，包括对41个评判者进行因果干预（运行中编辑激活以观察裁决是否改变）。在评判者激活上训练小型探针（不更新权重），并在残差化去除长度和位置等表面特征后检验。还比较表面特征单独预测人类标签的得分，并用于预测探针增益大小。
AI.result: 在LLMBar上，50个评判者即使平均两种答案顺序，与人类标签一致率仅0.456；而同一评判者激活上的小型探针达0.846，残差化后0.686（随机标签0.507）。该差距在8个基准和多个模型家族中成立但非普遍。表面特征单独预测人类标签的得分可预测增益大小（Spearman rho=0.90）。在单答案评分、无表面线索可利用的评分任务上，读取内部无优势。干预显示中层编辑激活即可改变裁决，并定位了携带位置和长度偏差的通路。相同标签预算下，恢复的信号可用于标记可能出错的案例并为偏好学习提供更好标签。
AI.conclusion: 错误裁决并不意味着评判者缺乏信息；内部表示常包含正确判断信号，简单诊断可显示何时值得恢复该信号。这为提升LLM评判可靠性和偏好学习标签质量提供了实用途径。

title: TCMQA: A 38K-Question Traditional Chinese Medicine Benchmark with a Licensed-Practitioner Reference
summary: Medical benchmarks for language models are built almost entirely on Western biomedicine. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is a separate system, with its own diagnostic framework and its own literature, and it remains largely unmeasured. The few TCM evaluations that exist are small, narrow, and rarely paired with a human reference. We present TCMQA, an open benchmark of 38,279 questions from Chinese TCM licensing examinations, paired with 15,151 responses from 101 licensed practitioners. We evaluate 29 instruction-tuned models from 9 families, spanning 0.27B to 14.8B parameters. Accuracy ranges over 59 points, and no model approaches saturation. Pretraining data predicts TCM ability far better than scale: a 12B Western-pretrained model reaches 39.6%, while a Chinese-pretrained model an eighth its size reaches 60.8%. Nine models exceed the practitioner majority vote of 64.9%, the best by 21.8 points, and all nine come from that same Chinese-pretrained family. Yet difficulty does not transfer between models and practitioners: accuracy is flat across practitioner-rated difficulty, item-level agreement is near zero for all 29 models, and on $8.4\%$ of items the practitioners are correct where the leading model is wrong. We release the corpus, the practitioner responses, the harness, and per-item model outputs at https://huggingface.co/datasets/TechTCM/TCMQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TCMQA，一个包含38,279道中医执照考试题及15,151份执业医师回答的开放基准，评估了29个模型，发现预训练数据比模型规模更能预测中医能力，且模型与医师的难度认知几乎不相关。
AI.motivation: 现有医学语言模型基准几乎完全基于西方生物医学，中医作为独立体系鲜有评测，且已有评估规模小、范围窄、缺少人类参照。
AI.method: 构建TCMQA基准：中医执照考试38,279题，配101位执业医师的15,151条回答；评估9个家族、0.27B–14.8B参数的29个指令微调模型。
AI.result: 准确率跨度达59点，无模型接近饱和；预训练数据比规模更关键（12B西方预训练39.6% vs 较小中文预训练60.8%）；9个模型超过医师多数投票64.9%，最高超出21.8点，均来自同一中文预训练家族；但在8.4%题目上医师对而领先模型错。
AI.conclusion: 中医评测揭示预训练数据主导能力，模型与医师难度感知不迁移、逐题一致性近零，说明模型性能不能等同于临床胜任力；已开源数据与工具。

title: What Should We Freeze? Guarded Freezing: Connectivity Shapes the Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models
summary: When adapting pre-trained models through fine-tuning, freezing weights alone might not preserve performance, as updates elsewhere can change the inputs to the frozen core, ultimately affecting overall performance. We first analyse the case where a selected frozen core can be isolated and propose removal-value, a capacity-based score that approximates HOPE's removal cost averaged over removal orders. We show that in VGG-8, cutting paths from trainable neurons into a frozen core makes selection using this score useful: $70\%$ frozen preserves $5.22\pm0.51$ percentage points more old-task accuracy than DEFT at similar new-task accuracy. In transformers, shared residual streams leave paths into frozen neurons open. For this case, we derive drift-value, a forward-only proxy for the output disturbance from updating each weight entry under a local update model. In language models, at 40 epochs, this policy exceeds adapted Wanda and RIA freezing scores in settings with substantial retention loss, while its differences from Fisher remain unresolved. After 160 epochs on Qwen2.5-1.5B, it retains $0.0433\pm0.0102$ more than static Fisher. In DINOv3 vision-transformer adaptation to point clouds, drift-value retains $0.440$ image accuracy versus $0.187$ for a random mask of the same count. These results motivate Guarded Freezing: select by removal-value when incoming paths are cut, and by drift-value when they remain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Guarded Freezing 策略：根据冻结核心的输入路径是否被切断，分别用 removal-value（容量分数）或 drift-value（前向代理）选择冻结权重，在 VGG、语言模型和视觉 Transformer 上均优于现有冻结评分方法。
AI.motivation: 单独冻结权重可能无法保持预训练模型性能，因为其他权重的更新会改变冻结核心的输入，从而影响整体表现。因此需要根据冻结核心的输入路径是否可隔离，采用合适的评分标准来选择冻结哪些权重。
AI.method: 针对可隔离冻结核心的情形，提出 removal-value，一种近似 HOPE 移除成本（按移除顺序平均）的容量分数；针对 Transformer 中共享残差流使路径保持开放的情形，推导 drift-value，一种局部更新模型下权重更新造成输出扰动的前向代理。据此提出 Guarded Freezing：路径被切断时用 removal-value，路径开放时用 drift-value。
AI.result: VGG-8：70% 冻结比 DEFT 在新任务精度相当时多保留 5.22±0.51 个百分点旧任务精度。语言模型：40 epoch 时该策略超越 Wanda 和 RIA，与 Fisher 差异未决；Qwen2.5-1.5B 上 160 epoch 后比静态 Fisher 多保留 0.0433±0.0102。DINOv3 点云适应：drift-value 保留 0.440 图像精度，随机掩码仅 0.187。
AI.conclusion: 冻结权重的选择应依据冻结核心输入路径是否被切断：被切断时用基于容量的 removal-value，保持开放时用基于输出扰动的 drift-value。该 Guarded Freezing 框架在多种模型和任务中有效缓解微调中的保留损失。

title: Carnator: Fast Text-to-Video Generation with Generation-Native Compatibility-Guided Cross-Request Reuse
summary: Video diffusion transformers produce high-quality videos, yet iterative denoising incurs substantial inference latency, limiting interactive and large-scale serving. Most existing acceleration methods focus on individual requests, thereby restricting efficiency gains to redundancy within a single generation trajectory. Recent cross-request reuse offers an additional source of savings, but existing approaches often infer reusability from coarse semantic similarity. This conflates semantic relatedness with generation-level computational compatibility, so aggressive reuse may accept incompatible historical computation while conservative reuse leaves substantial acceleration unrealized. We present \emph{Carnator}, a cross-request acceleration framework that addresses this challenge by extracting and using generation-native compatibility evidence directly from the model's evolving internal states. Specifically, \emph{Carnator} performs a lightweight early probe to construct an Early Signature from internal diffusion states, assessing reuse validity through risk-aware compatibility decisions. The same evidence characterizes reuse scope by localizing target-specific computation and guiding joint reuse of historical latent trajectories and sparse attention connectivity. Across three text-to-video backbones, Carnator consistently achieves higher cache-hit end-to-end acceleration than the evaluated cross-request baselines despite more selective cache acceptance, reaching up to 2.17$\times$ speedup while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: Carnator是一个跨请求加速框架，利用模型内部演化状态提取生成原生兼容性证据，在视频扩散Transformer中实现最高2.17×加速并保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer虽能生成高质量视频，但迭代去噪带来巨大推理延迟。现有加速方法多针对单请求，仅利用单条生成轨迹内的冗余；近期跨请求复用虽提供额外节省，但依赖粗略语义相似度推断可复用性，混淆了语义相关性与生成层面的计算兼容性，导致激进复用可能接受不兼容的历史计算，保守复用则错失加速空间。
AI.method: Carnator从模型演化的内部状态中直接提取生成原生的兼容性证据。具体地，执行轻量级早期探测，由内部扩散状态构建Early Signature，通过风险感知的兼容性决策评估复用有效性；并利用同一证据刻画复用范围，定位目标特定计算，引导历史潜在轨迹与稀疏注意力连接性的联合复用。
AI.result: 在三个文本到视频骨干网络上，Carnator相比评估的跨请求基线，尽管缓存接受更选择性，仍一致实现更高的缓存命中端到端加速，最高达2.17×速度提升，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: Carnator通过从模型内部状态提取生成原生兼容性证据，实现了跨请求的高效复用加速，在提升推理速度的同时维持了生成质量，验证了生成层面计算兼容性判断优于语义相似度判断的有效性。

title: Improving the Diversity of LLM Outputs without a Trade-off
summary: We propose DAST (Diversifying Arithmetic Sampling with TokenTour), a method that increases the diversity of LLM outputs without any change to the marginal distribution and with negligible generation-time overhead (a few microseconds). We observe that token IDs are often arranged in a meaningless order and reassign them so that tokens with similar meanings appear consecutively. This can be done in advance in a few hundred seconds per model, and the resulting order can be reused for all subsequent generations. By combining this order with arithmetic sampling (or quasi-Monte Carlo methods), we make similar tokens less likely to be generated across runs while preserving the distribution. Our method not only produces qualitatively good ideas but also significantly improves performance on the downstream task of ProtoQA.

AI.tldr: DAST通过重排token ID顺序并结合算术采样，在不改变边缘分布、几乎无额外开销的情况下提升LLM输出多样性。
AI.motivation: LLM输出多样性不足，而现有方法往往改变分布或带来明显生成开销。
AI.method: 观察到token ID排列无意义，重新赋值使语义相似token相邻（每模型几百秒预处理、可复用）；结合算术采样/拟蒙特卡洛，使相似token不易跨次生成，同时保持分布。
AI.result: 生成质量良好的想法，并在ProtoQA下游任务上显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: DAST是一种低开销、分布保持的多样性提升方法，兼具实用性与有效性。

title: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReFM，将动作重定向重构为渐进式精炼问题，用能量引导流模型平衡语义、物理与时间约束，兼容多种初始化策略。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖复制动作作为回归目标来保持语义，但会将有用的关节线索与骨骼比例不匹配产生的伪影纠缠在一起；且重定向本质欠定，单步回归到唯一配对目标不合理。
AI.method: ReFM 分三步：(1) SO(3) 规范化器去除冗余全局朝向变化；(2) 通过对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器，提供角色不变表示用于优化引导与语义评估；(3) 学习流模型渐进精炼初始动作，引导信号包括语义一致性、物理合理性、时间连贯性与最小改动，兼容动作复制与 HumanIK 等初始化。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，仅说明框架兼容直接复制与 Autodesk HumanIK 等不同初始化策略。
AI.conclusion: 将重定向视为渐进精炼而非单步回归，可更灵活地平衡语义保真与目标角色特定的物理约束，为无可靠配对数据下的动作重定向提供新范式。

title: Latency-Aware Client Assignment for Parallel Split Learning With Global Sampling
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computational Intelligence
summary: In cross-silo split learning, Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling forms representative pooled batches when class distributions differ across clients, but ignores client delay when several clients can supply the same class. We introduce Latency Budgeted Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling, which separates each pooled batch's integer class target from the choice of clients that supply its examples. The flow variant formulates this assignment as an integral network-flow problem and minimizes modeled client-side completion time for the current target. The fast variant uses a greedy next-completion rule to reduce schedule-construction cost. Both preserve the target stream and use every local example once per epoch. A planning rule selects between the variants while accounting for the cost of constructing both candidate schedules. On CIFAR-10, the flow variant reduces modeled training time by 6.75%, with a 0.30 percentage-point decrease in final accuracy. On Tiny ImageNet with 20 candidate classes per client, the fast variant reduces modeled time by 16.87% and reaches all four validation targets earlier than the latency-unaware baseline. Across 405 schedule comparisons, the planning rule stays within 2% of the lower realized cost in 96.54% of cases. In our evaluation, latency-aware provider assignment reduces modeled training time without changing the prescribed class targets, while the preferred variant depends on whether assignment savings outweigh schedule-construction overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出Latency Budgeted Parallel Split Learning with Global Sampling，将池化批次的类别目标与供给客户端的选择解耦，通过流分配和贪心两种变体在保持类别目标的同时降低建模训练时延。
AI.motivation: 跨孤岛拆分学习中，并行拆分学习+全局采样的池化批次在客户端类别分布不同时成立，但当多个客户端都能供同一类别时忽略了客户端时延。
AI.method: 将每个池化批次的整数类别目标与供给客户端选择分离；flow变体把分配建模为整数网络流问题，最小化当前目标的建模客户端完成时间；fast变体用贪心next-completion规则降低调度构建成本；两变体均保持目标流并每epoch使用每个本地样本一次；规划规则根据构建两个候选调度的开销选择变体。
AI.result: CIFAR-10上flow变体降低建模训练时间6.75%，最终精度下降0.30个百分点；Tiny ImageNet（每客户端20候选类）上fast变体降低建模时间16.87%，且比时延无关基线更早达到全部四个验证目标；405次调度比较中，规划规则96.54%情况下落在较低实际成本2%以内。
AI.conclusion: 时延感知的供给者分配可在不改变规定类别目标的前提下降低建模训练时间，偏好哪种变体取决于分配节省是否超过调度构建开销。

title: MergeHEIR: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations as the Tax of Model Merging
summary: Model merging consolidates task-specialized experts into a single deployable model. However, we show that such capability consolidation incurs a merging tax of increased hallucination: across 8 model-merging methods, every merged checkpoint exhibits a higher hallucination rate than the average of its constituent experts. An intuitive approach is to adapt existing hallucination-mitigation methods to the post-merge model, yet this unconstrained adaptation disrupts inherited capabilities, creating a tension between hallucination mitigation and expertise retention.
