AI.motivation: LLM存在时间错位问题，常源于训练语料的矛盾性。现有缓解策略依赖高成本微调或上下文繁重的RAG，而时间敏感回忆的内部机制仍未被充分探索。先前研究虽识别出注意力头和MLP层等时间组件，但缺乏特征层面的刻画。
AI.method: 利用transcoder电路追踪（circuit tracing）隔离单个MLP特征，对Gemma 2 2B、LLaMA 3.2 1B和Qwen3-4B三个模型进行分析，识别节点类别并研究其跨层交互方式。
AI.result: 识别出三类节点：common temporal（通用时间）、common to the year（年份通用）和chrono-semantic（时序语义）。这些特征并非简单线性流水线，而是跨层呈现并行、句法-语义混合的交互。此外发现一类高层时间组件，现有EAP-IG方法无法识别。
AI.conclusion: transcoder是比现有方法更完整的时间可解释性视角，MLP组件可为时间敏感事实回忆提供潜在的目标干预手段。

title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示文本到图像模型中的"喻体入侵"失败现象，提出VISTA基准和V-Score指标进行系统评估，并给出轻量缓解方案VISTA-Guard。
AI.motivation: TTI模型能生成高质量图像，但面对比喻性语言时存在失败：本应引导本体描绘的喻体被渲染为可见对象。该问题中侵入内容在文本上是合理的，却被赋予错误的视觉角色，说明视觉存在不等于忠实，而以存在为导向的评估会遗漏此类错误。
AI.method: 提出VISTA（喻体入侵与语义本体评估）多语言基准，按比喻形式和映射机制组织比喻提示；并提出V-Score，一种诊断性问答指标，评估生成图像中角色感知的比喻忠实度；同时提出轻量缓解方案VISTA-Guard。
AI.result: 对近期高性能TTI模型的评估表明，喻体入侵在不同语言和比喻类别中持续存在；VISTA-Guard可部分减少喻体入侵。
AI.conclusion: 喻体入侵是TTI模型比喻忠实度的系统性问题，VISTA基准和V-Score指标可有效诊断，VISTA-Guard为更忠实的比喻生成提供了实用路径，所有资源将公开。

title: CompassPlay: Rewarding the Proposer for Where It Moves the Solver
summary: In self-play, a proposer generates verifiable tasks to train a solver. Proposer rewards often depend on the solver's success rate, but equally difficult tasks can differ in their training value. We introduce CompassPlay, a self-play method that rewards the proposer through gradient alignment. The reward favors tasks whose solver loss gradients align with those of reference tasks representing the target capabilities. It draws on a first-order approximation to learning progress and scores each eligible task without additional solver training. Our experiments show gains in performance and training efficiency. In coding self-play with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, a small external reference set guides task generation. CompassPlay improves average accuracy over AZR's difficulty reward by 1.5 percentage points on in-domain coding and 2.7 on out-of-domain mathematics. In Lean4 theorem proving, CompassPlay matches the difficulty baseline's 150-iteration cumulative coverage with 40\% fewer GPU-hours.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CompassPlay，一种通过梯度对齐奖励出题者的自博弈方法，利用一阶近似学习进度来评估任务训练价值，在编码和定理证明任务上提升性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有自博弈中出题者奖励多依赖解题者成功率，但同等难度的任务训练价值可能不同，难度奖励无法有效衡量任务对目标能力的贡献。
AI.method: CompassPlay 通过梯度对齐奖励出题者：奖励那些其解题者损失梯度与代表目标能力的参考任务梯度对齐的任务；基于学习进度的一阶近似，每个合格任务无需额外训练解题者即可打分。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 编码自博弈中，少量外部参考集引导任务生成，CompassPlay 相比 AZR 难度奖励在域内编码平均准确率提升 1.5 个百分点，域外数学提升 2.7 个百分点；在 Lean4 定理证明中，以少 40% GPU 时间达到难度基线 150 次迭代的累计覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 通过梯度对齐奖励替代难度奖励，CompassPlay 能更有效衡量任务训练价值，在编码与定理证明自博弈中同时提升性能和训练效率。

title: Separating Diagnosis from Disease Representation: Dual-View EEG Learning with Neural-Dynamics-Guided Deformation
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based closed-loop neuromodulation calls for a subject-specific structured state, as opposed to a single disease probability, specifying which brain regions are deviant, at which frequencies, and at which lags. Sensor-space models keep the strongest diagnostic evidence without anatomy, source-space models give anatomy at a loss of predictive signal, and post-hoc attributions stay outside the prediction. We separate the two instead of forcing them into one representation, and propose DMD-EEG (Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG), which keeps a fixed scalp spectral expert for diagnosis and models the source-space disease-related representation as a low-rank, sparse, iterative deformation of a healthy neural-dynamics prior in a $46$-region-of-interest (ROI) $\times$ $5$-frequency $\times$ $4$-lag (autocorrelation-timescale) space. The two experts meet only at a fixed decision level, so the source state is architecturally separate from the scalp expert. Across major depressive disorder (MDD), first-episode psychosis (FEP), and Parkinson's disease (PD), decision-level fusion matches the strongest single expert on MDD and FEP and exceeds the source branch on PD. On FEP the source expert is the strongest branch, the task where the deformation contributes most. The source state is an explicit ROI-frequency-lag attribution defined in a shared source coordinate system across montages, which we treat as an anatomically-coordinated predictive representation whose coordinates are directly readable and hypothesis-generating. The highest-saliency coordinates align with established disease circuitry (fronto-limbic-temporal regions in MDD, motor-cortex beta in PD), and the MDD state transfers by rank to an unseen cohort recorded with a different montage.

AI.tldr: 提出DMD-EEG双视图框架，分开保留头皮频谱专家用于诊断、源空间低秩稀疏形变建模疾病表征，决策级融合，可读坐标与疾病环路吻合且可跨蒙太奇迁移。
AI.motivation: EEG闭环神经调控需要受试者特异的结构化状态（哪些脑区、哪些频率、哪些时滞异常），而非单一疾病概率。但传感器空间模型缺解剖、源空间模型损失预测信号、事后归因又游离于预测之外，因此需要分离而非强行统一两种表征。
AI.method: 提出DMD-EEG（双视图多尺度形变）：固定头皮频谱专家用于诊断；将源空间疾病相关表征建模为健康神经动力学先验的低秩、稀疏、迭代形变，表示于46 ROI×5频率×4时滞空间；两专家仅在固定决策层融合，源状态与头皮专家结构性分离。
AI.result: 在MDD、FEP、PD上，决策级融合在MDD和FEP匹敌最强单专家，在PD超过源分支；FEP中源专家最强（形变贡献最大）。高显著性坐标与已知疾病环路一致（MDD额-边缘-颞区、PD运动皮层beta），MDD状态可跨不同蒙太奇的未见队列按秩迁移。
AI.conclusion: 源状态是跨蒙太奇共享坐标系统下显式的ROI-频率-时滞归因，可作为解剖协调的可读预测表征，兼具预测力与假设生成能力。

title: Turning Speech Language Models into Multilingual Listeners
summary: Speech Language Models (SLMs) that understand spoken language questions support only a few high-resource languages, limiting access to millions of people worldwide. This gap stems from the scarcity of multilingual speech instruction-tuning datasets. We present MULTISPEECHQA, a large-scale, synthetically generated and human-verified dataset comprising 9200 hours of 10.8 million spoken question-answer pairs in 23 typologically diverse languages. Using MULTISPEECHQA, we also introduce MULTISPEECH-BENCH, a multi-task benchmark for evaluating SLM performance on 23 languages. We compare the performance of a cascading system to open-weight and closed SLMs on MULTISPEECH-BENCH and find that the cascading system outperforms open-weight SLMs but not all closed SLMs. We use MULTISPEECHQA to finetune Qwen 2.5-Omni, which improves its performance on our benchmark. Our findings show that high-quality synthetic datasets offer a cheap solution to improving the multilingual capabilities of SLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MULTISPEECHQA多语言语音问答数据集（9200小时、1080万对、23种语言），并构建MULTISPEECH-BENCH基准，用于评估并提升语音语言模型的多语言能力。
AI.motivation: 现有语音语言模型仅支持少数高资源语言，全球数百万人难以使用，根本原因是缺乏多语言语音指令微调数据集。
AI.method: 构建大规模、合成生成并经人工验证的多语言语音问答数据集MULTISPEECHQA（9200小时、1080万问答对、23种类型学多样的语言），并基于此提出多任务基准MULTISPEECH-BENCH；对比级联系统与开源/闭源SLM，并用该数据微调Qwen 2.5-Omni。
AI.result: 级联系统优于开源SLM但不及所有闭源SLM；用MULTISPEECHQA微调Qwen 2.5-Omni后，其在基准上的表现得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 高质量合成数据集是低成本提升语音语言模型多语言能力的有效方案。

title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
summary: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

AI.tldr: MOXAI是一个整合DNA甲基化与拷贝数变异数据的可解释深度学习框架，用于成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型分类，多模态模型交叉验证准确率达92.98%，DINOv2独立验证达94.25%，并可通过CAM/Grad-CAM定位关键CpG位点、基因及染色体区域。
AI.motivation: 现有DNA甲基化分析方法通常分别处理甲基化与拷贝数变异数据，未能捕捉二者互补信息；同时缺乏类内风险评估机制（类似传统肿瘤分级）以及能将分类决策归因到具体基因组位点的可解释性方法。
AI.method: 提出MOXAI多组学可解释AI框架，整合甲基化芯片的DNA甲基化与拷贝数数据。基于TCGA队列，训练ResNet50、DINOv2和GAT模型，分别使用甲基化、拷贝数及多模态数据。并开发基于CAM和Grad-CAM的XAI方法，识别与分类决策最相关的CpG位点、基因和染色体区域。
AI.result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高达92.98%，优于仅用CNV的模型；DINOv2泛化能力最强，独立验证集准确率达94.25%（置信度>0.9）。XAI结果与已知的成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子特征一致，验证了框架的生物学可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MOXAI证明整合甲基化与拷贝数数据的多模态深度学习可有效提升胶质瘤分子亚型分类性能，且CAM/Grad-CAM类XAI方法能提供具有生物学意义的决策解释，为肿瘤诊断与分级提供新思路。

title: "Where Can I Trust You?": Boundary-Aware Evaluation of Surrogate Fidelity
summary: Surrogate models are commonly evaluated by how often they agree with their teacher model over an evaluation set. Local variation in this agreement is well known, but its structure and consequences are less clear. We ask whether disagreement is systematically concentrated near the teacher's decision boundary and whether retaining that structure provides information beyond a single global score. Across several datasets and surrogate model classes, we find substantially lower fidelity near teacher decision boundaries under two different methods of identifying near-boundary examples. Moreover, conditioning agreement on confidence-defined regions improves prediction of teacher--surrogate agreement when evaluation-set composition changes, relative to the global score alone. Yet surrogates that agree equally well with the teacher both globally and near the decision boundary can respond very differently to changes selected using the surrogate itself. Finally, we show that independently trained deep teachers can agree on most predictions while identifying different examples as lying near their decision boundaries, complicating the use of those boundaries as stable reference regions for evaluating surrogates. Together, these results show that surrogate fidelity depends not only on how often a surrogate agrees with its teacher, but also on where that agreement holds and, for deep models, how stable the teacher's decision boundary is across training runs.

AI.tldr: 代理模型保真度并非全局均匀，在教师决策边界附近显著下降；单一全局一致率评分不足以刻画代理模型的真实行为。
AI.motivation: 现有代理模型评价通常只看其与教师模型在评估集上的总体一致率，但局部一致性差异及影响尚不清楚。本文探究分歧是否系统性地集中在教师决策边界附近，以及这种结构是否比单一全局分数提供额外信息。
AI.method: 在多个数据集和多种代理模型类别上，采用两种识别近边界样本的方法，比较全局与近边界区域的一致性；将一致性按置信度定义区域条件化，考察评估集组成变化时对教师—代理一致性的预测能力；并比较独立训练的深度教师模型在其决策边界识别上的一致性。
AI.result: 两种方法均发现教师决策边界附近保真度明显更低；按置信度区域条件化可改善评估集组成变化下的一致性预测；全局与近边界一致性相同的代理模型，对用代理自身选出的样本变化反应差异很大；独立训练的深度教师虽多数预测一致，却将不同样本视为近边界，削弱了决策边界作为稳定参考区域的价值。
AI.conclusion: 代理模型保真度不仅取决于总体一致率，还取决于一致性发生的位置；对深度模型而言，还取决于教师决策边界跨训练运行的稳定性。

title: Towards Scalable Data Diversification for Language Model Pretraining via Leverage Score Sampling
summary: Data selection for language model pretraining faces a fundamental tension between quality and diversity. While quality filtering is empirically effective, it often induces diversity collapse: by favoring texts similar to high-quality reference corpora (e.g., educational or QA-style data), it systematically excludes valuable data from underrepresented domains. In contrast, diversified selection preserves domain balance and encourages robust downstream performance, yet existing methods either focus on coverage-oriented objectives that indirectly enhance diversity, or directly optimize for diversity via costly covariance matrix recomputation that limits scalability. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)}, which iteratively selects samples that maximally expand the determinantal volume of the embedded data via leverage scores, a computationally efficient criterion that eliminates matrix recomputation and enables scalable selection. Empirically, Lev delivers up to $72\times$ speedup and improves dataset diversity, measured by the Vendi score, by $9.2\%$ over the strong diversification baseline \textbf{DiSF}. On CommonCrawl (CC) web data selection, Lev improves accuracy across seven downstream tasks by up to $1.31\%$ over existing baselines. For domains where robust quality criteria are inherently difficult to define (e.g., code), Lev serves as an effective unsupervised curation alternative: on StarCoderData, the selected subset reduces bits-per-byte by $3.08\%$ over DiSF. Notably, we uncover a cross-domain collapse of quality filtering: CC data filtered by DCLM-fastText fail to retain sufficient code-related content, yielding inferior code performance relative to Lev-selected data. These findings advocate for integrating diversity-aware practices into quality filtering for more effective data curation in language model pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出杠杆分数采样(Lev)方法，通过迭代选择最大化嵌入数据行列式体积的样本，高效实现多样性数据选择，兼顾质量与多样性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型预训练数据选择存在质量与多样性的根本矛盾：质量过滤虽有效但会引多样性崩溃，偏向高质量参考语料而排除弱势领域数据；而现有多样化选择方法要么仅间接提升多样性，要么因协方差矩阵重计算而难以扩展。
AI.method: Lev(杠杆分数采样)迭代选取能最大扩展嵌入数据行列式体积的样本，利用杠杆分数作为高效准则，无需矩阵重计算，实现可扩展的多样化选择。
AI.result: 相比DiSF基线，Lev提速达72倍，Vendi分数多样性提升9.2%；在CommonCrawl选择上，七项下游任务准确率提升最高1.31%；在StarCoderData上bits-per-byte降低3.08%。还发现质量过滤的跨领域崩溃现象：DCLM-fastText过滤的CC数据丢失代码相关内容，代码性能逊于Lev。
AI.conclusion: 主张将多样性感知实践融入质量过滤，以实现更有效的预训练数据策管。

title: Beyond Calibration: Do a Typed-Decision Model's Probabilities Obey the Probability Axioms?
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/bro789/typed-decision-coherence
summary: Typed-decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer a declared yes/no or multiple-choice question about a state with a probability instead of text, and their evaluations report accuracy and calibration. Neither requires that the probabilities a model gives to logically related questions fit together item by item, which is what a system that acts on those probabilities needs. We test this property, coherence, with a battery of logically linked questions that needs no labels. For 160 items from ChaosNLI and PubMedQA, each with three mutually exclusive labels, we ask whether the label is X, whether it is not X, whether it is one of the other two labels, and which label applies. On 480 negation pairs, Jev's probabilities for "the label is X" and "the label is not X" miss summing to one by 0.064 on average (95% CI 0.055 to 0.072). Qwen3.8-27B, run from its official BF16 weights, misses by 0.293 with first-token probabilities and by 0.122 with verbalized probabilities. The gap to the first-token readout persists on pairs where both systems give similar probabilities, without double-negation labels, and after averaging Jev's repeated calls. Jev is not coherent either: its violations are about five times its repeat noise, and it over-endorses statements about single labels, so that its three single-label probabilities sum to 1.14 on average. The two systems also fail differently. Qwen3.8-27B's first-token readout under-endorses the complement of a label whether or not the question contains "not", rejecting both a statement and its negation in 196 of 480 pairs, and it does not become more coherent where it is more confident, whereas Jev's violations concentrate where its answer is uncertain. Because the checks need no labels, they expose biases that appear only when question forms are compared, and inconsistencies within items.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"连贯性(coherence)"评估typed-decision模型（如Jev）与Qwen3.8-27B：对逻辑相关问题（如"标签是X"与"标签不是X"）的概率是否逐项自洽，无需标签即可检验。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只报告准确率和校准，但都不要求模型对逻辑相关问题给出的概率彼此一致，而真正依据概率行动的系统需要这种连贯性。作者希望用无需标签的逻辑关联问题组来检验这一被忽视的性质。
AI.method: 用一批逻辑关联、无需标签的问题：取ChaosNLI和PubMedQA各160项（每项三个互斥标签），询问"标签是X吗"、"不是X吗"、"是另外两个之一吗"及"是哪个标签"。共480对否定对，比较"标签是X"与"标签不是X"的概率之和是否为一；Jev多次调用取平均，并控制双否定标签、相似概率对等情形，对比Jev与Qwen3.8-27B（BF16权重，首token概率与言语化概率两种读法）。
AI.result: 在480个否定对上，Jev两概率偏离和为1平均0.064（95% CI 0.055–0.072）；Qwen3.8-27B首token读法偏离0.293、言语化读法0.122。该差距在两者概率相近、无双否定标签、以及Jev重复调用取平均后仍存在。Jev同样不连贯：违规约为其重复噪声的5倍，且过度认同单标签陈述，三个单标签概率平均和为1.14。两者失败模式不同：Qwen首token读法无论问题是否含"not"都低估标签的补集，480对中有196对同时拒斥陈述及其否定，且置信度越高并未更连贯；Jev的违规则集中于其答案不确定处。
AI.conclusion: 由于检验无需标签，这类方法能揭示仅在比较问题形式时才显现的偏差以及条目内部的不一致性。Jev与Qwen3.8-27B均不连贯且失败方式各异，说明现有准确率与校准评估不足以刻画可据以行动的概率系统。

title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
summary: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.

AI.tldr: 提出Devol-ONE，一种Mixture of Transformers架构，将视觉语言理解、潜在世界动态预测与动作生成统一在单一自回归框架中。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型直接以当前视觉语言上下文生成动作，未显式考虑场景如何随候选动作演变；现有WAM虽预测未来状态，但预测与策略学习在架构上相互分离，仅通过预测输出（像素级视频生成或独立训练的潜空间预测模块）连接。
AI.method: Devol-ONE采用Mixture of Transformers架构，在视觉语言流与V-JEPA预训练动态流上联合自回归预测，每一层都关注视觉语言KV缓存，在语言引导下预测未来潜状态；动作专家由语义推理与预测的物理动态持续塑造，而非依赖预先计算的固定表示。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0及Flexiv单臂与双臂真实世界环境中进行了大量实验；消融实验验证了动态流预测与逐层统一注意力的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构层面的统一注意力与动态流预测，验证了模型架构的一致性与有效性。

title: Arithmetic Simplicity in Stochastic Gradient Methods
summary:
A gradient descent method is arithmetically simple if the operations are limited to $+,-, \times$, and division $x/2^t$ with integer $t$. An arthmetically simple gradient method is easy to implement in chip design. We show how to transform AdaGrad, Adam, and AdamW into arithmetically simple.
  AdamW is based on the recursion $x_{t+1}=(1-λη)x_t-\frac{η}{s}m_t$ and Adam is the special case of AdamW with $λ=0$. We transform them into a static case with $s=S(T)$, where $T$ is the number of iterations, and $S(T)$ is a fixed function. The convergence analysis is given for a static Adam, which is also arithmetically simple.

AI.tldr: 将 AdaGrad、Adam、AdamW 转化为算术简单梯度方法（仅用加减、乘和除以 2 的幂），便于芯片实现，并给出静态 Adam 的收敛分析。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降方法算术越简单越易在芯片设计中实现，因此希望把 AdaGrad、Adam、AdamW 改造成算术简单形式。
AI.method: 利用 AdamW 递推 x_{t+1}=(1-λη)x_t-(η/s)m_t（Adam 为 λ=0 特例），将其转化为 s=S(T) 的静态情形，S(T) 为固定函数。
AI.result: 成功把 AdaGrad、Adam、AdamW 改造为算术简单方法，并对静态 Adam 给出收敛性分析。
AI.conclusion: 算术简单的 Adam/AdamW 变体可行且具收敛保证，适合芯片设计实现。

title: When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 25 pages, 16 figures. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文研究三模态VQA中不可靠辅助文本对答案选择的影响，发现"与问题对齐、与图像矛盾、支持特定错误选项"的文本危害最大。作者提出Textual Reliability Ladder诊断协议，并设计免训练推理干预缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 三模态VQA常用辅助文本补充视觉与文本输入，但其可靠性往往不受控。以往工作研究一般性模态冲突，却不清楚在固定的图像-问题-选项情境下，不同类型的不可靠辅助文本如何影响答案选择。
AI.method: 提出Textual Reliability Ladder受控诊断协议，沿三个轴分解辅助文本：图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持度；并设计免训练的推理时干预，通过噪声稳定性引导与动态接地抵消重定向效应。
AI.result: 在ScienceQA、VCR、A-OKVQA、Causal-VidQA及多个近期VLM上，支持干扰项的文本导致最大准确率下降（高达53.1%），且错误集中在特定错误选项上。
AI.conclusion: 辅助文本的可靠性应在决策层面理解，而非仅看事实正确性；提出的干预方法为更鲁棒的三模态推理提供了实用路径。

title: CoLMbo-SV: A Grounded Language Model for Explainable Speaker Verification
summary: Speaker verification systems achieve high accuracy but provide little account of the acoustic evidence behind their judgments. Making these systems inspectable requires exposing interpretable evidence while retaining the richer information on which their decisions depend. We present \textbf{CoLMbo-SV}, a speaker language model that combines strong speaker discrimination with structured, acoustically grounded comparison reports. By connecting a pretrained speaker encoder to a language model and supplying explicit acoustic measurements, CoLMbo-SV makes voice comparisons inspectable without restricting verification to the evidence verbalized in its reports. We additionally introduce \textbf{VoxReason}, paired recordings with measured acoustic properties and comparison reports filtered through numerical and qualitative checks, providing supervision for this combined capability. We also develop an evaluation framework that separates what acoustic information a speaker representation encodes, what influences the verification score, and what the generated report discusses. On VoxCeleb1-O, CoLMbo-SV achieves 0.99\% EER, reducing verification error by approximately 80\% relative to the strongest audio-language baseline fine-tuned on VoxReason, while attaining a numerical-grounding score of 0.82. Our analysis further demonstrates that acoustic correctness and decision relevance are distinct properties of an explanation, exposing a gap that numerical-grounding metrics miss. Together, these contributions substantially advance audio-language speaker verification, bring its accuracy toward that of dedicated speaker encoders while adding checkable acoustic reporting, and establish an empirical framework for connecting natural-language explanations to the decisions they explain.

AI.tldr: 提出CoLMbo-SV说话人语言模型，将预训练说话人编码器与语言模型结合并注入声学测量，实现可检验的声学对比报告；同时发布VoxReason数据集与评估框架，在VoxCeleb1-O上达0.99% EER，较最强基线降低约80%错误，并揭示声学正确性与决策相关性是解释的两个不同属性。
AI.motivation: 现有说话人验证系统精度高但缺乏对其判断背后声学证据的说明，难以被审查。要提升可检查性，需在保留丰富决策信息的同时暴露可解释的证据。
AI.method: 1) 构建CoLMbo-SV：连接预训练说话人编码器与语言模型，并提供显式声学测量，使语音对比可检验且不限于报告中所口头化的证据；2) 构建VoxReason数据集：成对录音、测量得到的声学属性及经数值与定性检查过滤的对比报告，用于监督联合能力；3) 设计评估框架，区分说话人表示编码的声学信息、影响验证分数的因素、以及生成报告讨论的内容。
AI.result: 在VoxCeleb1-O上，CoLMbo-SV达到0.99% EER，相比在VoxReason上微调的最强音频-语言基线降低约80%验证错误，数值接地分数为0.82。分析表明声学正确性与决策相关性是解释的两个不同属性，存在数值接地指标未能捕捉的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了音频-语言说话人验证，使其精度接近专用说话人编码器，同时增加可检验的声学报告，并建立了将自然语言解释与其所解释的决策相联系的实证框架。

title: Kernel-Based Steering of CLIP with Vision-Language Model Preferences
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can judge visual similarity, but their judgments are not directly available as compact image embeddings for efficient comparison. We study how to transfer these preferences into CLIP while retaining its image--text capabilities. We introduce ASK, a kernel-based steering method that learns from elicited pairwise judgments without accessing teacher embeddings or collecting new human similarity annotations. ASK constructs positive semidefinite target kernels within small image groups and combines visual kernel matching with an image--text distributional anchor. Low-rank adapters jointly update the visual and text encoders while regularizing predictions toward frozen CLIP. After adaptation, retrieval uses CLIP image embeddings and cosine similarity, with no VLM calls. Experiments across five image domains, four CLIP backbones, and six judges evaluate teacher agreement, retrieval, and recognition retention. For ViT-B/16, mean retrieval mAP on classes excluded from adaptation increases from 53.8 to 75.0, compared with 71.7 for DINOv2 targets with KL anchoring. Mean zero-shot accuracy with jointly adapted encoders increases from 61.8\% to 62.4\%, averaged over 12 benchmarks and the five adaptation domains. Prompting provides an additional capability: selecting which visual distinctions the student learns. Human-annotated evaluations across four datasets support this criterion-specific control.

AI.tldr: ASK将大型视觉语言模型的视觉相似性偏好通过核基引导方法迁移到CLIP，在保留图像-文本能力的同时提升检索效果。
AI.motivation: 大型VLM能判断视觉相似性，但其判断无法作为紧凑图像嵌入用于高效比较；希望将这种偏好迁移到CLIP，同时保留其图像-文本能力。
AI.method: 提出ASK，一种核基引导方法：在图像小组内构建半正定目标核，结合视觉核匹配与图像-文本分布锚定；用低秩适配器联合更新视觉和文本编码器，并正则化预测趋向冻结CLIP。适配后检索仅用CLIP图像嵌入和余弦相似度，无需VLM调用。
AI.result: 在五个图像域、四个CLIP骨干、六个评判者上评估。ViT-B/16在排除类上的平均检索mAP从53.8升至75.0（对比DINOv2目标+KL锚定的71.7）。联合适配编码器后12个基准和五域平均零样本准确率从61.8%升至62.4%。提示可额外控制学生学习哪些视觉区分，四个数据集的人工评估支持这种标准特定控制。
AI.conclusion: ASK有效将VLM视觉相似性偏好迁移到CLIP，提升检索与零样本性能，同时保留图像-文本能力，并支持通过提示实现标准特定的视觉区分控制。

title: Anytime-Valid LLM Leaderboards via Benchmark-weighted and Block-Factorized e-Processes
summary: Large language model (LLM) leaderboards compare model capabilities by ranking models according to their mean performance on fixed benchmarks. However, variability in evaluation outcomes across runs may produce unsupported claims of model superiority on the benchmark, a risk compounded by leaderboard updates. In this paper, we propose BB-EDGE (Benchmark-Weighted and Block-Factorized e-processes for Directed Graph Evaluation), a principled framework that represents an LLM leaderboard as a directed graph whose edges certify pairwise mean-performance advantages, with anytime-valid family-wise error rate (FWER) control. Concretely, for each direction, BB-EDGE constructs an empirical-Bernstein e-process by factorizing evidence over protocol-defined blocks and assigning stakes proportional to the corresponding block weights, then applies direct e-Holm across these $e$-processes to certify directional advantages as edges. Theoretically, we characterize weight-proportional linear stakes under heterogeneous benchmark-average nulls and prove anytime FWER control under arbitrary within-block and cross-pair dependence. BB-EDGE further supports anytime-valid Top-$k$ certification and simultaneous rank intervals. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and four real-world benchmarks demonstrate that BB-EDGE maintains anytime FWER control while achieving high efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出BB-EDGE框架，将LLM排行榜建模为有向图，通过e-process实现任意时间有效的FWER控制的方向性优势认证。
AI.motivation: LLM排行榜依据固定基准上的平均表现排名，但评估结果的多次运行变异性可能产生无根据的优越性声明，排行榜更新更放大此风险。
AI.method: 将排行榜表示为有向图，边表示成对平均性能优势。对每个方向构建经验Bernstein e-process：将证据按协议定义块分解，按块权重分配stakes，再用direct e-Holm在e-process上认证方向优势。
AI.result: 理论上刻画异质基准平均零假设下权重比例线性stakes，证明在任意块内与跨对依赖下任意时间FWER控制。支持Top-k认证与同步排名区间。合成数据及四个真实基准实验显示保持FWER控制且高效。
AI.conclusion: BB-EDGE为LLM排行榜提供原则性、任意时间有效且高效的成对方向优势认证方法，防止运行变异性导致的错误优越性声明。

title: RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks.
  To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving.
  Across ProgSpec and five existing benchmarks, RepoMAS achieves the best performance. Further analyses show that its issue-driven revision and repository maintenance mechanisms consistently contribute to performance. These results highlight the importance of allowing MASs to revise not only how a task is solved, but also revise their explicit representation of task requirements during execution.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进指定任务设定及ProgSpec基准，并设计RepoMAS多智能体框架，通过问题驱动机制动态修订任务需求，在多项基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统大多假设任务需求在执行前已充分明确，但实际中用户请求常不完整，额外需求可能在推理、工具使用或执行过程中才浮现。
AI.method: 提出ProgSpec基准，评估最终输出是否符合初始需求及任务证据支持的新增需求；并提出RepoMAS框架，借鉴开源项目管理，将新需求、冲突与失败记录为结构化Issue，据此修订任务规范与执行结构。
AI.result: 在ProgSpec及五个现有基准上，RepoMAS均取得最佳性能；分析表明其问题驱动修订与仓库维护机制持续带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统不仅需修订任务求解方式，还应在执行过程中修订对任务需求的显式表示，这对渐进指定任务至关重要。

title: Beyond Memory Construction: Rethinking Memory Access for LLM-based Conversational Agents
summary: Memory is a core component of conversational agents, enabling coherent and context-aware behavior over long interactions. Recent approaches commonly rely on LLM-based memory construction, where raw interactions are rewritten into structured memory units and later retrieved via a RAG pipeline. While effective in controlled settings, we show that this paradigm breaks down in long-horizon, high-entropy conversations: memory construction becomes increasingly lossy and unstable as context length and information complexity grow, and incurs prohibitive cost due to repeated LLM invocation. To address these limitations, we propose Threader, a memory system that shifts the focus from memory construction to efficient, structure-aware access over raw interactions. Instead of rewriting interactions, Threader preserves them as first-class memory, organizes them into topic-coherent segments via lightweight incremental segmentation, and enables accurate retrieval through multi-view representation. At query time, it performs multi-signal retrieval that combines segment-level access with localized evidence matching, ensuring both completeness and coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Threader consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall, while significantly reducing the memory construction overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出Threader记忆系统，摒弃LLM改写式记忆构建，转而保留原始交互并进行结构感知的高效检索。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的记忆构建在长时程、高熵对话中逐渐有损、不稳定且成本高昂（重复调用LLM）。
AI.method: 将原始交互作为一等记忆保留，通过轻量增量分割组织成语义连贯的topic segments，并用多视图表示与多信号检索（segment级访问＋局部证据匹配）实现检索。
AI.result: 在大量实验中，Threader持续提升答案准确率与证据召回率，并显著降低记忆构建开销。
AI.conclusion: 应将对话记忆的重点从“构建/改写”转向对原始交互的高效结构感知访问。

title: Geometry-Preserving Blind Watermarking for Raw 3D Point Clouds
summary:
Raw 3D point clouds are a core geometric representation. Establishing their ownership is challenging because point sets are irregular, unstructured, and frequently altered by resampling and geometric preprocessing. We present a blind watermarking framework that operates directly on xyz coordinates and supports both object-level shapes and scene-scale scans. At verification time, the embedded message is recovered from the observed point cloud alone, without access to the original point cloud, color, normals, or mesh connectivity. The method jointly learns watermark embedding and extraction through a feed-forward octree-based architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale geometric reasoning on large point sets. During training, a stochastic transformation layer exposes the decoder to common geometric perturbations, while progressive pose alignment improves robustness to pose changes.
  Experiments on object-level and scene-level benchmarks demonstrate reliable message recovery under common geometric processing while maintaining low geometric distortion. Qualitative comparisons further show that the learned perturbations are less visually conspicuous and less spatially structured than those of handcrafted alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出直接作用于xyz坐标的盲水印框架，基于八叉树前馈网络联合学习水印嵌入与提取，支持物体级与场景级点云，无需原始点云即可验证，兼顾鲁棒性与低几何失真。
AI.motivation: 3D点云是核心几何表示，但其集合不规则、无结构且常经重采样与几何预处理，导致所有权认证困难。
AI.method: 直接在xyz坐标上操作的盲水印框架；采用前馈八叉树架构联合学习嵌入与提取，实现大规模点集的多尺度几何推理；训练时引入随机变换层以暴露解码器于常见几何扰动，并用渐进式姿态对齐提升位姿鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在物体级与场景级基准上，常见几何处理下仍能可靠恢复信息，且几何失真低；定性比较显示所学扰动比手工方法视觉上更不显眼、空间结构更弱。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了无需原始点云、颜色、法线或网格连通性的盲验证，适用于物体与场景尺度，兼顾鲁棒性与低失真。

title: Representation Editing for Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt a pretrained multimodal model online to distribution shift across modalities using unlabeled test data, showing broad potential in real-world applications. However, existing methods primarily focus on adjusting fused features to bridge the source-target gap, lacking explicit control over intermediate representation misalignment, which is a key driver of performance drop under distribution shift. In this work, we tackle this challenge from the perspective of representation engineering. Unlike previous TTA methods that update fusion weights in place, we propose FourIer Representation Editor (FIRE), a novel multimodal TTA approach that directly edits semantically rich intermediate representations. Specifically, we first adopt representation editors into each intermediate layer of the unimodal encoders, enabling layer-wise calibration of unimodal representations. To further enhance the diversity and stability of the low-rank editing subspaces, each representation editor performs frequency domain mixing via the fast Fourier transform to construct structured bases. Moreover, we introduce multi-level adaptation objectives to optimize these editors, jointly promoting cross-modal semantic alignment, source-target statistical alignment, and asymmetric prediction consistency. In this way, FIRE yields aligned unimodal representations for fusion and further improves prediction reliability. Extensive experiments on two widely used multimodal benchmarks under various corruption types demonstrate the superiority of FIRE over existing multimodal TTA methods.

AI.tldr: FIRE提出一种多模态测试时自适应方法，通过表示工程直接编辑中间表示以应对分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态TTA方法主要调整融合特征，缺乏对中间表示错位的显式控制，而这是分布偏移下性能下降的关键因素。
AI.method: 在单模态编码器各中间层引入表示编辑器进行逐层校准；编辑器通过FFT频域混合构建结构化低秩编辑子空间；并用多层自适应目标联合优化跨模态语义对齐、源目标统计对齐和非对称预测一致性。
AI.result: 在两个广泛使用的多模态基准上，针对多种损坏类型，FIRE优于现有多模态TTA方法。
AI.conclusion: FIRE通过直接编辑中间表示产生对齐的单模态表示以利于融合，提升预测可靠性，验证了表示工程在多模态TTA中的有效性。

title: Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs
summary: Large language models can solve increasingly diverse reasoning tasks, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to task prompts, intermediate instructions, and the way reusable problem-solving knowledge is incorporated. Existing optimization methods usually focus on only one part of this design space: they either optimize a monolithic prompt, or separately induce and refine skills from model traces. As a result, they lack a principled mechanism for deciding which component should be updated when failures occur, and they rarely optimize prompts, skills, and skill-use policies in a unified framework. We propose SPARO (Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes task instructions, reusable skill blocks, and routing rules. It performs controlled counterfactual evaluations, converts examples' effects into a probabilistic responsibility distribution over prompt, skill, and routing components, samples one component from that distribution, and applies the corresponding targeted mutation. This design moves language-program optimization beyond global prompt rewriting toward structured, reusable, and selectively activated task knowledge. Across five benchmarks and five worker models, SPARO consistently outperforms both prompt-centered and skill-centered optimization baselines. These results suggest that effective language-program optimization depends not only on discovering useful task knowledge, but also on deciding where that knowledge should be stored and when it should be activated.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARO框架，联合优化任务指令、可复用技能块与路由规则，通过反事实评估分配概率责任并定向变异，在五个基准与五个worker模型上优于prompt中心和skill中心基线。
AI.motivation: 现有优化方法要么只优化单体prompt，要么单独从模型轨迹中诱导和精炼技能，缺乏在失败时决定更新哪个组件的原则性机制，鲜有统一优化prompt、技能与技能使用策略的框架。
AI.method: SPARO进行受控反事实评估，将示例的影响转化为对prompt、skill、routing组件的概率责任分布；从该分布采样一个组件，并施加对应的定向变异（targeted mutation）。
AI.result: 在五个基准和五个worker模型上，SPARO持续优于prompt中心与skill中心的优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 有效的语言程序优化不仅依赖发现有用的任务知识，还取决于决定该知识应存储于何处以及何时被激活，即从全局prompt重写转向结构化、可复用、选择性激活的任务知识。

title: The Text Beside the Image: Detection, Utility and Leakage for Trustworthy Multimodal Medical Data and Beyond
summary: Medical images are released with the reports that describe them, and protecting the image does not protect the report. This paper measures the text component of such releases. We measure identifier detection, downstream utility and residual identity leakage on the same documents, with the pseudonymisation policy as the variable under test: 15 detectors, three release conditions and four corpora of medical reports, legal judgments, news and other genres, and e-mail, in German, English, Chinese and Arabic. A fixed 13-detector union reaches a person sensitivity of 0.9998 at specificity 0.8686 on the medical reports, 0.9958 at 0.8504 on the legal judgments, 0.9352 at 0.9318 on news and other genres, and 0.9906 at 0.6235 on e-mail. With this ensemble, frequency matching with a public name list recovers zero identities by alignment across the four corpora; the names it got right were ones the detector missed, left in clear text. Cross-document linkage ranks the correct person first for 0.93% of e-mail queries without training and 3.94% with it, against 1/3697 chance and 71.98% on unmodified text. On the medical reports it recovers nothing without training and 0.71% of 138 queries with it, against 1/207 chance and a 2.73% ceiling on unmodified text.

AI.tldr: 本文系统衡量医学报告等文本发布中的隐私保护效果，用15类检测器与多种发布策略在4种语料、4种语言上测试标识符检测、下游效用与残余身份泄露。
AI.motivation: 医学图像常附带描述性报告发布，保护图像并不能保护报告，报告文本本身存在隐私泄露风险，需要量化其标识符识别与残余泄露。
AI.method: 以伪名化策略为变量，构建13检测器固定并集，在15种检测器、3种发布条件、4个语料（医学报告、法律判决、新闻及其他、电子邮件）、4种语言（德/英/中/阿）上进行标识符检测、下游效用与残余身份泄露测量，包括频率匹配与跨文档链接攻击。
AI.result: 检测器并集在医学报告上person敏感度0.9998/特异度0.8686，法律0.9958/0.8504，新闻等0.9352/0.9318，邮件0.9906/0.6235；频率匹配对齐恢复0身份，漏检姓名仍留明文；跨文档链接在邮件上无训练0.93%、有训练3.94%（随机1/3697，未处理71.98%），医学报告无训练0、有训练0.71%（随机1/207，未处理上限2.73%）。
AI.conclusion: 伪名化结合高灵敏度检测可显著降低直接标识符与链接泄露，但邮件等场景残余风险仍高，且漏检明文姓名是主要漏洞。

title: Skeletons in Flow: Graph Structured Flow Matching for Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction requires diverse future trajectories that remain consistent with observed motion and the articulated physical structure of the body. Skeletal constraints restrict individual poses, while coordinated motion depends on spatial interactions (between connected joints) and temporal interactions (between time instants). To facilitate human motion prediction in light of these constraints and interactions, we introduce Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM), which transports the complete future skeletal trajectory through a single conditional velocity field. The trajectory produces a spatiotemporal skeleton graph, and spatial and temporal attention couple its evolution according to skeletal relations and physical time offsets. Bone directions lie on unit spheres relative to a root joint, and tangent evolution preserves input bone lengths throughout generation. We train a learned velocity field through conditional flow matching along geodesic paths connecting random trajectories centered on the last-observed pose to recorded future trajectories. Experiments on the Archive of Motion capture As Surface Shapes (AMASS) dataset evaluate prediction accuracy, diversity calibration, and motion statistics. We demonstrate the contributions of spatial and temporal message passing in the developed architecture through an ablation study. GSFM models trained on AMASS also perform competitively on the Human3.6M skeleton without parameter updates or retraining, demonstrating applicability to an unseen skeletal structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GSFM（图结构流匹配），通过单一条件速度场传输完整未来骨骼轨迹，结合时空注意力建模骨骼约束与交互，在单位球面上保持骨长，实现在AMASS上的高精度多样化动作预测，并零样本迁移至Human3.6M。
AI.motivation: 人体动作预测需要多样化且与观测动作和骨骼物理结构一致的结果。骨骼约束限制单帧姿态，协调运动依赖空间（关节间）和时间（时刻间）交互，现有方法难以同时兼顾这些约束与交互。
AI.method: 提出图结构流匹配(GSFM)：用单一条件速度场传输完整未来骨骼轨迹，生成时空骨骼图，通过空间与时间注意力耦合其演化。骨骼方向相对于根关节位于单位球面，切空间演化保持骨长。沿测地路径（从以最后观测姿态为中心的随机轨迹到真实轨迹）用条件流匹配训练速度场。
AI.result: 在AMASS上评估预测精度、多样性校准及运动统计，消融实验证明时空消息传递的贡献；在无参数更新或重训练下，在Human3.6M骨骼上也具竞争力，验证对未见骨骼结构的适用性。
AI.conclusion: GSFM通过图结构流匹配有效结合骨骼约束与时空交互，生成多样且物理一致的动作预测，并展现跨骨骼结构的泛化能力。

title: When Can Old Evaluations Certify a New Model? Label-Efficient Release Decisions under Evaluator Drift
summary: Releasing a model update requires certifying that its current-population risk stays below a threshold. Trusted labels are expensive, while a cheap evaluator, such as an LLM judge, scores every example. Reusing evaluator errors from earlier audits is tempting, but when may such evidence replace current labels? It depends on the status of history. If the errors can change invisibly, no label-free test detects the change, and every valid, useful certifier must keep buying labels at a rate we characterize; if a bound on the change is assumed, label-free certification is valid at an explicit error cost. For the middle ground, where history is informative but untrusted, we propose \emph{portfolio vigilance}, a sequential certifier mixing a betting expert guided by history with one that learns only from current labels; history affects only how it bets, so validity holds for any history. The contribution is not prior-informed betting or expert mixtures, but separating history that may enter validity from history that may only guide label collection. In a canonical model, accurate history shortens decisions but never raises the evidence growth rate; stale history can destroy it. On held-out CIFAR-10N and DICES-990 data, portfolio vigilance needs 0.465 (95\% CI $[0.327,0.575]$) and 0.740 ($[0.618,0.877]$) times the labels of a matched prediction-powered monitor, with no observed false certification, and fewer labels on all six external blocks. Under corrupted advice it stays within 8.0\% of its better component, while trusting history alone costs up to 1.66 times as much. In post-confirmatory repeated-judge experiments on DICES-990 and ToxicChat, changing a fixed LLM judge's rubric moves its scores beyond run-to-run variation; the portfolio then needs 0.790 ($[0.667,0.909]$) and 0.631 ($[0.520,0.770]$) times the labels of the matched monitor, and fewer than trusting history alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究模型更新风险认证中如何利用历史评估器误差替代当前标签，提出"portfolio vigilance"顺序认证方法，区分可影响有效性的历史与仅能引导抽样的历史。
AI.motivation: 发布模型更新需证明当前人群风险低于阈值，但可信标签昂贵，廉价评估器（如LLM judge）打分虽便宜却不可靠。历史审计中的评估器误差能否替代当前标签取决于历史状态：若误差可无痕变化则无法免标签检验，若变化有界则需付出显式误差代价。中间情形下历史有信息但不可信，需一种既保持有效性又利用历史的认证方法。
AI.method: 提出portfolio vigilance：一种顺序认证器，混合两个专家——一个由历史引导的betting expert，一个仅从当前标签学习的专家；历史仅影响下注方式，不进入有效性条件，故对任意历史均有效。核心贡献是将可能影响有效性的历史与仅能引导标签收集的历史分离。在典型模型中分析准确历史与陈旧历史对决策收敛及证据增长率的影响。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10N与DICES-990上，portfolio vigilance所需标签仅为匹配prediction-powered monitor的0.465（95% CI [0.327,0.575]）和0.740（[0.618,0.877]）倍，无误认证，六个外部块标签均更少；在受损建议下保持在更优组件8.0%以内，而单纯信任历史成本最高达1.66倍。重复judge实验中，改变固定LLM judge评分标准使分数超出运行波动；portfolio所需标签为匹配监控的0.790（[0.667,0.909]）和0.631（[0.520,0.770]）倍，且少于仅信任历史。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离"影响有效性的历史"与"仅指导标签收集的历史"，portfolio vigilance在保持认证有效性的同时显著减少所需标签，且对历史质量与受损建议具有鲁棒性；准确历史加速决策但不提高证据增长率，陈旧历史则可能破坏收敛。

title: DAAF: From Failure Localization to Editable System Assets in LLM Agents
summary: Deployed LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent, versioned system assets such as routing rules, knowledge segments, prompt instructions, and reusable skills. Failure-localization methods can identify where an error manifests in an agent or execution trace, but repair requires a different decision: which editable system asset should be changed, and is that change expected to improve the task outcome? We study this gap through component-attribute failure attribution, where diagnosis targets versioned, addressable items rather than execution locations. We propose the Detection-Aware Attribution Framework (DAAF), which learns the effects of valid attribute replacements and amortizes this intervention evidence into deployment-time diagnosis. DAAF combines sparse and noisy failure signals to decide whether intervention is warranted, learns component-type-conditioned replacement effects from controlled replays evaluated by executable task outcomes, and shares supervision across requests with compatible intervention responses. At diagnosis time, DAAF uses only the observed execution, registered candidates, and available failure signals; it requires neither counterfactual replay nor task reward and returns no_change, a repair target, or an unresolved decision when evidence is insufficient. On held-out tau^2-bench Telecom tasks, DAAF achieves 80.72% attribute Hit@1, recovers 62.65% of failed executions while limiting clean-task regression to 3.23%, and reaches 71.93% overall task success. These results show that intervention-grounded attribute attribution can connect failure localization to executable system repair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAAF框架，用于LLM智能体的组件-属性故障归因，将故障定位连接到可执行的系统修复，在tau²-bench上取得80.72% Hit@1。
AI.motivation: 现有故障定位方法只能指出错误在何处显现，但修复需要决定应更改哪个可编辑的系统资产以及该更改是否有效改善结果，二者存在差距。
AI.method: DAAF学习有效属性替换的效果，将干预证据摊销到部署时诊断。它结合稀疏噪声故障信号判断是否需要干预，从受控重放（由可执行任务结果评估）中学习组件类型条件化的替换效果，并在具有兼容干预响应的请求间共享监督。诊断时仅用观测执行、注册候选和故障信号，无需反事实重放或任务奖励，输出no_change、修复目标或unresolved。
AI.result: 在留出的tau²-bench Telecom任务上，DAAF达到80.72%属性Hit@1，恢复62.65%失败执行，干净任务回归限制在3.23%，整体任务成功率71.93%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于干预的属性归因能够将故障定位连接到可执行的系统修复。

title: Calibration, Not Answer Selection: Distilling Internal Confidence in Reasoning Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with binary correctness rewards trains correctness, not calibrated confidence. The confidence that reasoning models verbalize is systematically overconfident, and the problem is not merely one of scale: verbalized confidence tracks how willing a model is to commit to an answer, not how likely the answer is to be right. Post-hoc rescaling therefore fits one distribution but rarely transfers. We look inside the model instead. On factual question answering, a linear probe on the hidden state between the chain of thought and the answer is substantially better calibrated: its expected calibration error is 5 to 38 times lower than that of the verbalized score across four benchmarks and two model families. However, when used to pick among N sampled answers, that same probe nearly ties majority voting yet falls far short of the oracle. Internal states answer "how certain am I" well and "which answer is right" poorly, so the signal should be reported as a confidence rather than used to select answers. As a result, we introduce probe-guided self-distillation (Probe-SD): score a model's own sampled traces with the probe, overwrite the confidence each trace states, and finetune the base checkpoint of the same family, so nothing but the model itself remains at test time. On Qwen3-14B, Probe-SD cuts ECE from 0.178 to 0.024 in-domain and from 0.542 to 0.113 out-of-domain, where it also beats post-hoc recalibration and self-consistency distillation. The resulting confidence is well-calibrated and useful for weighted voting, behaviors previously attributed to online RL, here obtained with supervised finetuning alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于探针引导的自蒸馏方法(Probe-SD),利用隐藏状态线性探针获得的校准置信度替换模型自我表述的置信度进行微调,在Qwen3-14B上显著降低内域和跨域ECE。
AI.motivation: 基于二元正确性奖励的强化学习只训练正确性而非校准的置信度。推理模型表述的置信度系统性过度自信,且这种偏差不随规模增大而消除——它反映的是模型"愿意给出答案"的程度而非"答案正确的概率",因此事后重缩放难以迁移。
AI.method: 在思维链与答案之间的隐藏状态上训练线性探针以估计校准置信度;随后提出Probe-SD:用探针为模型自身采样轨迹打分,覆盖每条轨迹表述的置信度,再对同族基础checkpoint进行监督微调,测试时不依赖任何外部组件。
AI.result: 在4个基准、2个模型族上,探针的ECE比表述置信度低5–38倍;但在N个采样答案选择中,探针仅与多数投票持平且远逊于oracle。Probe-SD在Qwen3-14B上将内域ECE从0.178降至0.024,跨域从0.542降至0.113,优于事后重校准和自洽蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态善于回答"我有多确定",却不善于回答"哪个答案正确",因此应作为置信度报告而非用于答案选择。Probe-SD表明,以往归因于在线强化学习的良好校准与加权投票行为,仅靠监督微调即可获得。

title: Two-Stage Multi-View Gait Recognition with a Re-Embedding Network
summary: Gait recognition always remains challenging due to severe overfitting and the rigid view constraints common in single-stage approaches. We propose a two-stage framework, termed Translate-First-Then-Reason (TFTR), to address these issues. In the first stage, a shallow Siamese convolutional network with triplet loss maps Gait Energy Images (GEIs) into a 128-dimensional view-specific embedding space. In the second stage, these per-view embeddings are treated as tokens and processed by a 12-layer Transformer encoder, which re-projects them into a new space with improved cosine separability. This design enables flexible fusion of an arbitrary number of views at inference, overcoming the fixed-input limitations of prior methods. Trained on the OU-MVLP dataset (6,000 subjects) and evaluated on unseen CASIA-B across normal, bag-carrying, and coat-wearing conditions, our pipeline achieves 96.91\% single-view and 99.49\% three-view accuracy on OU-MVLP, and attains 100\% accuracy on CASIA-B with three views.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架TFTR，先翻译后推理，解决步态识别过拟合与视角约束问题。
AI.motivation: 单阶段步态识别存在严重过拟合和刚性的视角约束问题。
AI.method: 第一阶段用带三元组损失的浅层Siamese卷积网络将GEI映射为128维视角特定嵌入；第二阶段用12层Transformer编码器将各视角嵌入视为token处理，重投影到余弦可分性更好的空间，支持推理时任意数量视角融合。
AI.result: 在OU-MVLP（6000人）训练，在未见CASIA-B上评测：OU-MVLP单视角96.91%、三视角99.49%；CASIA-B三视角达100%。
AI.conclusion: TFTR通过两阶段设计与Transformer融合多视角，克服固定输入限制，取得优异跨数据集泛化性能。

title: Self-Reconstruction Dynamics for Autoencoder Reconstruction Refinement
summary: Standard autoencoder (AE) inference uses a single encoder-decoder pass, though the latent may not be optimal for each sample under a fixed decoder. We ask whether a trained AE can reveal information for improving its own reconstruction. Repeated application of a frozen AE to its reconstruction produces transient image- and latent-space trajectories, termed Self-Reconstruction Dynamics (SRD). Although this degrades fidelity in the AEs studied here, SRD contains sample-specific information for correcting the reconstruction. We propose SRD-guided Reconstruction Refinement (SRD-RR), which predicts a latent correction from a short SRD with the AE frozen and no per-sample test-time optimization. We also introduce MSE-recov, an MSE recovery ratio relative to an empirical decoder-optimized reference. Across six datasets, SRD-RR recovers 38.6% of the empirically recoverable MSE gap with one transition and 45.3% with two. A two-transition variant trained without direct access to original images, using an SRD-derived pseudo-target, achieves 40.7% recovery and a 1.74 dB average PSNR gain. Removing trajectory information reduces the gain, while cross-sample trajectory assignment causes severe degradation, confirming strong sample specificity. Nonlinear SRD-conditioned refinement consistently outperforms fixed and trained linear latent correction. On a pretrained DINOv2-based representation autoencoder (RAE) with substantially different latent dynamics, SRD conditioning again improves a matched trajectory-free predictor. However, pixel-MSE latent refinement reveals a strong mismatch between pixel fidelity and perceptual quality, while the SRD-derived pseudo-target mitigates this degradation. Overall, SRD is a useful sample-specific refinement signal, while the objective determines how it translates into pixel and perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: 训练好的自编码器(AE)对自身重建结果反复作用会产生"自重建动力学(SRD)"轨迹，虽降低保真度却蕴含样本特异性的修正信息。作者提出SRD-RR，无需逐样本测试时优化即可预测隐空间修正，在六个数据集上恢复约38.6%–45.3%可恢复MSE差距，并揭示像素保真度与感知质量的错配。
AI.motivation: 标准AE推理仅做单次编码-解码，固定解码器下隐变量未必对每个样本最优。作者追问：训练好的AE能否自行揭示改进其重建的信息。
AI.method: 将冻结AE反复作用于自身重建，得到图像与隐空间的暂态轨迹(SRD)；据此提出SRD-RR，用短SRD预测隐空间修正，AE冻结、无逐样本优化。另引入MSE-recov（相对经验解码器优化参考的MSE恢复比）。还设计仅用SRD伪目标、不访问原图的变体。
AI.result: 六个数据集上，SRD-RR一次转移恢复38.6%、两次45.3%的可恢复MSE差距；两次转移、无原图的伪目标变体恢复40.7%，平均PSNR提升1.74 dB。移除轨迹信息降低增益，跨样本轨迹分配导致严重退化。非线性SRD条件修正优于固定及训练的线性修正。在DINOv2的RAE上同样有效，但像素MSE隐空间修正暴露像素保真度与感知质量的强错配，伪目标可缓解。
AI.conclusion: SRD是有效的样本特异性修正信号，而优化目标决定其如何转化为像素与感知质量。

title: TreeRef-BFN: Equivariance-Free De Novo Molecule Generation based on 2D Topology and Internal 3D Geometry
summary: De novo 3D molecular generation jointly models molecular size, topology, and geometry. Most methods pre-sample molecular size and generate Cartesian coordinates, limiting variable-size conditional tasks such as fragment completion and scaffold decoration while often relying on equivariant architectures. Internal-coordinate methods avoid rigid-body redundancy but typically require a known molecular graph or autoregressive construction, which may accumulate errors. We propose TreeRef, a tree-based molecular representation that assigns molecular topology and topology-dependent local 3D geometry to a naturally variable-size tree. RingRef nodes encode ring closures while preserving the tree structure, while Null nodes allow molecular size to emerge directly from node occupancy. Based on TreeRef, we develop TreeRef-BFN, a Bayesian Flow Network with a standard Transformer backbone that globally couples these locally defined variables and jointly generates discrete molecular variables and continuous local geometry. A single pretrained TreeRef-BFN supports unconditional generation and variable-size structure-conditioned 3D generation through masking alone, without retraining. Empirical studies demonstrate strong chemical validity, molecular stability, and diversity, accurate local geometric distributions, fast sampling, and competitive property-conditioned generation, establishing TreeRef-BFN as an efficient and flexible framework for 3D molecular generation.

AI.tldr: TreeRef-BFN：用可变大小树表示分子，通过贝叶斯流网络联合生成拓扑与局部几何，单一预训练模型经掩码即可完成无条件生成和变尺寸条件3D生成。
AI.motivation: 多数方法预采样分子尺寸并生成笛卡尔坐标，限制可变尺寸条件任务（如片段补全、骨架修饰），且依赖等变架构；内部坐标方法虽避免刚体冗余，但需已知图或自回归构建，易累积误差。
AI.method: 提出TreeRef树表示：RingRef节点编码环闭合以保持树结构，Null节点使分子尺寸由节点占用自然涌现。基于此构建TreeRef-BFN——标准Transformer骨干的贝叶斯流网络，全局耦合局部变量，联合生成离散分子变量与连续局部几何。
AI.result: 实验显示良好的化学有效性与稳定性、多样性，准确的局部几何分布，采样速度快，性质条件生成具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: TreeRef-BFN是高效灵活的3D分子生成框架，单一预训练模型仅靠掩码即可支持无条件与变尺寸结构条件的3D生成，无需重训。

title: BaatCheet: A Multilingual Corpus for Dialogue Translation in Indian Languages
summary: Existing translation models are typically trained on sentence-level and formal text, limiting their ability to capture everyday conversational dialogue phenomena such as informality, speaker interaction, and discourse coherence. Most existing Indic translation resources and evaluation benchmarks focus on sentence-level or formal text, making it difficult to assess translation quality of the dialogue phenomena. In this work, we introduce BaatCheet, a multilingual dialogue corpus named after the Hindi term for conversation or chitchat, containing approximately 49,000 dialogues for dialogue translation across five translation directions. We fine-tune five open-source LLMs across seven training data configurations and find that fine-tuning yields substantial gains over zero- and few-shot baselines. To comprehensively evaluate dialogue translation quality, we employ multiple evaluation strategies, including automatic metrics, LLM-as-judge, and human assessments using an SQM-guided Direct Assessment (DA) Protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BaatCheet，一个包含约49,000段对话、覆盖5个翻译方向的多语言对话语料库，用于对话翻译；通过微调5个开源LLM在7种数据配置下评测，发现微调效果显著优于零样本和少样本基线。
AI.motivation: 现有翻译模型多基于句子级和正式文本训练，难以处理日常对话中的非正式性、说话人交互和语篇连贯等现象；而现有印度语翻译资源和评测基准也集中于句子级或正式文本，无法评估对话现象的翻译质量。
AI.method: 构建BaatCheet多语言对话语料库（约49,000段对话，5个翻译方向）；在7种训练数据配置下微调5个开源LLM；采用多种评测策略，包括自动指标、LLM-as-judge，以及基于SQM引导的Direct Assessment (DA)协议的人工评估。
AI.result: 微调相比零样本和少样本基线取得显著提升；通过自动指标、LLM评判和人工评估多角度验证了对话翻译质量。
AI.conclusion: BaatCheet为印度语对话翻译提供了资源与评测基准，表明微调能有效提升开放源代码LLM在对话翻译任务上的表现。

title: RoboSTAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Sign Language Translation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Sign-language interpretation in public communication relies on qualified professional interpreters and can be difficult to scale, motivating robotic signing as a complementary accessibility interface. We present RoBoSTAR, a text-conditioned sign language production (SLP) framework for generating human-centric sign motion that can be retargeted for robotic execution, with speech supported optionally through an external ASR front end. Conventional autoregressive approaches flatten motion into a single full-resolution token sequence, forcing long-range and local dependencies to be modeled at a uniform temporal granularity. RoBoSTAR instead combines part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization with next-scale autoregression, generating motion over progressively finer temporal resolutions while predicting synchronized body and hand tokens in parallel within each step. This coarse-to-fine formulation provides compact long-range context before progressively refining motion details, while self-conditioning and context corruption improve robustness to cross-scale prediction errors. The generated motion is subsequently retargeted for physical humanoid execution. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of RoBoSTAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoBoSTAR，一个面向机器人执行的手语生成框架，通过分部位有限标量量化与跨尺度自回归实现由粗到细的运动生成。
AI.motivation: 公共传播中的手语翻译依赖专业口译员，难以规模化，因此需要机器人手语作为补充性无障碍接口。传统自回归方法将运动展平为单一全分辨率token序列，导致长程与局部依赖只能在同一时间粒度上建模，效率与质量受限。
AI.method: RoBoSTAR采用文本条件的手语生成（SLP）。核心是将part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization与next-scale autoregression结合，在逐步精细的时间分辨率上生成运动，并在每步内并行预测同步的身体与手部token。粗到细的建模先获得紧凑的长程上下文，再细化运动细节；同时引入自条件（self-conditioning）与上下文损坏（context corruption）提升对跨尺度预测误差的鲁棒性。生成的运动随后被重定向（retarget）用于物理人形机器人执行。语音可通过外部ASR前端可选支持。
AI.result: 论文进行了大量定性与定量评估以展示RoBoSTAR的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
AI.conclusion: RoBoSTAR为可规模化、可机器人执行的手语生成提供了新范式，验证了分部位量化与跨尺度自回归相结合的有效性。

title: Certification Frontiers for Gaussian LoRA: Independent Priors, Posterior Risk, and Prediction-Preserving Balancing
summary: Post-hoc Bayesian fine-tuning places Gaussians around trained low-rank adapters, yet a calibrated posterior does not by itself yield a useful generalization certificate. Such a posterior admits an informative PAC-Bayes certificate only when both the loss of its sampled predictors and its KL divergence from an admissible prior are small. In this research, we characterize this certification frontier for Gaussian LoRA posteriors and separate three interventions: changing the prior, changing the stochastic predictor, and changing only how its complexity is counted. First, an exact isotropic KL envelope eliminates the prior scale and yields a width threshold that excludes posterior widths before sampling, while a zero-KL floor identifies targets that no complexity reduction can reach at a measured risk bound. Second, we minimize KL in closed form over the full $GL(r)$ symmetry of the low-rank factors, leaving every sampled adapter product unchanged, and derive the noncentral objective required when the prior center is trained on an independent split. On a small-pool RoBERTa audit of 567 configurations, the recorded 64-draw summaries imply a certificate floor of $0.7298$ even with zero KL and Chernoff accounting, so reducing complexity alone cannot certify these posteriors at the recorded budgets. For a stable posterior in a controlled Gaussian-factor task, Chernoff accounting certifies risk below $0.1$ on 20 of 20 datasets with 1024 draws, whereas Hoeffding certifies none. On deliberately deformed synthetic rank-four factors, matrix balancing reduces KL by $29.3\%$ on average beyond scalar balancing without changing any prediction. Numerical split-prior scenarios make the remaining risk and complexity budgets explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了高斯LoRA后验的PAC-Bayes认证前沿，区分改变先验、改变随机预测器和改变复杂度计数三种干预，并给出闭式KL最小化与认证下界。
AI.motivation: 校准的后验本身不足以给出有用的泛化认证；只有当采样预测器的损失与其相对可行先验的KL散度都足够小时，后验才能给出有信息量的PAC-Bayes证书。因此需要刻画高斯LoRA后验的"认证前沿"。
AI.method: 将干预分为三类：(1) 改变先验——用精确各向同性KL包络消去先验尺度，得到宽度阈值，并用零KL下界识别不可达目标；(2) 改变随机预测器——在低秩因子的完整GL(r)对称性下闭式最小化KL，保持采样adapter乘积不变，并在独立划分上训练先验中心时推导非中心目标；(3) 只改变复杂度计数。另采用Chernoff与Hoeffding核算对比。
AI.result: 在RoBERTa小池审计的567个配置中，记录到的64次抽样摘要即便零KL加Chernoff核算仍给出0.7298的认证下界，故仅降低复杂度无法在既定预算下认证这些后验。在受控高斯因子任务中，Chernoff核算在20/20数据集上以1024次抽样认证风险低于0.1，而Hoeffding一个也认证不了。在刻意变形的合成秩四因子上，矩阵平衡比标量平衡平均额外降低KL 29.3%，且不改变任何预测。
AI.conclusion: 仅降低复杂度不足以认证这些LoRA后验；认证效果取决于先验选择、预测器参数化与复杂度计数方式三者的联合作用，矩阵平衡可在不改变预测的前提下显著降低KL，且Chernoff核算明显优于Hoeffding。

title: Learning from Others, Acting for You: Cross-User Memory Sharing for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents serving different users often solve related tasks, yet separate user histories can leave reusable experience inaccessible to other agents. Pooling memories expands access but risks transferring preferences that conflict with the receiving user's requirements. We introduce ShareMem, a memory architecture that shares reusable experience while grounding its application in the receiving user's own preferences. Shared experiences indicate how to act and which preferences to consult; the receiving user's memory supplies their concrete values. Two-stage consolidation refines experience locally before integrating accepted edits into a shared pool. During execution, scope-first retrieval jointly selects local and shared experiences under a common entry budget, while a user-bound channel supports initial and agent-initiated preference retrieval. We evaluate ShareMem across web navigation (Mind2Web), online personalized interaction (VitaBench~2.0), and multi-session coding (MemoryCode) with four backbone models. It improves step success, average task success, and dialogue-macro coding scores, respectively, over matched user-local memory across all four models. Ablations favor two-stage consolidation for smaller shared pools, lower induction token usage, and better downstream performance, and support complementarity between experience guidance and active preference retrieval. Further analyses show that sharing helps most when relevant local experience is scarce, while source quality and cross-user preference interference limit useful transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出ShareMem记忆架构，在共享可复用经验的同时，将应用约束到接收用户自身偏好上。
AI.motivation: 不同用户的LLM智能体常解决相关任务，但独立用户历史使可复用经验无法互通；直接汇聚记忆虽扩大访问范围，却可能转移与接收用户需求相冲突的偏好。
AI.method: 共享经验指示"如何行动"与"查阅哪些偏好"，接收用户记忆提供具体取值。两阶段巩固先在本地精炼经验，再将接受的编辑整合进共享池。执行时采用scope-first检索，在统一入口预算下联合选取本地与共享经验；用户绑定通道支持初始及智能体主动的偏好检索。
AI.result: 在Mind2Web、VitaBench 2.0、MemoryCode三种任务与四个主干模型上，分别提升步骤成功率、平均任务成功率与对话宏编码分数。消融显示两阶段巩固利于更小共享池、更低归纳token用量与更好下游表现，并支持经验引导与主动偏好检索的互补性。
AI.conclusion: 当本地相关经验稀缺时共享收益最大；源质量与跨用户偏好干扰限制有效迁移。

title: Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by iterative unmasking. At each denoising step, a dLLM proposes a token at every masked position, but the decoder commits only a confident subset of these proposals. Trace-based on-policy distillation (TOPD) builds on this process by matching the student to a stronger teacher, yet only at the committed positions. We argue that this discards much of the useful signal, which resides in the uncommitted proposals, where the student has made a prediction but is not yet confident enough to commit it. We call these proposals hesitations. In our pilot study on an SDAR-4B student, hesitations make up only 24% of supervisable state-position pairs but carry 66% of the teacher-student divergence. To exploit this signal, we propose Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation (HOPD), which extends teacher distribution matching to every masked position of each denoising step. Because hesitations are not equally informative, we further allocate supervision using hindsight from the completed trajectory, placing more weight on positions whose proposal was later disagreed with the final token and on blocks where first-step proposals rarely survive. Since both models already produce distributions at all masked positions, HOPD requires no additional forward passes over TOPD. The only extra cost is evaluating the loss at more positions. With SDAR-1.7B and SDAR-4B students distilled from TraDo-8B-Instruct, HOPD achieves the best average score among the evaluated methods on five math and coding benchmarks, under both static and dynamic decoding and at both scales. It also speeds up decoding. On SDAR-4B, the HOPD student hesitates less and commits 11% more tokens per denoising step than TOPD, while reaching higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HOPD，一种针对扩散大语言模型的"犹豫感知"在线策略蒸馏方法，利用未提交token的预测信号提升蒸馏效果与解码速度。
AI.motivation: 现有TOPD仅在已提交位置匹配师生分布，丢弃了大量有用信号。未提交但已有预测的"犹豫"位置虽仅占24%，却承载66%的师生分歧。
AI.method: HOPD将教师分布匹配扩展到每个去噪步的所有masked位置；利用完整轨迹的事后信息分配监督权重——对最终token不一致的提案位置和首步提案低存活率的块加大权重。无需额外前向，仅增加loss计算。
AI.result: 在SDAR-1.7B与4B学生（蒸馏自TraDo-8B-Instruct）上，HOPD在5个数学与编程基准、静态与动态解码下均取得最优平均分，并加速解码；4B学生每步多提交11% token且精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 利用犹豫信号可显著提升dLLM蒸馏效果与解码效率，且几乎无额外计算开销。

title: FSS-UBrain: Multi-region Few-Shot Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation
comment: This work has been submitted to the Elsevier for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Accurate delineation of whole tumor (WT), tumor core (TC), and enhancing tumor (ET) from multimodal magnetic resonance imaging remains challenging under limited annotation, cross-cohort variation, and severe target sparsity. We propose FSS-UBrain, a region-wise one-shot segmentation framework that uses a labeled positive support slice to condition binary query segmentation separately for WT, TC, and ET. Support-derived foreground and background descriptors guide query-feature adaptation, bottleneck interaction, decoder-side reconstruction, and boundary refinement. Episodic training additionally incorporates hard-negative and fully negative queries with empty-query regularization to suppress spurious foreground activation when the selected region is absent. Although inference operates on two-dimensional support--query slice pairs, checkpoint selection, threshold calibration, and final evaluation are performed after volumetric reconstruction. FSS-UBrain is evaluated on a held-out BraTS 2020 split and under target-supported cross-cohort protocols on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa. Cases used as target support are excluded from the query cohorts, and no target-domain fine-tuning or test-time parameter updates are performed. On BraTS 2020, FSS-UBrain achieves volumetric Dice scores of 89.82%, 82.14%, and 77.42% for WT, TC, and ET, respectively, with corresponding 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) values of 11.12, 9.01, and 4.46 mm. It also achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest finite-pair mean HD95 point estimates on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa among the compared few-shot methods. These findings support target-conditioned few-shot segmentation while highlighting sensitivity to support selection and cohort-specific variation.

AI.tldr: FSS-UBrain：基于区域级单样本分割框架，用一张标注支撑切片条件化WT/TC/ET二分类查询分割，在多队列BraTS数据上取得领先的少样本脑肿瘤分割性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态MRI下全肿瘤、肿瘤核心和增强肿瘤的精确分割面临标注有限、跨队列差异大以及目标稀疏等困难，需要减少对大量标注的依赖并提升跨队列泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出FSS-UBrain区域级单样本分割框架，使用一张正样本支撑切片分别条件化WT、TC、ET的二分类查询分割；利用支撑集前景/背景描述子引导查询特征适配、瓶颈交互、解码器重构和边界细化；训练时引入难负样本、全负样本及空查询正则抑制虚假前景；推理在2D支撑-查询切片对上进行，但检查点选择、阈值校准和最终评估均在体数据重建后完成；跨队列协议排除目标支撑病例且不做目标域微调或测试时更新。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020留出集上，WT/TC/ET的体Dice分别为89.82%、82.14%、77.42%，HD95分别为11.12、9.01、4.46 mm；在BraTS 2023和BraTS-Africa跨队列目标支持协议下，相较对比的少样本方法取得最高平均Dice和最低有限配对平均HD95点估计。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持目标条件化少样本分割的有效性，但同时提示该方法对支撑切片选择和队列特异性变异较为敏感。

title: From Anomalies to Failures: Constructing Causal Error Graphs for Agentic Trace Diagnosis
summary: LLM-driven agents are increasingly deployed in complex applications, where long agentic traces make failures difficult to diagnose. Existing trace diagnosis methods often conflate anomalies, errors, and failures, making diagnostic targets ambiguous; they also lack structured modeling of how causally relevant errors propagate and amplify into final task failures, resulting in unreliable failure attribution. To address these problems, we propose CEG-Agent, a tool-augmented agentic framework for causal diagnosis of agentic traces. Specifically, CEG-Agent introduces an explicit taxonomy of anomalies, errors, and failures, and constructs Causal Error Graphs (CEGs), a unified typed representation that links execution events, diagnostic nodes, and failure outcomes through causal relations. To evaluate causal trace diagnosis, we further construct CEG-Bench, a fully agent-annotated benchmark with high-confidence, consensus-derived CEG annotations obtained through an Adversarial Agentic Adjudication Protocol (AAAP). We validate the resulting annotations against an expert-curated human gold set, which shows close agreement with the automatic annotations. Experiments on CEG-Bench demonstrate that CEG-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance under both semantically relaxed and structurally exact evaluation criteria. Our code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出CEG-Agent，用因果误差图诊断LLM智能体长轨迹失败，并构建CEG-Bench基准，达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体长轨迹中失败难诊断；现有方法混淆异常、错误与失败，诊断目标模糊，且缺乏对因果相关错误如何传播并放大为最终失败的结构化建模，导致归因不可靠。
AI.method: CEG-Agent：工具增强的智能体框架，引入异常/错误/失败的显式分类法，构建因果误差图（CEG）——统一类型化表示，通过因果关系连接执行事件、诊断节点与失败结果。另构建CEG-Bench，通过对抗式智能体裁决协议（AAAP）获得高置信共识标注。
AI.result: 自动标注与专家人工金标准高度一致；CEG-Agent在语义宽松与结构严格两种评估标准下均达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: CEG-Agent为智能体轨迹的因果诊断提供了结构化、可解释的方案，CEG-Bench为评估提供了新基准，代码已公开。

title: CertMark: Distortion-Free Multi-Bit Watermarking with Certified Decoding
summary: Leading multi-bit watermarking methods for language models encode messages by biasing the model's next-token probabilities, creating a trade-off between message recovery and text quality. Their decoders typically return the highest-scoring candidate from accumulated token-level evidence, without a certified abstention rule that bounds the probability of outputting an incorrect message. We introduce CertMark, a distribution-preserving multi-bit watermark with certified decoding. Rather than modifying probabilities, CertMark uses the embedded message to seed an exact Gumbel-max sampler, thereby preserving the model's original sampling distribution. We propose two scalable decoders: a model-agnostic, text-only decoder and a model-aware variant that leverages the original next-token distributions for stronger recovery. Both support certified abstention with mathematical bounds on the probability of returning an incorrect message. Across text completion, summarization, and story generation, CertMark matches the perplexity of unwatermarked text while reliably recovering multi-bit messages. The model-aware decoder further achieves higher bit accuracy than probability-biasing baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/CertMark.

AI.tldr: CertMark提出一种保持分布的多比特水印方法，通过消息种子化Gumbel-max采样器，实现可认证弃权的解码。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型多比特水印通过偏置下一词概率编码消息，导致消息恢复与文本质量之间的权衡，且解码器缺乏能界定错误消息概率的弃权规则。
AI.method: 利用嵌入消息为精确Gumbel-max采样器提供种子，从而保留模型原始采样分布；提出两种可扩展解码器：模型无关的纯文本解码器，以及利用原始下一词分布以增强恢复的模型感知变体，二者均支持带数学界的认证弃权。
AI.result: 在文本补全、摘要和故事生成任务上，CertMark在可靠恢复多比特消息的同时与无水印文本的困惑度相当；模型感知解码器比概率偏置基线具有更高的比特准确率。
AI.conclusion: CertMark在保持文本质量的前提下实现可靠多比特消息恢复，并提供可认证的错误概率界，代码已公开。

title: HeroFrame-Bench: Reference-Anchored Evaluation via Rubric--Ranking Co-Evolution for Movie Hero Frame Selection
summary: Hero frames are in-film stills used as source imagery for theatrical posters, streaming cover art, film database listings, and other promotional placements. As the first visual entry point, they shape audiences' initial impressions of the movie and their subsequent willingness to watch it. Selecting these frames, a task we term hero frame selection, requires balancing content relevance with aesthetic appeal. A related task is keyframe selection, yet its benchmarks prioritize relevance over aesthetics, using either finite annotations that exclude valid alternatives or VideoQA that entangles selection quality with downstream model capability. We therefore introduce HeroFrame-Bench, built through a scalable VLM-as-a-Judge framework. We construct multimodal contexts from diverse metadata to ground a VLM judge that scores selected frames using our Reference-anchored Percentile. The percentile is obtained by inserting each frame into reusable, pre-ranked reference chains, enabling direct, extensible, and reliable evaluation. To reduce ambiguity and improve consistency in these subjective judgements, we further propose Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution, which generates movie-specific rubrics to condition the VLM judge and refines rubrics jointly with the resulting rankings. Within this process, we introduce several verifiable signals, most notably the Inverted Rubric Attack, to select robust rubrics. Finally, HeroFrame-Bench is instantiated over 204 movies with 2,031 reference chains and 1,970 learned rubrics. We build an annotation interface for human-alignment studies which show that our construction design improves VLM agreement with human from 77.56% to 83.78%. Evaluation on multiple methods show that hero frame selection remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"英雄帧选择"任务及HeroFrame-Bench基准，用VLM-as-a-Judge框架、Reference-anchored Percentile和Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution实现可扩展、可靠的评估。
AI.motivation: 英雄帧是海报、封面、影视资料等的首视觉入口，影响观众第一印象与观影意愿。选择需兼顾内容相关性与美学吸引力，但现有keyframe selection基准偏向相关性、忽略美学，或用有限标注排除有效替代、或将选择质量与下游模型能力纠缠。
AI.method: 构建可扩展的VLM-as-a-Judge框架：用多元元数据构造多模态上下文，让VLM评委基于Reference-anchored Percentile打分——将每帧插入可复用、预排序的参考链以获得百分位。提出Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution，生成影片专属评分准则以约束评委，并联合优化准则与排名；引入可验证信号（尤以Inverted Rubric Attack）筛选稳健准则。
AI.result: 在204部电影上实例化，含2,031条参考链与1,970个学习到的准则。人类对齐研究显示构造设计将VLM与人类一致率从77.56%提升至83.78%。多方法评估表明英雄帧选择仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: HeroFrame-Bench为英雄帧选择提供了兼顾相关性与美学、可扩展且可靠的新基准，但该任务依然困难，仍有较大提升空间。

title: Topology-Adaptive Hyperbolic Graph Attention Networks Guided by the Hyperbolic Sombor Index
summary: Hyperbolic geometry has emerged as a principled space for representing hierarchical graphs. However, existing hyperbolic graph neural networks typically rely on shared curvature configurations and feature-driven attention, failing to explicitly exploit local hierarchical topological patterns. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Hyperbolic Sombor Index (HSO) as a lightweight structural prior for capturing hierarchy-indicative degree stratification. Building on this, we propose \textbf{HSO-GAT}, a topology-adaptive hyperbolic graph attention network that unifies geometric adaptation and message propagation. Specifically, it comprises two complementary modules: HSO-Guided Local Curvature Adaptation, which performs adaptive node-wise geometric scaling from aggregated node-level HSO signals, and HSO-Gated Hyperbolic Graph Attention, which enables structure-aware message passing through feature-conditioned gating. Theoretically, we establish the monotonic sensitivity of edge-level HSO to degree imbalance and analyze the validity and radial scaling properties of node-adaptive hyperbolic mappings. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSO-GAT consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both node classification and link prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Hyperbolic Sombor Index (HSO) 作为结构先验，构建拓扑自适应双曲图注意力网络 HSO-GAT，在八个基准数据集上取得节点分类和链接预测的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有双曲图神经网络通常使用共享曲率配置和基于特征驱动的注意力，未能显式利用局部层次拓扑模式。
AI.method: 引入HSO捕捉层次指示的度分层结构；HSO-GAT包含两个模块：HSO引导的局部曲率自适应（基于节点级HSO信号进行节点级几何缩放），以及HSO门控双曲图注意力（通过特征条件门控实现结构感知消息传递）。
AI.result: 理论上证明边级HSO对度不平衡的单调敏感性，并分析节点自适应双曲映射的有效性与径向缩放性质；在八个基准数据集上，节点分类与链接预测均达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: HSO-GAT通过融合几何自适应与消息传播，有效利用局部层次拓扑结构，提升双曲图表示学习性能。

title: LocalProp: Neuro-Localized Memory-Efficient Backpropagation
summary: The current deep learning training paradigm employs end-to-end backpropagation, regardless of the training stage, i.e. pre-training or fine-tuning. However, backpropagating through the entire model is neither biologically plausible nor memory efficient, since learning inside the brain is highly localized. Therefore, we propose LocalProp, a training procedure that locally updates the weights of a model. Our neuro-localized weight updates follow the "pre-training then fine-tuning" paradigm, where the pre-training is based on I-JEPA. After locally updating the weights, a pruning operation is performed, followed by a short final fine-tuning phase. Pruning helps by sending the learning signal from higher blocks to lower blocks. We perform experiments on several datasets, including large-scale benchmarks such as ImageNet, and empirically show that LocalProp reaches good performance at a fraction of GPU peak memory. By varying the number of jointly optimized blocks, we identify gradient-propagation span as a practical control over the accuracy-memory trade-off.

AI.tldr: LocalProp是一种局部更新权重的训练方法，遵循"预训练后微调"范式，预训练基于I-JEPA，配合剪枝和短微调阶段，在ImageNet等基准上以极少GPU峰值内存达到良好性能。
AI.motivation: 端到端反向传播贯穿整个模型，既不生物合理也不内存高效，因为大脑学习高度局部化。作者希望实现神经局部化的权重更新。
AI.method: LocalProp采用局部权重更新，遵循"预训练再微调"范式，预训练基于I-JEPA；局部更新权重后执行剪枝操作，再进行短时最终微调。剪枝将高层块的学习信号传递到低层块，并通过改变联合优化块的数量调节梯度传播跨度。
AI.result: 在多个数据集（含ImageNet等大规模基准）上实验表明，LocalProp以极少的GPU峰值内存达到良好性能，且联合优化块数量可作为精度-内存权衡的实用控制手段。
AI.conclusion: LocalProp证明了局部化权重更新能在显著降低内存消耗的同时取得良好性能，梯度传播跨度是控制精度-内存权衡的有效手段。

title: Does Learning to Predict the World Help Agents Act? Auditing World-Model Post-Training
summary: Predicting how an environment will change before acting is a natural route to better decision making for agents.
