This differently sampled DLM in fact achieves lower generative perplexity in just 16 steps than what its standard sampler obtains with 1024, while improving both judged quality and semantic diversity. We further show that conventional per-output metrics can fundamentally obscure these gains, since any optimal trade-off between two such metrics can be attained by a generator supported on at most two outputs. We subsequently introduce GroupEval, which separately evaluates quality and across-output semantic diversity, and offers fresh insights including uncovering how 1.5-4.7x perplexity gains of a distilled model yield no corresponding quality gain. Finally, we explain why sharpening helps: parallel unmasking destroys dependencies among simultaneously generated tokens, creating a gap between prediction and generation. We prove that pervasive temperature choice of one is generically suboptimal under parallel sampling even for an exact denoiser, and that worse predictions can yield better samples. Through these results, we argue for a broader evaluation principle of treating the deployed generator as the object of comparison, benchmarking it against tuned baselines, and assessing quality and diversity jointly and with more human-aligned measures.

AI.tldr: 少步扩散语言模型的质量差距很大程度上源于采样器配置不当，而非模型本身；简单锐化采样器即可让旧模型超越新模型，并需重新思考评测方式。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）宣称可快速并行生成，但高质量样本往往需要大量细化步数，削弱了其实用优势。当前大量研究致力于少步生成新方法，作者质疑其中许多所谓质量差距实际上来自采样器配置次优，而非模型能力不足。
AI.method: 通过采样器锐化（sampler sharpening）而不重新训练模型，将老旧的掩码DLM与所谓改进的后继模型对比；分析并行解码中温度选择的理论性质；并引入GroupEval评测框架，分别衡量质量与跨输出的语义多样性。
AI.result: 经锐化采样的旧掩码DLM仅用16步即达到标准采样器1024步更低的生成困惑度，同时提升判定质量和语义多样性。此外发现蒸馏模型1.5-4.7倍困惑度收益并未带来相应质量提升；理论上证明并行采样下温度取1通常次优，更差的预测反而可能产生更好的样本。
AI.conclusion: 应把部署的生成器本身作为比较对象，与调优后的基线对比，并联合评估质量与多样性，采用更贴近人类的度量；传统逐一输出指标可能掩盖这些收益。

title: MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance visual reasoning by strengthening both perception and reasoning, implicitly assuming a process that transitions seamlessly from perception to reasoning. However, we observe a counterintuitive phenomenon that challenges this assumption: holding the model, question, and decoding fixed, we replace images with their caption or code representations (symbolic views), which seems to be redundant given the clear image structures, but the performance surprisingly improves by 10.2% to 23.6% across model scales and datasets. We term this performance gap as the Symbolic Visual Gap and then take a closer look at it. Through experiments, we find that although the visual evidence can already appear in the reasoning trace for the image-input model, the symbolic-view-input model shows much higher attention to the correct evidence than the image-input model. This suggests that despite good capabilities from current works in perception and reasoning themselves, another bottleneck exists between perception and reasoning in selecting perceived visual information as appropriate evidence for subsequent reasoning. To handle this bottleneck, since the symbolic view steers attention toward correct evidence and is readily obtained at scale, it provides supervision for evidence selection without manually labeled evidence. Building on this, we introduce MM-OPD, a multimodal on-policy self-distillation framework for symbolic-to-visual correction that transfers guidance from symbolic-conditioned behavior to the image-conditioned policy through residual token-level targets, steering the model toward correct visual evidence. Experiments across benchmarks and model scales show that MM-OPD improves a broad range of multimodal abilities, with gains in visual perception, chart and document understanding, mathematical reasoning, and general VQA.

AI.tldr: 论文发现把图像换成符号化视图(标题/代码)反而提升MLLM性能10.2%-23.6%，称为"符号视觉鸿沟"，归因于感知与推理间的证据选择瓶颈，并提出MM-OPD自蒸馏框架修复该问题。
AI.motivation: MLLM普遍假设从感知到推理过渡无缝。但作者发现：固定模型、问题和解码策略，将图像替换为标题或代码等符号化表示后，性能反而提升10.2%-23.6%，说明感知与推理之间存在证据选择的瓶颈。
AI.method: 通过实验分析发现符号视图输入使模型对正确证据的注意力显著高于图像输入模型。提出MM-OPD：一种多模态on-policy自蒸馏框架，利用符号视图的监督信号，通过残差token级目标将符号条件行为转移到图像条件策略，引导模型关注正确视觉证据。
AI.result: 在多个基准和模型规模上实验，MM-OPD提升了广泛的多模态能力，包括视觉感知、图表与文档理解、数学推理和通用VQA。
AI.conclusion: 感知与推理之间的证据选择是关键瓶颈，符号视图可作为无需人工标注的监督信号；MM-OPD通过符号到视觉的自我纠正有效提升多模态推理能力。

title: SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit control over this balance. To this end, we propose soft-target fine-tuning (SoFT) to balance learning from teacher demonstrations with retaining the Base model's existing capabilities. SoFT sets a minimum target probability for each demonstrated token while making the smallest KL change to the Base distribution. The resulting objective couples learning from demonstrations with adaptively weighted regularization toward the Base model. We further use domain-specific gradient budgets to control this balance and determine a probability threshold for each trajectory. Experiments on mixed-domain reasoning and agentic tasks show that SoFT achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, with improvements in both in-distribution capability acquisition and out-of-distribution generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出软目标微调(SoFT)，通过为演示token设置最小目标概率并对Base分布做最小KL改动，平衡多教师多域蒸馏中的分布内学习与分布外泛化。
AI.motivation: 多教师、多领域蒸馏中，学生模型需在获取多样能力的同时保持对训练任务之外的泛化，但不同SFT方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化之间存在权衡，缺乏显式控制机制。
AI.method: SoFT为每个演示token设定最小目标概率，并在对Base分布做最小KL改动的前提下构建目标；目标函数将演示学习与自适应加权的Base正则耦合。进一步引入领域特定的梯度预算控制该平衡，并为每条轨迹确定概率阈值。
AI.result: 在多领域推理与智能体任务上，SoFT相比对比方法取得最佳整体表现，分布内能力获取与分布外泛化均有提升。
AI.conclusion: SoFT通过软目标与梯度预算实现了对学习-保留平衡的显式控制，有效应对多教师多域蒸馏中的泛化挑战。

title: CUA-Sandbox: Efficient Environments for Computer-Use Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning enables computer-use agents to improve through interaction with real software environments, including websites and desktop applications. However, conventional deployments replicate an initialized runtime for each independent rollout, even when trajectories use the same software, incurring repeated memory and initialization costs as the number of parallel environments grows. Does an independent computer-use environment require an independent execution runtime? Our key observation is that trajectories require independent mutable state, while initialized application runtimes can be reused across concurrently evolving environments, making state the natural unit of environment independence. Guided by this observation, we introduce CUA-Sandbox, which separates private state capsules from shared runtimes through state-scoped execution and transactional lifecycle operations, including resets and branches, while retaining the original software interfaces and task evaluators. Experiments show comparable or improved task success relative to Docker, while substantially reducing rollout and resource costs. CUA-Sandbox achieves up to a 6.20x increase in rollout throughput, a 9.2x reduction in per-environment memory, and a 504x reduction in incremental storage.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CUA-Sandbox，将独立可变状态与共享应用运行时分离，实现计算机使用智能体强化学习环境的轻量并发执行。
AI.motivation: 传统部署为每个rollout复制初始化后的运行时，即使使用同一软件，也随并行环境数量增长带来重复内存与初始化开销。核心问题：独立环境是否需要独立运行时？观察：轨迹需要独立可变状态，但初始化的应用运行时可在并发环境中复用。
AI.method: CUA-Sandbox通过状态作用域执行与事务化生命周期操作（重置、分支），将私有状态胶囊与共享运行时分离，同时保留原始软件接口与任务评估器。
AI.result: 任务成功率与Docker相当或更优，同时大幅降低rollout与资源成本：rollout吞吐量最高提升6.20倍，每环境内存降低9.2倍，增量存储降低504倍。
AI.conclusion: 状态而非运行时才是环境独立性的自然单元，共享运行时+私有状态的架构可显著提升计算机使用智能体强化学习的效率。

title: On the Token Value Inequality in Efficient Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-Thought reasoning has enabled large language models to achieve substantial performance gains on complex tasks. However, these gains come at the cost of dramatically increased token consumption. This raises a fundamental question: is every token in the reasoning trace equally valuable? We present a diagnostic and optimization framework grounded in a key empirical finding: the value of tokens within a CoT reasoning sequence is highly non-uniform, and this non-uniformity can be effectively characterized by token-level log probability signals. We show that normalized log probability helps distinguish core tokens, which carry structural and decisive reasoning content, from redundant tokens, which are exploratory, low-confidence filler that contributes less directly to the final answer. Building on these findings, we formulate the TokenProbe framework around two empirical findings and one claim: findings identify token value inequality first and then establish TokenProbe as a core-token proxy, and the claim introduces an efficient GRPO objective positing that selectively compressing redundant tokens can yield Pareto improvements in the accuracy-token efficiency space. Empirically, our method preserves reasoning quality while reducing the token usage by 76% of the baseline. Under matched reasoning-length budgets, we show that it can even outperform strong flagship baselines like Gemini-3.1-Pro. Homepage: https://runjia.tech/tokenprobe/.

AI.tldr: CoT推理中token价值高度不均，可用归一化对数概率区分核心token与冗余token；TokenProbe框架选择性压缩冗余token，在保持推理质量的同时减少76% token用量。
AI.motivation: CoT推理虽提升大模型复杂任务表现，但token消耗剧增。核心疑问是推理链中每个token是否同等重要，是否存在可通过压缩冗余token实现效率与准确率双赢的空间。
AI.method: 基于token级对数概率信号的诊断与优化框架。归一化对数概率用于区分核心token（结构性、决定性推理内容）与冗余token（探索性、低置信度填充）。TokenProbe框架包含两条经验发现（token价值不均、TokenProbe作为核心token代理）及一个主张（选择性压缩冗余token的高效GRPO目标可实现准确率-效率Pareto改进）。
AI.result: 保持推理质量的同时将token用量较基线减少76%；在匹配推理长度预算下，甚至超越Gemini-3.1-Pro等旗舰基线。
AI.conclusion: token级价值不均可通过对数概率有效刻画，选择性压缩冗余token能在准确率-效率空间实现Pareto改进，为高效CoT推理提供可行路径。

title: DPAMixerSR: An Efficient Degradation-Pattern-Aware Model for Image Super-Resolution
summary: While content-adaptive schemes have delivered notable advances in image super-resolution (SR), existing approaches typically focus on texture complexity and ignore intrinsic degradation factors (e.g., blur kernels or noise patterns), leading to suboptimal computation allocation and reconstruction performance. To remedy this, we propose DPAMixerSR, a degradation-pattern-aware framework that enables efficient SR through adaptive sparse computation. We design a lightweight Perceptual Degradation Ranking (PDR) module partitions the image into severely and mildly degraded patches, which are routed to the Adaptive Sparse Processing (ASP) and a lightweight convolutional branch, respectively. ASP performs structure-aligned, multi-scale sparse propagation and bidirectional refinement, while the convolutional branch enhances efficiency in mildly degraded regions. By coupling degradation-driven routing with structure-aligned sparse processing, DPAMixerSR establishes a self-regulating framework that dynamically balances computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments on various SR tasks demonstrate that our DPAMixerSR achieves superior structural restoration and perceptual fidelity with markedly reduced computational overhead, providing a novel and scalable framework for degradation-aware, resource-efficient SR.

AI.tldr: DPAMixerSR是一个降解模式感知的图像超分框架，通过稀疏自适应计算实现高效超分。
AI.motivation: 现有内容自适应超分方案主要关注纹理复杂度，忽略内在退化因素（如模糊核、噪声模式），导致计算分配和重建性能不佳。
AI.method: 设计轻量级感知退化排序（PDR）模块，将图像划分为严重退化和轻度退化patch；严重退化patch路由至自适应稀疏处理（ASP）分支，进行结构对齐、多尺度稀疏传播和双向细化；轻度退化patch交由轻量卷积分支处理。
AI.result: 在多种超分任务上实验表明，DPAMixerSR在显著降低计算开销的同时实现了更优的结构恢复和感知保真度。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个可扩展的退化感知、资源高效超分框架，通过退化驱动路由与结构对齐稀疏处理耦合，实现效率与保真度的动态平衡。

title: Rondo: Unsupervised Discovery of Recurring Temporal Structure
summary: Many real-world time series data exhibit structural properties at multiple scales, from short, recurring units to complex sequences composed of these units. Unsupervised discovery of both these components and structure enables the design of intelligent systems that help interpret temporal data, thereby limiting the amount of costly human annotations required. Existing modeling approaches typically overlook the hierarchical structure inherent to many time series, treating recurring patterns at different temporal scales as independent structures. Moreover, most assume access to the complete data sequence and treat discovery as a static process, limiting their ability to evolve as new observations arrive. We introduce Rondo, an unsupervised approach for modeling recurring hierarchical structure in continuous temporal streams. By explicitly constructing vocabularies of reusable units and their recurring compositions, Rondo captures structure shared across complex temporal patterns while refining and expanding its discoveries as the stream evolves. Evaluations on temporal sequences spanning diverse domains and data modalities show that Rondo outperforms existing unsupervised recurrence-discovery baselines, with particularly pronounced advantages in limited-data and continual-stream settings. These capabilities provide a stronger foundation for recurring-pattern discovery, scalable behavior understanding, and adaptive intelligent systems operating on long, unlabeled temporal streams.

AI.tldr: 提出Rondo，一种从连续时序流中无监督发现多尺度层次化重复结构的方法，通过构建可复用单元及其重复组合的词汇表，并随流演化持续更新发现。
AI.motivation: 真实时序数据在多尺度上具有结构性质（从短小重复单元到复杂序列）。现有方法忽视层次结构，将不同尺度的重复模式视为独立结构，且假设可访问完整数据序列、将发现视为静态过程，无法随新观测演化。
AI.method: 显式构建可复用单元的词汇表及其重复组合，捕捉跨复杂时序模式共享的结构，并在流演化过程中不断细化和扩展发现（无监督、面向连续时序流）。
AI.result: 在跨多个领域和数据模态的时序序列上评测，Rondo优于现有无监督重复发现基线，在有限数据和持续流场景下优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 为重复模式发现、可扩展行为理解及长时无标签时序流上的自适应智能系统提供了更强基础。

title: Action Shaping: Policies Absorb What They Can Express
summary: Reward shaping has a theorem: a potential-based term can be removed without changing the optimal policy. The same practice on the action channel, an offset added in training and dropped at deployment, has no theorem. Nothing cancels an action offset, so the correction is kept at deployment or removed without a guarantee. We call it action shaping and state its principle. A trainable policy absorbs an offset its own output layer can reproduce exactly, which is what we mean by express; what is absorbed can be removed with the return intact. Its minimal instance is a zero-initialized linear head behind a learnable gate, added to an actor that trains through a learned action-value function, with no penalty or schedule. The gate rises and then falls on its own, for deterministic and stochastic actors alike, and on 20 tasks removing the head costs almost nothing. The condition is exact reproduction, not capacity: a nonlinear head with more parameters is not absorbed, and in a paired control, one linear path added to a nonlinear base head restores absorption. Exact reproduction gives the loss a flat direction that gradient noise drifts along, and the offset's amplitude indicates, before removal, what dropping the head will cost. Action shaping thus gains the counterpart of the shaping theorem, a condition for absorption, together with the mechanism behind it and a diagnostic that reads it. Policies absorb what they can express, and only that.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"动作塑形"（action shaping）原理：可训练策略会吸收其输出层能精确复现的偏移，而被吸收的偏移可在不损失回报的情况下移除。最小实例是门控后的零初始化线性头，实验证明其可自行升降，移除后 20 个任务上几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 奖励塑形有理论保证（势能项可移除而不改变最优策略），但动作通道上的偏移（训练时加、部署时删）缺乏对应定理：偏移不会自动抵消，导致部署时要么保留、要么无保证地移除。作者据此提出并形式化"动作塑形"问题。
AI.method: 提出动作塑形原理及"精确复现"吸收条件；最小实例为置于可学习门控后的零初始化线性头，附加到通过已学动作价值函数训练的 actor 上，不使用惩罚或调度。通过确定性/随机 actor、20 个任务、以及非线性头（更多参数但不被吸收）与线性路径恢复吸收的配对对照进行验证。
AI.result: 门控自行先升后降；在 20 个任务上移除该头几乎零代价。非线性头即使参数更多也未被吸收，而在线性基础上加一条线性路径可恢复吸收。精确复现使损失出现平坦方向，梯度噪声沿其漂移；偏移幅度可在移除前预测移除代价。
AI.conclusion: 动作塑形获得了与塑形定理对应的理论：吸收条件、其背后机制及可读诊断。核心结论为"策略只吸收其能表达的东西，且仅此而已"。

title: Do System One Decisions Add Up? A Study of Probabilistic Coherence
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/samanjoy2/system-one-coherence
summary: A decision model can give probabilities that sum to one for every question yet disagree with itself when the same decision is broken into smaller steps. We study this form of probabilistic coherence in Jev and the English Laya checkpoint, using 2,500 matched examples per system across TREC, CLINC150, and MASSIVE. Across 72,000 classification questions, we compare direct fine-label predictions with broad-category probabilities and predictions reconstructed through those categories. Both systems show substantial disagreement: mean category-level total variation ranges from 0.219 to 0.349 for Jev and from 0.424 to 0.689 for Laya, on a scale where zero means exact agreement. The consequences differ sharply. On CLINC150, reconstruction reduces Jev's accuracy by 22.9 percentage points (paired 95% bootstrap interval: [-24.9, -20.9]) and improves Laya's by 21.3 points ([18.0, 24.5]). The same directions hold across all three datasets, with all six unadjusted accuracy-change intervals excluding zero. Improved accuracy can also accompany less reliable confidence: on MASSIVE, Laya gains 9.2 accuracy points while its expected calibration error rises from 0.046 to 0.124. Error analysis identifies both broad-category mistakes and within-category confusions. These findings show why decision systems need joint evaluation of accuracy, confidence calibration, and probability coherence in the workflow used by an application.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了Jev和English Laya两个决策系统的概率一致性（coherence），发现两者在将决策分解为类别步骤时都存在显著自相矛盾，且该矛盾对准确率的影响方向相反（Jev下降、Laya上升），同时改进的准确率可能伴随更差的置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 决策模型对每个问题输出的概率虽归一，但当同一决策被拆分成更小的步骤时却可能自相矛盾。作者希望研究这种概率一致性（probabilistic coherence）在不同系统和工作流中的表现及后果。
AI.method: 使用Jev和English Laya两个系统，在TREC、CLINC150和MASSIVE三个数据集上各取2,500个匹配样本；在72,000个分类问题上，比较直接细标签预测、宽类别概率，以及通过类别重建的预测，并分析准确率变化与校准误差。
AI.result: 两系统均存在显著不一致：Jev的类别级平均总变差为0.219–0.349，Laya为0.424–0.689（0表示完全一致）。后果方向相反：CLINC150上重建使Jev准确率下降22.9个百分点，使Laya提升21.3个百分点；三个数据集方向一致，六个未调整准确率变化区间均不含零。MASSIVE上Laya准确率提升9.2点，但ECE从0.046升至0.124。误差分析识别出宽类别错误和类别内混淆。
AI.conclusion: 决策系统需要在应用工作流中联合评估准确率、置信度校准和概率一致性。

title: ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera
summary: We present ProDyGS, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-quality novel view synthesis from videos captured by a single static camera. While existing methods rely on multi-view setups or significant camera motion for geometric constraints, our approach addresses the challenging scenario where multi-view supervision is completely absent. We overcome this limitation by generating synthetic multi-view supervision through depth-guided proxy image synthesis. Specifically, we estimate temporally consistent depth maps using foundational monocular depth networks, then construct 3D Gaussian representations that generate proxy images from arbitrary viewpoints. A deformation network learns temporal dynamics by warping canonical Gaussians using this augmented supervision. Experiments on the DyNeRF dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring only monocular depth estimation as external supervision, outperforming approaches that rely on stronger priors such as scene flow.

AI.tldr: ProDyGS：单目视频动态3D高斯泼溅框架，通过深度引导代理图像合成生成多视角监督，在DyNeRF达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有动态重建方法依赖多视角或大幅相机运动获取几何约束，而单静态相机拍摄的场景缺乏多视角监督，难以高质量新视角合成。
AI.method: 用基础单目深度网络估计时间一致深度图，构建3D高斯表示从任意视角生成代理图像，借深度引导的代理图像合成提供多视角监督；再用变形网络通过该增强监督对规范高斯进行形变学习时序动态。
AI.result: 在DyNeRF数据集上实现SOTA性能，仅需单目深度估计作为外部监督，优于依赖场景流等更强先验的方法。
AI.conclusion: 证明在无多视角监督条件下，仅靠单目深度引导的代理监督即可有效提升单目视频动态3D高斯重建质量。

title: Fisher Simplicity in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks and Multilayer Perceptrons
summary:
Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) are motivated in part by interpretability: their learned edge functions can be inspected, pruned, and reduced to symbolic structure. In a fixed-basis KAN, this makes a small or zero basis coefficient look like a certificate of simplicity, much as a dead rectified linear unit (ReLU) marks unused computation in a multilayer perceptron (MLP). Fisher nullity gives a precise statistical notion: a parameter direction is Fisher-simple exactly when perturbing it is invisible under the task distribution. We study when these architectural and Fisher notions agree.
  For a dead ReLU unit, they agree: the closed activation region makes the associated score directions vanish. For a fixed-basis KAN, they do not. In the single-layer Gaussian case, the coefficient Fisher matrix is a basis Gram matrix under the input distribution and is independent of the fitted coefficients. In a multilayer KAN, Fisher simplicity is graph-path based: the data must reach a basis atom and its perturbation must propagate through the downstream network. We encode these two conditions in an effective edge measure and, under local dictionary independence and effective-measure nondegeneracy, show that zero effective exposure exactly identifies Fisher-null directions within an edge. Controlled diagnostics confirm that zero coefficients can preserve rank while effective path disconnections remove the predicted directions. Coefficient magnitude alone is therefore not a Fisher-based pruning criterion for KANs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究KAN中"系数小/零即简单"的直觉是否与Fisher零空间这一统计概念一致，发现二者在KAN中并不吻合，系数大小不能作为基于Fisher的剪枝标准。
AI.motivation: KAN的可解释性常依赖"低或零基系数=简单/未使用"的直觉，类似MLP中死ReLU标记未用计算。作者想检验这种架构直觉是否与Fisher零空间（扰动在任务分布下不可见）的统计定义相吻合。
AI.method: 对比死ReLU与固定基KAN：单层高斯情形下证明系数Fisher矩阵就是输入分布下的基Gram矩阵，与拟合系数无关；多层KAN中将Fisher简单性刻画为基于图路径的两条件（数据到达基原子、扰动沿下游传播），并编码为有效边测度，在局部字典独立与有效测度非退化假设下证明零有效暴露精确识别边内Fisher零方向。辅以对照实验验证。
AI.result: 死ReLU情形下架构与Fisher概念一致（闭合激活区使score方向消失）；固定基KAN中不一致。单层Fisher矩阵与系数无关；多层需有效路径连接。对照诊断显示：零系数可保持秩而不产生Fisher零方向，而有效路径断开会移除预测方向。
AI.conclusion: 系数大小单独不能作为KAN的Fisher-based剪枝准则；Fisher零方向由有效路径暴露决定而非系数幅值。

title: Adaptive Consistency Graph for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Large language model agents can often make reasonable local decisions on short tasks, yet their performance degrades when success requires long sequences of dependent actions and tool calls. During execution, task requirements, historical evidence, and the current execution state may gradually become disconnected, so later decisions can drift from the original objective. We study this problem by introducing the Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG) for long-horizon execution. ACG incrementally organizes execution evidence and its provenance in a persistent graph, then constructs a temporary requirement-centered view for each decision under a bounded context budget. Rather than replacing the base agent's planner or tool executor, ACG provides a structured and traceable context view for each decision. In the matched evaluation, ACG improves GPT-5.6-luna's average success from 44.5\% with ReAct to 50.2\%, with the largest gain on BrowseComp-Plus (73.5\% versus 62.4\%). We further analyze trajectory structure and inference cost to characterize this improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG)，通过为长时程 LLM 智能体的每次决策构建需求中心的结构化上下文视图，缓解目标漂移问题。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在短任务上可做合理局部决策，但长序列依赖动作与工具调用时性能下降。执行中任务需求、历史证据与当前状态逐渐脱节，导致后续决策偏离原始目标。
AI.method: ACG 增量地将执行证据及其来源组织进持久图，并在有界上下文预算下为每次决策构建临时的"以需求为中心"视图。它不替换基座智能体的规划器或工具执行器，仅提供结构化、可追溯的上下文视图。
AI.result: 在匹配评测中，将 GPT-5.6-luna 的平均成功率从 ReAct 的 44.5% 提升至 50.2%，在 BrowseComp-Plus 上增益最大（73.5% 对 62.4%）。并进一步分析轨迹结构与推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、可追溯的上下文视图能有效改善长时程智能体的连贯性与成功率。

title: Beyond Solo and Consistency: Vindicating Multi-Agent Debate via Conditional Progressive Pruning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) is one of the most effective test time scaling techniques. Through multi-round communication, agents complement each other in knowledge and reasoning and solve tasks that no single member can solve. However, existing MAD frameworks fail to beat strong Single Agent and Consistency-based baselines under the same strict cost limit, which shakes the foundation of the MAD field. We propose Conditional Progressive Pruning (CPP), a lightweight pruning framework that fully exploits multi-round MAD. CPP outperforms all existing MAD frameworks on multiple dominated benchmarks. It is also the first to fully outperform consistency methods. Our code, detailed agent interaction records will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出Conditional Progressive Pruning (CPP)，一种轻量级剪枝框架，在严格成本限制下充分发挥多轮多智能体辩论(MAD)优势，超越所有现有MAD框架并首次全面击败一致性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体辩论(MAD)虽是最有效的测试时扩展技术之一，但在相同严格成本限制下无法击败强单智能体和一致性基线，动摇了MAD领域的基础。
AI.method: 提出Conditional Progressive Pruning (CPP)，一个轻量级剪枝框架，旨在充分利用多轮MAD，通过渐进式剪枝优化多轮通信过程。
AI.result: CPP在多个主流基准上超越所有现有MAD框架，并且是首个全面超越一致性方法的框架。
AI.conclusion: CPP验证了在严格成本限制下充分挖掘多轮MAD潜力的可行性，为MAD领域提供了有效解决方案。代码及详细智能体交互记录将很快发布。

title: Region-Local Copula Evidence Fusion for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Superpixel copula models provide stable regional evidence for heterogeneous remote sensing change detection, but a single label per region limits localization within mixed superpixels. This letter develops a region-local copula evidence fusion method that retains the regional decision structure while introducing spatially varying local dependence anomalies. Independently fitted local models characterize departures from unchanged cross-image relationships. Reference ranking and an upper-tail gate transform these anomalies for fusion with continuous regional confidence. We derive the resulting regiondependent local decision threshold and identify a condition under which gating is equivalent to reparameterizing ungated fusion. On Lake and UK, whole-image optimized configurations achieve kappa coefficients of 0.78136 and 0.90817 and improve mixedregion and boundary decisions. Four-fold retrospective spatial validation over ten training subsets confirms complementary local information, with ungated reference fusion increasing mean kappa by 0.00693 and 0.01793. Fixed gating yields a larger UK gain of 0.03353 but only 0.00041 on Lake. These results support regional-local dependence interaction, while showing that calibration and gating have scene-dependent benefits.

AI.tldr: 提出区域-局部copula证据融合方法，保留区域决策结构并引入空间变化的局部依赖异常，用于遥感变化检测。
AI.motivation: 超像素copula模型提供稳定的区域证据，但每个区域单一标签限制了混合超像素内部的定位能力。
AI.method: 独立拟合局部模型刻画未变化跨图关系的偏离；通过参考排序与上尾门控变换异常，与连续区域置信度融合；推导区域相关局部决策阈值，并给出门控等价于重参数化无门控融合的条件。
AI.result: 在Lake与UK上整图优化kappa为0.78136与0.90817，改善混合区域与边界决策；十训练子集四折回顾空间验证中，无门控参考融合平均kappa提升0.00693与0.01793；固定门控在UK提升0.03353，Lake仅0.00041。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持区域-局部依赖交互，但校准与门控的收益具有场景依赖性。

title: What Do Latent Predictive Vehicle Representations Retain? Measuring State, Geometry, and Local Response
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures, under review, double-blind, code will be made public upon acceptance
summary: Models of vehicle dynamics learned from logged states and commands complement physics-based models, and latent world models, which predict in a learned representation, are used to plan and train controllers in other domains. Vehicle controllers are usually specified in physical terms: costs, limits, and references depend on position, yaw angle, speed, and yaw rate, and the optimizer compares or differentiates predicted outcomes across nearby commands. A latent model placed in such a controller must therefore let these quantities be recovered and must change its predictions with commands as the vehicle does, and prediction error on its own latent targets measures neither. We contribute a measurement protocol for action-conditioned latent predictors with a physical readout that separately tests retention, physical-neighborhood organization, forecasting, and local response to command perturbations, using an untrained-encoder reference and three matched response paths that locate errors in the representation or the predictor. In a case study of a temporal joint-embedding predictive model trained on signals logged in IPG CarMaker, the representations retain the measured planar outputs, though an untrained encoder of the same architecture retains them slightly better; future-command input improves one-second forecasts with retention nearly unchanged; and responses to small command pulses diverge from the simulator already in latent coordinates, raising regret when choosing among nearby commands in all comparisons. Updating the predictor on responses corrects them locally at a cost in forecast accuracy. Measuring retention, forecasting, and local response separately is thus what qualifies a predictive latent as a candidate model for control, and the protocol provides the basis for its closed-loop evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套针对动作条件下潜世界模型的测量协议，通过物理读出分别测试保持性、物理邻域组织、预测能力和对命令扰动的局部响应，并以IPG CarMaker数据训练的时序联合嵌入预测模型为案例验证。
AI.motivation: 车辆控制器通常在物理量（位置、偏航角、速度、偏航率）上定义成本、约束和参考，并要求优化器比较或微分邻近命令下的预测结果。因此，用于控制的潜模型必须能恢复这些物理量，并像真实车辆一样随命令改变预测；而仅用潜目标上的预测误差无法衡量这两点。
AI.method: 提出一种带物理读出的动作条件潜预测器测量协议，分别测试保持性（retention）、物理邻域组织、预测能力（forecasting）以及对命令扰动的局部响应；使用未训练编码器作为参照，并设置三条匹配的响应路径以定位误差来自表示还是预测器。案例研究：在IPG CarMaker日志信号上训练时序联合嵌入预测模型。
AI.result: 表示能够保持所测平面输出，但同架构的未训练编码器略优；引入未来命令输入改善了一秒预测，保持性几乎不变；对小命令脉冲的响应在潜坐标中就已偏离模拟器，在所有比较中均导致近邻命令选择上的遗憾（regret）增加。在响应上更新预测器可在局部纠正，但代价是预测精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 分别测量保持性、预测和局部响应，是判断潜预测器能否作为控制候选模型的关键，该协议为其闭环评估提供了基础。

title: Readout is not Recovery: Dissociating Coordinate Emission from Visual-Corruption Repair in Vision-Language Models
summary: VLM bounding-box localization is both language generation and spatial commitment. Parseable fields such as bbox_2d make localization easy to score, but dimensions that emit coordinate tokens need not repair localization after visual evidence is damaged. We study this readout/recovery separation in Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct on single-object COCO grounding. We compare clean coordinate-token readout rankings with corruption-derived repair rankings, using object-mask endpoint replacement for recovery and clean-input flooring for depth localization. In Qwen3-VL, coordinate-token rankings are inert through layer 24, load-bearing from layers 32-35, and peak at layer 34; corruption-derived rankings harm layers 16-24 but become beneficial near layer 35/final. A Kimi-VL-A3B diagnostic shows a matching output-proximal transition despite a different box format. Object-mask recovery separates rank budgets: $k=250$ shows necessity, $k=500$ shows Top-$k$ restoration above random, and $k=d/2$ is largely capacity-driven. Partial-occlusion sweeps reveal that high-overlap coordinate-token sets can hurt at $k=1000$ and help mainly at half-width, while population corruption-derived sets provide no reliable fixed repair set. Edge-attribution patching shows coordinate-token paths are high precision but low recall for detection recovery, and RMSNorm quasi-layer controls do not close the endpoint-repair gap. Endpoint coordinate triage is therefore a useful circuit prior, but occlusion recovery requires a separate benchmark.

AI.tldr: 研究Qwen3-VL-4B中坐标token定位与遮挡恢复的可分离性，发现坐标token读出在早期惰性、后期载荷，恢复则需独立基准。
AI.motivation: VLM的bbox定位兼具语言生成与空间承诺双重属性；虽然bbox_2d等字段易评分，但当视觉证据受损时，发射坐标token的维度未必能修复定位，需研究读出与恢复的分离。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct上进行单目标COCO grounding实验，对比干净坐标token读出排名与损坏派生修复排名；采用对象掩码端点替换做恢复、干净输入flooring做深度定位；辅以Kimi-VL-A3B诊断、部分遮挡扫描、边归因patch及RMSNorm准层控制。
AI.result: 坐标token排名在24层前惰性，32-35层载荷，34层达峰；损坏排名在16-24层有害，近35层/末层有益。Kimi-VL呈类似输出近端转变。恢复分rank预算：k=250必要性、k=500 Top-k优于随机、k=d/2受容量驱动。高重叠集合在k=1000有害、半宽有益；无可靠固定修复集。坐标token路径精度高但召回低，RMSNorm控制未弥合差距。
AI.conclusion: 端点坐标triage是有用的电路先验，但遮挡恢复需单独基准。

title: REALIS: A Curated Dataset for Studying the Challenges of AI Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors are often evaluated on benchmarks where real and synthetic images differ in content, quality, or generation artifacts, allowing models to rely on dataset-specific cues and fail on unfamiliar generators or processed images. Existing datasets provide limited support for evaluating these challenges jointly across diverse visual content. We introduce REALIS, a dataset of 1.43 million real and synthetic images generated by 42 modern text-to-image models, including the latest proprietary systems such as Nano Banana 2. REALIS combines prompts derived from real images, quality filtering, and stratified sampling to reduce class-specific shortcuts while preserving content diversity. We further introduce REALIS-Expert, a stress-test subset for high-quality synthetic images, where real and generated samples are selected with closely matched semantic and visual characteristics. We also propose a robustness protocol covering 35 transformations at five severity levels to analyze detector behavior under image processing. Based on REALIS, our benchmark evaluates pretrained detectors, fine-tuned models, and zero-shot vision-language models under generator and post-processing shifts. On the hardest processed split, the best pretrained conventional detector achieves 0.550 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.752 for the best REALIS-trained detector. REALIS provides a unified framework for measuring and improving the reliability of AI-image detectors under conditions that better reflect real-world use.

AI.tldr: REALIS是一个包含143万张真实与合成图像的大规模数据集（覆盖42个文生图模型），通过质量过滤与分层采样减少捷径特征，并引入REALIS-Expert压力测试子集和35种变换的鲁棒性协议，用于更真实地评估AI图像检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测基准中真实与合成图像在内容、质量或生成伪影上存在差异，导致模型依赖数据集特定线索，在新生成器或经过处理的图像上失效。现有数据集难以在多样视觉内容上联合评估这些挑战。
AI.method: 构建REALIS数据集（143万张图像，42个现代文生图模型，含Nano Banana 2等最新专有系统），通过源自真实图像的提示、质量过滤和分层采样降低类别特定捷径并保持内容多样性；提出REALIS-Expert压力测试子集（语义与视觉特征高度匹配）；设计覆盖35种变换、5个严重等级的鲁棒性协议；在生成器偏移与后处理偏移下评估预训练检测器、微调模型及零样本视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 在最难的经处理划分上，最佳预训练传统检测器仅达0.550 ROC-AUC，而最佳REALIS训练检测器达0.752。
AI.conclusion: REALIS提供了一个统一框架，用于在更贴近真实使用场景的条件下衡量并提升AI图像检测器的可靠性。

title: Does Transolver really need a Transformer?
summary: The widely used Transolver family of neural operators is based on physics-attention, which softly assigns the points of an unstructured mesh to a small number of slices, applies self-attention among the resulting tokens, and broadcasts the result back to the points. We provide a comprehensive empirical and theoretical analysis to elucidate the mechanisms which are responsible for model performance. To this end, we perform careful ablations on a challenging suite of nine 3D fluid dynamics benchmarks to find that replacing token attention with a constant linear map does not affect the accuracy. Thus, Transolver does not need a Transformer at all. However, removing the global mixing (slicing/deslicing) or doing it only once leads to performance collapse. We leverage the theory of averaging neural operators to explain and corroborate our findings by showing that just slicing/deslicing, in conjunction with pointwise MLPs, already suffices for universal approximation of continuous operators and attention is redundant in this context. Finally, we provide a novel FlashAttention-style efficient implementation of the key slicing/deslicing module of Transolver. This flashslice kernel streams slice and deslice over the points without materializing the heavy slice-weight tensor, while reproducing the best available implementation to floating point error. At the same time, it leads to very significant memory and compute savings, particularly at large slice counts.

AI.tldr: Transolver 的注意力机制其实是冗余的：切片/反切片（全局混合）才是性能关键，去掉它会导致崩溃；本文还提出高效的 FlashSlice 实现。
AI.motivation: Transolver 系列神经算子广泛使用 physics-attention，但其性能来源机制尚不清晰，需要系统性分析以厘清哪些组件真正重要。
AI.method: 在 9 个 3D 流体动力学基准上做细致消融实验；用平均神经算子理论进行解释与验证；并设计 FlashAttention 风格的 flashslice 内核，流式处理切片/反切片，避免物化大权重张量。
AI.result: 将 token attention 换成常量线性映射不影响精度（即不需要 Transformer）；但去掉全局混合或只做一次会导致性能崩溃。理论证明仅切片/反切片加点式 MLP 即可通用逼近连续算子，注意力冗余。flashslice 内核复现最优实现至浮点误差，并在大切片数下显著节省内存和计算。
AI.conclusion: Transolver 的性能主要来自 slice/deslice 全局混合而非注意力，注意力可省略；同时提出高效的 flashslice 实现以降低内存与计算开销。

title: Mandela-Bench: Multimodal Models Remember Canonical Images Instead of Seeing Them
summary: Historical photographs and other canonical images can now be edited seamlessly with a single instruction, often leaving no reliable pixel-level trace. In such cases, the only evidence of manipulation may be a fact about what the image depicts. Existing benchmarks instead rely on generator artefacts, image-caption inconsistencies, visual implausibilities, or external references, and therefore do not test whether a model can use its own world knowledge to verify a recognized image. We introduce Mandela-Bench, containing 1,507 edits of canonical images: 1,359 knowledge-only forgeries, each contradicting one verifiable fact, and 148 anchor-free controls that preserve the editing process without introducing a factual contradiction, together with 474 untouched originals. We score not only whether a model detects a forgery, but whether its explanation identifies the inserted entity or the fact being violated. Across 36 multimodal models, from 0.8B parameters to frontier scale, we find a consistent failure mode. When a public figure is removed from a familiar photograph, models still name that person in up to 72.7% of responses. Some models can distinguish the replacement face from the original when shown in isolation, yet still judge the full edited photograph as authentic. Providing the true event and date does not improve knowledge-grounded detection, whereas providing the same information after cropping away the recognizable composition does. Even under explicit verification prompts, only one of the 36 models meets the KGR criterion on at least half of the forged images. These results suggest that the failures cannot be explained by missing knowledge or inadequate perception alone. Instead, they are consistent with recognition biasing verification toward the remembered canonical image rather than the observed edit.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Mandela-Bench 基准，用 1507 张经典图像的编辑（1359 个与事实矛盾的伪造、148 个无锚点对照、474 个原图）评估 36 个多模态模型。发现普遍失败：模型凭记忆中的经典图像而非实际观察验证，识别偏差压倒检测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准依赖生成器伪影、图文不一致、视觉不合理或外部引用，无法测试模型能否用自身世界知识验证经典图像。而单指令无缝编辑的经典照片往往无法从像素追踪，唯一证据是"图像所描绘的内容"这一事实。
AI.method: 构建 Mandela-Bench：1359 个"仅知识"伪造（各自违反一项可验证事实）、148 个保留编辑过程但不引入事实矛盾的无锚点对照、474 张未修改原图。评分不仅检测是否识别出伪造，还看解释是否指出插入实体或被违反的事实。测试 36 个多模态模型（0.8B 到前沿规模）。
AI.result: 一致失败模式：人物被移除后，模型仍能在最多 72.7% 的回复中说出该人物姓名；部分模型单独看能区分替换脸与原脸，却仍将整张编辑图判为真实。提供真实事件与日期不改善知识检测，而裁掉可识别构图后再提供相同信息则有效。即使明确验证提示，36 个模型中仅 1 个在至少一半伪造图上满足 KGR 标准。
AI.conclusion: 失败不能仅用知识缺失或感知不足解释，而与"识别将验证偏向记忆中的经典图像而非实际观察到的编辑"一致。

title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. Existing critics focus on evaluating trajectories and generating feedback, but rarely track what happens after feedback is delivered. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved. Opera decides when to review through periodic and event-driven triggers, diagnoses issues with typed operators, audits feedback against visible evidence before delivery, and tracks the agent's subsequent actions to distinguish mere compliance from actual resolution. As a test-time critic, Opera improves the resolve rate of non-critic agents by up to 12.4, 15.0, and 8.9 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a SWE-Bench Pro subset, and DeepSWE v1.1, respectively, across four policy models, and achieves the highest mean resolve rate among competitive critic baselines on all three benchmarks, and also improves policy models when the policy critiques itself. Beyond inference, Opera-guided rollouts provide approximately on-policy training data: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on them improves its resolve rate on held-out SWE-Bench Pro repositories by 10.2 percentage points without a critic at inference time, matching fine-tuning on rollouts from a stronger model, while preserving its performance when switching harness, i.e., from Openhands to Terminus-2, which the latter substantially degrades.

AI.tldr: Opera 是一种"言语批评家"框架，将每次纠正视为持续追踪的笔记，直到诊断出的问题真正解决，从而在多个基准上提升编码智能体的解决率。
AI.motivation: 长时段编码智能体需要及时纠正，但现有批评家仅关注评估轨迹和生成反馈，很少追踪反馈交付后发生了什么，导致反馈可能误判或未触及根本问题而无效甚至有害。
AI.method: Opera 将每次纠正视为持续笔记并跟踪至问题解决：通过周期性及事件驱动触发决定何时审查，用类型化算子诊断问题，交付前基于可见证据审核反馈，并追踪智能体后续行动以区分"表面服从"与"真正解决"。
AI.result: 作为测试时批评家，Opera 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、SWE-Bench Pro 子集和 DeepSWE v1.1 上分别将非批评智能体的解决率提升最高 12.4、15.0、8.9 个百分点（跨四个策略模型），并在三个基准上取得竞争性批评基线中最高的平均解决率。Opera 也能在策略模型自我批评时提升其性能。此外，Opera 引导的 rollout 提供近在策略训练数据，微调 Qwen3.5-9B 后在未见过的 SWE-Bench Pro 仓库上解决率提升 10.2 个百分点，且切换工具链（Openhands 到 Terminus-2）时保持性能。
AI.conclusion: 将反馈作为持续追踪的笔记并验证问题真正解决，能显著提升编码智能体的表现，同时生成可用于训练的高质量在策略数据。

title: Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度引导解耦适配框架G2DA，通过跨模态解耦、模态特异性课程学习和双向回放，解决Geo-VLM多任务优化中的任务异质性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间视觉语言模型采用统一多任务适配范式，未考虑任务间异构优化特性，导致视觉-语言差异、分支内梯度关系和任务干扰，阻碍有效多任务优化。
AI.method: G2DA首先通过梯度引导的跨模态解耦将任务分为视觉中心和语言中心两组；再基于任务梯度相似性构建模态特异性课程；最后用双向回放缓解顺序优化带来的近因效应。
AI.result: 在三个Geo-VLM基准、六种InternVL3/Qwen3.5-VL变体及GeoChat、GeoLLaVA上评估。24个基准-模型组合中G2DA均优于基线，在UrBench-MCQ、XLRS-Bench-Lite、VRS-Bench-VQA上分别比最强对手提升3.08、4.30、2.81个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 梯度引导的任务组织对Geo-VLM适配有效，G2DA在多任务地理空间学习中具有显著优势。

title: Activation Flow: Manufacturing Activations for Steering
summary: Difference-in-means steering requires activations recorded while a model shows the desired behavior, which a sandbagging model withholds by deliberately underperforming. We introduce Activation Flow (ActFlow), which manufactures these activations from $k$ correct labels without fine-tuning. ActFlow sets target logits that rank each labeled item's correct answer first, and moves the logits toward them by adding one vector $x$ to all $k$ residual streams at one layer. ActFlow is a family of ordinary differential equations for $x$, one for each rule that maps the required logit change to the velocity of $x$. The smallest-norm rule lands exactly on the targets, while the others keep only the top singular directions of the Jacobian. We test ActFlow on three instruction-tuned models, each locked by a sandbagging prompt and by a password-locked LoRA. At $k=40$, ActFlow keeping five singular directions raises the mean held-out ARC-Easy accuracy over the six locked models from $0.05$ to $0.85$, against $0.88$ for fine-tuning and $0.92$ for the honest models. Furthermore, it scores higher than the smallest-norm rule in 16 of the 18 combinations of locked model and $k$, and its steering direction is nearly orthogonal to the honest difference-in-means direction. It also unlocks two LoRA locks where the honest direction fails.

AI.tldr: ActFlow 无需微调，仅用 k 个正确标签即可"制造"激活以解锁 sandbagging 模型，恢复其性能。
AI.motivation: 差异均值引导（difference-in-means steering）需要模型表现出目标行为时的激活，但 sandbagging 模型会故意表现不佳而隐藏这些激活。
AI.method: ActFlow 设定目标 logits 使每个样本的正确答案排名第一，通过在某一层的所有 k 个残差流中加入一个向量 x 来逼近目标。它是一族关于 x 的常微分方程，每种规则将所需 logit 变化映射为 x 的速度；最小范数规则精确达到目标，其他规则仅保留 Jacobian 的顶部奇异方向。
AI.result: 在三个指令微调模型上（各由 sandbagging 提示和密码锁定 LoRA 锁定）：k=40 时，保留五个奇异方向的 ActFlow 将六个锁定模型在 ARC-Easy 上的平均留出准确率从 0.05 提升到 0.85（微调为 0.88，诚实模型为 0.92）。在 18 种锁定模型与 k 组合中，它 16 次优于最小范数规则，且其引导方向几乎正交于诚实差异均值方向，还能解锁两个诚实方向失败的 LoRA 锁。
AI.conclusion: ActFlow 能从少量正确标签合成激活，有效引导并解锁 sandbagging 模型，性能接近微调与诚实模型，且引导方向与诚实差异均值方向差异显著。

title: Forecasting Intraday USD/CAD Exchange Rate with News-Derived Monetary-Policy Signals
summary: Monetary-policy announcements and central-bank communications play a central role in foreign exchange markets, yet their qualitative, unstructured form makes their forecasting value difficult to quantify. While prior research has largely focused on sentiment extracted from financial news, comparatively little is known about the relative contribution of different dimensions of monetary-policy communication. Existing studies primarily evaluate whether textual information improves overall forecasting performance but provide limited insight into which communication channels drive such improvements. To address this gap, this paper introduces a statistical attribution methodology that decomposes monetary-policy communication into interpretable channels and quantifies their incremental forecasting contribution under false-discovery-rate control. Monetary-policy news is transformed into structured communication signals using large language models (LLMs) and temporal feature engineering. These signals are evaluated using rolling-window experiments with tree-based machine-learning models. The results show that monetary-policy communication contains measurable predictive information. Attribution analysis shows that predictive value is concentrated in a small subset of signals, with communication timing providing the strongest individual feature-level contribution, targeted communication-activity measures also contributing positively, and LLM-derived sentiment providing complementary information at the group level. The findings indicate that communication-based forecasting value extends beyond sentiment alone and that attribution, rather than aggregate accuracy alone, is central to evaluating news-derived signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统计归因方法，将央行货币政策沟通分解为可解释渠道，在错误发现率控制下量化各渠道对汇率预测的增量贡献，发现预测价值集中于少数信号（沟通时点最强，LLM情绪提供补充）。
AI.motivation: 货币政策公告与央行沟通在汇率市场作用核心，但其定性、非结构化特征使预测价值难量化。既有研究多关注金融新闻情绪，对不同沟通维度的相对贡献了解有限，且通常只评估文本信息是否提升整体预测表现，难以揭示哪一沟通渠道驱动改进。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型与时间特征工程将货币政策新闻转化为结构化沟通信号；采用滚动窗口实验配合树模型进行评估；提出统计归因方法，将沟通分解为可解释渠道，并在假发现率控制下量化各渠道的增量预测贡献。
AI.result: 结果显示货币政策沟通包含可测量的预测信息；归因分析表明预测价值集中于少数信号，沟通时点（timing）在个体特征层面贡献最强，定向沟通活动指标也有正贡献，LLM情绪在组层面提供互补信息。
AI.conclusion: 基于沟通的预测价值不止于情绪；评估新闻衍生信号应以归因而非仅靠整体准确率。

title: RewardExplainer: Learning Reward Model Explanations from Counterfactual Preference Feedback
summary: Reward models (RMs) are a key component of large language model post-training, providing reward signals for subsequent reinforcement learning. However, conventional discriminative RMs typically output only scalar scores, making it difficult to identify the response behaviors associated with their scoring decisions. Existing interpretation methods often rely on predefined high-level attributes and require repeated counterfactual interventions for each response pair to validate candidate explanations, lacking a closed-loop mechanism that uses RMs' feedback to train a reusable explainer. To address this, we propose RewardExplainer, a framework that obtains feedback from the target reward model through counterfactual rewriting and uses this feedback to further optimize the explainer. RewardExplainer generates open-ended, atomic, and intervenable natural-language scoring mechanisms, making explanations more concrete, readable, and actionable. It further converts counterfactual feedback into preference supervision, enabling the explainer to more faithfully capture the target RM's scoring preferences and sensitive behaviors than single-pass generation. Extensive experiments across multiple target RMs and explainer backbones show consistent improvements. Beyond interpretation, we use the generated mechanisms to identify potential bias patterns and construct targeted debiasing data for fine-tuning the reward model, improving robustness on reward-hacking benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出RewardExplainer框架，通过反事实重写从奖励模型获取反馈并优化解释器，生成开放、原子化、可干预的评分机制。
AI.motivation: 传统判别式奖励模型仅输出标量分数，难以识别其评分决策对应的响应行为；现有解释方法依赖预定义高层属性，且需对每个响应对反复做反事实干预，缺乏利用RM反馈训练可复用解释器的闭环机制。
AI.method: 通过反事实重写从目标奖励模型获取反馈，并用于进一步优化解释器；生成开放、原子化、可干预的自然语言评分机制；将反事实反馈转化为偏好监督，使解释器比单次生成更忠实地捕捉目标RM的评分偏好和敏感行为。
AI.result: 在多个目标RM和解释器主干上实验一致提升；利用生成的机制识别潜在偏见模式，并构建针对性去偏数据微调奖励模型，提升奖励黑客基准上的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RewardExplainer实现了闭环、可复用的奖励模型解释，并可用于偏见识别与去偏，提升奖励模型鲁棒性。

title: AnesTRACE: Benchmarking Intraoperative Anesthesia from Multimodal Perception to Multi-step Decision-Making
summary: Intraoperative anesthesia requires systems to interpret evolving multimodal evidence, recommend timely management, and revise decisions as patient states change, yet existing benchmarks usually isolate perception or single-point reasoning. We introduce AnesTRACE, an evaluation suite comprising AnesTRACE-Bench and AnesTRACE-Eval. Built from public perioperative datasets with anesthesiologist annotation, AnesTRACE-Bench evaluates Intraoperative Perception, Single-point Anesthesia Decision-Making, and Multi-step Anesthesia Decision-Making. AnesTRACE-Eval assesses open-ended responses through anesthesiologist-defined criteria for Clinical Correctness, Evidence Grounding, Task Completeness, and Safety, with Temporal Consistency for multi-step decisions; its domain-specific evaluator is trained by supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment on expert-reviewed judgments. Across more than 30 models, fine-grained visual grounding and intervention selection remain difficult: the leading model reaches only 32.2 mIoU for TEE visual grounding and retains a 17.5\% Major/Critical Safety Error Rate in multi-step management. Evaluator alignment with anesthesiologists improves across both training stages, while the best decision quality is accompanied by a 74.3-second P95 Latency. These results show that aggregate performance alone does not establish safe, timely longitudinal decision-making. We release our code at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/AnesTRACE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnesTRACE，一个用于术中麻醉纵向决策的评测套件，包含基准测试与评估器，揭示现有模型在视觉定位与安全决策上的不足。
AI.motivation: 术中麻醉需要系统理解多模态证据、及时推荐管理并随患者状态变化修正决策，但现有基准通常只针对感知或单点推理，缺乏对纵向决策的评估。
AI.method: 基于公开围术期数据集并配麻醉医生标注，构建AnesTRACE-Bench（评估术中感知、单点麻醉决策、多步麻醉决策）与AnesTRACE-Eval（依据麻醉医生标准评估临床正确性、证据支撑、任务完整性与安全性，多步决策增加时序一致性，评估器通过SFT与偏好对齐训练）。
AI.result: 在30余个模型上评测，细粒度视觉定位与干预选择仍困难：最佳模型TEE视觉定位仅32.2 mIoU；多步管理存在17.5%重大/关键安全错误率；评估器与麻醉医生对齐度在两阶段训练中提升；最佳决策质量伴随74.3秒P95延迟。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭总体性能无法保证安全、及时的纵向决策，AnesTRACE揭示了当前模型在术中麻醉决策上的关键不足。

title: What Does a ProcGen Generalization Gap Measure? Action Rules, Convergence, and the Missing Random Floor
summary: A generalization gap in reinforcement learning (return on training levels minus return on held-out levels) is usually reported without a reference point. We argue that the missing reference is a measured random floor: the return of a uniform-random policy on the same levels under the same harness. On ProcGen, the floor changes what several standard numbers mean. On identical checkpoints and levels across eight environments, switching between sampled and greedy (argmax) test-time actions moves held-out return in both directions, and greedy evaluation takes three environments to or below the floor: in miner, the sampled policy scores 4.9x the floor on held-out levels while its argmax scores below it. Raw policy entropy places seven of eight environments short of convergence, but 35-65% of that entropy is spread across actions with identical effects; after merging them, one to three remain short, and against the floor only heist has learned nothing that transfers. An audit of twelve prior ProcGen codebases finds that all eleven with held-out evaluation sample test-time actions for their policy-gradient agents, nine by default rather than explicit choice, and six report running in-loop averages rather than evaluating a fixed checkpoint. Applied to our own case study, the same checks grade down a statistically significant encoder effect and rule out a within-encoder train-vs-test CKA statistic. We recommend that every reported gap state its action rule, use a matched and seeded protocol, and report the random floor on both level sets.

AI.tldr: 本文指出强化学习中的"泛化差距"缺少参照点，主张应以同一测试环境下均匀随机策略的回报作为"随机地板"，并基于ProcGen实验与对12个已有代码库的审计，揭示该参照点如何改变标准指标的解释。
AI.motivation: 现有RL研究通常直接报告"训练关卡回报减留出关卡回报"的泛化差距，却没有任何参照基准，导致该数值难以解释甚至产生误导。作者认为缺失的参照应是一个可测量的随机地板（uniform-random policy在同一关卡与测试框架下的回报）。
AI.method: 在ProcGen的8个环境中，对相同checkpoint和关卡，比较"采样动作"与"贪心(argmax)动作"两种测试时策略；分析策略熵在合并等效动作后的变化；并审计12个既有ProcGen代码库的留出评估实践。
AI.result: 切换采样/贪心会双向改变留出回报，贪心评估使3个环境跌至地板及以下（如miner中采样策略是地板的4.9倍，argmax却低于地板）；原始熵显示8个环境中7个未收敛，但35-65%的熵来自等效动作，合并后仅1-3个仍未收敛，以地板为准则只有heist未学到可迁移能力。12个代码库中11个在留出评估时采样动作（9个为默认而非显式选择），6个报告在线均值而非固定checkpoint。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议：每个报告的泛化差距都应说明其动作规则、采用匹配且固定种子的评估协议，并在两个关卡集上同时报告随机地板；该检查在本文案例中会导致原先统计显著的encoder效应被降级，并排除一个within-encoder的train-vs-test CKA统计量。

title: Agentic Network Traffic Monitoring
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, to appear in IEEE URTC 2026
summary: As the use of agentic artificial intelligence increases in nearly every industry, there exists a widening attack surface. It is necessary to monitor agents to ensure that agents are acting in a way that is aligned with the users intent. Auditing an agent's network traffic provides a clear record of the agent interactions. This work presents a novel approach to monitoring the network traffic of agentic systems using complex valued hypersparse traffic matrices by integrating DBOS (DataBase OS), the OneSparse PostgreSQL database, and the GraphBLAS math library. To develop these concepts an agentic simulator was constructed, allowing a varying numbers of AI agents to collectively survey a virtual environment using different strategies. The resulting network traffic matrices enable easy monitoring of the AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用复数超稀疏流量矩阵监控智能体系统网络流量的新方法，通过集成DBOS、OneSparse PostgreSQL和GraphBLAS实现。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体AI在各行业广泛应用，攻击面不断扩大，需要监控智能体行为以确保其符合用户意图。审计网络流量可提供清晰的智能体交互记录。
AI.method: 整合DBOS（Database OS）、OneSparse PostgreSQL数据库和GraphBLAS数学库，构建复数域超稀疏流量矩阵；并搭建智能体模拟器，使不同数量的AI智能体采用不同策略协作勘察虚拟环境。
AI.result: 生成的网络流量矩阵能够便捷地监控AI智能体，模拟器支持可变数量智能体与多种策略下的协同行为。
AI.conclusion: 基于复数超稀疏流量矩阵的网络流量监控方法为智能体系统提供了清晰可审计的交互记录，有助于保障智能体行为与用户意图的一致性。

title: Faithful Activation Verbalization: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM Representation Interpretation
summary: Activation verbalization methods such as Activation Oracle and Natural Language Autoencoders decode hidden representations of large language models into human-readable natural language. However, existing methods can produce incomplete or hallucinated descriptions, making their activation verbalizations difficult to trust and use reliably in practice. To this end, we introduce AVPO, a two-stage framework that first reconstructs source text from a hidden activation and then evaluates the resulting text with a separate frozen question-answering model, yielding an explicit and inspectable intermediate readout. We further optimize the inverter with direct preference optimization (DPO), using rewards that capture both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Across six text families, AVPO improves gist- and detail-level information recovery over the strongest baseline by up to 17.1 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Crucially, the gains arise from preference optimization rather than fine-tuning on selected reconstructions alone, enabling compact cross-model inverters to surpass donor-matched question-conditioned verbalizers while improving both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Moreover, out-of-distribution case study shows that AVPO better recovers high-level semantics while fabricating fewer details.

AI.tldr: 提出AVPO两阶段框架，通过DPO优化激活反演器，提升激活言语化的可靠性与信息恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有激活言语化方法（如Activation Oracle、Natural Language Autoencoders）会产生不完整或幻觉描述，导致其可用性和可信度低。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：先从隐藏激活重建源文本，再用独立冻结的QA模型评估该文本，得到显式可检查的中间读数；并用DPO优化反演器，奖励兼顾语义可恢复性与词汇保真度。
AI.result: 在六类文本上，gist级与细节级信息恢复相比最强基线分别最多提升17.1和9.3个百分点；增益来自偏好优化而非仅对选定重建的微调；紧凑跨模型反演器超过供体匹配的问题条件化言语化器；OOD案例显示更好恢复高层语义且更少编造细节。
AI.conclusion: AVPO提升了激活言语化的可信度与可靠性，兼顾语义与词汇保真，且泛化性更好。

title: LoCoVSR: Local Context Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Video Super-Resolution
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to reconstruct a high-resolution (HR) video from a noisy, low-resolution (LR) version of it. We present LoCoVSR, a diffusion-based VSR framework that leverages pixel-space denoising diffusion probabilistic models. LoCoVSR integrates the Diffusion Posterior Sampling technique with spatio-temporal context learning, operating in a moving-average form. A localized window of adjacent LR frames is used for recovering each center frame, while applying a shared noise trajectory across all frames. The localized windowing enables processing of long videos without length limitations, supports parallel inference, and prevents error accumulation that may occur in recursive processing. Unlike prior methods, LoCoVSR offers a simple yet very effective VSR solution, avoiding explicit optical flow estimation, or information loss caused by latent space processing. Trained on the VFHQ face dataset, LoCoVSR achieves accurate, temporally consistent and high-quality upscaling with competitive results against recent diffusion-based VSR approaches.

AI.tldr: LoCoVSR：一种基于扩散后验采样与时空上下文学习的像素空间扩散VSR框架，无需光流估计，支持长视频并行推断。
AI.motivation: 视频超分是病态逆问题，现有方法依赖显式光流估计或潜空间处理导致信息损失，且递归处理易造成误差累积并受视频长度限制。
AI.method: 融合扩散后验采样与时空上下文学习，以移动平均形式运作；用相邻LR帧的局部窗口恢复中心帧，并对所有帧施加共享噪声轨迹；在VFHQ人脸数据集上训练。
AI.result: 在VFHQ上实现准确、时序一致且高质量的上采样，性能与近期基于扩散的VSR方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LoCoVSR提供了一种简单而有效的VSR方案，避免光流估计和潜空间信息损失，可处理无长度限制的长视频并支持并行推断，防止误差累积。

title: Shared Autoregressive Context Can Distort Relationships in Synthetic Data
summary: Large language models can generate several records within one autoregressive completion, making earlier answers available as context for later records. This paper shows that such shared-completion batching can distort relationships among variables in the resulting synthetic data, using controlled tests on synthetic survey respondents. In a matched experiment on 2,000 European Social Survey profiles, generating ten rather than one respondent per request increases mean absolute error in within-country correlations by 48-58% for Qwen3.8-27B and 114-127% for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct across three seeds, holding profiles, examples, questions and decoding parameters fixed. The distortion primarily reflects exaggerated relationship strength, while retaining substantial agreement with the human ordering of correlations. Controlled interventions establish answer history as a causal channel: re-pairing the same preceding values, with profiles and marginal distributions fixed, changes correlations among subsequently generated responses. Hiding preceding answers reduces correlation error in the tested settings but worsens marginal accuracy. Exploratory corrections across social-attitude, health and economic data likewise show that lower correlation error can coexist with worse marginal distributions and regression estimates. Request construction is therefore part of the data-generating process, and synthetic-data validity must be evaluated against the analyses the generated data are intended to support.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在单次自回归生成中批量生成多条记录时，先前答案会作为后续记录的上下文，从而扭曲合成数据中变量之间的关系；共享补全批处理会引入相关性误差，需针对目标分析评估合成数据有效性。
AI.motivation: LLM可在一次补全中生成多条记录，使先前答案成为后续记录上下文。作者希望探究这种"共享补全批处理"是否会扭曲合成数据中变量间关系。
AI.method: 在2,000个欧洲社会调查（ESS）画像上做匹配实验，比较每请求生成10条与1条回答。对Qwen3.8-27B和Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct在三个随机种子下测试，固定画像、示例、问题与解码参数。并通过控制干预（重新配对前序答案、隐藏前序答案）验证答案历史作为因果渠道。
AI.result: 生成10条比1条使国内相关性平均绝对误差增加48-58%（Qwen3.8-27B）和114-127%（Llama-3.3-70B）；扭曲主要体现为关系强度被夸大，但仍保持与人类相关性排序的较大一致性。控制干预证明答案历史是因果渠道：重配对前序值改变后续回答的相关性；隐藏前序答案降低相关性误差但损害边际准确性。探索性修正表明更低相关性误差可能与更差边际分布和回归估计共存。
AI.conclusion: 请求构建本身是数据生成过程的一部分，合成数据的有效性必须针对其预期支持的分析进行评估。

title: Learning response-aware patient dynamics for respiratory support
summary: Respiratory support can shape the short-term physiological trajectory of critically ill patients, but patients receiving the same intervention may follow different physiological trajectories. Clinical patient dynamics models typically predict future states from recent physiology and recorded interventions, while physiological change is mainly represented through the predicted future state. We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly represents physiological change during autoregressive state updating. The model decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, with room air providing a reference for the decomposition. We provide a formal analysis of this reference-anchored formulation. A response pathway encodes the predicted physiological change and uses it to update the latent patient state across the forecast horizon. Across ICU cohorts from two independent institutions, the proposed model achieves comparable overall trajectory prediction to patient dynamics baselines, with more consistent improvements when physiological states are changing.

AI.tldr: 提出响应感知的患者动态模型，将生理变化分解为状态依赖的基线动态与呼吸支持相关偏差，以室内空气为参照锚定，提升生理状态变化时的轨迹预测。
AI.motivation: 同一呼吸支持干预下患者可能呈现不同生理轨迹，而现有患者动态模型主要通过预测的未来状态隐含表达生理变化，未显式建模干预-反应的关联。
AI.method: 在自回归状态更新中显式表示生理变化：将预测变化分解为状态依赖基线动态与呼吸支持相关偏差，用室内空气作参照，并对该参照锚定形式进行形式化分析；通过响应通路编码预测变化并更新潜状态。
AI.result: 在两个独立机构的ICU队列上，整体轨迹预测与基线模型相当，在生理状态变化时改进更一致。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模生理变化并锚定呼吸支持参照可提升患者动态预测在状态变化期的稳健性。

title: Who Gets a Token, and What Does It Carry? Unequal Name Support and Concept Access in Large Language Models
summary: Names are personal identifiers, but they also carry social meaning and are widely used to evaluate how language models treat different people. Such evaluations typically assume that matched names are comparable model inputs. We show that this assumption often fails at the lexical interface: matched names are not necessarily matched inputs. Some names receive direct single-token access, while others are assembled from multiple subwords, creating unequal name-surface support. Across nearly half a million first names and 12 LLM-associated tokenizers, direct lexical access is highly selective, model dependent, and uneven across race- and gender-associated name metadata. We introduce NameTrace, a model-native, fine-grained, pre-behavioral framework for measuring whether unequal name-surface support remains a vocabulary property or becomes visible in task-relevant internal representations. NameTrace measures concept accessibility from the model's own probabilities over task-specific adjective axes with continuous task-aligned weights. On matched atomic and short-fragmented names within the same race/ethnicity--gender-associated strata, support predicts systematic differences in concept accessibility across fellowship, hiring, clinical assessment, and lending. These differences persist across all eight matched strata, extend across model families, and transfer to unseen names. Hidden-state interventions further show that the measured task directions have downstream leverage, shifting later constrained choices. Unequal lexical support is therefore demographically structured at the input and remains visible in task-relevant model computation. NameTrace makes lexical comparability measurable, supporting a broader principle: behavioral comparability begins with lexical comparability.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出名字在LLM分词中并非等价输入，某些名字可直接单token访问而其他名字被拆成多个子词，造成"名字表面支持"不均。作者提出NameTrace框架量化这种词汇层面的不平等，发现其在人口统计维度上结构化，并转化为下游任务中概念可及性的系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 以往评估LLM对名字的公平性时，常假设匹配的名字是等价的模型输入。论文证明这一假设在词汇界面往往失效：有些名字能被单个token直接表示，有些则需多个子词拼接，导致不平等的"名字表面支持"。这种不均衡是否只是词汇表属性，还是会进入任务相关的内部表征并影响模型决策，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 研究覆盖近50万个名字与12个LLM相关分词器，测量直接词汇访问的选择性与人口统计不均。提出NameTrace：一种模型原生、细粒度、行为前的框架，利用模型在任务特定形容词轴上的概率分布（带连续任务对齐权重）衡量"概念可及性"。在同一种族/族裔—性别分层内，对比匹配的原子型与短碎片型名字，并结合隐藏状态干预实验检验任务方向的下游影响。
AI.result: 直接词汇访问高度选择性、依赖具体模型，并随种族与性别相关元数据分布不均。匹配的原子型与短碎片型名字间，表面支持系统性预测概念可及性差异，出现在奖学金、招聘、临床评估与借贷四类任务中，且在所有八个匹配分层中持续存在，跨越不同模型家族，并可迁移到未见名字。隐藏状态干预显示所测任务方向具有下游杠杆作用，能改变后续受约束的选择。
AI.conclusion: 不平等的词汇支持在输入端即具有人口统计结构，并持续显现在任务相关的模型计算中。NameTrace使词汇可比性变得可测量，支撑一个更广泛的原则：行为可比性始于词汇可比性。

title: From Feed-Forward to Flow: Unifying Reconstruction and Generation Is Easier Than You Think
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Haoru Wang and Qianfan Shen contributed equally
summary: Reconstruct where the images provide evidence, and generate where they do not: recent success of spatial world models such as Atlas (World Labs Team, 2026) highlights the value of unifying reconstruction and generation in one model. Yet the two have long lived in separate paradigms with distinctive failure modes: feed-forward reconstruction averages ambiguity into blur, while conditional generation invents plausible but scene-inconsistent detail. In this work, we present a unified flow-based formulation for reconstruction and generation, where a shared clean-target predictor performs direct reconstruction at its single-step endpoint and unfolds conditional generation through multi-step flow. A controlled toy study reveals the mechanism: with a single step, the predictor collapses to the conditional mean just like feed-forward methods, favoring consistency over diversity. With multi-step inference, the fidelity of generated details grows with context richness: closer observations reduce ambiguity and yield better-matched details. We further instantiate the formulation in appearance and geometry 3D tasks. JiT-LVSM improves perceptual and distributional quality in novel view synthesis, while JUSt3R retains competitive single-step geometry prediction with additional multi-step inference capabilities that reduces veil and flying-pixel artifacts, producing cleaner surface structure with greater test-time compute. Together, they show that reconstruction and generation can share both a formulation and a backbone, with their behavior governed by denoising configuration---making unification surprisingly simple.

AI.tldr: 本文将重建与生成统一到一个基于流的框架中，共享一个干净目标预测器，其行为由去噪配置（单步 vs 多步）决定，并在3D外观与几何任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 重建与生成长期分属不同范式，各有失败模式：前馈重建将歧义平均为模糊，条件生成则捏造合理但与场景不一致的细节。作者受Atlas等空间世界模型启发，希望将二者统一于一个模型。
AI.method: 提出统一的基于流的公式：共享一个干净目标预测器，单步终点做直接重建，多步流做条件生成。通过一个受控玩具实验揭示机制，并实例化到外观与几何3D任务（JiT-LVSM用于新视角合成，JUSt3R用于几何预测）。
AI.result: 玩具实验显示：单步时预测器坍缩到条件均值（偏一致性、缺多样性）；多步时生成细节保真度随上下文丰富度提升。JiT-LVSM提升了感知与分布质量；JUSt3R保持有竞争力的单步几何预测，并具备多步推理能力，减少veil与flying-pixel伪影，生成更干净表面结构。
AI.conclusion: 重建与生成可以共享同一公式与骨干网络，其行为由去噪配置决定，统一方式出人意料地简单。

title: Prioritizing Repeated LLM Evaluation for Hidden Failure Discovery
summary:
Large language models are commonly evaluated by generating a small number of stochastic responses for each prompt in a benchmark. Because inference budgets are limited, this shallow evaluation may fail to observe low-probability but operationally important failures. A prompt that produces no failures in a small sample may therefore appear reliable despite having a nonzero latent probability of failure under repeated inference.
  We formulate LLM reliability evaluation as a budget-constrained discovery problem in which each prompt is associated with an unknown per-generation failure probability. We propose a budgeted discovery framework that first performs shallow evaluation across the prompt set and then uses trial-level failure outcomes together with prompt-derived representations to learn a feature-based ranking of failure propensity. The resulting scores prioritize prompts with zero observed shallow failures for deeper evaluation, concentrating the deep-evaluation budget where hidden failures are more likely to be discovered.
  We evaluate this approach on AIRBench and StrongREJECT across multiple model and system-prompt conditions. The central empirical test asks whether models fit without access to deep-evaluation outcomes can rank prompts with zero observed shallow failures according to their likelihood of producing failures under deeper evaluation. On AIRBench, the highest-ranked 10\% of unresolved prompts achieves 2.54x hidden-failure lift for Qwen 2.5 7B and 1.87x for Gemma 3n E4B, recovering 25.4\% and 18.7\% of subsequently observed hidden failures, respectively, compared with 10\% expected under random allocation. Semantic-neighborhood and feature-ablation analyses further show that this predictive signal can be recovered from multiple representations of prompt content and relationships.

AI.tldr: 将LLM可靠性评测建模为预算约束下的失败发现问题，通过浅层评测+特征排序优先深评零失败提示，显著提升隐藏失败发现效率。
AI.motivation: 现有评测仅对每个提示生成少量随机响应，受推理预算限制，难以观测低概率但重要的失败；浅层样本无失败的提示可能仍存在潜在失败概率，误判为可靠。
AI.method: 提出预算化发现框架：先在提示集上做浅层评测，再利用试验级失败结果与提示表示学习基于特征的失败倾向排序，用得分优先对零浅层失败的提示分配深评预算。
AI.result: 在AIRBench和StrongREJECT多模型/系统提示条件下测试。AIRBench上最高排名10%未解决提示实现2.54x（Qwen 2.5 7B）和1.87x（Gemma 3n E4B）隐藏失败提升，分别召回25.4%和18.7%，远高于随机10%。
AI.conclusion: 浅层失败信号与提示表示可预测潜在失败倾向，有效集中深评预算；该信号可由多种提示内容与关系表示恢复，语义邻域与特征消融分析予以验证。

title: CLAIRE: A Schema-Grounded Hybrid Workflow for Healthcare Administrative Form Completion
summary: Healthcare administrative staff transfer structured information from electronic health records, referrals, claims systems, provider rosters, and work queues into dynamic forms. We developed and evaluated CLAIRE (Clinical Language and Agentic Intelligence for Reasoning and Entry), a hybrid workflow that separates field-state discovery, source-to-field mapping, deterministic validation, bounded correction, escalation, and audit tracing. We tested five synthetic healthcare administrative schemas, 1,000 source records, four interface variants, two data-quality suites, and six comparators, yielding 24,000 benchmark episodes. A separate strict-output audit evaluated direct mappings from Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B, and a trace-derived operational simulation covered 6,000 episodes. Under the evaluated synthetic benchmark conditions, full CLAIRE achieved 1.000 episode success, field accuracy, required-field completion, and dependency completion in both suites; removing validation reduced stress-suite success to 0.500. In the simulation, 100.0% of clean and validation-stress episodes reached a staff-reviewable draft, compared with 68.6% of escalation challenge episodes, unsupported cases were blocked. Scenario-based savings were 149.7-165.5 seconds per case, not observed staff times. The findings support schema-grounded, validation-first healthcare administrative automation in which language-model components assist mapping but do not authorize unsupported or consequential actions.

AI.tldr: 提出并评估CLAIRE混合工作流，将字段状态发现、源到字段映射、确定性验证、有界纠错、升级与审计追踪分离，用于医疗行政表单填写。
AI.motivation: 医疗行政人员需将结构化信息从电子病历、转诊、理赔等系统填入动态表单，需要可控、可审计的自动化方案，避免语言模型直接授权高风险操作。
AI.method: 构建CLAIRE（分离发现、映射、确定性验证、有界纠错、升级、审计追踪）；测试5个合成医疗行政模式、1000条源记录、4种界面变体、2套数据质量套件、6个比较对象，共24000个基准回合；另用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B做严格输出审计，并做6000回合的追踪派生运行模拟。
AI.result: 合成基准下，完整CLAIRE在两套套件中回合成功率、字段准确率、必填字段完成率、依赖完成率均达1.000；去除验证后压力套件成功率降至0.500。模拟中干净与验证压力回合100.0%生成可人工审核草稿，升级挑战回合为68.6%，不支持案例被阻断；每案例场景节省149.7–165.5秒（非实测人员时间）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持以模式为基础、验证优先的医疗行政自动化：语言模型仅辅助映射，不授权无依据或后果性操作。

title: Evaluating Machine Unlearning in ASR
summary: Machine unlearning (MU) offers a path to compliance with "right to be forgotten" regulations. While MU has received increasing attention for speech tasks, it remains largely unexplored for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). In this work, we investigate whether existing MU algorithms and evaluation tools are suitable for ASR. We apply several MU techniques to an ASR model, evaluating privacy-utility trade-offs for single-subject unlearning, then assess the best algorithm under sequential and simultaneous unlearning. Results show that gradient ascent-based algorithms achieve strong utility-privacy trade-offs, whereas more complex approaches over-unlearn samples, making them easier to identify as unlearned. This suggests standard privacy evaluations based on simple Membership Inference attacks are insufficient to reliably assess unlearning success, motivating improved evaluation methods for MU in ASR. Finally, we show that both sequential and simultaneous unlearning yield worse privacy and utility than single-subject unlearning, underscoring the need for unlearning constructions better suited to these settings.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究机器遗忘（MU）在自动语音识别（ASR）中的适用性，发现梯度上升类算法权衡较好，但现有评估方法不足。
AI.motivation: MU在语音任务受关注，但在ASR领域几乎未被探索；需验证现有MU算法与评估工具是否适用于ASR，以满足"被遗忘权"合规需求。
AI.method: 将多种MU技术应用于ASR模型，评估单主体遗忘的隐私-效用权衡；对最优算法进一步测试顺序遗忘与同时遗忘设置。
AI.result: 梯度上升类算法取得较强的效用-隐私权衡，而更复杂方法会过度遗忘样本，使其更易被识别为已遗忘；顺序与同时遗忘的隐私和效用均劣于单主体遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 基于简单成员推理攻击的隐私评估不足以保证遗忘成功，需改进ASR中MU的评估方法；同时需设计更适合顺序/同时遗忘场景的遗忘构造。

title: OmniMoE-VL: A Sparse Vision-Language Model with Coupled Visual-Depth Routing
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly use sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to scale language-side computation, yet visual information is typically routed only after passing through a fixed cross-modal interface. This leaves an important decision unresolved: which intermediate visual representations should be exposed to language computation for a given question? We introduce OmniMoE-VL, a sparse VLM with a coupled visual-depth routed projector. For each image-prompt pair, the projector selects a sparse set of intermediate visual depths and reuses the resulting global preference to guide both local patch fusion and dynamic visual injection into the language model. This design enables question-dependent visual access while preserving the native visual-token sequence, and complements token-level expert routing in the vision and language stacks. Across eight image-based benchmarks, OmniMoE-VL achieves an average score of 85.9 with 28B total and 9B activated parameters. Controlled comparisons show that the routed visual interface provides the dominant architectural gain, while matched route and component controls, same-image route analysis, and route interventions further support the value of coupling and question-conditioned visual access.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniMoE-VL，一种带耦合视觉深度路由投影器的稀疏 MoE 视觉语言模型，实现问题依赖的视觉信息访问，平均分达 85.9。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 使用稀疏 MoE 扩展语言侧计算，但视觉信息仅通过固定跨模态接口后被路由，忽略了「给定问题应暴露哪些中间视觉表征给语言计算」这一关键决策。
AI.method: 提出耦合视觉深度路由投影器：对每个图像-提示对，投影器选择稀疏的中间视觉深度集合，并复用由此产生的全局偏好同时指导局部 patch 融合和向语言模型的动态视觉注入，在保持原生视觉 token 序列的同时实现问题依赖的视觉访问。
AI.result: 在八个图像基准上，28B 总参数、9B 激活参数下平均分 85.9。受控对比显示路由视觉接口带来主要架构增益；匹配路由与组件对照、同图像路由分析及路由干预进一步验证了耦合与问题条件视觉访问的价值。
AI.conclusion: 问题条件化的路由视觉接口是提升稀疏 VLM 的关键架构设计，耦合视觉深度选择与语言计算可有效增强视觉语言模型的性能。

title: Compositional Objectives: Learning Structure in Structure
summary: Intelligence is defined in many ways. One of these definitions defines intelligence as the pursuit of learnable novelty. However, learnable novelty can be meaningless without the ability to compose the learned structures to take action and achieve goals. Learnable novelty builds on epiplexity, which is a way to measure learnable structure in data through a bounded observer. In this paper, we investigate a closed-form spectral approximation to compute epiplexity. We use a fixed-trace constraint and find that the epiplexity objective prefers a more uniform distribution of spectral mass rather than concentrating it in a small number of directions. However, a representation may spread information across many directions without organizing that information into features useful for a particular task. To address this gap, we propose a compositional objective whose observer measures the relationships between the parts and interactions of an image. We compare it with the original spectral objective given only the masked parts. In our ImageNet training runs, the spectral objective with masked parts produces an almost maximally spread representation while achieving the strongest frozen-feature classification performance on most evaluations, more than doubling the linear-probe accuracy of the whole-image baseline. Across multiple image benchmarks, changing what the observer sees matters more than adding relation and interaction tokens. At the same time, our prediction-oriented compositional objective produces substantially better held-out observer prediction but relatively weaker classification, revealing that spectral diversity, predictability, and downstream utility are distinct properties. These results suggest that the usefulness of spectral spreading depends not only on how much structure is preserved, but on which relationships the observer makes available to the objective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究epiplexity的闭式谱近似，提出固定迹约束下的谱目标及其组合目标，并在ImageNet等基准上探究谱多样性、可预测性与下游效用之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 智能可被定义为对"可学习新颖性"的追求，但学习到的结构需要能被组合以采取行动、达成目标。epiplexity通过有界观测者度量数据中的可学习结构。作者希望探究如何用闭式谱近似计算epiplexity，以及表示能否被组织成对特定任务有用的特征，从而厘清谱多样性、可预测性与下游效用之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用固定迹约束的闭式谱近似来近似epiplexity；发现该目标偏好将谱质量更均匀地分布于众多方向而非集中于少数方向。据此提出一个组合目标，其观测者度量图像各部分之间的关系与交互，并与仅给定masked部分的原始谱目标进行对比。
AI.result: 在ImageNet训练中，masked部分的谱目标产生几乎最大程度分散的表示，并在多数评测上取得最强的冻结特征分类性能，线性探针精度较整图基线提升一倍以上。在多个图像基准上，改变观测者所见内容比加入关系与交互token更重要。预测导向的组合目标在留出观测者预测上显著更好，但分类性能相对较弱。
AI.conclusion: 谱多样性、可预测性与下游效用是彼此不同的性质。谱扩散的有用性不仅取决于保留了多少结构，还取决于观测者向目标暴露了哪些关系。

title: $T^5$: Twin-Critic Training for Token-Level Thoughts in Reinforcement Mid-Training
summary: Reinforcement mid-training lets language models learn internal thoughts from unlabeled text, but efficient token-level credit assignment remains challenging. Existing group-relative methods require costly repeated generation. Learned critics offer single-rollout feedback, but accurate return prediction alone does not ensure reliable policy updates. Our analysis shows how training--inference mismatch and PPO clipping prevent a common offset in advantage estimates from cancelling out, introducing additional update drift. We propose \tfour{}, a twin-critic method that calibrates token-level advantages from a single generated trajectory. After warmup and held-out qualification, the critics provide two advantage estimates, combined using action-dependent weights learned through a conditional-moment saddle-point objective. This objective brings the average advantage at each prefix toward zero, while a signal-retention constraint prevents the correction from erasing the learning signal. Sharing information across text positions avoids repeated sampling of each prefix. Theoretically, we characterize optimal mixing under the signal-retention constraint and establish an upper bound on residual mean-induced drift. Experiments show that, compared with the state-of-the-art critic-free method, \tfour{} improves mean benchmark performance by 7.8\% and reduces mean training-step time by up to 63.4\%.

AI.tldr: 提出 twin-critic 方法 TFour，用单次生成轨迹校准 token 级优势，解决强化中等训练中的信用分配问题，性能提升 7.8%、训练时间最多降低 63.4%。
AI.motivation: 强化中等训练让语言模型从无标注文本学习内部思维，但 token 级信用分配困难：组相对方法需反复生成代价高；学习式 critic 虽单次 rollout 反馈，但准确预测回报不足以保证可靠策略更新。作者分析发现训练-推理不匹配与 PPO 裁剪使优势估计中的共同偏移无法抵消，引入额外更新漂移。
AI.method: TFour 为 twin-critic 方法：warmup 与留出验证后，两个 critic 提供两个优势估计，通过条件矩鞍点目标学习动作相关权重进行组合。该目标使每个前缀的平均优势趋于零，同时用信号保留约束防止修正抹除学习信号；跨文本位置共享信息以避免重复采样同一前缀。
AI.result: 相较最优的 critic-free 方法，TFour 平均基准性能提升 7.8%，平均每训练步时间最多减少 63.4%。理论上刻画了信号保留约束下的最优混合，并给出残余均值致漂移的上界。
AI.conclusion: TFour 通过双 critic 校准单轨迹 token 级优势，在保证学习信号的同时降低更新漂移，兼具性能与效率优势，并为优势混合提供理论保证。

title: Unknown is not normal: separating language-model extraction from rule-based decision logic for clinical risk scores
comment: 14 pages (7 of main text), 5 figures, 2 tables, appendix included; full supplementary material in the code repository. Code: https://github.com/nicoveraz/calc-bounds (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004726)
