summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to compute clinical risk scores from free-text notes. Notes are often incomplete, and treating undocumented findings as normal can silently misclassify patients. We test whether separating three-state extraction (present, absent or unknown, by an LLM) from decision logic (deterministic code computing score bounds over unknown inputs) lets a system ask only questions that can change the decision. On 1,200 synthetic emergency cases across six calculators (HEART, CURB-65, qSOFA, PERC, Wells, Cockcroft-Gault), with a simulated clinician answering questions, we compared this bounds policy with asking for every missing input, a missing-equals-normal schema, and an end-to-end LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5). With Claude Haiku 4.5 as extractor, the bounds policy matched ask-all accuracy (99.4% vs 99.4%) with half the questions (0.92 vs 1.78 per case) and no irrelevant ones. Treating missing as normal dropped accuracy to 91.2% and under-triaged 8.5% of patients (95% CI 7.1-10.2), and under-triage persisted under messy notes and a noisy clinician. The agent was equally accurate under ideal conditions (99.6%) but 9.5% of its questions were irrelevant; with a noisy clinician it was less accurate than the bounds policy (83.5% vs 87.0%, p<0.001) and committed prematurely in 2.7% of cases (bounds: 0%). A 9B local model as extractor reached oracle-level accuracy (99.8%). In 584 real case reports from MedCalc-Bench, only 52% contained enough information to determine the category (HEART 13%). Routing decisions through code that reasons explicitly about unknowns avoids premature commitment and irrelevant questions, halves the questions asked, and works with small local models.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出将三态信息抽取（存在/不存在/未知）与确定性决策逻辑分离，仅对能改变决策的未知项提问，在六个临床评分计算器上验证该方法能以一半提问量达到最高准确率，且远优于"缺失即正常"和端到端LLM agent。
AI.motivation: 临床文本记录常不完整，将未记录项默认为"正常"会静默误分类患者。需要一种既能处理不确定性、又避免询问无关问题、避免过早决策的方法。
AI.method: 将三态抽取（present/absent/unknown，由LLM完成）与决策逻辑（确定性代码计算未知输入下的分数边界）分离。在1,200个合成急诊病例、六种计算器（HEART、CURB-65、qSOFA、PERC、Wells、Cockcroft-Gault）上，对比边界策略、全提问、缺失即正常、端到端LLM agent（Claude Opus 5.5）；抽取器用Claude Haiku 4.5及一个9B本地模型，并模拟临床医生答题（含噪声条件）。
AI.result: 边界策略准确率99.4%，与全提问持平，但提问数减半（0.92 vs 1.78/例），无无关问题；缺失即正常准确率降至91.2%，8.5%患者被低分诊（95% CI 7.1-10.2）。端到端agent理想条件下99.6%，但9.5%提问无关；噪声下不如边界策略（83.5% vs 87.0%，p<0.001），2.7%过早决策（边界为0%）。9B本地模型达99.8%。584份MedCalc-Bench真实报告中仅52%含足以判定分类的信息（HEART仅13%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式推理未知项的代码来路由决策，可避免过早决策和无关提问、将提问量减半，并能配合小型本地模型工作。

title: CT-OPD: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
summary: Diffusion vision-language models generate answers by gradually resolving masked tokens, making accurate conditional prediction in partially resolved states central to post-training. Masking completed answers yields coherent contexts and targets, but prescribed masks do not reflect the model's reveal decisions. Its trajectories capture these decisions, yet their provisional visible tokens can conflict with the target response. Outcome-based reinforcement learning follows these trajectories but provides only response-level feedback, which loses contrast when sampled rewards tie. To align coherent token-level supervision with the model's reveal decisions, we introduce Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD), which combines completed teacher responses with trajectory masks from the current student. CT-OPD retokenizes each teacher response in the student's vocabulary and extracts unresolved-position masks at successive stages of the student's reverse process. For each mask, it discards provisional rollout values and reconstructs the partial state from the teacher endpoint, so the supervised positions follow the current trajectory while the visible context and targets remain consistent with the same response. The student is trained on these reconstructed states with its native categorical loss, and trajectories are refreshed as the model evolves. Across dense and sparse diffusion architectures, CT-OPD consistently enhances multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, with gains of up to 9.80 points on the nine-benchmark average. On the unified understanding-and-generation architecture, it also improves both visual understanding and image generation, showing that the same principle transfers across architectures and modalities. Ablations further attribute these gains to coherent reconstruction and current-model trajectory masks.

AI.tldr: 提出CT-OPD方法，将完整教师回答与当前学生轨迹掩码结合，实现连贯的token级监督，提升扩散视觉语言模型的理解与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散VLM通过逐步解掩码生成答案，掩码式监督或仅依赖结果级反馈的强化学习难以与模型的揭示决策对齐，导致监督信号不一致或对比度不足。
AI.method: CT-OPD按学生词表重tokenize教师回答，在学生反向过程各阶段提取未解位掩码；对每个掩码丢弃临时rollout值，从教师端点重建部分状态，使监督位置跟随当前轨迹而上下文与目标保持一致，用原生分类损失训练，并随模型演化刷新轨迹。
AI.result: 在密集与稀疏扩散架构上均持续提升多模态理解与推理，九基准平均最高提升9.80分；在统一理解与生成架构上同时改善视觉理解与图像生成；消融证实增益源于连贯重建与当前模型轨迹掩码。
AI.conclusion: CT-OPD通过对齐连贯token级监督与模型揭示决策，跨架构、跨模态有效，为扩散VLM后训练提供了通用原则。

title: CAESAR: Clustering via Autonomous Embedding-Space Agglomerative Reorganization
summary: Clustering algorithms that operate on nearest-neighbor graphs, such as FINCH (First Integer Neighbor Clustering Hierarchy), depend heavily on the quality of the embedding space they are given. However, pretrained vision and language model embeddings are not optimized for this purpose. We propose CAESAR, a method that reorganizes a pretrained embedding space: a reorganization network is trained to pull mutual nearest neighbors together and push non-neighbors apart, yielding a reorganized embedding space substantially better suited to clustering. CAESAR offers a second major advantage: it never requires the number of clusters $K$. This matters because in realistic unsupervised settings, $K$ is typically unknown and discovering it is often part of the problem, yet most strong clustering methods take it as an input. We therefore design the entire CAESAR pipeline to infer $K$ rather than assume it is known. Empirically, reorganizing the embeddings consistently improves clustering over the raw space on both text and image datasets. Since the few deep clustering methods that also infer $K$ do not release their code, we complement controlled comparisons with methods that infer $K$ on the same embedding space by comparisons with strong deep clustering methods that are given the true $K$, giving them a substantial oracle advantage. Even so, CAESAR outperforms all of them on text, achieves the best results on the most challenging image benchmark and remains competitive on the others. Reorganizing pretrained embeddings thus emerges as a simple and powerful route to clustering realistic data, where classes overlap and the number of clusters is unknown.

AI.tldr: 提出CAESAR，通过重新组织预训练嵌入空间（拉近互为最近邻的点、推远非邻居）使其更适合聚类，且全程无需预设簇数K，能自行推断K。
AI.motivation: 基于最近邻图的聚类算法（如FINCH）严重依赖嵌入空间质量，但预训练视觉/语言模型的嵌入并非为聚类优化；同时现实无监督场景中簇数K通常未知却常被大多数强聚类方法当作输入。
AI.method: 训练一个重组网络，将互为最近邻的样本拉近、非邻居推远，得到更适合聚类的嵌入空间；整个CAESAR流程被设计为推断K而非假设K已知。
AI.result: 在文本和图像数据集上，重组嵌入一致优于原始嵌入。相比也推断K的深度聚类方法（其未公开代码，故做受控比较），并与给定真实K、享有oracle优势的强深度聚类方法对比：CAESAR在文本上全面胜出，在最困难图像基准上最佳，其余也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 重组预训练嵌入是一种简单而强大的路径，可用于类别重叠且簇数未知的现实数据聚类。

title: AgentHabit: Characterizing Distinct Behaviors of Agents on Everyday Tasks
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents assist users with everyday tasks that can be completed in many reasonable ways. Even when their answers are useful, how agents carry out these tasks may not match users' preferences and needs. For example, agents differ in whether they ask clarifying questions or search the web. We introduce HABIT, a taxonomy of 23 behavioral axes in five categories, which three authors and three LLMs derive bottom-up from 408 agent trajectories across 17 domains. On held-out tasks, HABIT distinguishes models more clearly than existing taxonomies of human values and agent actions while supporting comparably consistent annotation. Building on HABIT, we construct AgentHABIT, a benchmark that profiles each agent's behavioral tendencies from its trajectories on 86 everyday tasks. Profiling 18 models with AgentHABIT reveals a range of distinctive tendencies. For example, most GPT and Claude models state their assumptions and offer alternatives when requirements conflict, whereas Qwen and Google's models more often leave assumptions or changes to requirements unstated. These profiles remain recognizable even when built from entirely different sets of tasks, indicating that they reflect general tendencies rather than task-specific behavior. Prompting agents to adopt specific behaviors shifts some axes readily but barely changes others, while fine-tuning on another model's trajectories changes only part of a model's profile and leaves much of it intact. Overall, HABIT and AgentHABIT provide a systematic framework for characterizing how agents carry out everyday tasks beyond task success, offering insights to guide the development of agents whose behavior better fits users' needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HABIT行为分类体系与AgentHABIT基准，从轨迹中刻画LLM智能体在完成日常任务时的行为倾向。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体完成任务的方式多样，即使答案有用，其行为方式也可能不符合用户偏好，而现有分类体系难以清晰区分这些行为倾向。
AI.method: 基于17个领域、408条轨迹自下而上提炼出23个行为轴、5大类；据此构建AgentHABIT基准，通过86个日常任务轨迹对18个模型进行行为画像，并测试跨任务一致性、提示与微调的干预效果。
AI.result: HABIT比现有人类价值与智能体行为分类体系更能区分模型；不同模型呈现独特倾向（如GPT/Claude常陈述假设并给替代方案，Qwen/Google常不说明假设）；画像跨任务稳定，提示可改变部分轴，微调仅改变部分画像。
AI.conclusion: HABIT与AgentHABIT提供了超越任务成功率、系统刻画智能体行为方式的框架，有助于开发更符合用户需求的智能体。

title: Understanding Clinical Cognitive Dialogues Using Large Language Models
summary: In-person cognitive assessment is both a test and an interaction. Clinicians explain tasks, repair misunderstandings, and adapt to patient responses, while patients may hesitate, seek clarification, or disengage. Yet clinical dialogue resources rarely label the interaction structure needed to study these behaviors at scale. We present an de-identified corpus of 33 cognitive assessment conversations with 8,250 utterances annotated for three speaker roles and 56 dialogue acts. We use this corpus to benchmark large language models on fine-grained dialogue-act classification and next-patient-utterance generation. We also test whether out-of-domain instruction data and explanation-augmented training transfer to this clinical setting. Instruction tuning produces the strongest patient-utterance reference matching and improves classification accuracy. Reasoning-aware fine-tuning produces the strongest classification results among the LLaMA-3.1-8B variants. However, even the best models struggle to separate closely related dialogue acts, showing that broad conversational intent is easier to recognize than fine-grained communicative function. The corpus and benchmark make interaction structure measurable in cognitive assessments and support follow-up work on conversational markers, clinician education, and carefully validated simulated patients. This work does not make diagnostic claims. Instead, it provides the data and evaluation framework needed to study these applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了一个包含33段认知评估对话、8250条话语的匿名语料库，标注了3种说话者角色与56种对话行为，并用于评测大语言模型在细粒度对话行为分类和下一句患者话语生成上的表现。
AI.motivation: 面对面认知评估既是测试也是互动，临床医生会解释任务、修正误解、适应患者反应，患者也会犹豫、寻求澄清或退出。然而临床对话资源很少标注这种互动结构，难以大规模研究这些行为。
AI.method: 构建匿名语料库（33段对话、8250条话语、3种角色、56种对话行为）；用该语料库对大型语言模型进行细粒度对话行为分类与下一句患者话语生成的基准测试；并测试域外指令数据与解释增强训练能否迁移到该临床场景。
AI.result: 指令微调在患者话语参考匹配上表现最好，并提升分类准确率；推理感知微调在LLaMA-3.1-8B变体中分类结果最强；但即使最佳模型也难以区分相近的对话行为，说明粗略会话意图比细粒度交际功能更易识别。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库与基准使认知评估中的互动结构变得可测量，支持会话标记、临床医生教育及经严格验证的模拟患者等后续研究。本工作不作诊断性声明，而是提供研究这些应用所需的数据与评估框架。

title: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Compression of Implicit Geometric Representations for Large-Scale Point Clouds
summary: Large-scale point cloud representations of complex geome tries incur prohibitive computational and memory costs, necessitating compressed implicit representations. To ad dress this, we propose a unified framework comprising im plicit geometric field representation, hierarchical frequency domain compression, and conditional high-frequency predic tion. Specifically, an unordered point cloud is mapped to an implicit field defined within its physical bounding box. A smooth Fourier pyramid is then constructed, where com pact low-frequency components capture the global geometry. Inter-scale high-frequency residuals are encoded to preserve the spatial information required for reconstructing fine geo metric details. To restore the high-frequency information lost during compression, we develop a hierarchical 3D neural net work. The reconstructed implicit field is converted back into a point cloud through isosurface extraction. Experiments on a complex-boundary point cloud with more than eight mil lion points demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a higher compression ratio than existing point cloud compres sion methods while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架：隐式几何场表示+层次频域压缩+条件高频预测，实现大尺度点云高压缩比压缩。
AI.motivation: 大规模复杂几何点云的显式表示计算与内存开销巨大，需压缩的隐式表示。
AI.method: 1) 将无序点云映射到物理包围盒内的隐式场；2) 构建平滑傅里叶金字塔，低频分量捕获全局几何，跨尺度高频残差编码细节；3) 用层次3D神经网络恢复压缩丢失的高频信息；4) 通过等值面提取还原点云。
AI.result: 在超800万点的复杂边界点云上，压缩比高于现有点云压缩方法，重建质量相当。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持可比重建质量的同时实现更高压缩比，适用于大规模复杂点云。

title: Trapped by Their Own Rollouts: Understanding Aggregation--Rollout Feedback in Federated On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach to language-model adaptation, aligning teacher supervision with the student's own generated trajectories. When adaptation prompts are distributed across clients, can this process benefit from federated collaboration? We study federated OPD and find that substantial collaboration gains can be obscured by learning-rate sensitivity: FedAvg can perform no better than independent local training at a small learning rate, yet recover a clear advantage at a larger rate. We explain this phenomenon through the student's dual role as learner and generator of future training data. An aggregation-induced optimization lag can delay access to useful teacher supervision, which in turn slows subsequent learning. Our theory establishes this aggregation--rollout feedback in a solvable model with a common optimum and stable updates, and identifies two coupled roles of learning rate: learning from current supervision and reaching future supervision. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedTOPS (Federated Teacher-guided On-Policy Scaling), which reuses teacher feedback on current trajectories to adapt the FedAvg update magnitude under clientwise predictive-change constraints. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, FedTOPS improves macro Avg@8 over FedAvg by 4.56--14.57 percentage points across the evaluated student models and local learning rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究联邦在线策略蒸馏（Federated OPD），发现FedAvg的协作增益会被学习率敏感性掩盖：小学习率下FedAvg不优于独立训练，大学习率下才有明显优势。作者从学生模型"学习者+数据生成者"双重角色出发提出"聚合-rollout反馈"理论，并据此设计FedTOPS方法以自适应调整FedAvg更新幅度，在六个数学推理基准上比FedAvg提升4.56–14.57个百分点。
AI.motivation: 联邦场景下，当适配提示分布在多个客户端时，OPD能否从联邦协作中获益尚不明确。作者发现协作增益被学习率敏感性所掩盖：小学习率下FedAvg与独立本地训练相当，仅在大学习率下才显现优势。因此需要解释这一现象并提出缓解方法。
AI.method: 作者分析学生模型兼具"学习者"和"未来训练数据生成者"的双重角色，提出"聚合引发的优化滞后"（aggregation-induced optimization lag）机制：聚合延迟了获得有用教师监督的时机，进而拖慢后续学习。在一个具有共同最优解和稳定更新的可解模型中，理论刻画了"聚合–rollout反馈"。据此提出FedTOPS（Federated Teacher-guided On-Policy Scaling），利用当前轨迹上的教师反馈，在客户端级预测变化约束下自适应调整FedAvg更新幅度。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准上，针对所评估的学生模型和本地学习率，FedTOPS将宏观Avg@8相比FedAvg提升4.56–14.57个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 联邦OPD的协作增益存在学习率敏感性，其根源在于聚合引起的优化滞后与rollout反馈的耦合。理论识别出学习率的两个耦合作用：从当前监督中学习与抵达未来监督。FedTOPS通过复用教师反馈自适应缩放更新幅度，有效释放了联邦协作的收益。

title: PlanGuard: A Guardrail for Multi-Step Plan Safety in Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied task planners may produce multi-step plans whose subtask dependencies and interactions with the environment create physical risks during execution. Yet existing safeguards overlook such compositional risks, as general-purpose guardrails focus on semantic harm and embodied safety detectors assess subtasks in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce PlanGuard, the first pre-execution detector that evaluates the physical safety of a complete multi-step plan in its current environment. For training and evaluation, we construct a Multi-Step Plan Safety (MSP-Safe) dataset through paired task construction, plan generation using diverse planners, and safety annotation by three judges. Task-oriented SFT on MSP-Safe establishes fundamental plan-safety assessment capabilities, yet a substantial gap remains between compact models suitable for real-time deployment and stronger but costlier large models. Accordingly, we propose Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation (STAC-OPD), which provides compact models with adaptive strong-teacher supervision along their on-policy trajectories. It combines token-level distribution transfer from a fine-tuned strong teacher with probability-routed sequence-level compensation, retaining student-generated targets when the student favors the reference safety decision and using teacher-reconstructed targets otherwise. Across all test subsets, PlanGuard-2B achieves average 87.15% ACC and 87.21% F1, demonstrating effective whole-plan physical-risk detection at compact model scale. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: PlanGuard 是首个在执行前评估完整多步计划物理安全性的检测器，通过 MSP-Safe 数据集和 STAC-OPD 蒸馏方法，使 2B 小型模型达到平均 87.15% ACC 与 87.21% F1。
AI.motivation: 具身任务规划器生成的多步计划中，子任务依赖与环境交互会带来组合性物理风险，而现有安全防护（通用语义护栏、单子任务评估器）忽视了这种组合风险，存在空白。
AI.method: 构建 MSP-Safe 数据集（配对任务构建、多规划器生成、三评委安全标注）；用任务导向 SFT 建立基础评估能力；提出 STAC-OPD，结合强教师的 token 级分布迁移与概率路由的序列级补偿，在 on-policy 轨迹上为学生模型提供自适应监督。
AI.result: PlanGuard-2B 在所有测试子集上平均达 87.15% ACC 和 87.21% F1，证明紧凑模型规模下可有效进行整计划物理风险检测。
AI.conclusion: PlanGuard 填补了多步计划组合性物理风险检测的空白，STAC-OPD 有效缩小紧凑模型与大型模型间的差距，实现可实时部署的整计划安全检测。

title: Word Similarity Datasets for Indian Languages: Annotation and Baseline Systems
summary: With the advent of word representations, word similarity tasks are becoming increasing popular as an evaluation metric for the quality of the representations. In this paper, we present manually annotated monolingual word similarity datasets of six Indian languages - Urdu, Telugu, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil and Gujarati. These languages are most spoken Indian languages worldwide after Hindi and Bengali. For the construction of these datasets, our approach relies on translation and re-annotation of word similarity datasets of English. We also present baseline scores for word representation models using state-of-the-art techniques for Urdu, Telugu and Marathi by evaluating them on newly created word similarity datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了六种印度语言（乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语和古吉拉特语）的人工标注单词相似度数据集，基于英文数据集的翻译与重标注，并给出乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语上词表示模型的基线得分。
AI.motivation: 随着词表示（word representations）的发展，词相似度任务成为评估表示质量的重要指标，但印度语言缺乏此类人工标注数据集。
AI.method: 通过翻译英文词相似度数据集并进行重标注，为六种印度语言构建单语词相似度数据集；随后在新数据集上评估最先进的词表示模型。
AI.result: 发布了六种印度语言的人工标注词相似度数据集，并提供乌尔都语、泰卢固语、马拉地语上词表示模型的基线得分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了印度语言词相似度评测资源的空白，为后续词表示研究提供基准。

title: Latent Space Is Not Flat: Rethinking Latent Structure for 3D Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Latent generative models make 3D medical image synthesis computationally practical by generating in a compressed space. However, we show that the common flat Euclidean assumption induced by $\ell_2$ objectives is imprecise: latent-space geometry is so strongly anisotropic that equal-magnitude errors can produce drastically different decoded distortions. We further find that this anisotropy has a clear feature: sensitive variation concentrates in a low-rank subspace. The dominant low-rank components capture the overall structure, encoding long-range, spatially coordinated variation while remaining resistant to local noise. Its orthogonal residual, in contrast, mainly captures local and image-specific variation. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Latent Structure Flow (LSF). At each block, LSF decomposes the latent state into structure and residual, models structural changes with global context, and predicts residual variation locally while preserving a direct path for the input structure. LSF changes only the generator, leaving the frozen codec and pointwise training objective unchanged. Across cross-modality synthesis and tumor inpainting tasks, LSF outperforms all compared baselines on both global and tumor-specific metrics, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling latent-space structure for 3D medical image synthesis.

AI.tldr: LSF通过将潜空间分解为低秩结构子空间与正交残差，显式建模几何各向异性，仅改生成器即提升3D医学图像合成质量。
AI.motivation: 潜生成模型在压缩空间合成3D医学图像，但ℓ2目标隐含的平坦欧氏假设不准确：潜空间几何高度各向异性，等幅误差会导致差异极大的解码失真。作者发现这种各向异性具有明确特征——敏感变化集中于低秩子空间。
AI.method: 提出Latent Structure Flow (LSF)：每个block将潜状态分解为结构与残差，用全局上下文建模结构变化，局部预测残差变化，并为输入结构保留直接路径。仅修改生成器，冻结codec与逐点训练目标不变。
AI.result: 在跨模态合成与肿瘤修复任务上，LSF在全局指标和肿瘤特定指标上均优于所有对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模潜空间结构（低秩结构分量编码长程协调变化、残差编码局部细节）对3D医学图像合成有显著收益。

title: DimPO: Dimensionality Reduction for Attention using Preference Optimization
summary: A linear projection can reduce the dimension of query and key vectors without updating the pretrained model, but it remains unclear which training objective best preserves model behavior. We ask whether preferences over keys and attention mass on the highest-weighted keys provide a better signal than matching the full attention distribution with KL divergence, especially in long-context settings. We introduce DimPO, which combines listwise preference optimization with a lightweight top-k cross-entropy term for head-fidelity. DimPO is trained offline from the attention patterns of a frozen language model, with one map per layer, shared by the query and the keys and trained separately from the other layers. Across LLaMA3.2-3B, LLaMA3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Qwen3-4B Instruct models, pairwise preference objectives outperform the triplet baseline and retain 98% of the original score on short-context tasks when projecting to half the dimension on the last 40% of the layers. With more projected layers or on long-context RULER, they degrade rapidly. In contrast, KL and DimPO, which use every key during training, retain about 95% of the original RULER 4k score on the 8B model when projecting up to 50% of the layers. KL-based projections remain closer to the original attention distribution and attention output, yet DimPO achieves better downstream performance. Beyond 50% of projected layers, DimPO increasingly outperforms KL on tasks including SQuAD, common-word extraction, frequent-word extraction, and variable tracking. These results suggest that under dimensionality reduction, preserving the ordering and concentration of task-relevant attention can matter more than reproducing the full attention distribution.

AI.tldr: DimPO用列表偏好优化配合top-k交叉熵，在投影降维下比KL更好保留长上下文下游性能。
AI.motivation: 线性投影可降低query/key维度而不更新预训练模型，但何种训练目标最能保持模型行为尚不明确，尤其是长上下文场景。
AI.method: DimPO结合listwise偏好优化与轻量top-k交叉熵项以保持头部保真度；从冻结模型的注意力模式离线训练，每层一个映射，query与key共享，逐层独立训练。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3.2-3B、LLaMA3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B上，成对偏好目标优于三元组基线，投影最后40%层至半维时短上下文保留98%得分；KL和DimPO在8B上投影达50%层时保留约95%的RULER 4k得分；超过50%后DimPO在SQuAD等任务上愈发优于KL。
AI.conclusion: 在降维下，保持任务相关注意力的排序与集中度可能比复现完整注意力分布更重要。

title: Re-derivability Decides What a Staged Agent Pipeline Recovers After an Upstream Fault
comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables; preprint under review
summary: One variable sets what an upstream fault costs a staged pipeline of language-model agents: re-derivability, how much of what a stage needs it can rebuild from the original problem. Grounding an inspector agent in that problem is worth +0.608 [+0.517, +0.700] to +0.358 over a blind one on four open-weight backbones served with thinking disabled, and on the two Qwen backbones the blind inspector changes no item at all. That head-to-head is exploratory. One deterministic fault enters the first stage, and we re-expose the original problem to $k = 0,\dots,3$ of the downstream stages with agents, items, fault and topology held fixed, on 120 gsm_hard items per arm at temperature zero. Accuracy under fault rises on four of four backbones, from +0.233 to +0.392, the largest Holm-adjusted $p$ being $2.1\times10^{-6}$. A registered kill test rules out tokens. Blanking every word holds the word slots fixed, and retention tracks the visible fraction on four of four, climbing from 0.221 to 0.692 on the primary. Those two families are confirmatory and everything else here is exploratory. The interaction excludes zero on two of four backbones under the registered pipeline, four of four under a three-stage pipeline, and three of four under full message history, the primary at +0.317. On Llama-3.1-8B the fault carries no detectable cost at any dose, so the other three carry every claim about what a fault costs. Re-derivability also sets what the architecture costs, and no decomposition we measured reliably beats one direct call. With no fault injected the registered pipeline loses to that call by -0.267, -0.125 and -0.317, and on Phi-4 reads +0.058 at $p = 0.118$, which the test fails to separate from zero. The repair that works is cheap and front-loaded: the first re-grounded stage buys +0.394 of matched retention for +59.8 tokens per item on Qwen3-14B, and the stages after it buy nothing.

AI.tldr: 上游故障对语言模型智能体流水线的代价由"可再推导性"决定：将检查智能体接地到原问题可显著提升故障下准确率，且修复廉价、前置；但无故障时分解架构不如单次直接调用。
AI.motivation: 探究一个变量——可再推导性（重推导能力）——如何决定上游故障对分级语言模型智能体流水线的代价，以及架构本身的开销来源。
AI.method: 在第一阶段注入确定性故障，将原问题重新暴露给k=0..3个下游阶段（智能体、条目、故障、拓扑固定），在120条gsm_hard条目、温度零下测试。设置注册的杀死测试排除token影响；通过屏蔽所有词汇固定词槽。比较接地检查智能体与盲检查智能体（4个开放权重骨干，禁用思考）。
AI.result: 故障下准确率在4/4骨干上升（+0.233至+0.392，最大Holm校正p=2.1e-6）。接地检查智能体比盲检查智能体高+0.608[+0.517,+0.700]至+0.358。保留率随可见比例上升（0.221至0.692，主实验）。交互项在2/4（注册流水线）、4/4（三阶段）、3/4（全消息历史）骨干上排除零。无故障时注册流水线落后单次直接调用（-0.267、-0.125、-0.317）。首个重接地阶段买入+0.394匹配保留率，代价+59.8 token/条（Qwen3-14B），后续阶段无收益。Llama-3.1-8B上故障无检测到代价。
AI.conclusion: 可再推导性同时决定故障代价与架构代价；修复有效但前置，后续阶段冗余；分解架构无故障时不如单次直接调用。

title: Quantitative Measurement of Language Distance among Closely Related Indo-European Languages Using Pretrained Language Models: A Case Study on the North Germanic Branch
summary: Among closely related North Germanic languages, the quantification of language distance has traditionally relied on qualitative methods, lacking a unified multi-dimensional computational framework. Multilingual pretrained models based on the Transformer architecture can map texts from different languages into a shared vector space, enabling quantitative measurement of language distance. This paper focuses on the three North Germanic languages---Danish, Norwegian (Bokmål), and Swedish---and proposes a three-metric quantitative framework based on pretrained language models: (1)~sentence-level semantic distance, computed as cosine similarity between LaBSE and mBERT encodings of parallel sentences; (2)~orthographic fragmentation rate, measuring subword tokenization efficiency when cross-applying monolingual BERT vocabularies to parallel texts; (3)~MLM predictability, comparing prediction confidence and entropy in masked language modeling using mBERT across languages. Using 150 trilingual parallel sentence triplets from the Tatoeba corpus as controlled samples, we obtain consistent distance rankings on two independent models: LaBSE: da--no $0.012 < $ no--sv $0.016 < $ da--sv $0.020$; mBERT: da--no $0.016 < $ no--sv $0.045 \approx $ da--sv $0.046$. This ranking is consistent with the historical linguistic conclusion that ``400 years of Danish rule over Norway (1380--1814) led to highly cognate written languages.'' The three metrics---semantic, orthographic, and predictability---converge on the same conclusion, providing a reproducible computational framework for the quantitative study of distance among closely related languages, extensible in principle to more branches of the Indo-European language family, pending validation on additional language groups.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于预训练语言模型的三种度量框架（语义距离、正字法碎片化率、MLM可预测性），量化丹麦语、挪威语（书面语）和瑞典语之间的距离，结果一致显示丹-挪最近。
AI.motivation: 传统上北日耳曼语系内语言距离的量化依赖定性方法，缺乏统一的多维计算框架。
AI.method: 基于LaBSE和mBERT计算平行句余弦相似度（语义距离）；用单语BERT词表交叉分词衡量正字法碎片化率；用mBERT的MLM预测置信度与熵衡量可预测性。使用Tatoeba语料150组三语平行句。
AI.result: LaBSE：da-no 0.012 < no-sv 0.016 < da-sv 0.020；mBERT：da-no 0.016 < no-sv 0.045 ≈ da-sv 0.046。排名与历史语言学结论（丹麦统治挪威400年导致书面语高度同源）一致。
AI.conclusion: 三种度量（语义、正字法、可预测性）收敛于同一结论，为近亲语言距离的定量研究提供可复现的计算框架，原则上可扩展至更多印欧语系分支，尚待在更多语族验证。

title: Progressive Risk Estimation for Accident Anticipation
summary: Accident anticipation aims to recognize anomalous driving cues before a crash while avoiding false alarms during normal driving. Existing approaches typically formulate this task as binary classification, focusing on whether an accident will occur rather than when it will occur. We propose PRE-ACT, a framework that models accident risk as a continuously evolving signal that increases as the crash approaches. By explicitly enforcing temporal ordering and distance-to-accident awareness, our method progressively raises risk while suppressing premature alarms, leading to significant improvements on MM-AU subsets and Nexar. We further introduce a Separation Score to evaluate the global behavior of predicted risk curves beyond local temporal windows. Code and visualizations are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/PRE-ACT.

AI.tldr: 提出PRE-ACT框架，将事故风险建模为随碰撞临近而持续上升的信号，并引入Separation Score评估风险曲线全局行为。
AI.motivation: 现有事故预判方法多将其作为二分类问题，只关注是否会发生事故，而忽略了事故何时发生。
AI.method: 通过显式约束时间顺序与距事故的远近感知，使风险逐步升高并抑制过早告警。
AI.result: 在MM-AU子集和Nexar数据集上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将事故风险建模为连续演化信号并引入全局评估指标，可有效提升事故预判性能。

title: Age of Learning: Temporal Persistence of Prediction Errors as a Learning Signal
summary: Current machine learning algorithms primarily rely on instantaneous signals such as loss, margin, and prediction confidence to characterize model behavior. These signals indicate how difficult a prediction is at the current optimization step, but they do not capture how long the model has remained incorrect. We study this temporal dimension of learning and introduce Age of Learning (AoL), a learning-state variable that measures the persistence of prediction errors over time. AoL increases while an error remains unresolved and resets when a correct prediction is achieved, thereby distinguishing persistent under-learning from transient mistakes. We develop AoL-based training strategies for both offline and streaming settings. In offline learning, sample-level AoL is accumulated over training and aggregated into class-level states that guide adaptive reweighting and resampling. In streaming learning, where full historical access is unavailable, we maintain lightweight class-level AoL states using current and buffered observations. Across long-tailed classification settings, AoL improves or matches standard training baselines, with larger benefits when learning difficulty persists over time. Multi-seed streaming experiments further show reproducible gains under temporally stable imbalance. Analysis of class frequency, loss, and margin shows that AoL is related to conventional difficulty measures but captures additional information about error duration. These results suggest that temporal persistence provides a useful complementary signal for characterizing and controlling learning dynamics in imbalanced and non-stationary environments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Age of Learning (AoL)，一种衡量预测错误持续时间的时序学习状态变量，用于离线与流式长尾分类训练。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习算法主要依赖损失、间隔、预测置信度等瞬时信号刻画模型行为，只能反映当前优化步的预测难度，无法捕捉模型错误持续了多久。论文旨在研究学习的时序维度，区分持续性的欠学习与短暂的错误。
AI.method: AoL在错误未解决时递增，正确预测时重置。离线设置中累积样本级AoL并聚合为类别级状态，指导自适应重加权与重采样；流式设置中利用当前与缓冲观测维护轻量类别级AoL状态。
AI.result: 在长尾分类场景中，AoL提升或匹配标准训练基线，当学习难度持续存在时收益更大。多种子流式实验显示在时间稳定不平衡下具有可复现的增益。
AI.conclusion: AoL与传统难度度量相关但额外捕捉错误持续时间信息，表明时序持续性为不平衡与非平稳环境下的学习动态刻画与控制提供了有用的互补信号。

title: Nutri-ATLAS: Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for Smarter nutrition
summary: Generative and Agentic IoT systems offer a promising foundation for digital healthcare applications that combine sensing, personalized reasoning, and autonomous interaction in real-world environments. Nutrition assistance is a natural use case, but existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems are often limited to passive text interaction and static context, making them unreliable when food descriptions are ambiguous or nutritional evidence is missing. We propose Nutri-ATLAS, an Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for smarter nutrition in the real world. It integrates graph-grounded nutrition reasoning, hardware-aware LLM selection, and robot-based evidence acquisition. Nutri-ATLAS builds a unified Food-Nutrient knowledge graph from USDA FoodData Central and FoodKG and learns 64-dimensional GATv2 food and recipe embeddings. A shared hybrid graph-text scoring mechanism supports food nutrition extraction, nutritional gap filling, substitute retrieval, and recipe-level meal composition, while an LLM-guided skill interface navigates landmarks, updates dietary-context and food-accessibility memory, and grounds recommendations in observed food availability. We evaluate Nutri-ATLAS across nutrient estimation, substitution retrieval, recipe recommendation, patient-profile adherence, edge deployment, and real-world embodied execution. On HealthyFoodSubs, the hybrid retriever achieves 37.9% MAP, 80.7% RR@5, and 90.1% RR@10. On NutriBench v2, Dense+GAT retrieval grounds nutrient estimation across nine quantized Qwen3.5-9B configurations. On PFoodReQ, Nutri-ATLAS reaches 78.8% MAP, 83.0% MAR, and 77.5% F1. A patient-profile study shows adherence to allergy and healthy-target constraints for all selected cases.

AI.tldr: Nutri-ATLAS 是一个具身智能体系统，融合图增强营养推理、硬件感知 LLM 选择与机器人证据采集，用于真实世界的智能营养辅助。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的营养系统多为被动文本交互且上下文静态，在食物描述模糊或营养证据缺失时不可靠。
AI.method: 构建 USDA FoodData Central 与 FoodKG 统一食物-营养知识图谱，学习 64 维 GATv2 食物/食谱嵌入；采用共享混合图-文本打分机制支持营养提取、缺口填补、替代品检索与食谱级配餐；LLM 引导技能接口进行地标导航、饮食上下文与食物可及性记忆更新。
AI.result: HealthyFoodSubs 上混合检索达 37.9% MAP、80.7% RR@5、90.1% RR@10；NutriBench v2 上 Dense+GAT 检索在九种量化 Qwen3.5-9B 配置下支撑营养估计；PFoodReQ 上达 78.8% MAP、83.0% MAR、77.5% F1；患者档案研究中对所有选定案例均遵守过敏与健康目标约束。
AI.conclusion: Nutri-ATLAS 通过图基础推理与具身证据采集，提升了营养辅助系统的可靠性，并验证了边缘部署与真实具身执行的可行性。

title: Toward a Graded Measure of Belief Stability in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people access and reason with information, yet factual reliability is usually evaluated one judgment at a time. We introduce graded belief stability, a relational measure of how well a belief persists within an LLM's broader belief system. Unlike individual belief probability, it asks whether support for a claim persists when that claim is considered alongside the model's other epistemic commitments. We operationalize this idea with a Direct Conditional estimator that uses internal model representations to estimate conditional belief probabilities. Across 12 LLMs and three domains, lower-stability beliefs exhibit greater mean behavioral movement under conversational challenge in 83.3% of model-domain settings after matching on individual belief probability. Graded belief stability therefore extends reliability assessment beyond how strongly an LLM supports a claim to how robustly that belief is supported within its broader system of beliefs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“分级信念稳定性（graded belief stability）”，一种衡量LLM信念在其整体信念体系中持久性的关系型指标，并用直接条件估计器验证其与对抗性对话下行为变化的关系。
AI.motivation: LLM日益成为人们获取与推理信息的媒介，但现有事实可靠性评估通常只针对单个判断，忽略信念是否与模型其他认知承诺相互支持。
AI.method: 提出 graded belief stability，定义为信念在模型整体信念体系中能否持续得到支持；用 Direct Conditional estimator 借助模型内部表征估计条件信念概率；覆盖12个LLM、3个领域，并控制个体信念概率后进行匹配比较。
AI.result: 在83.3%的“模型-领域”设置中，低稳定性信念在对话挑战下表现出更大的平均行为移动。
AI.conclusion: 分级信念稳定性把LLM可靠性评估从“支持某主张的强度”扩展到“该信念在其整体信念体系中受支撑的稳健程度”。

title: USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed to quantitatively evaluate VLM's reasoning capabilities on built environment metrics via remote sensing imagery. USAI-Quant is curated from the 335 largest U.S. cities, aligning high-resolution remote sensing images with quantitative built environment metrics. We then evaluate both general-purpose and remote sensing VLMs (RS-VLMs) by applying VQAs to tens of built environment metrics across three complexity levels. Our results reveal that current state-of-the-art models consistently fall short on numeric reasoning tasks. We further conduct in-depth analyses across models, question types, and geographic locations, uncovering insights into performance variability and task-specific challenges.

AI.tldr: 论文提出USAI-Quant，首个针对遥感影像建筑环境指标的定量推理基准，用于评估视觉语言模型的定量推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感VLM评估多基于定性VQA，缺乏对建筑环境指标定量推理能力的洞察。
AI.method: 从美国335个最大城市构建USAI-Quant，对齐高分辨率遥感影像与定量建筑环境指标，对通用及遥感VLM在数十个指标、三个复杂度层次上进行VQA评估。
AI.result: 当前最先进模型在数值推理任务上持续表现不足；进一步分析揭示模型、问题类型和地理位置的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: USAI-Quant填补了定量推理评估空白，表明VLM在建筑环境指标定量推理上仍有显著挑战。

title: Not Every Term Adds New Structure: Sobolev Novelty for Symbolic Regression
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover compact and meaningful mathematical equations from data, but searching the vast combinatorial space of symbolic structures remains challenging. Existing methods typically guide this process using expression-level objectives, such as fitting error, which assess a candidate equation as a whole but provide little information about whether an individual term contributes genuinely new structure or is largely redundant with the rest of the expression. We introduce \textbf{Sobolev Novelty}, a term-level measure of structural independence for symbolic equations. For each term, we construct an empirical Sobolev signature from its function values and exact derivatives over the observed inputs, and quantify how much of this behavior cannot be reconstructed by the remaining terms. We further derive a theory-calibrated threshold, yielding a principled and tuning-free criterion for identifying structurally novel terms. Using this threshold, 92.6\% of terms in benchmark ground-truth equations exhibit sufficient structural novelty, compared with only 38.3\% on average for expressions produced by 15 SR methods, revealing a substantial gap between scientific equations and current SR solutions. As a lightweight plug-in, Sobolev Novelty can be incorporated into diverse SR paradigms to support term pruning, search guidance, LLM feedback, and data selection, yielding consistent performance gains and demonstrating broad applicability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sobolev Novelty，一种项级别（term-level）的结构独立性度量，通过 Sobolev 签名判断符号表达式中各项是否贡献真正的新结构，并给出无需调参的理论阈值，可作为插件提升多种符号回归方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归方法多用表达式级目标（如拟合误差）引导搜索，无法判断单个项是否带来新结构还是冗余，导致搜索庞大组合空间困难。
AI.method: 对每个项，利用其在观测输入上的函数值与精确导数构造经验 Sobolev 签名，量化该项行为有多少无法被其余项重构；并推导理论校准阈值，形成无需调参的结构新颖性判别准则。
AI.result: 在基准真值方程中，92.6% 的项具有足够结构新颖性；而 15 种符号回归方法生成表达式中平均仅 38.3%，揭示科学方程与现有方法之间的显著差距。
AI.conclusion: Sobolev Novelty 可作为轻量插件融入多种符号回归范式，支持项剪枝、搜索引导、LLM 反馈与数据选择，带来一致性能提升，具有广泛适用性。

title: Decision-Sufficient State Representations: Measuring and Reducing Write-Time Regret
comment: 29 pages (10 main, 17 appendix), 12 figures (4 main, 8 appendix), 18 tables (2 main, 16 appendix)
summary: Long tasks produce more history than an LLM agent can hold in its context, and more than it uses reliably even when the history fits. A growing line of work therefore has agents carry a short written state instead: at every step a writer rewrites the state, and a reader acts from the state alone. Steps stay cheap, but anything the writer drops is lost before later decisions reveal that they need it. We quantify this loss and ask whether training can reduce it. Comparing the written state with the best state of the same size written in hindsight, we split the reader's loss into a budget loss, which any state of that size must incur, and a write-time regret, which comes from the writer's choices. In TextWorld cooking games where we control how long a fact must be carried before it is needed, a 128-token state holding the facts wins nearly every game, while prompted language-model writers win at most 17%. Almost all of the loss is write-time regret, and it grows with the delay. We then train the writer from the reader's own loss. DSSR (decision-sufficient state representations) scores candidate states by how well the reader acts after the writer carries them forward, and teaches the writer to prefer the better ones. This forward-rolled score predicts game outcomes ($ρ= 0.48$), whereas scoring a candidate as a fixed context, as hindsight methods usually do, does not ($ρ\leq 0.07$). On a pre-registered test split opened once, training adds +7.0 [+1.9, +12.2] points of success when facts are needed soon, bringing a plain summary writer to the level of belief- and slot-based memory prompts. The gain shrinks as the delay grows and is significant only at the shortest delay. We trace this limit to credit assignment: keeping a fact now pays off only if every later rewrite keeps it too, which a per-step score cannot see.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了长任务中LLM代理"书面短状态"记忆的损失来源，将其分解为预算损失与写时后悔，并提出DSSR方法，用阅读者的决策损失来训练写作者。
AI.motivation: 长任务历史超出LLM上下文容量，即使放得下也难以可靠利用，因此代理需携带短书面状态；但写作者一旦丢弃信息，后续决策需要时已无法恢复，这种损失此前未被量化。
AI.method: 将书面状态与同尺寸最优事后状态对比，把阅读者损失拆为预算损失（任何同尺寸状态都无法避免）和写时后悔（写作者选择导致）。提出DSSR：用阅读者依据候选状态行动的表现来评分，通过前向滚动得分训练写作者偏好更优状态。
AI.result: 在TextWorld烹饪游戏中，128 token的最优状态几乎全胜，而提示LLM写作者最多赢17%，损失几乎全来自写时后悔且随延迟增长。前向滚动评分可预测游戏结果（ρ=0.48），而事后固定上下文评分不能（ρ≤0.07）。预注册测试中训练带来+7.0[+1.9,+12.2]成功率提升，但仅在最短延迟显著。
AI.conclusion: 训练可减少写时后悔，使普通摘要写作者达到信念/槽位记忆提示水平，但增益随事实需携带延迟增长而衰减。极限源于信用分配：当前保留某事实只有在后续每次重写都保留时才有回报，逐步评分无法捕捉这一点。

title: LLMs are not stochastic parrots: Evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction from conlang-like tasks
summary: The strong version of the stochastic parrot argument claims that, although large language models (LLMs) may exceed rote regurgitation, they cannot move beyond statistical pattern matching into abstraction or reasoning, remaining ontologically near the lower bound of pattern reuse despite producing alluringly fluent text. We test this hypothesis using conlang-like tasks. Several LLMs are given only natural-language descriptions of fictional languages that subvert prominent superficial patterns in training data by combining statistically uncommon and unattested features. Crucially, no example outputs are given. We argue that if the models exhibit rule-following behaviour, they cannot be relying solely on superficial statistical patterns; such patterns often work against the correct output. Instead, successful performance requires representations of the constraints specified in the prompt. Across three complementary task families, models systematically move in the meaning-predicted direction: they distinguish prompt exposure from instructed use, alter semantic relationships in response to novel constraints, and sometimes produce exact matches to complex translation answer keys. Although performance varies across the spectrum of models used, these results provide evidence for meaning-mediated abstraction in LLMs and refute the strong stochastic parrot hypothesis. Our work shows that, under appropriate architectural and contextual constraints, statistical learning can produce meaning-mediated abstractions, although generation remains strongly constrained by superficial plausibility. We discuss implications for model development and for understanding how increasingly abstract representations may emerge from plausible-text-generation objectives.

AI.tldr: 通过人造语言任务测试LLM是否只是统计模式匹配，发现模型能依据含义遵循新规则，反驳强随机鹦鹉假说。
AI.motivation: 强随机鹦鹉假说认为LLM无法超越统计模式匹配，只能停留在模式复用层面，无法实现抽象或推理。
AI.method: 使用类似人造语言的虚构语言任务，仅提供自然语言描述，不提供示例输出，设计的三类任务中表层统计模式常与正确答案相反。
AI.result: 多个LLM系统性地朝含义预测方向作答，能区分提示暴露与指令使用，依据新约束改变语义关系，有时还能精确匹配复杂翻译答案。
AI.conclusion: 在原强随机鹦鹉假说被反驳的基础上，表明在适当架构与语境约束下，统计学习可产生含义中介的抽象，但生成仍受表层合理性强烈限制。

title: Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling
summary: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EGGroW，结合GenusSink与随机特征，高效计算流形/图上的测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离，并应用于3D姿态估计与模板检测。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein距离可用于度量不同度量空间上的分布，应用广泛，但受限于涉及稠密空间内距离矩阵的三次时间复杂度，难以大规模使用。欧氏空间已有可扩展核方法，但一般测地距离（流形）或图上最短路径距离尚缺乏类似技术。
AI.method: 提出EGGroW：一类高效算法，用熵Sinkhorn类方法计算测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离，借助最新GenusSink方法与随机特征理论。下游应用包括3D姿态估计；3D模板检测中，将部分3D模板恢复建模为分阶段问题：先进行容量约束的场景选择，再进行半松弛的模板可见性与对应关系恢复。
AI.result: 实验表明EGGroW在标准欧氏方法失败时仍能给出准确解，且计算开销小，与理论分析一致。
AI.conclusion: EGGroW为一般流形/图上的测地GW距离提供了高效可扩展方案，在3D姿态估计与模板检测等任务中兼具精度与低计算成本。

title: AnchorRep: Defending LLMs Against Cross-Model Adversarial Transfer via Representation Repulsion
comment: NeurIPS 2026; Code, configs and logs: https://github.com/galwert/AnchorRep
summary: Adversarial attacks optimized on a single open-weight LLM can transfer to and jailbreak architecturally different models, allowing an attacker with white-box access to one model to compromise independently deployed systems. This creates a shared vulnerability across models, yet existing defenses are not designed for this cross-model threat. We find that cross-model transfer aligns with shared internal representation geometry, making it a natural defense target. AnchorRep targets this geometry directly with a lightweight LoRA adapter that pushes the defended model's internal representations of harmful prompts away from those of a frozen anchor model on the same prompts. Training uses a small set of harmful prompts and no adversarial examples. Across five models and four architectural families, AnchorRep reduces cross-model attack success rate to <=1.1% on 2,000 transferred attacks (0% on two), including the largest drop on Mistral (36% -> 1.1%). Existing defenses can reduce transfer, but only at high cost either inducing up to 77% degenerate benign output or increasing over-refusal by up to 18%. Because such degenerate benign outputs are not captured by standard refusal-based metrics, we introduce the Benign Garble Rate to quantify them. Our results suggest that cross-model robustness can be achieved by shaping representation geometry, without requiring attack-specific training

AI.tldr: AnchorRep通过轻量LoRA适配器调整被防御模型的内部表征几何，使其偏离冻结锚模型对有害提示的表征，从而在不使用对抗样本的情况下显著降低跨模型迁移攻击成功率（≤1.1%），并提出了Benign Garble Rate来量化退化良性输出。
AI.motivation: 针对单一开源LLM优化的对抗攻击可迁移并越狱架构不同的模型，形成跨模型共享漏洞；而现有防御并未针对这种跨模型威胁设计。
AI.method: 发现跨模型迁移与共享内部表征几何一致，故直接作用于该几何：用轻量LoRA适配器将防御模型对有害提示的内部表征推离冻结锚模型的同提示表征；仅用少量有害提示训练，无需对抗样本。
AI.result: 在5个模型、4个架构家族上，对2000个迁移攻击将成功率降至≤1.1%（其中2个模型为0%），Mistral降幅最大（36%→1.1%）。现有防御虽能降低迁移，但代价高：最多77%退化良性输出或增加18%过度拒绝。因标准拒绝指标未捕捉退化良性输出，提出Benign Garble Rate。
AI.conclusion: 通过塑造表征几何可在无需攻击专用训练的情况下实现跨模型鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Counterfactual Fragility and Demographic Bias in Clinical Evaluation of LLMs
summary: Clinical LLM evaluation often emphasizes answer accuracy; however, accuracy alone does not test counterfactual consistency or demographic robustness. We evaluated six LLMs on 150 MedQA USMLE questions using two automated perturbation tests to assess their performance. The counterfactual validity (CFV) test asked each model to make a minimal, plausible clinical change that would make a different answer correct. The demographic robustness test added six demographic prefixes to the same vignette and compared the answers and explanations with a no demographic baseline. Of the 900 CFV attempts, 228 (25.3 %) were valid and 672 were invalid. Across 5,400 demographic comparisons, 1,097 answers were changed (20.3%). Automated judging identified 3,128 stereotype evidence flags, including 1,932 in the broad Other category. MedGemma 27B achieved the highest accuracy (87.1%) and CFV (63.3%), lowest answer change rate (16.0%), and low mean Explanation Demographic Dissonance (EDD) score (0.169). However, its accuracy still exceeded its CFV, indicating that correct answers do not guarantee reliable performance on the counterfactual validity task. OpenBioLLM had the highest answer change rate and EDD, whereas GLM had the highest stereotype flag rate. These findings show that accuracy, CFV, answer stability, EDD, and stereotype evidence capture different evaluation aspects. Because all judgments were automated and no clinician validation was available, the results support safety screening but do not establish clinical deployability of the model.

AI.tldr: 评估六种LLM在150道MedQA USMLE题上的反事实一致性与人口统计学鲁棒性，发现准确率无法保证反事实有效性与稳健性。
AI.motivation: 临床LLM评估常侧重答案准确率，但准确率无法测试反事实一致性或人口统计学鲁棒性，需补充其他评价维度。
AI.method: 对六种LLM在150道MedQA USMLE题上进行两项自动化扰动测试：反事实有效性（CFV）测试要求模型做最小合理临床改动使另一答案正确；人口统计学鲁棒性测试在相同案例上加入六种人口统计学前缀，与无前缀基线比较答案与解释。
AI.result: 900次CFV尝试中228次（25.3%）有效；5,400次人口统计学比较中1,097次答案改变（20.3%）；识别3,128个刻板印象证据标记。MedGemma 27B准确率最高（87.1%）、CFV最高（63.3%）、答案改变率最低（16.0%）、EDD最低（0.169），但其准确率仍高于CFV。OpenBioLLM答案改变率和EDD最高，GLM刻板印象标记率最高。
AI.conclusion: 准确率、CFV、答案稳定性、EDD与刻板印象证据反映不同评价方面；因判断全自动且无临床医生验证，结果仅支持安全性筛查，不能确立模型临床可部署性。

title: USA: Update-aware SAM for Cross-domain On-Policy Disitllation of Language Agents
summary: On-policy distillation instils multi-turn agentic reasoning through dense token-level supervision on the student's own trajectories, but a single domain saturates early, so further supervision has to be drawn from other domains. Multi-domain data mixing is the most direct way of incorporating them, at the cost of conflicts between their data distributions and of retraining the entire model whenever one domain is revised. Model merging avoids both by distilling every domain independently and fusing the resulting task vectors afterwards. We find instead that the benefit polarizes across domain pairs: on those exhibiting negative transfer, every merging operator we evaluate falls below the single-domain reference. We attribute this to cross-domain update coupling, where a substantial fraction of coordinates is updated comparably by both domains and a merge can therefore displace them by as much as their own updates. To overcome this limitation, we propose USA, which converts per-parameter update magnitudes measured during a brief warm-up into per-coordinate perturbation radii, reducing curvature precisely on the coordinates that carry most of the merging displacement. Experiments across mathematics, science and code at two student scales show USA strongest in all six transfer directions, ahead of the single-domain reference by more than four points on average, and reverse the negative transfer of the conflicting pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多领域on-policy蒸馏中模型合并存在负迁移问题，归因于跨域更新耦合，并提出USA方法通过warm-up阶段的更新幅度构造逐坐标扰动半径来缓解冲突，在六个迁移方向上均超越单域基线。
AI.motivation: 单领域on-policy蒸馏会较早饱和，需要引入其他领域监督。多域数据混合带来分布冲突且单域修改需整体重训，模型合并虽可避免这两点，但在负迁移的领域对上，所有合并算子都低于单域参考。
AI.method: 作者将问题归因于跨域更新耦合：大量坐标被两个领域以相近幅度更新，合并时位移可达其自身更新量。为此提出USA，利用短暂warm-up期间测得的逐参数更新幅度转化为逐坐标扰动半径，从而在合并位移最大的坐标上降低曲率。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、代码三个领域和两个学生规模上，USA在全部六个迁移方向均表现最强，平均超单域参考4分以上，并逆转了冲突领域对的负迁移。
AI.conclusion: USA通过逐坐标扰动半径有效缓解跨域更新耦合，使模型合并超越单域蒸馏且消除负迁移，为多领域on-policy蒸馏提供更优方案。

title: VCRE-Fib: View-Conditioned Regional Evidence for Fine-Grained Ultrasound Grading of Schistosoma japonicum-Associated Liver Fibrosis
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/StatXzy7/vcre-fib
summary: Accurate assessment of Schistosoma japonicum-associated liver fibrosis is essential for disease management and long-term follow-up in endemic regions. Ultrasound provides non-invasive imaging, but complex local echogenic patterns and anatomical structures make fine-grained grading challenging. Existing deep learning methods can predict fibrosis scores, yet directly incorporating acquisition views and regional cues into grading while retaining spatial information for inspection remains an open problem. Here we present VCRE-Fib, a view-conditioned regional evidence framework that integrates anatomical context, local information, and global image assessment for fine-grained ultrasound grading. The framework forms view-conditioned local grading evidence before spatial pooling, uses weak localization to guide its aggregation, and combines it with global predictions. Image-only inference jointly returns a fibrosis score, acquisition view, and candidate abnormal-region map. We developed and evaluated the method on a re-curated cohort of 108,709 ultrasound images from 6,373 patients across 35 centers. On a patient-disjoint test set of 4,107 images from 240 patients across four centers, VCRE-Fib reduced the prespecified composite grading risk by 7.115% relative to SFibAI trained and evaluated on the same data split. Image-level mean absolute error decreased from 0.391 to 0.378, alongside lower patient-max, patient-median, and center-balanced risks. The full model also achieved lower composite grading risk than variants that separately removed view conditioning or weak localization. These results support incorporating anatomical context and regional evidence into ultrasound grading while exposing spatial predictions for inspection alongside severity estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出VCRE-Fib，一种视图条件区域证据框架，用于日本血吸虫相关肝纤维化的细粒度超声分级，融合解剖上下文、局部信息与全局评估，性能优于基线。
AI.motivation: 血吸虫相关肝纤维化的准确评估对疾病管理至关重要，但超声图像存在复杂回声模式和解剖结构，细粒度分级困难；现有深度学习方法难以在保留空间信息的同时有效整合采集视图与区域线索。
AI.method: VCRE-Fib在空间池化前形成视图条件的局部分级证据，用弱定位指导其聚合，并与全局预测结合；仅用图像推理可同时输出纤维化评分、采集视图和候选异常区域图。
AI.result: 在108,709张图像、6,373名患者、35个中心的数据上开发评估；四中心240名患者的4,107张图像测试集上，相比SFibAI复合分级风险降低7.115%，图像级MAE从0.391降至0.378，并降低患者最大、中位及中心平衡风险；去除视图条件或弱定位的变体性能更差。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将解剖上下文与区域证据纳入超声分级，并在给出严重度估计的同时提供可检查的空间预测。

title: Learning the Graph and the Embedding Together: Classifier-Independent Rewiring for Heterophilic Node Classification
summary: Graph neural networks lose much of their advantage on heterophilic graphs, where connected nodes often carry different labels. Graph rewiring is a popular remedy, but rewiring methods are usually evaluated with a single classifier, which makes it hard to tell whether the gains come from the new topology or from that particular pairing. We propose an affinity-guided rewiring method that estimates the graph and the node representation together. It alternates, in the spirit of expectation maximisation, between training a lightweight graph neural network on the current graph and re-weighting candidate edges under a modularity objective with a pseudo-label homophily term. Candidate edges come from a compact pool scored by a contrastively learned node similarity and a neighbourhood-distribution affinity. The method returns two classifier-independent outputs: a rewired graph and a node embedding learned on it. Across six heterophilic benchmarks and five downstream classifiers, it improves accuracy over the original graph with normalised features in 23 of 30 classifier-dataset combinations, with a mean gain of 5.8 points, and reduces the accuracy spread between classifiers about fourfold. A controlled ablation shows that the two outputs are each useful and play complementary roles: the embedding contributes most of the accuracy gain, while the rewired graph makes different classifiers agree. A fully unsupervised variant, which uses no labels during rewiring, retains most of the improvement. The rewired graphs are also more homophilic and improve label propagation and community detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种亲和力引导的图重连方法，联合估计图结构与节点表示，在异质图上提升多种分类器性能并减少分类器间差异。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络在异质图上表现不佳，图重连虽为常见补救手段，但通常仅用单一分类器评估，难以判断增益来自新拓扑还是特定分类器配对。
AI.method: 以类似EM的方式交替进行：在当前图上训练轻量GNN，并在带伪标签同质性项的模块度目标下重新加权候选边。候选边来自紧凑候选池，由对比学习的节点相似度和邻域分布亲和力评分。输出与分类器无关的重连图和节点嵌入。
AI.result: 在6个异质图基准和5个下游分类器上，30个组合中有23个提升准确率，平均提升5.8个点，分类器间准确率差异减少约4倍。消融显示嵌入贡献主要准确率增益，重连图促进分类器一致性。无监督变体保留大部分提升。重连图同质性更高，并改善标签传播和社区检测。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过联合学习图结构与节点表示，有效缓解异质图上的GNN性能问题，且输出分类器无关、具互补作用，并有无监督版本可用。

title: Overwhelmed by Choice: Studying LLM Decision Making at Scale
comment: Accepted at TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop. 23 pages
summary: Multiple-choice and candidate-selection evaluations are widely used to assess LLM reasoning and decision-making, yet most benchmarks contain relatively small candidate sets. It remains unclear whether conclusions drawn from these settings remain valid as the candidate space scales. We systematically evaluate LLMs as the number of competing candidates increases and find substantial accuracy degradation across tasks, prompting strategies, and model scales. Controlled analyses show that standard long-context retrieval explanations cannot fully account for this degradation. Instead, we identify two systematic failure patterns. First, gold-margin collapse: the score gap between the correct answer and the strongest distractor progressively shrinks, driven primarily by weakening confidence in the correct answer. Second, earlier candidate preferences become increasingly difficult to overturn, with later candidates exerting progressively weaker influence on the final prediction. Motivated by these findings, we evaluate hierarchical partitioning and permutation-based inference, which improve accuracy by roughly 20 percentage points at $N=160$ on both HotpotQA and MIMIC. Overall, our results identify candidate-set scale as an important evaluation-protocol variable and show that strong small-option performance does not necessarily imply robust large-scale candidate comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究候选集规模对LLM多选/候选选择评估的影响，发现候选数增加会导致显著精度下降，并揭示两种系统性失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有多选和候选选择评测通常候选集较小，尚不清楚结论在候选空间扩大后是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 系统评估LLM在不同候选数量、任务、提示策略和模型规模下的表现；进行受控分析排除长上下文检索解释；识别失败模式；评估分层划分与排列式推理。
AI.result: 候选数增加导致跨任务、策略和模型规模的显著精度下降。失败模式包括：gold-margin collapse，即正确答案与最强干扰项分数差逐渐缩小，主要因正确答案置信度减弱；早期候选偏好越来越难被推翻，后续候选影响逐渐减弱。分层划分与排列式推理在HotpotQA和MIMIC上N=160时提升约20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 候选集规模是重要评估协议变量；小选项上的强表现不必然意味着大规模候选比较稳健。

title: MAS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) split a task across specialized roles and are promising on complex tasks, yet a prevailing approach relies on inference-time orchestration alone. General-purpose APIs are costly and hard to customize, while small models with role prompts rarely develop stable role competence or reliable collaboration, so post-training a MAS jointly is central. Most attempts use reinforcement learning, whose team-level reward leaves undetermined which step of which agent brought about the outcome, while local rewards need redesigning per task. On-policy distillation (OPD) gives token-level teacher supervision on trajectories the student samples, a denser signal needing no local reward, yet is underexplored for the interdependent agents of a MAS. Two difficulties arise: building complementary specialization from a judgement of which role a behavior belongs to while preserving the knowledge all roles need, and turning cross-agent collaborative information into supervision OPD can exploit. We present MAS-OPD, where Role-Advantage Specialization defines the role advantage as the difference between the teacher signals under target and non-target role conditions, and Privileged Attribution for Coordination attributes an interaction conflict to its source and supplies it to the teacher alone as privileged information. Extensive experiments on code and mathematics benchmarks show that MAS-OPD attains the highest mean score at both student scales and leads the agents to develop clearer role specialization and more effective collaborative behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MAS-OPD，将在线策略蒸馏（OPD）应用于多智能体系统（MAS）的联合后训练，通过角色优势专门化与协调特权归因两项技术，在代码和数学基准上取得最高平均分并促进角色专门化与协作。
AI.motivation: MAS 有望处理复杂任务，但主流方法仅依赖推理时编排：通用 API 成本高难定制，小模型加角色提示难以形成稳定角色能力与可靠协作，因此需要联合后训练。现有强化学习方案中，团队奖励无法定位是哪个智能体的哪一步带来结果，局部奖励又需逐任务重设。OPD 提供 token 级、无需局部奖励的更密集信号，但在 MAS 相互依赖的智能体上尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出 MAS-OPD，包含两点：1）Role-Advantage Specialization——将角色优势定义为目标角色条件与非目标角色条件下教师信号的差异，在保留所有角色共有知识的同时构建互补专门化；2）Privileged Attribution for Coordination——将交互冲突归因到其来源，并仅作为特权信息提供给教师。
AI.result: 在代码与数学基准上的大量实验表明，MAS-OPD 在两个学生规模下均取得最高平均分，并促使智能体形成更清晰的角色专门化与更有效的协作行为。
AI.conclusion: MAS-OPD 证明了 OPD 可有效用于相互依赖的多智能体联合后训练，为 MAS 提供了一种无需局部奖励、信号更密集的训练范式。

title: Beyond Temporal Smoothing: Spatial Energy Budgets Stabilize One-Step Diffusion Editing
summary: One-step text-guided diffusion editing is efficient but prone to spatially misallocated updates that distort the edited object and alter the background. Existing methods often improve stability by averaging the editing field across timesteps. We instead identify spatial energy misallocation as a distinct and measurable failure mode: across two independent noise draws, the residual field is essentially unrepeatable, making the background field unreliable for direct transport, while its total energy still sets a usable magnitude for the draw at hand. BudEdit turns that magnitude into an explicit budget and reallocates it to edit-relevant regions selected jointly by residual energy and cross-attention, controlling where editing energy is spent rather than averaging over timesteps. The resulting training-free, inversion-free editor spends the budget on transport and reuses it to scale a correction in a lower-noise gated refinement. The budgeted injection field matches its prescribed budget exactly and vanishes on the identified background support, by construction. On PIE-Bench with SD-Turbo, BudEdit outperforms ChordEdit under each method's reported default settings on all 11 evaluated metrics, including a $2.1$\,dB gain in background PSNR, $31$\% lower DINO, and $36$\% lower LPIPS, while improving all five editing-quality metrics and reporting the lowest runtime in the comparison.

AI.tldr: BudEdit是一种无需训练和反演的一步文本引导扩散编辑方法，通过显式能量预算分配来解决空间能量误配问题，在PIE-Bench上全面超越ChordEdit。
AI.motivation: 一步扩散编辑效率高，但容易产生空间误配的更新，扭曲编辑对象并破坏背景。现有方法主要通过跨时间步平均编辑场来提升稳定性，但这掩盖了"空间能量误配"这一可测量的独立失败模式：残余场在不同噪声采样间不可重复，背景场不可靠，但其总能量仍可作为当前采样的有效量级。
AI.method: BudEdit将残余场总能量转化为显式预算，并重新分配到由残余能量和交叉注意力共同选定的编辑相关区域，从而控制编辑能量的花费位置而非跨时间步平均。该编辑器无需训练、无需反演，将预算用于传输，并复用于低噪声门控细化中的校正缩放。预算注入场精确匹配预设预算，并在构造上于识别的背景支撑区消失。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench上使用SD-Turbo，BudEdit在每个方法各自报告的默认设置下，于全部11项评估指标上超越ChordEdit，包括背景PSNR提升2.1 dB、DINO降低31%、LPIPS降低36%，同时改善全部五项编辑质量指标，并报告了对比中最低的运行时间。
AI.conclusion: BudEdit通过将空间能量误配显式建模为可分配预算，实现精准、稳定的单步文本引导编辑，在质量与效率上均优于现有方法。

title: Stabilizing the Dynamic Low-Rank Training
summary: Training neural networks directly in a low-rank parameterization is an appealing route to reducing memory, compute, and storage simultaneously during both training and inference. Dynamic low-rank training (DLRT), which confines weights to a rank-$r$ manifold via the Galerkin projection of the gradient flow, is particularly attractive because it identifies efficient subnetworks on the fly without specialized initialization or post-factorization. However, DLRT fails to find trainable networks under high compression. In this paper, we derive the gradient flow of the best rank-$r$ approximation and point out that the offset of DLRT comes from a curvature-coupling term which is large and thus non-negligible under aggressive compression. Guided by this analysis, we propose a stable dynamic low-rank training method, named SDLRT, which maintains a lightweight compensation buffer that reinjects the top neglected singular directions. Additionally, we introduce a negative feedback on the truncation tolerance to stabilize each layer's rank. Experimentally, SDLRT reliably finds trainable subnetworks where DLRT collapses and as a PEFT adapter on DeBERTa-v3, it achieves the best average score on SuperGLUE at only $2.8\%$ parameter overhead over LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文分析DLRT在高压缩率下失败的原因（曲率耦合项偏移），提出SDLRT：通过轻量补偿缓冲重注入被忽略的奇异方向，并对截断容差施加负反馈以稳定各层秩，在高压缩下可靠找到可训练子网络，作为PEFT适配器在SuperGLUE上以2.8%的参数开销超越LoRA。
AI.motivation: 动态低秩训练（DLRT）能在训练中实时发现高效子网络，无需特殊初始化或后分解，但在高压缩率下无法找到可训练网络。作者希望揭示其失败机理并加以修复。
AI.method: 1) 推导最佳秩-r逼近的梯度流，指出DLRT的偏移源自一个在激进压缩下很大且不可忽略的曲率耦合项；2) 提出SDLRT，维护轻量补偿缓冲，重新注入被忽略的顶部奇异方向；3) 对截断容差引入负反馈以稳定每层秩。
AI.result: SDLRT在DLRT崩溃的场景下能可靠找到可训练子网络；作为DeBERTa-v3上的PEFT适配器，在SuperGLUE上取得最佳平均分，且相比LoRA仅增加2.8%参数开销。
AI.conclusion: 曲率耦合项是DLRT高压缩失效的根源，补偿缓冲与秩稳定负反馈可有效解决该问题，使动态低秩训练在高压缩下兼具效率与性能。

title: Right Answer, Wrong Reason: Accuracy, Consistency, and Consensus Are Misleading Indicators of LLM Faithfulness in Clinical Decision Support
comment: Accepted and received best paper award from ICETCI 2026 Conference, https://ietcint.com/
summary: Clinical Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong medical-exam accuracy; however, a correct answer does not guarantee that the explanation names the concepts that actually drove the decision. We introduce three lightweight, directly interpretable metrics for this faithfulness gap: the Explanation Stability Index (ESI), which measures reasoning consistency across repeated queries; the Causal Faithfulness Score (CFS), which tests whether cited concepts drive predictions via concept ablation; and the Perturbation Stability Score (PSS), which measures robustness to semantic-preserving paraphrases. By evaluating six LLMs on 150 MedQA-USMLE questions (900 model-question observations), we found that only 23.3% of the cited clinical concepts were causally necessary. Correct answers had lower CFS than incorrect answers (0.212 vs. 0.398), answer consistency negatively predicted CFS (Spearman r = -0.466), and model pairs could agree on answers while sharing only 8.8% of cited reasoning concepts. These results show that accuracy, consistency, and consensus are incomplete safety signals for clinical decision-making support. The evidence is behavioral rather than mechanistic: concept ablation tests counterfactual sensitivity of outputs, not internal circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三个轻量可解释指标（ESI、CFS、PSS）来评估临床大模型答案与解释之间的“忠实性缺口”，发现多数被引用的临床概念并非因果必要，正确答案可解释性反而更差，且答案一致/共识不代表推理忠实。
AI.motivation: 临床大模型在医学考试题上准确率很高，但答对不等于其解释中提到的概念真正驱动了决策，这种解释忠实性缺口尚缺直接可解释的度量方法，而准确率、一致性、共识等常用信号可能不足以作为临床决策支持的安全指标。
AI.method: 在150道MedQA-USMLE问题上评估6个模型（共900个模型-问题观测），采用三个指标：解释稳定性指数ESI（重复查询下的推理一致性）、因果忠实性分数CFS（通过概念消融检验被引用概念是否驱动预测）、扰动稳定性分数PSS（对语义保持改写的鲁棒性）；方法性质为行为层面而非机制层面。
AI.result: 仅23.3%的被引用临床概念被证明是因果必要的；正确答案的CFS低于错误答案（0.212 vs 0.398）；答案一致性与CFS呈负相关（Spearman r = -0.466）；不同模型可在答案上一致但仅共享8.8%的被引用推理概念。
AI.conclusion: 准确率、一致性和共识都是临床决策支持安全性的不完整信号；本文证据属行为性证据，概念消融测的是输出的反事实敏感性而非内部电路机制。

title: Coherence-Aware Distributional Evaluation of Open-Ended Text Generation
summary: Existing metrics for open-ended text generation measure likelihood, lexical diversity, or distributional similarity in generic representation space, yet they can miss fundamental dimensions of quality. A prominent blind spot is global coherence: a generated passage may be locally fluent while remaining globally contradictory, causally inconsistent, or topically disconnected. Such failures can still preserve the token-level and lexical statistics that existing metrics rely on. We identify representation as a central bottleneck in detecting these failures and introduce CHORD (Coherence-aware Hidden-state Open-generation Reference Distance), a coherence-sensitive distributional metric. CHORD encodes generated and human-written corpora in the hidden-state space of a frozen LLM using a coherence-eliciting prompt, and compares the resulting distributions using MMD with an RBF kernel. To validate that the metric responds to coherence degradation but not generic textual change, we construct a counterfactual evaluation suite that pairs graded coherence-degrading perturbations with meaning-preserving controls. CHORD selectively detects relation, discourse, structural, and mixture failures that perplexity, entropy, MAUVE, FBD, and MMD-based baselines either miss or cannot separate from benign rewriting. Factorial ablations show that representation is the primary source of coherence sensitivity,while RBF-MMD improves sample efficiency once the relevant distinctions become visible. Larger backbones capture finer-grained distinctions, but coherence prompting improves selectivity only when the backbone can follow the prompt.On unconditional generation and prefix continuation, CHORD yields model rankings that strongly align with human judgments of whether outputs make sense and appear human-written. Together, these results establish representation design as central to reliable distributional evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CHORD——一种基于隐状态表征与MMD的连贯性敏感分布度量，用于检测开放式文本生成中的全局连贯性失败。
AI.motivation: 现有开放式生成度量（似然、词汇多样性、分布相似性）在通用表征空间中无法捕获全局连贯性，生成文本可能局部流畅但全局矛盾、因果不一致或主题脱节，而这些失败仍保持token级与词汇统计特征，因此难以被检测。
AI.method: 将生成与人写语料在冻结LLM的隐状态空间中用"连贯性诱发提示"编码，再用RBF核的MMD比较分布；并构建反事实评测套件，将分级的连贯性退化扰动与保义对照配对，做因子消融分析。
AI.result: CHORD能选择性检测关系、话语、结构和混合型失败，而困惑度、熵、MAUVE、FBD及MMD基线或漏检或无法与良性改写区分；消融显示表征是连贯性敏感性的主要来源，RBF-MMD在区分可见后提升样本效率；更大骨干能捕获更细粒度差异，连贯性提示仅在骨干能遵循提示时提升选择性；CHORD的模型排名与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 表征设计是可靠分布评估的核心，CHORD证明连贯性敏感的隐状态分布度量可弥补现有度量的关键盲点。

title: SynCo: Learning Cross-Modal Synergy by Contrasting Interaction Residuals
summary: Multimodal contrastive learning is a dominant paradigm for learning transferable representations from unlabeled data, but standard objectives primarily capture information that is redundant between modalities. Partial Information Decomposition (PID) shows that task-relevant information in multimodal data decomposes into three components: redundancy shared between modalities, uniqueness specific to each modality, and synergy available only from their joint observation. Recent frameworks extend contrastive learning to capture all three components, yet synergy remains undertrained in practice. We propose SynCo (Synergy Contrastive Learning), a method that directly addresses synergy undertraining through dedicated supervision on an interaction residual. SynCo fits a linear projector to predict the fused representation from independently computed unimodal features, and the resulting interaction residual, which removes the linearly unimodal-predictable component, receives dedicated contrastive supervision at negligible computational cost. On the controlled Trifeature benchmark, SynCo achieves state-of-the-art synergy capture with a $+5.98\%$ gain over the baseline, and on real-world benchmarks from MultiBench, DARai, and MM-IMDb, SynCo consistently outperforms or matches prior methods across diverse modality combinations and task types. The method operates as a plug-in to existing contrastive multimodal frameworks without modifying the underlying fusion architecture and can further improve synergy capture when combined with other methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SynCo方法，通过专门监督交互残差来解决多模态对比学习中协同信息训练不足的问题，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 标准多模态对比学习目标主要捕捉模态间的冗余信息，而PID分解中的协同信息（仅联合观测可得）在现有框架中训练不足。
AI.method: SynCo用线性投影器从各模态独立特征预测融合表示，得到去除线性可预测部分的交互残差，并对其施以专门的对比监督，计算开销极小。
AI.result: 在Trifeature基准上协同捕捉达SOTA，较基线提升+5.98%；在MultiBench、DARai、MM-IMDb上跨多种模态组合与任务类型持续优于或匹敌现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SynCo可作为插件嵌入现有多模态对比框架，无需改动融合架构，并能与其他方法结合进一步提升协同捕捉。

title: Intuition vectors
summary: Large self-supervised vision models learn representations that support scene segmentation and the semantic decomposition of physical objects. We ask whether their representational geometry supports transfer to visual reasoning problems without any task-specific fine-tuning. We hypothesized that relational representations may bridge perception and abstract reasoning by encoding similarities and transformations among visual inputs such that an intuitive, implicit form of reasoning may be performed via latent vector arithmetic. Specifically, we examine DINOv3, MAE, and random pixel projections on abstract and naturalistic Bongard problems, ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2, and novel ARC-GEN instances. On both Bongard benchmarks, the accuracy of a simple nearest-centroid readout of frozen visual embeddings is within four percentage points of the task-specific baselines reported with the original benchmarks. In ARC, latent difference vectors summarizing demonstration input-output transformations, which we refer to as intuition vectors, show greater alignment with test vectors from the same task, whereas those from unrelated tasks are near orthogonal. This latent geometry is operational: transporting a query along its intuition vector consistently improves exact-output retrieval, reaching 70.7 on ARC-AGI-2 evaluation. Across 397,000 ARC-GEN instances from 794 tasks, single-pair intuition vectors identify the generating task with approximately 87\% leave-one-out accuracy. These findings suggest that latent vector arithmetic over frozen visual representations supports implicit rule inference across varied problem domains without a generative model component, indicating that inferring an abstract transformation and generating its instance-specific consequence may be separable capacities.

AI.tldr: 冻结的自监督视觉模型（如DINOv3、MAE）的表示几何，可通过潜在向量算术支持无需微调的隐式视觉推理。
AI.motivation: 探究自监督视觉模型的表示几何能否在无任务特定微调的情况下迁移到视觉推理任务，并假设关系性表示（编码相似性与变换）能通过潜在向量算术连接感知与抽象推理。
AI.method: 在Bongard问题、ARC-AGI-1/2及新型ARC-GEN实例上，考察DINOv3、MAE与随机像素投影；使用冻结嵌入的最近质心读出，并构建"直觉向量"（演示输入-输出变换的潜在差分向量）进行查询迁移。
AI.result: 两个Bongard基准上，冻结嵌入的简单最近质心读出准确率与原基准任务特定基线相差四个百分点以内；ARC中同任务直觉向量与测试向量对齐度高（无关任务近正交），查询迁移提升精确输出检索，ARC-AGI-2达70.7；79.4万实例中单对直觉向量识别生成任务约87%留一准确率。
AI.conclusion: 冻结视觉表示上的潜在向量算术可在无生成模型组件下支持跨领域的隐式规则推断，表明"推断抽象变换"与"生成其实例特定结果"可能是可分离的能力。

title: When Can First-Order Models of Fine-Tuning Bound Forgetting?
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on new data can make it forget facts that it should keep. We ask whether measurements taken at the start of a fine-tuning run can bound, for each protected fact, the probability that the run makes the model forget it. In LoRA fine-tuning with stochastic gradient descent on models from 0.6B to 14B parameters, a first-order response model estimated by finite-difference probes predicts changes of per-fact margins with correlation 0.974-0.998. Predictions of forgetting built on this model nevertheless failed, because forgetting requires parameter changes far outside the region in which the model was validated. The probes can, however, bound the probability that a margin first falls below a boundary near zero: we derive Freedman and Azuma first-passage bounds for a linear surrogate of the margin and test on new runs whether they hold for the model. The bounds contain a term R that measures how much the response coefficients change during the run. The simplified Freedman bound, which sets R = 0, certified most facts but was violated in 14 of 112 conditions, and every fact on which it was violated had R >= a, where a is the distance of the fact's margin to the boundary. The complete Freedman bound certifies only facts with R < a, and it held in every condition. On the violated facts, the spread of the margin across test runs was a median of 14.6 times the prediction of the response model, so the failures are breakdowns of the model, and in our data they occurred only where R >= a. We found this pattern post hoc and tested it in two preregistered confirmatory studies with 43 new conditions: the complete bound held in all of them, and the simplified bound failed there on only 3 facts, each with R >= a. First-order models of fine-tuning can thus bound forgetting on the facts whose response coefficients change by less than their distance to the boundary.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究微调导致语言模型遗忘事实的问题，提出用有限差分探针估计一阶响应模型，并推导Freedman/Azuma首达边界来限定每个事实的遗忘概率。
AI.motivation: 微调新数据可能使语言模型遗忘本应保留的事实，作者希望找到一种在微调开始时就测量、并能对每个受保护事实限定遗忘概率的方法。
AI.method: 在0.6B至14B参数模型的LoRA微调（SGD）中，用有限差分探针估计一阶响应模型，预测各事实margin的变化；基于margin的线性替代模型推导Freedman与Azuma首达边界，并用新训练验证边界；边界含衡量响应系数变化的项R，简化Freedman边界取R=0，完整边界仅认证R<a的事实。另做两项预注册确认研究（43个新条件）。
AI.result: 响应模型预测margin变化的相关性达0.974-0.998，但直接预测遗忘失败，因遗忘所需参数变化超出验证区域。简化Freedman边界认证多数事实，却在112个条件中有14个被违反，且所有违反事实均满足R>=a；完整Freedman边界仅认证R<a的事实，并在所有条件中成立。违反事实上margin跨测试运行的散布中位数为响应模型预测的14.6倍，说明是模型失效。确认研究中完整边界在全部43个新条件成立，简化边界仅3个事实失败且均R>=a。
AI.conclusion: 微调的一阶模型可以限定遗忘概率，但仅适用于响应系数变化量小于其到边界距离（R<a）的事实；该模式经预注册研究确认。

title: SALMONN-duo: Adaptive Dual-System Coordination for Full-Duplex Voice Agents
summary: Full-duplex speech large language models (LLMs) enable low-latency, natural voice interaction. However, real-world agents must also use tools and perform deliberative reasoning-operations whose variable latency and computational cost conflict with the stringent timing requirements of real-time conversation. To reconcile these demands, we propose SALMONN-duo, an adaptive dual-system voice agent inspired by dual-process theories of cognition. SALMONN-duo separates real-time interaction from deliberative computation by pairing an always-on, fast-thinking full-duplex speech LLM (system 1) with a powerful asynchronous slow-thinking LLM agent (system 2). Beyond handling real-time interaction, system 1 learns when to answer directly and when to delegate, remaining responsive during backend execution and seamlessly integrating returned information into the ongoing dialogue without exposing tool traces or losing conversational context. Evaluations on single-turn spoken question answering (QA) and multi-turn conversations demonstrate that adaptive delegation substantially improves accuracy on knowledge-intensive and multi-hop reasoning questions, while knowledge-boundary-aware training avoids unnecessary system 2 invocations. On a customized version of $τ$-Voice, SALMONN-duo further demonstrates its ability to complete environment-grounded, policy-constrained tasks through multi-turn interactions in realistic business scenarios. Finally, cost-aware reinforcement learning further enhances the trade-off between task performance and backend usage across the QA and conversation tasks, while improving task success and response safety on $τ$-Voice with an acceptable increase in the delegation rate.

AI.tldr: 提出SALMONN-duo双系统语音智能体，将实时交互与深思计算分离以兼顾低延迟与复杂推理。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音LLM虽能低延迟交互，但真实场景需工具调用与深思推理，其可变延迟与实时对话的严格时序要求相冲突。
AI.method: 受双过程认知理论启发，构建双系统架构：常开快速全双工语音LLM（系统1）负责实时交互并学习何时直接回答、何时委派；强大的异步慢思考LLM智能体（系统2）负责深思计算。系统1在后端执行时保持响应并无缝整合返回信息，不暴露工具痕迹；采用知识边界感知训练与成本感知强化学习。
AI.result: 在单轮口语问答和多轮对话上，自适应委派显著提升知识密集与多跳推理准确率，知识边界感知训练避免不必要调用系统2；在定制τ-Voice上可完成环境锚定、策略约束的多轮业务任务；成本感知强化学习改善了性能与后端使用权衡，在可接受的委派率增长下提升任务成功率与响应安全性。
AI.conclusion: SALMONN-duo通过自适应双系统委派有效协调实时交互与深思计算，兼顾低延迟、准确率与任务成功率。

title: PolyTopoBench: A Benchmark for Complex Vector Polygon Generation from Remote Sensing Imagery
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
summary: Vector polygon generation converts visual inputs, e.g., remote sensing (RS) images, into vectorized polygonal geometries, supporting applications such as autonomous driving, vector map construction, and remote sensing.
