AI.method: 提出"可靠性覆盖率"（达阈值的题目比例）及两种检验：检验一在每道题内重分配各策略的存储正确性结果；检验二进一步保持每个策略的总成功数，以控制整体质量差异。在70亿参数视觉语言模型的5个训练种子上进行，并对比混合、路由器、投票、权重平均等部署方式，以及不同数据集训练、更强训练配方与控制实验。
AI.result: 阈值0.10下，重分配复现了估计oracle差距0.113中的0.096，两种检验均无显著证据，小优势不明确。混合、路由器、投票、权重平均无可检测提升；轻量后训练下跨数据集特化不明显、无路由器收益。更强配方产生真实特化，两种检验均检出，仅在高阈值出现路由器收益（可预测特化的对照中路由器收回约一半oracle差距）。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖率界限解释了为何即使存在真实oracle优势也未必带来部署收益；该检验可在投入路由前，用存储响应评估表观特化是否真实。

title: Scaling Properties of Same-Family On-Policy Distillation
summary: *Reinforcement learning (RL)* can induce substantial reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs), but how much of this capability transfers across model scales, and how quickly, remains unclear. We study the scaling properties of *on-policy distillation (OPD)* across *weak-to-strong*, *same-base*, and *strong-to-weak* teacher--student setups. We find that early OPD training dynamics uniformly exhibit a regular *useful-transfer* regime, in which held-out accuracy (the *gold score*, $G$) rises approximately linearly in $d=\sqrt{\mathrm{KL}(π_θ\Vert π_{\mathrm{ref}})}$, the square root of token-level reverse KL divergence from the student initialization. In every observed weak-to-strong pair, the student's peak gold score exceeds its teacher's own, so a compact RL expert can transfer capability to a much larger student via OPD. To estimate OPD outcomes, we fit *power laws* for how $G_{\mathrm{peak}}$ and the slope of the useful-transfer regime scale with student and teacher parameter counts and with teacher gold score. These laws show that peak gold score improves with teacher scale only up to roughly the student's scale, and that at a matched gold score smaller teachers transfer better, so a teacher's score alone does not define its supervision value. We also study the scaling effects of two OPD variants, bootstrapping weak-to-strong OPD, and the degree of on-policy supervision.

AI.tldr: 研究on-policy distillation（OPD）的scaling性质，覆盖weak-to-strong、same-base、strong-to-weak设置，发现early OPD阶段存在規律的useful-transfer regime并拟合power laws。
AI.motivation: RL能为LLM带来强推理能力，但这种能力跨模型尺度的迁移程度和速度尚不明确，需要研究OPD的scaling规律。
AI.method: 在多种teacher-student规模组合下研究OPD scaling；定义gold score G，并以d=sqrt(KL(πθ||πref))作为分析量；对G_peak及useful-transfer regime斜率随student/teacher参数量和teacher gold score拟合power laws；并考察两种OPD变体、bootstrapping weak-to-strong OPD以及on-policy监督程度的影响。
AI.result: early OPD统一表现为useful-transfer regime，G随d近似线性上升；所有observed weak-to-strong配对中，student的peak gold score超过其teacher自身；peak gold score随teacher scale提升仅到约student scale为止；在gold score匹配时，较小teacher迁移效果更好。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑RL expert能通过OPD向更大student迁移能力；teacher的score本身不足以定义其监督价值。power laws可用于估计OPD结果。

title: Planner-as-Router: Joint Plan-Time Model Routing for Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Workflows
comment: Accepted at AIxSET 2026. 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Data and Code in github: https://github.com/vsingh45/par-entbench
summary: Running large language model (LLM) agents in production gets expensive fast. A frontier model (the largest, most capable tier) is accurate but can cost 25 times what a small model costs per token, and the gap compounds once a workflow chains several calls together. Planner-as-Router (PaR) attacks this from a different angle. Instead of leaving model-tier selection to some component downstream, it folds the choice into planning itself. As the planner breaks a query into subtasks, it also assigns each one a model size tier (small, mid, or frontier, ordered by capability and price), so the dependencies between subtasks are visible before any specialist runs. Unlike per-call routers such as cascade routing, which look at one node at a time, PaR sees the whole workflow up front and needs no separate router model or training data. We evaluate PaR with EntBench, a benchmark of 54 enterprise agentic tasks across seven classes, graded by actually running the generated Structured Query Language (SQL) and MongoDB queries against live databases. Over 1,157 evaluations spanning eight routers and three seeds, PaR stays on the observed cost-accuracy frontier. It matches a sink-frontier heuristic (frontier model on terminal nodes only) in accuracy at comparable cost and a faithful FrugalGPT cascade at lower cost, and cuts cost 44% against all-frontier routing while giving up 2.9 points of accuracy. Several accuracy gaps fall inside the plus-or-minus six-point confidence interval of a 54-task study, so we frame PaR's advantage as frontier position rather than a clean accuracy win. We also report a preliminary observation, not a validated result: a small pilot hints that cheap routing may carry a hidden compounding penalty on compositional workflows, which we frame as a hypothesis for future measurement. PaR, EntBench, and all evaluation code are open source.

AI.tldr: PaR（Planner-as-Router）将模型档位选择融入规划阶段，为每个子任务分配小/中/前沿模型，无需额外路由器模型或训练数据，在 EntBench 企业级任务上处于成本-精度前沿前沿。
AI.motivation: 在生产中运行 LLM 智能体成本上升很快：前沿模型的每 token 成本可达小模型 25 倍，工作流多步链式调用会放大成本差距。现有逐调用路由器（如级联路由）只能逐节点判断，缺乏全局工作流视角。
AI.method: PaR 让规划器在把查询拆成子任务的同时，为每个子任务指定模型档位（小/中/前沿，按能力与价格排序），从而在任何专家模型运行前就暴露子任务依赖关系。与逐调用路由器不同，PaR 事先看到整个工作流，且不需要单独的路由器模型或训练数据。
AI.result: 在 EntBench（54 个企业级智能体任务、7 类，通过真实执行 SQL/MongoDB 查询评分）上，覆盖 8 个路由器、3 个随机种子共 1157 次评估：PaR 位于观测到的成本-精度前沿。与 sink-frontier 启发式在相当成本下精度相当，比忠实的 FrugalGPT 级联成本更低；相比全前沿路由降低 44% 成本，仅损失 2.9 个百分点精度。若干精度差距落在 54 任务研究的 ±6 点置信区间内，故作者将 PaR 的优势表述为"前沿位置"而非干净精度胜利。另有一个未验证的初步观察：小规模试点提示廉价路由可能在组合式工作流上存在隐藏的复合惩罚。
AI.conclusion: PaR 通过将模型档位选择折入规划，实现了全局工作流感知的成本优化，处于成本-精度前沿；但精度优势需谨慎解读，"廉价路由的复合惩罚"仅作为未来待验证假设。PaR、EntBench 及全部评估代码已开源。

title: Zero-Shot Cue-Grounded Topic Segmentation of Spoken Documents
summary: Topic segmentation structures spoken documents into coherent sections, facilitating navigation and downstream understanding. The appropriate granularity can vary substantially, ranging from broad thematic shifts to fine-grained subtopics. Existing LLM-based segmenters, however, often struggle to adapt to this variation, causing them to either merge distinct subtopics or over-segment coherent themes. To address this, we introduce Cue-Grounded Segmentation (CGS), a training-free framework that operates without any task-specific supervision. CGS first identifies phrases that explicitly signal the start of a new topic and uses their sentence positions as segment boundaries. When such cues are insufficient, it falls back to semantic segmentation, guided by the document structure inferred during cue extraction. Across six benchmarks and six LLM backbones, CGS consistently outperforms existing baselines, remains robust to noisy ASR transcripts, and achieves these gains with low API cost on proprietary models.

AI.tldr: CGS 是一种无需训练的语音文档主题分割框架，利用显式话题起始短语作为边界，不足时回退到语义分割，在多个基准和 LLM 上优于现有方法且成本低。
AI.motivation: 语音文档需要分割成连贯章节以便导航和理解，但合适的分割粒度变化很大（从宽泛主题到细粒度子话题）。现有基于 LLM 的分割器难以适应这种变化，导致合并不同子话题或过度分割连贯主题。
AI.method: 提出 Cue-Grounded Segmentation（CGS），一种无需训练、无需任务特定监督的框架。它先识别明确表示新话题开始的短语，以其句子位置作为分割边界；当这些线索不足时，回退到语义分割，并由线索提取阶段推断出的文档结构进行引导。
AI.result: 在六个基准和六个 LLM 骨干上，CGS 持续优于现有基线，对噪声 ASR 转录保持鲁棒，并在商业模型上以低 API 成本取得这些提升。
AI.conclusion: CGS 通过结合显式话题线索与语义回退机制，有效解决了主题分割中粒度自适应的难题，兼具高性能、鲁棒性和低成本优势。

title: Certified Interface Aliases: Exact Collisions in Vision-Language Preprocessing, and When They Exist
summary: Vision-language verifiers and routers must distinguish errors repairable by more reasoning from those caused by visual evidence never reaching the language model. This distinction lacks ground truth because annotators see full-resolution images while models receive preprocessed tensors. We introduce AliasForge to create cases where the relevant fact is provably absent from the interface. Fixed-point resampling makes the pre-rounding resize an exact integer linear map that can send nonzero integer perturbations to zero. Hiding a label-flipping perturbation there produces images with opposite step-correctness labels but bit-identical interface states. Every verifier therefore has the same output law on both members, giving pair-balanced accuracy exactly one half and zero gain from language-side repair. We prove that every fixed-point downscaler has such null vectors and bound their smallest size at the most common ratios, which rules out an 8-bit fit whenever the bound exceeds 255. From the resize configuration alone, a lattice criterion supplies realizable collisions and certifies their absence within the specified construction family. It resolves all 20 screened configurations, 17 as constructible and 3 as non-constructible. We construct certified pairs across three architectures and certify four additional processors, with zero decision-logit gap on all 18 scored pairs and none of the 18 controls. The pairs also screen routers that waste computation on re-attention or further reasoning. On natural items, per-item routing headroom exists, but no tested interface-only router improves over stopping. Our fiber ceiling bounds the headroom recoverable from the interface. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/aliasforge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AliasForge，构造接口不可见的扰动案例，证明视觉语言验证器/路由器无法区分可修复错误与视觉信息缺失，并给出理论界限与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 验证器与路由器需区分"可通过更多推理修复的错误"和"视觉证据从未到达语言模型导致的错误"，但因标注者看全分辨率图而模型只接收预处理张量，这一区分缺乏真实标签（ground truth）。
AI.method: 利用定点重采样（fixed-point resampling）使预舍入缩放成为精确整数线性映射，可将非零整数扰动映射为零。在此处隐藏翻转标签的扰动，生成接口状态逐位相同但步骤正确性标签相反的图像对。用格（lattice）判据从缩放配置中找出可实现碰撞并证明其不存在性。
AI.result: 证明每个定点降采样器都存在此类零向量，并在常见比例下界定其最小尺寸，当界限超过255时排除8位表示。20个配置中17个可构造、3个不可构造。在三种架构上构造出认证对，另认证四个处理器；18个评分对决策logit差为零，18个对照则无。自然样本上存在逐项路由空间，但测试的仅接口路由器均未优于停止策略。
AI.conclusion: 接口本身可成为信息瓶颈，其"纤维上限"界定了可恢复的路由空间。仅依赖接口的验证器/路由器在该构造下无法获得超过随机（准确率0.5）的收益。

title: Distributionally Robust Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning: Finite-Sample Guarantees under Weak Communication
summary: We study distributionally robust reinforcement learning (DR-RL) in the average-reward setting under weak communication. Our main result provides finite-sample guarantees for estimating the robust optimal average reward and learning a near-optimal policy, covering both SA-rectangular and S-rectangular structures with divergence-based and distance-based uncertainty sets. Specifically, for Kullback--Leibler and $f_k$-divergence balls, we establish explicit radius conditions under which the robust average-reward Bellman equation admits a constant-gain solution, while for total variation and Wasserstein balls, any positive radius suffices without requiring the nominal MDP to be weakly communicating. Our algorithm is prior-knowledge-free and achieves sample complexities of $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-1}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_δ^{\ast})ε^{-2})$ for estimating the robust optimal average reward and $\widetilde O(|\mathcal{S}||\mathcal{A}|p_{\wedge}^{-2}\operatorname{Span}^{2}(u_δ^{\ast})ε^{-2})$ for learning an $ε$-optimal policy. Here, $p_{\wedge}$ is the smallest positive nominal transition probability and $u_δ^{\ast}$ is a robust optimal bias function. We further provide an almost-tight explicit upper bound on $\operatorname{Span}(u_δ^{\ast})$. Finally, we validate the predicted $n^{-1/2}$ convergence rate through numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 研究弱通信条件下平均奖励的分布鲁棒强化学习，给出有限样本保证、显式半径条件与近乎最优的样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 平均奖励设定下的分布鲁棒强化学习此前缺乏弱通信条件下的有限样本理论保证，尤其是关于鲁棒平均奖励贝尔曼方程何时存在常增益解尚不清楚。
AI.method: 针对SA-矩形与S-矩形结构，结合散度型（KL、f_k-散度）与距离型（TV、Wasserstein）不确定集，推导常增益解成立的半径条件；提出无需先验知识的算法。
AI.result: 估计鲁棒最优平均奖励的样本复杂度为 Õ(|S||A|p∧^{-1}Span²(u*_δ)ε^{-2})，学习ε-最优策略为 Õ(|S||A|p∧^{-2}Span²(u*_δ)ε^{-2})；给出Span(u*_δ)近乎紧的显式上界；数值实验验证n^{-1/2}收敛率。
AI.conclusion: 为弱通信平均奖励DR-RL提供统一有限样本理论，KL/f_k需显式半径条件而TV/Wasserstein任意正半径即可且无需名义MDP弱通信。

title: Precision As You Need: Stochastic Computing Is a Dense Adaptive Quantizer
summary: Matrix multiplications dominate the inference cost of modern transformer-based vision models, yet existing efficiency techniques such as post-training quantization and mixed-precision inference are largely limited to the small set of fixed-width formats (INT4, INT8, BF16, and FP16) supported by conventional accelerators. We revisit stochastic computing (SC) as a way to lift this constraint: viewed as a dense adaptive quantizer, SC controls precision by bit-stream length L rather than a fixed datapath, while each multiplication reduces to a single AND/XNOR gate. We build a GPU library that emulates SC matrix multiplication at scale, exposes stream lengths as first-class kernel arguments, and evaluates SC end-to-end on image classification, object detection and instance segmentation, class-conditional image generation, and visual world-model planning. On top of this substrate, we develop a dynamic per-row mixed-precision policy that assigns stream length per token or group at matched average budget, requires no retraining, and uses the same SC hardware across schedules. Across tasks, SC remains competitive with fixed-format INT quantization at matched bit budgets, while per-row mixed precision helps maintain accuracy at lower average stream lengths. These results provide software-level feasibility evidence that SC can serve as a dense-precision substrate for fine-grained mixed-precision inference on modern vision transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文探索随机计算(SC)作为视觉Transformer细粒度混合精度推理的密集可调精度基座,通过GPU库验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 矩阵乘法主导视觉模型推理开销,但现有PTQ和混合精度技术受限于INT4/INT8/BF16/FP16等固定位宽格式;SC以比特流长度L控制精度、乘法仅需AND/XNOR门,可突破该限制。
AI.method: 构建GPU库大规模模拟SC矩阵乘法,把流长度作为一等内核参数;提出无需重训练的逐行/逐token动态混合精度策略,在平均预算匹配下分配流长度。
AI.result: 在图像分类、目标检测、实例分割、类条件图像生成和视觉世界模型规划上评估:SC在匹配比特预算下与固定格式INT量化相当,逐行混合精度可在更低平均流长度下保持精度。
AI.conclusion: 软件层面证明SC可作为现代视觉Transformer细粒度混合精度推理的密集精度基座。

title: AgentHop: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agentic Multi-Hop Scientific Question Answering
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Evaluation and Datasets Track
summary: Agentic tasks require a large language model to interact with the world, navigating information and gathering evidence across multiple steps with restricted resources. Due to this complexity, agentic task failures arise from various sources, and pinpointing these failure causes is essential to diagnose and improve agentic systems. Existing benchmarks, however, tend to focus on a single leaderboard score, leaving the underlying failure modes opaque. To fill this gap, we introduce AgentHop, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,011 multiple-choice questions paired with a controlled seven-tool sandbox under fixed token, turn, and tool-call constraints. AgentHop reveals model vulnerabilities by dissecting a single accuracy score along four axes of agent operation: retrieval, synthesis, tool-call, and resource management. Across 19 models, we find that behavior clusters by model family, with tool-call signatures revealing distinct family fingerprints: GPT models commit early, Anthropic and GLM checkpoints verify before committing, DeepSeek and Kimi over-search, and Gemini-3 Pro stays balanced. Decomposed axes further expose within-family structure: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 land within one accuracy point yet diverge on retrieval-versus-synthesis emphasis, with Opus retrieving more and Sonnet synthesizing better. We release the full benchmark set and the harness to support diagnostic agent benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentHop诊断基准（1011道多选题+受控七工具沙盒），在固定token/轮次/工具调用约束下，从检索、综合、工具调用、资源管理四轴拆解单一准确率，揭示19个模型的失败模式。
AI.motivation: Agentic任务需多步交互、受限资源下获取证据，失败来源多样，但现有基准只看单一排行榜分数，失败原因不透明，难以诊断和改进系统。
AI.method: 构建AgentHop：1011道多选题配七工具沙盒，固定token、turn、tool-call约束；将准确率沿检索、综合、工具调用、资源管理四轴分解。
AI.result: 19个模型行为按家族聚集：GPT早提交，Anthropic与GLM提交前验证，DeepSeek与Kimi过度检索，Gemini-3 Pro均衡；同家族内亦有差异，Claude Opus 4.6与Sonnet 4.6准确率差不到1分但Opus偏检索、Sonnet偏综合。
AI.conclusion: AgentHop通过多轴分解暴露模型脆弱性与家族指纹，并公开基准与工具框架以支持诊断式agent评测。

title: Safety-Constrained Cascade Inference for Robust Malaria Cell Classification Under Field Corruptions
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at https://github.com/josehagbe3/MalariaVision
summary: Automated malaria diagnosis from thin blood-smear microscopy could meaningfully reduce the burden on under-resourced laboratories, but a model that maximises accuracy on clean laboratory images fails badly the moment an inexpensive smartphone camera introduces sensor noise. This paper introduces MalariaCascade, a two-stage inference system in which a lightweight MobileNetV2 sentinel (2,225,153 parameters) makes confident classifications at low compute cost and escalates uncertain cases to an EfficientNet-B3 expert (10,697,769 parameters) that sees only clean, standardised images regardless of how corrupted the incoming frame is. Structural isolation of the expert stage, not learned robustness, is the mechanism. The sentinel is trained under a safety-score objective that places an explicit floor on Recall(Parasitised) (>=0.95) and Recall(Uninfected) (>=0.40) before precision is optimised, ensuring the checkpoint satisfies clinical safety constraints by construction. On the NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset (27,558 cells), the cascade reaches Accuracy=0.9736, Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570, Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912, F1=0.9738, and AUROC=0.9955 on the clean test set. Under Gaussian sensor noise at full severity, cascade Recall(Parasitised) degrades by only 2.4 pp (0.9570 to 0.9329), while the flat single-model baseline collapses by 63.0 pp (0.9584 to 0.3281). McNemar's test confirms the cascade improvement is statistically significant (chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085). An ablation isolating the structural property shows that routing clean images to the expert is responsible for a 16.8 pp Recall(Parasitised) advantage under sensor noise relative to a cascade where the expert also sees corrupted inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出两级级联系统 MalariaCascade：轻量哨兵模型处理简单样本，不确定样本升级至仅接收清晰图像的专家模型，实现抗噪疟疾诊断。
AI.motivation: 低成本智能手机显微图像存在传感器噪声，单一在干净图像上训练的模型在真实场景下会严重失效，而重训练强鲁棒模型代价高。
AI.method: MobileNetV2 哨兵（约 222 万参数）以安全分数目标训练（Recall(Parasitised)≥0.95、Recall(Uninfected)≥0.40 为约束再优化精度），置信样本直接分类，不确定样本路由至 EfficientNet-B3 专家（约 1070 万参数）；专家只处理标准化后的清晰图像，与输入损坏程度解耦。
AI.result: 在 NIH 数据集（27,558 细胞）干净测试集上 Accuracy=0.9736、Recall(P)=0.9570、Precision(P)=0.9912、F1=0.9738、AUROC=0.9955；满强度高斯噪声下 Recall(P) 仅降 2.4pp，而单模型基线降 63.0pp；McNemar 检验显著（χ²=11.14, p=0.00085）；消融显示专家仅看干净图像带来 16.8pp 优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构隔离而非学习鲁棒性即可有效抵抗传感器噪声，为资源匮乏地区的自动化疟疾诊断提供可行方案。

title: Predicting the Financial Impact of Supply Chain Risk for Major AI-Related Semiconductor Firms: A Heterogeneous Graph Patch Transformer Approach
summary: Modern semiconductor production relies on a globally distributed, multi-tier supply chain in which financial stress at one firm spreads with a delay and eventually affects the revenue, inventory, and profitability of the companies that design AI chips. Most firms see only their direct partners, and prior predictive research has mainly targeted market-based risk measures, so few tools forecast how supply chain stress will appear in reported financials. In this study, we propose a heterogeneous graph patch transformer that forecasts these quarterly changes one and two quarters ahead. Learning from a 15,186-company network over 60 quarters, the proposed model fuses quarterly fundamentals with macro-trade, event, and disaster signals through learned gates, carries risk across supplier, customer, ownership, and headquarters relations through typed, direction-specific propagation, and encodes the propagated histories with patch-based tokenization. In preliminary experiments on 116 focal semiconductor firms, the proposed model achieves the lowest error on every target at both horizons, and its profitability advantage widens at the two-quarter horizon. These forecasts can help supply chain managers and investors act before disruptions appear in reported financials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出异构图补丁Transformer，提前1-2季度预测半导体AI芯片供应链财务压力传导，在116家焦点企业上取得最低误差。
AI.motivation: 半导体生产依赖全球多层供应链，一家企业的财务压力会延迟扩散并最终影响AI芯片设计公司的营收、库存与盈利；现有预测研究多聚焦市场风险指标，缺乏从供应链压力到财报表现的预测工具，且多数企业仅能看到直接合作伙伴。
AI.method: 提出异构图补丁Transformer：基于15,186家公司、60个季度的网络学习；通过可学习门控融合季度基本面与宏观贸易、事件、灾害信号；在供应商、客户、股权、总部等关系上进行带类型、方向特定的风险传播；用补丁式分词编码传播历史。
AI.result: 在116家焦点半导体企业的初步实验中，模型在两个预测周期（1、2季度）的所有目标上误差最低，且在2季度周期上盈利能力优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 该预测可帮助供应链管理者与投资者在扰动反映到财报前提前行动。

title: TRACE: Learning to Self-Calibrate Wireless Digital Twins from ISAC Measurements
summary: Wireless digital twins (DTs) rely on 3D environment models to predict radio propagation and support wireless-network decisions, yet these models are often initialized from imperfect 3D maps. Errors in building position, height, footprint, and orientation can therefore cause a high-fidelity propagation engine to simulate the wrong physical environment. In this paper, we study how a deployed wireless network can repair an existing DT using its own radio frequency (RF) measurements. In particular, we introduce Twin Residual Alignment and Calibration Engine (TRACE), a physics-grounded learning-based self-calibration framework that treats twin maintenance as residual alignment between the physical world and the current DT. Using the same sensing configuration as the physical measurements, TRACE ray-traces the current DT, coherently backprojects the measured and simulated RF onto a common world grid, and extracts the same local region around each building's current DT position. A multi-view corrector then fuses evidence across sensing nodes and neighboring buildings to predict a gated six-parameter correction per building, without relying on absolute layout or sensor ordering, and supports iterative correction through re-rendering. On 5,400 held-out samples from unseen simulated scenes at 28 GHz, TRACE reduces 3D position RMSE from 2.202 m to 0.302 m and yaw RMSE from 4.978° to 0.894°, outperforming ViT and U-Net baselines under changes in layout, building count, sensing-node count, and SNR. On measured 28 GHz RF data from the NIST outdoor courtyard, a model trained only on synthetic RF reduces mean planar wall-position error from 1.00 m to 7.8 cm, without measured-data fine-tuning or geometric labels. These results show that the discrepancy between measured and twin-rendered RF can serve as a learning signal for repairing a wireless DT.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE框架，利用无线网络的RF测量自校准数字孪生3D环境模型，通过物理可导的残差对齐修复建筑位置与朝向误差。
AI.motivation: 无线数字孪生依赖3D环境模型预测电波传播，但初始3D地图常含建筑位置、高度、轮廓和朝向误差，导致高保真传播引擎模拟错误的物理环境。本文研究如何利用已部署网络自身的RF测量修复DT。
AI.method: TRACE将孪生维护视为物理世界与当前DT间的残差对齐。使用与物理测量相同的传感配置对当前DT做射线追踪，将实测与仿真RF相干反向投影到公共世界网格，并围绕各建筑当前位置提取相同局部区域。多视图校正器融合跨传感节点与邻近建筑的证据，预测每个建筑的门控六参数修正，不依赖绝对布局或传感器顺序，并支持通过重渲染迭代修正。
AI.result: 在28GHz未见仿真场景的5,400个留出样本上，3D位置RMSE从2.202m降至0.302m，偏航RMSE从4.978°降至0.894°，优于ViT和U-Net基线，且在布局、建筑数量、传感节点数和SNR变化下稳健。在NIST室外庭院实测28GHz RF数据上，仅用合成RF训练的模型将平均平面墙体位置误差从1.00m降至7.8cm，无需实测微调或几何标签。
AI.conclusion: 实测与孪生渲染RF之间的差异可作为学习信号来修复无线数字孪生。

title: Remember by Asking: Retrieval-Induced Memory Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for language agents to maintain coherent and effective behavior over extended, multi-session interactions. Existing memory systems mainly use retrieval at read time, while write-time memory formation still relies on direct extraction or compression. However, when future information needs are unknown, compressing an entire interaction in one pass can overlook locally important details that may matter later. To this end, we introduce RIME, a retrieval-induced memory framework that shifts memory construction from monolithic compression toward evidence-centered integration. RIME uses generic self-questions to retrieve focused dialogue evidence and grounds memory formation in both the retrieved evidence and relevant historical memories, which are jointly reconciled into an evolving memory bank with temporal and provenance information. At inference time, compressed memory serves as the primary rather than the sole source of evidence: when it cannot support an answer, RIME retrieves relevant source dialogue together with its local context to recover information omitted during memory formation, without resorting to full-history processing. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GPT-5.6 Sol show that RIME consistently achieves the best performance across all three quality metrics among the compared methods, while requiring substantially fewer query-time LLM tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出RIME记忆框架，将记忆构建从整体压缩转向以证据为中心的整合，通过自提问检索对话证据并与历史记忆协同，形成带时间与来源信息的演化记忆库，推理时压缩记忆作为主要而非唯一证据源。
AI.motivation: 现有语言智能体的长期记忆系统主要在读取时检索，而写入时记忆形成依赖直接抽取或压缩。当未来信息需求未知时，一次性压缩整段交互会忽略局部重要细节。
AI.method: RIME采用通用自提问检索聚焦的对话证据，将记忆形成建立在检索到的证据和相关的历史记忆之上，二者协同调和进入带时间与来源信息的演化记忆库。推理时当压缩记忆无法支撑回答，则检索相关源对话及其局部上下文以恢复遗漏信息，无需全历史处理。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo数据集上使用Qwen3-235B-A22B和GPT-5.6 Sol进行实验，RIME在所有三个质量指标上均优于对比方法，同时显著减少查询时的LLM token消耗。
AI.conclusion: RIME通过证据中心整合与自适应证据检索，在提升长期记忆质量的同时降低推理成本，验证了压缩记忆与源证据结合的有效性。

title: Residual Diffusion Implicit Models
comment: 38 pages, 17 figures. Implementation available at https://github.com/joaolcguerreiro/RDIM
summary: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出残差扩散隐式模型(RDIM)，显式建模HQ与LQ图像的残差以对齐退化的前向过程，并推导非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，实现少步甚至单步重建，兼顾保真度与多样性，在去噪与超分任务上超越桥模型与一致性模型。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在逆问题中从纯高斯噪声初始化，与真实退化不对齐；扩散桥约束过严且反向过程长易产生幻觉；一致性模型虽单步但缺乏方差建模，严重退化下性能下降。
AI.method: RDIM显式建模高质量与低质量图像间的残差，使前向过程与实际退化对齐；推导非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，可跳过中间时间步；引入可控方差机制，在确定性与随机采样间插值；并支持感知损失的直接使用。
AI.result: 在去噪和超分基准上，RDIM在PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS上稳定超越桥模型与一致性模型等SOTA方法，减少幻觉，且仅需少量采样步（常为一步）。
AI.conclusion: RDIM为各类图像复原任务提供了高效且通用的解决方案。

title: Benchmarking EEG Foundation Models at Scale: Lessons from 20,000 Evaluations
comment: 91 pages, including appendices and supplementary material
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) promise transferable neural representations, yet their advantages over strong supervised baselines and their prospects for further scaling remain unclear. To address these questions, we introduce EEG-Arena, an open-source benchmark covering 30 EEG FMs and 25 supervised baselines evaluated on 57 downstream tasks from 23 public datasets. Through more than 20,000 evaluations across five experimental protocols, we assess downstream performance, pretraining benefits, model size scaling, pretraining data scaling, and robustness to channel configuration. We find that (1) EEG FMs outperform strong task-specific supervised baselines on most evaluated tasks, particularly under non-bipolar settings; (2) compared with architecture-matched supervised training from scratch, pretraining improves both early optimization and final downstream performance, with larger and more consistent gains as more labeled downstream data become available; (3) existing EEG FMs do not exhibit a consistent positive relationship between parameter count and downstream performance; (4) under a fixed architecture, increasing the pretraining data scale yields sustained downstream gains; and (5) channel-flexible FMs achieve higher absolute performance than channel-constrained models across most evaluated channel configurations. Together, these findings demonstrate the downstream value of EEG FMs and identify pretraining data expansion as a promising direction for further progress. To support continued research, we release EEG-Arena as an open-source evaluation framework that provides shared infrastructure for reproducible benchmarking, model comparison, and community-driven development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EEG-Arena，一个开源 EEG 基础模型基准，覆盖30个基础模型、25个监督基线、23个数据集57项任务，超2万次评估，系统分析EEG基础模型的性能、预训练收益、规模扩展与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: EEG基础模型虽被寄予可迁移表征的期望，但其相对强监督基线的优势以及进一步扩展的前景尚不明确，缺乏系统性的公平评测。
AI.method: 构建开源基准EEG-Arena，覆盖30个EEG基础模型与25个监督基线，在23个公共数据集的57个下游任务上，采用5种实验协议进行超过20,000次评估，考察下游性能、预训练收益、模型规模扩展、预训练数据规模扩展及通道配置鲁棒性。
AI.result: (1) EEG基础模型多数任务上优于强任务专用监督基线，尤其非双极设置；(2) 相比同架构从零训练，预训练改善早期优化与最终性能，且有标签数据越多增益越大越稳定；(3) 现有EEG基础模型参数量与下游性能无一致正相关；(4) 固定架构下增加预训练数据规模带来持续增益；(5) 通道灵活模型在多数配置下绝对性能更高。
AI.conclusion: EEG基础模型具有显著下游价值，预训练数据扩展是未来进展的可行方向；EEG-Arena作为开源评估框架支持可复现基准测试与社区共建。

title: Diagnosing Sampled LLM Reasoning in Formal Geometry: Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence
summary: Repeated sampling can reveal a correct numerical answer without yielding either a reliable system output or a supported derivation. We present Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence (CRV), an evaluation protocol for sampled large language model (LLM) reasoning over formal geometry states. Coverage is answer availability, realization is readout accuracy on the frozen candidate pool, and validity evidence is a label-blinded critic judgment of derivational support rather than a proof certificate. CRV freezes each candidate pool before comparing readouts and analyzes covered failures by correct-answer multiplicity and within-problem discrimination. On HardShift441, a 441-problem set for which a reference solver leaves 406 problems unsolved, a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-7B generator obtains 24.2% average single-sample accuracy and 68.9% pass@16, whereas verifier-weighted self-consistency (WSC) reaches 38.0%. Readout accuracy is particularly low when the correct answer occurs only once or twice in the pool. In a separate constructed audit of 195 covered problems, the critic labels 12 correct-answer representatives as supported, 181 as refuted, and two as uncertain. These results show that coverage, realization, and validity evidence from the critic are distinct quantities and should be reported separately.

AI.tldr: 提出CRV评估协议，将采样LLM推理分解为覆盖、实现和有效性证据三个独立量，应分别报告。
AI.motivation: 重复采样可能得到正确答案，却不代表系统输出可靠或推导得到支持；现有评估混淆了答案可得性与推理质量。
AI.method: CRV协议：覆盖=答案可得性；实现=冻结候选池上的读出准确率；有效性证据=标签盲审评论者对推导支持的判断（非证明证书）。冻结候选池后再比较读出，并按正确答案重数与问题内区分度分析已覆盖失败。用LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B在HardShift441上测试，对比单样本、pass@16与WSC。
AI.result: HardShift441（参考求解器406题未解）上，单样本准确率24.2%，pass@16为68.9%，WSC达38.0%；正确答案仅出现一两次时读出准确率尤其低。195道覆盖题审计中，评论者判定12例支持、181例反驳、2例不确定。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖、实现与评论者有效性证据是不同量，必须分开报告，避免以正确率掩盖推理缺陷。

title: Unbiased Top-$k$ Estimation for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming an important component of large language model (LLM) post-training for transferring the reasoning capability of a strong teacher LLM to a weaker student LLM. OPD trains the student by minimizing the reverse KL divergence between the teacher and the student via rollouts generated by the student's policy. However, estimating the gradient of the reverse KL divergence in OPD remains a challenge. Using only the sampled token from the student-generated rollout is computationally cheap but provides limited distributional supervision, which will degrade accuracy. In addition, using the full vocabulary provides complete distributional supervision but is computationally expensive. Therefore, recent works propose Top-$k$ OPD (TK-OPD) that use selected top-$k$ tokens, which provides richer distributional supervision than sampled-token estimation at substantially lower computational cost than full-vocabulary estimation. Unfortunately, using only the selected top-$k$ tokens induces bias, leading to accuracy degradation, as the probability mass outside the selected top-$k$ tokens is discarded. To address the bias of TK-OPD, we propose Tail-Corrected Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD). It preserves the advantages of TK-OPD, including rich distributional supervision and low computational cost, while providing an unbiased estimator of the gradient of the reverse KL divergence. The key insight of TT-OPD is to use not only the selected top-$k$ tokens, but also the sampled token from the student-generated rollout, thereby recovering the discarded probability mass in expectation, avoiding the bias. Experimental results demonstrate that TT-OPD significantly outperforms other tested OPD variants.

AI.tldr: 提出TT-OPD，通过结合top-k token与采样token，实现反向KL散度梯度的无偏估计，提升LLM蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: On-policy蒸馏(OPD)中，反向KL散度梯度估计面临困境：仅用采样token计算便宜但分布监督不足导致精度下降；用全词表监督完整但计算昂贵。已有Top-k OPD(TK-OPD)虽折中，但因丢弃top-k外概率质量而引入偏差，导致精度退化。
AI.method: 提出Tail-Corrected Top-k On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD)。核心思想是不仅使用选定的top-k token，还使用学生生成rollout中的采样token，从而在期望意义上恢复被丢弃的概率质量，消除偏差，同时保留TK-OPD的丰富分布监督和低计算成本优势。
AI.result: 实验结果表明TT-OPD显著优于其他测试的OPD变体。
AI.conclusion: TT-OPD为反向KL散度梯度提供了无偏估计，兼顾分布监督丰富性与计算效率，是更优的OPD方法。

title: NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation
summary: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware

AI.tldr: NutriVision是一个端到端框架，利用单张RGB图像和可选配料表，通过视觉几何与语义线索估计营养信息，在Nutrition5k上平均PMAE达13.60%。
AI.motivation: 营养估计在饮食追踪、临床营养、慢性病管理等领域至关重要，但现有方法分成两条独立路线：依赖标定RGB-D的视觉模型和仅用文本线索的配料感知方法，融合有限。
AI.method: 用DepthAnything-V3获取深度模态，CLIP编码配料描述，并整合三个机制：IC-FAFM（配料条件频率对齐融合）、IA-MPH（配料感知掩码预测头，门控与通道掩码以食物身份为条件）、以及模态特定的ISM语义建模块。
AI.result: 在Nutrition5k上平均PMAE为13.60±0.10%，优于IGSMNet 0.89个百分点、OmniFood8k 2.90个百分点（均p<0.001）。消融显示IA-MPH为主要贡献模块，提升1.50±0.17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 配料条件预测与频率感知RGB-D融合能显著提升单图营养估计，且无需专用深度传感硬件，为营养评估系统提供实用路径。

title: Reuse or Relearn? A Spectral View of Earth Observation Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models are rarely used as generic, frozen feature extractors; instead, they are fine-tuned for the target downstream application. This practice is particularly prevalent in Earth observation (EO), and it raises a question that downstream accuracy alone cannot answer: does fine-tuning reuse the pretrained representation, or does it relearn a new one? We study this with spectral diagnostics that compare a model before and after adaptation, quantifying how well its dominant singular subspaces are preserved, how broadly the weight update is distributed, and how large it is. Using natural image models such as CLIP and DINO as a reference, we find that, under the evaluated fine-tuning settings, EO models undergo far larger, higher-rank updates and retain much less of their pretrained structure, so their downstream performance is often obtained with substantial changes to the pretrained weight structure. The diagnostics further provide insight into how cheaply a model can be adapted: where the pretrained subspaces are preserved, adapting a small fraction of the parameters can match full fine-tuning, and where they are not, it can fall behind. More broadly, foundation models, and EO foundation models in particular, should be assessed not only by benchmark accuracy, but also by how reusable their pretrained representation is.

AI.tldr: 本文用谱诊断方法分析微调前后模型，发现地球观测（EO）基础模型在微调时产生更大、更高秩的权重更新，保留的预训练结构远少于自然图像模型（CLIP、DINO）。
AI.motivation: 基础模型很少被当作通用冻结特征提取器，而是针对下游任务微调，尤其在EO领域。仅看下游精度无法回答关键问题：微调是复用预训练表示还是重新学习新表示？
AI.method: 提出谱诊断指标，比较模型适配前后的状态：主导奇异子空间的保留程度、权重更新的分布广度及其大小。以CLIP、DINO等自然图像模型为参照。
AI.result: 在评测的微调设置下，EO模型经历更大、更高秩的更新，预训练结构保留更少，其下游性能常伴随预训练权重结构的显著改变。诊断还揭示适配成本：预训练子空间被保留时，少参适配可媲美全量微调；未被保留时则会落后。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型（尤其EO基础模型）不应仅以基准精度评估，还应评估其预训练表示的可复用性。

title: The Commit-Abstain Circuit: Why Language Models Hallucinate Instead of Abstaining
summary: Language models (LMs) often hallucinate by committing to confident answers rather than abstaining, even when they do not have enough information to answer reliably. A large body of existing work mitigates hallucination through detection or abstention mechanisms, but leaves open how models internally arrive at the decision to commit or abstain in the first place. We study this decision through mechanistic analysis, framing hallucination as unsupported commitment: the model commits despite exhibiting signals of unanswerability. Using causal gating, we identify a Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC), a sparse, causally localised subset of attention heads and MLP sublayers underlying this decision. Across ten LMs (3B-14B) from five families and three benchmarks, the CAC exhibits a recurring accumulate-yet-undercorrect pattern: commitment-promoting components build up commitment in earlier layers, while abstention-promoting components act later as corrective signals that are often insufficient to overturn the accumulated commitment. Building on this finding, a lightweight policy trained on CAC activations improves decision accuracy by 12.2 points over the model's intrinsic commit-abstain margin, reduces false abstentions by 2.5 times, transfers to unseen benchmarks, and extends to larger models (27B-35B). The CAC is both diagnostic, clarifying how models overcommit, and practical, enabling improved abstention decisions.

AI.tldr: 该论文从机制可解释性角度研究语言模型的"承诺-弃权"决策，识别出一条稀疏因果的Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC)，揭示其"累积却修正不足"的模式，并据此训练轻量策略显著提升弃权决策准确率。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常在信息不足时仍给出自信答案而非弃权（幻觉），现有工作多聚焦检测或弃权机制，但未解释模型内部如何做出"承诺或弃权"这一决策。
AI.method: 将幻觉定义为"无支撑承诺"（模型在显示不可答信号时仍承诺），使用因果门控（causal gating）识别出Commit-Abstain Circuit（CAC）——一组稀疏、因果局部的注意力头和MLP子层。在10个模型（3B-14B，5个家族）和3个基准上分析该回路。基于CAC激活训练一个轻量策略来改进弃权决策。
AI.result: CAC呈现"累积却修正不足"模式：承诺促进组件在早期层累积承诺，弃权促进组件在后期作为纠正信号但常不足以逆转。基于CAC激活的策略相比模型内在承诺-弃权margin提升12.2个百分点决策准确率，假弃权减少2.5倍，可迁移到未见基准并扩展到更大模型（27B-35B）。
AI.conclusion: CAC既具诊断价值（阐明模型如何过度承诺），又具实用价值（改进弃权决策），为理解和缓解幻觉提供了机制层面的新视角。

title: When Words Fall Short: Iterative Synergy Between Verbalized Reasoning and Hidden Features for LLM Confidence Estimation
summary: Confidence estimation is crucial for developing trustworthy large language models (LLMs), with most methods following estimator-based or verbalization-based paradigms. While recent research increasingly focuses on improving verbalized self-reports of confidence, we challenge the prevailing view that this approach surpasses independent confidence estimators. Our empirical study shows that a dedicated confidence estimator can substantially outperform verbalized confidence, indicating that LLMs' internal representations contain richer confidence signals. Building on this finding, we propose Iterative Policy-Estimator Training (IPoET), a framework that synergizes the complementary strengths of verbalized reasoning traces and informative representations. IPoET alternates policy optimization with estimator updating, integrating estimator-derived confidence feedback into policy learning and refreshing the estimator on new policy rollouts. Experiments across diverse datasets and Qwen and Llama backbones demonstrate that, by iteratively exploiting richer hidden features and adapting to the evolving policy distribution, IPoET consistently outperforms both estimator- and verbalization-based baselines in-domain and achieves superior or comparable results across all out-of-domain metrics. For more details, refer to https://github.com/xyk829/ipoet.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑"语言化置信度优于独立估计器"的主流观点，提出IPoET框架协同语言化推理与内部表示，在域内和域外均超越基线。
AI.motivation: 构建可信LLM需要准确的置信度估计。现有方法分为估计器式和语言化式两类，近期研究多认为语言化自报告优于独立估计器，但作者对此提出质疑。
AI.method: 实证发现专用置信度估计器可显著超越语言化置信度，说明LLM内部表示含更丰富信号。据此提出Iterative Policy-Estimator Training (IPoET)：交替进行策略优化与估计器更新，将估计器置信度反馈融入策略学习，并在新策略rollout上刷新估计器。
AI.result: 在多种数据集及Qwen、Llama骨干上，IPoET持续优于估计器式和语言化式基线（域内），且在所有域外指标上达到更优或相当结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过迭代利用更丰富的隐藏特征并适应演化的策略分布，IPoET有效融合语言化推理与内部表示优势，为可信LLM置信度估计提供了更优方案。

title: Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality
summary: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

AI.tldr: 用深度可分离因子化构建极轻量3D U-Net，参数仅536,990，在MSD肝肿瘤分割上超越现有方法并具正则化效果。
AI.motivation: 3D密集卷积网络在体素医学分割中性能最强，但参数量随卷积核扩展急剧膨胀（k×k到k×k×k使权重乘k），导致3D模型参数过多，难以在小数据医学场景中应用。
AI.method: 利用深度可分离因子化的不对称性：立方核代价仅作用于深度阶段，主导参数量的逐点投影不变，因此同架构2D到3D仅增长5%（密集U-Net增长200%）。据此构建3D U-Net。并进一步测试用固定位移替换部分可学习空间滤波器。
AI.result: 模型536,990参数，比同类密集3D U-Net少24倍。MSD Task03 Liver五折交叉验证：肿瘤Dice 0.577（95% CI [0.518,0.633]），肝脏Dice 0.947（95% CI [0.941,0.952]）。肝脏Dice超越已有报告；肿瘤Dice超过低分辨率配置0.107、2D配置0.5394，且参数约1/24。同条件对比密集3D U-Net：肝脏+0.031（p=0.006），肿瘤+0.041（p=0.056）。部分空间滤波器可替换为固定位移而不损精度，全部替换则显著变差。
AI.conclusion: 深度可分离因子化可大幅降低3D分割网络参数量，并作为正则化器在小数据医学场景中提升性能；空间容量的放置位置比其总量更重要。

title: The Extender: A Log-Structured Transformer
summary: We introduce the Extender, a log-structured variant of the standard Transformer architecture. In a standard Transformer, each layer communicates with subsequent layers exclusively via the residual $\mathbf{h}$, a superposition channel. The Extender adds a concatenation channel $\mathbf{x}$: each layer $\ell$ emits both a residual update $δ_\ell$ which is added to $\mathbf{h}$, and a much smaller extension $ε_\ell$ which is appended to $\mathbf{x}$. While both the FFN and $\mathbf{q}$ see $\mathbf{h}$, the attention $\mathbf{kv}$ projections take only $\mathbf{x}$ as input. As a result, the fully extended $\mathbf{x}$ contains the complete input for the $\mathbf{kv}$ projections of all layers, reducing the persistent attention memory footprint from $2Ld_{model}$ to $\sum|ε_\ell|$. We find that with $|ε_\ell|=32$, the Extender matches Transformer accuracy on short-context (CORE) tasks at 199M-924M parameters, and exceeds Transformer accuracy on long-context (RULER) workloads, again at 924M parameters. For our 1664-wide, 924M model, the Extender's persistent attention memory footprint is $104\times$ smaller than MHA. The memory savings grow with model width.

AI.tldr: 提出Extender，一种日志结构化的Transformer变体，通过引入拼接通道x替代传统残差叠加通道来传递层间信息，大幅降低注意力KV缓存内存占用，同时保持甚至提升精度。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer各层仅通过残差h（叠加通道）向后传递信息，导致KV投影需要持久化保存全部层的KV，内存占用为2Ld_model，随模型宽度增长显著。作者希望降低这一持续注意力内存开销。
AI.method: Extender在残差h之外增加拼接通道x：每层ℓ输出残差更新δ_ℓ（加到h）和较小的扩展ε_ℓ（追加到x）。FFN和q投影读取h，而kv投影仅以x为输入。完整的x包含所有层kv投影所需的全部输入，从而将持久注意力内存从2Ld_model降至Σ|ε_ℓ|。
AI.result: 在|ε_ℓ|=32时，Extender在199M–924M参数规模上于短上下文(CORE)任务达到与Transformer相当的精度；在924M参数下于长上下文(RULER)任务上超过Transformer，且其1664宽、924M模型的持久注意力内存比MHA小104倍，节省随模型宽度增大而增加。
AI.conclusion: Extender通过日志结构化设计有效解决了注意力内存瓶颈，在保持精度甚至提升长上下文性能的同时实现显著内存节省，且收益随模型规模扩大而增强。

title: RGDT-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning for Rule-Governed Decisions and Their Justifications
summary: We study reasoning in Rule-Governed Decision Tasks (RGDTs), where models apply external rules to case facts and justify decisions, as required in policy, contract, and compliance settings. Beyond the deductive capability emphasized by standard mathematical and logical reasoning tasks, RGDTs require interpreting rules and their applicability, assessing conditions from evidence, combining judgments under rules and exceptions, and providing checkable justifications. These demands motivate a benchmark assessing both decisions and their stated grounds. We introduce RGDT-Bench, providing 202.1K condition-level supervision slots across four task tracks and eight supported task-probe combinations that vary access to supporting information. Label-blind extraction and deterministic checks produce labels for warrant completeness: source-referenced coverage and consistency of stated decision grounds. The benchmark attributes failures to four process layers: rule use, condition, evidence, and aggregation, and checks the final outcome. Among evaluable correct responses, warrant incompleteness averages 40.2% across six evaluated LLMs and supported task-probe combinations. Such warrant incompleteness poses potential safety risks and remains difficult to detect: the best of seventeen existing evaluators reaches only 57.69% (random: 50%) task-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). To address this difficulty, we train a simple reward model with warrant supervision. It achieves 69.24% task-averaged AUROC among correct answers, exceeding the matched outcome-supervised baseline by 10.37 pp (percentage points) and the best existing evaluator by 11.55 pp. Beyond completeness assessment, the model outperforms both outcome-supervised baselines across nearly all response-selection comparisons, supporting RGDT-Bench's warrant supervision for RGDT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RGDT-Bench 基准，用于评估规则治理决策任务中模型决策及其理由（warrant）的完整性与一致性，揭示现有 LLM 理由不完整问题并训练奖励模型加以缓解。
AI.motivation: 政策、合同、合规等场景要求模型依据外部规则对案件事实作出决策并给出可检验的理由，这超出了标准数学/逻辑推理所强调的演绎能力，需要解释规则适用性、评估证据条件、结合规则与例外进行判断并提供可核查的论证，因此亟需同时评估决策与理由的基准。
AI.method: 构建 RGDT-Bench，包含 202.1K 条件级监督槽，覆盖四个任务赛道和八种任务-探针组合（改变支持信息访问）。采用标签盲提取与确定性检查，为 warrant 完整性生成标签（来源引用覆盖度与决策依据一致性），并将失败归因于规则使用、条件、证据、聚合四个流程层，同时检查最终结果。此外训练一个带 warrant 监督的简单奖励模型。
AI.result: 在可评估的正确回答中，六个 LLM 及支持的组合上 warrant 不完整率平均达 40.2%。十七个现有评估器最佳仅达 57.69% 任务平均 AUROC（随机为 50%）。warrant 监督奖励模型在正确回答中达 69.24% AUROC，超过匹配的结果监督基线 10.37 个百分点，超过最佳现有评估器 11.55 个百分点，并在几乎所有响应选择比较中优于结果监督基线。
AI.conclusion: warrant 不完整普遍存在且难以检测，带来潜在安全风险；RGDT-Bench 的 warrant 监督能有效支持 RGDT 推理评估，训练后的奖励模型在完整性和响应选择上均显著优于基线。

title: SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment
summary: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.

AI.tldr: SemReward-VL：用临床结果作为语义奖励，通过GRPO微调VLM，从发育筛查视频中生成条目特异的行为描述。
AI.motivation: 发育筛查视频记录儿童行为，但临床记录只有结果、缺少过程描述，需要模型从结果反推条目特异的行为描述。
AI.method: VLM生成描述，冻结语言模型按与临床结果一致性、与条目相关性、无关视频-条目对的弃答和清晰度打分作为语义奖励；用GRPO更新LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 在13,379个视频、41个条目上，提升了总体准确率和召回率高于0.5的条目数量；仍存在时序方向、持续时间和年龄特异解释的错误。
AI.conclusion: 语义奖励驱动的GRPO可有效改善发育筛查行为描述生成，但时序、时长与年龄相关理解仍需改进。

title: AnchorMixGAN: Anchor-Aligned Generative Semi-Supervision for DDoS Detection in Cloud-Integrated IoT Networks
summary: Detecting distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks in cloud-integrated IoT networks is difficult when labeled traffic is scarce. Generative semi-supervised learning can supplement the available training data, but prediction shifts induced by synthetic views may affect the targets assigned to real unlabeled flows. We propose AnchorMixGAN, a generative semi-supervised framework that addresses this problem through anchor-aligned target construction. Its Anchor-MAS module treats each real unlabeled flow as an anchor and creates alternative views by replacing one field group at a time with values from generated traffic. A frozen reference classifier predicts the anchor and its views; averaging and sharpening these predictions produces a soft target for the original flow. The flow and its target are then mixed with a labeled example using MixUp, allowing the detector to learn from both the original labeled records and the mixed examples. We analyze how reference-classifier error, view construction, and sharpening affect the target, and derive a bound on the resulting change in cross-entropy at a fixed detector prediction. At the reported 90% training setting with 20% of the training records labeled, AnchorMixGAN attains accuracies of 97.3%, 97.4%, and 96.5% on NSLKDD, BoT-IoT, and CICIoT2023, respectively, exceeding the corresponding MixGAN results by 1.6, 1.0, and 4.4 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出AnchorMixGAN生成式半监督框架，通过锚点对齐目标构建缓解合成视图导致的预测偏移，用于云集成IoT网络DDoS检测。
AI.motivation: 云集成IoT网络中标注流量稀缺，DDoS检测困难。生成式半监督学习可补充训练数据，但合成视图诱导的预测偏移会影响分配给真实无标注流量的目标。
AI.method: 核心为Anchor-MAS模块：将每个真实无标注流作为锚点，每次用一个字段组替换为生成流量值构建替代视图；用冻结参考分类器预测锚点及视图，对预测进行平均与锐化得到软目标；再通过MixUp将流与其目标同有标注样本混合训练检测器。并分析参考分类器误差、视图构建、锐化对目标的影响，推导固定检测器预测下交叉熵变化的界。
AI.result: 在90%训练设置、20%标注记录下，NSLKDD、BoT-IoT、CICIoT2023准确率分别为97.3%、97.4%、96.5%，较MixGAN分别提升1.6、1.0、4.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 锚点对齐目标构建有效缓解合成视图诱导的预测偏移，在标注稀缺的IoT DDoS检测中显著优于基线MixGAN。

title: Certified Long-Horizon Code Agent Evolution via Validation-Gated Skill Optimization
summary:
Long horizon agent self-evolution without model weight updates is essential for enabling deployed agents to accumulate reusable skills and improve over time. Prior self-evolution work has focused primarily on short-horizon tasks, while repository-level software engineering remains unexplored despite being an ideal testbed for long-horizon adaptation. In this setting, agents are required to solve streams of sequential tasks, navigate complex dependencies with evolving repositories and persistently store and reuse experience. Text-based skill optimization offers an efficient, non-parametric approach for such adaptation. However, existing methods often suffer from unstable updates, performance drawdown, and agent collapse over extended deployments. In this paper, we formalize the concept of in-context self-evolution and introduce VALVE, a validated-gated framework for long-horizon skill optimization. We establish finite convergence, provide theoretical guarantees for future-task gain and drawdown, and derive the validation and evaluation holdout sizes required for a prescribed tolerance, with leading-order scaling
  Empirically, our pipeline, VALVE achieves stable self-improvement over evolution horizon spanning more than 1,000 SWE tasks, with average final and peak gains of $14.9$ and $16.5$ points across three frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude-4.6 and MiniMax-M2.7). The validation gate reduces average drawdown by 75% and produces an 11x more compact skill bank than ungated evolution. We further present extensive ablations identifying the design choices most critical to long-horizon skill evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化"上下文自演化"概念，提出VALVE——一个带验证门控的长时程技能优化框架，在1000+ SWE任务上实现稳定自改进，并给出收敛性与回撤的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 已部署智能体需在不更新权重的前提下积累可复用技能并持续提升，这对长时程任务是必需的。现有自演化研究多聚焦短时程任务，仓库级软件工程这一长时程适应理想试验场仍未被探索；且现有文本技能优化方法在长期部署中存在更新不稳定、性能回撤和智能体崩溃等问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义"in-context self-evolution"；提出VALVE，一种验证门控（validated-gated）的长时程技能优化框架，用于过滤不稳定的技能更新、抑制回撤并保持技能库紧凑。
AI.result: 理论上证明了有限收敛性，给出未来任务增益与回撤的保证，并推导出满足给定容忍度所需的验证集与评估留出集规模及其主导阶缩放。实验上，在跨越1000+个SWE任务的演化时程中实现稳定自改进，三个前沿模型（GPT-5.5、Claude-4.6、MiniMax-M2.7）平均最终增益与峰值增益分别为14.9和16.5分；验证门控将平均回撤降低75%，技能库比无门控演化紧凑11倍。此外通过大量消融实验识别了长时程技能演化中最关键的设计选择。
AI.conclusion: VALVE为长时程、无权重更新的智能体自演化提供了有理论保障且经验有效的方案，验证门控是抑制回撤、保持技能库紧凑的关键机制。

title: CARDAMOM: A Micro-Dialectal Arabic Speech Dataset for ASR
summary: We present Cardamom, a micro-dialectal Arabic speech dataset designed to support fine-grained evaluation and adaptation of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. Community-curated by native speakers familiar with the represented varieties, Cardamom contains approximately 40 hours of transcribed YouTube speech spanning 21 micro-dialects across Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Mauritania, Palestine, and Saudi Arabia. Each segment is annotated with one or more operational micro-dialect labels, code-switching information, and utterance-level perceived gender, enabling analysis of sub-country variation that is obscured by conventional country-level labels. We describe the collection and annotation process, motivate the micro-dialect inventory linguistically, and benchmark four multilingual ASR systems in zero-shot and adapted settings. The strongest zero-shot system obtains 43.47% aggregate WER, with particularly high error rates on Mauritanian and Lebanese varieties; adaptation on Cardamom reduces its WER to 35.21%. Audio-based identification experiments further show that the annotations provide a learnable prediction target, with a dedicated classifier reaching 85.57% accuracy on 21-way micro-dialect identification. Cardamom provides a resource for studying localized dialectal variation and developing Arabic speech systems with broader regional coverage.

AI.tldr: Cardamom是一个阿拉伯语微方言语音数据集，包含21个微方言，用于ASR的细粒度评估与自适应。
AI.motivation: 传统国家级标签掩盖了国家内部的语言变异，需要更细粒度的方言资源来评估和提升ASR系统。
AI.method: 由熟悉方言的母语者社区协作构建，含约40小时YouTube语音，覆盖埃及、约旦、黎巴嫩、毛里塔尼亚、巴勒斯坦、沙特阿拉伯的21个微方言；每段标注微方言标签、语码转换信息和感知性别，并对四种多语言ASR系统进行零样本与自适应评测。
AI.result: 最强零样本系统聚合WER为43.47%，毛里塔尼亚和黎巴嫩方言错误率尤其高；自适应后WER降至35.21%；微方言识别分类器达到85.57%准确率。
AI.conclusion: Cardamom为研究局部方言变异和开发区域覆盖更广的阿拉伯语语音系统提供了资源。

title: dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding
summary: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.

AI.tldr: 论文研究固定预算下的稀疏视频证据选择，发现全局Top-K选择器虽保持识别与定位，但事件证据不稳定（Frame AUC 51.5）。提出dKFD，一种分阶段可微选择器，在编码后将预算分配到事件前、事件、事件后三个阶段。K=12时Frame AUC提升+30.97（p<0.01），识别略升、定位相当。阶段监督是关键机制。
AI.motivation: 针对时间局部化事件，稀疏选择器通常全局分配固定帧预算，使所有帧相互竞争。但有用证据往往分布在事件前背景、事件本身与事件后结果中，全局竞争是较差的归纳偏置，导致事件证据不稳定。
AI.method: 提出dKFD：阶段结构化的可微选择器。先进行全序列时间编码，再在事件前、事件、事件后三个阶段间预留证据容量，并引入阶段监督。
AI.result: DoTA异常识别上，全局Top-K在K=12时Frame AUC仅51.5±10.8。dKFD在同预算多种子下Frame AUC提升+30.97（p<0.01），识别小幅显著提升，定位相当。去除阶段监督后Frame AUC降至41.1±12.0。VRU-Accident上跨VLM家族均有增益，稠密描述任务中均匀采样仍有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 阶段结构化分配是一种可控的固定预算事件中心稀疏证据选择方法，而非通用视频摘要策略。阶段监督是核心机制。

title: Structuring Relations Among Learning Paradigms via Protocol--Objective--Resource Reductions
summary: Modern machine learning spans supervised, transfer, continual, meta-learning, and related regimes that often reuse the same hypothesis classes, architectures, and optimizers but differ in information access, objectives, memory, adaptation, and sample accounting. This makes it difficult to determine whether one paradigm is genuinely distinct, a special case of another, or part of a broader structural hierarchy. We introduce a protocol-objective-resource (POR) framework that separates representational capacity from these design choices. A paradigm is specified by an environment class, observation protocol, admissible learners, performance functional, and resource accounting rule. POR reductions combine environment embeddings, learner compilers, threshold maps, and calibrated resource overheads. Our main theorem shows that such reductions imply worst-case complexity domination on embedded comparison classes, transferring upper bounds forward and lower bounds backward; under labeled-example accounting, this yields sample complexity domination. We also show that calibrated nontrivial accuracy regimes are necessary to avoid vacuous comparisons, and that strengthening the objective can strictly increase minimax sample complexity even with unchanged protocols and learner classes. Instantiating the framework for supervised, transfer, continual, and meta-learning yields canonical special-case relations: continual contains transfer, transfer contains supervised, and meta-learning contains supervised under aligned raw-example accounting. We further derive a non-exact episode-to-example reduction for episodic meta-learning and capture within-paradigm refinements such as replay memory and task identifiers. The framework thus provides a unified language for structuring learning paradigms and transferring complexity guarantees across them.

AI.tldr: 提出 POR 框架，将学习范式分解为协议、目标、资源三层设计选择，并用归约证明范式间的复杂度支配关系，统一刻画监督、迁移、持续与元学习。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习涵盖监督、迁移、持续、元学习等范式，它们常复用相同的假设类、架构与优化器，仅在信息访问、目标、记忆、适应方式和样本记账上不同，导致难以判断某一范式是真正独立、另一范式的特例，还是更广泛层次结构的一部分。
AI.method: 提出 protocol-objective-resource (POR) 框架，将表示能力与设计选择分离。范式由环境类、观察协议、允许的学习器、性能泛函和资源记账规则定义。POR 归约结合环境嵌入、学习器编译器、阈值映射和校准的资源开销。
AI.result: 主定理表明 POR 归约蕴含嵌入比较类上的最坏情况复杂度支配，前向传递上界、后向传递下界；在带标签样本记账下导出样本复杂度支配。还证明校准的非平凡精度区间是避免空洞比较的必要条件，并表明在协议和学习器类不变时加强目标可严格增大极小极大样本复杂度。实例化后得到持续学习包含迁移学习、迁移学习包含监督学习、元学习在原始样本记账对齐下包含监督学习等关系，并导出情节式元学习的非精确 episode-to-example 归约，刻画重放记忆与任务标识等范式内细化。
AI.conclusion: POR 框架为组织学习范式、跨范式迁移复杂度保证提供了统一语言。

title: X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization
comment: Project in Progress. Homepage: https://sitaocheng.github.io/xtree/. Code: https://github.com/sitaocheng/X-Tree/
summary: Multi-step agents are trained on flat action streams: SFT and RLVR weight every token uniformly and ignore the sub-procedures that recur across tasks, the hierarchy that lets humans plan top-down from reusable routines. This structure sits unused, and flat training uses each scarce trajectory less fully than its content allows. Recent agents do use that structure, but only as LLM-written skills in context, never in the weights, so their gains do not generalize beyond retrieval. We instead recover this hierarchy from the data itself and train on it, with no LLM calls. Following text tokenizers, which build a vocabulary by counting alone, we score action spans by reusability and merge canonicalized actions into a reusable eXperience tree (X-Tree). Each X-Tree node captures how a frequent and success-bearing skill is composed from sub-skills, guiding efficient generalization. We integrate X-Tree into three training settings: offline RL, with each node as a training instance; online RLVR, with an adaptive skill bonus; and on-policy self-distillation, with X-Tree as the self-teacher's privileged context. Across WebArena, ScienceWorld, and WebShop at three model scales, X-Tree improves over standard recipes at matched data and budget by up to 4.5% SR on WebArena, 5.8% SR on ScienceWorld and 4.1% success on WebShop. Matched analyses attribute the gains to the X-Tree structure and the three integrations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出X-Tree：从数据中自动挖掘可复用子程序层级结构，并用其指导多步智能体的训练，无需LLM调用，在多个基准上超越标准训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体训练（SFT、RLVR）在扁平动作流上均匀加权所有token，忽略了跨任务复现的子过程与层级结构，导致稀缺轨迹利用不充分；现有利用层级的方法仅在上下文中使用LLM编写的技能，未融入权重，泛化有限。
AI.method: 仿照文本分词器仅靠计数构建词表，按可复用性对动作片段打分，并将规范化动作合并为可复用的经验树（X-Tree），节点刻画技能由子技能组合的方式。将X-Tree集成到三种训练中：离线RL（每个节点作为训练实例）、在线RLVR（自适应技能奖励）、在线自蒸馏（X-Tree作为自教师的特权上下文）。
AI.result: 在WebArena、ScienceWorld、WebShop三个基准、三种模型规模下，相同数据与预算时相比标准方法：WebArena最高+4.5% SR，ScienceWorld+5.8% SR，WebShop+4.1% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 匹配分析表明增益来自X-Tree结构及三种集成方式；从数据中恢复层级结构并训练能有效提升多步智能体泛化，且无需LLM调用。

title: Papers Without Code: Availability of GitHub Repositories Linked in *CL Publications
comment: Accepted for publication in Computational Linguistics. Author's final version (pre-MIT Press publication)
summary: Source code and data published at computational linguistics (*CL) venues are increasingly being shared via GitHub. While this generally is a favourable development for the accessibility and potential reusability of research artifacts in natural language processing (NLP), the long-term availability of such repositories has not been evaluated. In this squib, we discuss the availability of repositories linked in papers published in the Computational Linguistics (CL) journal as well as at ACL and its co-located events over the past ten years. Contrary to our expectations, we find that GitHub repositories linked in more recent ACL publications are unavailable at similar rates as in older publications, in parts due to an increase in empty and placeholder repositories. Similar trends hold for other *CL venues, but not for platforms other than GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了NLP领域论文中GitHub仓库的长期可用性，发现近期ACL等会议论文的仓库不可用率与旧论文相近，部分因空仓库和占位仓库增加。
AI.motivation: NLP研究中代码和数据越来越多通过GitHub共享，这有利于研究件的可访问性和可复用性，但这些仓库的长期可用性尚未被评估。
AI.method: 调查过去十年发表在Computational Linguistics期刊、ACL及其同址活动论文中链接的GitHub仓库的可用性。
AI.result: 与预期相反，更新的ACL论文中链接的GitHub仓库不可用率与旧论文相似，部分原因是空仓库和占位仓库增加。其他*CL场所也有类似趋势，但GitHub以外的平台没有。
AI.conclusion: NLP领域研究件的长期可用性存在问题，且未随年份改善，需要关注仓库维护与存档。

title: QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing
summary: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/QSCP

AI.tldr: 提出 query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP)，支持类别名、同义词与意图句查询，返回查询专属掩码及配对时序语义图。
AI.motivation: 现有 RCD 仅用类别提示指定变化目标并返回二值掩码，无法满足用户对特定转变及配对语义图（"变成什么"）的需求，需要显式的源-目标推理。
AI.method: QSCP 将请求解析为意图与语义槽位，组合双向视觉证据，并用查询条件化解码器预测两个时序状态。
AI.result: 在 SECOND 上，QSCP 在同义词、句子和转变查询上优于 RCDNet，端到端语义预测优于评估的语义基线；WHU-CDC 实验验证了无目标域训练的跨数据集迁移与等价表达一致性。
AI.conclusion: QSCP 扩展了 RCD 能力，支持灵活查询与配对语义输出，具备良好泛化性，代码已开源。

title: Continual Learning via Self-Probe Gradients
summary: Adapting pretrained models to new data can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously learned behavior. When only a few past samples remain, they give continual learning methods sparse and narrow evidence about what to preserve. We show that language models can expand this evidence through self-probing, in which the frozen model generates new inputs from the retained samples and records its own predictions on them. Unlike prior work that replays such data as training examples, our method, CPLUS uses self-probe and past-sample gradients to scale down parameter updates that conflict with prior behavior. Experiments with five language models on four benchmarks show three results. First, the same probes preserve more prior behavior as gradient signals than as replay data. Second, CPLUS learns the new data while consistently reducing forgetting more than existing baselines, especially when past data are scarce, and this protection extends to benchmarks not used for training. Third, we observe that CPLUS also becomes more effective as models grow: within the Qwen3 model family, it recovers an increasing share of the forgetting caused by standard fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 CPLUS：用自探测(self-probe)生成梯度信号来约束参数更新，缓解语言模型持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，在少样本场景下优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 适应新数据会导致预训练模型灾难性遗忘；当过去样本稀少时，持续学习方法获得的“需要保留什么”的证据既稀疏又狭窄，需要扩展这类证据。
AI.method: 利用冻结模型的自我探测：从保留的旧样本生成新输入，并记录模型自身的预测。与以往将探测数据作为重放训练样本不同，CPLUS 将自我探测数据与过去样本的梯度结合，用于缩放（抑制）与先前行为相冲突的参数更新。
AI.result: 在 5 个语言模型、4 个基准上：(1) 同样的探测作为梯度信号比作为重放数据更能保留旧行为；(2) CPLUS 学习新数据的同时遗忘更少，尤其在过去数据稀缺时优势明显，且保护作用可泛化到未参与训练的基准；(3) 在 Qwen3 系列中，模型越大 CPLUS 越有效，能恢复标准微调造成的遗忘中越来越大的比例。
AI.conclusion: 自我探测的梯度信号是一种比数据重放更有效的抗遗忘手段，CPLUS 在少样本持续学习中一致减少遗忘，并随模型规模增大而收益提升。

title: Model-Aware Data Selection from In-and-Out Information Interplay
summary:
LLMs are effective representations that assimilate vast amounts of knowledge during pretraining, but post-training is necessary for models to reliably access this knowledge and "know what they know." We observe an interesting rank equilibrium between knowledge stored in the weights and the data stream passing through the model. Across all model layers, we find that the hidden states (data stream) follow a U-shaped pattern, showing substantial compression in early layers and a steep rise during the late-layer decoding phase. In contrast, the weight rank follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, with very low rank in the early and late layers and high rank in the middle. We interpret this as an in-and-out information interplay: intermediate activations do not need to carry content that the weights can supply later, so they primarily preserve what the weights cannot provide.
  Motivated by this observation, we propose a model-aware data selection method, CAP (Counterfactual Assimilation Profile), which can determine whether a data candidate contains information accessible to the current model by utilizing the divergence gap in early- and late-layer representations between model-generated and reference responses. Across math, code, and science domains, CAP delivers 35.4% greater average improvement over the base model than the strongest baseline under different selection budgets. With only 10% of the data pool, CAP surpasses or matches full-pool training on math and science. We further show that CAP transfers to multimodal data selection and is robust to response horizon and noise.

AI.tldr: 论文发现模型权重与数据流在网络层间存在U型与倒U型的秩均衡，据此提出模型感知的数据选择方法CAP，在数学、代码、科学任务上均优于最强基线。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练已存大量知识，但需后训练才能可靠访问并"知其所知"。作者观察到权重秩与隐藏状态秩在各层间呈互补模式（前者倒U型、后者U型），推测中间激活只需保留权重无法提供的信息，由此需要一种反映模型当前可获取信息的数据选择方法。
AI.method: 基于该观察提出CAP（Counterfactual Assimilation Profile）。它利用模型生成响应与参考响应在早层和晚层表示之间的散度差，判断候选数据是否含有当前模型可获取的信息，从而实现模型感知的数据选择。
AI.result: 在数学、代码、科学领域，CAP在不同选择预算下相比最强基线平均提升35.4%。仅用10%数据池即可在数学和科学上超越或匹配全池训练，并可迁移至多模态数据选择，对响应长度与噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 权重与数据流的秩均衡揭示了模型内外信息的互补机制；CAP据此有效筛选高价值训练数据，提升后训练效率与性能，具备跨模态与抗噪的通用性。

title: RoPE is Dead, Long Live RoPE: Towards Scalable Data-aware Positional Encodings
summary: Transformers process tokens without any inherent notion of order, making positional encoding a fundamental requirement rather than an architectural refinement. Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) has become the default positional encoding in modern language models, yet it is heavily biased toward nearby tokens. Existing alternatives have been evaluated under different settings, leaving the literature fragmented and without a clear replacement. We bring structure to this landscape by examining a specific weakness of RoPE: its slow frequency bands, whose wavelengths exceed the training context and expose models to unseen angles during extrapolation. We therefore introduce Data aware RoPE (DaRoPE), which preserves standard RoPE on the fast bands but replaces absolute position on the slow bands with bounded coordinates learned from contextual representations. Therefore, the slow-band geometry depends on the data rather than only on positional distance. We compare representative encodings under matched conditions across synthetic tasks, symbolic music, genomics, neural signals, and language models spanning 124M to 50B parameters. Across these experiments, DaRoPE leads on non-text benchmarks, mitigates recency bias, while remaining best or on par in language modeling and length extrapolation. Moreover, the learned coordinates also make the mechanism interpretable, revealing how attention layers leverage contextual information beyond token distance. Together, these results support DaRoPE as the best overall default among the evaluated methods, when there is no domain-specific reasons to prefer another.

AI.tldr: 提出 DaRoPE，通过将 RoPE 慢频带上的绝对位置替换为基于上下文学到的有界坐标，缓解位置编码偏差，在多领域和多种规模模型中表现优异。
AI.motivation: Transformer 本身无内置顺序概念，位置编码是必需组件。RoPE 是现代语言模型的默认选择，但严重偏向邻近 token，尤其在慢频带上波长远超训练上下文，导致外推时出现未见角度。现有替代方案评估设置不一，缺乏清晰结论，因此需要系统性比较并提出更好方案。
AI.method: 提出 DaRoPE：在快速频带上保留标准 RoPE，在慢速频带上用从上下文表示中学到的有界坐标替代绝对位置，使慢频带几何依赖数据而非仅依赖位置距离。在匹配条件下比较代表性编码方法。
AI.result: 在合成任务、符号音乐、基因组学、神经信号以及 124M 至 50B 参数的语言模型实验中，DaRoPE 在非文本基准上领先，缓解了近因偏差，同时在语言建模和长度外推上保持最佳或相当水平；学到的坐标还使机制更具可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 在没有领域特定偏好时，DaRoPE 是被评估方法中整体最优的默认选择。

title: Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段高效VLN方法：先构建显式、可压缩的教师模型（可导航查询+指令对齐），再通过查询瓶颈蒸馏训练紧凑学生模型，参数减少93.65%且性能接近教师。
AI.motivation: 大规模VLN模型精度高但参数量和计算需求大，部署成本高，需要高效VLN方案。
AI.method: 第一步构建教师模型：用少量可学习查询槽，经Navigable Query Generator从全景观测提取全局与局部充分导航证据，再用Instruction-Query Aligner逐步将证据token与指令对齐做策略预测。第二步以此查询瓶颈为蒸馏接口，用导航感知的token自适应目标蒸馏教师查询，并在微调时匹配动作分布，训练紧凑学生模型。
AI.result: 在标准VLN基准上，学生模型性能几乎与教师持平，参数量比教师减少93.65%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式可压缩的查询瓶颈与蒸馏，可实现高效VLN，兼顾性能与部署效率。

title: Beyond Gaussian Assumptions: Distribution-Aware Channel Capacity for Effective Connectivity
summary: Effective-connectivity estimation from brain signals often relies on Gaussian residual modeling, which enables tractable estimation but can discard informative distributional structure and distort inferred directed interactions when empirical residuals are non-Gaussian. We show across multiple modalities, species, and experimental conditions that both brain signals and fitted channel residuals frequently deviate from Gaussianity. We therefore introduce a distribution-aware, information-theoretic measure of effective connectivity based on channel capacity under general residual distributions. To estimate the resulting capacity from empirical, potentially non-Gaussian residuals, we develop a dual-flow min-max estimator based on normalizing flows, in which a generator searches over admissible input distributions under a power constraint while an observer estimates output entropy. We provide a theoretical characterization of the estimator, showing that the observer objective recovers differential entropy up to a KL approximation term, that the formulation reduces to classical Gaussian capacity as a special case, and that residual entropy can alter achievable information rates beyond variance; game-gap and error analyses further characterize optimization and approximation sources. In brain-like simulations with known directed connectivity, Dual-flow achieves the highest AUROC and AUPRC across ten conditions spanning diverse network topologies, hidden drivers, feedback, and heterogeneous hemodynamics, compared with Gaussian capacity, Granger causality, VAR-LiNGAM, and GIMME. Applied to multimodal brain signals, the method reveals time- and condition-resolved directed interactions consistent with known neurobiological circuitry. Together, these results establish a principled distribution-aware framework for effective-connectivity estimation beyond Gaussian residual modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文打破有效连接估计中惯用的高斯残差假设，提出基于信道容量、分布感知的信息论有效连接度量，并用归一化流构建双流min-max估计器（Dual-flow），在仿真与多模态脑信号上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统有效连接估计依赖高斯残差建模，估计虽易处理，但会丢弃有信息的分布结构；实证残差常为非高斯，导致推断的有向交互被扭曲。作者需验证该偏差的普遍性并加以纠正。
AI.method: 1）跨模态、物种、实验条件检验脑信号及拟合残差的非高斯性；2）提出基于一般残差分布下信道容量的分布感知信息论有效连接度量；3）用归一化流构造双流min-max估计器：生成器在功率约束下搜索可行输入分布，观测器估计输出熵；4）给出理论刻画（观测器目标含KL近似项恢复微分熵、退化为经典高斯容量、残差熵可改变可达信息率，并分析博弈间隙与误差来源）。
AI.result: 在已知有向连接的类脑仿真中，Dual-flow在涵盖多种网络拓扑、隐藏驱动、反馈与异质血流动力学的十个条件下取得最高AUROC与AUPRC，优于高斯容量、Granger因果、VAR-LiNGAM与GIMME；应用于多模态脑信号时，揭示出与已知神经回路一致的、时间与条件分辨的有向交互。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了超越高斯残差建模的、原理性的分布感知有效连接估计框架。

title: When Pair Count Is Not the Sample Size: What All-Pairs Agent Comparisons Estimate
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
summary: When an agent benchmark compares every pair of leaderboard entries, the number of comparisons can look much larger than the independent evidence behind them: A versus B and A versus C both reuse A. Whether this reuse affects inference depends on what the analysis is meant to describe. If the board and its outcomes are fixed, the all-pairs mean is an exact summary of those entries, and any interval must come from another declared source of randomness. If the entries are instead treated as iid draws from a population of future configurations and the pair rule is regular and nondegenerate, the same mean is an order-two U-statistic whose first-order uncertainty depends on the number of configurations, not the number of pairs. We use near ties as the running example, but the distinction extends to other symmetric pair summaries when their regularity conditions hold. We examine both interpretations using a fixed SWE-bench Verified snapshot and an exact binary model with known truth. On SWE-bench, intervals that accounted for shared configurations were more than twice as wide as a pair-iid reference that treated the pairs as independent. In the exact model, pair-iid coverage fell far below the nominal level when edges shared endpoints but remained near nominal for matched independent edges. Results on two other fixed leaderboards show that exact summaries also depend on which pairs are included and how they are weighted. An all-pairs analysis must therefore state what is fixed, what is sampled, and how it handles shared entries and pair aggregation.

AI.tldr: 论文区分了全对比较中两种分析视角：固定榜单下均值是精确摘要，而将条目视为iid抽样时均值是二阶U统计量，其不确定性取决于配置数而非对数。忽略共享配置会导致区间过窄、覆盖率不足。
AI.motivation: 全对排行榜比较中，A-B与A-C都复用了A，比较数量看起来远多于背后的独立证据。作者希望澄清这种复用是否影响推断，关键在于分析所描述的对象是什么。
AI.method: 作者区分两种解释：若榜单与结果固定，全对均值是这些条目的精确摘要，任何区间必须来自另一声明的随机性来源；若条目被视为来自未来配置总体的iid抽样且配对规则正则非退化，则同一均值是二阶U统计量。用近并列作为示例，并采用固定SWE-bench Verified快照和已知真值的精确二元模型进行检验。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench上，考虑共享配置的区间宽度是pair-iid参照的两倍以上。在精确模型中，当边共享端点时pair-iid覆盖率远低于标称水平，而匹配独立边时接近标称。另两个固定榜单结果表明精确摘要还依赖包含哪些对及如何加权。
AI.conclusion: 全对分析必须明确声明什么是固定的、什么是抽样的，以及如何处理共享条目与配对聚合。该区分可推广到满足正则条件的其他对称配对摘要。
