We study the internal processes accompanying this behavior, which we call context restoration, in controlled attention-only transformers and five pretrained LLMs (1B-32B parameters) across arithmetic, reading comprehension, and multiple-choice reasoning tasks. In the attention-only transformers, restoration emerges spontaneously despite training exclusively on clean sequences, without corruption training or an explicit denoising objective. We find that context restoration follows a two-phase process: early layers localize effects associated with repair at corrupted positions, while later layers accumulate these effects at uncorrupted positions through the residual stream and ultimately concentrate them at the output position. Repair outcome is predictable from hidden states: cosine alignment with the clean state is highly predictive in attention-only models, while linear probes recover additional information in pretrained LLMs. A linear probe using only the corrupted prompt's first-block hidden state predicts failure with mean ROC-AUC 0.78. This enables failure triage under matched or even partially shifted deployment conditions and may reduce unnecessary verification or computation. Failed examples also show substantially greater nonlinearity along corruption directions. Moderate-corruption finetuning increases corruption tolerance while simultaneously reducing displacement-normalized linearization error, associating improved robustness with a more nearly linear response to corruption.

AI.tldr: 研究语言模型在输入损坏时仍能输出正确答案的"上下文恢复"机制。发现恢复在两阶段过程中自发涌现：早期层在损坏位置定位修复效应，后期层通过残差流将其聚集到输出位置。隐藏状态可预测修复结果，线性探针可预测失败（平均ROC-AUC 0.78）。
AI.motivation: 语言模型有时在输入被删除、替换或拼写错误损坏时仍能产生正确输出，但这一行为背后的内部机制尚不清楚。作者希望理解这种"上下文恢复"的内部过程，并探索其可预测性与鲁棒性关联。
AI.method: 在受控的纯注意力（attention-only）变压器和五个预训练LLM（1B-32B参数）上，跨算术、阅读理解、多项选择推理任务进行研究。使用余弦对齐和线性探针分析隐藏状态对修复结果的预测能力，并考察损坏方向上的非线性及中等损坏微调的影响。
AI.result: 恢复在仅用干净序列训练时自发涌现，无需损坏训练或显式去噪目标。恢复呈两阶段过程：早期层在损坏位置定位修复效应，后期层通过残差流将效应累积到未损坏位置并集中于输出位置。余弦对齐在纯注意力模型中预测力强，线性探针在预训练LLM中恢复更多信息；仅用损坏提示第一块隐藏状态的线性探针以平均ROC-AUC 0.78预测失败。失败样本沿损坏方向表现出更大非线性。中等损坏微调提升损坏容忍度，同时降低位移归一化线性化误差。
AI.conclusion: 上下文恢复是模型自发涌现的两阶段机制，可通过隐藏状态预测修复结果，支持部署中的失败分流以减少验证与计算；鲁棒性提升与对损坏更接近线性的响应相关联。

title: Native Association: Confidence-Aware Human Perception in the Wild with a Foundation VLM
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Human-Centered Multimodal Intelligence in the Wild (HCMIW). 16 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables; supplementary material included as ancillary file
summary: Extracting who is where, on which team, wearing which number from a broadcast frame is typically done by stitching a detector, an OCR engine, and classifiers together -- and the stitching step swaps identities under occlusion. We make association native instead: a 0.77B vision-language model (Florence-2) is fine-tuned to emit all per-person attributes as one grammar-constrained sequence, with each attribute generated inside its owner's block. Output is therefore schema-valid on every frame by construction, and no post-hoc binding step exists to attach a correctly read number to the wrong player: residual misassociation is pure perception error, $\approx4\times$ rarer than zero-shot-prompted frontier APIs' (0.057 vs. 0.21-0.24). On a frozen multi-sport test set, this single pass reaches 0.95 detection F1 (APIs: 0.65-0.75). A single extra forward pass yields a per-field confidence that supports a reject option (jersey precision $0.71\rightarrow0.96$ at half coverage) and routes a training-free zoom-and-re-read for small players. Surprisingly, once the grammar is learned, further parameter-efficient tuning yields no measurable gain under the adaptation configurations we test; the identical recipe on WIDER-Attribute reaches 93.1 mAP given-box, yields the first detection-coupled end-to-end results under its standard test protocol (84.5 mAP), and reproduces the same tuning result. In this regime, the gains live in the structure, not in added weights.

AI.tldr: 通过微调0.77B视觉语言模型(Florence-2)，将人物属性(位置、队伍、号码)作为语法约束的单一序列输出，使关联成为模型原生能力，避免传统检测器+OCR+分类器拼接带来的错配问题。
AI.motivation: 传统广播图像人物属性提取需拼接检测器、OCR引擎和分类器，拼接步骤在遮挡下会交换身份，导致正确读取的号码被错误绑定到球员。
AI.method: 微调Florence-2模型，用语法约束让每个属性在其所属人物块内生成，输出天然符合schema；额外一次前向传播提供逐字段置信度(支持reject选项)并路由无训练的小球员放大重读。
AI.result: 残差错配仅约4倍于前沿API(0.057 vs 0.21-0.24)；多运动测试集单次通过达0.95检测F1(API:0.65-0.75)；球衣精度0.71→0.96(半覆盖)；WIDER-Attribute达93.1 mAP，标准协议下首个检测耦合端到端结果84.5 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 一旦学会语法，进一步参数高效微调无增益。该范式下收益来自结构而非增加权重。

title: Adaptive Ensemble Selection for Noisy Labels on Tabular Data
summary: Incorrect or corrupted labels in tabular datasets can significantly degrade supervised learning performance, particularly when mislabeling is subtle and not easily detectable from feature space alone. In the context of automated or AI-augmented data science workflows, robust detection of such label noise is critical for building reliable models. We propose a data-centric reasoning module for AI data science systems that automatically diagnoses dataset quality and selects appropriate cleaning strategies. Given a dataset, a meta-model predicts weights over a diverse set of detectors, including confidence-based, neighborhood-based, and distributional methods. Across benchmark datasets with controlled noise, our approach achieves performance comparable to a Confident Learning baseline on average, with dataset-dependent gains and losses, particularly in heterogeneous regimes. We further show that detector effectiveness is systematically linked to dataset properties. These results demonstrate the value of descriptor-driven, data-centric ensembling as a component of AI-assisted data-science pipelines for robust dataset assessment and model reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出一个数据中心的元模型，为表格数据自动加权多种标签噪声检测器，实现自适应清洗。
AI.motivation: 表格数据中的错误或损坏标签会显著降低监督学习性能，尤其当误标注微妙、难以从特征空间检测时。在自动化/AI增强的数据科学流程中，鲁棒的标签噪声检测对可靠模型至关重要。
AI.method: 一个数据中心推理模块，自动诊断数据集质量并选择清洗策略。给定数据集，元模型预测一组多样检测器的权重，包括基于置信度、邻域和分布的方法。
AI.result: 在受控噪声的基准数据集上，平均性能与Confident Learning基线相当，存在数据集相关的增益与损失，尤其在异质情形下。检测器有效性与数据集属性系统相关。
AI.conclusion: 描述符驱动的数据中心集成对AI辅助数据科学流程有价值，可用于鲁棒的数据集评估与模型可靠性。

title: DISCERN: Can AI Agents Work Like Scientists and Guide Discovery?
summary: Reliable automated research requires agents to vet data, verify analyses, and generate hypotheses grounded in trustworthy evidence, potentially reducing routine scientific workload while allowing scientists to focus on interpretation and discovery. Existing benchmarks often only assess analytical task completion or hypothesis generation separately rather than testing whether reliable evidence supports valid and novel claims. We introduce DISCERN (Data Integrity and Scientific Capability: Evidence, Reasoning, and Novelty), a controlled benchmark on real, publicly available datasets that evaluates three key levels of an automated research workflow. The first two levels test data integrity and analysis verification under confounds and tool traps, while the third tests hypothesis generation and revision under adversarial review, including counterfactual cases in which evidence consistent with real data and documented scientific phenomena conflicts with established expectations, motivating alternative explanations and testable hypotheses. Across 203 tasks, eight life-science tracks, and eight models, DISCERN shows that strong aggregate performance can mask level-specific weaknesses. Agents earn perfect scores in only 60.8% of Level 1, 34.2% of Level 2, and 0.6% of Level 3 evaluations, with penalties attributed to rejection of sound data, failure to carry recognized limitations into conclusions, and wide variation in hypothesis production. Cross-track rankings by token and code use are substantially more stable than rankings by evidence judgment, suggesting greater consistency in computational effort than in evidence-based reasoning. These profiles identify opportunities for supervised scientific assistance, but current agents do not yet demonstrate reliable autonomous analysis or discovery. Code and data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/discern-bench-anon/discern-benchmark

AI.tldr: 本文提出DISCERN基准，用于评估自动化研究流程中的数据完整性、分析验证与假设生成能力，揭示当前智能体尚不具备可靠的自主分析或发现能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多只评估分析任务完成或假设生成，未测试可靠证据能否支撑有效且新颖的主张，缺乏对自动化科研全流程可信度的系统检验。
AI.method: DISCERN基于真实公开数据集，构建受控基准，涵盖三个层级：数据完整性与混杂/工具陷阱下的分析验证，以及对抗性评审下的假设生成与修正；包含203个任务、8个生命科学赛道、8个模型，并引入与已知科学现象一致但与预期冲突的反事实案例。
AI.result: 智能体仅在60.8%的Level 1、34.2%的Level 2和0.6%的Level 3评估中获满分；失分源于拒绝可靠数据、未将已知局限纳入结论、假设产出差异大。按token与代码使用排序的跨赛道排名比按证据判断排序更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体可作为有监督的科研辅助工具，但尚不能实现可靠的自主分析与科学发现。

title: Who Is Left of Whom? Tracing Spatial Evidence and Role Binding in Relative-Position Reasoning
summary: High instance-level accuracy can mask inconsistencies in spatial reasoning when objects exchange positions or their roles are reversed in the query. The internal representations supporting relative-position reasoning remain poorly understood. We investigate two complementary components of this process: tracking object locations in the input and representing their query roles. Across three VLMs with visual or textual inputs and their language-model backbones, activation patching reveals a staged progression from early-layer source representations through intermediate-layer query-object representations to late-layer answer states. Targeted interventions further establish causal links along this progression: manipulating source-side representations shifts location information at query-object mentions and ultimately alters relation predictions. Beyond object-location information, we also identify a stable query-side direction associated with the roles of the two objects in the comparison. Steering along directions estimated on synthetic scenes generalizes to natural-image benchmarks, improving accuracy and both forms of paired consistency in most settings without retraining. Our findings reveal complementary components of relational reasoning across visual and textual settings and show how targeted interventions can improve the consistency of models' behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视觉语言模型相对位置推理的内部机制，发现从早期源表征经中间查询对象表征到晚期答案状态的分阶段过程，并通过干预改善一致性与准确率。
AI.motivation: 高实例级准确率可能掩盖空间推理中的不一致性（如物体交换位置或查询角色反转时）。模型支撑相对位置推理的内部表征仍不清楚，需探究物体位置追踪与查询角色表征这两个互补成分。
AI.method: 对三个视觉或文本输入的VLM及其语言模型骨干进行激活修补（activation patching），并结合定向干预（manipulating source-side representations）与合成场景估计的查询侧方向进行引导。
AI.result: 发现早期层源表征、中间层查询对象表征、晚期层答案状态的分阶段进程；干预源侧表征可改变查询对象提及处的位置信息并最终改变关系预测；还识别出与两物体比较角色相关的稳定查询侧方向，合成场景估计的方向可泛化到自然图像基准，在多数设置下提升准确率和两类配对一致性且无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了视觉与文本设置中关系推理的互补成分，并表明定向干预可提升模型行为的一致性。

title: SphMind: Towards Robust, Training-Free VLM-based Spatial Reasoning with a 360 Camera
summary: Omnidirectional or 360 cameras provide embodied AI agents with a holistic, wide field-of-view (FoV) view of their surroundings, motivating the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for omnidirectional spatial reasoning. However, most MLLMs are trained on conventional 2D perspective images and struggle with the severe distortions and wrap-around discontinuities induced by spherical geometry. Enabling them to generalize to non-Euclidean 3D spaces without retraining therefore remains challenging. We propose SphMind, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that decouples semantic perception from geometric reasoning. Rather than requiring MLLMs to learn spherical geometry internally, SphMind preserves their semantic capabilities while handling geometry externally. We introduce a Spherical Harmonics-based Spatial Graph (SHSG) that models spatial relationships through equivariant transformations on the sphere, together with Inference-Time Geometric Grounding (IGG), a model-agnostic closed-loop optimization process that aligns MLLM representations with spherical geometric constraints during inference. Experiments on three benchmarks show that SphMind achieves over 21.4% average improvement in directional reasoning on MP3D and Stanford2D-3D, outperforms prompt-engineering baselines by 8.7% on the real-world ODI-Bench, and improves rotational invariance by 5.9% under panorama rotations, without additional training or dataset-specific tuning. In-the-wild evaluations further show that SphMind resolves directional reasoning queries that baseline vision-language models fail to answer correctly.

AI.tldr: SphMind是一个免训练、即插即用的框架，通过解耦语义感知与几何推理，让MLLM无需重训练即可进行全景空间推理。
AI.motivation: 全向/360相机为具身智能体提供全景视野，但多数MLLM基于2D透视图像训练，难以应对球面几何导致的畸变和环绕不连续性，无法泛化到非欧几里得3D空间。
AI.method: 提出SphMind，保留MLLM语义能力、外部处理几何；引入基于球谐函数的空间图（SHSG），通过球面上的等变变换建模空间关系；并提出推理时几何接地（IGG），一种模型无关的闭环优化，在推理时对齐MLLM表示与球面几何约束。
AI.result: 在MP3D和Stanford2D-3D上方向推理平均提升超21.4%；在ODI-Bench上比提示工程基线高8.7%；全景旋转下旋转不变性提升5.9%；无额外训练或数据集特定调优。
AI.conclusion: SphMind有效解决MLLM全景空间推理难题，野外评估也显示其能正确回答基线模型失败的方向推理问题。

title: Feasible Flow Matching for Graph Reconstruction via Within-Sampling Primal-Dual Guidance
summary: Graph reconstruction from partial observations often comes with structural side information, such as degree bounds, triangle counts, or an edge-density band. Prior-Informed Flow Matching (PIFM) reconstructs graphs by transporting a local prior toward the graph distribution, but it provides no mechanism to incorporate this side information. We put forth Constrained Primal-Dual PIFM (CPD-PIFM), which augments the sampler with Lagrange multipliers that evolve along each trajectory. The multipliers respond to constraint violations at a predicted endpoint and guide subsequent sampling steps without retraining. We prove that the sampler inherits PIFM's permutation equivariance and bound its expected terminal slack by a term that decays as the inverse square root of the number of steps, plus two approximation terms. On three link-prediction benchmarks and nine combinations of datasets and constraints, CPD-PIFM raises feasibility by 11-26 percentage points and remains competitive with fixed guidance without selecting a separate multiplier for each constraint.

AI.tldr: 提出CPD-PIFM，用拉格朗日乘子在线约束流匹配采样器，无需重训即可满足图结构约束。
AI.motivation: 图重建常需满足度约束、三角形计数或边密度等结构侧信息，而原PIFM缺乏融入此类约束的机制。
AI.method: 在PIFM采样中引入沿轨迹演化的拉格朗日乘子，依据预测终点的约束违反情况调整后续采样步。
AI.result: 证明其继承置换等变性，终端松弛期望以步数平方根倒数衰减加上两项近似项；在3个链接预测基准、9种数据集-约束组合上，可行性提升11-26个百分点，且与固定引导相当而无需为每个约束单独调乘子。
AI.conclusion: CPD-PIFM能高效融入结构约束，提升可行性且保持性能竞争力，无需重训或逐约束调参。

title: DrafTS: Time-Aware Decomposition with Residual Correction for Time Series Modeling
summary: Real-world time series contain evolving underlying dynamics with irregular variations that lack stable temporal patterns and are often referred to as noise. Existing methods address this mixture by filtering frequencies or suppressing noisy observations. They either miss temporal evolution or risk suppressing useful dynamics. We propose DrafTS, a model-agnostic framework that aims to reduce noise while preserving evolving dynamics through time-aware Decomposition with ResiduAl correction For Time Series. DrafTS uses features derived from instantaneous amplitude and frequency to guide decomposition into a primary component intended to capture underlying dynamics. A task-specific backbone models the primary component, while a lightweight correction module uses residual information to correct the backbone output. Across four time series modeling tasks, DrafTS improves six diverse backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is at https://github.com/Autumn61q/DrafTS

AI.tldr: DrafTS是一个模型无关框架，通过时间感知分解与残差校正来降低时间序列噪声，同时保留演化动态。
AI.motivation: 真实世界时间序列存在不断演化且缺乏稳定时间模式的动态变化，常被视为噪声。现有方法要么忽略时间演化，要么可能抑制有用动态。
AI.method: 利用瞬时振幅和频率特征引导将序列分解为主成分以捕捉潜在动态；任务特定骨干网络建模主成分，轻量校正模块利用残差信息校正骨干输出。
AI.result: 在四类时间序列建模任务上，DrafTS提升了六种不同骨干模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: DrafTS验证了其作为通用去噪并保留演化动态框架的有效性，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Token Scale: Chunk-Level Sparse Autoencoders for Reliable Semantic Feature Discovery
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose features that help us understand and steer language models, but faithful reconstruction does not guarantee informative concepts. Token-level objectives reward lexical and formatting details alongside semantic content, all competing for a limited sparse budget. We introduce a family of chunk-level SAEs that encode mean-pooled activations over chunks, each a contiguous span of tokens: Mean-Chunk reconstructs the observed chunk, Cross-Chunk predicts an independently processed neighbor, and Joint-Chunk combines both targets. These designs separate the effect of a larger observation unit from that of predicting information shared across passages. With matched training data, chunk-level SAEs remain powerful interpretability tools while learning reliable semantic features that capture high-level concepts and respond selectively to relevant content. Their strengths are complementary: Mean-Chunk improves high-level feature discovery, reasoning detection beyond surface cues, and steering; Cross-Chunk leads document retrieval and classification transfer while producing selective, persistent features. Changing what an SAE sees and predicts yields reliable semantic features for more meaningful tasks. We demonstrate their practical value through gains across downstream tasks such as retrieval, reasoning detection, and steering.

AI.tldr: 提出chunk-level SAEs（Mean-Chunk、Cross-Chunk、Joint-Chunk），通过改变编码单元与预测目标，学习更可靠的语义特征，提升检索、推理检测与steering等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 传统token-level SAE虽能忠实重构，但其目标奖励词汇和格式细节，与语义内容争夺有限的稀疏预算，导致特征可解释性不足。
AI.method: 构建chunk-level SAEs，编码chunk（连续token跨度）的mean-pooled激活：Mean-Chunk重构观测chunk；Cross-Chunk预测独立处理的相邻chunk；Joint-Chunk结合两者目标。
AI.result: Chunk-level SAE仍是强可解释工具且学到高层语义特征；Mean-Chunk在高层特征发现、超越表层线索的推理检测与steering上更强；Cross-Chunk在文档检索与分类迁移上领先，并产生选择性、持久的特征。
AI.conclusion: 改变SAE的观测单位与预测目标可得到更可靠的语义特征，在检索、推理检测和steering等实际任务中展现互补优势。

title: Printability-Constrained Adversarial Decals for Near-Nadir Aerial Perception: Measured Ink Gamuts, Nested Realism Constraints, and a Physical-World Bound
summary: Adversarial patches for aerial perception are typically evaluated as digital composites, with printing left as an implementation detail. This study imposes three physical constraints during optimization rather than after it: the color range a particular printer can reproduce, the size of the flat panel a vehicle offers, and the loss of fine detail incurred when the patch is imaged from altitude. The principal comparison isolates the ink set. Two patches share all seventeen recorded optimization settings and differ only in the colors available to them. One is constrained to a uniform color cube; the other to a gamut measured by printing and scanning a 216-patch chart. Each was optimized at three seeds and evaluated against thirteen victim conditions, with every rate reported against a size-matched optimized control. The effect of the measured gamut is victim-dependent rather than uniform. Net attack success rises on three of six closed-set segmentation victims, and for these the seed ranges of the two ink sets are disjoint: $+0.120$ on DeepLabv3-R101 and $+0.041$ on SegFormer-B0. The color-cube patch is consistently stronger on the open-vocabulary segmenter and on two of four detectors, though no detector exceeds a net of $+0.026$ under either ink set. The natural explanation is that a printable palette is simply less chromatic and lower in frequency than a digital one. Eleven further patches test this account and it does not hold. Once cardinality is matched, a palette as chromatic as the cube attacks equally well. Cardinality itself shows no trend from three inks to thirty-two. Palettes matched on cardinality, lightness and chroma, and differing only in hue placement, span $0.035$ to $0.136$. A physical evaluation with printed decals did not detect transfer; it bounds the transferred rate at $0.133$, which does not exclude the simulated value of $0.121$.

AI.tldr: 该研究在优化阶段即引入打印机色域、面板尺寸和高度成像细节损失三项物理约束，比较实测色域与均匀色立方两种墨水集对抗贴片的效果。结果发现色域影响因受害者而异，且可打印调色板"色度低/频率低"的常规解释不成立。
AI.motivation: 对抗贴片用于航空感知时多被当作数字合成评估，打印仅视为实现细节。作者希望把物理约束（打印机可复现的颜色范围、车辆能提供的平板尺寸、高空成像的细节损失）直接纳入优化，并厘清不同墨水/调色板对攻击效果的真实影响来源。
AI.method: 在优化中直接施加三项物理约束。核心对比仅隔离墨水集：两个贴片共享全部17个记录优化设置，仅颜色可用范围不同——一个限定于均匀色彩立方，另一个限定为通过打印并扫描216色卡测得的色域。每个贴片在3个随机种子下优化，对13种受害者条件评估，所有比率均与尺寸匹配的优化对照比较。另用11个额外贴片检验"可打印调色板色度更低、频率更低"的解释，并做打印贴纸的物理评估。
AI.result: 实测色域影响是受害者依赖而非一致的：在6个闭集分割受害者的3个上净攻击成功率上升，且两者种子范围不重叠，如DeepLabv3-R101上+0.120、SegFormer-B0上+0.041；色彩立方贴片在开放词汇分割器和4个检测器中的2个上持续更强，但检测器净增益均不超过+0.026。匹配基数后，与立方同样色度的调色板攻击效果相当；基数从3种墨水到32种无趋势。在基数、亮度、色度匹配、仅色相位置不同的调色板间，效果跨度0.035至0.136。打印贴纸的物理评估未检出迁移，将迁移率上界限定为0.133，故不能排除模拟值0.121。
AI.conclusion: 可打印色域对对抗贴片效果的影响因受害者而异，不能简单归因于色度或频率较低；一旦匹配调色板基数，高色度调色板同样有效，且基数本身无显著趋势。物理打印评估未检测到迁移，但0.133的上界不足以排除模拟结果0.121，说明物理迁移仍需更大规模验证。

title: What Should Data Teach? Moving Bottlenecks Across Circuit, Store, and Use
summary: What should data teach a language model at a particular point in training? A circuit view reveals three distinct bottlenecks: forming a computation, making its required content available, and selecting among available routes. A shared diagnosis-to-data principle connects them: localize the missing operation, preserve its causal relation, vary shortcut-bearing context, and re-audit the residual. Formation-sensitive selection and prerequisite ordering accelerate a binding-matching-transport path; a brief early prefix from the same training multiset retains a validation advantage through 100B tokens. Availability counterfactuals then distinguish writing content from invoking available memory, while paired supervision and context-opportunity ranking improve matched route decisions and long-context answer likelihood. A continuous 350M-model experiment connects the three interventions on the same facts: early circuit training improves subsequent learning, and the complete sequence outperforms stage-replacement controls on facts withheld from Use teaching. Independent query surfaces and opposed-source decisions expose conditional arbitration as the remaining frontier. Together, these results show why a change in the limiting operation calls for a change in supervision, not merely a new ranking of difficult examples.

AI.tldr: 论文从"电路视角"揭示语言模型训练中三类瓶颈（形成计算、内容可用、路径选择），并提出"诊断到数据"的共享原则指导数据选择，用350M模型连续实验验证三种干预的协同效果。
AI.motivation: 在训练的不同阶段，数据应该教会模型什么？作者希望超越"按难度排样本"的传统思路，针对当前限制性操作瓶颈提供对应的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出诊断原则：定位缺失操作、保持因果关联、变化捷径上下文、复审残差。据此设计三类干预：形成敏感的数据选择与前置排序（binding-matching-transport路径）、可用性反事实区分内容写入与调用记忆、配对监督与上下文机会排序改进路由决策。用连续训练的350M模型统一验证。
AI.result: 早期使用同训练集前缀可保留长达100B token的验证优势；早期电路训练提升后续学习；完整干预序列在未用于Use教学的事实上优于阶段替换控制。条件仲裁（独立查询表面与对立来源决策）仍为未解前沿。
AI.conclusion: 当限制性操作发生变化时，应改变监督方式而非仅重新排序困难样本。这为按训练阶段定制数据提供了电路层面的理论与实证框架。

title: Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising for Video Deepfake Detection
summary: The growing threat of video deepfakes necessitates multimodal detection. Beyond serving as independent indicators of authenticity, audio and visual signals have intrinsic dependencies that also provide an essential criterion for detection. Previous methods often overlook the cross-modal correspondences, hindering information transfer between domains and leaving crucial detection cues unexplored. To address this challenge, we propose a framework called Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising (CTCLD) for video deepfake detection. It connects the distinct distributions of heterogeneous modalities in latent spaces, enabling smooth cross-domain information transfer to improve detection performance. We first establish a Bayesian foundation by decomposing the audio-visual joint distribution. Subsequently, CTCLD translates both modalities via bidirectional latent denoising conditioned on each other, effectively capturing subtle inconsistencies in the manipulated signals. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CTCLD enables comprehensive domain alignment, resulting in a robust video deepfake detection approach with competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CTCLD 框架，通过条件潜在去噪实现跨模态翻译，捕获音视频内在依赖关系以检测视频深度伪造。
AI.motivation: 视频深度伪造威胁加剧，需要多模态检测。音视频信号不仅各自是真实性的独立指标，其内在依赖关系也是重要检测依据。但现有方法常忽视跨模态对应关系，阻碍域间信息传递，遗漏关键检测线索。
AI.method: 提出 Cross-modal Translation via Conditional Latent Denoising (CTCLD)：首先通过分解音视频联合分布建立贝叶斯基础；然后以彼此为条件进行双向潜在去噪，连接异质模态在潜在空间中的不同分布，实现平滑跨域信息传递并捕获被操纵信号中的细微不一致。
AI.result: 实验表明 CTCLD 能实现全面的域对齐，形成鲁棒的视频深度伪造检测方法，性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CTCLD 通过跨模态条件潜在去噪有效利用音视频依赖关系，解决了跨模态对应缺失问题，提升了视频深度伪造检测性能。

title: Less Sycophancy, Stronger Refusal? Lessons for AI Safety from Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Reliable refusal of harmful requests is essential to the safe deployment of language models. Because excessive eagerness to please users may undermine existing refusal capabilities, reducing sycophancy offers a potential route to stronger refusal beyond the harmful scenarios covered by safety training. We investigate this possibility using compensatory feature injection (CFI), a training technique designed to limit the acquisition of a target concept by supplying its associated activation during learning. Across three Qwen3.5 base models, we use sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to identify the top-ranked sycophancy feature from paired sycophantic and independent responses, then validate its behavioral influence through inference steering. We subsequently inject the selected feature during supervised fine-tuning on sycophantic targets. Positive injection reduces learned sycophancy after removal (by 62.0% relative to ordinary fine-tuning in 35B-A3B), whereas modest negative injection increases it. Unexpectedly, these reductions in sycophancy do not consistently improve direct refusal of harmful requests, motivating a narrower evaluation of the same harmful intents under user pressure. In this setting, ordinary fine-tuning on sycophantic responses substantially weakens refusal, while selected checkpoints trained with positive injection recover part of the loss, including approximately 95% in 35B-A3B. These findings show that persistent sycophancy reduction does not guarantee stronger direct refusal, while identifying recovery under user pressure as a distinct, conditional benefit of training intervention.

AI.tldr: 该论文用补偿特征注入(CFI)减少模型谄媚，发现谄媚降低不必然增强直接拒答，但在用户施压下能恢复拒答能力。
AI.motivation: 过度迎合用户（谄媚）可能削弱模型拒答有害请求的能力，因此减少谄媚有望成为超越安全训练范围的拒答增强途径。
AI.method: 在三个Qwen3.5基础模型上，用稀疏自编码器(SAE)从谄媚/独立回答对中识别排名最高的谄媚特征，并通过推理期引导验证其行为影响；随后在对谄媚目标的监督微调中注入该特征。
AI.result: 正向注入在移除后使学到的谄媚减少（35B-A3B相对普通微调减少62.0%），而适度负向注入反而增加谄媚。谄媚减少并未一致提升直接拒答；但在用户施压场景下，普通微调显著削弱拒答，而正向注入训练的检查点恢复了部分损失（35B-A3B约95%）。
AI.conclusion: 持续的谄媚减少并不能保证更强的直接拒答，但能带来用户在压力下的拒答恢复这一独特且有条件的收益。

title: SceneScaffold: Active Scene-State Construction for Unified 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Recent 3D large multimodal models (3D-LMMs) rely on a visual bottleneck to compress complex 3D scene evidence into a limited number of visual tokens compatible with large language models (LLMs). Current visual bottlenecks, however, often passively compress heterogeneous 3D evidence into a homogeneous object-centric token sequence, leaving the spatial organization of the scene under-represented. This under-representation forces the LLM to recover spatial relations from a flattened token sequence, leading to unstable reasoning in relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous scenes. To address this issue, we propose SceneScaffold, an active scene-state construction framework for unified 3D scene understanding. SceneScaffold reformulates the visual bottleneck from a passive feature compressor into an active scene organizer, constructing a role-aware spatial scaffold before language reasoning. Specifically, SceneScaffold organizes superpoint-level visual evidence into scene-state components with distinct structural roles: entity states preserve core object semantics, scene-frame states maintain spatial references via boundary and region anchors, relation states encode object-environment interaction cues, and a global summary provides compact context. Through this role-aware construction, SceneScaffold provides the LLM with a spatially organized scene representation before language reasoning. Experiments on unified 3D scene understanding tasks, including 3D visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning, demonstrate the effectiveness of SceneScaffold, while diagnostic results further show its applicability to relation-intensive and spatially ambiguous cases. Code is available at https://github.com/lixiangqi707/SceneScaffold.

AI.tldr: 提出SceneScaffold，将3D多模态模型的视觉瓶颈从被动特征压缩器改为主动场景组织器，通过角色感知空间脚手架提升3D场景理解。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-LMM的视觉瓶颈被动地将异构3D证据压缩为同质物体中心的token序列，空间组织表征不足，迫使LLM从扁平序列恢复空间关系，导致关系密集和空间歧义场景推理不稳定。
AI.method: SceneScaffold主动构建角色感知空间脚手架，将超点级视觉证据组织为具有不同结构角色的场景状态组件：实体状态保留核心物体语义，场景框架状态通过边界和区域锚点维持空间参照，关系状态编码物体-环境交互线索，全局摘要提供紧凑上下文，在语言推理前提供空间组织化表征。
AI.result: 在统一3D场景理解任务（3D视觉定位、问答、密集描述）上验证了有效性，诊断结果进一步显示其在关系密集和空间歧义案例中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉瓶颈重新表述为主动场景组织器，通过角色感知空间脚手架构建，可有效提升统一3D场景理解性能，尤其在关系密集和空间歧义场景中。

title: Saturation-Insensitive Dueling Bandits with General Function Approximation
summary: We study contextual dueling bandits with general function approximation under the Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) preference model. A key challenge in this setting is the saturation of the preference model: when the current reward model can already distinguish two actions with high confidence, the resulting preference feedback becomes weakly informative, making it difficult to further improve reward estimation. Consequently, existing sample-complexity analyses often depend on the inverse-derivative factor $1 / σ'[Δ_{r^\ast}]$ which can be prohibitively large when the link function $σ$ saturates for large reward gaps $Δ_{r^\ast}$. To address this issue, we introduce `SI-CDB`, an algorithm that selects opponent arms using a carefully designed heuristic for arm selection. This design enables saturation-insensitive reward learning and recovers the near-optimal dependence for linear reward classes, eliminating the unfavorable $1/σ'(\cdot)$ factor. The core of our analysis is a localized Eluder dimension framework tailored to dueling bandits with general function approximation. Our theoretical results also explain why two-arm regret analysis is crucial for improving single-arm performance in dueling bandits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究BTL偏好模型下、带通用函数逼近的上下文对决赌博机问题，提出SI-CDB算法解决偏好模型饱和导致的奖励学习困难，消除1/σ'因子，并建立局部化Eluder维度分析框架。
AI.motivation: BTL模型在对决赌博机中面临"偏好饱和"挑战：当当前奖励模型已能以高置信度区分两个动作时，偏好反馈信息量很弱，难以进一步改进奖励估计。现有样本复杂度分析常依赖逆导数因子1/σ'[Δ_{r*}]，当连接函数σ在大奖励差处饱和时，该因子会变得极大，导致复杂度爆炸。
AI.method: 提出SI-CDB算法，通过精心设计的启发式规则选择对手臂（opponent arm），从而实现"饱和不敏感"的奖励学习。分析核心是面向通用函数逼近对决赌博机的局部化Eluder维度（localized Eluder dimension）框架。
AI.result: SI-CDB恢复了线性奖励类的近最优依赖，消除了不利的1/σ'(·)因子；理论结果同时解释了为何双臂（two-arm）遗憾分析对于提升单臂（single-arm）性能至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过算法设计与局部化Eluder维度分析，有效解决了BTL偏好饱和问题，为通用函数逼近下对决赌博机的样本复杂度分析提供了新工具与理论洞见。

title: CoViST: Visual Token Compression via Composable States
summary: Visual token compression lowers the inference cost of vision--language models by representing images with fewer tokens. However, most existing methods compress visual tokens to a reduced set, leaving the amount of visual evidence represented by each token and its original spatial context implicit. Therefore, the compressed representation does not explicitly encode how much visual information each representative carries or where it lies in the original image. This limitation arises even after a single reduction and becomes more pronounced when compression is repeated across decoder layers. To address this issue, we propose CoViST, a training-free framework that represents a compressed image as a composable visual state. Specifically, the state combines representative features with original positions, effective contribution weights, and reusable selection metadata. CoViST constructs this state through coverage-guided selection and conservation-based contribution composition, and explicitly incorporates its contribution and positional information into decoder attention. Each component of the state retains its interpretation under successive reductions, enabling the same formulation to support both fixed compression before prefill and progressive compression within the decoder. Experimental results on seven LLaVA-1.5-7B benchmarks show that CoViST-Fixed retains 99.9\%, 99.5\%, and 98.1\% of uncompressed performance at 192, 128, and 64 tokens, respectively, and CoViST-Pro retains 99.8\%, 99.9\%, and 99.1\% at the corresponding layer-average budgets, outperforming state-of-the-art methods under their respective budget settings. Code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 CoViST，将压缩后的图像表示为可组合视觉状态，显式编码每个 token 的贡献权重与空间位置，支持固定与逐层渐进压缩，在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上以极少 token 保留近乎无损性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 token 压缩方法只保留一个缩减后的 token 集合，隐含了每个 token 所代表的视觉证据量及其原始空间上下文。压缩表示没有显式编码每个代表 token 承载多少视觉信息、位于原图何处，且在多解码器层反复压缩时问题更严重。
AI.method: CoViST 是免训练框架，把压缩图像表示为可组合视觉状态，组合代表特征、原始位置、有效贡献权重和可复用选择元数据。通过覆盖度引导选择（coverage-guided selection）和守恒式贡献组合（conservation-based contribution composition）构造该状态，并把贡献与位置信息显式注入解码器注意力。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的七个基准上，CoViST-Fixed 在 192/128/64 token 下分别保留未压缩性能的 99.9%/99.5%/98.1%；CoViST-Pro 在对应层平均预算下保留 99.8%/99.9%/99.1%，在各自预算设置下优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将压缩图像显式建模为带贡献与位置信息的可组合视觉状态，可在固定与渐进压缩下保持组件可解释性并实现近乎无损性能，为视觉 token 压缩提供了新思路。

title: Almieyar: A Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition
summary: Arabic speech technology has largely focused on Modern Standard Arabic, leaving the living dialects spoken by hundreds of millions under-served. We introduce ALMIEYAR, a culturally grounded ASR benchmark covering 17 Arabic dialects across six families, built entirely from newly recorded speech unseen by existing models. Dialect-community coordinators selected culturally relevant images across 10 topics, and native speakers described them through five structured scenarios, yielding approximately 50 minutes per dialect (13.7 hours total). We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art ASR systems zero-shot, including GPT-4o-transcribe, Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, Whisper, SeamlessM4T-v2, and wav2vec2-based models. GPT-4o-transcribe achieves the lowest overall WER at 35.0%, followed by Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, and Whisper-Large-v3 at 41.1%, 45.9%, and 49.5%, respectively, indicating substantial remaining errors across Arabic dialect communities. Performance varies considerably across dialect groups, with no model performing uniformly best across all groups. WER alone also obscures dialectal ASR behaviour: wav2vec2-based models show large WER/CER gaps, where character-level agreement remains much higher than word-level accuracy, motivating joint WER/CER reporting. ALMIEYAR provides a unified benchmark for culturally grounded Arabic ASR evaluation, including the first published benchmark for Ahwazi Arabic.

AI.tldr: ALMIEYAR 是一个覆盖 17 种阿拉伯语方言、基于全新录制语音的文化接地 ASR 基准，评测 12 个 SOTA 系统，最佳 GPT-4o-transcribe 总体 WER 仍达 35.0%。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语语音技术主要聚焦现代标准阿拉伯语，数亿人使用的活方言长期被忽视，缺乏文化接地的评测基准。
AI.method: 由方言社区协调员选取 10 个主题的文化相关图片，母语者通过五种结构化场景描述，构建 6 个语系、17 种方言的语料，每种方言约 50 分钟（共 13.7 小时）；零样本评测 12 个 ASR 系统。
AI.result: GPT-4o-transcribe 总体 WER 最低（35.0%），其次 Voxtral-Mini-4B（41.1%）、Fanar-STT-LF（45.9%）、Whisper-Large-v3（49.5%）；各方言组表现差异大，无模型全面最优；wav2vec2 类模型 WER/CER 差距大，需联合报告。
AI.conclusion: ALMIEYAR 为文化接地的阿拉伯语 ASR 提供统一评测基准，并首次发布 Ahwazi 阿拉伯语基准，揭示方言 ASR 仍有大量误差。

title: Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical MIL for Weakly-Supervised Thoracic Disease Detection in Chest X-rays
summary: Weakly-supervised thoracic disease detection in chest X-rays (CXR) is challenging due to subtle appearances and complex anatomical overlap, motivating anatomy-aware modeling for improved localization. However, prior anatomy-aware methods typically rely on coarse region proxies or static spatial priors, which may restrict dynamic instance discovery and limit precise localization of small abnormalities. We propose Anatomy-Structured Hierarchical Multiple Instance Learning (ASH-MIL), a framework that introduces parallel anatomy-structured observation branches (cardiac, pulmonary, and agnostic) combined with hierarchical MIL aggregation. Anatomical priors are injected as soft spatial biases into decoder cross-attention, enabling anatomically grounded evidence maps without disease bounding-box supervision. Instance localization is derived directly from MIL-weighted cross-attention maps without bounding box supervision. Experiments on CXR8 and cross-domain MIMIC-CXR held-out sets demonstrate consistent improvements over prior weakly-supervised and anatomy-aware approaches, particularly under stricter localization criteria. Our code is available at https://github.com/jn-kim/ash-mil.

AI.tldr: 提出ASH-MIL框架，通过解剖结构化的并行观测分支与层次化MIL聚合，结合软空间先验注入解码器交叉注意力，实现无框监督的胸部疾病定位。
AI.motivation: 胸部X光疾病检测因表现细微和解剖重叠而困难，现有解剖感知方法依赖粗糙区域代理或静态空间先验，限制动态实例发现与小病灶精确定位。
AI.method: 引入并行解剖结构观测分支（心脏、肺部、无关）与层次化MIL聚合；将解剖先验作为软空间偏置注入解码器交叉注意力，从MIL加权的交叉注意力图直接导出实例定位，无需疾病边界框监督。
AI.result: 在CXR8及跨域MIMIC-CXR留出集上，相比先前弱监督和解剖感知方法取得一致提升，在更严格的定位标准下尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: ASH-MIL通过解剖结构化建模实现无边界框监督的精确弱监督胸部疾病定位，验证了解剖先验引导注意力机制的有效性。

title: Relative Generalization Invariance of LLM Pretraining
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining performance is jointly shaped by three components of the training triplet: the optimizer, model architecture, and training data stream. However, how these components influence performance in distinct ways remains unclear. We take a first step toward isolating their effects by studying relative generalization. We introduce Relative Generalization Invariance (RGI), the invariance of the validation-loss difference between any two tokens across models. We show that RGI approximately holds across a wide range of optimizers and moderate architectural variations, suggesting that these choices induce an approximately uniform shift in token-wise losses. In contrast, changing the training data stream can substantially alter relative generalization. We further show that RGI cannot be explained by the neural tangent kernel or mean-field regimes alone and prove that it can emerge in an overparameterized quadratic model. Overall, our work identifies RGI as a new phenomenon in LLM pretraining that helps distinguish the effects of optimizers and architectures from those of training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"相对泛化不变性"(RGI)——任意两个token在模型间验证损失差的跨模型不变性，发现RGI在优化器和适度架构变化下近似成立，而数据流改变会破坏它，从而区分不同训练组件的影响。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练性能由优化器、模型架构和训练数据流共同决定，但三者以何种不同方式影响性能仍不清楚。作者希望隔离并区分这些组件各自的作用。
AI.method: 作者研究"相对泛化"问题，引入相对泛化不变性(RGI)：即任意两个token间的验证损失差在不同模型间保持不变。他们在多种优化器与适度架构变化下检验RGI，并分析其与神经正切核(NTK)及平均场理论的关系，还在过参数化二次模型中给出证明。
AI.result: RGI在广泛的优化器和适度的架构变化下近似成立，表明这些选择对token级损失造成近似均匀的偏移；而改变训练数据流会显著改变相对泛化。RGI无法仅用NTK或平均场机制解释，但可在过参数化二次模型中涌现。
AI.conclusion: RGI是LLM预训练中的一种新现象，有助于将优化器和架构的影响与训练数据的影响区分开来。

title: COEVO: Co-Evolving Context and Parameters for Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) seeks to move large language models beyond static training pipelines toward systems that can participate in improving their own future behavior. Existing approaches largely follow two directions: updating model parameters through online learning, or improving the external context through search, reflection, and prompt optimization. Although both mechanisms can support continued improvement, they are typically studied independently. This separation overlooks an important interaction: the context shapes the experience from which a model learns, while an evolving model may interpret and utilize the same context differently over time. We therefore formulate RSI as a problem of parameter--context co-evolution, where model parameters and the learning context adapt within a shared feedback loop. We introduce COEVO, a framework that updates model parameters from on-policy experience while adapting contextual guidance according to the state of the evolving policy. Policy entropy and prompt-conditioned attention are used as complementary signals to guide this adaptation. Experiments show that COEVO consistently improves task performance over fixed-context reinforcement learning and produces policies that are more robust to changes in system prompts. More broadly, our results suggest that external context should be viewed not merely as a fixed interface to a large language model, but as an adaptive component of recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将递归自我改进(RSI)重新表述为参数-上下文协同演化问题，并设计COEVO框架，在共享反馈回路中同时更新模型参数与上下文引导，实验表明其优于固定上下文强化学习。
AI.motivation: 现有RSI方法分两条独立路线：在线学习更新参数、搜索/反思/提示优化改进上下文，二者被割裂研究，忽略了关键交互——上下文塑造学习经验，而演化中的模型会随时间以不同方式解读同一上下文。
AI.method: 将RSI建模为参数-上下文协同演化，在共享反馈回路中自适应。提出COEVO框架：从on-policy经验更新模型参数，同时依据演化策略状态调整上下文引导；利用策略熵与提示条件注意力作为互补信号指导上下文适配。
AI.result: COEVO在任务性能上持续优于固定上下文强化学习，并产生对系统提示变化更鲁棒的策略。
AI.conclusion: 外部上下文不应仅被视为大语言模型的固定接口，而应作为递归自我改进中的自适应组件。

title: FactorEngram: Factorized N-gram Memory with Basis-Level Gating for Language Models
summary: Lookup-based memory has been a promising way to scale the parameters of large language models (LLMs). It retrieves learned representations of local token patterns, such as n-grams, instead of reconstructing them through successive layers of computation. However, existing designs such as Engram treat each retrieved embedding as a monolithic unit. Each embedding is stored in its own hashed slot and modulated by a single scalar gate. As a result, polysemous patterns cannot selectively read out the components of their memory that are relevant to the context. Moreover, parameters are shared only through hash collisions, which are largely unrelated to semantics. We propose FactorEngram, a factorized n-gram memory with basis-level contextual gating. FactorEngram retrieves sparsity-regularized coefficients over a dictionary of basis vectors shared across patterns, so related patterns can reuse common components. The same dictionary is also used for gating. The backbone hidden state is scored against each basis vector to gate the corresponding coefficient before reconstruction, which lets the context modulate each memory component individually. FactorEngram also covers both individual tokens and multi-token n-grams, and we systematically study where the memory branch should be inserted. On 340M- and 1B-parameter Transformer backbones, FactorEngram improves language modeling and downstream task performance. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component and identify insertion before the attention sublayer in the middle layers as an effective configuration.

AI.tldr: FactorEngram 提出因子化的 n-gram 记忆与基级上下文门控，解决现有方法中多义词无法选择性读取记忆组件、参数仅通过哈希碰撞共享的问题，在语言建模与下游任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于查找的记忆（如 Engram）将每个检索到的嵌入当作整体单元，存储在独立哈希槽中并用单一标量门控调制；导致多义模式无法按上下文选择性地读取相关记忆组件，且参数仅通过语义无关的哈希碰撞共享。
AI.method: FactorEngram 在共享基向量字典上检索稀疏正则化系数，使相关模式复用公共组件；同一字典也用于门控：用主干隐藏状态对每个基向量打分，在重建前逐个调制对应系数，实现上下文对每个记忆组件的独立调节。方法覆盖单 token 与多 token n-gram，并系统研究记忆分支的插入位置。
AI.result: 在 340M 与 1B 参数的 Transformer 主干上，FactorEngram 提升了语言建模和下游任务表现。消融实验验证了各组件的作用，并发现插入到中间层的注意力子层之前是有效配置。
AI.conclusion: 因子化记忆表示与基级上下文门控能有效改进基于查找的 LLM 参数扩展方法，插入位置（中间层注意力子层前）是重要设计因素。

title: In-Token Learning for High-Fidelity Image Restoration via Diffusion Transformers
comment: Technical report, 25 pages, 12 figures. Preserves the earlier broader study underlying Fill2SR (ECCV 2026), including automatic colorization; Fill2SR subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction
summary: We present In-Token Learning, an image restoration framework that adapts a pretrained diffusion transformer using conditional rectified flow matching. Clean targets paired with degraded inputs supervise transport from Gaussian noise to restored images. Spatially aligned degraded-image tokens are fused with evolving latent tokens along the channel dimension, preserving the image-token count at a given resolution. Direct Low-Quality Guidance (DLG) combines frozen degraded-image embeddings with a fixed task prompt through the native conditioning pathway, without a trainable ControlNet-style branch or image captioning. We evaluate super-resolution and denoising on DIV2K, LSDIR, FFHQ, RealLQ250, and RealPhoto60, and automatic colorization on DIV2K and LSDIR. The tasks use separately trained checkpoints under the same framework. Results show competitive fidelity and perceptual quality under the evaluated protocols, with weaker generalization on RealLQ250. We report full-image QHD ($2560{\times}1440$) inference and a tiled $12$K restoration demonstration of Along the River During the Qingming Festival. Attention cost still increases with resolution. This technical report preserves the early broader study underlying Fill2SR, which subsequently developed the real-world super-resolution direction.

AI.tldr: 提出In-Token Learning图像修复框架，用条件rectified flow匹配微调预训练扩散Transformer，通过token融合和DLG实现超分、去噪、上色，并演示高分辨率修复。
AI.motivation: 利用预训练扩散Transformer进行图像修复，避免ControlNet式可训练分支和图像描述生成，同时保持token数量以支持高分辨率。
AI.method: 条件rectified flow匹配，将退化图像token与演化隐token沿通道维融合；Direct Low-Quality Guidance (DLG)通过原生条件路径结合冻结退化图像嵌入与固定任务提示。
AI.result: 在DIV2K、LSDIR、FFHQ、RealLQ250、RealPhoto60上评测超分和去噪，DIV2K与LSDIR上评测上色，保真度和感知质量具竞争力，但RealLQ250泛化较弱；实现QHD全图推理和12K分块修复。
AI.conclusion: 框架统一多任务且支持高分辨率，但注意力成本随分辨率增长；该报告保留了Fill2SR的早期更广泛研究，后续转向真实世界超分。

title: Low-Rank Single-Index Bandits with Unknown Links: From Matrices to Tensors
summary: Low-rank matrix and tensor bandits exploit structured interactions but typically assume a known reward link. Recent single-index bandit methods accommodate unknown links without directly exploiting matrix or tensor rank. We address this gap by studying stochastic matrix and tensor bandits with an unknown shared Lipschitz link and a low-rank index parameter under known regular candidate distributions and finite-variance noise. For monotone links, T-ESTOR combines robust, rank-adaptive Stein estimation with epoch-based greedy selection. Under exact selected-score access and a uniformly positive selected-design Stein signal, it achieves square-root regret with dimension dependence determined by the low-rank structure. For every admissible design, the monotone lower bound matches the rank, dimension, and horizon dependence up to logarithmic factors at large horizons, for fixed menu size and model/design constants. For nonmonotone links under a nonzero base-law Stein signal, T-BSTOR combines structured estimation with robust bin-based learning and attains the optimal $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ horizon rate for fixed dimensions, menu size, and model/design constants. Synthetic and CCLE-based experiments illustrate the benefits of structured estimation relative to vectorized and competing single-index baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带未知共享Lipschitz链接和低秩索引参数的矩阵/张量bandit问题，提出T-ESTOR（单调）与T-BSTOR（非单调）算法，实现与低秩结构相关的近乎最优遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 低秩矩阵/张量bandit通常假设奖励链接已知；单索引bandit虽可处理未知链接，但未直接利用矩阵/张量秩。本文旨在填补二者之间的空白。
AI.method: 在已知正则候选分布与有限方差噪声下：单调链接时，T-ESTOR结合秩自适应Stein估计与基于epoch的贪心选择；非单调链接时，T-BSTOR结合结构化估计与鲁棒的基于bin的学习。
AI.result: T-ESTOR在精确选中分数访问与一致正Stein信号下达到平方根遗憾，维度依赖由低秩结构决定，且单调下界在长时域上匹配秩、维度和时域依赖（至对数因子）。T-BSTOR在非零基准分布Stein信号下达到固定维度下最优的Õ(T^{2/3})率。合成数据与CCLE实验显示结构化估计优于向量化及竞争的单索引基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将未知链接的单索引建模与矩阵/张量低秩结构结合，给出接近最优的理论保证，并通过实验验证结构化估计的优势。

title: Language Models Act on Hidden Valence
summary: Language models describe some internal states as good and others as bad. But whether models have a stake in them is an open question. Simply asking the model is unlikely to be informative. Any answer may be consistent with genuine introspection, superficial pattern-matching, or with fixed scripts learned in character training. We therefore study revealed preference. Rather than asking about a state, we use activation steering to attach a positively or negatively valenced activation pattern to one of two otherwise meaningless 'zones', switch steering off, and then observe which zone the model prefers. A model with a stake in that state should choose accordingly. Across seven open-weight models from five families, this is indeed what we find. First, steering changes the passages models write about each zone, and those words shift later choice. Second, the shift persists when all surface-level tokens are held fixed and only the hidden KV cache differs. Third, the effect also remains when all text is generated without steering and valence is only injected during cache construction. Thus, the hidden state alone moves choice in proportion to the steering dose. Fourth, this dependence of choice on hidden valence is nearly absent in a base model and emerges during DPO, consistent with a link between valence and goal-directed behaviour formed in training. Finally, given tools to steer itself, a model does not tend to induce a positive state, but it reliably removes an imposed negative state. It does so at a dose-dependent rate and significantly more often than it removes interventions in random directions. Overall, we demonstrate that valence-related activation patterns leave hidden traces that predictably govern later choices, even when every visible token is identical across conditions. Whether these traces are accompanied by any subjective experience relevant to model welfare remains unclear.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"激活引导+选择行为"研究语言模型对内部状态是否有"利害关系"（stake），而非依赖模型自陈。发现在7个开源模型（5个家族）中，隐藏状态中的效价信息能因果性地影响模型后续选择，且该效应在DPO训练中出现，模型还会主动移除负面状态。
AI.motivation: 语言模型会描述某些内部状态为"好"、另一些为"坏"，但模型是否真正对这些状态有"利害关系"仍是未解问题。直接询问模型不可靠，因为回答可能源于真实内省、表层模式匹配或角色训练学到的固定脚本。因此需要研究"显示性偏好"（revealed preference）而非自陈。
AI.method: 使用激活引导（activation steering）将正向或负向效价激活模式绑定到两个本来无意义的"区域"之一，随后关闭引导，观察模型偏好哪个区域。进行系列消融：①观察引导是否改变模型书写的文本及词汇对后续选择的影响；②固定所有表层token、只改变隐藏KV缓存；③文本完全不引导生成、仅在缓存构建时注入效价；④对比base模型与DPO训练后的模型；⑤给模型自我引导工具，观察其是否主动诱导正状态或移除负状态，并与随机方向干预对比。
AI.result: 在7个开源模型、5个家族上均发现：引导改变模型对区域的描述且词汇影响后续选择；当表层token完全相同、仅KV缓存不同时效应依然存在；仅缓存构建时注入效价也能改变选择，且选择随引导剂量成比例变化；该依赖在base模型中几乎不存在，在DPO中出现；模型被赋予自我引导工具时不会倾向于诱导正状态，但会以剂量依赖的速率可靠地移除被强加的负状态，且显著多于移除随机方向干预。
AI.conclusion: 效价相关的激活模式会留下可预测地支配后续选择的隐藏痕迹，即使所有可见token在各条件下完全相同。这提示效价与目标导向行为之间存在由训练形成的联系。至于这些痕迹是否伴随与模型福利相关的主观体验，仍不清楚。

title: PGL-3D: Towards Progressive Geometric Learning for 3D Visual Query Localization
comment: Code and models will be released
summary: 3D Visual Query Localization (3DVQL) retrieves the latest contiguous occurrence of a queried object in an RGB--point-cloud sequence and predicts a 9-DoF cuboid for every response frame. The query is captured independently of the search sequence, so its annotated pose may differ from how the object appears in the search frames. The benchmark baseline predicts cuboids after feature modeling, leaving their geometry unused for subsequent feature refinement. We investigate whether complete intermediate cuboids can improve query and proposal representations before final decoding. We introduce Progressive Geometric Learning for 3DVQL (PGL-3D), a predict--select--refine--re-predict framework that uses intermediate cuboids to guide the aggregation of search evidence and update query and proposal representations. A shared head first predicts a complete cuboid for every proposal. Query--Tube--Memory (QTM) then selects reference observations by combining proposal association, cuboid quality, frame response, and target absence, since association confidence alone establishes neither target presence nor geometric accuracy. The center, size, and orientation of each selected cuboid define soft pooling weights over query-conditioned proposal features. The pooled memory updates the query and proposal representations, and the head re-predicts from the updated features. A training-only objective, ST-D9O, supervises cuboid geometry at every stage by adding boundary, signed-distance, and soft-overlap terms to parameter regression. PGL-3D achieves a mean stAP of $0.270 \pm 0.004$ on 3DVQL, compared with $0.044$ reported for LaF. Ablations support the benefits of geometry-guided feature updates, while stage-wise analyses show improved cuboid accuracy. Replacing the geometry objective in our PROT3D reproduction with ST-D9O improves mAO on GSOT3D from $21.63\%$ to $25.78\%$. Our code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出PGL-3D框架，用中间3D立方体引导特征聚合与更新，显著提升3DVQL性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3DVQL基线在特征建模后才预测立方体，中间几何信息未被用于后续特征精炼，未充分利用几何结构。
AI.method: PGL-3D采用预测-选择-精炼-再预测框架：共享头为每个proposal预测完整立方体；QTM结合关联、质量、帧响应和缺失选择参考观测；以中心、尺寸、方向定义软池化权重更新查询与proposal表征并再预测；ST-D9O训练目标加入边界、有符号距离和软重叠项监督几何。
AI.result: 3DVQL上平均stAP达0.270±0.004（LaF为0.044）；消融验证几何引导特征更新有效；PROT3D复现中ST-D9O将GSOT3D的mAO从21.63%提升至25.78%。
AI.conclusion: 完整中间立方体能有效改进查询与proposal表征，几何引导学习与分阶段监督显著提升3DVQL准确度。

title: Łukasiewicz Neural Networks Extended: Residual Architectures and Crystallization Strategies for Interpretable Rule Extraction
summary:
A feed-forward neural network whose weights are integers and whose activation is the truncated identity implements, neuron by neuron, the connectives of Łukasiewicz many-valued logic. This exact correspondence --- established theoretically by Castro and Trillas and developed into a training algorithm by Leandro --- enables \emph{symbolic knowledge extraction}: training produces not a black-box model but a logical formula. Two obstacles have limited the approach to shallow architectures and small datasets: crystallization (forcing weights to integers) succeeds only probabilistically under the original Levenberg--Marquardt training scheme, and the theoretical guarantees break down as networks grow deeper.
  This paper addresses both obstacles. First, we prove that \emph{residual connections} (skip connections of the kind used in ResNets) extend Łukasiewicz neural networks to arbitrary depth while preserving the symbolic correspondence \emph{at merge neurons} by construction: merge neurons in a Łukasiewicz residual block automatically satisfy the neuron-classification proposition, regardless of the inner layer weights; inner-layer neurons are trained toward representability by the crystallization strategy. Second, we analyse three crystallization strategies --- Levenberg--Marquardt (corrected), straight-through estimation (STE), and proximal regularization --- characterizing their theoretical guarantees, failure modes, and interpretability trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文证明残差连接可将Łukasiewicz神经网络扩展至任意深度并保持符号对应，同时分析三种结晶策略。
AI.motivation: 原始Łukasiewicz网络受限于浅层架构和小数据集：结晶过程仅概率性成功，且深度增加时理论保证失效。
AI.method: 引入残差连接（ResNet式跳跃连接），在合并神经元处按构造保持符号对应；内层神经元通过结晶策略训练趋向可表示性。分析三种结晶策略：修正的Levenberg-Marquardt、直通估计（STE）、近端正则化。
AI.result: 残差连接使Łukasiewicz网络可扩展至任意深度，合并神经元自动满足神经元分类命题，不受内层权重影响；三种结晶策略各自的理论保证、失效模式与可解释性权衡被刻画。
AI.conclusion: 残差连接解决了深度扩展问题，三类结晶策略分析为符号知识提取的深层网络训练提供理论指导。

title: Temporal Graph Learning of Wearable Actigraphy and Sleep Traces for Modelling Adolescent Crystallized Intelligence
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems for possible publication
summary: Wearable actigraphy offers a scalable, ecologically valid alternative to episodic clinical assessment. However, predicting continuous adolescent crystallized intelligence ($G_c$) from such traces remains challenging due to irregular device adherence and complex behavioral-environmental interactions. We address this using daily summary data derived from 21-day Fitbit records of 6,091 adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study (Release 5.1). We propose SATURN, a Sleep-Activity Temporal Unified Regression Network. It represents participants as 21-node temporal graphs encoding daily behaviors and temporal adjacency. To prevent imputation artifacts, invalid-day edges are dynamically pruned during forward passes. Node embeddings are refined via residual GATv2 layers, aggregated through masked attention pooling, and fused with sociodemographic covariates. Under family-controlled, age-sex-BMI-stratified cross-validation, SATURN achieves $R^2 = 0.2783 \pm 0.0127$, consistently improving upon flattened machine learning (Gradient Boosting, $R^2 = 0.2372$) and sequential deep learning (BiLSTM, $R^2 = 0.2688$) baselines. Explainability analyses identify light activity, metabolic equivalents, and sleep duration as dominant predictors, while Monte Carlo dropout and subgroup analyses confirm equitable performance across sociodemographic strata. Ultimately, SATURN establishes a rigorous computational framework for digital cognitive phenotyping, offering a scalable pathway to complement traditional assessments by highlighting macro-level behavioral anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SATURN模型，用Fitbit可穿戴设备21天记录预测青少年晶体智力，通过时序图神经网络处理不规则设备佩戴问题。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备提供可扩展的评估替代方案，但从佩戴数据预测青少年晶体智力面临设备佩戴不规律和行为-环境交互复杂的挑战。
AI.method: SATURN将参与者表示为21节点的时序图；前向传播中动态剪枝无效日期边以避免插补伪影；用残差GATv2层精炼节点嵌入，经掩码注意力池化聚合，并与社会人口协变量融合。
AI.result: 在家庭控制、年龄-性别-BMI分层的交叉验证中，SATURN达到R²=0.2783±0.0127，优于梯度提升（0.2372）和BiLSTM（0.2688）；可解释性分析显示轻活动、代谢当量和睡眠时长是主要预测因子；蒙特卡洛dropout与亚组分析确认跨人群公平性。
AI.conclusion: SATURN为数字认知表型建立了严谨的计算框架，提供可扩展途径以补充传统评估，并突显宏观行为异常。

title: Can LLMs Value the Right Evidence? Evidence-Value Misalignment in Dynamic Medical Diagnosis
summary: A correct diagnosis reached from insufficient or misleading evidence can pose a clinical hazard, yet outcome-based accuracy may reward such lucky guesses. We call this mismatch between diagnostic decisions and the value of available evidence Evidence-Value Misalignment (EVM). To disentangle evidential grounding independently from diagnostic accuracy, we introduce MedEVM, a dynamic benchmarking environment comprising 1,050 cases across 24 disease systems. Observations arrive turn by turn, requiring models to continuously calibrate its decision by deciding whether to wait for more evidence or submit a diagnosis. Across 9 LLMs, four interesting patterns are observed. (1) Miscalibrated evidence tracking. Making a diagnosis often fails to calibrate evidence sufficiency, even in more capable models, and even worsens in reasoning mode. (2) Misaligned diagnosis submission. Confidence in the correct diagnosis often fails to ensure timely submission despite sufficient evidence. (3) Evidence order matters. Reordering the same evidence changes diagnoses even when model confidence remains similar. (4) Misleading evidence remains influential. Added misleading evidence redirects diagnoses even after prior evidence becomes sufficient. We further verify that EVM predicts errors and that preventing premature submission improves accuracy. These findings motivate Evidence-Verified Diagnosis Harness (EVD-Harness). It decouples diagnosis generation from submission through an offline Contrastive Diagnostic Wiki and three online control stages, namely observation management, proposal and witness verification, and diagnosis submission control. Across five LLMs, EVD-Harness improves accuracy by 12.0--51.1 percentage points while mitigating EVM-related failures. Our results demonstrate that verifying evidential support before submission can make diagnostic decisions more reliable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ev值-证据错位(EVM)概念，即诊断决策与证据价值不匹配的问题，并构建MedEVM动态基准(1050案例/24疾病系统)揭示9个LLM的四种错位模式，进而提出EVD-Harness(离线对比诊断Wiki+三阶段在线控制)，在5个LLM上提升准确率12.0–51.1个百分点并缓解EVM失效。
AI.motivation: 基于结果的诊断准确率可能奖励"幸运猜测"——即从不足或误导性证据中得出正确诊断，存在临床隐患。核心动机是需将"证据基础"与"诊断准确率"解耦评估，以衡量模型是否真正基于充分证据做出决策。
AI.method: 构建MedEVM动态基准环境，涵盖24个疾病系统共1050案例，观察逐步(逐轮)到达，模型须决定继续等待证据还是提交诊断。基于此对9个LLM进行测试，发现四类EVM模式。随后提出EVD-Harness：将诊断生成与提交解耦，包含离线对比诊断Wiki及三个在线控制阶段——观察管理、提议与见证验证、诊断提交控制。
AI.result: 9个LLM中观察到四种模式：(1)证据跟踪校准失准，即便更强模型亦如此，推理模式下更糟；(2)诊断提交错位，对正确诊断的信心未能确保及时提交；(3)证据顺序影响诊断，即使置信度相近；(4)误导性证据持续影响，在先前证据已充分后仍会改变诊断。并验证EVM可预测错误、阻止过早提交可提升准确率。EVD-Harness在五个LLM上准确率提升12.0–51.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在提交诊断前验证证据支持可使诊断决策更可靠，EVD-Harness有效缓解EVM相关失效，说明将诊断生成与提交解耦、对证据充分性进行显式验证是提升临床诊断可靠性的关键。

title: ForeFly: A Dual-Horizon World Action Model for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial Vision-Language Navigation (AVLN) requires UAVs to maintain reliable instruction following over long trajectories in complex 3D environments. However, existing AVLN approaches are predominantly reactive or limited to single-horizon prediction, overlooking complementary future cues across different temporal horizons. To address this limitation, we propose ForeFly, a dual-horizon latent world action model that predicts both a proximal future for local continuity and an adaptive route-critical future for long-range guidance. Horizon-specific foresight queries are primed with recent and route-critical visual memories, providing history-aware context for future prediction. To exploit their distinct roles in action generation, we introduce Foresight-Guided Action Refinement (FGAR), which asymmetrically exploits proximal foresight for local action enhancement and route-critical foresight for feature-wise correction and route-level guidance. Experiments on the TravelUAV and UAV-ON benchmarks show that ForeFly consistently outperforms strong baselines across seen and unseen settings, validating the effectiveness of dual-horizon foresight and FGAR learning. The code is available at: https://github.com/kunhuiW/ForeFly

AI.tldr: 提出 ForeFly，一种双时间视野潜在世界动作模型，用于空中视觉语言导航，通过近端与自适应路径关键未来预测提升导航性能。
AI.motivation: 现有空中视觉语言导航（AVLN）方法多为反应式或单视野预测，忽略了不同时间尺度上的互补未来线索。
AI.method: 设计双视野潜在世界动作模型，预测近端未来（局部连续性）和自适应路径关键未来（远程引导）；用近期与路径关键视觉记忆初始化时间视野特定的预见查询；引入 Foresight-Guided Action Refinement（FGAR），非对称地利用近端预见增强局部动作，利用路径关键预见进行特征校正与路径级引导。
AI.result: 在 TravelUAV 和 UAV-ON 基准上，ForeFly 在已见和未见设置下均持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 验证了双视野预见与 FGAR 学习的有效性，代码已开源。

title: What Must a World Model Distinguish for Planning?
summary: World models simulate the consequences of action candidates, but good planning need not preserve every physical distinction required for accurate prediction. We formalize this gap through a hierarchy of mechanism, response, and decision sufficiency. Given a candidate set, the planning query determines which physical variations matter and how precisely they must be preserved: coarse decisions can discard much of the information needed for prediction, whereas fine decisions may require nearly the same resolution. In practice, planners often adaptively search to construct candidates, and information unnecessary for final selection may still be needed to discover good candidates. What a world model must preserve therefore depends on the query, the candidate set, and the planner. We study these effects in a collision system, nonlinear dynamics, and robotic planning. These varying requirements raise a design question: where should query information enter the planning system? A model that jointly generates actions and outcomes conditioned on the query achieves lower regret than an action-conditioned world model on seen objectives, but this advantage largely disappears when generalizing to unseen objectives. Motivated by this, we propose a modular design in which the query determines where to look and an action-conditioned model predicts what will happen, allowing the same predictions to be reused across objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文将世界模型需保留的信息需求形式化为机制、响应与决策充分性三个层级，指出其依赖查询、候选集与规划器；在碰撞系统、非线性动力学与机器人规划中验证后，提出"查询决定看哪里、动作条件模型预测会发生什么"的模块化设计。
AI.motivation: 世界模型用于模拟动作候选的后果，但好的规划并不需要保留准确预测所需的全部物理区分。现有做法未明确规划查询究竟需要保留哪些信息，因此需要刻画这种信息需求差距并指导世界模型的设计。
AI.method: 通过机制、响应、决策三层充分性层级进行形式化分析；给定候选集，规划查询决定哪些物理变化重要及其精度要求。在碰撞系统、非线性动力学和机器人规划中研究这些效应，并比较"以查询为条件联合生成动作与结果"的模型与"动作条件"世界模型。
AI.result: 联合生成动作与结果的查询条件模型在已见目标上比动作条件世界模型遗憾更低，但该优势在泛化到未见目标时基本消失。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型必须保留的信息取决于查询、候选集和规划器。据此提出模块化设计：由查询决定"看哪里"，由动作条件模型预测"会发生什么"，使同一预测可跨目标复用。

title: Which the Eye Fears: Writing with Read-Blindness Explains Massive Activations in Transformers
summary:
Massive activation features (MAs) in Transformers are extreme-value residual-stream features that persist across layers despite the model's ability to suppress them. Why do they survive? Our investigation using an operator-level mechanistic analysis of attention and feed-forward (FFN) blocks reveals that these blocks systematically ignore MA coordinates while reading, but not while writing; creating a read-write asymmetry that blocks corrective feedback while allowing continued accumulation. We find that both attention and feed-forward layers have this read-blindness, and contribute to the emergence and persistence of MAs.
  To validate prior work that hypothesized that FFN's amplification abilities is the primary reason for MAs (Sun et al., 2026), we analyze the model checkpoints during learning. Contrary to our expectation, read-blindness emerges before FFN amplification, suggesting that it acts upstream in the MA mechanism. We further contribute gradient analysis to link this behavior to surprising asymmetries in the loss landscape, concluding that the model actively maintains this read-blindness. Finally, we find that removing read-blocking at different locations induces compensatory shifts elsewhere, but MAs still persist.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究 Transformer 中 Massive activation features (MAs) 为何能跨层持续存在。作者通过算子级机制分析发现，注意力与 FFN 模块在“读取”时会系统性忽略 MA 坐标，但在“写入”时不会，形成读写不对称，从而阻断纠正反馈、允许 MA 持续累积。
AI.motivation: MAs 是残差流中的极端值特征，尽管模型有能力抑制它们，却依然跨层持续存在。作者想弄清这种持续性背后的机制，并验证此前关于 FFN 放大作用是 MA 主因的假说。
AI.method: 对 attention 和 FFN 模块做算子级机制分析；分析学习过程中的模型 checkpoint；引入梯度分析，将读写不对称与损失景观的不对称性联系起来；并通过在不同位置移除 read-blocking 做干预实验。
AI.result: attention 和 FFN 都存在 read-blindness，且都参与 MAs 的产生与持续。与预期相反，read-blindness 出现在 FFN 放大之前，说明它在 MA 机制中处于上游。梯度分析表明模型会主动维持这种 read-blindness。移除不同位置的 read-blocking 会引起其他位置的补偿性转移，但 MAs 仍然持续存在。
AI.conclusion: MAs 的持续源于读写不对称：模块读取时忽略 MA 坐标、写入时不忽略，阻断纠正反馈并允许累积。FFN 放大并非首要原因，read-blindness 更上游，且模型似乎主动维持这一行为；单纯局部移除 read-blocking 不足以消除 MAs。

title: Fill2SR: Repurposing Inpainting Diffusion Transformers for Real-World Super-Resolution
comment: ECCV 2026. 26 pages, 12 figures, including an 8-page appendix with additional visual results
summary: Recent real-world image super-resolution (SR) methods often adapt text-to-image (T2I) backbones with ControlNet-style branches or spatial conditioning tokens, which increases memory and computes with resolution and often constrains training to a fixed scale. We propose Fill2SR, which repurposes a masked-inpainting Diffusion Transformer for SR without extra spatial branches. Our Inpainting-Interface Evidence Adapter (IIEA) writes the low-quality (LQ) observation into the native masked-image slot under a full-image mask, turning inpainting into a reverse-degradation conditional rectified flow trained with LoRA-only tuning. We further introduce RCDT, an offline pipeline that distills degradation descriptors from unpaired real images and transfers them onto clean targets using frozen open-source models. Fill2SR supports mixed-resolution training up to QHD and yields stable performance across $512/1024/2048$ outputs. On synthetic benchmarks, our base model with IIEA achieves the best LPIPS on DIV2K and LSDIR; adding RCDT trades a small LPIPS drop for consistently stronger no-reference quality on RealLQ250 and RealPhoto60. Fill2SR remains memory-predictable, running $1536^2$ inference on a single 32GB GPU and extending to multi-megapixel outputs via tiled restoration.

AI.tldr: Fill2SR将掩码修复扩散Transformer复用为超分模型，通过IIEA适配器把低质图像写入掩码槽，无需额外空间分支，支持混合分辨率训练与QHD输出。
AI.motivation: 现有真实世界超分方法依赖ControlNet式分支或空间条件token，内存和计算随分辨率增长，且训练常受限于固定尺度。作者希望无需额外空间分支即可实现高分辨率超分。
AI.method: 提出Fill2SR：复用掩码修复Diffusion Transformer。IIEA把LQ观测写入全图掩码下的原生掩码图像槽，将修复转化为反向退化条件矫正流，仅用LoRA微调。RCDT离线流水线从无配对真实图像蒸馏退化描述符并迁移到干净目标。
AI.result: 合成基准上，带IIEA的基础模型在DIV2K和LSDIR达到最佳LPIPS；加入RCDT以少量LPIPS下降换取RealLQ250和RealPhoto60上更强的无参考质量。支持512/1024/2048输出，单张32GB GPU可跑1536²推理，并可通过分块扩展到多百万像素输出。
AI.conclusion: Fill2SR证明修复式Diffusion Transformer可高效复用于真实世界超分，内存可预测、分辨率可扩展，为高分辨率SR提供了轻量可行方案。

title: Balancing Early Performance Sacrifices with Long-Term Gains: Scaling Learning-Rate Warmup Duration Across Training Horizons
summary: Learning-rate warmup is a standard technique in language-model training, yet its duration remains largely heuristic. Common approaches use either a fixed number of updates or a fixed fraction of the training horizon, two choices that imply very different scaling as training gets longer. When should warmup stay fixed, and when should it grow with the horizon? We address this question with a quadratic model whose modes respond differently to the peak learning rate. Warmup slows progress in directions that already contract well at the peak rate, but can remove persistent error in directions near the stability edge, with higher peak rates shifting the balance toward longer warmup durations. This yields a compact horizon scaling law that captures regimes ranging from essentially no warmup, through fixed-duration warmup, to durations that grow with the training horizon, and explains how the preferred regime changes with peak learning rate. Because the law captures the tradeoff between giving up early progress and improving the trajectory that follows, it can be fit using shorter runs and used to predict warmup at substantially longer horizons. Together, our results explain several familiar properties of warmup through a single tradeoff and suggest treating warmup duration as a horizon-dependent hyperparameter rather than a fixed training heuristic.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型训练中学习率预热（warmup）时长应如何随训练时长变化，提出一个紧凑的 horizon scaling law，揭示从几乎不需预热，到固定时长预热，再到随时长增长预热的多种 regime，并说明其如何随峰值学习率变化。
AI.motivation: 预热时长目前多为启发式设置：常用固定更新步数或固定训练总时长比例，两者在长训练下标度差异巨大。论文试图回答何时预热应保持固定、何时应随训练时长增长。
AI.method: 基于一个二次模型，其中不同模式对峰值学习率响应不同：预热会拖慢在峰值率下已良好收缩方向的进度，但能消除接近稳定边缘方向的持续误差；更高峰值率使平衡倾向于更长预热。由此推导出 horizon scaling law。
AI.result: 该标度律覆盖从几乎无预热、固定时长预热，到预热时长随训练 horizon 增长的多种 regime，并解释优选 regime 如何随峰值学习率变化；同时可用较短训练拟合并预测更长 horizon 下的预热时长。
AI.conclusion: 结果通过单一权衡解释了预热的若干已知性质，建议将预热时长视为依赖 horizon 的超参数，而非固定训练启发式。

title: Rubric Rewards from Item Response Theory
summary: Many language tasks have no single answer that can be checked automatically. Rubrics provide criteria for judging responses to these tasks. For reinforcement learning, the resulting verdicts must be combined into a scalar reward. A common approach sums the points assigned to satisfied criteria. Distinct verdict patterns can thus receive the same reward, and the fixed points encode how much each criterion should count, not how strongly its verdict distinguishes the current rollouts. Beyond this aggregation problem, judging the full rubric needs more judge requests as the criterion count grows. To address these limitations, Rubric Response Theory (RRT) measures quality and selects criteria when rubric criteria are monotone indicators of a shared target. Rather than adding assigned points, RRT uses a two parameter item response model that treats the verdict pattern as evidence about scalar quality specific to the rubric. Under this model, its likelihood score maximizes the local signal-to-noise ratio for quality. Its Response Parameter Network (RPN) reads the prompt and criterion text to predict criterion difficulty and discrimination. As the policy distribution changes during training, RRT uses online expectation maximization to update the RPN from current rollout verdicts. With Qwen3.5-4B as the policy, RRT's macro criterion score across Medical, Science, Rubrics as Rewards Science, and RubricBench is 1.7 points above that of group relative policy optimization (GRPO). On hard and very hard criteria in Medical and Science, RRT gains 2.8 to 5.6 points over GRPO. At half the criterion budget, adaptive Fisher selection with a frozen RPN keeps the macro criterion score across four datasets within 0.1 points of GRPO with full judging. These results show RRT can reduce judge requests while remaining competitive with GRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Rubric Response Theory (RRT)，将 rubric 评分建模为两参数项目反应模型，用似然分数聚合判决模式，并通过 Response Parameter Network 与在线 EM 自适应训练，减少评测请求的同时在多个基准上优于 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 许多语言任务没有可自动校验的单一答案，rubric 提供评判标准。但将判决转为 RL 标量奖励时，常见做法是把满足标准的分数相加，导致不同判决模式可能得到相同奖励，且固定分值只编码标准的重要性而非对当前 rollout 的区分度；此外标准数量增长会带来更多 judge 请求。
AI.method: RRT 假设 rubric 标准是共享目标的单调指标。它不累加分数，而用两参数项目反应模型把判决模式视为关于该 rubric 标量质量的证据，以最大化局部信噪比的似然分数作为奖励。Response Parameter Network (RPN) 读取 prompt 与标准文本，预测标准难度和区分度；训练中策略分布变化时，用在线期望最大化从当前 rollout 判决更新 RPN。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3.5-4B 为策略，RRT 在 Medical、Science、Rubrics as Rewards Science、RubricBench 上的 macro criterion score 比 GRPO 高 1.7 分；在 Medical 和 Science 的 hard/very hard 标准上比 GRPO 高 2.8 至 5.6 分。在标准预算减半时，使用冻结 RPN 的自适应 Fisher 选择，四数据集 macro 分数与全量评判的 GRPO 差距在 0.1 分以内。
AI.conclusion: RRT 能减少 judge 请求，同时在多个基准上保持与 GRPO 竞争甚至更优的表现，说明将 rubric 判决作为质量证据建模并自适应选择标准是可行且有效的方向。

title: IVT-Guard: All-in-One Reasoning Model for AI-Generated Content Detection
summary: The rapid proliferation of highly realistic AI-Generated Content (AIGC) necessitates robust and interpretable detection mechanisms. However, existing detectors are predominantly confined to single modalities and provide binary outputs without reasoning. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) present a promising solution, their development is constrained by the scarcity of multimodal reasoning data and the reasoning-detection optimization dilemma, where explicit reasoning supervision can compromise detection accuracy. To this end, we introduce IVT-Set, a comprehensive dataset comprising over 152K diverse image, video, and text samples equipped with multi-granularity Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Based on it, we propose IVT-Guard, a pioneering framework for unified and interpretable AIGC detection across image, video, and text modalities. Furthermore, to overcome the aforementioned optimization dilemma, we design a novel three-stage training paradigm: Artifact-Aware Pre-training, Artifact-to-Evidence Supervised Fine-Tuning via artifact-aware injection, and Evidence-Verdict Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IVT-Guard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance across in-domain, out-of-domain, and cross-dataset settings while delivering faithful reasoning. Code and data will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出IVT-Set数据集与IVT-Guard框架，实现图像、视频、文本多模态AIGC统一可解释检测，并设计三阶段训练范式解决推理-检测优化困境。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC检测器局限于单模态且仅输出二分类结果缺乏推理；MLLM虽有潜力，但面临多模态推理数据稀缺及显式推理监督损害检测精度的优化困境。
AI.method: 构建超152K图像/视频/文本样本且含多粒度CoT推理轨迹的IVT-Set数据集；提出统一可解释的IVT-Guard框架；设计三阶段训练：伪影感知预训练、基于伪影感知注入的伪影到证据监督微调、证据-判定一致性GRPO。
AI.result: 在域内、域外及跨数据集设置下均达到SOTA检测性能，同时提供忠实的推理过程。
AI.conclusion: IVT-Guard验证了统一、可解释的多模态AIGC检测的可行性，缓解了推理与检测精度间的优化矛盾，数据集与代码将开源。

title: Cost-free Spectral Estimation for Adaptive Newton--Schulz in Matrix Optimizers
summary: Matrix optimizers such as Muon transform each momentum matrix through an approximate orthogonalization, typically implemented by a small number of Newton-Schulz matrix multiplications. The quality and cost of this approximation depend strongly on the singular-value spectrum of its input, yet existing implementations use the same fixed polynomial routine for every layer and throughout training. We show that this uniform treatment is unnecessary: the computations in the Newton-Schulz method already reveal enough information to make the method adaptive. The Gram matrices formed inside Newton-Schulz iterations yield spectral moments through inexpensive scalar reductions, requiring no additional matrix multiplications. From these moments, we recover an estimate of the empirical singular-value distribution and use it to select a polynomial routine specialized to the current matrix. This turns Newton--Schulz orthogonalization into a spectrum-adaptive procedure that responds to differences across both layers and training time. On saved momentum matrices, spectral estimation substantially reduces orthogonalization error at a fixed iteration budget or reaches the same accuracy with fewer iterations, and in GPT pretraining up to 1B parameters it lowers the validation loss of two matrix optimizers. Our results suggest that matrix-function operations inside optimizers need not be designed for a conservative worst-case spectrum: they can cheaply measure the spectrum they are already processing and specialize computations accordingly.

AI.tldr: 提出对抗性谱自适应 Newton–Schulz 正交化方法，利用迭代中 Gram 矩阵的谱矩估计奇异值分布，为每个矩阵选择专用多项式例程，提升矩阵优化器（如 Muon）的效率与效果。
AI.motivation: 现有矩阵优化器（如 Muon）对每个动量矩阵用相同的固定 Newton–Schulz 多项式做近似正交化，忽略不同层和不同训练阶段奇异值谱的差异，导致精度与开销非最优。作者认为这种统一处理不必要。
AI.method: 在 Newton–Schulz 迭代过程中，利用已形成的 Gram 矩阵通过廉价的标量归约（无需额外矩阵乘法）得到谱矩，进而估计经验奇异值分布；据此为当前矩阵选择专门的多项式例程，将正交化变为谱自适应过程。
AI.result: 在保存的动量矩阵上，固定迭代预算下显著降低正交化误差，或减少迭代次数达到同等精度；在最高 10 亿参数的 GPT 预训练中，降低了两种矩阵优化器的验证损失。
AI.conclusion: 优化器内部的矩阵函数操作不必按保守的最坏情况谱设计，可廉价地测量正在处理的谱并据此特化计算。

title: MAC-Net: A Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Modeling Cognitive Function From Task-Based fMRI
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 supplementary tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering for possible publication
summary: Objective cognitive assessment from neural signals supports neurorehabilitation, but individual-level prediction from task-based fMRI (tfMRI) remains difficult because neural features coexist with substantial demographic and scanner-related variation. We present the Multi-task Activation and Contrast Network (MAC-Net), a covariate-aware deep learning framework for modeling individual cognitive function from regional tfMRI. By isolating tfMRI features into a dedicated neural pathway and restricting participant variables to a terminal late-fusion pathway, MAC-Net prevents dominant covariates from suppressing high-dimensional clinical representations during feature learning. Evaluating baseline data from 6,500 Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study participants under family-aware cross-validation, MAC-Net was benchmarked against linear models, random forests, and alternative deep architectures. The N-back plus Monetary Incentive Delay configuration achieved $R^{2}$ values of 0.174, 0.238, and 0.277 for fluid, crystallized, and total cognition, outperforming covariate-only baselines (0.178) and alternative deep models (0.217). N-back was the most informative paradigm, whereas incorporating the Stop Signal Task marginally degraded performance. Feature attributions via Integrated Gradients, DeepLIFT, and Input Gradient were highly concordant, localizing working-memory-related frontal, parietal, and cingulate regions. These findings demonstrate that covariate-aware multi-task modeling yields reproducible cognitive-function estimations, establishing a robust neural engineering framework for clinical translation.

AI.tldr: MAC-Net是一个协变量感知的深度学习框架，通过分离tfMRI神经特征与参与者变量，实现从任务态fMRI对个体认知功能的预测。
AI.motivation: 基于神经信号的客观认知评估有助于神经康复，但从任务态fMRI进行个体级预测困难，因为神经特征与人口统计及扫描仪相关变异共存，主导性协变量会掩盖临床表征。
AI.method: 提出MAC-Net（多任务激活与对比网络），将tfMRI特征隔离到专门的神经通路，把参与者变量限制在终端的晚期融合通路中。在6500名ABCD研究参与者的基线数据上，采用家庭感知交叉验证，与线性模型、随机森林及替代深度架构进行对比。
AI.result: N-back加MID配置在流体、晶体及总认知上R²分别为0.174、0.238、0.277，优于仅协变量基线（0.178）和替代深度模型（0.217）。N-back最具信息量，加入Stop Signal任务略微降低性能。Integrated Gradients、DeepLIFT和Input Gradient的特征归因高度一致，定位到工作记忆相关额叶、顶叶和扣带回区域。
AI.conclusion: 协变量感知的多任务建模可产生可复现的认知功能估计，为临床转化建立了稳健的神经工程框架。

title: Late Attention Layers Alone Can Copy Entity Tokens, but Not Without Attending to Their Context
summary: Large language models (LLMs) reliably perform entity copying, in which a model copies tokens referring to an entity, termed entity tokens, from the prompt into its output to answer a question. Although entity copying is straightforward for most LLMs, existing research does not provide a systematic account of which layers specialize in this fundamental task or how other tokens in the same sequence, termed context tokens, influence the model's ability to copy the entity tokens. To address these questions, we conduct experiments on Qwen3-8B using two novel methods: genie-in-a-bottle, which controls exactly which layers can participate in an entity-copying task, and attention lobotomy, which cuts off specific tokens' attention to entity tokens without affecting the remaining attention distribution. We find that two distinct groups of layers in the second half of the model are both necessary and sufficient for entity copying. Moreover, in addition to the decoding position's attention to entity tokens, context tokens' attention to entity tokens also proves necessary for copying the exact tokens, even though context tokens do not store entity information themselves unless they satisfy particular semantic properties. Our findings establish the critical role of late layers in entity copying under the guidance of context tokens, calling for future work on how models propagate and consume entity information.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究LLM实体复制任务的层特化与上下文token影响，通过两种新方法发现模型后半部分两组层对实体复制必要且充分，且上下文token对实体token的注意力也是复制的关键。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对哪些层专门负责实体复制任务，以及同序列中其他context token如何影响实体复制的系统解释。
