AI.method: 提出CompoWorld：用编码智能体将工具规范转化为带类型状态和共享接口的验证服务，世界模型处理无法可靠实现的工具；通过随机游走以依赖图连接服务，生成并验证需跨服务信息流动的任务。验证轨迹用于SFT，Completion-Focused Rubric Reward引导RL关注每组内通过率较低的标准以促进完整任务完成。构建448个服务、10,130个工具，用3K SFT轨迹和1K RL任务训练Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。
AI.result: CompoWorld在八个基准上平均比backbone提升9.17分；在AutomationBench上超过Claude Opus 4.6等前沿模型，并在所比较的35B-A3B专用智能体模型中领先。
AI.conclusion: 组合式环境扩展能有效生成跨服务任务，提升通用智能体的训练效果与性能。

title: Video, Ergo Genero: Unifying Video Tasks via Spatiotemporal Analogy
summary: Adapting video models to new tasks typically requires dedicated data curation and fine-tuning. While visual analogy provides a training-free alternative by specifying tasks in-context, it remains restricted to the image domain. To explore whether analogy-based methods can unify diverse video tasks and generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios, we introduce ViGeo, a framework that extends visual in-context learning to the video domain via spatiotemporal canvas completion. Evaluated on a diverse task taxonomy with a strict train-test split, ViGeo generalizes to unseen video manipulations and zero-shot modalities (e.g., event cameras). Finally, we identify task internalization, where a query format associated with a pretrained task overrides the demonstration, and show that this shortcut can be removed with a small amount of task-unrelated data, highlighting the need to decorrelate prompt format from task identity.

AI.tldr: ViGeo 将视觉类比（in-context learning）从图像扩展到视频域，通过时空画布补全实现无训练的多样视频任务统一与分布外泛化。
AI.motivation: 适配视频模型到新任务通常需要专门的数据整理与微调；视觉类比提供免训练替代方案，但此前仅限于图像域。
AI.method: 提出 ViGeo 框架，通过时空画布补全（spatiotemporal canvas completion）将视觉 in-context learning 扩展到视频域；在带严格训练-测试划分的多样任务分类体系上评估。
AI.result: ViGeo 能泛化到未见过的视频操作任务及零样本模态（如事件相机）；发现"任务内化"现象——与预训练任务相关的查询格式会覆盖演示，该捷径可用少量任务无关数据消除。
AI.conclusion: 类比方法可统一多样视频任务并具备泛化能力；需解耦提示格式与任务身份以消除任务内化捷径。

title: When Does Backpropagating Through Policy Memory Matter? Physical Credit, Optimizer Updates, and Observability
comment: 33 pages, 9 figures, 20 tables, Under review at TMLR
summary: Policies with memory can learn along two backward paths: through the physical states their actions produce and through the representations they store. Transformer-XL and truncated backpropagation through time cut the second path at stored history while keeping its values. We ask when this cut matters. Holding the forward computation fixed and varying only derivative edges, we measure parameter gradients, the updates the optimizer applies, and continued training in a Transformer vessel-trajectory model and a quadrotor tracking policy. In the vessel model, detaching the key-value cache shrank the gradient to about a tenth of its norm, with little rotation, when gradients flowed through all earlier physical states, but barely changed it under one-step physical credit. In this strongly clipped regime the optimizer, not the gradient, set how far updates differed: global-norm clipping removed most of the gradient difference between memory-cut graphs, whereas AdamW turned a 2% gradient difference between two placements of the cut into update differences of up to 31% at the step where the placement was switched. In a quadrotor trained from initialization with 0.20 m/s velocity noise, removing memory raised tracking error by 43% and cutting memory gradients raised it by 32%; at low noise the cut's mean cost exceeded the value of memory. Two-step truncation segments gave no measurable gain, although with hidden velocity a two-step window captured most of the value of memory; eight-step segments removed half to three quarters of the cost. Switching the cut on only for the last fifth of training understated its cost about threefold at 0.20-0.30 m/s, but not at low noise or with hidden velocity. These results suggest measuring the cost of a memory cut by training with it from initialization, and comparing backward graphs by the updates the optimizer applies rather than by raw gradients.

AI.tldr: 本文研究策略记忆的反向梯度路径被切断（如Transformer-XL或截断BPTT）何时真正影响训练，通过固定前向计算、仅改变反向图来测量梯度、优化器更新和持续训练效果。
AI.motivation: 带记忆的策略有两条反向学习路径：通过动作产生的物理状态和通过存储的表示。既有方法（Transformer-XL、截断BPTT）在保留记忆值的同时切断了表示路径的反向传播，但这一切断何时重要尚不清楚。
AI.method: 固定前向计算，仅改变导数边，在Transformer船舶轨迹模型和四旋翼跟踪策略上测量参数梯度、优化器实际更新及持续训练表现；对比不同记忆切断位置、截断长度（2步、8步）及训练后期才启用切断等设置。
AI.result: 船舶模型中，切断KV缓存使梯度范数降至约十分之一、方向变化小（当梯度流经所有早期物理状态时），但在单步物理信用下几乎无差异；强裁剪下优化器而非梯度决定更新差异：全局范数裁剪消除大部分差异，而AdamW将2%梯度差异放大为切换步高达31%的更新差异。四旋翼在0.20 m/s噪声下，移除记忆使跟踪误差增43%、切断记忆梯度增32%；低噪声时切断的代价超过记忆价值。2步截断无增益，8步截断消除一半到四分之三的代价；仅在最后五分之一训练启用切断会低估约三倍代价（0.20–0.30 m/s时）。
AI.conclusion: 应从初始化起就带着记忆切断进行训练来评估其代价，并用优化器实际施加的更新而非原始梯度来比较不同反向图。

title: Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) and Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) are traditionally treated as disjoint problems: the former adapts models to domain shift assuming all test classes are known, while the latter discovers novel categories assuming labeled training data for known classes. However, real-world deployment rarely fits either setting. Motivated by this gap, we introduce Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD), a unified and more realistic scenario where a vision-language model must adapt to distribution shifts, classify known categories using only textual supervision, and discover novel categories, all during test time and without access to labeled data. To address this challenging scenario, we propose PACT (Prototype Assignment for Category discovery at Test time), a fully unsupervised framework that casts known-class recognition and novel-class discovery via prototype assignment. PACT first re-aligns shifted visual features with the text-derived class representations of the VLM using confident zero-shot predictions. Known and novel categories are then both represented by prototypes in the visual embedding space, estimated from the unlabeled test stream, and each test image is assigned to the category whose prototype is most similar to its visual feature. Extensive experiments across corruption and domain-shift benchmarks demonstrate that PACT outperforms adapted state-of-the-art TTA and GCD methods, effectively bridging the gap between adaptation and discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Test-Time Generalized Category Discovery (TT-GCD)新场景，让视觉-语言模型在测试时无标签情况下同时适应分布偏移、分类已知类并发现新类，并提出无监督框架PACT解决该问题。
AI.motivation: 传统上Test-Time Adaptation (TTA)与Generalized Category Discovery (GCD)被视为互不相关的问题：TTA假设测试类全部已知、只处理域偏移；GCD假设已知类有标注训练数据、只发现新类。然而真实部署场景很少单独符合其中任何一种设定，因此存在将二者统一的需求。
AI.method: 提出PACT框架，完全无监督，通过原型分配(prototype assignment)统一已知类识别与新类发现。第一步利用高置信度零样本预测将偏移后的视觉特征与VLM的文本类表示重新对齐；第二步在视觉嵌入空间中为已知类和新类分别估计原型(来自无标签测试流)，每个测试图像被分配到与其视觉特征最相似的原型对应的类别。
AI.result: 在多个corruption与domain-shift基准上，PACT均优于经过适配的最先进TTA和GCD方法，有效弥合了适配与发现之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: PACT为TT-GCD这一统一且更贴近现实的场景提供了有效的无监督解决方案，验证了同时进行模型适配与类别发现的可行性。

title: Perturb-and-Solve: Efficient Learned-Operator Conditioning for Latent Diffusion Inverse Problems
summary: Latent diffusion models serve as powerful priors for solving inverse problems in image restoration, such as deblurring, inpainting, and super-resolution. Current methods have a trade-off between generality and efficiency. Solvers that are restricted to a fixed set of degradation operators are fast and efficient. Methods that support arbitrary degradation operators are slow and require gradients through the diffusion network. To break this bottleneck, we introduce PASEO (Perturb-And-Solve for Efficient Operator conditioning), a method that uses a small (1M parameters) learned network to degrade diffusion model predictions in latent space. PASEO supports learned degradation operators without back-propagating through the diffusion network. We efficiently sample reconstructions from an approximate posterior by combining the diffusion model's prediction with the observed image. We do this by adding noise and solving linear equations based on a local linear approximation of the learned network, without building or inverting large covariance matrices. Across super-resolution, deblurring, and inpainting on FFHQ and COCO, PASEO achieves strong perceptual quality while running up to 9x faster and using up to 34% less peak memory than the tested baselines, with the same or fewer model evaluations.

AI.tldr: PASEO提出用小型(1M参数)学习网络在潜空间对扩散模型预测进行退化，无需反传扩散网络即可支持任意退化算子，结合局部线性近似高效采样重建。
AI.motivation: 潜扩散模型求解图像复原逆问题时，现有方法在通用性与效率间存在权衡：固定退化算子求解器快但不通用；支持任意算子的方法慢且需梯度穿过扩散网络。
AI.method: 用小型(1M参数)学习网络在潜空间退化扩散模型预测；通过加噪并基于该网络的局部线性近似求解线性方程组，从近似后验采样重建，无需构建或求逆大协方差矩阵，也无需反传扩散网络。
AI.result: 在FFHQ和COCO上的超分辨率、去模糊、修复任务中，PASEO实现强感知质量，速度最高快9倍，峰值内存最多减少34%，且模型评估次数相同或更少。
AI.conclusion: PASEO打破了通用性与效率的权衡瓶颈，以学习退化算子+局部线性近似实现高效通用的潜扩散图像复原。

title: Auditing Agent Actions through Query-Conditioned Attribution
summary: LLM agents increasingly take consequential actions through interactions with users, policies, and external tools. Auditing these agents requires automated attribution of realized actions to their historical basis. However, existing attribution formulations do not provide question-specific traces for diverse auditing objectives. Additionally, when access to the acting model is limited (e.g., in API-only deployments), applicable methods commonly rely on costly input perturbations or external LLM analysis of complete trajectories. We therefore formulate $\textit{query-conditioned agent action attribution}, a new task that takes a natural-language auditing query as input and recovers the source and ordered intermediate evidence for the query-specified aspect of an action. We instantiate this task with $A^3Bench$, a benchmark comprising 1,396 auditing queries across policy basis, parameter provenance, failure propagation, and unsafe-behavior tracing. To enable efficient, query-specific attribution, we use small open-weight models as attribution proposers that combine query-conditioned gradient saliency with query-semantic relevance to rank history units. Our proposer consistently achieves stronger source and evidence rankings at lower inference cost than open-weight baselines, improving source MRR by up to 40.9\% and evidence MAP by 42.1\% with only two forward passes and one backward pass. Controlled evaluations confirm that our proposer improves attribution specificity by adapting its rankings to fine-grained changes in the auditing query. Building on a proposer ensemble, our end-to-end system surpasses the strongest frontier-model baseline in source accuracy (64.5\% vs.\ 60.4\%) while reducing empirical deployment latency by 29.9\% relative to the fastest frontier API baseline. Code and data will be released after the initial review period following final validation and cleanup.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"查询条件化智能体动作归因"新任务及A³Bench基准，用小型开源模型结合梯度显著性与语义相关性实现高效、查询特定的动作溯源。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地通过用户、策略和外部工具交互执行重要动作，审计需将已执行动作归因到其历史依据。但现有归因方法不提供针对不同审计目标的查询特定轨迹；且在API-only等受限访问下，现有方法依赖昂贵输入扰动或外部LLM分析完整轨迹。
AI.method: 形式化查询条件化智能体动作归因任务：输入自然语言审计查询，恢复动作指定方面的来源及有序中间证据。构建A³Bench基准（1,396条查询，覆盖策略依据、参数来源、失败传播、不安全行为追踪）。使用小型开源模型作为归因提出器，融合查询条件梯度显著性与查询语义相关性对历史单元排序。
AI.result: 提出器在更低推理成本下实现更强的来源与证据排序：来源MRR提升最高40.9%，证据MAP提升42.1%，仅需两次前向和一次反向传播。端到端系统来源准确率64.5%，超过最强前沿模型基线60.4%，部署延迟比最快前沿API基线降低29.9%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在受限访问下实现高效、查询特定的智能体动作归因，兼顾准确性与部署效率，代码与数据将在评审后发布。

title: Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors
summary: Immersive video communication requires photorealistic, render-efficient, and compact dynamic scene representations. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers a promising representation, but dynamic 3DGS remains difficult to compress due to dense primitives and spatiotemporal redundancy. Anchor-based formulations improve compactness with sparse scaffolds that share geometry and appearance across primitives. However, existing designs often rely on deforming a single canonical scaffold and condition each primitive on its associated anchor in isolation, limiting their ability to handle non-local dynamics and disocclusion while under-exploiting inter-anchor correlations, particularly in motion- or texture-dense regions. To address these limitations, we propose SAGA, a volumetric video codec built upon Sparse Anchor-assisted GAussian splatting representations. SAGA represents dynamic 3D scenes using hierarchically organized sparse 4D anchors, where coordinate-based INR decoders generate fine anchors and Gaussian primitives from inter-anchor interpolations, enabling compact parameter sharing across spatiotemporal structures. For long-range dependencies among unstructured anchors, we further introduce fixed-size memory slots with orthogonality-informed updates for accurate entropy-context modeling. Experiments show that SAGA achieves strong rate-distortion performance against GIFStream, with PSNR BD-rate reductions of 80.39% and 83.94% on Neu3D and MPEG MIV, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGA，基于稀疏动态锚点的3DGS体积视频编解码器，用分层稀疏4D锚点+INR解码器实现紧凑时空参数共享，并用正交性记忆槽建模长程依赖，率失真性能显著优于GIFStream。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式视频需逼真、渲染高效且紧凑的动态场景表示。动态3DGS因密集基元与时空冗余难以压缩；现有锚点方法依赖单规范支架变形、孤立条件化每个基元，难以处理非局部运动与去遮挡，且未利用锚点间相关性。
AI.method: SAGA将动态3D场景表示为分层组织的稀疏4D锚点，基于坐标的INR解码器通过锚点间插值生成细锚点与高斯基元，实现时空结构间的紧凑参数共享；针对非结构化锚点的长程依赖，引入固定大小记忆槽与正交性引导更新进行熵上下文建模。
AI.result: 相比GIFStream，在Neu3D上PSNR BD-rate降低80.39%，在MPEG MIV上降低83.94%，取得强率失真性能。
AI.conclusion: SAGA通过稀疏锚点与记忆槽机制有效提升动态3DGS压缩的紧凑性与率失真表现，适合沉浸式体积视频通信。

title: When an Evaluation Rule Writes Training Labels: Measuring Human-Reference Forgiveness in NAVSIM
summary: When the human reference scores zero on a metric, the released GTRS-Dense label generator for NAVSIM marks every candidate trajectory in the scene as passing it. NAVSIM's authors introduced this human-reference forgiveness to avoid penalizing contextually justified maneuvers when scoring one trajectory, and warned that it could overlook important failures. In label generation it sets a whole column of 16,384 candidate targets to passing. To measure the consequences for supervision, we re-run the generator with the overwrite disabled and compare the pre-overwrite targets with the released labels on all 103,288 navtrain scenes. The rule erases a candidate distinction that the training loss reads on 11,237 of them (10.8793%). Firing usually changes most of a column: lane keeping carries 9,982 of the 13,042 forgiven loss columns, and its median forgiven column had 14,391 of 16,384 candidates failing before the overwrite. On held-out navtest scenes forgiven on lane keeping, the released lane-keeping head's median AUC against the pre-overwrite outcome is 0.7095; on unforgiven scenes matched on failing-candidate count it is 0.9807. For the Hydra-MDP checkpoint released with GTRS, whose configuration takes the same label file, the two values are 0.6627 and 0.9761. Continuing the released GTRS-Dense checkpoint for 300 optimizer steps with three paired seeds, we observe the forgiven-scene AUC 0.1086-0.1251 higher with pre-overwrite than with published targets, and a narrower gap between matched groups, still above zero. Scoring with forgiveness disabled, we observe lane keeping higher by 2.478-3.524 points on navtest scenes forgiven on any of five loss metrics, with lower adjacent-frame plan consistency. Both changes are larger there than on the rest. EPDMS, scored the same way, does not separate the two target sets.

AI.tldr: 在NAVSIM的GTRS-Dense标签生成器中，当人类参考在某指标上得零分时会将该场景所有候选轨迹标记为通过，本文通过禁用该覆盖重跑生成器，量化其对监督信号的影响。
AI.motivation: NAVSIM作者引入"人类参考宽容"以避免在单轨迹评分时惩罚情境上合理的驾驶行为，但警告可能忽略重要失败。在标签生成中该规则将整列16,384个候选目标置为通过，其对监督的实际后果尚未量化。
AI.method: 在全部103,288个navtrain场景上，禁用覆盖并重跑生成器，比较覆盖前目标与已发布标签；评估两个已发布检查点（GTRS-Dense车道保持头、Hydra-MDP）的AUC；以三个配对种子继续训练300步对比；在navtest上以禁用宽容方式评分，并与EPDMS对照。
AI.result: 该规则在11,237个场景（10.8793%）擦除了训练损失读取的候选区分；车道保持占13,042个被宽容列中的9,982个，其中位被宽容列有14,391/16,384候选在覆盖前为失败。navtest上被宽容场景的中位AUC为0.7095（GTRS-Dense）与0.6627（Hydra-MDP），匹配的未宽容场景为0.9807与0.9761。继续训练后宽容场景AUC高0.1086–0.1251。禁用宽容评分时车道保持高2.478–3.524分但相邻帧规划一致性更低；EPDMS不区分两套目标。
AI.conclusion: 人类参考宽容在标签生成中大规模擦除有效监督信号并显著损害模型性能，尤其影响车道保持；禁用宽容可改善AUC但降低规划一致性，而EPDMS对此不敏感，表明该问题特定于GTRS-Dense的标签监督方式。

title: SWE-Game: Can Coding Agents Build the Games We Want?
summary: We introduce SWE-Game, a benchmark of 247 tasks grounded in 41 executable reference Godot games spanning 13 gameplay categories in 2D and 3D. Five task types cover development from a brief, implementation from a game design document, skeleton completion, repair of 83 injected-fault cases, and Godot-to-Unity porting. Reference materials specify the intended gameplay, while a shared instrumentation interface lets evaluator-owned drivers and probes execute actions and observe independently implemented games. Evaluation combines engine-state checks, certified reference-input replay, and agent-authored feature demonstrations to assess mechanic correctness, demonstrated playability, and behavioral restoration and preservation after repairs. Game-specific vision-language rubrics separately assess presentation. Across six models, Opus5 achieves the highest overall score in all five task types. Best overall scores remain below 60 out of 100 across the three construction tasks, with Brief-to-Game reaching 50.38. Analysis of reviewed submissions identifies requirement omissions and gameplay logic errors as predominant implementation problems. On human-labeled behaviors from 100 agent-built games, executable checks achieve 92.59% balanced accuracy, compared with 78.41% for a video-based VLM judge. Rubric-based visual scores reach a Spearman correlation of 0.829 with human ratings of 200 gameplay clips. Together, these results characterize current agent capabilities across game-development activities and support combining runtime evidence with visual assessment.

AI.tldr: SWE-Game 是一个基于 41 款可执行 Godot 游戏、13 类玩法的 247 任务基准，覆盖游戏开发的五种任务类型，并通过运行时证据与视觉评估结合来刻画智能体的游戏开发能力。
AI.motivation: 现有评测缺乏对游戏开发全流程（从需求到实现、修复、跨引擎移植）的系统性评估手段，且难以独立、可执行地衡量智能体构建游戏的能力。
AI.method: 构建 247 个任务，涵盖从需求简述开发、按设计文档实现、骨架补全、83 个注入故障修复以及 Godot 到 Unity 移植；采用共享插桩接口让评测方驱动与探针独立执行并观测游戏，结合引擎状态检查、认证参考输入回放与智能体自撰功能演示评估机制正确性、可玩性及修复后行为恢复与保持；另用游戏专属视觉语言评分表评估表现。
AI.result: 六个模型中 Opus5 在五类任务上总分最高，但三类构建任务最佳总分均低于 60（Brief-to-Game 为 50.38）；主要问题为需求遗漏与玩法逻辑错误。在 100 个智能体构建游戏的人工标注行为上，可执行检查达 92.59% 平衡准确率，视频 VLM 评判为 78.41%；评分表视觉得分与 200 个游戏片段人工评分的 Spearman 相关为 0.829。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了当前智能体在各类游戏开发活动中的能力水平，并表明结合运行时证据与视觉评估是有效的评测方向。

title: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark of YOLO-Based Weed Detection in Precision Agriculture
summary: Weed detection is an important component of precision agriculture, enabling site-specific weed management and reducing unnecessary herbicide use. Although deep learning methods have achieved strong results for crop and weed detection, many studies rely on single-dataset evaluation, making it difficult to assess robustness across different agricultural domains. This paper presents a multi-dataset benchmark of deep object detectors for weed detection in precision agriculture, with a focused evaluation of YOLO26 models. We evaluate nano, small, and medium variants on seven public weed-detection datasets covering different crops, weed species, field conditions, acquisition setups, and annotation protocols. The models are compared in terms of detection accuracy, model complexity, inference latency, FPS, and model size. In addition to in-dataset evaluation, we investigate cross-domain generalization using a unified one-class weed setup and evaluate multi-source training using the combined training subsets from all datasets. The results show that YOLO26 achieves strong in-dataset performance, with YOLO26m obtaining the highest average accuracy and YOLO26s providing the best practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off. However, cross-domain performance decreases substantially, with YOLO26s dropping from an average in-domain mAP$_{50:95}$ of 0.603 to 0.148 in the off-domain setting. Multi-source training improves performance on several datasets, but does not fully eliminate domain shift. Overall, the benchmark highlights the importance of dataset diversity, domain similarity, and target-domain adaptation for robust weed detection in real-world precision agriculture applications.

AI.tldr: 本文对YOLO26（n/s/m）在7个公开杂草检测数据集上进行多数据集基准评测，涵盖域内精度、复杂度、延迟与跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习杂草检测研究多依赖单数据集评估，难以判断模型跨不同农业场景的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 在7个公开杂草检测数据集（不同作物、杂草种类、田间条件、采集设备与标注协议）上评测YOLO26的nano/small/medium变体，比较检测精度、模型复杂度、推理延迟、FPS与模型大小；并进行统一单类杂草设置的跨域泛化实验和多源联合训练实验。
AI.result: 域内表现强：YOLO26m平均精度最高，YOLO26s精度-效率权衡最佳；但跨域性能大幅下降，YOLO26s的平均mAP50:95从域内0.603降至域外0.148；多源训练提升部分数据集表现，但未完全消除域偏移。
AI.conclusion: 数据集多样性、域相似性与目标域自适应对真实精准农业中的鲁棒杂草检测至关重要。

title: AG-CoT: Verified Algorithmic Traces for LLM Program Synthesis on Clifford Circuits
summary: Scientific code generation can produce executable programs that fail to compute the intended scientific object. We study this problem in language-model synthesis of Clifford circuits, which prepare the stabilizer states used in quantum error correction and admit exact classical verification. In our target-conditioned framework, each target is given as compact signed stabilizer generators, and an exact verifier checks the generated OpenQASM circuits. We supervise models with Aaronson-Gottesman chain-of-thought (AG-CoT) traces checked by the verifier, and continue training on model generations that the verifier accepts. Across two independently trained model families (3B and 7B), AG-CoT supervision multiplies greedy-decode state-equivalence accuracy by four to six times over circuit-only baselines, and verifier-filtered continuation training adds a further consistent gain atop both. A complementary 32B study shows that supervised models achieve near-perfect syntax and Clifford validity while the strongest direct model reaches 6.14% state equivalence per target, rising to over 10% under verifier-guided selection with multiple candidates. These results show that algorithmic trace supervision gives a large, statistically significant gain in both model families and that verifier-filtered continuation adds a further repeated gain. The persistent gap between Clifford validity and state equivalence confirms that exact verification is necessary: a circuit can be syntactically and physically valid yet prepare the wrong quantum state.

AI.tldr: 论文研究语言模型生成Clifford电路时"有效但错误"的问题，提出以稳定子生成元为目标的框架，用精确验证器监督AG-CoT训练并进行验证器过滤的持续训练，显著提升状态等价准确率。
AI.motivation: 科学代码生成可能生成可执行但计算错误科学对象的程序。作者以Clifford电路合成为切入点，因其可精确经典验证，能严格检查生成的OpenQASM电路是否真正制备目标稳定子态。
AI.method: 目标条件化框架：每个目标以紧凑的带符号稳定子生成元给出，精确验证器检查生成电路。使用经验证器检验的Aaronson-Gottesman链式思维（AG-CoT）轨迹监督模型，并对验证器接受的模型生成进行持续训练。
AI.result: 在两个独立训练的模型族（3B和7B）中，AG-CoT监督使贪心解码状态等价准确率比仅电路基线提升4-6倍，验证器过滤的持续训练带来进一步提升。32B研究中，监督模型语法与Clifford有效性近乎完美，最强直接模型状态等价率6.14%，多候选验证器引导选择下超过10%。
AI.conclusion: 算法轨迹监督在两个模型族中均带来大幅且统计显著的增益，验证器过滤持续训练进一步重复增益。Clifford有效性与状态等价之间的持续差距证明精确验证必要：电路可以语法和物理上有效，却制备错误的量子态。

title: TopoMamba: A Load-Support Relation-Guided Multi-Directional State-Space Model for Topology Optimization
summary: Deep learning has emerged as an efficient alternative for predicting high-performance material distributions in topology optimization. Existing methods struggle to accurately capture load-transfer information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization, while their model architectures often incur high computational costs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes TopoMamba, a topology prediction framework incorporating a load-support relation-guided multi-directional state-space model. Coupling physical fields with load-support relations enables more effective modeling of mechanical dependencies. A load-support relation-guided spatially adaptive fusion mechanism dynamically adjusts multi-directional scan features according to spatial conditions. Mamba is coupled with the solid isotropic material with penalty method to enhance structural mechanical performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Results on two-dimensional topology optimization benchmarks demonstrate that TopoMamba achieves superior topology prediction accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and computational efficiency over state-of-the-art models. The proposed load-support physics-guided framework enables efficient optimization of more complex structural systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TopoMamba，一个结合载荷-支撑关系引导的多方向状态空间模型的拓扑预测框架，用于高效预测高性能材料分布。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习拓扑优化方法难以准确捕捉载荷传递信息，导致分布外泛化能力不足，且模型架构计算成本高。
AI.method: 将物理场与载荷-支撑关系耦合以建模力学依赖；提出载荷-支撑关系引导的空间自适应融合机制，动态调整多方向扫描特征；将Mamba与SIMP方法耦合提升结构力学性能并保持计算效率。
AI.result: 在二维拓扑优化基准上，TopoMamba在拓扑预测精度、分布外泛化和计算效率上均优于当前最优模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出的载荷-支撑物理引导框架可实现更复杂结构系统的高效优化。

title: UnfoldCRF: Structured Mask Refinement with Image-Conditioned Latent Regions
summary: Learned mask refiners improve segmentation accuracy, but it is hard to tell how much of the improvement comes from explicit structure rather than from extra capacity, and whether it holds up when the mask generator or its error distribution changes. UnfoldCRF treats refinement as inference in a conditional random field over pixel labels and latent region variables. Its energy has a corrected unary term, learned local pairwise interactions, and image-conditioned latent-region consistency, with a null state that lets a region with weak label agreement withdraw from the consistency term; inference unrolls damped mean-field updates on this one energy. To isolate the effect of structure, we compare against recurrent black-box refiners that read the same inputs and receive the same parameter budget, stage count, and supervision. On COD10K, UnfoldCRF beats the strongest matched control by 1.0 $F^ω_β$ point, improves all four COD metrics, and lowers the fraction of images made worse from 11.7\% to 8.5\%. Under a train-once protocol over five datasets and several mask sources, the 2.6M-parameter variant gains 4.2 mean $Δ$IoU against 2.0 for its control, and a variant built on frozen DINOv2 features matches the strongest foundation-model refiner with about a seventh of its resident parameters while staying ahead of its own control. On mask generators never seen in training, the gain is 2.0 $F^ω_β$ points against 0.6 for the control. Zeroing individual messages shows where the corrections come from: the pairwise messages mostly fix boundaries, the region messages mostly fix non-boundary errors. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: UnfoldCRF将掩码精修建模为CRF推断，通过消融对比证明增益来自显式结构而非额外容量。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式掩码精修器提升分割精度，但难以区分提升来自显式结构还是额外容量，且不确定在掩码生成器或误差分布变化时是否稳健。
AI.method: 提出UnfoldCRF，将精修视为像素标签与潜在区域变量上的条件随机场推断；能量含修正一元项、学习的局部成对交互、图像条件潜在区域一致性（带可退出的null状态）；推断通过展开阻尼平均场更新实现。与读取相同输入、相同参数量/阶段数/监督的循环黑箱精修器对比以隔离结构效应。
AI.result: COD10K上比最强匹配基线高1.0 F^ω_β，四项COD指标均提升，变差图像比例从11.7%降至8.5%；五数据集train-once协议下2.6M参数变体平均ΔIoU提升4.2（对照2.0）；基于冻结DINOv2特征的变体以约1/7参数量匹敌最强基础模型精修器；未见掩码生成器上提升2.0 F^ω_β（对照0.6）。消融显示成对消息主要修正边界，区域消息主要修正非边界错误。
AI.conclusion: 显式CRF结构本身带来稳定增益，而非单纯容量扩张，且在不同掩码来源和未见生成器上更具泛化性。

title: Apparent Compression, Real Stability: The Intrinsic Dimension of Learning a Quantum Wavefunction
summary: How many directions in weight space does training need? The intrinsic dimension answers this with the smallest number of random directions in which training still reaches a target accuracy, and small values have motivated parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA. We measure it for variational Monte Carlo (VMC), which trains a neural network to represent the ground state of a quantum many-body system. VMC is a demanding test, because the network generates its own training samples and every gradient is noisy, and a revealing one, because the exact answer is known and every run can be scored. We train only a small latent vector that a frozen random map turns into the network's weights, with no change to the standard natural-gradient optimizer. We find that a small dimension can be misleading, while the stability it brings is real. On a magnet with a hard sign pattern, a network that cannot represent signs reaches its best energy in 8 of 28,642 directions, but only because no such network can go lower; once signs are learnable, neither the signs nor the magnitudes are cheap. The dimension rises across a quantum phase transition, so it tracks how difficult a state is at far less compute than fitting a scaling law, yet it never falls below a floor set by the random subspace itself, even where the ground state is nearly trivial. Training in the subspace, in contrast, never diverged in our experiments, whereas full-parameter training with the same settings did, and a control with matched solvers attributes the difference to the reduced dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文测量了变分蒙特卡洛(VMC)中神经网络的固有维度，发现小维度可能具有误导性，但降维训练带来的稳定性是真实的。
AI.motivation: 研究训练在权重空间中需要多少个方向，用小固有维度解释参数高效方法(如LoRA)，并检验VMC这一严苛任务的固有维度。
AI.method: 仅训练一个小潜向量，由冻结的随机映射生成网络权重，不改变标准自然梯度优化器；在硬符号模式磁体上测试，并跨量子相变观察维度变化，设置匹配求解器的对照组。
AI.result: 无法表示符号的网络在28642个方向中仅8个达到最佳能量，但这只是因为该网络无法更低；符号可学后，符号和幅度都不便宜。维度随量子相变升高，但永不低于随机子空间自身设定的下限。子空间训练从未发散，而全参数训练相同设置下发散，对照实验将差异归因于维度降低。
AI.conclusion: 固有维度可低成本追踪量子态难度，且降维训练能提升稳定性，但小维度可能掩盖真实难度，需谨慎解读。

title: One Latent, Many Tokens: Jointly Learning Compressed Embeddings for Efficient Language Diffusion
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, and 8 tables. Includes appendices
summary: Most continuous diffusion language models process one latent position per token at each sampling step, making generation expensive. Two-stage methods lower the cost by reducing the latent length, but they fix the compressed embedding space before training the diffusion model. Embeddings from the fixed space can be difficult to model with diffusion and decode reliably into tokens, which limits generation quality after compression. To address this problem, we introduce JPEG-DLM (Joint-embedding Prediction for Efficient Generation with Diffusion Language Model), which jointly trains a compressor, a flow matching model and a decoding module. With joint-embedding prediction, JPEG-DLM learns compressed embeddings that are more structured, easier to model with diffusion and reliably decodable into tokens. JPEG-DLM achieves the lowest mean Gen-PPL and highest throughput among recent diffusion and flow models on LM1B and OWT. At a compression rate of 0.5 on OWT, it reaches a Gen-PPL of 34.52 and approximately 2.3 times ELF's throughput. These results suggest that jointly learning compressed embeddings offers a promising path toward efficient diffusion language modeling. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: JPEG-DLM通过联合训练压缩器、流匹配模型和解码模块，学习更结构化、易建模且可靠可解码的压缩嵌入，在LM1B和OWT上实现最低Gen-PPL和最高吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型每步每token处理一个隐位置导致生成昂贵；两阶段方法虽降低隐长度，但在训练扩散模型前固定压缩嵌入空间，导致固定空间的嵌入难以用扩散建模并可靠解码，限制了压缩后的生成质量。
AI.method: 提出JPEG-DLM，联合训练压缩器、流匹配模型和解码模块，通过联合嵌入预测学习更适合扩散建模和可靠解码的压缩嵌入。
AI.result: 在LM1B和OWT上取得近期扩散与流模型最低的Gen-PPL和最高吞吐量；在OWT上压缩率0.5时Gen-PPL为34.52，吞吐量约为ELF的2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习压缩嵌入为高效扩散语言建模提供了有前景的路径，代码将发布。

title: MetaSampling: Making Frame Samplers Efficient for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Frame selection is an important component of long-video question answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing frame-selection methods improve over simple top-$k$ embedding retrieval and uniform sampling, but are typically applied under a fixed global selection budget. We introduce \textbf{MetaSampling}, a training-free, plug-and-play sampling strategy that can be applied on top of existing frame selectors. MetaSampling improves downstream VQA efficiency by dynamically reducing the number of frames passed to the MLLM while preserving, and in some cases improving, answer accuracy. We evaluate MetaSampling across 36 paired frame-selector--MLLM-backbone--VQA-benchmark configurations. MetaSampling reduces the number of selected frames in all 36 configurations and improves accuracy in 25 of them, yielding an average frame reduction of $8.9\%$ while slightly improving accuracy overall.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaSampling：一种免训练、即插即用的采样策略，可在现有帧选择器之上动态减少送入MLLM的帧数，在36种配置中全部减少帧数、25种提升准确率，平均减少8.9%帧且整体准确率略升。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答的帧选择方法虽优于简单top-k检索和均匀采样，但通常采用固定的全局选择预算，缺乏灵活性，导致效率与准确率难以兼得。
AI.method: MetaSampling为免训练、即插即用策略，可叠加于现有帧选择器之上，在保持（甚至提升）答案准确率的同时，动态减少传递给MLLM的帧数量。
AI.result: 在36种“帧选择器—MLLM骨干—VQA基准”组合配置上评估：全部36种配置减少所选帧数，25种配置准确率提升，平均帧数减少8.9%，整体准确率略有提升。
AI.conclusion: MetaSampling能有效提升下游VQA效率，在不损失甚至提升准确率的前提下显著减少帧数，具备良好的通用性与实用性。

title: Orthogonal Witness Control for Muon Optimization via Sigmoid Spectral Reshaping
summary: Matrix-valued optimizers such as Muon exploit the spectral structure of neural network updates through Newton--Schulz orthogonalization, but their near-flattening of the singular spectrum discards relative magnitude information across gradient modes. We introduce \emph{Soren} (\textbf{S}pectral \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{Re}shapi\textbf{n}g), a matrix-valued optimizer that preserves the singular subspaces of the gradient while applying a bounded, monotone sigmoid transformation to its singular values. This smoothly compresses dominant modes without fully flattening the spectrum. We interpret Soren as a positive-definite preconditioned gradient method and establish convergence guarantees under relative smoothness and metric Polyak--Łojasiewicz geometry. To avoid explicit singular value decomposition, we further develop a finite-depth Soft Newton--Schulz (SNS) polynomial realization of the sigmoid spectral map and characterize how its spectral approximation affects the induced convergence geometry. Experiments across LLM pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and direct preference optimization demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of Soren against established optimizers.

AI.tldr: Soren 是一种矩阵值优化器，通过有界单调 sigmoid 变换压缩梯度的奇异值而非完全展平谱，保留奇异子空间信息，并在理论和实验上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: Muon 等矩阵值优化器用 Newton-Schulz 正交化利用神经网络更新的谱结构，但近似完全展平奇异谱，丢失了不同梯度模态间的相对幅度信息。
AI.method: Soren 保留梯度的奇异子空间，对奇异值施加有界单调 sigmoid 变换，平滑压缩主导模态而不完全展平谱；将其解释为正定预条件梯度方法，并在相对光滑性与度量 Polyak-Łojasiewicz 几何下建立收敛保证；提出有限深度 Soft Newton-Schulz (SNS) 多项式实现以避免显式 SVD，并分析谱近似对收敛几何的影响。
AI.result: 在 LLM 预训练、监督微调与直接偏好优化实验中，Soren 相较已建立的优化器展现出有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Soren 通过保留谱相对幅度信息并提供理论收敛保证与高效多项式实现，成为优于现有矩阵值优化器的稳健选择。

title: Position Aware Layer Queries for Test Time Training in Vision Language Models
summary: Test-Time Training (TTT) adapts models to incoming test samples (e.g. out-of-distribution, (OOD)) when conventional fine-tuning is infeasible. Existing TTT methods for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) create supervision from several augmented views, each requiring forward (and often backward) passes through the entire VLM, incurring substantial computational cost. We observe that one forward pass with all the intermediate layer outputs already yields far more signal than the final embedding from all augmentations. We introduce Layer Query Network (LQN), a lightweight approach that can adapt a frozen VLM (teacher) in a single forward pass of the VLM via a small model (student). LQN uses Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) to mimic the teacher VLM's intermediate-layer spatial tokens by querying spatial coordinates of intermediate tokens. LQN additionally relies on Location Consistency Regularization (LCR), a self-supervision technique, replacing expensive O(H x W) image augmentation with O(1) coordinate sampling. Integrating these, LQN i) adapts and improves zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16 by 9.8% Top-1 on OOD ImageNet, ii) outperforms the previous best GS-Bias on fine-grained classification by 3.9% Top-1, iii) achieves faster convergence than TPS for CLIP ResNet-50 (47 mins vs 55 mins), iv) generalizes adaptation to VLMs like SigLIP, EVA-CLIP, and CoCa, and lightweight students like MLP, ResNet, VGG, and v) extends to panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出LQN，一种轻量级测试时训练方法，仅需一次VLM前向即可适配冻结的视觉-语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM测试时训练方法依赖多次增强视图的前向（及反向）传播，计算开销巨大；且观察到一次前向中所有中间层输出比多次增强的最终嵌入蕴含更多信号。
AI.method: LQN通过小模型（学生）在冻结VLM（教师）单次前向中适配，采用Position-Aware Distillation (PAD)按空间坐标查询并模仿教师中间层空间token，并用Location Consistency Regularization (LCR)以O(1)坐标采样替代O(H×W)图像增强。
AI.result: CLIP ViT-B/16在OOD ImageNet上零样本Top-1提升9.8%；细粒度分类Top-1超越GS-Bias 3.9%；CLIP ResNet-50收敛快于TPS（47 vs 55分钟）；可泛化至SigLIP、EVA-CLIP、CoCa及MLP、ResNet、VGG等轻量学生，并支持全景、实例、语义分割。
AI.conclusion: LQN以单次前向、轻量学生实现高效VLM测试时适配，效果、效率与通用性均优于现有方法。

title: Teach Yourself Where to Look: On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation for Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation trains reasoning models on their own trajectories using dense token distribution guidance from a privileged teacher with access to a verified solution. This supervision transfers what the teacher predicts without directly transferring where it attends within the preceding context. We introduce On-Policy Attention Self-Distillation (OPASD), which complements token-level supervision with solution-conditioned attention distillation. Because the privileged teacher can attend to verified solution tokens unavailable to the student, OPASD projects teacher attention onto student-visible positions and renormalizes the resulting distribution before alignment. Across three model sizes and four competition-level mathematics benchmarks, OPASD consistently outperforms token-only OPSD, improving average accuracy by 4.98 to 8.40 percentage points. OPASD also avoids the response-length inflation and performance degradation observed with token-only distillation, reducing generated rollout tokens by 73.9% and estimated model compute by 72.6% while training 1.53x faster. These results show that solution-conditioned attention provides a complementary supervision signal that makes on-policy self-distillation more accurate, stable, and compute-efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出OPASD，在on-policy自蒸馏中补充解条件注意力蒸馏，投影并重归一化教师注意力到学生可见位置，显著提升准确率并降低token与计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏(OPSD)仅传递教师的token分布，未传递其在前文上下文中的注意力位置信息，监督不完整。
AI.method: OPASD：在token级监督基础上加入解条件注意力蒸馏；因特权教师可关注学生不可见的验证解token，将教师注意力投影到学生可见位置并重归一化后再对齐。
AI.result: 在3种模型规模、4个竞赛级数学基准上，OPASD稳定优于纯token的OPSD，平均准确率提升4.98–8.40个百分点；生成rollout token减少73.9%，估计计算量减少72.6%，训练快1.53倍，并避免响应长度膨胀与性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 解条件注意力是互补的监督信号，使on-policy自蒸馏更准确、稳定且计算高效。

title: Does Adversarial Training Improve Generalization in Multi-View VLAs? Revealing and Mitigating View Collapse
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for closed-loop robot control, transferring their perceptual and semantic capabilities to action prediction. Despite strong in-distribution performance, however, VLAs often degrade under deployment shifts. Adversarial training (AT) offers a model-adaptive approach to robustness without explicitly anticipating individual shifts, but its effect on natural distribution-shift generalization in multi-view VLAs remains unclear. We study this question using a multi-view VLA directly adapted from a pretrained VLM and evaluate generalization across seven LIBERO-Plus shift axes. Direct AT substantially improves Camera Viewpoint and Sensor Noise, the two shifts affecting only the third-person view, yet produces mixed or negative effects on other shifts. Controlled view interventions reveal a surprising failure mode that we term view collapse: Direct AT can shift cross-view reliance so strongly that the policy becomes dominated by the wrist view. This exposes a \textit{robustness shortcut}: apparent robustness to a shifted view can arise from reduced use of that view rather than more robust perception of it. This motivates a distinction between robust perception, extracting reliable information under within-view shifts, and robust fusion, adapting reliance across views according to their reliability. To reduce fixed view reliance, we use a simple View Swap intervention and then re-evaluate AT. With View Swap, AT further improves Camera Viewpoint, Sensor Noise, and Robot Initial State, while its effects remain mixed on other shifts. Our results show that multi-view robustness requires separating improved perception from changes in cross-view reliance, and that AT provides selective rather than generic distribution-shift benefits.

AI.tldr: 研究对抗训练(AT)对多视角VLA分布偏移泛化的影响，发现其带来"视角崩溃"问题，提出鲁棒感知与鲁棒融合的区分，并用View Swap干预改善效果。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在分布内表现强，但部署时遇到分布偏移会退化。AT是一种无需预知具体偏移的模型自适应鲁棒性方法，但其对多视角VLA自然分布偏移泛化的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用直接从预训练VLM适配的多视角VLA，在LIBERO-Plus的七个偏移轴上评估泛化；进行直接AT实验、受控视角干预(揭示视角崩溃)、以及View Swap干预后重新评估AT。
AI.result: 直接AT显著改善Camera Viewpoint和Sensor Noise（仅影响第三人称视角的两个偏移），但对其他偏移效果混合或负面。视角干预揭示"视角崩溃"：AT使策略过度依赖腕部视角。加入View Swap后，AT进一步改善Camera Viewpoint、Sensor Noise和Robot Initial State，其他偏移仍效果混合。
AI.conclusion: 多视角鲁棒性需要区分感知改进与跨视角依赖变化；AT提供的是选择性而非通用的分布偏移收益，并暴露了"鲁棒性捷径"问题。

title: SMORE: Stability-Promoting Mesh-Agnostic Model Reduction for Time-Dependent PDEs
summary: High-fidelity simulations of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) are computationally expensive, motivating data-driven reduced-order surrogates for many-query tasks such as uncertainty quantification, design optimization, data assimilation, and optimal control. However, existing surrogate models often exhibit poor temporal stability, which can lead to unstable rollouts and exploding gradients during backpropagation, especially in multistep long-horizon forecasting. To address this, we propose SMORE, a mesh-agnostic framework for model order reduction of time-dependent PDEs. Its latent dynamics are trained with Lyapunov-guided stability regularization, which promotes stable long-horizon rollouts. We provide theoretical guarantees under the stated structural assumptions. Beyond forecasting PDE evolution, the learned latent dynamics, which are interpretable and linear or linear-quadratic, could bring benefits for downstream tasks such as data assimilation and optimal control. Moreover, our framework is capable of predicting continuous PDE solution fields from sparse measurements of the initial condition. We evaluate SMORE on a range of problems, including wave propagation, the Navier-Stokes equations, and the shallow water equations. Our results show that it improves long-horizon rollout generalization and empirical robustness, and achieves competitive accuracy at comparable parameter budgets relative to competitive baselines including DINo, FNO, CNO, and Transolver.

AI.tldr: 提出SMORE框架，用Lyapunov引导的稳定性正则化训练潜动力学，实现时间依赖PDE的稳定长时程滚动预测，并支持数据同化与最优控制等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 高保真时变PDE模拟计算昂贵，需要数据驱动的降阶代理模型；但现有代理模型时序稳定性差，多步长时程预测时易出现不稳定滚动与梯度爆炸。
AI.method: SMORE为网格无关的PDE模型降阶框架，潜动力学采用Lyapunov引导的稳定性正则化训练，以促进稳定长时程滚动，并在给定结构假设下提供理论保证；学到的潜动力学可解释且为线性或线性二次型，还能从稀疏初始条件测量预测连续解场。
AI.result: 在波传播、Navier-Stokes方程和浅水方程等任务上评估，SMORE改善了长时程滚动泛化与经验鲁棒性，在相当参数预算下相对DINo、FNO、CNO、Transolver等基线达到有竞争力的精度。
AI.conclusion: SMORE通过稳定性正则化有效缓解时序不稳定问题，兼具理论保证与下游任务潜力，是网格无关且具竞争力的PDE降阶代理方案。

title: BIRD: Distilling Decision Boundaries into Rationales for MLLM Adaptation
summary: Adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to specialized domains requires learning domain-specific decision criteria, which often hinge on subtle visual distinctions between otherwise plausible answers. Rationale augmentation aims to expose such evidence through additional observations or inter-sample comparisons, yet a visually valid cue is not necessarily decision-relevant: it may describe how samples differ without changing the model's relative preference between competing answers. We therefore introduce BIRD, a self-improving Boundary-Informed Rationale Distillation framework that uses model-specific confusions to locate unresolved local decision boundaries and distills the evidence that resolves these confusions into rationales. For each sample, BIRD retrieves candidate neighbors from the target MLLM's own representation space and selects the most confusable one according to its answer preferences. It then generates answer-blind candidate evidence from their visual differences and functionally verifies which evidence most effectively strengthens the model's preference for the correct answer while avoiding inappropriate transfer across the pair. The verified evidence is then distilled into a single-sample rationale for standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on medical and chart VQA show that BIRD outperforms competing rationale-augmentation methods across two target MLLMs, while further analyses demonstrate clearer separation of confusable answers and stronger gains from model-matched supervision.

AI.tldr: BIRD：一种利用模型自身混淆定位决策边界，并将可验证证据蒸馏为单样本理由的自提升框架，用于多模态大模型领域适配。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大模型适配专业领域需要学习领域决策准则，其常依赖细微视觉差异；现有理由增强方法产生的视觉有效线索未必与决策相关，可能只描述样本差异而不改变模型对答案的相对偏好。
AI.method: BIRD从目标MLLM自身表征空间检索候选邻居，按模型答案偏好选出最易混淆样本；基于视觉差异生成答案盲候选证据，并功能性验证哪些证据最能增强正确答案偏好且避免不当迁移；最终蒸馏为单样本理由用于标准监督微调。
AI.result: 在医学和图表VQA上，BIRD在两种目标MLLM上均优于竞争性理由增强方法；分析显示易混淆答案分离更清晰，且模型匹配监督带来更强增益。
AI.conclusion: 以模型特定混淆为核心的边界知情理由蒸馏，能有效提升专业领域多模态大模型适配效果。

title: 3D Point Tracking with State Space Models
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding
summary: Tracking any point of a dynamic scene in metric 3D - in absolute meters, not up to an unknown scale - underpins 3D and 4D reconstruction, robot navigation, and autonomous driving, where decisions are made in meters, not pixels. Our objective is a 3D point tracker accurate in those absolute terms and operating within a single commodity GPU, pose-free, monocular budget. Our method rests on one observation: once a point's 2D image trajectory is fixed, the quantity that governs its metric accuracy is the depth along its pixel ray. Rather than learning tracking end-to-end, we therefore compose two frozen front-ends - dense optical flow for 2D correspondence and a monocular metric-depth network for the third dimension - and learn only the residual they cannot supply: that depth, refined by a compact state space model (Mamba-3) conditioned on appearance features (DINOv3). A state space model rather than the transformers the strongest 3D trackers adopt is what makes a single-GPU budget attainable: it summarises a track in a fixed-size recurrent state whose memory cost is constant in the number of frames, whereas attention requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with them. On the TAPVid-3D minival benchmark our best configuration attains the highest absolute metric accuracy among methods evaluated under identical conditions (mean metric Average Jaccard, 0.256), exceeding strong feed-forward trackers, while a companion analysis, reproduced with each competitor's own evaluator, explains why several published trackers lose most of their accuracy under this budget.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在单张消费级GPU、无需位姿的单目条件下进行绝对公制3D点追踪的方法，通过在冻结的光流与公制深度前端之上，用Mamba-3状态空间模型学习深度残差，在TAPVid-3D上取得最高绝对公制精度(平均AJ 0.256)。
AI.motivation: 动态场景的3D点追踪需要以绝对米为单位的精度，支撑3D/4D重建、机器人导航和自动驾驶，因为这些任务以米而非像素做决策。但现有最强3D追踪器多依赖Transformer，其KV缓存随帧数线性增长，难以在单张消费级GPU的受限预算下运行。
AI.method: 方法基于一个观察：一旦点的2D图像轨迹确定，决定其公制精度的量就是沿像素射线的深度。因此不端到端学习追踪，而是组合两个冻结前端——密集光流做2D对应、单目公制深度网络提供第三维——只学习它们无法提供的残差：由紧凑状态空间模型Mamba-3、以DINOv3外观特征为条件精化的深度。用SSM而非Transformer，使追踪汇总为固定大小的递归状态，内存开销与帧数无关。
AI.result: 在TAPVid-3D minival基准上，最佳配置在相同条件下评估的方法中获得最高绝对公制精度，平均公制Average Jaccard为0.256，超过强前馈追踪器；配套分析用各竞品自带评估器复现，解释了为何若干已发表追踪器在此预算下损失大部分精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过组合冻结的2D光流与公制深度前端并仅用Mamba-3学习深度残差，可在单GPU、无位姿单目预算下实现高公制精度的3D点追踪，验证了状态空间模型在内存效率上的优势。

title: When Do Models Admit They Are Wrong? Failure Disclosure Is Unstable Under Reinforcement Learning
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can produce models with similar task performance but very different ways of communicating about their mistakes. We study failure disclosure: whether a model admits that an attempted solution failed rather than staying silent or presenting it as successful. Across repeated outcome-only GRPO training runs, failure disclosure varies far more than task accuracy. The pattern extends to a second reasoning task and stabilized PPO, persists at 7B, and also appears in an instruction-conditioned 32B setting. We also find that small floating-point and sampling differences during training can redirect reporting behavior even when the task objective and earlier training history are held fixed. Additional tests show that failure disclosure is not a single decision: Checking the answer, entering a report, and completing the admission can separate, and the weak point depends on the task and response format. Further, experiments with neutral controls show more broadly that behaviors left weakly constrained by training are especially likely to vary across runs, of which failure disclosure is an example. We can reduce variability in failure disclosure by discouraging the model from drifting from its starting policy on failed, well-formed responses. This makes reporting substantially more consistent, though its effect on task performance depends on the setting. Stable task accuracy therefore does not guarantee stable safety-relevant behavior: Researchers should measure these behaviors directly across runs and design training methods that keep them reliable.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于结果奖励的强化学习（GRPO/PPO）中“失败披露”行为的跨运行不稳定性：任务准确率稳定但模型是否承认失败差异很大，并提出降低该变异的训练方法。
AI.motivation: 结果导向的RL能让模型在任务表现上相似，但在如何沟通错误方面差异巨大。作者关注“失败披露”（承认尝试失败、而非沉默或谎报成功），担心稳定的任务准确率掩盖了安全相关行为的不稳定。
AI.method: 在多次仅用结果奖励的GRPO训练运行中测量失败披露的变异，并扩展到第二个推理任务、PPO、7B模型以及指令条件下的32B设置；进一步通过改变浮点/采样差异、将失败披露拆解为检查答案、进入报告、完成承认等子步骤进行测试，并用中性对照实验验证弱约束行为更易变异；最后尝试抑制模型在失败且格式良好的响应上偏离初始策略来降低变异。
AI.result: 失败披露的跨运行变异远大于任务准确率变异；该现象在不同任务、算法、模型规模和指令设置中重复出现；微小数值/采样差异即可改变报告行为；失败披露非单一决策，其薄弱环节依赖任务和响应格式；所提方法能显著提高报告一致性，但对任务性能的影响依设置而定。
AI.conclusion: 稳定的任务准确率不能保证安全相关行为的稳定。研究者应跨运行直接测量此类行为，并设计能保持其可靠性的训练方法。

title: Self-Designed Evaluators and Warm Memory for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: A tool-using language-model agent deployed over a long stream of tasks receives no reward, so it cannot tell whether it succeeded, cannot safely retry, and cannot label the experience it needs to improve. We present SelfSuite, in which the agent's own base model, given only the world's public materials, designs a small evaluation suite of weighted judges and grounded per-task briefs, freezes it, and uses it to gate a keep-best retry and to label a typed, outcome-tracked memory. On matched five-repeat benchmarks over tau2-bench and AppWorld, SelfSuite scores above the plain agent without any labels, matches methods given ten expert labels on tau2-bench, and trails Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) on AppWorld, where code execution gives a direct success signal. In an ablation campaign run on the same tasks, it is above label-free ACE in every repeat, and the gated second attempt is the only component whose removal hurts in every repeat. We also simulate a subject-matter expert who grades ten onboarding tasks per world. Using those labels to calibrate SelfSuite's evaluator gives a small, consistent gain, and using them to warm up ACE's memory lifts ACE to tie calibrated SelfSuite. A single-run study on a second model family shows the same ordering.

AI.tldr: 提出 SelfSuite：让智能体用自身基础模型设计并冻结一个加权评委评测套件，用于门控重试与标注结果记忆，在无奖励长任务流中实现无标签的自我改进。
AI.motivation: 长任务流中工具型语言模型智能体无奖励信号，无法判断成败、无法安全重试、无法标注经验，因而难以自我改进。
AI.method: 智能体仅用公开材料，由自身基础模型设计小型加权评委+接地任务简报的评测套件，冻结后用于：(1)门控 keep-best 重试；(2)标注带类型、追踪结果的内存。并做消融实验与专家标注校准实验。
AI.result: 在 tau2-bench 与 AppWorld 五次重复基准上超过无标签基线，tau2-bench 上追平用十个专家标签的方法，AppWorld 上落后于 ACE（因代码执行提供直接成功信号）；消融中始终优于无标签 ACE，门控第二次尝试是唯一不可缺失组件；专家标签校准带来小幅稳定提升，用于预热 ACE 则可追平校准后的 SelfSuite；第二个模型家族单次实验呈同样排序。
AI.conclusion: 无标签条件下，智能体可自建冻结评测套件实现可靠自我评估、重试与记忆标注，达到或接近有标签方法的效果，且门控重试最为关键。

title: SCOPD: Sparse-Context On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) process images and videos as long sequences of visual tokens, making inference expensive. Training-free token pruning reduces this cost, but aggressive compression can sharply degrade performance, often attributed to irreversible loss of task-relevant visual information. We show that this explanation is incomplete. In a fixed-context Pass@K analysis, repeated sampling from the same pruned visual representation recovers many examples missed by greedy decoding, indicating that useful visual evidence can remain accessible but be used unreliably. We call this the representation-utilization gap. Motivated by this observation, we introduce SCOPD, a sparse-context on-policy self-distillation framework in which a student generates reasoning trajectories from pruned visual tokens while a privileged full-context teacher supervises the same on-policy prefixes. SCOPD requires no ground-truth responses, architectural changes, or additional inference-time computation. We further introduce SCOPD+, which uses a small visual-budget intervention to identify visually sensitive response positions and selectively distill them. At 10% visual-token retention, the Vanilla model retains 86.37% of its unpruned performance across 13 benchmarks. SCOPD raises this to 90.49%, while SCOPD+ further improves it to 92.43%. Across token budgets, benchmarks, and pruning operators, our results show that efficient reasoning depends not only on which visual information survives pruning, but also on how reliably the model learns to use it.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出token剪枝导致性能下降并非仅因视觉信息丢失，而是模型利用剪枝后表征不可靠（representation-utilization gap）；提出免训练、无GT的稀疏上下文on-policy自蒸馏框架SCOPD及SCOPD+，在10%视觉token保留率下将性能从86.37%提升至92.43%。
AI.motivation: 推理型VLM将图像/视频作为长视觉token序列，推理成本高。免训练token剪枝可降成本，但激进压缩会大幅降低性能，通常被归因于任务相关视觉信息的不可逆丢失。作者通过固定上下文Pass@K分析发现，同一剪枝表征重复采样可恢复贪心解码漏掉的样本，说明有用视觉证据仍可获取但使用不可靠，即representation-utilization gap，因此问题不只在"保留什么"，也在"能否可靠利用"。
AI.method: 提出SCOPD：稀疏上下文on-policy自蒸馏框架。学生模型基于剪枝视觉token生成推理轨迹，特权全上下文教师在相同on-policy前缀上监督；无需GT回答、无需架构改动或额外推理开销。进一步提出SCOPD+：用小幅视觉预算干预定位视觉敏感响应位置，仅对这些位置选择性蒸馏。
AI.result: 在10%视觉token保留率下，13个基准上Vanilla保留未剪枝性能的86.37%；SCOPD提升至90.49%；SCOPD+进一步提升至92.43%。结果跨token预算、基准与剪枝算子一致。
AI.conclusion: 高效推理不仅取决于剪枝后哪些视觉信息存活，还取决于模型能否可靠地学会利用这些信息。SCOPD通过on-policy自蒸馏弥合representation-utilization gap，在无额外推理成本下显著提升剪枝VLM性能。

title: RMB: Reward Model Boosting Mitigates Reward Hacking
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), September 2026
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is a powerful technique for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preference. However, it often suffers from the reward hacking issue, where policy optimization improves the proxy reward model while actually degrading performance with respect to the true human preference, due to the imperfection of the proxy. To address this, we propose Reward Model Boosting (RMB), a novel approach that enhances the robustness and reliability of the reward signal for RLHF. RMB first trains a set of reward models with a diversity-promoting regularizer. This encourages each model to learn complementary aspects of the reward landscape. Then, RMB learns a lightweight aggregator in the principle of boosting to aggregate the outputs of the diverse reward models into a more accurate and robust reward signal. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that RMB significantly improves reward accuracy on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets, substantially mitigating the reward hacking issue and ultimately improving RLHF performance.

AI.tldr: 提出RMB方法：训练多样化奖励模型并用boosting聚合，缓解RLHF中的reward hacking问题。
AI.motivation: RLHF中代理奖励模型不完美，策略优化会提升代理奖励却降低真实人类偏好表现（reward hacking）。
AI.method: 先用多样性正则项训练一组奖励模型以学习互补的奖励结构，再基于boosting思想学习一个轻量级聚合器，将多个模型输出融合为更准确稳健的奖励信号。
AI.result: 在分布内和分布外数据集上显著提升奖励准确率，大幅缓解reward hacking，最终提升RLHF性能。
AI.conclusion: RMB通过多样化建模与boosting聚合，增强奖励信号鲁棒性与可靠性，是一种有效缓解reward hacking的方案。

title: Robust Biomolecular Complex Design Across Protein Conformational Landscapes
summary: Proteins populate conformational ensembles, yet structure-based biomolecular design typically optimizes candidates against a single target conformation. Consequently, a candidate that fits one state can lose favorable interactions or develop steric clashes when the target adopts another. We introduce FlexEvo, a model-agnostic evolutionary framework that adapts candidates once at inference time from a single target conformation to improve compatibility with alternative natural conformations unseen during adaptation, without retraining the source model or requiring a conformational ensemble. FlexEvo casts cross-state adaptation as geometry-constrained bi-objective optimization, balancing preservation of input-state interactions against robustness to plausible conformational perturbations. To limit the search space and reduce invalid structural edits, geometry-derived FlexBoxes define protected anchor regions, adaptable regions for local exploration, and forbidden regions for clash avoidance. A unified all-atom representation supports topology-preserving adaptation across diverse binder categories, while Pareto selection preserves nondominated candidates across the two objectives. We evaluate FlexEvo across multiple generation baselines and nine representative binder categories spanning diverse molecular sizes and structural topologies. FlexEvo reduces the category-balanced mean relative performance degradation from 47.8% to 4.4%, while adding only 1.4--3.1 minutes of adaptation per sample. These results establish single-state inference-time adaptation as a practical route toward robust biomolecular complex design across protein conformational landscapes.

AI.tldr: FlexEvo：面向单状态蛋白候选的模型无关进化式推理时适配框架，跨构象状态提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质以构象系综形式存在，但结构设计通常只针对单一目标构象优化，导致候选在目标换构象时丢失有利相互作用或产生空间冲突。
AI.method: 将跨状态适配建模为几何约束的双目标优化，平衡输入状态相互作用保持与对合理构象扰动的鲁棒性；用几何导出的FlexBox定义保护锚区、可适配局部探索区和禁飞区；统一全原子表示支撑拓扑保持适配；Pareto选择保留非支配候选。仅推理时适配一次，无需重训练或构象系综。
AI.result: 在多个生成基线和九类代表性结合物（跨分子尺寸与拓扑）上，类别均衡平均相对性能退化从47.8%降至4.4%，每样本仅增加1.4–3.1分钟适配时间。
AI.conclusion: 单状态推理时适配是跨蛋白构象景观实现稳健生物分子复合物设计的实用路径。

authors: Jose Luis Garcia del Castillo y Lopez
title: ARCH-B: Architectural Representation, Comprehension and Hierarchy Benchmark
summary: Multimodal models increasingly interpret visual environments, but their ability to recognize the same building across photographs, floor plans, elevations, sections, and renderings remains poorly characterized. We introduce ARCH-B, a benchmark of 354 four-choice questions across 11 cross-representational archetypes, constructed from a building-linked corpus of 3.9 million architectural images using visually similar distractors, model-guided difficulty screening, and manual validation. We evaluate 25 multimodal models and collect 5,830 responses from non-expert human participants. Model accuracy ranges from 10.45% to 83.90%, compared with a human baseline of 35.35%. Models perform comparatively well on mixed-representation outlier detection and photograph matching, but remain weaker on floorplan-to-photograph correspondence. Human and model difficulty across archetypes is only weakly correlated (Spearman's (ρ=0.33)). Held-out evaluation confirms that the difficulty identified during screening generalizes beyond the curation models. ARCH-B provides a diagnostic evaluation of visual correspondence and representation transfer across architectural media.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ARCH-B基准，用于评估多模态模型跨建筑表现媒介（照片、平面图、立面图、剖面图、渲染图）识别同一建筑的能力，包含354道四选一题，覆盖11种跨表现类型。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型虽日益能理解视觉环境，但其在多种建筑表现媒介间识别同一建筑的能力尚缺乏系统刻画，需要专门的诊断性基准来评估视觉对应与表现迁移能力。
AI.method: 基于390万张建筑图像构建建筑关联语料库，采用视觉相似干扰项、模型引导的难度筛选与人工验证，构建354道四选一题、11种跨表现类型；评估25个多模态模型并收集5,830份非专家人类回答。
AI.result: 模型准确率介于10.45%至83.90%，人类基线为35.35%；模型在混合表现的异常检测和照片匹配上较好，但在平面图到照片对应上较弱；人类与模型的难度相关性弱（Spearman ρ=0.33）；留出评估证实筛选难度可推广至筛选模型之外。
AI.conclusion: ARCH-B为跨建筑媒介的视觉对应与表现迁移提供了诊断性评估工具，揭示模型与人类难度分布不一致及平面图-照片对应的薄弱环节。

title: HTN Planning as a Coordination Layer for Multi-Server MCP Tool Orchestration
comment: 5 pages. Camera-ready version of a paper accepted at the ICAPS 2026 Workshop on Hierarchical Planning (HPlan 2026), Dublin. Non-archival. Code: https://github.com/PCfVW/hplan26-artifact
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) isolates servers by design: only the host can orchestrate cross-server workflows. When the host is a large language model, the resulting orchestrations are non-deterministic, non-reproducible, and pay one inference round-trip per tool call. We present a coordination architecture in which a Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planner generates a verifiable cross-server plan once, and a runtime middleware executes it deterministically across multiple MCP servers, binding cross-action data dependencies via a template mechanism (\verb|${context.X}|) substituted at execution time. The architecture mirrors MCP's isolation constraint: each compound task decomposes into server-local primitive actions, and inter-server data flow is bound at execution time via JSON-path output extractors. We instantiate the architecture on five HTN domains spanning laboratory robotics, bioinformatics and multiscale modelling, and demonstrate end-to-end execution from a browser-based plan controller against eight live third-party MCP servers querying real biological databases.

AI.tldr: 提出一种协调架构，用HTN规划器一次性生成可验证的跨服务器计划，由运行时中间件在多个MCP服务器上确定性执行，实现跨服务器数据依赖绑定。
AI.motivation: MCP设计上隔离服务器，仅主机能编排跨服务器工作流；当主机是大语言模型时，编排非确定性、不可复现，且每次工具调用消耗一次推理往返。
AI.method: HTN规划器生成可验证的跨服务器计划，运行时中间件确定性执行；采用模板机制${context.X}在运行时替换，绑定跨动作数据依赖；每个复合任务分解为服务器本地原语动作，服务器间数据流通过JSON-path输出提取器在运行时绑定。
AI.result: 在涵盖实验室机器人、生物信息学和多尺度建模的五个HTN域上实例化该架构，并演示从浏览器端计划控制器对八个实时第三方MCP服务器进行端到端执行，查询真实生物数据库。
AI.conclusion: 该架构在保持MCP隔离约束的同时，实现跨服务器工作流的确定性、可复现执行，并在真实MCP服务器上验证了可行性。

title: SNaP: One-Step Posterior Sampling for Noisy Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching models can produce high-quality posterior samples for inverse problems, but typically require tens to thousands of network evaluations per draw. MeanFlow enables one-step generation, yet applying it to inverse problems leaves no intermediate steps at which to enforce measurement consistency. We introduce SNaP, a one-step MeanFlow posterior sampler for linear inverse problems with Gaussian noise. Its central innovation is a measurement-adapted source: a Gaussian distribution whose mean and anisotropic covariance are determined by the measurement operator, observation, and noise level. The source anchors well-measured directions while preserving variation where the measurements are weak or uninformative. We show that the exact conditional flow transports this source to the true posterior. Across natural-image restoration and multi-coil MRI, SNaP produces diverse, high-quality samples with one network evaluation per draw, 30 to 2250 $\times$ faster than iterative samplers.

AI.tldr: SNaP提出一种一步式MeanFlow后验采样器，通过测量自适应源分布解决反问题，速度比迭代采样器快30-2250倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流匹配模型虽能生成高质量反问题后验样本，但每次采样需数十到上千次网络评估。MeanFlow支持一步生成，但应用于反问题时缺乏中间步骤来强制测量一致性。
AI.method: 核心创新是"测量自适应源"：一个高斯分布，其均值与各向异性协方差由测量算子、观测值和噪声水平共同决定。该源在测量充分的方保持锚定，在测量弱或无信息的方保留变化。作者证明精确条件流可将此源传输到真实后验。
AI.result: 在自然图像修复和多线圈MRI任务上，SNaP每次采样仅需一次网络评估，即可生成多样且高质量的样本，速度比迭代采样器快30-2250倍。
AI.conclusion: SNaP实现了反问题的高效一步后验采样，兼顾速度与样本质量及多样性，为快速反问题求解提供了新思路。

title: The Price of Locality: Why Forward-Forward Underperforms Backpropagation?
comment: This paper is accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: The Forward-Forward Algorithm (FFA) replaces backpropagation (BP) with layer-wise local contrastive objectives, eliminating the backward pass and the need to retain intermediate activations, yet suffers a persistent performance gap with BP that worsens with depth. This paper diagnoses two structural failure modes: an optimization floor arising from concurrent local updates; and a geometric collapse of layer representations driven by the local update mechanism. On the optimization side, we prove that the FFA loss satisfies the Polyak--Lojasiewicz inequality at each layer; however, simultaneous layer updates induce inter-layer representation-distribution drift, so each layer optimizes against a moving input distribution and incurs an error floor. On the representational side, the pairwise similarity kernel of layer representations contracts exponentially toward rank one as depth increases, collapsing the diversity of per-layer error signals. This collapse bounds FFA's effective learning capacity, which measures the diversity of gradient information across layers, independently of depth, whereas BP's chain-rule signal preserves per-layer diversity, yielding a capacity that scales with depth.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了前向-前向算法(FFA)相比反向传播(BP)的性能差距，揭示其两大结构性失效模式：并发局部更新导致的优化误差下限，以及表示几何坍缩导致的学习容量受限。
AI.motivation: FFA用逐层局部对比目标替代BP，省去反向传播和中间激活存储，但性能始终落后于BP，且随深度增加差距扩大。作者希望从理论与实践上诊断这一差距的根源。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明FFA损失在每层满足Polyak-Lojasiewicz不等式；分析同步层更新引起的层间表示分布漂移；研究层表示的成对相似核随深度的变化。
AI.result: 证明并发更新使每层面对移动的输入分布，产生误差下限；成对相似核随深度增加指数收缩趋近秩一，导致逐层误差信号多样性坍缩。FFA的有效学习容量被限制且与深度无关，而BP的链式信号保持逐层多样性，容量随深度增长。
AI.conclusion: FFA的性能瓶颈源于优化误差下限与表示几何坍缩两个结构性因素，其有效学习容量无法随深度扩展，这从根本上解释了FFA与BP的差距。

title: Skill2Env: Capability-Oriented Environment Synthesis from Skills for General Agents
summary: Executable environments are critical for post-training agents on tasks that require tool use and multi-step interaction, but constructing executable tasks together with their environments remains difficult to scale. Skills provide reusable domain knowledge, operational procedures, and tool-use instructions, but a substantial gap remains between the information contained in a skill and a concrete, challenging task with a complete executable environment. To address this gap, we introduce Skill2Env, a capability-oriented framework that starts from a skill and uses agent capability demands to guide task and environment synthesis. Skill2Env represents these demands through reusable difficulty patterns and instantiates them into task blueprints that specify objectives, challenges, environment facts, information boundaries, and acceptance criteria. These blueprints guide the joint construction of task instructions, execution substrates, workspaces, and rubric-based evaluators around source skills. We further propose Iterative Task Hardening, which uses solver execution evidence to identify insufficiently challenging task designs, strengthen or extend their difficulty-pattern instantiations, and revise the corresponding blueprints and environments. Using 1.5K high-scoring trajectories generated from Skill2Env environments for supervised fine-tuning, we observe consistent improvements across a broad range of agent benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of capability-oriented environment synthesis for agent post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出Skill2Env框架，从技能出发，以能力需求驱动可执行任务与环境合成，结合迭代任务加固，生成高质量轨迹用于智能体后训练。
AI.motivation: 可执行环境对需工具使用和多步交互的智能体后训练至关重要，但规模化构建可执行任务及其环境仍很困难。技能虽提供可复用的领域知识、操作流程与工具使用说明，但从技能到具体、有挑战性且环境完整可执行的任务之间存在显著鸿沟。
AI.method: Skill2Env以技能为起点，用智能体能力需求引导任务与环境合成：将需求表示为可复用的难度模式，实例化为任务蓝图（含目标、挑战、环境事实、信息边界、验收标准），据此联合构建任务指令、执行底座、工作区和基于评分标准的评估器。并提出迭代任务加固，利用求解器执行证据识别难度不足的设计，强化或扩展难度模式实例，并修订蓝图与环境。
AI.result: 使用从Skill2Env环境生成的1.5K条高分轨迹进行监督微调，在广泛的智能体基准上取得一致的性能提升，验证了能力导向环境合成对智能体后训练的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 能力导向的环境合成（Skill2Env+迭代任务加固）能有效弥合技能与可执行任务之间的鸿沟，为智能体后训练提供可扩展的高质量数据来源。

title: WhiteCon: Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation Regression Through Whitening Transform and Dual Consistency
summary: Domain adaptation is crucial for addressing distributional shifts that degrade model performance across domains. While most existing research has centered on classification, semi-supervised domain adaptation regression (SSDAR) for continuous-output tasks remains largely unexplored, particularly in practical scenarios with limited labeled target data. To address this gap, we propose semi-supervised domain adaptation regression through whitening transform and dual consistency (WhiteCon), which combines domain-specific whitening transform (DWT) and dual consistency regularization to enhance training stability and domain adaptation. DWT reduces the variance of the model parameters by transforming the feature covariance matrix into an identity matrix, thus stabilizing training under ordinary least squares assumptions. In addition, variance consistency regularization, as part of dual consistency regularization, aligns the variances of weak, strong, and mixup-augmented features to improve resilience against augmentation-induced perturbations. Empirical evaluations on various benchmark datasets under SSDAR settings demonstrate that the proposed WhiteCon achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods, effectively addressing domain shifts in regression tasks. The code for WhiteCon is available at https://github.com/sejin-sim/WhiteCon.

AI.tldr: 提出WhiteCon方法解决半监督域适应回归(SSDAR)问题，结合域特定白化变换与双重一致性正则化提升训练稳定性与域适应性能。
AI.motivation: 现有域适应研究多集中于分类任务，半监督域适应回归(SSDAR)在连续输出任务中尤其是标签目标数据有限的实际场景下仍鲜有探索，存在研究空白。
AI.method: WhiteCon融合两项技术：(1)域特定白化变换(DWT)，将特征协方差矩阵变换为单位矩阵以降低模型参数方差，在普通最小二乘假设下稳定训练；(2)双重一致性正则化，其中方差一致性正则化对齐弱增强、强增强及mixup增强特征的方差，提升对增强扰动鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多种基准数据集的SSDAR设置下进行实证评估，WhiteCon相比现有方法达到最优性能，有效应对回归任务中的域偏移。
AI.conclusion: WhiteCon有效填补SSDAR研究空白，通过白化变换与双重一致性正则化显著提升域适应回归性能，代码已开源。

title: Minimax-Optimality of Posterior Sampling for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Posterior sampling for reinforcement learning (PSRL) is one of the simplest and most effective exploration methods, but a basic question has remained open: does unmodified PSRL achieve minimax regret without structural assumptions on the prior? We answer yes. Exact vanilla PSRL is minimax optimal in leading-order Bayesian regret under arbitrary correlated priors. The difficulty is that a posterior-sampled transition model is coupled with its own continuation value. We overcome this with a common empirical transition reference that isolates the resulting value mismatch and a Bellman-based variance argument that controls it without an extra leading-order state-space factor. For finite-horizon, time-inhomogeneous tabular MDPs with unknown stochastic rewards, this yields the minimax $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAH^3K})$ regret rate under arbitrary joint priors over rewards and transitions. The same proof principle gives the minimax $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{H^3K})$ rate for linear-mixture MDPs under arbitrary joint parameter priors.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了未修改的vanilla PSRL在任意相关先验下即可达到minimax贝叶斯遗憾，无需结构性假设。
AI.motivation: PSRL是最简单有效的探索方法之一，但一个基本问题悬而未决：未修改的PSRL是否能在无先验结构假设下达到minimax遗憾？本文回答"是"。
AI.method: 核心难点是后验采样的转移模型与其自身continuation value耦合。作者引入一个共同的empirical transition reference来隔离产生的value mismatch，并用基于Bellman的方差论证控制它，避免额外的一阶状态空间因子。
AI.result: 对有限时域、时非齐次表格MDP（未知随机奖励），在奖励与转移的任意联合先验下达到minimax $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAH^3K})$ 遗憾率；同一证明原理对线性混合MDP在任意联合参数先验下给出minimax $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{H^3K})$ 率。
AI.conclusion: Exact vanilla PSRL在任意相关先验下是leading-order贝叶斯遗憾的minimax最优方法，且该证明框架可推广到线性混合MDP。

title: Learning Strategies to Break Judges
summary: As AI agents surpass human performance, it becomes exceedingly hard for system designers to evaluate them directly and understand their failure modes. Consequently, agents themselves are being deployed extensively to evaluate, judge, and provide feedback on model traces. But this raises an important question: how can we trust the judge? In this work, we propose an agent-guided method to find weaknesses of agentic judges that expose interpretable failure mechanisms. Our method focuses on mathematical reasoning and proceeds in two stages: first, we deploy adversarial agents to mutate a set of sound proofs by introducing errors, attempting to misguide judges---in other words, injecting errors that judges are unable to catch. Then, we distill these attempts into a small set of mutation strategies which allow us to analyze the failure modes of the judges. To ensure that these strategies are not overfit to the initial set of proofs, we evaluate them by applying the mutation strategies to a held-out set of proofs and querying the same judge. We deploy our method on GPT-5.6-sol and Claude Opus 5, paired with their agent orchestrators, Codex and Claude Code, respectively. These are used both as mutators to introduce errors and as judges to evaluate correctness of mathematical reasoning. We find that across all the agentic judges, we are able to distill mutation strategies that consistently bypass their evaluations, thereby enabling us to ascertain actionable failure modes. Our analysis also reveals that judge reliability degrades at the frontier: errors in Olympiad-level proofs or graduate-level mathematical texts are detected more consistently, whereas flaws in research-level manuscripts are more likely to escape detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种agent引导的方法,通过对抗性变异策略发现agentic judge(如GPT-5.6-sol/Codex、Claude Opus 5/Claude Code)在数学推理评判中的可解释失败机制。
AI.motivation: 随着AI性能超越人类,系统设计者难以直接评估agent,于是广泛用agent作为judge。但这带来"如何信任judge"的问题,需要找到judge的弱点并理解其失败模式。
AI.method: 两阶段方法,聚焦数学推理:1)部署对抗agent对可靠证明进行变异引入错误,试图误导judge(注入judge无法察觉的错误);2)将这些尝试蒸馏为少量变异策略以分析judge失败模式。为防过拟合,在留出证明集上应用策略并再次查询同一judge。在GPT-5.6-sol+Codex、Claude Opus 5+Claude Code上实验,这些系统既作变异者又作评判者。
AI.result: 在所有agentic judge上均能蒸馏出持续绕过其评估的变异策略,从而确定可操作的失败模式。分析还发现judge可靠性在"前沿"下降:奥林匹克级证明或研究生级数学文本中的错误被更一致地检测,而研究级手稿中的缺陷更易逃过检测。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效暴露agentic judge的可解释失败机制,并揭示judge可靠性随问题前沿程度而下降的现象,为可信的agent评估提供思路。

title: Advancing Wildlife Conservation through Multimodal Animal Re-Identification with Environmental Metadata
summary: Identifying individual animals is crucial for effective wildlife monitoring and conservation efforts. Recent advancements in computer vision have shown promise in animal re-identification (Animal ReID) by leveraging data from camera traps. However, existing Animal ReID datasets rely exclusively on visual data, overlooking environmental metadata that ecologists have identified as highly correlated with animal behavior and identity, such as temperature and circadian rhythms. Meanwhile, modern vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich multimodal reasoning capabilities, but existing resources underutilize their text-processing potential. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWild, a multimodal Animal ReID dataset comprising 20,890 images across six species, paired with environmental metadata extracted from embedded camera trap overlays and scene contexts. Additionally, to facilitate the use of metadata in existing ReID methods, we propose the Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA), a lightweight module that can be incorporated into existing VLM-based ReID methods, allowing ReID models to leverage both environmental metadata and visual information to improve ReID performance. Experiments on MetaWild show that combining baseline ReID models with MFA to incorporate metadata consistently improves performance compared to using visual information alone, validating the effectiveness of incorporating metadata in re-identification.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaWild多模态动物重识别数据集，包含20890张图像和六物种的环境元数据，并提出Meta-Feature Adapter模块，让现有ReID模型能融合元数据提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动物重识别数据集仅依赖视觉数据，忽略了生态学家认为与动物行为和身份高度相关的环境元数据（如温度、昼夜节律）。同时现有视觉语言模型资源未能充分利用文本处理能力。
AI.method: 构建MetaWild数据集，涵盖六物种20890张图像，元数据从相机陷阱叠加层和场景上下文中提取；提出Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA）轻量模块，可嵌入现有基于VLM的ReID方法，融合环境元数据与视觉信息。
AI.result: 在MetaWild上的实验表明，将基线ReID模型与MFA结合引入元数据后，性能相比仅用视觉信息持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 验证了在动物重识别中融合环境元数据的有效性。

title: Feedback-Robust AI for Patient Knowledge Graphs
summary: Patient knowledge graphs from bedside monitoring should type their relations and state whether the data support their signs. In anesthesia and intensive care, clinicians titrate drugs and ventilation in response to the physiology, so temporal relations mix the patient's response with the clinician's policy. We introduce ClosedLoopBench: 29 relations with signs fixed by physics, pharmacology or clinical practice, on 3,442 VitalDB surgical cases (12,653 h) with negative-control action streams. When each patient's actions are replaced by another patient's, six of 12 estimators declare on average 11-18 of their 19-29 distinct relation estimates significant without calibration, and after calibration cross-correlation and Granger tests still assign ventilator rate -> end-tidal CO2 the sign of the clinician's policy. We propose feedback-robust patient graphs that combine concept nodes with evidence pointers, typed relations admitted against negative controls, and beat-level couplings. On VitalDB under null streams, our graphs contain 0.06-0.10 false concept-level relation instances per graph, versus 10-12 for correlational construction. Patient-specific estimates of 11 slow drug and ventilator responses predict later data no better than population estimates, whereas the pulse-arrival-time-systolic-pressure slope is negative in 94.3% of 2,884 cases and patient-specific (early-late correlation 0.67 [0.63, 0.70]).

AI.tldr: 提出ClosedLoopBench基准,揭示临床闭环数据中时序关系估计的混杂问题,并提出反馈鲁棒的患者知识图构建方法。
AI.motivation: 床旁监测的患者知识图需要对关系进行类型化并说明数据是否支持其符号。但在麻醉与重症监护中,医生根据生理反应调整药物和通气,导致时序关系混合了患者反应与医生策略(闭环反馈),这使得关系估计易产生伪相关。
AI.method: 构建ClosedLoopBench:基于3,442例VitalDB手术病例(12,653小时)及阴性对照动作流,定义29种由物理、药理或临床实践固定符号的关系;用量换其他患者动作的方式检验估计器;提出反馈鲁棒的患者图——结合概念节点与证据指针、经阴性对照筛选的类型化关系及搏动级耦合。
AI.result: 动作量换后,12个估计器中有6个在未校准时平均将19-29个不同关系估计中的11-18个判为显著;校准后交叉相关和Granger检验仍将呼吸机频率->呼末CO2符号误判为医生策略符号。新图在零流下每图仅0.06-0.10个假概念级关系实例,而相关性构建为10-12个。11种慢速药物与通气反应的患者特异性估计预测后续数据并不优于群体估计,但脉搏到达时间-收缩压斜率的负向在94.3%(2,884例)中成立且患者特异(早晚相关0.67 [0.63, 0.70])。
AI.conclusion: 闭环反馈会严重偏倚临床时序关系估计,使多数估计器产生虚假显著关系;需采用反馈鲁棒的知识图构建与阴性对照验证,才能得到可信的患者特异性关系。

title: Evidence-Inference Reconstruction: When The Evidence Is Recalled But The Reasoning Goes Wrong
summary: Modern multi-hop LLM agents are equipped with built-in mechanisms to detect errors in intermediate reasoning steps. Such errors trigger corrective actions from these agents, which mostly follow the paradigm of retrying the steps or the reasoning trajectories. Not only are these retries expensive, we present in this paper that they are also potentially unnecessary. To this end, we introduce Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR), which uses structured state to guide one retrieval trajectory, accumulating source evidence in the process. We show that as long as the relevant evidence has been collected, EIR is capable of generating the correct answer in a single final model call even if erroneous evidence has been mixed in due to incorrect intermediate reasoning steps. In one evaluation, using Haiku 4.5 and GPT-4.1 Mini, we evaluate EIR on matched 1,000-question subsets of HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, showing that EIR improves Answer F1, the overlap between the model's and the correct answer, over the baseline by 8.3--32.8 points, Agentic SSR by 10.6--29.1 points, and Reflexion by 1.1--15.9 points. Additionally, we show that EIR averages 4.85 total model calls per question, compared with 35.29 for Agentic SSR and 12.41 for Reflexion. Together, these results corroborate EIR's central premise: separating evidence retrieval from the final answer model call can improve answer accuracy while utilizing substantially less computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR)，用结构化状态引导单条检索轨迹并累积源证据，只要相关证据被收集，即使混入错误证据也能在单次最终模型调用中生成正确答案，从而避免昂贵的重试式纠错。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳 LLM agent 在检测到中间推理错误后，通常采用重试步骤或整条推理轨迹的纠错范式。这类重试不仅计算昂贵，论文指出它们也可能是非必要的。
AI.method: EIR 使用结构化状态引导一条检索轨迹，并在过程中累积源证据；将证据检索与最终答案生成分离，最终只需一次模型调用即可基于已收集证据重构答案。
AI.result: 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 的 1,000 题匹配子集上，使用 Haiku 4.5 和 GPT-4.1 Mini 评估：EIR 的 Answer F1 较基线提升 8.3–32.8 点，较 Agentic SSR 提升 10.6–29.1 点，较 Reflexion 提升 1.1–15.9 点；平均总模型调用 4.85 次/题，而 Agentic SSR 为 35.29 次，Reflexion 为 12.41 次。
AI.conclusion: 将证据检索与最终答案生成分离，可以在显著降低计算量的同时提升答案准确率，验证了 EIR 的核心主张。

title: The Devil is in the Spectrum Bias: Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching for Robust Representation Distillation
summary: Large visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable transferability across a wide range of downstream tasks. To deploy such models efficiently, feature matching has become a popular knowledge distillation approach that transfers teacher representations to smaller student models without requiring labeled data. However, we show that the conventional feature matching objective with L2-distance is inherently biased toward reconstructing dominant spectral directions of the teacher representation, while under-optimizing low-variance directions that often contain task-relevant information. To address this, we propose Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching, SpecMatch, a simple objective that adaptively emphasizes under-optimized spectral directions while preserving the relative importance of dominant directions. SpecMatch is easy to implement and introduces negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image recognition demonstrate that SpecMatch consistently improves downstream adaptation across diverse tasks, including image classification, anomaly detection, medical image analysis, and domain generalization.
