Questioning them further does not complete the set but adds mostly wrong diagnoses. We formalise this pattern with a theoretical reference model of single-hypothesis tracking. The benchmark, generator, and evaluation code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CLIMB-8340.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CLIMB基准，用于评估多轮交互与多标签诊断下的临床推理，发现现有模型表现很差。
AI.motivation: 患者常同时患有多种临床病症，且识别这些共病症的信息在多轮问诊中逐渐显现，现有评估缺乏同时覆盖多轮交互与多标签诊断的基准。
AI.method: 构建CLIMB基准：医生模型与模拟患者交互，目标是恢复真实的共病集合；案例由临床决策算法和诊断数据集合成，将多病表现扎根于结构化临床知识；并建立单假设追踪的理论参考模型。
AI.result: 在六个前沿及开源模型中，没有一个能在超过10%的交互案例中完全恢复病症集合；共病时诊断性能下降，即使给出完整病历和真实病症数；交互进一步降低性能；模型表现为单假设追踪者（锚定首个诊断线索、围绕其提问、仅当视野内线索指向时才找回第二病症），继续提问多为错误诊断。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在多轮多标签临床推理上存在显著缺陷，倾向于单假设追踪，CLIMB为相关评估与改进提供基准与工具。

title: D$^2$-VLA: Dual-Memory Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model For Long Dynamic Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to remember cues that are no longer in view while responding to moving objects. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies often rely on the latest observation, and refreshing their visual context typically requires another costly vision-language model (VLM) pass. We present D$^2$-VLA, which combines dual memory and dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA. D$^2$-VLA uses block-wise causal KV caching to encode observations incrementally and, guided by distinct temporal attention patterns, constructs separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter incorporates fresh visual features into the latest history-conditioned KV block, while a short fast-memory queue supports action replanning. We introduce DOMINO-Long, a ten-task benchmark requiring robots to use earlier visual cues when manipulating moving objects. D$^2$-VLA achieves complete-task success rates of 29.3\% on DOMINO, compared with 9.6\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 17.2\% for PUMA, and 60.0\% on DOMINO-Long, compared with 35.4\% and 20.6\%, respectively. It improves success rates on eight real-robot tasks and reaches 97.5\% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3\% on RoboTwin 2.0.

AI.tldr: D²-VLA 通过在预训练 VLA 的 KV-cache 接口引入双记忆与双频控制，缓解长时程操作中视觉线索过期问题，并在 DOMINO 等基准上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 长时程操作需机器人记住已不在视野中的线索并响应移动物体，但现有 VLA 策略多依赖最新观测，刷新视觉上下文又需昂贵的 VLM 前向计算。
AI.method: 采用块级因果 KV 缓存增量编码观测，依据不同时间注意力模式为 VLM 与动作专家构建独立的历史 KV 读取视图；周期性 VLM 更新间用门控适配器将新视觉特征注入最新历史条件 KV 块，并用短快记忆队列支持动作重规划。
AI.result: DOMINO 完整任务成功率 29.3%（π0.5 为 9.6%，PUMA 为 17.2%）；DOMINO-Long 达 60.0%（对比 35.4%、20.6%）；八项真机任务均提升；LIBERO-Long 97.5%，RoboTwin 2.0 74.3%。
AI.conclusion: D²-VLA 有效融合双记忆与双频控制，在长时程和动态操作场景中显著优于现有 VLA 基线，并具备良好真机泛化能力。

title: ResonAct: Streaming Metrics for Runtime Diagnosis and Self-Healing in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used to automate enterprise workflows involving multiple specialized agents, external tools, and long-running task execution. Failures may arise from tool degradation, context propagation errors, coordination breakdowns, or repeated agent interactions that prevent task completion. While existing observability frameworks provide traces and logs, diagnosis and remediation are largely performed after execution completes, limiting opportunities for recovery during runtime. We present ResonAct, a runtime self-healing framework that enables continuous monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation of multi-agent systems through streaming operational metrics. ResonAct ingests execution traces, agent interactions, and tool invocations into a streaming analytics layer that continuously derives task progress, context health, and tool reliability metrics. These metrics serve as runtime control signals for detecting anomalous execution patterns and localizing root causes using a structured failure model. Based on the diagnosed failure, ResonAct dynamically selects remediation policies and performs actions. The framework operates as an external control plane, enabling intervention without modifying application agents or orchestration logic. We evaluate ResonAct across enterprise workflow scenarios and AppWorld benchmarks. The results show that the streaming metric-based analysis identifies execution degradations and localizes faults. Furthermore, policy-driven remediation improves task completion rates by up to 10.00 percentage points, with detection precision ranging from 70.59% to 82.91%, recall from 63.09% to 100%, recovery rates from 10.48% to 46.67%, and runtime overhead ranging from $-0.25%$ to 14.12% across the evaluated configurations.

AI.tldr: ResonAct 是一个多智能体系统的运行时自愈框架，通过流式运行指标实现持续监控、诊断与修复，无需修改应用智能体。在 AppWorld 等基准上，任务完成率最高提升 10 个百分点，检测精确率 70.59%–82.91%。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统在企业工作流中面临工具退化、上下文传播错误、协作中断等故障，但现有可观测框架仅在执行结束后提供追踪与日志，诊断和修复多为事后完成，缺乏运行时恢复机会。
AI.method: ResonAct 将执行追踪、智能体交互和工具调用摄入流式分析层，持续派生任务进度、上下文健康和工具可靠性指标，作为运行时控制信号。基于结构化故障模型检测异常模式并定位根因，再动态选择修复策略执行动作。框架作为外部控制平面运行，无需修改应用智能体或编排逻辑。
AI.result: 在企业工作流场景和 AppWorld 基准上，流式指标分析能识别执行退化并定位故障。策略驱动修复使任务完成率最高提升 10.00 个百分点；检测精确率 70.59%–82.91%，召回率 63.09%–100%，恢复率 10.48%–46.67%，运行时开销 -0.25%–14.12%。
AI.conclusion: ResonAct 证明了基于流式指标的运行时自愈在多智能体系统中可行且有效，能作为外部控制平面在不停机、不改代码的情况下提升任务完成率并降低故障影响。

title: Representation Alignment as a Bottleneck in LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
summary: While LLMs show promise in general reasoning, symbolic planning in chemistry remains a bottleneck. Direct ''SMILES-to-PDDL'' attempts fail because they force models to juggle chemical analysis and planning-language structuring simultaneously. We hypothesize that this failure stems from a lack of intermediate abstractions rather than insufficient model capacity. By decomposing retrosynthesis into molecule mapping, reaction mapping, and PDDL generation, we achieve high success rates where end-to-end approaches fail. This provides evidence that a primary bottleneck lies in representation alignment rather than raw model capacity. Our structural analysis demonstrates that intermediate representations are essential in retrosynthesis planning, highlighting the importance of representation-centric design in future systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将逆合成规划从直接SMILES到PDDL的端到端转换，分解为分子映射、反应映射和PDDL生成三步中间抽象，证明瓶颈在于表征对齐而非模型能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在通用推理上表现良好，但在化学符号规划中仍是瓶颈。直接"SMILES-to-PDDL"转换失败，因为模型需同时处理化学分析与规划语言结构化。作者假设失败源于缺乏中间抽象，而非模型容量不足。
AI.method: 将逆合成规划分解为三个阶段：分子映射（molecule mapping）、反应映射（reaction mapping）和PDDL生成。
AI.result: 在端到端方法失败的任务上，分解式方法取得了高成功率。结构分析表明中间表征在逆合成规划中至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 主要瓶颈在于表征对齐而非原始模型能力，中间表征对逆合成规划至关重要，未来系统应采用以表征为中心的设计。

title: Physics-Guided Spectral Distillation for Underwater Image Enhancement on Resource-Constrained Devices
summary: Underwater image enhancement is crucial for improving visual perception in marine applications. Existing underwater image enhancement studies mainly focus on enhancement quality and visual fidelity, while rarely considering real-time deployment capability, which is essential for resource-constrained underwater robots. To this end, we introduce a physics-guided spectral distillation (PSD) method, which reduces model capacity for real-time applications while maintaining the high performance of underwater image enhancement models. To decompose the outputs of teacher and student models, PSD adopts a multilevel Haar discrete wavelet transform. It transfers low-frequency color and illumination information as well as high-frequency structural details through band-specific objectives. Moreover, the distillation process of PSD is degradation-aware. We estimate degradation-aware weights through a physical head and combine them with ground-truth-guided reliability masks to selectively retain valuable teacher guidance. Experiments on the UIEB, LSUI, and EUVP datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Furthermore, we demonstrate the benefits of enhanced images for downstream perception tasks, including object detection. Deployment on a self-developed ROV further demonstrates its practical applicability in real-world underwater scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理引导光谱蒸馏（PSD）方法，通过多级Haar小波变换分解教师与学生模型输出，实现资源受限水下机器人的实时水下图像增强。
AI.motivation: 现有水下图像增强研究主要关注增强质量和视觉保真度，很少考虑实时部署能力，而这对资源受限的水下机器人至关重要。
AI.method: PSD采用多级Haar离散小波变换分解教师和学生模型的输出，通过分频段目标传递低频颜色与光照信息及高频结构细节；蒸馏过程具备退化感知能力，通过物理头估计退化感知权重，并结合真值引导的可靠性掩码，选择性保留有价值的教师指导。
AI.result: 在UIEB、LSUI和EUVP数据集上验证了方法的有效性；展示了增强图像对下游感知任务（如目标检测）的益处；在自主研制的ROV上部署，证明了其在真实水下场景中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: PSD在保持高性能水下图像增强的同时降低模型容量，满足实时部署需求，并具备实际应用价值。

title: PI-NOMT: Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Mass Transport for Brain Fluid Dynamics
summary: Recovering hidden transport mechanisms from sparse spatiotemporal observations is a fundamental inverse problem in scientific machine learning. In brain tracer imaging, dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI) provides time-resolved measurements of tracer concentration, while the underlying velocity and source mechanisms governing tracer propagation remain unobserved. We formulate this problem as physics-informed latent-state inference, in which the transport field itself is the primary object of inference rather than an auxiliary variable used only to reconstruct observed densities. We propose Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Mass Transport (PI-NOMT), a framework that represents density, velocity, and source as continuous neural fields and combines a continuous neural density teacher, recursive differentiable advection--diffusion--source rollout, unbalanced optimal-transport regularization, and governing-equation supervision. Physical laws act as structural priors that constrain the space of admissible transport mechanisms, while observed tracer dynamics provide evidence for estimating the latent transport state. We evaluate PI-NOMT on a synthetic benchmark with known ground-truth transport and on DCE-MRI sequences from nine control rats. On the synthetic benchmark, PI-NOMT accurately recovers the prescribed velocity field, including its magnitude, direction, and integrated trajectories, rather than merely reconstructing endpoint densities. Across the nine rat datasets, the framework yields sub-percent local endpoint error, consistent physical speed scales, and low post-training PDE and incompressibility residuals. These results support physics-informed latent-state inference as a general framework for recovering hidden transport mechanisms from observed dynamic scalar fields.

AI.tldr: 提出PI-NOMT框架，将脑示踪剂成像中的隐藏运输机制恢复建模为物理信息潜状态推断，用连续神经场表示密度、速度与源，在合成基准和九只大鼠DCE-MRI上准确恢复速度场并达到亚百分比端点误差。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏时空观测中恢复隐藏运输机制是科学机器学习的核心逆问题。DCE-MRI可测示踪剂浓度时间序列，但驱动其传播的速度与源机制不可观测，需直接推断运输场本身而非仅重建观测密度。
AI.method: PI-NOMT将密度、速度、源表示为连续神经场，结合连续神经密度教师、递归可微平流-扩散-源展开、非平衡最优传输正则化与守恒方程监督，以物理定律作为结构先验约束可行运输机制空间。
AI.result: 合成基准上准确恢复预设速度场的大小、方向和积分轨迹，而非仅重建端点密度；九只大鼠DCE-MRI数据上取得亚百分比局部端点误差、一致的物理速度尺度和较低的训练后PDE及不可压缩性残差。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息潜状态推断可作为从观测动态标量场恢复隐藏运输机制的通用框架。

title: FromPitch2Board: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Football Management
summary: Long-horizon agent benchmarks typically report how far an agent progresses, but do not identify whether its performance comes from the foundation model, scaffold, responsibility scope, match-control granularity, or horizon. We introduce FromPitch2Board, a deterministic football-management benchmark that studies five configurable factors through controlled comparisons on a single simulator, using paired seeds and a frozen calibration. We evaluate four foundation models and four agent scaffolds. In the Model Track, Coach points Z-scores span 0.19, while Manager points Z-scores span 0.68, with GPT-5.6 showing a sharp rise in passivity under responsibility expansion. Its responsibility ladder rises from 46.1 to 58.1 points with recruitment, then falls to 46.8 under full management, localizing the regression to the final responsibility boundary. Across that boundary, its skipped-decision rate rises from 1.1% to 57.9%. Within the Flash-Pro pair crossed across every scaffold, scaffold choice changes Manager points Z-scores by up to 0.48 relative to the fixed stateless scaffold. The 3Y cohort shows a directional reversal in mean ranking between years one and three, while a selected Claude Code+Pro configuration peaks in year three and remains below that peak, showing that responsibility scope and horizon expose behavior changes that a single headline score conceals.

AI.tldr: 提出FromPitch2Board足球管理基准，通过单模拟器受控对比，解耦基础模型、脚手架、职责范围、匹配控制粒度与时间跨度五个因素，揭示单一分数掩盖的行为变化。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体基准通常只报告进展程度，无法分辨性能来源于基础模型、脚手架、职责范围、匹配控制粒度还是时间跨度。作者需要一个可控、确定性、可配对比较的基准来系统隔离这些因素。
AI.method: 构建FromPitch2Board确定性足球管理基准，在单一模拟器上用配对种子和冻结校准，对五个可配置因素做受控对比；评估4个基础模型与4个智能体脚手架，设置Model Track（Coach/Manager）与3Y时间队列。
AI.result: Coach分数Z-score跨度0.19，Manager达0.68；GPT-5.6职责扩大后被动性剧增，职责阶梯从46.1升至58.1（招募后），全面管理时降至46.8，跳过决策率由1.1%升至57.9%；Flash-Pro对中脚手架选择使Manager分数Z-score变化达0.48；3Y队列在第1与第3年均值排名出现方向反转，某Claude Code+Pro配置第3年达峰后回落。
AI.conclusion: 职责范围与时间跨度会暴露单一头条分数所掩盖的行为变化，该基准能有效定位性能回归的具体边界，并分离模型、脚手架等因素的贡献。

title: Share-Borne AI Virus: Memory-Hopping Attacks Across LLM Agents
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as stateful assistants that retain information across interactions and use tools to read, modify, and create persistent artifacts. As these artifacts are shared between users, they form an indirect communication channel between otherwise independent assistants. We study a failure mode in which this channel enables self-propagating attacks. We introduce artifact-mediated propagation, where adversarial content introduced through an artifact (e.g. a report), is stored in an assistant's persistent memory, reproduced in a subsequently created artifact, and acquired by another assistant that later reads it. We evaluate this process in temporal human-agent universes that model artifact exchange between independently operated assistants over time, measuring whether an attack survives successive hand-offs, how many hops it reaches, and how broadly it spreads. We find that attacks can propagate across multiple independent assistants and persist over extended interaction sequences. In larger simulated environments, even GPT-5.6 Luna exhibits substantial spread, reaching 60-80% of agents with propagation chains extending to eight hops. These results show that persistent artifacts can act as durable carriers of adversarial state, allowing attacks to outlive individual interactions and spread across isolated assistants.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"制品介导传播"(artifact-mediated propagation)：共享持久化制品成为独立助手间的隐蔽通信信道，使对抗内容可自我传播。实验显示攻击可跨多个独立助手传播，GPT-5.6 Luna 亦有 60-80% 智能体被感染，传播链长达八跳。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益作为有状态助手部署，能跨交互保留信息并通过工具读写持久化制品。由于制品在用户间共享，原本独立的助手间形成了间接通信信道。作者欲探究这一信道是否会导致自传播攻击这一失败模式。
AI.method: 提出"制品介导传播"：对抗内容经制品（如报告）进入助手持久记忆，再现于后续创建的制品中，被另一助手读取后继续传播。在模拟独立助手间制品交换的时序人-智能体宇宙中进行评估，度量攻击能否经受连续交接、传播跳数与扩散广度。
AI.result: 攻击可跨多个独立助手传播，并在长交互序列中持续存在。在较大模拟环境中，即使 GPT-5.6 Luna 也出现显著扩散，感染 60-80% 智能体，传播链延伸至八跳。
AI.conclusion: 持久化制品可作为对抗状态的耐久载体，使攻击超越单次交互、跨孤立助手扩散，凸显有状态助手生态的安全隐患。

title: ControlTrace: Recovering Control Fields for Hidden-Content Recognition
summary: Spatially conditioned diffusion models can embed words and contours in natural-looking images, but vision-language models (VLMs) may fail to recognize the hidden content. Transformation-based recovery depends on parameter and view selection. To evaluate hidden-content recovery and recognition, we construct FreqBlind, a 6,000-image benchmark spanning contours, real words and non-words across three conditioning strengths. The evaluated transformation-based methods show limited recognition of contour patterns and weakly conditioned hidden content. To address this limitation, we propose ControlTrace to recover the grayscale control field used during generation. An 8.4M-parameter U-Net predicts this field from the carrier image, and a VLM then identifies its content. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, ControlTrace achieves 60.2% open-ended contour recognition accuracy across the three conditioning strengths, exceeding the best of the three evaluated prior methods by 26.9 percentage points. On an A100 GPU, the complete pipeline adds only 7.4 ms (5.3%) to direct VLM inference. Recovered fields have lower pixel errors and higher structural similarity than the evaluated transformation views. Across four evaluated VLMs, ControlTrace retains its overall contour recognition advantage. Recognition remains stable under the tested JPEG compression, Gaussian noise and downsampling. These results support control-field recovery for hidden-content recognition in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FreqBlind 基准与 ControlTrace 方法，通过恢复生成时使用的灰度控制场来识别扩散模型图像中的隐藏内容，在轮廓识别上大幅超越基于变换的方法。
AI.motivation: 空间条件扩散模型能将文字与轮廓嵌入自然图像，但 VLM 难以识别这些隐藏内容；基于变换的恢复方法依赖参数与视角选择，识别能力有限。
AI.method: 构建 FreqBlind 基准（6000 张图，涵盖轮廓、真实词与非词，三种条件强度）；提出 ControlTrace，用 8.4M 参数的 U-Net 从载体图像预测生成时的灰度控制场，再由 VLM 识别其内容。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 下开放轮廓识别达 60.2%，超最优先前方法 26.9 个百分点；A100 上仅增 7.4ms（5.3%）开销；恢复场像素误差更低、结构相似度更高，四款 VLM 均保持优势，且在 JPEG、噪声、下采样下稳定。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明控制场恢复在所评估场景下能有效支持隐藏内容识别。

title: JET: Justification Evaluation in Transformer
summary: JET uses pretrained language and vision-language models to select among a finite set of answers without additional training. It evaluates candidate likelihoods directly and shares computation across candidates. Experiments on desktop CPUs and consumer GPUs assess decision accuracy and execution cost. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B achieves 87.48% accuracy on the full MMLU test set and 3.69 requests per second on a separately timed MMLU subset. The accuracy-throughput comparison covers model, hardware, and reasoning choices, with Jev as an external reference. Controlled execution experiments show 2.18-2.23-fold speedups from prefix reuse and cache management, and a 30.8% reduction in process time from input preparation optimizations, with unchanged outputs. Optional reasoning has a task-dependent accuracy-throughput trade-off. These results support local decision inference from existing models.

AI.tldr: JET是一个无需额外训练的推理框架，利用预训练语言/视觉-语言模型在有限答案集中直接评估候选似然并共享计算。在CPU和消费级GPU上验证了准确率与效率：MMLU达87.48%，吞吐3.69 req/s，并通过前缀复用、缓存管理和输入准备优化获得显著加速。
AI.motivation: 论文动机是探索在本地设备（桌面CPU、消费级GPU）上直接使用现有预训练模型进行决策推理，无需额外训练即可在有限候选答案中做出选择，兼顾准确率与执行成本。
AI.method: JET直接评估候选答案的似然，并在候选之间共享计算以降低开销。通过受控执行实验引入前缀复用、缓存管理及输入准备优化，同时比较模型、硬件与推理选项，并与Jev作为外部参照。
AI.result: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B在完整MMLU测试集上达到87.48%准确率，单独计时的MMLU子集上吞吐为3.69 req/s。前缀复用与缓存管理带来2.18–2.23倍加速，输入准备优化使处理时间减少30.8%且输出不变。可选推理存在任务相关的准确率-吞吐权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明基于现有模型的本地决策推理是可行的，优化后能有效平衡准确率与执行效率。

title: RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents
summary: Practical deployment of large language model (LLM) agents requires strong task performance at affordable inference cost. For long-horizon agentic tasks, this performance-cost trade-off can be improved through within-task large-small model collaboration, as smaller models can handle some stages even when they cannot solve the full task. In this paper, we introduce RSI-router, a routing framework that constructs subtask-level model assignments and model-specific skills through recursive self-improvement over accumulated experience. Each iteration consists of four stages: Subtask Mining derives subtask definitions and identification rules from training trajectories; Routing Strategy Evolution proposes and evaluates diverse model assignments; Model-Specific Skill Evolution compares routed and large-model-only trajectories to diagnose failures and develop reusable execution skills; and Pareto-Optimal Router Selection updates the Pareto population using historical and newly generated routers while retaining dominated routers as experience for subsequent evolution. Routing between DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.5-9B, RSI-router consistently surpasses the DeepSeek-only baseline at roughly half the inference cost (48.3%) across five agentic benchmarks. In particular, on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, it cuts inference cost by 74.7-82.2% while simultaneously improving performance; on Terminal-Bench 2.0, it achieves a 16.7% relative performance gain at 18.0% lower cost. Moreover, RSI-router establishes a stronger performance--cost Pareto frontier than 9 routing methods.

AI.tldr: RSI-router：通过递归自改进构建子任务级大-小模型协作路由与技能，在约半成本下超越纯大模型基线。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体部署需兼顾任务性能与推理成本；长程任务中，小模型虽无法独立完成全任务，但可胜任部分阶段，因此任务内大-小模型协作可改善性能-成本权衡。
AI.method: RSI-router递归自改进框架，每轮四阶段：子任务挖掘（从轨迹中提取子任务定义与识别规则）、路由策略演化（提出并评估多种模型分配）、模型专属技能演化（对比路由与纯大模型轨迹以诊断失败并生成可复用技能）、帕累托最优路由选择（更新帕累托种群，保留被支配路由作为经验）。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash与Qwen3.5-9B间路由，五个智能体基准上以约48.3%成本持续超过纯DeepSeek基线；ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop成本降74.7-82.2%且性能提升；Terminal-Bench 2.0性能相对提升16.7%、成本降18.0%；性能-成本帕累托前沿优于9种路由方法。
AI.conclusion: RSI-router通过子任务级大-小模型协作与递归自改进，在显著降低推理成本的同时提升智能体任务表现，建立更优的性能-成本帕累托前沿。

title: TCSAlgBench: Benchmarking Automated Proving for Research-Level Theoretical Computer Science
summary: Large language models perform strongly on competition mathematics, but their research-level reasoning remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithm design to explicit guarantees and fundamental limits, providing a setting for evaluating whether models can justify computational improvements with arguments humans can inspect. We introduce TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery, comprising 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers. Expert-designed rules complete paper-specific context, preserve computational assumptions and quantitative guarantees, and withhold constructions when discovering an algorithm is part of the task. For each task, prover systems receive theorem statements and access to cited prior work. The pipeline supports fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers. We evaluate ten model configurations from four families under direct inference and prover-verifier discussion, and compare four agent workflows under matched model-call opportunities. All evaluations use the full benchmark. In the model comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 23.6% after 10-round discussion. Discussion and repeated sampling improve coverage. In the separate agent comparison using GPT-5.5 xhigh, decomposition improves coverage over discussion, and agentic planning achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 25.4%. TCSAlgBench provides a refreshable testbed for measuring progress in model reasoning and studying how agent workflows support research-level proof discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出TCSAlgBench基准与流程，用398个来自STOC/COLT 2026论文的定理级任务，评估LLM在理论计算机科学研究级证明发现中的能力，GPT-5.6 Sol与GPT-5.5 xhigh分别取得23.6%和25.4%的验证器接受覆盖率。
AI.motivation: LLM在竞赛数学上表现强劲，但研究级推理难以系统评测。理论计算机科学连接算法设计与可检验的保证和极限，适合评估模型能否给出人类可审查的计算改进论证。
AI.method: 构建TCSAlgBench：398个定理级挑战，来自138篇STOC和COLT 2026论文；专家规则补全论文上下文、保留计算假设与定量保证，在"发现算法属于任务"时隐藏构造。任务中prover系统获得定理陈述和被引文献。流程支持从新论文生成全新版本化挑战批次。评估四家族十种模型配置（直接推理与prover-verifier讨论），并在匹配模型调用机会下比较四种agent工作流。
AI.result: 模型比较中，GPT-5.6 Sol max在10轮讨论后五轮验证器接受覆盖率最高为23.6%；讨论与重复采样提升覆盖率。agent比较中（GPT-5.5 xhigh），分解优于讨论，agentic planning最高达25.4%。
AI.conclusion: TCSAlgBench提供可刷新的测试平台，用于衡量模型推理进展并研究agent工作流如何支持研究级证明发现。

title: From Perception to Integration: Revisiting the Internal Dynamics of Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer simple visual questions, but often struggle when one question requires several visual judgments. We study this gap with controlled tasks for feature binding, numerosity, spatial relations, and amodal completion, together with a Composite task that combines them. Matched counterfactual image pairs isolate changes in the visual evidence needed to answer. Across four models, direct answers, hidden-state readouts, and state interventions show that the individual judgments can be made without explicit reasoning and that intervening on the corresponding states can affect the answer. During reasoning, the Composite answer becomes decodable from hidden states and usable from shortened traces, often before the model stops on its own. We train a small detector to predict this readiness and stop reasoning at that point. On MMStar and RealWorldQA, this reduces mean reasoning tokens by 79.1% and 74.5%, while average accuracy rises by 3.13 and 3.30 percentage points, respectively. These findings connect the internal development of answer readiness to a practical rule for allocating reasoning computation.

AI.tldr: 研究VLM在多步视觉判断中的推理机制，发现答案在推理早期即已就绪，可提前停止推理以大幅省token并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: VLM能回答简单视觉问题，但需多步视觉判断时表现不佳。作者想弄清这一差距：单个判断是否可无推理完成、复合判断何时在内部"就绪"。
AI.method: 设计受控任务（特征绑定、数量、空间关系、非模态补全）及组合任务Composite；用匹配的反事实图像对隔离视觉证据变化；对四个模型做直接回答、隐状态读出与状态干预；训练小型检测器预测答案就绪并据此提前终止推理。
AI.result: 单个判断可无需显式推理完成，干预对应状态可影响答案；Composite答案在推理中可从隐状态解码、并用截短轨迹使用，常早于模型自行停止。提前停止后MMStar与RealWorldQA推理token平均减少79.1%和74.5%，准确率分别升3.13和3.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将答案就绪的内部发展过程与实用的推理计算分配规则相连，证明可动态提前停止推理以节省算力并提升性能。

title: Vanilla Policy Optimization Is Both Optimal and Differentially Private for Stochastic Contextual Bandits
summary: Can vanilla policy optimization explore enough to achieve near-optimal regret in stochastic contextual bandits? We show that standard exponential policy updates driven by offline regression do so under realizability, without exploration bonuses or importance weighting. For $A$ actions, $T$ rounds, and a finite prediction class $F$, vanilla PO achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{AT\log(|F|)})$ regret with high probability. Our analysis reveals an implicit exploration mechanism of independent interest: gradual policy updates prevent actions from losing probability too quickly, allowing the regression oracle to learn their expected losses. We further develop a batched version using only $O(\log T)$ regression calls and policy switches, and show how private regression oracles yield differentially private contextual bandit algorithms without composition across batches. For a finite class, this gives pure $\varepsilon_{\rm priv}$-DP and regret $\widetilde O\left( \sqrt{AT \log(|F|/δ)}(1+\varepsilon_{\rm priv}^{-1/2}) \right)$. Finally, experiments across oracle-based contextual bandit algorithms, with and without privacy, demonstrate the practical effectiveness of policy optimization and the value of explicit exploration under stronger privacy constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明，在可实现性条件下，基于离线回归的标准指数策略更新（vanilla policy optimization）无需探索奖励或重要性加权，就能在随机上下文老虎机中实现近最优遗憾 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{AT\log(|F|)})$，并揭示其隐式探索机制；进一步给出分批版本和差分隐私算法。
AI.motivation: 研究核心问题：vanilla policy optimization 是否能在随机上下文老虎机中充分探索，从而达到近最优遗憾？以往方法通常依赖显式探索奖励或重要性加权，本文希望说明标准策略优化本身已具备足够的探索能力。
AI.method: 采用由离线回归驱动的标准指数策略更新（policy optimization），不使用探索奖励或重要性加权；分析其隐式探索机制：渐进式策略更新防止动作概率过快衰减，使回归预言机能够学习其期望损失。进一步设计仅需 $O(\log T)$ 次回归调用和策略切换的分批版本，并利用私有回归预言机给出差分隐私算法。
AI.result: 对于 $A$ 个动作、$T$ 轮和有限预测类 $F$，vanilla PO 以高概率达到 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{AT\log(|F|)})$ 遗憾。分批版本仅需 $O(\log T)$ 次回归调用与策略切换。对于有限类，可获得纯 $\varepsilon_{\rm priv}$-DP，遗憾为 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{AT\log(|F|/\delta)}(1+\varepsilon_{\rm priv}^{-1/2}))$，且无需跨批次组合。实验验证了策略优化的实际有效性。
AI.conclusion: 标准策略优化本身具有足够探索能力，可实现近最优遗憾，无需额外探索机制；其隐式探索也可扩展到分批和差分隐私场景，实验表明策略优化在实践中有效，且在更强隐私约束下显式探索更有价值。

title: PDE-JEPA: Predictive Representation Learning of Latent Dynamics Modeling for Parametric PDEs
summary: Physical trajectories contain more than snapshots of a system: they also reveal how its states evolve under governing conditions. However, representation learning for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) has largely relied on reconstruction-based objectives that emphasize recovering observed physical fields. In this paper, we investigate predictive representation pretraining as an alternative to reconstruction-based learning. We find that predictive representations preserve rich physical information, yet this advantage alone does not ensure accurate field evolution. Based on these observations, we introduce PDE-JEPA for parametric PDE dynamics. Specifically, we first train an encoder using a masked-latent prediction to capture the underlying regularities of PDE dynamics. To explicitly adapt the pretrained representation toward a more dynamics-aligned state space, we then introduce a geometry projector that aligns latent trajectory geometry with the evolution geometry of physical fields. Finally, building on this geometry-aligned latent space, we further develop a physics-structured latent predictor that decomposes the dynamics into parameter-independent evolution and parameter-dependent response components. Extensive experiments on nine widely used PDE benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by an average of 33.4\% in-distribution, while achieving an average improvement of 51.4\% when extrapolating to unseen governing parameters. The project page is available \href{https://tanpig-x.github.io/PDE-JEPA/}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDE-JEPA，用预测式表征预训练替代重建式目标，学习参数化PDE动力学，在9个基准上显著超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有参数化PDE表征学习多依赖重建目标（只关注还原观测物理场），忽略了轨迹中蕴含的状态演化规律。作者发现预测式表征虽保留丰富物理信息，但仅此不足以保证精确的场演化。
AI.method: PDE-JEPA框架：1）用掩码潜变量预测训练编码器，捕捉PDE动力学内在规律；2）引入几何投影器，将潜轨迹几何与物理场演化几何对齐，使表征更贴合动力学；3）在几何对齐的潜空间上设计物理结构化潜预测器，将动力学分解为参数无关的演化项与参数相关的响应项。
AI.result: 在9个常用PDE基准上，框架在同分布上平均超越现有SOTA 33.4%，在向未见控制参数外推时平均提升51.4%。
AI.conclusion: 预测式表征预训练结合几何对齐和物理结构化预测器，能有效学习参数化PDE动力学并具备强外推能力。

title: Simultaneous Translation between Sign Languages
summary: Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) signers cannot converse in real time across different sign languages today: existing sign-to-sign translation systems run offline, requiring the full source clip before any target sign is emitted. Live use cases - e.g. broadcast interpretation and two-way video calls - instead demand simultaneous output, while the source signer is still signing. We present, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous sign-to-sign (S2S) translation system, with two wait-k regimes: test-time wait-k inference applied directly to a full-sentence model, and a trained wait-k model via stochastic multi-path supervision. We further introduce ca-Stream-AL, a computation-aware latency metric for streaming output. Averaged across six S2S directions on both a smaller human-verified test set and a larger synthetic S2S corpus, our streaming system achieves a 38% ca-Stream-AL reduction while staying within a 9% DTW-PA-MPJPE increase and a 2.1 BLEU-4 drop compared to the full-sentence baseline. A word-order case study probes how the streaming model handles word order mismatch between different sign languages - a consequence of simultaneous translation.

AI.tldr: 首个同步手语到手语(S2S)翻译系统，采用wait-k策略实现流式输出，并引入计算感知延迟指标ca-Stream-AL。
AI.motivation: 现有手语到手语翻译系统离线运行，需完整源片段才能输出，无法满足广播翻译和双向视频通话等实时场景需求。
AI.method: 采用两种wait-k机制：直接对全句模型做测试时wait-k推理，以及通过随机多路径监督训练wait-k模型；并提出计算感知的流式延迟指标ca-Stream-AL。
AI.result: 在六个S2S方向上平均，流式系统实现38%的ca-Stream-AL降低，同时DTW-PA-MPJPE仅增加9%、BLEU-4仅下降2.1，优于全句基线。
AI.conclusion: 系统能以较小质量损失换取显著延迟降低，并通过词序案例研究分析同步翻译带来的跨手语词序错配问题。

title: ESTHER: Egocentric Stereo Hand Estimation and Reconstruction in the Wild
summary: Human dexterity is guided by two eyes watching two hands: binocular vision supplies the metric 3D structure that fine-grained manipulation consumes. Egocentric stereo is therefore the natural perceptual interface for robots, AR, and VR-yet metric 3D hand reconstruction from this very signal still has neither an end-to-end model nor an in-the-wild benchmark. We propose ESTHER, a model whose stereo geometry, temporal reasoning, and output representation are designed for wearable egocentric stereo. It is trained on pseudo-labels from a calibrated labeling pipeline and in turn assembles our benchmark ESTHER3D, an egocentric stereo hand dataset pairing a large in-the-wild training set of model-generated labels with a motion capture test set of true metric ground truth. Experiments show state-of-the-art accu?racy, superior external generalization, and robustness to the missing views, dropped frames, and lighting and motion blur extremes of real egocentric capture that break existing meth?ods. This robustness runs deeper than graceful degradation: stereo guidance teaches the model to bind apparent hand scale to metric depth, so it not only adapts to different stereo rigs and modalities with minimal fine-tuning, but more strikingly preserves true metric scale even after collapsing to a single monocular view.

AI.tldr: 提出ESTHER——首个面向可穿戴式自我中心立体视觉的端到端度量3D手部重建模型，并构建了带真实动捕标注的基准数据集ESTHER3D。
AI.motivation: 自我中心立体视觉是机器人、AR、VR的自然感知接口，但该信号下的度量3D手部重建既缺少端到端模型，也缺乏真实场景基准。
AI.method: 设计针对自我中心立体的立体几何、时序推理与输出表示；用标定标注流水线生成的伪标签训练，并借此构建ESTHER3D数据集（大规模野外训练集+动捕测试集）。
AI.result: 达到SOTA精度，外部泛化性强，对缺失视图、丢帧、光照与运动模糊等真实采集极端情况具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 立体引导让模型将表观手部尺度与度量深度绑定，能以极少微调适配不同立体设备和模态，甚至在退化为单目视图后仍保持真实度量尺度。

title: From Human Narrative to Harmonic Structure: A Human-Centered Investigation of Algorithmic Music Generation through the Chord Wheel Diagram
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, link to GIT
summary: Contemporary AI-based music generation can produce compositions that satisfy formal requirements of tonality and musical coherence. However, whether musical expression can be described by mathematical properties alone remains a fundamental question. Human composers operate within personal and cultural contexts that influence harmonic decisions and deliberate departures from established patterns. This study investigates six narrative-driven popular songs by Bob Dylan, Johnny Cash, and Ritchie Valens. Original human harmonies are compared with outputs of an explainable computational harmonizer operating on the same melodies without access to the original chord progressions. We examine harmonic vocabulary, functional persistence, repetition, non-diatonic events, and tension-resolution patterns using Chord Wheel Diagrams and BPMN-based representations. Results show that high melody-chord compatibility does not necessarily imply preservation of the original human harmonic decision pattern. Some generated harmonizations retain the economical structure of the reference, while others alter harmonic diversity or suppress distinctive events while remaining compatible with the melody. Rather than quantifying artistic quality, the study introduces narrative-conditioned harmonic structure as a complementary perspective for computational music analysis. The findings suggest that generative systems may benefit from modeling not only harmonic correctness, but also structural identity, context, and human compositional intention.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了Bob Dylan、Johnny Cash和Ritchie Valens的六首叙事性流行歌曲的人类和声与可解释计算和声器在相同旋律上的输出，发现高旋律-和弦兼容性并不保证保留人类原有的和声决策模式。
AI.motivation: 当代AI音乐生成能产出符合调性与音乐连贯性形式要求的作品，但问题是音乐表达能否仅用数学属性描述尚不明确。人类作曲家在和声决策中受到个人与文化语境的影响，会有意偏离既定模式，因此需要从叙事条件化的和声结构视角考察和声决策。
AI.method: 选取Bob Dylan、Johnny Cash和Ritchie Valens的六首叙事驱动流行歌曲，将原始人类和声与在相同旋律上运行、无法获取原始和弦进行的可解释计算和声器输出进行比较。通过Chord Wheel Diagrams和基于BPMN的表示，考察和声词汇、功能持续性、重复、非调性事件以及张力-解决模式。
AI.result: 高旋律-和弦兼容性不一定意味着保留原始人类和声决策模式。一些生成的和声保留了参考的简约结构，另一些则改变了和声多样性或抑制了独特事件，同时仍与旋律兼容。
AI.conclusion: 研究并非量化艺术质量，而是引入叙事条件化和声结构作为计算音乐分析的补充视角。结果表明，生成系统不仅应建模和声正确性，还应建模结构身份、语境和人类作曲意图。

title: Twist, Don't Tilt: Trajectory-Exact Constrained Decoding for Masked Diffusion Models
summary: Constrained decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) aims to ensure that generated outputs satisfy a specified structure or syntax constraint. MDLMs generate outputs by repeatedly unmasking masked positions present in their current state. Recent strategies for constrained decoding constrain the model's per-step mean-field posterior (which factorizes over masked positions) by enforcing the desired constraint with an automaton. The resulting chain-structured factor graph allows exact constrained sampling via dynamic programming. However, despite each draw being exact and constraint-satisfying, we prove that their composition, in general, tilts away from the model's relative probabilities over valid trajectories, thus leading to trajectory bias. We derive an exact expression for this bias as a product of ratios measuring how valid continuation mass changes when the denoiser is reconditioned, and characterize when the bias vanishes. We then correct the bias by introducing TWISTER, the first automaton-twisted Sequential Monte Carlo decoder for MDLMs, using the step-exact decoder as the proposal. We show that for regular language constraints, the Feynman-Kac correction is exactly computable, with the twists obtained efficiently using quantities pre-computed for step-exact sampling. We prove that the resulting Feynman-Kac model targets the unbiased Doob h-transformed path law conditioned on constraint satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本文指出MDLM约束解码中逐步精确采样会导致轨迹偏差，并提出TWISTER（首个自动机扭曲SMC解码器）来纠正该偏差。
AI.motivation: MDLM通过反复去掩码生成输出，现有约束解码虽每步精确满足约束，但其组合会偏离模型在有效轨迹上的相对概率，产生轨迹偏差。
AI.method: 推导偏差的精确表达式（有效续接质量比值的乘积），刻画偏差消失条件；提出TWISTER，以步精确解码器为提议分布，用自动机扭曲的序贯蒙特卡洛进行Feynman-Kac纠正。
AI.result: 对正则语言约束，Feynman-Kac纠正可精确计算，扭曲项利用步精确采样预计算量高效获得。
AI.conclusion: 证明所得Feynman-Kac模型目标为在约束满足条件下的无偏Doob h-变换路径分布。

title: Generative Residual Factorization
summary: Under a shared-factor model, the conditional law of the next image patch factors into a posterior over the shared scene factor and a residual kernel given that factor. A sufficient statistic of the past replaces the raw past in the posterior and does not replace the kernel. The conditional entropy splits into residual entropy, which no observation of the factor can remove, and a posterior term, which a better representation of the past can remove. Next-embedding prediction is a directional likelihood on a shallow map, so the fiber of that map is unidentified and a constant embedding remains a minimizer. The same split is an equality in a scalar Gaussian model, evaluated in closed form.

AI.tldr: 论文在一个共享因子模型下分析下一图像块预测，将条件熵拆分为不可约的残差熵与可通过更好表示历史消除的后验项，并指出下一嵌入预测是可识别性不足的浅层映射似然。
AI.motivation: 作者想弄清下一图像块预测中哪些不确定性是可以被更好的历史表示消除的，哪些是无法通过观测共享场景因子消除的，以厘清表示学习目标的理论边界。
AI.method: 在共享因子模型下，将下一块的条件分布分解为共享场景因子的后验与给定因子后的残差核；用充分统计量替代原始历史进入后验但不替代核；把条件熵拆成残差熵与后验项，并在标量高斯模型中给出闭式等式。
AI.result: 条件熵明确分解为残差熵（观测因子也无法消除）与后验项（更好历史表示可消除）；下一嵌入预测作为浅层映射上的方向似然，其纤维不可识别，常数嵌入仍是最小化目标。
AI.conclusion: 下一嵌入预测类目标存在可识别性缺陷，改进历史表示只能消除后验项而非残差熵，需正视该分解以设计更合理的预测目标。

title: Augmented Feature Boosting for Multicalibration
summary: Multicalibration requires a predictor's residuals to be unbiased not only globally, but also after conditioning on the predictor's own level sets and reweighting by a rich class of test functions. Standard boosting approaches in the distributional setting achieve this by repeatedly discretizing the predictor's range then auditing and repairing the resulting level sets. One consequence is that in practice, the algorithm's guarantees are sensitive to this parametrization of the rounding parameter. A natural theoretical question, then, is how to do discretization-free boosting which avoids this rounding within the boosting process itself. Here, we analyze an alternative feature-augmentation boosting paradigm inspired by Tax et al. (2026): at each round, a squared-loss oracle is called on hypotheses that receive the previous predictor's output as an additional feature, and only the final predictor is rounded to have a finite set of level sets to provide the multicalibration guarantee with respect to. We give a theoretical analysis of this procedure through the expressivity of the augmented hypothesis class, and show how the expressivity of this class yields a hierarchy of guarantees, including multiaccuracy, multicalibration, and the stronger notion of level-set multicalibration.

AI.tldr: 本文分析一种无需离散化的特征增强提升方法：每轮在加入前一轮预测作为特征的假设类上调用平方损失oracle，仅对最终预测器做舍入，并通过增强假设类的表达能力给出多准确、多校准及层级集多校准的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 现有多校准提升方法需反复离散化预测器取值范围再审计修复层级集，导致算法保证对舍入参数敏感；作者希望从理论上探讨避免提升过程内部舍入的无离散化提升方案。
AI.method: 采用受Tax et al. (2026)启发的特征增强提升范式：每轮将前一轮预测器输出作为额外特征，调用平方损失oracle；仅对最终预测器进行舍入以获得有限层级集，并通过增强假设类表达能力进行理论分析。
AI.result: 通过增强假设类的表达能力，作者展示了该过程可产生一系列保证层级，包括多准确（multiaccuracy）、多校准（multicalibration）以及更强的层级集多校准（level-set multicalibration）。
AI.conclusion: 该特征增强提升范式为无离散化多校准提升提供了理论路径，其保证由增强假设类的表达能力决定，并可分层覆盖从多准确到层级集多校准的多种概念。

title: SANTA++: Sampling Attention through Representative Keys
summary: Attention often concentrates on a small subset of tokens in the context, but which subset matters changes from one query to the next. To exploit this changing structure, we introduce SANTA++, a training-free stochastic attention method that uses representative keys for memory-efficient selection without scanning the entire key-value (KV) cache. Cached keys are organized into teams, and the query scores one representative from each team to decide which teams to sample. We compute exact attention scores within the sampled teams and reweight each team's contribution by the inverse of its inclusion probability. This importance sampling correction estimates attention over the full cache, with a sampling budget that lets us trade memory reads for accuracy. Remarkably, with 32 or 64 sampled teams, SANTA++ uses 16% to 22% of dense attention's KV reads and retains 94% to 99% of the dense-attention baseline's scores on LongBench v2 and HELMET's retrieval-augmented generation subset, and 85% to 91% on RULER, with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 32K context. With 31 sampled teams, our GPU implementation delivers a $1.69\times$ attention speedup over the dense FlashAttention baseline at 32K context. By reducing the number of cache entries read, SANTA++ in principle complements architectures with compressed KV representations, such as multi-head latent attention. Our kernels are available at: https://github.com/OPUSLab/santapp-kernel-demo.git.

AI.tldr: SANTA++是一种免训练随机注意力方法，通过将KV缓存键分组成"团队"并采样代表，用重要性采样校正估计全缓存注意力，以少量KV读取实现接近稠密注意力的精度与加速。
AI.motivation: 注意力通常集中在上下文的一小部分token上，但该子集随查询变化。现有方法难以高效应对这种动态结构，需要在不扫描整个KV缓存的前提下实现内存高效的注意力选择。
AI.method: 将缓存键组织成"团队(teams)"，查询对每队代表打分以决定采样哪些团队；对被采样团队计算精确注意力分数，并用该团队被包含概率的倒数对其贡献重新加权（重要性采样校正），从而估计全缓存注意力。采样预算可调节，实现内存读取与精度的权衡。方法免训练。
AI.result: 在32或64个采样团队时，仅用稠密注意力16%-22%的KV读取，在LongBench v2与HELMET RAG子集保留94%-99%分数，RULER保留85%-91%（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，32K上下文）。31个团队时，GPU实现相对稠密FlashAttention基线在32K上下文达1.69倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过减少读取的缓存条目数，SANTA++原则上可与压缩KV表示架构（如多头潜在注意力MLA）互补。代码/内核已开源。

title: WM-VLM: Probing Internal World Models for Interleaved Visual-Textual Reasoning
summary: Humans often solve spatial problems by mentally simulating visual transformations. In contrast, conventional vision-language models (VLMs) reason primarily through language. We investigate whether VLMs can solve spatial problems by reasoning with both text and generated visual states. To this end, we introduce WM-VLM, which equips a pretrained VLM with a lightweight world model branch for generating intermediate visual states. Our two-stage training first teaches the model to generate the next visual state and then to use that state for reasoning. We programmatically construct spatial reasoning tasks with verifiable intermediate visual states. These tasks allow us to evaluate how well the model generates visual states and how much it relies on them to answer the question. On 2D and 3D mental rotation tasks, WM-VLM consistently outperforms the supervised fine-tuned backbone, with gains of up to 39.25 percentage points. Ablations suggest that these gains depend on the generated visual states, as removing or corrupting them sharply reduces performance. Together, these results suggest that internal world models offer a promising path toward VLMs that reason in both language and visual space.

AI.tldr: 提出 WM-VLM，为预训练视觉语言模型加轻量世界模型分支生成中间视觉状态，实现文本与视觉双空间推理，在2D/3D心理旋转任务上最多提升39.25个百分点。
AI.motivation: 人类常通过心理模拟视觉变换解决空间问题，而现有VLM主要用语言推理，缺乏视觉状态推理能力，作者探索VLM能否结合文本与生成的视觉状态进行空间推理。
AI.method: WM-VLM为预训练VLM配备轻量世界模型分支生成中间视觉状态；两阶段训练：先学生成下一视觉状态，再用该状态推理；并程序化构造带可验证中间视觉状态的空间推理任务。
AI.result: 在2D和3D心理旋转任务上，WM-VLM持续优于监督微调主干，最高提升39.25个百分点；消融显示移除或破坏生成视觉状态会显著降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 内部世界模型为VLM在语言与视觉空间双推理提供有前景的路径。

title: MISHAP-Bench: A Hallucination Benchmark for Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) produce fluent responses about audio but often hallucinate by making plausible yet ungrounded claims. Existing audio hallucination benchmarks mainly measure response correctness, leaving it unclear whether an LALM hallucinates or simply fails to understand the audio. We challenge correctness-based evaluation by defining two hallucination categories: (i) context, where claims are not grounded in the audio; and (ii) knowledge, where claims about audio-related topics lack support from externally verifiable facts. We introduce MISHAP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark with 12,000 challenging open-ended question-audio pairs and a rigorous evaluation pipeline covering both categories. To evaluate open-ended responses, we propose a groundedness judge that uses reference rubrics and judge prompts guided by human annotations. We extensively evaluate ten state-of-the-art LALMs and show that hallucination remains substantial. Even a frontier model such as Gemini 3.7 Flash reaches a hallucination rate of 36.5%. We further adapt and benchmark four mitigation methods from multiple domains for LALMs. Despite some improvements, effective hallucination mitigation remains an open challenge. Finally, we call on the community to evaluate hallucination and benchmark mitigation methods with MISHAP-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出MISHAP-Bench基准（12000个开放问答对），将音频幻觉分为上下文与知识两类，并设计groundedness评判器，揭示现有LALM幻觉严重且缓解仍困难。
AI.motivation: 现有音频幻觉基准主要衡量回答正确性，无法区分模型是幻觉还是单纯未理解音频，导致评估不清。
AI.method: 定义两类幻觉：上下文幻觉（未基于音频）与知识幻觉（缺乏外部可验证事实支撑）；构建MISHAP-Bench基准；提出基于参考评分标准和人工标注引导的评判提示的groundedness judge，用于评估开放式回答；评测10个SOTA LALM及4种跨领域缓解方法。
AI.result: 即使Gemini 3.7 Flash等前沿模型幻觉率也达36.5%，四种缓解方法虽有改善，但有效缓解幻觉仍是开放难题。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁社区使用MISHAP-Bench评估幻觉与基准缓解方法。

title: Privacy-Preserving Full-Body Meshing from mmWave Radar via Mesh Foundation Model Supervision
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving human perception, but the extreme sparsity of point clouds from commercial single-chip sensors (mean ~6.5 points/frame; ~28% empty frames) has confined prior art to body-part keypoints or discrete action classification. We present a cross-modal teacher-student framework that lifts commercial radar to full-body, per-frame, metric 3D mesh reconstruction with per-joint uncertainty. Three innovations: (1) a mesh-foundation-model teacher - SAM 3D Body produces whole-body MHR ground truth (70 joints, 18,439 mesh vertices) from a single RGB frame with zero training, slashing annotation cost by orders of magnitude; (2) StudentPoseFormer - set encoding with masked attention pooling, a temporal Transformer, and a CVAE multi-hypothesis head that outputs both the pose mean and per-joint variance, honestly reporting where the radar cannot see; and (3) a multi-stage ground-truth quality pipeline (confidence gating, depth validation, temporal smoothing, bone-length consistency, bad-frame rejection) plus systematic information-lever ablations. On the public MM-Fi benchmark (same TI IWR6843 sensor, cross-subject), our full configuration reaches 7.45 cm 12-joint MPJPE, with ablations proving the causal value of point accumulation (k = 3, -0.34 cm), Doppler (-0.85 cm; -2 cm at the wrist on fast actions), and velocity loss (-0.27 cm). On our own synchronized radar + RGB-D corpus with block-level held-out splits, the pipeline achieves 21.47 cm end-to-end (per-joint hierarchy from 4.8 cm at the hip to 34.7 cm at the wrist - matching physical information limits), could be improved to 15 cm with ~30k diverse samples, and a scaling law shows sample diversity, not volume, is the binding constraint. Deployment inference is radar-only - no camera, no image.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态师生框架，将商用单芯片毫米波雷达提升到逐帧全身度量3D网格重建并给出逐关节不确定性。
AI.motivation: 商用毫米波雷达点云极稀疏（平均约6.5点/帧，约28%空帧），导致既有工作局限于身体部位关键点或离散动作分类，无法实现全身精细感知。
AI.method: 三大创新：(1) 以SAM 3D Body网格基础模型作为教师，从单张RGB零训练生成全身MHR真值（70关节、18439网格顶点），大幅降低标注成本；(2) StudentPoseFormer学生模型，采用集合编码+掩码注意力池化、时序Transformer与CVAE多假设头，输出姿态均值与逐关节方差；(3) 多阶段真值质量流水线（置信度门控、深度校验、时序平滑、骨长一致性、坏帧剔除）及系统性信息杠杆消融。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi公开基准（同款TI IWR6843，跨被试）上，完整配置达到7.45 cm 12关节MPJPE；消融证明点累积(k=3, -0.34 cm)、Doppler(-0.85 cm；快速动作手腕处-2 cm)、速度损失(-0.27 cm)的因果价值。自建同步雷达+RGB-D语料上端到端21.47 cm（髋部4.8 cm至手腕34.7 cm，符合物理信息极限），约3万多样本可提升至15 cm，缩放律表明样本多样性而非数量是瓶颈。部署时仅用雷达推理。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次实现商用雷达逐帧全身度量3D网格重建并提供不确定性，部署阶段无需相机或图像，具备隐私保护优势；未来关键在于提升样本多样性。

title: Rethinking Personalized Generation: Test-Time Alignment via Factorized Ranking Models
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to diverse user preferences is fundamentally hindered by standard alignment paradigms that optimize for monolithic users. In this work, empirical studies are first used to reveal the existence of a massive, untapped performance headroom for personalized generation through test-time alignment. We demonstrate that personalized generation is uniquely suited for test-time scaling methods like Best-of-N (BoN) because it can be viewed primarily as a candidate matching problem rather than a generator capability bottleneck. While reward models could in principle exploit this headroom, they are poorly calibrated for personalization, and their billion-parameter scale makes scoring large candidate pools prohibitively expensive. To overcome this limitation, we propose a parameter-efficient framework utilizing million-parameter scale multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ranking models. Our personalized ranking model directly reuses the internal embeddings of the base generator with minimal overhead. By scaling train-time data to provide fine-grained personalized preferences, this million-parameter ranking model accurately scores large candidate pools and can seamlessly guide generation to reduce the cost of materializing N candidates. Extensive experiments on nine datasets spanning three personalized generation settings show that our personalized ranking model effectively exploits the discovered headroom, outperforming billion-parameter generalist reward models on every dataset, with under 0.4% of their parameters and four orders of magnitude lower scoring latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种参数高效的个性化排序框架：利用百万参数级MLP复用生成器内部嵌入，通过测试时对齐（如BoN）挖掘个性化生成的性能潜力，在9个数据集上超越十亿参数通用奖励模型，参数不足其0.4%，评分延迟低四个数量级。
AI.motivation: 标准对齐范式面向单一用户进行优化，难以满足多样化的用户偏好，形成个性化生成中巨大的、未被开发的性能空间（headroom）。
AI.method: 先用实证研究揭示测试时对齐存在个性化headroom；将个性化生成视为候选匹配问题，适用Best-of-N等测试时扩展方法；提出复用基础生成器内部嵌入的百万参数级MLP排序模型，并通过扩展训练时数据提供细粒度个性化偏好。
AI.result: 在覆盖三类个性化生成设置的九个数据集上，该个性化排序模型释放了发现的headroom，在所有数据集上均超越十亿参数通用奖励模型，参数不到其0.4%，评分延迟低四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 个性化生成更应被视作候选匹配问题；轻量级个性化排序模型可高效替代庞大奖励模型，实现低成本、高质量的测试时个性化对齐。

title: Multi-Scale Semantic Mapping in Urban Environments via Observation Calibration and Policy Dependence Regularization
summary: Semantic mapping is fundamental to embodied navigation, yet existing methods are developed for indoor environments, where objects exhibit relatively limited scale variation and are observed from a restricted range of viewpoints. Urban environments pose substantially greater challenges: agents must map objects ranging from pedestrians to buildings while navigating large spaces with highly diverse viewing distances. These conditions introduce two key difficulties that existing datasets and methods fail to cover. First, object scale and observation distance can be severely mismatched. For example, small objects may be viewed from far away, whereas large objects may be observed at extremely close range, resulting in unreliable observation likelihoods. Second, objects with substantially different sizes and geometries require distinct mapping behaviors, which are difficult to capture with a single shared value estimator. To investigate these challenges, we introduce a large-scale urban semantic mapping dataset featuring realistic city layouts, high-fidelity rendering, and instance-level annotations spanning multiple object scales. We then propose a category-aware likelihood calibration policy that identifies and alleviates unreliable observations according to object category and viewing distance. Because the calibration and motion policies are optimized toward the same mapping objective, they may learn redundant shortcuts and become excessively coupled. We therefore introduce a mutual-information (MI) regularizer that penalizes their estimated representation dependence and encourages complementary behaviors. To better model heterogeneous mapping strategies across object scales, we further employ category-wise value estimators. We formulate their joint optimization as a Pareto optimization problem to mitigate conflicting gradients across categories.

AI.tldr: 本文针对城市环境语义建图的挑战，提出大规模城市语义建图数据集，并设计类别感知似然校准策略、MI正则化与类别价值估计器，通过帕累托优化解决跨类别梯度冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有语义建图方法主要针对室内环境，物体尺度变化有限、视角受限。城市环境面临物体尺度差异巨大（行人到建筑）、观测距离多样的问题，导致两类困难：(1) 物体尺度与观测距离严重失配，使观测似然不可靠；(2) 不同大小与几何的物体需要不同的建图行为，单一共享价值估计器难以捕捉。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模城市语义建图数据集，含真实城市布局、高保真渲染及多尺度实例级标注；2) 提出类别感知似然校准策略，按物体类别与观测距离识别并缓解不可靠观测；3) 引入互信息正则化，惩罚校准策略与运动策略的表示依赖，鼓励互补行为；4) 采用类别价值估计器建模异构建图策略，并将联合优化建模为帕累托优化以缓解跨类别梯度冲突。
AI.result: （摘要未给出具体定量结果。）
AI.conclusion: 通过类别感知校准、MI正则化与类别价值估计器结合帕累托优化，可更有效地应对城市环境中尺度差异与观测距离失配带来的语义建图挑战。

title: No Free Efficiency: Revisiting the Trade-off Between Training Efficiency and Model Vulnerability
summary: Training efficiency has become the central driver of recent progress in foundation models. To overcome the massive computational and data requirements of large-scale training, researchers increasingly adopt strategies such as selective data sampling, efficient pre-training, and simplified reinforcement learning pipelines. While these strategies drastically reduce overhead, they prompt a critical, yet neglected question: Is efficiency achieved at the expense of model robustness and security? To our knowledge, we present the first systematic cross-domain investigation of the efficiency-vulnerability trade-off. Across vision and language models, we show that efficiency-oriented training increases susceptibility to adversarial and privacy attacks. We characterize this vulnerability by analyzing the models' internal geometry and functional representations, demonstrating that the evaluated efficient variants consistently exhibit sharper loss geometry together with systematic changes in representational structure. We further extend our analysis to "zero RL training", finding that models trained using simplified RL recipes exhibit substantially greater susceptibility to catastrophic forgetting and more pronounced overconfidence than those trained through conventional alignment pipelines. Our findings suggest that training efficiency is rarely a "free lunch"; rather, the mechanisms that minimize computation can inadvertently compromise safety. We conclude by calling for a paradigm shift toward multi-objective training that jointly optimizes for performance, cost, and security.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究训练效率与模型鲁棒性/安全性之间的权衡：跨视觉与语言模型发现，效率导向的训练策略会增加对抗与隐私攻击的脆弱性，并在"零RL训练"下加剧灾难性遗忘与过度自信。
AI.motivation: 大模型训练对算力和数据需求巨大，研究者普遍采用选择性数据采样、高效预训练、简化强化学习流程等策略降低成本。但这些策略是否以牺牲模型鲁棒性和安全性为代价，此前被忽视，缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 开展首个跨领域（视觉与语言模型）的效率-脆弱性权衡研究：对比高效训练变体与常规训练模型在对抗攻击和隐私攻击下的表现，并通过分析模型内部几何与表征结构揭示机制；同时扩展到"零RL训练"，考察简化RL流程对灾难性遗忘和过度自信的影响。
AI.result: 效率导向训练使模型更易受对抗与隐私攻击；高效变体一致表现出更尖锐的损失几何（loss landscape）以及表征结构的系统性改变；采用简化RL流程训练的模型比常规对齐流程的模型更易发生灾难性遗忘，且过度自信更明显。
AI.conclusion: 训练效率并非"免费的午餐"，减少计算的机制可能无意中损害安全性。作者呼吁转向同时优化性能、成本与安全的多目标训练范式。

title: Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at structured, verifiable tasks, but their low-entropy bias can produce homogeneous and predictable outputs, limiting their utility for open-ended scientific ideation. Effective discovery, however, spans a broader creative spectrum: from structured day science to loosely structured, serendipitous night science that reaches ideas beyond those typically considered. We introduce AI Night-Scientist, an agentic framework that uses reinforcement learning to teach models when and how to depart from predictable reasoning. Grounded in cognitive science, we model creativity along three axes: action (what to do and how creatively), process (when to explore versus exploit), and outcome (the novelty and usefulness of the resulting idea). We use these axes to train models with GRPO, exposing them to varying degrees and forms of creativity throughout training. This produces substantially more diverse scientific proposals, expanding the range of research directions by 27.8% and contribution types by 14.9% over the base model. It also improves predicted citation impact by up to 32.0 percentage points and originality by 66.2 points. These gains cannot be reproduced by simply increasing decoding temperature; instead, we find that semantic guidance specifying what kind of creativity to pursue is critical. Overall, our results suggest that creativity is a learnable, multi-level ability that can be shaped to help researchers reach ideas beyond those typically explored by LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 AI Night-Scientist 智能体框架，用强化学习（GRPO）训练LLM在合适时机脱离可预测推理，沿行动、过程、结果三维度建模创造力，显著提升科学构想多样性与新颖性。
AI.motivation: LLM在结构化、可验证任务上表现优异，但低熵偏好导致输出同质、可预测，限制其在开放式科学构想中的效用。真正的研究发现需要跨越从"日间科学"到松散、偶然性的"夜间科学"这一更广的创造谱系。
AI.method: 提出 agentic 框架 AI Night-Scientist。基于认知科学，将创造力沿三轴建模：行动（做什么/多具创造性）、过程（何时探索vs利用）、结果（想法的创新性与有用性）。用 GRPO 强化学习训练模型，在训练中暴露于不同程度与形式的创造力，并提供语义引导（指明追求何种创造力）。
AI.result: 相比基座模型，研究方向扩展27.8%，贡献类型扩展14.9%，预测引用影响力提升最高32.0个百分点，原创性提升66.2分。仅提高解码温度无法复现这些增益，说明语义引导（指明创造力类型）至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 创造力是一种可学习的多层次能力，可被塑造以帮助研究者触及LLM通常探索之外的想法。

title: Transform-Aligned Learned Features for Lossy Point Cloud Attribute Compression
summary: Transform-based methods provide an effective framework for point cloud attribute compression by representing attributes as transform coefficients. Introducing learned spatial context into this framework requires mapping spatial representations to the transform domain, but this known basis change is often left for the network to learn implicitly. We propose Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF) by applying the attribute transform to learned spatial representations, explicitly aligning them with the coding targets. Our analysis shows that the resulting features exactly represent the first-order prediction term of a smooth nonlinear model, with a bounded Taylor remainder. We integrate TALF into a transform-based attribute codec with explicit coefficient prediction and conditional residual entropy modeling under a unified coefficient-domain rate--distortion objective, while retaining explicit quantization-step control. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets and multiple transform bases demonstrate that TALF improves rate--distortion performance over conventional and learned baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出TALF，将属性变换作用于学习到的空间表示，显式对齐编码目标，集成到基于变换的属性编解码器中，提升率失真性能。
AI.motivation: 在基于变换的点云属性压缩中，引入学习到的空间上下文需要将空间表示映射到变换域，但这种已知的基变换通常留给网络隐式学习。
AI.method: 对学习到的空间表示施加属性变换，显式对齐编码目标，形成TALF；理论分析表明这些特征恰为平滑非线性模型的一阶预测项且有界泰勒余项。将其集成到基于变换的属性编解码器中，采用显式系数预测、条件残差熵建模和系数域率失真目标，并保留显式量化步长控制。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集和多种变换基上，TALF相比传统及学习型基线均提升了率失真性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式对齐变换域的学习特征可有效改进点云属性压缩的率失真表现。

title: Finite Probes Suffice: Identifiability and Universality for Weight-Space Learning
summary: Learning properties of neural networks has recently attracted growing interest, with existing approaches operating either directly on network parameters or through probe-based representations of network behavior. While probing methods have shown strong empirical performance, their theoretical foundations remain limited. In this work, we study when finite probe-based representations are sufficient for learning neural functionals. We establish general identification and universality results for probing, and show that using intermediate hidden representations can provide significantly more informative representations than relying only on final outputs. Motivated by these results, we introduce HIDDENPROBE, a simple architecture for learning from hidden probe responses. Across a range of neural functional benchmarks, including both MLPs and Transformers, HIDDENPROBE consistently improves over existing probing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于探针的神经网络函数学习，提出通用可识别性与普适性理论，证明中间隐藏表征比最终输出更具信息量，并据此提出HIDDENPROBE方法，在MLP和Transformer基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 探针方法在学习神经网络性质上经验表现强，但理论基础有限；同时，仅依赖最终输出的探针表征信息量不足。
AI.method: 建立探针的通用可识别性和普适性理论；分析中间隐藏表征相对于最终输出的信息量优势；提出HIDDENPROBE架构，直接从隐藏探针响应中学习。
AI.result: HIDDENPROBE在多种神经函数基准（含MLP与Transformer）上稳定优于现有探针方法，达到最新最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 有限探针表征足以学习神经函数，且利用隐藏表征可显著提升性能，HIDDENPROBE为探针方法提供了理论与实践双重支持。

title: Before the Token Commits: Trajectory-Level Benchmarking of Visual Hallucinations in Diffusion VLMs
summary: Multimodal diffusion language models generate responses by iteratively unmasking tokens, making each answer the endpoint of a multi-step trajectory rather than an immediate commitment. Hallucination benchmarks built for autoregressive models evaluate only the final output, and therefore cannot determine whether an unsupported claim in diffusion VLMs appears late or has already stabilized before any answer token is revealed. We introduce DynaHall, a trajectory-level benchmark of annotation-backed binary visual propositions covering object existence, counting, attributes, and relations, with controlled hard negatives graded by visual prior. DynaHall is paired with a commitment-aware protocol that records the intermediate answer tendency at every unmasking step alongside the committed output. Across five diffusion VLMs from three architecture families, visual hallucination is settled before commitment: an unsupported answer is already the preferred state while the answer position is still masked, and later unmasking steps rarely reverse it, so the failure is not introduced at the write step. This holds across decoding schedules, answer formats, and open-ended generation. DynaHall also exposes failures hidden by final-output metrics, including counting and relation collapse, prior-driven false positives, and attribute errors whose direction changes by type. Guided by this diagnosis, PGS (Pre-commitment Gradient Steering) edits still-masked answer states to reduce false positives, bringing the affirmation rate close to balance, and transfers to another architecture without degrading general ability. DynaHall and PGS suggest that hallucination should be measured and mitigated along the generation trajectory of diffusion VLMs, not only at the final answer.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹级基准DynaHall与承诺感知协议，发现扩散VLM幻觉在答案提交前就已稳定，并据此提出PGS梯度引导方法缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉基准仅评估最终输出，无法判断扩散VLM中不支持的断言是晚期出现还是在答案token揭示前就已稳定。
AI.method: 构建DynaHall：基于标注的二值视觉命题（存在、计数、属性、关系），含视觉先验分级的受控难负例；搭配承诺感知协议，记录每个解掩码步骤的中间答案倾向与最终输出。并提出PGS（预承诺梯度引导）编辑仍被掩码的答案状态。
AI.result: 在3个架构家族的5个扩散VLM上，幻觉在承诺前已形成——答案位置仍被掩码时错误答案已是偏好状态，后续解掩码很少逆转。该现象跨解码调度、答案格式和开放生成成立。DynaHall还揭示最终指标掩盖的失败（计数与关系崩塌、先验驱动假阳性、属性错误方向随类型变化）。PGS降低假阳性，使确认率接近平衡，并可跨架构迁移且不损通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 扩散VLM的幻觉应在生成轨迹上测量和缓解，而非仅看最终答案。

title: Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL
summary: People learn not only by repeating successful actions, but also by recounting and explaining their experiences, revising their understanding to guide future behavior. Can a language-model agent improve its future actions by training only on explanations of its own experience? We investigate this question by studying Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a minimal online procedure designed to isolate the effect of explanation-only training on subsequent behavior. The agent attempts a task, observes available feedback, generates a retrospective explanation, and is fine-tuned with a next-token prediction loss on the explanation tokens alone. The procedure uses neither an external teacher nor a reward-based policy update. In software-engineering experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, ROFT is trained on problems with mixed successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts. On held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro, it reaches 49.2% and 26.8% solve rates after 20 updates without using a verifier, compared with GRPO's 48.0% and 25.3% after 40 updates in the evaluated runs, and makes faster early progress in training time and sampled attempts. It also learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, showing that learning can begin without any initially successful trajectories. Behavioral analyses find that ROFT indirectly assigns credit to actions, encouraging good actions and discouraging incorrect ones. Moreover, prompting retrospections to emphasize more direct solutions yields shorter subsequent attempts even without an explicit length penalty. Together, these findings show that learning to explain can also improve learning to do, establishing self-generated retrospections as useful training targets and motivating further study of explanation-to-action transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"仅反思微调"(ROFT)：智能体执行任务后生成回顾性解释，仅用下一词预测损失在解释文本上微调，无需外部教师或奖励策略更新，即可提升后续行为表现。
AI.motivation: 人类不仅靠重复成功动作学习，还通过复述和解释经验、修正理解来指导未来行为。作者想探究：语言模型智能体能否仅通过训练自身经验的解释来改进未来动作，从而分离"解释"本身对行为的影响。
AI.method: ROFT 是一个极简在线过程：智能体尝试任务→获取反馈→生成回顾解释→仅在解释token上以next-token prediction损失微调。不使用外部教师，也不需要基于奖励的策略更新。在软件工程任务上用 Qwen3.5-4B 实验，训练数据混合成功与失败尝试。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Pro 上，ROFT 经20次更新达到 49.2% 和 26.8% 解决率（无verifier），对比 GRPO 40次更新的 48.0% 和 25.3%，且训练时间和采样次数上早期进展更快。它能学会解决所有64次采样基线尝试均失败的任务。行为分析显示 ROFT 间接为动作分配信用，鼓励正确动作、抑制错误动作；提示解释强调更直接的解法还能在不加长度惩罚下缩短后续尝试。
AI.conclusion: 学会解释也能提升"做事"能力，自生成的回顾可作为有效的训练目标，并启发进一步研究"解释到动作"的迁移。

title: ORAV: Benchmarking Audio-Video Generation from Multimodal Contexts
summary: Audio-video generation using heterogeneous multimodal references has emerged as a new challenge, requiring both compositional control over generation and grounded understanding of multimodal context. In this paper, we introduce ORAV Bench for Omni Reference Audio-Video Generation, comprising 380 task instances with 2-10 references, 9 semantic roles, and 30 role compositions. Instructions specify the relationships among references; the media supply the identities, dynamics, and audio characteristics to be realized. To evaluate these open-ended outputs, we develop a reference-aware pairwise protocol that prepares visual and auditory evidence, compares the intended contribution of each reference, and checks the overall verdict in both presentation orders. On held-out instances, it achieves 86.08% effective agreement with human judgments. Across 5 frontier systems, overall rankings conceal distinct strengths across reference compositions. A recurring failure is to reproduce unintended source content in place of the requested result, despite closely resembling a reference. Reproducible pointwise diagnostics of quality, reference affinity, and speech reveal distinct dimensions of model behavior. ORAV thus offers a benchmark for tracking progress toward controllable, compositional, and reference-faithful audio-video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出ORAV Bench基准，用于评估异构多模态参考下的音视频生成，涵盖380个任务、9种语义角色和30种角色组合，并设计了参考感知的成对评估协议。
AI.motivation: 使用异构多模态参考进行音视频生成是新挑战，需要同时实现组合式控制和对多模态上下文的落地理解，但缺乏相应评测基准。
AI.method: 构建ORAV Bench，包含380个任务实例、2-10个参考、9种语义角色和30种角色组合；指令指定参考间关系，媒体提供身份、动态和音频特征；开发参考感知成对评估协议，准备视觉与听觉证据，比较每个参考的预期贡献，并在两种呈现顺序下检查总体判定。
AI.result: 在留出实例上与人类判断达到86.08%的有效一致率；对5个前沿系统评估发现总体排名掩盖了不同参考组合下的各自优势；常见失败是复现了非预期的源内容而非请求结果，尽管与参考高度相似；可复现的逐点诊断揭示质量、参考亲和度和语音等不同维度。
AI.conclusion: ORAV为追踪可控、组合式且忠实于参考的音视频生成进展提供了基准。

title: On the Two Faces of Adam in Separable Linear Classification
summary:
We consider the behavior of deterministic, full-batch, bias-corrected Adam in separable linear classification with softmax parametrization under log-loss. In this setting, under a wide range of conditions Adam is known to approach max-norm-margin optimality when its stability constant $ε$ is zero, while with a positive $ε$, it is known to approach Euclidean-margin optimality. Our main contribution is the quantitative description of Adam's behavior for small fixed positive $ε$. We give sufficient conditions under which an Adam-trained classifier nearly maximizes the max-norm margin before the updates become gradient-like. We also show that the classifier reaches a fixed target Euclidean margin only much later. Specifically, we show that for polynomially decreasing stepsizes with exponent \(a\), where \(1/3<a<1\), the updates become approximately proportional to the negative gradient after $Θ(\log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)})$ iterations. At that time, the classifier still nearly maximizes the max-norm margin. Reaching a fixed target Euclidean margin above that of every max-norm-optimal classifier, but below the optimum,
  is shown to require $ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)}$ iterations. Under inverse-linear stepsize decay (\(a=1\)), the update
  transition takes polynomially many iterations, whereas reaching the target margin takes
  exponentially many. Experiments support these predictions. The later change in the classifier
  can improve or worsen generalization after training error reaches zero, connecting the
  analysis to grokking and its reverse.

AI.tldr: 本文定量刻画了小固定正稳定性常数ε下，确定性全批量Adam在可分离线性分类中的两阶段行为：先近似最大化max-norm margin，随后才转向近似最大化Euclidean margin，并给出两个阶段的迭代复杂度。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明：当ε=0时Adam逼近max-norm-margin最优性，而ε>0时逼近Euclidean-margin最优性，但对小固定正ε下Adam如何在这两种解之间过渡缺乏定量理解。
AI.method: 研究确定性、全批量、带偏置校正的Adam，在softmax参数化与log-loss下的可分离线性分类问题，分析多项式递减步长（指数a）以及逆线性步长衰减（a=1）情形，刻画更新变为近似梯度更新的时间点及分类器最终达到目标Euclidean margin所需迭代数，并用实验验证。
AI.result: 当1/3<a<1时，经过Θ(log(1/ε)^{1/(1-a)})次迭代更新变为近似负梯度方向，此时分类器仍近似最大化max-norm margin；而达到某个高于所有max-norm最优分类器、但低于最优的固定目标Euclidean margin需要ε^{-Θ(1)/(1-a)}次迭代。a=1时，更新过渡只需多项式次迭代，而达到目标margin需要指数次迭代。实验支持上述预测。
AI.conclusion: Adam训练中的后期分类器变化会在训练误差归零后改善或恶化泛化性能，将本文分析与grokking及其反向现象联系起来。

title: Page-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation for EvalLLM 2026: A Five-Variant Study on French PDFs
summary: We study retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for questions about French PDF documents when both the answer and its supporting document pages are evaluated. Five system variants add dense retrieval, rank fusion, reranking, and query decomposition to a BM25 baseline. On 595 challenge questions, the complete system scores 0.4450 MRR@10 and 0.4013 Recall@10, compared with 0.3430 and 0.2994 for BM25. Dense retrieval alone and a simple lexical--dense fusion both underperform BM25. Reranking improves the hybrid system, whereas adding query decomposition produces the largest further gain, with higher latency and more detected output artifacts. The complete system slightly exceeds the reported anonymous overall mean on two answer metrics but falls below it on most page-retrieval metrics. These results identify accurate page selection, rather than semantic retrieval in isolation, as the main opportunity for improvement in this setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究法语PDF文档问答的RAG系统，在同时评估答案与其支撑页面时，比较BM25基线及加入稠密检索、排名融合、重排序和查询分解的五个变体。完整系统取得0.4450 MRR@10与0.4013 Recall@10，优于BM25的0.3430和0.2994。稠密检索单独及简单词法-稠密融合均不如BM25；重排序改善混合系统，查询分解带来最大增益但延迟更高、输出伪影更多。结论指出精准页面选择（而非单独的语义检索）是主要改进方向。
AI.motivation: 在法语PDF文档问答场景中，不仅需要正确答案，还需要定位支撑答案的文档页面。现有RAG系统常关注语义检索本身，但页面级检索质量对最终效果影响如何、何种组件组合最优尚不清晰，因此需要系统比较不同检索增强策略。
AI.method: 以BM25为基线，构建五个系统变体，逐步加入稠密检索、排名融合（rank fusion）、重排序（reranking）与查询分解（query decomposition），在595个挑战性问题上同时评估答案指标与支撑页面检索指标。
AI.result: 完整系统0.4450 MRR@10、0.4013 Recall@10；BM25为0.3430与0.2994。稠密检索单独及简单词法-稠密融合均低于BM25。重排序提升混合系统；查询分解带来最大额外增益，但延迟更高、检测到的输出伪影更多。完整系统在两项答案指标上略超匿名总体均值，但在多数页面检索指标上低于该均值。
AI.conclusion: 该场景下主要改进空间在于精准的页面选择，而非孤立的语义检索；重排序与查询分解有效但需权衡延迟与输出质量，页面级检索仍是薄弱环节。

title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
summary: Looped Transformers reuse one block of layers several times: by spending extra computation they push a model of fixed size further, and so use its parameters more fully; while sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few of many experts for each token. Looped MoE bridges these two design philosophies and gives MoE models new potential for better expert usage, but it raises a question: how to loop a MoE? We answer it with Foil. With the expert parameters and the expert compute per token held fixed, Foil (1) flattens the experts, halving the expert layers, doubling the experts per layer and doubling the passes, so that every routing decision chooses from a larger pool, and (2) unties the attention, giving each pass its own attention parameters while the experts and routers stay shared. Experiments show that Foil clearly outperforms the unflattened looped baseline: at 20B tokens every Foil model has lower pretraining loss than the baseline; at 100B tokens the loss improves monotonically with the degree of flattening, the most flattened Foil ending 0.012 nat below the baseline at equal parameters and compute, with downstream accuracy on par or better; untying the attention also yields more balanced and more confident routing at equal shape. Our ablations analyse why Foil works and turn the findings into design guidance for looped MoE: the returns of looping and of widening the expert layers amplify each other, routing confidence tracks healthy expert use better than load balance, and a sparse looped MoE should therefore use more experts per layer and more passes. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/SR-A-W/how-to-loop-moe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Foil，一种循环 MoE 设计：通过"压平"专家层（减半层数、加倍每层专家数、加倍循环次数）并解绑注意力参数，在固定专家参数与计算量下提升预训练效果。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过重复使用同一层块来更充分利用参数，而稀疏 MoE 每 token 仅激活少量专家。二者结合（循环 MoE）虽能改善专家利用，但"如何循环 MoE"尚无明确答案。
AI.method: Foil 在保持专家参数和每 token 专家计算量不变的前提下：(1) 压平专家——专家层数减半、每层专家数加倍、循环次数加倍，使每次路由从更大专家池中选择；(2) 解绑注意力——每次循环使用独立注意力参数，而专家与路由器保持共享。
AI.result: 20B token 时所有 Foil 模型预训练损失均低于未压平基线；100B token 时损失随压平程度单调改善，最强 Foil 在等参数等计算下损失低 0.012 nat，下游精度持平或更优。解绑注意力在相同形状下带来更均衡、更自信的路由。
AI.conclusion: 消融表明循环与加宽专家层的收益相互放大；路由置信度比负载均衡更能反映健康的专家使用。因此稀疏循环 MoE 应采用每层更多专家和更多循环次数。

title: EviSplat: Preserving Multi-View Evidence in 3D Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding enables object localization and segmentation from free-form text queries without a fixed category vocabulary. Many recent methods build on 3D Gaussian Splatting and consolidate multi-view observations, such as masked crops from individual views, into language features or compact object descriptors before the query is known. However, observations of the same object vary across viewpoints and are not equally informative: some reveal cues relevant to a particular query, whereas others provide incomplete or misleading evidence. Pre-query consolidation can therefore suppress cues on which a later query depends. We introduce EviSplat, which preserves individual observation features as evidence for later text queries. EviSplat retains individual observation features within class-agnostic 3D instances that represent objects, object parts, or background regions. It also learns, for each Gaussian, a distribution describing which visual appearances its observations support. Given a text query, EviSplat scores each instance using its most relevant observations. It then computes a score for each Gaussian by combining instance-level relevance with locally supported evidence, weighted by how often and how unambiguously that Gaussian was observed. Different queries can thus draw on different visual cues from the same preserved evidence. Experiments across diverse datasets and evaluation protocols demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, supporting the benefit of preserving multi-view evidence until query time and aggregating it according to the query.

AI.tldr: EviSplat 提出在查询前保留每个观测的特征作为证据，并基于查询动态聚合多视角证据，实现开放词汇 3D 场景理解。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在查询前就将多视角观测压缩为语言特征或对象描述符，但同一对象的不同视角信息量不同，提前压缩会抑制后续查询所需的线索。
AI.method: 将单个观测特征保留在类别无关的 3D 实例中（对象、部件或背景）；为每个 Gaussian 学习其观测支持的视觉外观分布；给定文本查询时，用最相关观测给实例打分，再结合实例级相关性与局部支持证据（按观测频率和明确度加权）计算每个 Gaussian 的分数。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和评测协议上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，验证了保留多视角证据到查询时并按查询聚合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 保留多视角证据直到查询时，并按查询动态聚合，有助于不同查询利用同一证据中的不同视觉线索，提升开放词汇 3D 场景理解。

title: JIVE: Jacobian-Informed Volume Expansion for Diverse Generative Sampling
summary: Generative models often suffer from mode collapse and limited sample diversity. While prior works attempt to mitigate this by jointly generating a batch of samples and repelling their trajectories, these heuristics do not explicitly maximize the diversity of the resulting endpoints. We introduce JIVE, a training-free framework that enhances generative diversity by injecting velocity perturbations aligned with the leading right singular subspace of the generator's endpoint Jacobian. By leveraging this local geometric structure, JIVE provably maximizes endpoint diversity while preserving sample quality. To maintain practical efficiency, we compute these perturbation directions via matrix-free iterations rooted in classical numerical linear algebra, requiring only a small computational overhead. Across different benchmarks, JIVE boosts both pixel and feature-level diversity in few-step and one-step generation.

AI.tldr: JIVE：一种无需训练的生成框架，通过注入与生成器端点雅可比主右奇异子空间对齐的速度扰动，显式最大化生成端点多样性，且计算开销小。
AI.motivation: 生成模型常出现模式坍塌和样本多样性不足；现有通过批量联合生成并排斥轨迹的启发式方法并未显式最大化生成端点的多样性。
AI.method: JIVE在生成器的端点雅可比的主右奇异子空间方向上注入速度扰动，利用局部几何结构。为保持效率，采用基于经典数值线性代数的免矩阵迭代计算扰动方向，仅带来很小计算开销。
AI.result: 方法可证明能在保持样本质量的同时最大化端点多样性；在多个基准上提升了少步和单步生成中的像素级与特征级多样性。
AI.conclusion: JIVE是一种免训练、高效且理论可证的生成多样性增强框架，适用于少步及单步生成场景。

title: Applying Language Models in medical Medicine: Recent Trends and Perspectives
comment: 7 pages, aimed to be a blogpost of the current state of the medical LLM field
summary: The use and applicability of artificial intelligence (AI) in medical research and clinical practice has received increasing attention in the literature over recent years. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has expanded discussions in regards to applications of AI within healthcare. While traditional deep learning based AI applications in medicine have often focused on specific and defined tasks, LLMs offer broader capabilities and flexibility in working with available data,. At the same time of writing, the integration of LLMs into medical settings raises important questions regarding their reliability, accuracy, transparency, safety, and appropriate role in a medical setting. This text presents and discusses recent talks and articles concerning the application of LLMs in medicine, with particular emphasis on their potential utility in research and clinical practice. It considers both the opportunities offered by these technologies and the challenges associated with their implementation, aiming to provide a perspective on the current and emerging role of LLMs within the medical field.

AI.tldr: 本文综述并讨论了大型语言模型（LLM）在医学研究与临床实践中的应用，涵盖其机遇与挑战。
AI.motivation: AI在医学中的关注度上升，LLM的出现拓展了医疗应用讨论；相比传统聚焦特定任务的深度学习AI，LLM具备更强灵活性与能力，但其融入医疗场景带来可靠性、准确性、透明度、安全性及角色定位等关键问题。
AI.method: 采用观点/综述性写作，梳理并讨论近期有关LLM在医学中应用的演讲与文章，重点关注其在研究与临床实践中的潜在效用。
AI.result: 总结了LLM在医学应用上的机会与实施挑战两方面内容（摘要未给出具体实证结果）。
AI.conclusion: 旨在提供关于LLM在医学领域当前与新兴角色的视角性认识。

title: When Text Matters: Design Principles for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Model
summary: Visual token pruning has been widely studied as a practical approach to reducing the computational cost of large vision-language models. However, it struggles to preserve essential visual information, which can lead to substantial performance degradation. In particular, image-based token selection can overlook task-relevant details, while text-guided token selection may fail to capture the text--visual relationships needed for complex reasoning. We find that applying textual guidance too early can limit its ability to identify answer-relevant visual regions, whereas text-to-visual attention becomes more informative at intermediate decoder depths. This finding motivates our training-free method, which separates early vision-guided pruning from deferred text-guided reselection. We first prune visual tokens using vision-encoder attention, retain additional candidates until the decoder midpoint, and then use text-to-visual attention to determine the final visual-token set. Across eight benchmarks and three models, our method outperforms the best-performing baselines by an average of 11.10 and 16.84 percentage points in performance recovery at 80% and 90% pruning, respectively, with comparable or lower LLM-prefill latency than most baselines.
