Across six retrospective cohorts - four dengue (N = 1000, 1523, 989, 1018), malaria (N = 2190), and influenza (N = 4569) - a uniform, label-free, cohort-fitted K = 2 protocol yielded positive-class F1 scores of 0.996, 0.634, 0.936, 0.917, 0.695, and 0.842, and all-record accuracies of 0.996, 0.558, 0.914, 0.893, 0.707, and 0.906, respectively, with full partition-decision coverage using the frozen package and disease-specific knowledge representations. Neither scoring nor clustering uses outcome labels. Logistic regression provides a supervised baseline. Influenza incorporates confirmatory molecular PCR and is not independent pre-test prediction. Results characterize knowledge-grounded evidence separation, auditability, and sensitivity, not prospective clinical validity or comparative superiority. FOL/LLM-based clinical explanation remains unevaluated.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的CKG Reasoner诊断范式，将患者观测映射到显式医学知识，通过证据特征节点、信息门控与知识加权证据累积进行候选排序，并独立于结果标签用K-means聚类。在6个队列（登革热、疟疾、流感）上取得不同F1与准确率，且全程不使用结果标签。
AI.motivation: 现有临床预测系统多依赖学习"患者-变量-结局"关联，缺乏对显式医学知识的利用、可审计性与可解释性。作者希望探索一种无需训练、将患者观测直接映射到显式医学知识的诊断范式。
AI.method: CKG Reasoner整合候选特异证据特征节点、患者-参考匹配、有界信息门控、知识加权证据累积、疾病相似度与决定性临床规则；采用缺失感知归一化与覆盖率审计区分"缺失"与"不可用"证据。候选排序与结果标签无关，K-means聚类基于4个派生证据坐标（证据强度、相对幅度、方向相似性、证据完整性），而非原始预测因子或目标。采用统一、无标签、队列拟合的K=2协议。
AI.result: 在6个回顾性队列取得正类F1：登革热0.996/0.634/0.936/0.917，疟疾0.695，流感0.842；全记录准确率依次为0.996/0.558/0.914/0.893/0.707/0.906，并实现完整分区决策覆盖。Logistic回归作监督基线；流感含分子PCR确证，非独立预检预测。
AI.conclusion: 结果阐释了知识驱动的证据分离、可审计性与敏感性，而非前瞻性临床有效性或对比优越性。基于FOL/LLM的临床解释尚未评估。

title: W2Rep: Learning Visual Representations by Watching the World Change
summary: Images capture the world at one moment, whereas video reveals how it changes. Image self-supervision learns spatial structure from a single moment, while video methods commonly learn temporal relationships inside a representation computed jointly from several frames. We ask whether watching a scene change can instead improve features available from one image without sacrificing the ability to represent video. We introduce W2Rep, a masked feature-prediction framework in which an independently encoded source image participates in prediction at the same or another moment. The predictor is conditioned on visible video context, the queried location, and the signed time interval between source and target. This gives the cross-frame objective two complementary roles: the image path learns features that remain useful across time, while the video path must gather evidence that is missing from the source image. Across model scales and downstream tasks, W2Rep improves frozen and fine-tuned recognition under our comparison protocol, while joint video encoding provides further gains over frame-wise aggregation. Controlled experiments show that these gains depend on directly updating the source-image features and on using both video context and temporal displacement. Overall, change across a video can supervise a visual encoder whose representations remain useful at either image or video granularity. Code is available at~\href{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 W2Rep，一个掩码特征预测框架：将独立编码的源图像引入预测过程，并让预测器以可见视频上下文、查询位置及带符号时间间隔为条件，使视频中的变化能监督一个在图像或视频粒度上都有效的编码器。
AI.motivation: 图像自监督学习单帧的空间结构，而视频方法通常仅在多帧联合表示的内部学习时序关系。作者希望探索：观看场景变化能否反过来提升单张图像的特征，同时不牺牲表示视频的能力。
AI.method: W2Rep 采用掩码特征预测框架，源图像被独立编码并结合到同一时刻或另一时刻的预测中。预测器以可见视频上下文、查询位置和源-目标间的带符号时间间隔为条件，从而让跨帧目标具备双重作用：图像路径学到跨时间仍有效的特征，视频路径则必须收集源图像中缺失的证据。
AI.result: 在不同模型规模和下游任务上，W2Rep 在统一比较协议下提升了冻结和微调的识别性能；联合视频编码相比逐帧聚合带来进一步收益。受控实验表明，这些提升依赖于直接更新源图像特征，以及对视频上下文和时间位移的共同使用。
AI.conclusion: 视频中的变化可以作为监督信号训练视觉编码器，使其表示在图像或视频粒度上都保持有效。代码已开源。

title: Broken Symmetry in BF16 Attention: Why FlashAttention Gradients Blow Up Late in Training
summary: BF16 is now standard in large-scale pretraining, including in fused attention kernels such as FlashAttention, and these kernels are widely trusted. When we used FlashAttention-3 to pretrain a 450M-parameter transformer on 50B tokens, however, we ran into a problem: training was healthy for 25B tokens, then the gradient norm grew a thousandfold and the loss ended 0.2 nats above FP32 attention, without a single NaN. Recomputing the attention backward of just two layers in FP32 removes almost all of the excess gradient. Part of the cause is known: a fused multiply-add in the forward softmax, so far treated as an extreme-input NaN case and never fixed in FlashAttention-3. Repairing it stops the blow-up, but the query gradient is still wrong by more than its own size, and training still drives attention logits to thousands of times their size under accurate gradients. The remaining error comes from a broken conservation law. The softmax score gradient sums to zero along every row, which makes the query gradient blind to where the keys sit as a group; rounding it to BF16 leaves a small nonzero sum that leaks the mean key into the gradient, and the leak grows exactly as late training makes keys large and attention sharp. We introduce GProj (gauge projection), which restores the zero sum after the cast with two rank-one corrections per row. It cuts the remaining median query/key gradient errors from 219%/13% to 0.34%/0.37%, on par with FP32 attention, for 4.7% more time per training step. In matched from-scratch runs it trains to the same loss as FP32 attention, while FlashAttention-3 and key smoothing both destabilize.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示FlashAttention-3在BF16训练中因softmax梯度守恒律被破坏导致query/key梯度误差，提出GProj修复，恢复精度且训练稳定。
AI.motivation: BF16已知在极端输入下有NaN问题，但作者发现即使无NaN，训练仍会梯度爆炸、loss偏高，其根因未被修复，需系统诊断。
AI.method: 分析融合attention在BF16下的误差来源：前向softmax的融合乘加问题，以及softmax分数梯度沿行求和应为零的守恒律被BF16舍入破坏。提出GProj（gauge projection），在cast后每行用两次秩一修正恢复零和。
AI.result: GProj将query/key梯度中位误差从219%/13%降至0.34%/0.37%，接近FP32注意力，训练步耗时仅增加4.7%；从头训练达到与FP32 attention相同loss，而FlashAttention-3和key smoothing均不稳定。
AI.conclusion: BF16融合attention存在被忽视的守恒律破坏问题，GProj能以极小开销修复，使大规模预训练稳定且与FP32精度对齐。

title: Narrowing the Horizon: Quantifying Topic Saliency Shifts in Generative Monoculture
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to how we access and share information, they play an increasingly powerful role in shaping global knowledge. However, as these models evolve, their outputs risk converging into a \textit{generative monoculture}, where the diversity of perspectives they represent narrows over time. Studies at the model level often fail to pinpoint which specific topics or viewpoints are being marginalised or amplified in this process. In this paper, we introduce a method to measure shifts in topic saliency across model families, tracking what gains or loses prominence during post-training. Applying this approach to a case study of climate change discourse, we demonstrate how homogenisation affects the representation of diverse solutions across different models. We also test interventions to counter this trend, showing that specialised models can help preserve a broader range of perspectives. This underscores the importance of monitoring topic saliency to diagnose the risks of monoculture and to ensure AI systems reflect a pluralism of ideas. Data and Code are accessible \href{https://github.com/oriane/topic_saliency_shift}{here}.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种衡量模型家族间主题显著性变化的方法，用于诊断LLM的"生成单一文化"现象，并以气候变化话语为例验证。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM成为信息获取与传播的核心，其输出存在向"生成单一文化"收敛的风险，即观点多样性逐渐收窄。现有模型层面的研究难以定位具体哪些主题或观点被边缘化或被放大。
AI.method: 提出一种度量方法，追踪后训练过程中不同模型家族间主题显著性的变化（哪些主题获得或失去突出地位）。以气候变化话语为案例，比较不同模型对多元解决方案的表征。
AI.result: 展示了同质化如何影响不同模型对多元解决方案的呈现；并通过干预实验表明，专业化模型有助于保留更广泛的观点。
AI.conclusion: 监测主题显著性对于诊断单一文化风险、确保AI系统反映观念多元性至关重要。数据与代码已开源。

title: Handwritten Text Recognition Lives in the High-Pixel Variance Subspace
comment: Accepted at 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: In self-supervised pretraining for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), pixel reconstruction methods outperform contrastive methods, unlike in natural-image classification. We argue that this difference follows from where discriminative signal lies in pixel space: for HTR, it is concentrated in high-variance directions and largely absent from low-variance ones. This predicts that objectives preserving high-variance pixel content will transfer best. We test six SSL methods from three families (pixel-grounded MIM, JEPA, and contrastive) under matched encoder, data, and evaluation protocols on six handwriting benchmarks across five languages. With full labels, pixel-groundrounded SSL achieves the lowest CER on every benchmark and both frozen probes, exposes per-position character information that other families recover only through the readout, and is the only family to benefit from pretraining on real handwriting. Pixel-grounded representations are also more label efficient. Across datasets, encoder alignment with the high-variance pixel subspace predicts CER within every method. With a pretrained LLM decoder, a frozen pixel-grounded encoder is competitive with fully fine-tuned supervised baselines; full fine-tuning achieves the lowest mean CER and ranks first or second on every benchmark. These results show that the value of pixel reconstruction depends on where discriminative signal lies in the input.

AI.tldr: 在手写文本识别(HTR)中，像素重建式自监督预训练优于对比式方法，原因是判别信号集中在高方差像素方向；实验证明像素接地方法在六个基准上CER最低、标签效率最高。
AI.motivation: 自然图像分类中对比方法常优于像素重建，但HTR中相反。作者假设这一差异源于判别信号在像素空间中的分布：HTR的判别信号集中于高方差方向，低方差方向几乎缺失。因此预测保留高方差像素内容的目标函数迁移效果最好。
AI.method: 在匹配的编码器、数据和评测协议下，比较三大类六种SSL方法：像素接地的掩码图像建模(MIM)、JEPA、对比学习，覆盖五种语言的六个手写基准。分析编码器与高方差像素子空间的对齐程度与CER的关系，并使用预训练LLM解码器进行评测。
AI.result: 有全标签时，像素接地SSL在每个基准和两种冻结探针下CER最低，暴露逐位置字符信息，是唯一能从真实手写数据预训练中获益的家族，且标签效率更高。编码器与高方差像素子空间的对齐度可预测各方法的CER。配合预训练LLM解码器，冻结的像素接地编码器可与全微调监督基线竞争；全微调达到最低平均CER。
AI.conclusion: 像素重建的价值取决于判别信号在输入中的位置；HTR中信号集中于高方差像素方向，因此像素接地SSL表现最优。这为理解不同SSL家族在HTR与自然图像任务中的差异提供了统一解释。

title: Direct Self-Evolving Optimization: Evolving LLMs without Challenger Training
summary: Self-evolving language models improve by generating tasks and learning from their own feedback, but adapting the task generator often requires a separate challenger-training loop. Can we generate tasks adapted to the current solver without explicitly training a challenger? We introduce \textbf{D}irect Self-\textbf{E}volving \textbf{O}ptimization (DEO), which replaces challenger parameter updates with solver-guided task sampling. The KL-regularized challenger objective defines an exponential tilt of a fixed base task distribution. DEO uses this distribution as a sampling target: a frozen LLM generates and mutates tasks, the solver scores them, and an approximate Metropolis selection rule refines the training pool. Only the solver is trained. Theoretically, for an idealized variant that samples exactly from the tilted distribution, and under regularity, local gradient-dominance, and initialization conditions, we show that DEO learns distributionally robust reasoning ability. In experiments, DEO achieves reasoning performance competitive with R-Zero while using over $50\%$ less wall-clock training time, and improves reasoning accuracy over a no-walk ablation. Replacing the task generator with a frozen API-only LLM further improves the local solver, illustrating a capability enabled by removing challenger training.

AI.tldr: 提出DEO（Direct Self-Evolving Optimization），用求解器引导的任务采样替代挑战者参数更新，仅训练求解器即可实现自演化语言模型，节省50%以上训练时间且性能具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 自演化语言模型通过生成任务并从自身反馈学习来提升能力，但适配任务生成器通常需要单独的挑战者训练循环，成本高昂。作者希望在不显式训练挑战者的情况下生成适配当前求解器的任务。
AI.method: DEO将KL正则化的挑战者目标视为固定基础任务分布的指数倾斜(exponential tilt)。用一个冻结LLM生成并变异任务，求解器为其打分，并通过近似Metropolis选择规则精炼训练池，仅训练求解器。理论上针对精确采样倾斜分布的理想变体，在正则性、局部梯度占优和初始化条件下证明其学习到分布鲁棒推理能力。
AI.result: DEO在推理性能上与R-Zero相当，但使用的墙钟训练时间减少超过50%；相比无walk消融实验，推理准确率有所提升。用仅API的冻结LLM替换任务生成器可进一步提升本地求解器。
AI.conclusion: 移除挑战者训练是可行且有效的，DEO在无需显式训练挑战者的前提下实现了自演化优化，兼具效率与性能优势，并展示了冻结API模型作为生成器的额外能力。

title: Reliability Engineering for AI Systems: Challenges, Methods, and Directions
summary: AI reliability concerns whether an AI system performs its intended function dependably over a stated period and under stated operating conditions, with stated evidence. As these systems become more autonomous, that function includes more than a correct output. Retrieval, memory, tool use, permissions, human oversight, and interactions among systems must operate consistently and safely, and, for generative systems, so must the reasoning process that produces the output. Average benchmark accuracy measures capability; it does not quantify this broader reliability claim. This paper adapts established reliability engineering methods, from failure definitions and operational envelopes to FMEA, accelerated testing, field monitoring, and reliability growth, to AI systems. A four-level diagnostic framework classifies failures as component, operational-loop, agentic-conduct, or network and governance failures. Test, evaluation, verification, and validation (TEVV), sequential monitoring, and FRACAS create and refresh evidence. SMART provides statistical guidance for measurement, analysis, assessment, and test planning; the NIST AI Risk Management Framework provides organizational guidance for governance, evaluation, monitoring, and mitigation. Three cases illustrate the program: adversarial testing of a convolutional neural network, perception-error propagation, and autonomous-vehicle disengagements. Established reliability engineering provides a usable foundation; new measurements and safety guardrails are still needed as these systems are self-evolving.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将传统可靠性工程方法适配到AI系统，提出四级故障诊断框架及配套的测试、监控与治理流程，以量化AI更广义的可靠性。
AI.motivation: AI系统日益自主化，其可靠性不只等于输出正确，还涉及检索、记忆、工具使用、权限、人类监督及系统间交互等。平均基准准确率只衡量能力，无法量化这种更广义的可靠性主张，因此需要建立可靠性工程视角。
AI.method: 把既有可靠性工程方法（故障定义、运行包络、FMEA、加速测试、现场监控、可靠性增长）迁移到AI。提出四级故障诊断框架，将故障分为组件级、运行环路级、智能体行为级、网络与治理级；用TEVV、序贯监控与FRACAS生成并更新证据；以SMART提供测量、分析、评估与测试规划的统计指导，以NIST AI风险管理框架提供组织治理、评估、监控与缓解指导。用三个案例说明该方案：卷积神经网络的对抗测试、感知错误传播、自动驾驶脱管。
AI.result: 通过三个案例展示了框架的适用性：CNN对抗测试、感知错误传播与自动驾驶脱管场景均可纳入该可靠性诊断与证据体系。
AI.conclusion: 既有可靠性工程为AI可靠性提供了可用基础，但由于AI系统具有自演化特性，仍需新的测量方法与安全护栏。

title: AHMAD: Adaptive Hybrid Multi-task Vision Learning with Assisted Distillation for Keypoint Detection
summary: Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning. However, handling diverse vision tasks -- spanning dense and sparse predictions -- remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures. In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection. Our approach incorporates these five tasks into a unified structure: a shared encoder-decoder with several lightweight task-specific projectors. Under the multitask learning paradigm, we observed a complementary performance gain, achieving a state-of-the-art PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO-val panoptic and semantic segmentation, respectively. Additionally, for top-down keypoint detection, which typically incurs high computational overhead due to multiple forward passes, we introduce a knowledge distillation-based method that enables a single forward pass over the entire image, greatly improving efficiency. Ultimately, our model delivers a lightweight yet effective generalist multitask learning framework, demonstrating strong performance across five vision tasks.

AI.tldr: AHMAD 提出统一框架，用共享编解码器加轻量任务投影器整合五类视觉任务，实现互补性能提升并大幅提高关键点检测效率。
AI.motivation: 多任务通用视觉模型面临密集与稀疏预测任务输出结构差异大的挑战，难以在单一框架中高效学习。
AI.method: 统一结构：共享编码器-解码器加多个轻量任务专用投影器，整合语义分割、实例分割、深度估计、关键点检测和物体检测；并对top-down关键点检测引入知识蒸馏，实现整图单次前向传播。
AI.result: 在多任务学习下取得互补性能增益，COCO-val全景分割PQ达53.1，语义分割mIoU达66.5；关键点检测效率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: AHMAD 提供轻量且有效的通用多任务学习框架，在五项视觉任务上均展现强性能。

title: Agentic High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization with Hypothesis- and Evidence-Guided Search
summary: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization (HDBO) seeks sample-efficient optimization when the number of variables is large relative to the evaluation budget. Recent LLM-based and agentic BO methods incorporate task knowledge and adapt search decisions during a run, but have primarily been evaluated on low- and moderate-dimensional problems. We ask whether this paradigm can transfer to the higher-dimensional regime. Our experiments show that these methods do not remain reliable in the high-dimensional regime, where the challenge is not only where to evaluate, but also which modeling assumption and search geometry to use when the objective's useful structure is unknown. We therefore introduce HERA, a Hypothesis- and Evidence-guided Research Agent that uses task context, optimization feedback, and structural diagnostics to revise search hypotheses, select and configure HDBO strategies, and determine their execution length. PRISM, its numerical optimization engine, generates and evaluates candidates sequentially within each search block, updating numerical models after each observation. HERA remains competitive with strong numerical HDBO baselines and outperforms the evaluated LLM-based and agentic methods on four metadata-free synthetic functions. Across eight real-world tasks, HERA achieves the best mean final objective among all evaluated systems on most benchmarks. Further analyses show that structural diagnostics change strategy use, metadata effects vary across tasks, and adaptive search blocks reduce inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出HERA，一种基于假设与证据引导的研究智能体，将LLM/智能体BO范式扩展到高维贝叶斯优化，并在合成与真实任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM与智能体BO方法主要在低维、中维问题上评估，在高维场景下不可靠；此时不仅需要决定在哪评估，还需在目标结构未知时选择合适的建模假设与搜索几何。
AI.method: HERA利用任务上下文、优化反馈和结构诊断来修订搜索假设、选择并配置HDBO策略、决定执行长度；其数值优化引擎PRISM在每个搜索块内顺序生成与评估候选，并在每次观测后更新数值模型。
AI.result: 在四个无元数据合成函数上与强数值HDBO基线相当，并优于所评估的LLM/智能体方法；在八个真实任务中，HERA在多数基准上取得最佳平均最终目标值。分析还显示结构诊断会改变策略使用、元数据效应因任务而异、自适应搜索块可降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: HERA表明智能体式BO范式可迁移到高维情形，通过结构诊断与自适应策略配置有效应对未知结构，兼具性能与成本优势。

title: Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero
summary: Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach through code evolution; ii) a hyper agent progressively modifies the task agent and itself to provide open-ended design behavior; iii) the evolved MetaBBO codebase is evaluated and all in-execution information is fed back to the agents for recursive self-referential improvement. As a result, given a naive MetaBBO template, our framework automates a design evolution and finds novel variants superior to up-to-date human-made MetaBBO baselines. Surprisingly, the experimental results also demonstrate that our framework supports fast adaption across different optimization domains. Solid interpretation analysis further reveals interesting design principles emerge in such open-ended process. This work serves as the first exploration on automating design of complex learning-assisted optimization algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出双智能体框架，将MetaBBO的设计循环视为编码任务，利用递归自我改进的编码智能体实现自动化算法设计，生成超越人类基线的MetaBBO变体，并支持跨域快速适配。
AI.motivation: 现有MetaBBO虽提升了优化系统性能下界，但其设计需针对不同优化问题人工定制，引入主观性，限制了性能上界与实际可用性，亟需自动化设计方法。
AI.method: 将MetaBBO设计循环视为编码任务，提出双智能体框架：(i) 任务智能体通过代码进化持续改进目标MetaBBO方法代码库；(ii) 超智能体逐步修改任务智能体及自身，提供开放式设计行为；(iii) 对进化后的代码库进行评估，并将执行信息反馈给智能体以实现递归自我改进。
AI.result: 给定朴素MetaBBO模板，框架自动完成设计演化并发现优于当前人工MetaBBO基线的新变体；实验还表明框架支持跨不同优化域的快速适配，解释性分析揭示了涌现的设计原则。本工作首次探索复杂学习辅助优化算法的自动化设计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将开放式递归自我改进引入MetaBBO设计，实现自动化算法演化，性能超越人类基线且具备跨域适配能力，为学习辅助优化算法的自动设计开辟新方向。

title: From Scores to Samples: Elastic Forcing for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需score模型的少步自回归视频生成后训练框架，直接在参考视频上学习rollout分布，用MMD在冻结自监督表示空间中匹配，1.3B模型VBench从83.80提升至84.64，保持17FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成依赖DMD，需要双向扩散teacher和在线fake-score模型，成本高且限制规模。作者希望消除这些score模型，直接从参考视频学习rollout分布。
AI.method: 在冻结自监督视频表示空间中最小化MMD，采用混合Nyström-Monte Carlo估计器平衡近似偏差与采样方差；通过内存高效replay和梯度子采样使目标可行。
AI.result: 与Self-Forcing同架构同初始化的1.3B模型，VBench Total从83.80升至84.64，保持17FPS；去除score模型后可在8块H200上做14B后训练。
AI.conclusion: 无需score模型即可蒸馏，并能从参考视频获取新视觉风格、语义概念和空间先验，无需目标特定扩散teacher。

title: Epistemic Learning from Imprecise Annotation
summary: Imprecise annotations may support several plausible labelling distributions, yet learning methods often resolve this ambiguity into a single predictive distribution. This can obscure what the annotation evidence leaves unresolved. We introduce epistemic learning from credal supervision, a framework that uses convex sets of plausible labelling distributions, called credal sets, as supervision and learns sets of predictive distributions. We instantiate the framework with the pessimistic--optimistic credal classifier (POCC), which combines a shared backbone with two classification heads trained to minimise worst-case and best-case losses over the supervision sets. Their outputs define a predictive credal set whose spread provides an uncertainty score. We also show how credal labels can be obtained through a simple relaxation of existing probabilistic labels, reducing commitment to their precise probability assignments. This construction admits closed-form inner optimisation under cross-entropy loss, enabling efficient training. Assuming the supervision sets contain the true conditional label distributions, and other regularity assumptions, we establish a finite-sample generalisation bound for the averaged predictor with an explicit penalty for supervision imprecision. We evaluate POCC using human annotator disagreement and teacher predictions, alongside label smoothing as a controlled proxy for annotation imprecision. Across these settings, POCC achieves a favourable balance of predictive accuracy, calibration, and uncertainty-based selective classification versus competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出"credal监督下的认知学习"框架，用凸集（credal集）作为监督，学习预测分布集合，并以POCC实例化，在准确率、校准和选择性分类上取得较好平衡。
AI.motivation: 不精确标注本可对应多个合理的标签分布，但现有学习方法常将这种模糊性压缩为单一预测分布，从而掩盖了标注证据本身未解决的部分。
AI.method: 用可信集（凸的合理标签分布集合）作为监督来学习预测分布集合；实例化POCC：共享骨干网络加两个分类头，分别最小化监督集上的最坏情况与最好情况损失，其输出构成预测可信集，其广度作为不确定性度量。credal标签可由概率标签简单松弛得到，交叉熵下内层优化有闭式解，训练高效。
AI.result: 在监督集包含真实条件标签分布等正则假设下，为平均预测器建立有限样本泛化界，并显式包含监督不精确性惩罚项。在人类标注者分歧、教师预测及标签平滑代理实验中，POCC在预测准确率、校准和基于不确定性的选择性分类上相较竞争基线取得有利平衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过可信集监督学习预测分布集合，可显式保留标注模糊性并量化不确定性，POCC是有效且可高效训练的实例，兼具理论与实证优势。

title: TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving
summary: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TMCS，一种工具接地的多智能体推理框架，将化学问题求解形式化为可解释的工作流，在多项化学任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM在计算化学中虽具潜力，但严格的组合化学问题仍困难，因为需要定量约束的分子修改、候选验证及失败后的系统修订。现有工具增强化学智能体虽能规划和使用工具，但缺乏统一循环来实现性质驱动的分子优化与工作流级组合。
AI.method: 提出TMCS（Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving），逐步多智能体框架。任务层面：专用智能体利用外部工具、少样本轨迹记忆与结构化反思迭代优化解。工作流层面：将生成、理解、编辑、描述与优化串联为闭环流水线。
AI.result: 在多个化学任务上的评测表明，TMCS在开源与闭源基座模型上均持续提升化学推理能力，达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: TMCS通过工具接地的多智能体闭环工作流，有效增强了化学推理，验证了工作流级组合与工具增强对复杂化学问题求解的价值。

title: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models. Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source. In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question. To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered. The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details. Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools. The memory tree and prior question--answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter. We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings. Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.

AI.tldr: 提出Sprout智能体框架，边推理边构建记忆，用时序树在线动态构建视频记忆，降低成本并保持/提升长视频问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解采用"先构建记忆再推理"的离线流程：问题少时构建整段视频记忆开销远大于答题本身；问题多时记忆从不对更新，答题中获得的经验无法传递给后续问题。长视频通常被多个问题共享，导致这一流程两端都很昂贵。
AI.method: Sprout以低帧率逐段观看视频，当当前问题可被回答时停止；将每段记为树的粗节点，重访关键区间并以高帧率细化出详细节点。段一旦转成文本，其视频输入即从上下文历史中移除，但原视频仍可通过视频工具访问。记忆树与历史问答记录跨问题持久化，从第一个问题起构建、由后续每个问题更新。
AI.result: 将累积的视频输入替换为文本记忆，显著降低上下文占用且保持准确率，部分设置下略有提升。在三个模型的多个基准上，Sprout相对代表性离线记忆方法取得有竞争力或更好的准确率，且无前置构建阶段、每问上下文成本更低。
AI.conclusion: Sprout验证了在线、动态、边推理边构建记忆的可行性，兼顾准确率与效率，为多问题共享长视频场景提供了更优方案。

title: One Sequence, Many Decodings: CAGenMol-2 Recasts Drug Design as Masked Molecular Inference
summary: Drug design couples property evaluation, conditional generation, structure-based design, and local optimization, yet machine learning systems typically address these capabilities with separate task-specific models. We introduce CAGenMol-2, a masked diffusion molecular language model that represents molecules, continuous scalar properties, and 3D protein pockets within a single wrapped sequence. Within this pretrained interface, downstream operations are selected by which sequence regions are observed or masked at inference, allowing one checkpoint to perform property prediction, property- and pocket-conditioned generation, and partial-constraint design without task-specific architectures or backbone fine-tuning. We further propose Adaptive Fragment Optimization (AdaFO), a gradient-free mask-and-refill search that turns the masked decoder into an iterative local molecular optimizer. On CrossDocked2020, AdaFO increases Success Rate from 30.2\% to 70.8\%, the best reported under this protocol, while largely preserving drug-likeness and diversity. Finally, scaffold-preserving directional editing and CRBN/VHL case studies demonstrate its use in compound design workflows spanning local molecular editing, structure-based prioritization, and downstream simulation-based screening.

AI.tldr: 提出CAGenMol-2掩码扩散分子语言模型，用统一序列表示分子、连续性质与3D口袋，通过观察/掩码序列区域切换下游任务；并引入无梯度AdaFO局部优化方法。
AI.motivation: 药物设计涉及性质评估、条件生成、基于结构的设计和局部优化，但机器学习通常用各自独立的任务专用模型处理这些能力，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: CAGenMol-2：将分子、连续标量性质和3D蛋白口袋编码进单一包裹序列的掩码扩散分子语言模型；推理时通过选择观察或掩码的序列区域激活不同下游操作（性质预测、性质/口袋条件生成、部分约束设计），无需任务专用架构或骨干微调；提出无梯度掩码-填充搜索AdaFO，将掩码解码器转为迭代局部分子优化器。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked2020上，AdaFO将成功率从30.2%提升至70.8%，为该协议下最佳报告结果，同时大体保持成药性和多样性；骨架保持的方向编辑及CRBN/VHL案例研究展示了其在局部编辑、基于结构优先级排序及下游模拟筛选中的应用。
AI.conclusion: 单一掩码扩散语言模型接口可统一多种药物设计能力，AdaFO有效实现局部优化并显著提升成功率，具备实际化合物设计工作流中的应用价值。

title: Jev thinks "I don't know'', but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration
summary:
The appearance of Jev marked the era of System One Models, foundation models that return structured decisions with probability distributions rather than text. Aside from low cost and great speed, Jev's central promise is that these probabilities are calibrated: such claim is not backed by any public test and available external benchmarks evaluate confidence calibration, not whether every returned option probability has the right numerical meaning. To tackle this issue, we introduce Sys1Cal-v1, a dataset of True/False questions about a proposition $A$ for which the exact probability $P(A)$ is known by construction. Each item is queried through the three Jev primitives - Noul, Choice and Score - and evaluated by total variation distance from the ground-truth distribution, which can be used to estimate a soft accuracy of System One Models.
  We showcase the utility of Sys1Cal-v1 as a benchmark dataset by evaluating Jev and SemIf, an open-source Choice-style baseline. In this work, however, we focus even more deeply on Jev, by studying the calibration of its Score and Choice answers. In particular, we discover a peculiar behaviour that can be explained by assuming that Jev suppresses a third truth value, going beyond True and False. In other words, in 	exttt{Choice} answers, $P(A)$ and $P(
eg A)$ are presented as if $P(A)+P(
eg A)=1$, while a term $P(U)
eq0$ is missing in the sum. Recovering $P(U)$ leads to an improvement of median soft accuracy in 	exttt{Choice} answers from $0.771$ to $0.978$, suggesting that, even in binary decisions, Jev wants to answer with a third option:``I don't know''.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sys1Cal-v1 数据集，用已知真实概率的 True/False 问题评估 System One 模型（Jev）的概率校准，发现其 Choice 回答隐含被抑制的第三真值 P(U)，恢复后中位软准确率从 0.771 提升至 0.978。
AI.motivation: Jev 等 System One 模型声称返回的概率分布是校准的，但该声明缺乏公开测试；现有外部基准只评估置信度校准，而非每个选项概率的数值意义是否正确。
AI.method: 构建 Sys1Cal-v1：对命题 A 的 True/False 问题，其真实概率 P(A) 由构造已知；通过 Jev 的 Noul、Choice、Score 三种原语查询，并用与真实分布的总变差距离评估，可估计模型的软准确率。以 Jev 和开源基线 SemIf 进行评测。
AI.result: 发现 Jev 存在特殊行为：Choice 回答中 P(A)+P(¬A) 被当作 1，但遗漏了非零的 P(U)；恢复 P(U) 后，Choice 的中位软准确率由 0.771 提升到 0.978。
AI.conclusion: 即使在二元决策中，Jev 也倾向于给出第三个选项“我不知道”，说明其概率输出经过第三真值的抑制，Sys1Cal-v1 能有效揭示并量化这一问题。

title: SolveEdit: Benchmarking Visual Problem Solving in Generative Models
summary: Machine intelligence is often evaluated through abstract reasoning problems, yet many real-world problems are visual, such as arranging objects, repairing layouts, or tracing routes. Solving these problems requires understanding a scene, inferring what must change to achieve a goal, and realizing that change without disturbing unrelated content. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate perception, generation, or explicitly specified transformations, leaving goal-driven visual problem solving underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SolveEpIT, a benchmark for visual problem solving through scene transformation. Given an image and a goal, a model must infer a valid transformation from the request, the scene, or a visually expressed rule, then execute it while preserving unrelated content. SoLvEEDrr contains 2,728 cases. Atomic transition contracts specify required and protected conditions, enabling SoLvEScoRE to measure completion and unintended changes without a single reference output. The strongest evaluated model achieves only57.0% SolvEScore. We further introduce SolveEdiT-PLAN, a two-stage visual planner that instantiates the transition before generation. Under matched single-generation evaluation, it improves SoLvEScoRE by 9.1 points on average across three tested generators, including a gain from 57.0% to 71.6% for GPT-Image-2, without modifying the editor.

AI.tldr: 提出 SolveEpIT 基准，评估通过场景变换进行目标驱动的视觉问题求解，并给出两阶段规划器 SolveEdiT-PLAN。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评估感知、生成或明确指定的变换，未充分探索目标驱动的视觉问题求解（需理解场景、推断目标所需变化并在不破坏无关内容下实现变化）。
AI.method: 构建 SolveEpIT 基准，含 2,728 个案例；用原子转移契约（atomic transition contracts）规定必需与保护条件，提出 SoLvEScore 无需单一参考输出即可衡量完成度与意外改动；另提出两阶段视觉规划器 SolveEdiT-PLAN，先生成转移再生成图像。
AI.result: 最强评估模型仅达 57.0% SoLvEScore；SolveEdiT-PLAN 在三种生成器上平均提升 9.1 分，其中 GPT-Image-2 从 57.0% 提升至 71.6%（不修改编辑器）。
AI.conclusion: 目标驱动的视觉问题求解仍具挑战；先实例化转移的两阶段规划可显著提升场景变换完成度并减少无关改动。

title: Riemannian Difference-of-Convex Optimization for K-Means Clustering
summary: K-means is a widely adopted clustering approach in signal processing and machine learning. In this paper, we study K-means clustering through a cardinality-constrained formulation on a compact embedded submanifold. We replace the cardinality constraint with a difference-of-convex (DC) penalty and establish a global error bound to prove that the penalized and constrained formulations share the same global minimizers whenever the penalty parameter exceeds a finite threshold. To solve the resulting nonsmooth Riemannian DC problem, we reformulate it as a minimax problem and propose RADA-DC, a Riemannian alternating descent ascent method combining dual regularization with DC linearization. Under standard assumptions and suitable parameter choices, RADA-DC finds an $ε$-Riemannian critical point within $O(ε^{-3})$ iterations. We conduct experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets to demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the tested baselines, including K-means++, in solution quality at competitive computational cost when the number of clusters is large.

AI.tldr: 本文在紧嵌入子流形上研究基数约束的K-means聚类，用DC罚替代基数约束，提出黎曼交替下降上升算法RADA-DC，并给出O(ε^{-3})收敛性保证。
AI.motivation: K-means在信号处理与机器学习中广泛使用，但传统方法存在局限。作者希望在紧嵌入子流形上通过基数约束形式化K-means，并解决约束形式带来的非凸、非光滑难题。
AI.method: 将基数约束替换为DC（凸差）罚项，建立全局误差界证明罚问题与原约束问题在罚参数超过有限阈值时共享全局极小点；将非光滑黎曼DC问题重构为极小极大问题，提出RADA-DC——结合对偶正则化与DC线性化的黎曼交替下降上升方法。
AI.result: 理论：证明罚与约束形式全局极小点一致，RADA-DC在标准假设与合适参数下以O(ε^{-3})次迭代找到ε-黎曼临界点。实验：在合成和真实数据集上，当聚类数较大时，方法在解质量上优于包括K-means++在内的基线，且计算成本相当。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为黎曼流形上的DC聚类提供了理论保证与高效算法，在大聚类数场景下优于经典基线，具有竞争性计算成本。

title: ReVA: A Scene-Centric Dataset Beyond Repetition for Remote Sensing Video Question Answering
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable advances in remote sensing. However, existing remote sensing multimodal reasoning benchmarks exhibit two critical limitations: they rely on (i) template-driven questions, which causes repetitive questions; and (ii) static images that fail to capture the inherent temporal nature of drone/UAV videos. This leaves systematic evaluation of remote sensing video reasoning largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce ReVA, a new dataset for remote sensing video question answering, designed to assess spatiotemporal, scene-centric, and reasoning-oriented capabilities of MLLMs. ReVA comprises 2,438 drone videos spanning 18 cities worldwide (580K frames) and 22K high-quality question-answer pairs across 11 challenging QA tasks. We develop a semi-automatic annotation pipeline that leverages Text LLMs and MLLMs for question-answer generation with human verification. We evaluate 23 proprietary and open-source Video LLMs on ReVA, exposing fundamental limitations of current models. These findings position ReVA as a critical benchmark toward better remote sensing video understanding and temporal reasoning capabilities for real-world deployments. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/zyaocoder/ReVA

AI.tldr: ReVA是首个面向遥感视频问答的大规模基准数据集，包含2,438个无人机视频与22K问答对，评估了23个视频大模型并揭示其能力缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感多模态推理基准存在两大缺陷：(i)依赖模板生成问题导致问题重复；(ii)使用静态图像，无法捕捉无人机/UAV视频固有的时间特性。因此遥感视频推理的系统性评估基本空白。
AI.method: 构建ReVA数据集，涵盖18个城市的2,438个无人机视频（580K帧），覆盖11类QA任务共22K高质量问答对，用于评估时空、场景中心与推理导向能力。采用半自动标注流程，结合文本LLM与MLLM生成问答并进行人工校验。
AI.result: 在ReVA上评测了23个专有及开源视频LLM，暴露出当前模型的根本性局限。
AI.conclusion: ReVA作为关键基准，推动遥感视频理解与时间推理能力发展，助力真实场景部署。代码与数据集已开源。

title: One Rollout Is All You Get: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents are deployed with frozen weights and discard everything they experience on the job. Existing ways to update an agent's weights assume something deployment withholds: ground truth, rollouts beyond the single attempt (retries, samples, practice runs), or a learning phase other than deployment. Because GUI actions can be irreversible, a deployed agent gets one attempt per task occurrence, in arrival order, and every attempt counts. No ground truth is available at any point. We define fully test-time adaptation for GUI agents by these constraints and pair it with a minimal weight-space method, SOLO. Auxiliary models read each episode: a judge selects the episodes it deems successful, and a proposer-verifier pair relabels a failed episode's prefix with the subtask that prefix completed. Admitted episodes enter a short sliding window, and each admission updates a small adapter by top-K self-distillation on the agent's own predictions, provided the window holds a judged success. On recurring task streams built from WebArena, VisualWebArena and MobileWorld, SOLO improves on the frozen agent with both UI-TARS-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, by three to six points of success rate, and exceeds two in-setting memory methods on the web streams.

AI.tldr: SOLO: 面向GUI智能体的完全测试时自适应（无真值、单次尝试）最小化权重更新方法
AI.motivation: GUI智能体部署时权重冻结，且因GUI动作不可逆，每次任务仅一次尝试、按到达顺序进行，无任何真值可用；现有更新方法都依赖部署时无法获得的信息。
AI.method: 定义完全测试时自适应约束，并提出SOLO：用辅助模型读episode，judge筛选成功episode，proposer-verifier对失败前缀重标子任务；合格episode进入滑动窗口，在窗口含判定成功时，用top-K自蒸馏更新小型adapter。
AI.result: 在WebArena、VisualWebArena、MobileWorld构建的任务流上，SOLO对UI-TARS-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B分别提升3-6个成功率点，并在web流上超越两种同设置记忆方法。
AI.conclusion: 在严格部署约束下，利用自蒸馏与辅助模型的轻量权重更新可有效提升GUI智能体性能。

title: Don't Inoculate Everything: Stratified Inoculation Prompting Narrows Backdoor Triggers and Preserves Desired Traits
summary: Supervised fine-tuning can teach language models undesired behaviours alongside desired ones. Inoculation prompting (IP) aims to limit unwanted generalisation by requesting the undesired behaviour during training and removing the request at inference. However, undesired behaviour can still appear under unrelated prompts. IP can also hinder learning of the desired behaviour. We address these limitations in settings where both behaviours co-occur in most training examples, so filtering out examples with undesired behaviour leaves only a small clean subset. We introduce stratified inoculation prompting (SIP). SIP leverages a small clean subset to demonstrate that desired behaviour should persist without the undesired one across different contexts. SIP oversamples these clean examples under diverse non-eliciting prompts while inoculating the rest. SIP substantially reduces expression of undesired behaviour while preserving more of the desired behaviour than IP. These gains persist even when we extend IP to oversample the same clean subset at the same rate as SIP. Moreover, SIP yields lower emergent misalignment rates in all harmful-advice setups we tested. SIP can be further extended to limit the undesired behaviour even under prompts that explicitly request it. We introduce backdoor dilution, which weakens expression under the inoculation prompt, and password-locked inoculation, which concentrates elicitation on a designated password. Taken together, our findings show that changing the training contexts for a small clean subset can significantly improve selective generalisation.

AI.tldr: 提出分层接种提示(SIP)，利用少量干净样本配合多样化非诱导提示过采样，减少不良行为泛化同时保留期望行为，并降低涌现性错位。
AI.motivation: 接种提示(IP)虽能限制不良行为泛化，但在无关提示下不良行为仍会出现，且会损害期望行为的学习。当两种行为在多数训练样本中共现、过滤后仅剩少量干净子集时，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: SIP利用小规模干净子集，展示期望行为应能在不同语境下脱离不良行为独立存在；对干净样本在多样化非诱导提示下过采样，同时对其余样本施加接种。扩展方法包括backdoor dilution(削弱接种提示下的表达)与password-locked inoculation(将诱导集中于指定密码)。
AI.result: SIP显著减少不良行为表达，比IP保留更多期望行为；即使将IP扩展到以相同比率过采样同一干净子集，该优势仍存在。在所有测试的有害建议场景中SIP的涌现性错位率更低，并可扩展到显式请求不良行为的提示。
AI.conclusion: 改变小规模干净子集的训练语境可显著提升选择性泛化，为控制模型行为泛化提供了有效思路。

title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Recent image generation models can take multiple reference images as input and combine them into a new image. However, multi-reference image generation remains challenging: models may omit or duplicate subjects from the references, or produce images in which multiple subjects appear unnaturally pasted. Recent work has proposed image generation agents that combine image generation models, reasoning models, and a harness, which is an executable program that specifies how reference images are interpreted, how generation is performed, how outputs are diagnosed, and how the final image is selected. In multi-reference generation, however, references play different roles and outputs must satisfy many criteria at once, such as fidelity to each reference and the naturalness of the whole image, so many parts of the harness could be improved, from how references are processed to how outputs are diagnosed. This makes it hard to predict which changes will improve performance and by how much, and good harnesses difficult to design by hand; indeed, human-written harnesses vary widely in performance. We therefore propose AutoRef, which optimizes the harness automatically while keeping both models frozen: a coding agent iteratively rewrites the harness code. AutoRef separates the tasks whose feedback informs proposals from the tasks used to select candidates, and continues the search from a beam of the top-ranked harnesses on the selection tasks. Using this procedure, we discover AutoRef-Harness, which improves the open-weight FLUX.2 [klein] 4B from 5.72 to 7.37 on held-out four-reference tasks of the MultiBanana benchmark, matching or exceeding proprietary models including Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5. Without re-optimization, the same harness also improves results when the generator, number of references, benchmark, evaluator, or reasoning model differs from those used in the search.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoRef，用编码智能体自动优化多参考图像生成的harness（冻结模型），搜索出AutoRef-Harness，将FLUX.2 [klein] 4B在MultiBanana四参考任务上从5.72提升到7.37，媲美或超越Nano Banana Pro与GPT-Image-1.5，并具有一定泛化性。
AI.motivation: 多参考图像生成易出现主体遗漏、重复或拼接生硬等问题。现有图像生成智能体依赖手工设计的harness，但参考图角色不同、评价标准多元，改动难以预测效果，人工设计的harness性能差异大，因此需要自动优化harness。
AI.method: AutoRef在保持生成与推理模型冻结的前提下，由编码智能体迭代重写harness代码。方法将用于产生提案反馈的任务与用于候选选择的任务分离，并在选择任务上从排名靠前的harness组成的beam继续搜索。
AI.result: 发现AutoRef-Harness，将开权重模型FLUX.2 [klein] 4B在MultiBanana基准四参考留出任务上的得分从5.72提升至7.37，匹配或超过Nano Banana Pro、GPT-Image-1.5等专有模型；在不重新优化的情况下，更换生成器、参考图数量、基准、评估器或推理模型时也能提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 自动优化harness是提升多参考图像生成的有效途径，AutoRef无需微调模型即可显著提升性能并具备跨设定泛化能力。

title: Routing Without Embeddings: Fast And Interpretable Routing With Regular Expressions
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) routers commonly rely on neural query embeddings, with larger encoders expected to better capture query intent and difficulty. Yet scaling Qwen2.5 encoders from 0.5B to 72B parameters brings little improvement in routing accuracy (Figure 1b), suggesting that small encoders may already capture the query properties needed for routing. We therefore investigate which properties matter and whether they can be extracted directly from text without a neural encoder. We introduce REGEXROUTE, a pipeline that uses sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to discover interpretable regular-expression (regex) features. Using unlabeled text, an LLM turns descriptions of grouped SAE latents into regex extractors and refines them to match latent activation patterns. These extractors supply numerical features to a lightweight routing head, eliminating neural encoding at inference (Figure 1a). Across four benchmarks, one fixed set of 128 features achieves 76.43% average routing accuracy, comparable to 76.41% for the strongest neural text encoder baseline, with much smaller latency and strong robustness. These findings establish explicit, interpretable text features as a practical basis for designing and understanding LLM routers.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现LLM路由器的神经查询编码器从0.5B扩展到72B几乎不提升准确率，提出REGEXROUTE，用稀疏自编码器（SAE）发现可解释的正则表达式特征替代神经编码器进行路由，以128个固定特征在四个基准上达到76.43%平均准确率，与最强神经编码器基线76.41%相当，且延迟更低、鲁棒性更强。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由器普遍依赖神经查询嵌入，直觉上更大的编码器应更能捕捉查询意图与难度，但实验发现将Qwen2.5编码器从0.5B扩展到72B对路由准确率提升甚微，暗示小型编码器已足以捕捉路由所需属性。作者因此想探究究竟哪些属性对路由起决定作用，以及能否无需神经编码器、直接从文本中提取这些属性。
AI.method: 提出REGEXROUTE流水线：用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在无标注文本上发现可解释的正则表达式特征；由LLM将分组后的SAE隐变量描述转化为正则提取器，并迭代精炼以匹配隐变量激活模式；这些提取器输出的数值特征输入轻量级路由头，从而在推理阶段完全省去神经编码。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，一组固定的128个特征达到平均76.43%的路由准确率，与最强神经文本编码器基线的76.41%相当，同时延迟大幅降低且鲁棒性强。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明显式、可解释的文本特征可作为设计和理解LLM路由器的实用基础，说明路由所需查询属性可从文本直接提取，无需依赖大规模神经编码器。

title: A decision-support system applied to Law: Reasoning and explainability of the decision
summary: The emergence of the digital transition brought an increasing need to control the processing of digital information, including in Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). At the EU level, in recent years, many regulations have emerged to control data processing and exchange. Texts other than the GDPR, such as the ''Law Enforcement Directive (LED)'', appeared to regulate specifically how Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) could process data. A formal representation of these regulations can be part of decision systems that support LEAs in processing data in compliance with the regulations. Although many new formalisms have emerged to represent legal norms and rules, few are provided with a reasoning mechanism. Furthermore, systems used in decision-making processes in critical contexts such as medical diagnoses or legal decisions cannot be fully automated, and the explainability of their results is essential to ensure user confidence in decisions. This explainability aspect, while crucial, is lacking in most modern approaches that rely on machine learning. This paper describes a framework to operate formal rules from regulations, by focusing on explainability of the decision. After describing the general architecture of the proposed decision support framework, the paper showcases how symbolic AI and the SPARQL query language can support legal reasoning. It then describes an algorithm to generate a justification for the reasoning results, and outlines the procedure to be followed when the reasoning does not lead to a satisfactory conclusion. We notably focus on a method based on decision trees to determine what additional information to request from the user.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释的决策支持框架，用符号AI与SPARQL从法规（如LED）形式化规则进行法律推理，并提供理由生成与信息补全机制。
AI.motivation: 欧盟数字转型催生大量数据合规法规，执法机构需确保数据处理合规；现有法律形式化方法多缺乏推理机制，且现代机器学习方法缺乏可解释性，影响医疗、法律等关键领域决策的用户信任。
AI.method: 提出决策支持框架总体架构；用符号AI与SPARQL查询语言实现法律推理；设计算法为推理结果生成理由（justification）；当推理无法得到满意结论时，采用基于决策树的方法确定需向用户额外索取哪些信息。
AI.result: 展示了符号AI与SPARQL支持法律推理的可行性，给出了理由生成算法及推理不充分时的补全流程。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在执法机构数据合规处理等场景中提供可解释的决策支持，弥补现有法律形式化方法推理机制与可解释性不足。

title: Look Before You Judge: Training-Free Region Mining for Grounded and Explainable Deepfake Detection
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can explain deepfake verdicts in natural language, but such explanations are not necessarily visually grounded in the visual evidence underlying the prediction. A model may describe plausible artifacts inferred from language priors rather than from image evidence. Existing grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions, but they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image, making them ill-suited for forensic artifacts that are subtle, spatially localized, and image-dependent. We propose Look Before You Judge, a training-free framework that formulates explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition process. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, our framework first identifies image-specific candidate evidence regions by contrasting the MLLM's decoder-to-visual attention between an original image and its Gaussian-blurred counterpart. The identified regions are then inspected individually, and the resulting local evidence is integrated with the global image context before reaching a final verdict. The framework operates without manipulation masks, external forensic models, or parameter updates, making it directly applicable to off-the-shelf MLLMs. Across five open-source MLLMs on TriDF and MMTD-Set, our framework improves detection accuracy by up to 12.8%, reduces CHAIR by up to 33.4% and hallucination rate by up to 21.3%, and outperforms representative training-free decoding and attention methods.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架"Look Before You Judge"，将可解释deepfake检测建模为序列化证据获取过程，先定位图像特定的候选证据区域再逐一核查，提升MLLM检测准确率与解释的可视化依据。
AI.motivation: MLLM能对deepfake判定给出自然语言解释，但解释未必真正基于视觉证据，可能只是依赖语言先验编造看似合理的伪影。现有grounding方法通过解码或注意力干预增强视觉依赖，但往往作用于全图，难以应对隐蔽、局部、因图而异的取证伪影。
AI.method: 免训练框架：先通过对比原图与高斯模糊版本下MLLM解码器到视觉的注意力，定位图像特定的候选证据区域；再逐区域单独检查，最后将局部证据与全局图像上下文整合后给出最终判定。无需篡改掩码、外部取证模型或参数更新，可直接用于现成MLLM。
AI.result: 在TriDF与MMTD-Set上评测五个开源MLLM，检测准确率最高提升12.8%，CHAIR最高降低33.4%，幻觉率最高降低21.3%，优于代表性免训练解码与注意力方法。
AI.conclusion: 将检测重构为局部证据的序列获取与核查，可有效提升MLLM对deepfake的检测性能与解释的视觉依据，且无需训练、即插即用。

title: The Composition Gap in Dataset Distillation
summary: Dataset distillation compresses a training set into a small synthetic set, usually evaluated one at a time. In federated and data-governance settings, several parties distill their own data and a user trains on their union. We ask whether the union of separately distilled sets reproduces training on the union of the real data composability and show that it can fail even when every source is distilled exactly and the total budget admits an exact joint distillate. Compressing a training trajectory into fewer steps transforms the source statistics nonlinearly, so averaging compressed sources differs from compressing their average. For quadratic objectives we derive the exact composition error for two-to-one step compression in terms of the source-Hessian variance and the linear terms of the losses, and on a smooth network at small step sizes this prediction captures the local endpoint discrepancy in magnitude and direction. For learned synthetic sets, however, the composed error decomposes exactly into this local discrepancy and an aggregate source residual. Under endpoint matching the residual exceeds the structural term by more than an order of magnitude, and under distribution matching the two terms partly cancel. Joint distillation also retains an accuracy advantage when both sets are distilled from the same dataset, where the local discrepancy is exactly zero. Training fidelity and downstream accuracy are therefore distinct requirements, neither established by evaluating each set on its own.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数据集蒸馏的"可组合性"：多方各自蒸馏后再取并集，是否能等价于对真实数据并集的联合训练。作者发现即使每个源都被精确蒸馏，组合仍可能失败，因为压缩轨迹会非线性地改变源统计量。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习与数据治理场景下，各方分别蒸馏自己的数据，用户在其并集上训练。现有评估通常对单个蒸馏集逐一评测，缺乏对"分别蒸馏再合并"是否等价于"直接对并集联合蒸馏"的理论与实证分析。
AI.method: 针对二次目标，推导两步压缩为一步（two-to-one）时组合误差的精确表达式，用源 Hessian 方差和损失的线性项刻画；在小步长光滑网络上验证该预测能捕捉局部端点偏差的量级与方向。对学习到的合成集，将组合误差精确分解为局部偏差与聚合源残差两部分，并比较端点匹配与分布匹配下的表现。
AI.result: 组合确实可能失败，即便每个源都精确蒸馏且总预算允许存在精确的联合蒸馏集。学习合成集下，端点匹配时残差比结构项大一个数量级以上；分布匹配时两项部分抵消。当两组数据来自同一数据集时局部偏差恰为零，联合蒸馏仍保持精度优势。
AI.conclusion: 训练保真度与下游精度是两个不同要求，二者都不能仅靠逐一评估每个蒸馏集来确立。联合蒸馏在可组合性上具有优势，提示数据集蒸馏的评估需考虑组合场景。

title: Structural Alignment for Reliable Industrial AI: Bridging Physical Reality, Data, Models, and Human Intent
summary: Artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed in critical industrial domains, including healthcare, energy grids, subsurface exploration, where failures can have severe consequences for human safety, system stability, and economic outcomes. Yet AI is still evaluated primarily through benchmark accuracy, a model-centric metric that fails to capture the structural complexity and risks of real-world deployment. We propose a framework that views industrial AI reliability as a problem of structural alignment across four interacting worlds: physical, representational, machine, and human cognitive. These worlds are connected through two interfaces: digitalization, linking physical reality to computational representations, and goal encoding, translating human cognition to the machine objectives. Together, they define the space of admissible solutions. We characterize the solution space through four attributes: existence, non-uniqueness, robustness, and interpretability and show how mismatches arise at interfaces and propagate across worlds to produce reliability failures. Applications to healthcare, energy grids, and subsurface exploration illustrate that although dominant failure modes differ across domains, for example, interpretability in healthcare, robustness in energy grids, and non-uniqueness in subsurface exploration, all originate from a shared structural mechanism. By shifting the focus from model-centric evaluation to system-level alignment, this framework offers a principled foundation for assessing and governing reliability in industrial AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个将工业AI可靠性视为"结构对齐"问题的框架，跨越物理、表征、机器、人类认知四个世界，通过数字化和目标编码两个接口连接，用存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性、可解释性四个属性刻画解空间，揭示不同领域失效模式共享的结构性机制。
AI.motivation: AI日益部署于医疗、能源、地下勘探等关键工业领域，失效后果严重；但当前主要用基准准确率这种模型中心指标评估，无法捕捉真实部署的结构复杂性和风险。
AI.method: 提出一个框架，将工业AI可靠性视为四个相互作用世界（物理、表征、机器、人类认知）的结构对齐问题。两接口：数字化连接物理现实与计算表征，目标编码将人类认知转化为机器目标，二者共同定义可接受解空间。用四个属性刻画解空间：存在性、非唯一性、鲁棒性、可解释性。
AI.result: 展示接口处的失配如何跨世界传播导致可靠性失效；通过医疗、能源、地下勘探的应用表明，各领域主导失效模式不同（医疗为可解释性、能源为鲁棒性、地下勘探为非唯一性），但均源自共同的结构机制。
AI.conclusion: 将焦点从模型中心评估转向系统级对齐，为评估和治理工业AI系统的可靠性提供了有原则的基础。

title: Learning to Reason with Persistent Object States for Video Instance Segmentation
summary: Video segmentation models maintain object identities by carrying instance information across frames. Under prolonged occlusion, reappearance, or interactions between similar instances, however, an unreliable update can overwrite a valid history and cause persistent identity drift. We introduce POSReasoner, a trainable, plug-and-play framework that explicitly decides when an observation should change an object's state. Each persistent state records identity, confidence, and absence history. A sparse state-observation graph supports Propose-Verify reasoning: provisional associations are revisited using object history, predicted presence, and competition among identities. The verified decisions determine whether to retain, update, reactivate, or suppress each state, while a learned gate controls the evidence written back to memory. Only verified transitions update the persistent state used in subsequent frames. POSReasoner uses standard video annotations and keeps the base model frozen, enabling integration with diverse VOS and VIS architectures. Experiments across long-term VOS and VIS benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, with the largest gains under occlusion and object reappearance.

AI.tldr: 提出POSReasoner：可训练、即插即用的框架，通过Propose-Verify推理显式决定观测何时更新物体状态，缓解长时遮挡/重现造成的身份漂移，在VOS和VIS基准上稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 视频分割模型跨帧携带实例信息，但在长时间遮挡、重现或相似实例交互时，不可靠的状态更新会覆盖有效历史，导致持续的身份漂移。
AI.method: 每个持续状态记录身份、置信度和缺席历史；用稀疏的状态-观测图支持Propose-Verify推理，借助物体历史、预测存在性和身份间竞争来复核临时关联；验证后的决策决定保留/更新/重激活/抑制各状态，学习门控控制写回记忆的证据；仅已验证的转换更新持久状态。使用标准视频标注，冻结基础模型，可集成多种VOS/VIS架构。
AI.result: 在长期VOS和VIS基准上相比强基线取得一致性提升，在遮挡和物体重现情况下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: POSReasoner通过显式验证状态更新，有效缓解身份漂移，作为通用即插即用模块提升多种视频分割架构的性能。

title: Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for enhancing the reasoning of large language models, yet the high dimensionality of parameter updates makes its training dynamics hard to analyze. We study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and use vector steering to identify a low-dimensional effective manifold in activation space associated with RL-induced gains. We uncover two geometric properties. (1) Effective Manifold Capacity: the capacity needed to reproduce RL gains can be very small but is not infinitely compressible; at extremely low capacity, intervention dimensionality and input-dependent expressiveness become key constraints, and this requirement varies with injection depth. (2) Control Manifold Separation: effective control directions lie mainly in the low-variance complement of the activation principal subspace. Within a task and base model, the learned geometry stays largely consistent across training configurations, and across tasks geometric alignment correlates with capability transfer. Experiments on 5 LLMs and 6 verifiable-reward tasks support these findings. We then propose Alpha-Stabler, a plug-and-play framework with a Predictor that monitors principal-subspace intrusion for early collapse warnings, and a Controller that removes the principal-subspace component of activation gradients during backpropagation while preserving the orthogonal complement. Alpha-Stabler stabilizes training for 2,000 steps and consistently improves RL gains, offering practical insights for robust post-training. Code: https://github.com/caiyuchen-ustc/On_Policy_Vector_Training

AI.tldr: 研究RLVR训练动态，用向量引导发现激活空间中的低维有效流形，揭示两个几何性质，并提出Alpha-Stabler框架稳定训练。
AI.motivation: RL是提升大模型推理的关键范式，但参数更新维度极高，训练动态难以分析。
AI.method: 使用向量引导识别与RL增益相关的低维有效流形；提出Alpha-Stabler，含监测主成分子空间侵入的Predictor和反向传播中移除激活梯度主成分分量的Controller。
AI.result: 发现有效流形容量可很小但非无限压缩；控制方向主要位于激活主成分子空间的低方差补空间；5个LLM、6个可验证奖励任务验证；Alpha-Stabler稳定训练2000步并持续提升RL增益。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的几何结构在训练配置间基本一致，跨任务几何对齐与能力迁移相关，为稳健后训练提供实用见解。

title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon
summary: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: WorldPlay2 交互式世界模型，通过因子化混合控制接口与压缩记忆+稳定蒸馏的协同设计，实现实时响应与长时程一致性。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需实时响应多样控制并保持长时程一致性，但异质控制建模困难，且爆炸性上下文与不稳定蒸馏难以兼顾长时程一致性与实时性。
AI.method: 1) 因子化混合控制接口：将帧对齐动作控制与结构化语义控制（解耦场景外观、角色身份、动态语义事件）结合；2) 将历史上下文压缩为紧凑记忆token，由自回归学生与双向教师共享，实现片段级记忆条件打分，降低蒸馏开销；3) Stable Forcing：少步策略初始化学生，并用全rollout回放保持长时程质量。
AI.result: 大量实验表明模型具有强泛化性，性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 压缩记忆与稳定蒸馏的协同设计有效解决了实时性与长时程一致性的矛盾，WorldPlay2 在交互式世界建模上表现优越。

title: Building Transformation Layers for Riemannian Neural Networks
summary: Recently, deep neural networks on manifold-valued representations have garnered significant attention across various machine learning applications. One recent focus is the generalization of Euclidean fully connected (FC) and convolutional layers to non-Euclidean geometries. However, previous approaches typically focus on a few selected manifolds and rely on specific properties of the target manifold. In contrast, this work proposes a framework for constructing FC and convolutional layers over computationally tractable Riemannian spaces. This framework incorporates several previous FC layers across different geometries as special cases and is instantiated on ten representative manifolds, including three hyperbolic models, five geometries of the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold, and two Grassmannian perspectives. Experiments on different manifolds demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of our approach. Code can be found at https://github.com/GitZH-Chen/RieTrans.

AI.tldr: 提出一个在可计算黎曼空间上构建全连接层和卷积层的通用框架，支持多种流形几何，并在十个代表性流形上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 已有将欧氏FC和卷积层推广到非欧几何的工作，但通常只针对少数选定流形并依赖特定流形性质，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 提出一个在计算可行的黎曼空间上构建FC和卷积层的框架，可涵盖以往多种几何的FC层作为特例，并在十个代表性流形上实例化（三个双曲模型、五个SPD几何、两个Grassmannian视角）。
AI.result: 在不同流形上的实验证明了方法的有效性和适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为流形值表示的神经网络层提供了通用构建方式，并公开代码。

title: Revisiting Risky Tackle Detection with Vision Transformers
summary: This paper is a Track 2 reproducibility companion to an ICPR 2026 study on risky tackle detection in American football prac- tice videos. The original work fine-tuned a Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) on 733 clips labeled with the SATT-3 rubric. It used focal loss, Taguchi L18 augmentation, and 5-fold cross-validation. It reported risky- class recall of 0.67 and risky-class F1 of 0.59. This companion documents the released artifact and traces those numbers to specific scripts, fold out- puts, and aggregation files. The reproduced headline is run_15. It com- bines Gaussian noise with static brightness decrease and uses no rotation and no flip. Its fold-mean risky recall is 0.667 and its fold-mean risky F1 is 0.588. These values match the published headline after rounding. The ablation shows that brightness is the dominant factor. Its risky-recall main-effect range is 0.055, which is larger than the ranges for rotation, flip, and noise. Without augmentation, ViViT reaches risky recall of 0.545 and does not exceed the C3D baseline of 0.583. The raw clips show iden- tifiable student athletes, so they cannot be redistributed. The artifact provides a public sample for pipeline checks and a controlled route for full-data review.

AI.tldr: ICPR 2026风险擒抱检测研究的Track 2复现论文：复现headline run_15（高斯噪声+静态亮度下降，无旋转无翻转），折均风险召回0.667、F1 0.588，与原文四舍五入后一致。
AI.motivation: 作为原研究的复现companion，需将已发布的0.67召回/0.59 F1追溯至具体脚本、折输出与聚合文件，并核实可复现性；同时原始视频含可识别学生运动员，存在数据无法再分发的伦理约束。
AI.method: 微调Video Vision Transformer (ViViT)，在733个SATT-3标注片段上训练；采用focal loss、Taguchi L18增强与5折交叉验证。复现配置run_15组合高斯噪声与静态亮度降低，不使用旋转和翻转；通过消融实验分析各增强因子主效应。
AI.result: 复现headline run_15折均风险召回0.667、折均风险F1 0.588，与原文0.67/0.59四舍五入一致。消融显示亮度为主导致因，其风险召回主效应极差0.055，大于旋转、翻转和噪声。无增强时ViViT风险召回仅0.545，未超过C3D基线0.583。
AI.conclusion: 原研究主要数字可复现，亮度增强是性能关键。制品提供公开样本用于流程验证及受控的全数据审查途径，原始片段因隐私不可再分发。

title: FAST-Brain: A Flow-Aligned Spatio-Temporal Surrogate Brain Model
summary: Modeling resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data is crucial for understanding brain-wide neural activity. However, traditional methods struggle to capture complex temporal dynamics over long horizons, to account for the brain's anatomical spatial structure, and to model high-dimensional ambient signals that lie on a low-dimensional intrinsic subspace. We propose FAST-Brain, a unified flow-aligned spatio-temporal surrogate brain model that addresses all three challenges. At its core is a flow-aligned generative framework that directly predicts the clean blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signal, paired with a graph convolutional network that captures spatial structural constraints and a Transformer that models long-range temporal dependencies. Theoretically, we show that under a low-dimensional subspace assumption, the approximation error of our model scales with the intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient dimension, which justifies our direct modeling of the BOLD signal. Extensive experiments on synthetic and Human Connectome Project datasets demonstrate that FAST-Brain achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering functional connectivity, effective connectivity, and the implicit low-dimensional signal subspace.

AI.tldr: 提出FAST-Brain，一种流对齐时空代理脑模型，统一解决rs-fMRI建模中的长时动态、空间结构和高维低维子空间三大挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统方法难以捕捉长时程复杂时间动态、难以刻画大脑解剖空间结构，且难以建模位于低维内在子空间上的高维环境信号。
AI.method: 核心为流对齐生成框架，直接预测干净的BOLD信号，结合图卷积网络捕获空间结构约束、Transformer建模长程时间依赖；理论上证明在低维子空间假设下近似误差随内在维度而非环境维度缩放。
AI.result: 在合成数据和Human Connectome Project数据集上的大量实验表明，FAST-Brain在恢复功能连接、有效连接及隐式低维信号子空间方面达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: FAST-Brain作为统一时空代理脑模型有效应对rs-fMRI建模的三大挑战，理论与实验均验证其优越性。

title: Just Initialize: A Training-Free Initialization Component for Large-Scale Routing Optimization
summary: Large-scale routing problems are difficult to solve efficiently as their search spaces grow rapidly with problem size. Existing approaches primarily improve the optimization procedure itself, often at increasing computational cost. We instead shift the focus to a useful initialization that can be refined into a high-quality solution with limited downstream refinement. We propose Just Initialize, a training-free and solver-agnostic initialization component for large-scale routing optimization. Just Initialize compresses a large routing instance into a compact surrogate space, optimizes its global routing structure, and recovers the resulting solution as an optimization-friendly starting point in the original space. Extensive experiments on Traveling Salesman Problems (TSPs), Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems (CVRPs), Vehicle Routing Problems with Time Windows (VRPTWs), and Prize-Collecting Traveling Salesman Problems (PCTSPs) demonstrate that Just Initialize achieves high-quality solutions comparable to or better than state-of-the-art methods while substantially reducing computational cost across instances ranging from 1K to 100K nodes, including an average speedup of approximately 70$\times$, sub-second runtimes on 10K-node instances, and runtimes within tens of seconds on 100K-node instances.

AI.tldr: 提出"Just Initialize"，一种免训练、求解器无关的初始化组件，通过将大规模路径问题压缩到紧凑代理空间优化全局结构，再恢复为原空间的高质量起点，显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 大规模路径问题搜索空间随规模迅速增长，现有方法主要改进优化过程本身，但计算成本不断增加。作者将重点转向"有用初始化"，使其能在有限下游精炼下达到高质量解。
AI.method: Just Initialize 将大规模路径实例压缩为紧凑的代理空间（surrogate space），优化其全局路由结构，再将解恢复为原空间中利于优化的起点。该方法免训练且与具体求解器无关。
AI.result: 在TSP、CVRP、VRPTW、PCTSP上，1K至100K节点范围的实验表明，其解质量可媲美或优于SOTA方法，同时大幅降低计算成本：平均约70倍加速，10K节点实例亚秒级运行，100K节点实例数十秒内完成。
AI.conclusion: 通过聚焦高质量初始化而非优化过程本身，Just Initialize 在大规模路径优化中实现了效率与解质量的良好平衡，具有通用性和实用价值。

title: Less Is More: Genetic Frame Selection for Efficient Novel View Synthesis
summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis reconstructs a scene from many input images in a single forward pass, yet more views do not necessarily improve performance: redundant or poorly chosen frames increase computational cost and may degrade reconstruction quality. We address the problem of selecting, from an already captured sequence, a fixed-size subset of input views that is most informative for reconstructing specified target viewpoints. We propose a render-free view selector that scores candidate frames based on three complementary criteria: target-view coverage, measured against observed frames that stand in for the targets, redundancy with previously selected views, and image sharpness. A lightweight scoring network then selects the most informative frames without rendering, reconstruction, or per-scene optimization at inference time. To train the selector, we distill an expensive offline search procedure in which a genetic algorithm identifies high-quality subsets by directly optimizing reconstruction performance on training scenes. The selector learns to reproduce these choices from geometric and image-level features alone. Across six datasets and multiple input budgets, our method consistently outperforms both geometric and reconstruction-aware view-selection baselines while incurring significantly lower selection costs than reconstruction-based alternatives. Moreover, carefully selected subsets can outperform feed-forward reconstruction from the full input sequence. The learned selector generalizes across diverse reconstruction paradigms (feed-forward, 3D Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF), to object-targeted reconstruction and to a cross-capture setting in which the target views come from a separate acquisition pass. More broadly, our results indicate that explicitly reasoning about target relevance and inter-view redundancy is a fundamental factor in efficient scene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无渲染的视图选择器，从已捕获序列中选固定数量最有信息量的输入视图，以重建指定目标视角。
AI.motivation: 前馈新视角合成中更多输入视图未必更好：冗余或选择不当的帧增加计算成本甚至降低重建质量，需要从已有序列中选出对目标视角最有益的子集。
AI.method: 基于三个互补标准打分：目标视角覆盖度（用观测帧代替目标衡量）、与已选视图的冗余度、图像清晰度。用轻量评分网络在推理时无渲染、无重建、无逐场景优化地选帧。训练时蒸馏遗传算法离线搜索得到的高质量子集，使选择器仅凭几何与图像级特征复现这些选择。
AI.result: 在六个数据集和多种输入预算下，持续优于几何与重建感知的基线，选择成本显著低于基于重建的方法；精选子集甚至优于用完整序列的前馈重建。该选择器可泛化到前馈、3DGS、NeRF 等范式，以及目标物体重建和跨采集场景。
AI.conclusion: 显式考虑目标相关性与视图间冗余是高效场景重建的关键因素。

title: AutoBCI: Forecast-Guided Agentic Neural Architecture Discovery for EEG-Based Brain--Computer Interfaces
summary: EEG-based brain-computer interfaces support a broad range of applications, yet designing decoding architectures that perform well across diverse tasks remains challenging. We introduce AutoBCI, an agentic framework in which a Designer Agent and a Forecaster Agent support the discovery and selection of EEG decoding architectures across tasks. The Designer Agent performs Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery (PGAD), generating and refining architectures through training and validation across multiple EEG tasks, such as emotion recognition, motor imagery, and sleep staging. The Forecaster Agent performs Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge (PEEK), using architecture code, the training protocol, and early learning curves to predict full-budget validation performance and select promising candidates for continued training. Across 14 EEG datasets spanning motor imagery, emotion recognition, and sleep staging, we evaluate AutoBCI with six LLMs, including Opus 5.5 and GPT 5.6 Sol, and compare the architectures selected by the search procedure against ten baselines: six conventional EEG models and four foundation models. The architecture discovered by AutoBCI with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves 64.16% average test balanced accuracy (bAcc), compared with 63.87% for REVE, the strongest baseline on this metric. Using ten observed epochs, PEEK reduces mean absolute error in predicting average validation bAcc from 2.20 to 1.36 percentage points, a 38.1% reduction relative to the best-observed-score baseline.

AI.tldr: AutoBCI是一个智能化框架，通过Designer Agent和Forecaster Agent自动发现与选择跨任务EEG解码架构。
AI.motivation: EEG脑机接口应用广泛，但设计能在多种任务上表现良好的解码架构仍具挑战性。
AI.method: Designer Agent执行PGAD，通过多任务训练验证生成并优化架构；Forecaster Agent执行PEEK，利用架构代码、训练协议和早期学习曲线预测完整预算的验证性能并筛选候选。
AI.result: 14个EEG数据集上，AutoBCI结合Claude Opus 5.5达到64.16%平均测试bAcc，高于最强基线REVE的63.87%；PEEK用10个epoch将验证bAcc预测MAE从2.20降至1.36个百分点，降低38.1%。
AI.conclusion: AutoBCI能有效跨任务发现并选择EEG解码架构，且PEEK可显著提升性能预测精度。

title: What Paired Evaluations Reveal under Visual Perturbations
summary: Robustness evaluation must examine diverse visual perturbations, while benchmarks cover only some real-world conditions and physical testing is costly. Paired evaluations link clean and perturbed predictions for the same image, capturing changes in correctness, confidence, and acceptance beyond aggregate accuracy. We investigate how this image correspondence supports two needs in robustness evaluation: interpreting paired evaluation results and prioritizing samples for physical testing. To interpret paired evaluation results, we fix both sets of prediction records and vary their correspondence within each class. We prove that classwise correct-correct counts give the same sharp bounds on lost acceptance and mean true-class probability decrease among retained-correct inputs as any feasible five-state refinement. Distinguishing persistent from changed wrong answers can further constrain accepted-error transitions, while shared correspondence can establish policy orderings left unresolved by separate cost intervals. To prioritize samples for physical testing, we retain each image's synthetic responses and rank clean-correct images by their mean true-class probability under corruption. Across 44 classifiers, testing the highest-risk 20% finds 67% and 45% of failures under mild screen and print recaptures, versus 58% and 36% for clean confidence and 60% and 37% for an equal-size natural-transformation average. With both probability averaging and an A3Rank scoring adaptation, the tested corruption set yields higher mean failure recall than the natural-transform set; differences between scores depend on the source and budget. Together, these findings show that the value of correspondence depends on the evaluation objective: classwise counts suffice for specified reliability bounds, while image-specific synthetic responses improve the allocation of physical tests within the evaluated pool.

AI.tldr: 论文研究clean-perturbed配对评估中图像对应关系如何支持鲁棒性评估的两个目标：解释配对结果与优先选择物理测试样本。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒性评估需覆盖多样视觉扰动，但基准仅含部分现实条件，物理测试成本高。配对评估可捕捉同一图像正确性、置信度与接受度变化，但图像对应关系的价值尚不明确。
AI.method: 固定预测记录、在类内改变对应关系，证明类内correct-correct计数能给出失接受率与保留正确样本真实类概率下降的紧界；并保留每张图像的合成响应，按腐化下平均真实类概率对clean-correct图像排序以优先物理测试。
AI.result: 在44个分类器上，测试最高风险20%可发现mild screen与print recapture下67%和45%的失败，优于clean confidence的58%/36%与等量自然变换平均的60%/37%；概率平均与A3Rank适配下，测试腐化集召回高于自然变换集。
AI.conclusion: 对应的价值取决于评估目标：类内计数足以给出指定可靠性界，而图像级合成响应能改进物理测试在评估池内的分配。

title: Spexis: Speculative Lookahead Scheduling for LLM Inference
summary:
Spexis is a multi-GPU LLM inference framework that improves the efficiency of pipeline and tensor parallelism through speculative parallelism. Rather than using speculative decoding only to accelerate token generation, Spexis runs speculation in parallel with normal execution, introducing a new parallelism axis without increasing KV-cache memory usage. This improves memory efficiency and helps mitigate the bottlenecks of multi-GPU inference.
  Spexis further uses lookahead scheduling to predict speculation quality and future memory pressure, allowing it to reduce wasted speculation, KV-cache eviction, and recomputation. Built on top of vLLM, Spexis largely improves serving performance across a range of GPU configurations, achieving speedups of up to 34% over a baseline that uses the optimal combination of pipeline and tensor parallelism. Spexis's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/mlsys-seo/spexis.

AI.tldr: Spexis是一个多GPU LLM推理框架，通过将推测执行与正常执行并行运行，引入新的并行轴而不增加KV-cache开销，并结合前瞻调度缓解多GPU推理瓶颈，相比最优流水线+张量并行基线最高提速34%。
AI.motivation: 多GPU LLM推理中，流水线并行和张量并行存在效率瓶颈，而传统推测解码仅用于加速token生成，未充分利用其并行潜力。
AI.method: 将推测执行与正常执行并行进行，作为新的并行轴且不增加KV-cache内存；采用lookahead调度预测推测质量和未来内存压力，减少无效推测、KV-cache驱逐与重计算；基于vLLM实现。
AI.result: 在多种GPU配置下显著提升服务性能，相比使用最优流水线+张量并行组合的基线最高提速34%。
AI.conclusion: Spexis通过推测并行与前瞻调度有效提升多GPU LLM推理效率，代码已开源。保留"推测并行"作为新并行轴这一措辞。

title: A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations): A Visual-Symbolic Framework for Virtual Humans
summary: Creating believable vh requires the coherent integration of perception, reasoning, and action mediated by language. A central challenge is to combine these components into a control loop grounded in interactive 3D environments. To this end, we present A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations), a visual-symbolic framework for language-driven vh that leverages a pretrained vlm with tool calling to unify perception, reasoning, and action within a single control loop. A.D.A.M.O. maintains a dual visual-symbolic world model that combines egocentric visual input and synchronized symbolic state to support grounded task-oriented behavior from natural language prompts. To support diagnostic evaluation, we introduce a controlled task suite organized by a cd taxonomy that breaks down spatial tasks into procedural and linguistic complexity. Experiments in controlled scenes show that semantic labeling strongly influences task completion and failure modes, reducing perceptual ambiguity while shifting failures toward downstream execution, whereas reasoning errors remain comparatively rare.

AI.tldr: 提出A.D.A.M.O.视觉-符号框架，利用预训练VLM与工具调用统一感知、推理与行动，实现语言驱动的虚拟人控制。
AI.motivation: 创建可信虚拟人需在交互式3D环境中连贯整合感知、推理与行动，核心挑战是将各组件融合进单一控制回路。
AI.method: A.D.A.M.O.基于预训练VLM+工具调用，维护结合自我中心视觉输入与同步符号状态的双重视觉-符号世界模型；并设计按认知难度(CD)分类的任务套件用于诊断评估。
AI.result: 受控场景实验显示语义标注显著影响任务完成与失败模式，能降低感知歧义、将失败转移至下游执行，而推理错误相对罕见。
AI.conclusion: 语义标注是影响语言驱动虚拟人任务表现的关键因素，框架有效统一感知-推理-行动并揭示失败模式分布。

title: ReSS: Residual-Restoring Sparse Attention for 3D Vision Transformers
summary: 3D vision transformers such as VGGT predict camera poses and scene geometry from multi-view images in a single forward pass, but their global attention over all concatenated view tokens dominates computation as the number of views grows. To reduce this cost, SparseVGGT and HeSS sparsify attention at the block level, and both retain blocks with high attention probability. However, we observe that attention probability poorly predicts how much the model's behavior actually changes when a block is removed, and we show that this mismatch is why performance collapses as sparsity increases. In this paper, we propose ReSS (ReSidual-ReStoring Sparse Attention), which recasts block selection from a problem of maximizing the retained attention mass to one of minimizing the drift that sparsification leaves in the residual stream. We introduce a drift score that quantifies how much each block shifts the residual, and, since the drift of a drop set depends on the directions of the contribution vectors rather than on their magnitudes alone, an iterative residual restoration procedure that refines the drop set as a whole. Across three backbones and five datasets, ReSS preserves dense performance better than prior methods at matched sparsity. Two further results support drift as the quantity that governs the cost of sparsification: maximizing drift degrades performance faster than random selection, and plotted against realized drift instead of sparsity, all methods fall approximately onto a single curve.
