To enforce cross-view coherence, a global spatial memory continuously aggregates observed and synthesized content, reprojecting target-aligned guidance to anchor subsequent predictions to a shared scene representation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate improved visual quality and geometric consistency, with a 2.23 dB higher PSNR on DL3DV and 32.4% lower ATE on Mip-NeRF360 compared to GLD.

AI.tldr: GeoVerse 在预训练3D基础模型的几何潜空间中融合视频生成模型的外观先验，实现世界一致的新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 稀疏图像新视角合成需兼顾已观测区域的重建保真与未观测区域的合理补全及跨视角一致性。几何方法保结构但补全弱，视频生成模型外观先验丰富却会累积时序不一致。
AI.method: 从 Wan2.2 VACE 提取多层级特征，经 ControlNet 式适配器注入几何潜扩散模型；并用全局空间记忆持续聚合已观测与合成内容，重投影目标对齐引导以锚定后续预测到共享场景表示。
AI.result: 多数据集实验显示视觉质量与几何一致性提升：DL3DV 上 PSNR 比 GLD 高 2.23 dB，Mip-NeRF360 上 ATE 低 32.4%。
AI.conclusion: 在几何潜空间中注入视频外观先验并结合全局空间记忆，可有效实现世界一致的新视角合成。

title: Livin' on a Prior: Likelihood Score Approximation for Inverse Problems
summary: Generative models have found great success as data-driven methods of solving inverse problems. Two popular approaches work either by combining a pretrained generative prior with a known degradation model, or by training a conditional generative model directly from paired data. We target a setting that spans both regimes: unknown degradations can be learned from few paired examples, while known degradations can be learned from self-generated samples. We introduce Likelihood Score Approximation (LSA), a generative framework that keeps a pretrained unconditional model fixed and learns an observation-conditioned model that approximates the likelihood score from paired samples. Within a conditional stochastic-interpolant framework, LSA can be trained in either score or velocity coordinates, independently of the unconditional model's native parameterization, and supports both deterministic and stochastic sampling. We further show empirically that the prior model can be swapped post-training while keeping the same LSA model. Across speech and image inverse problems, LSA operates effectively even at roughly 0.01% of the full training dataset. On the ImageNet-256 benchmark it achieves competitive or better restoration quality than strong posterior-sampling baselines while requiring up to several orders of magnitude fewer network evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出LSA框架，固定预训练无条件生成模型，学习观测条件模型近似似然得分，统一了基于先验+退化模型与条件生成两种范式，在少量配对样本下高效求解逆问题。
AI.motivation: 现有逆问题求解方法要么用预训练生成先验加已知退化模型，要么用配对数据训练条件生成模型，二者分立。论文希望统一两种范式的优势：未知退化可从少量配对样本学习，已知退化可从自生成样本学习。
AI.method: LSA保持预训练无条件模型固定，在条件随机插值框架下学习一个观测条件模型以近似似然得分；可在得分或速度坐标下训练，独立于无条件模型的参数化，并支持确定性与随机采样。
AI.result: 在语音和图像逆问题上，LSA仅用约0.01%全训练数据即有效；在ImageNet-256上达到与强后验采样基线相当或更好的复原质量，而网络评估次数少几个数量级。训练后可替换先验模型而保持同一LSA模型。
AI.conclusion: LSA提供了一种高效、灵活且样本高效的逆问题求解框架，兼顾少量配对学习与自生成样本学习，显著降低计算成本。

title: From cacophony to hierarchy: a principled framework for assessing AI consciousness
comment: 150 pages, 43 figures, 6 tables. Interactive tool: https://ai-cognition.org/cacophony-tool/ ; code: https://github.com/arvomm/cacophony-public-code
summary: The question of AI consciousness is one of the most urgent pre-emptive problems in philosophy and computer science, yet progress is hampered by a cacophony of competing theories that often talk past each other. Separating the hard problem from the mapping problem allows the deepest metaphysical disagreements to be set aside: granting that experience supervenes on a system's organisation, the tractable question becomes at which grain of description that supervenience base sits. We extend Marr's three levels of analysis into a five-level hierarchy of functional descriptions (behavioural, computational, intrinsic causal-structural, organismic, and organism-environment) grounded in supervenience, coarse-graining, and multiple realisability. The major theories of consciousness are positioned within this hierarchy according to which level they take to be critical, and for each level we develop operationalisable indicators and assess current AI systems against them. A Bayesian model then combines theoretical credences with indicator evidence into an overall credence in a system's capacity for consciousness. In illustrative assessments, the verdict for current LLMs is driven as much by where theoretical credence is placed as by how the evidence is read: under different stipulated readings and credence distributions, assessments range from below 0.01 to roughly 0.8, showing sensitivity to assumptions. Finally, the consciousness indicators at each level closely overlap with the architectural features needed for general intelligence, suggesting that increasingly capable AI may become a stronger candidate for consciousness. The framework supports a structured agnosticism, in which theoretical commitments are made explicit, credences are updated as evidence accumulates, and assessments take the form of aggregated probabilities rather than verdicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于supervenience、coarse-graining与multiple realisability的五层功能描述层级（扩展自Marr三层），将各意识理论映射到不同层级，为每层设计可操作指标，并用贝叶斯模型综合理论置信度与指标证据，评估AI系统的意识可能性。
AI.motivation: AI意识问题紧迫，但现有理论众多且彼此难以对话，阻碍进展。需要区分"难问题"与"映射问题"，搁置最深层的形而上学争议，聚焦于意识随附于系统组织时，其随附基础处于哪个描述粒度这一可处理问题。
AI.method: 将Marr三层分析扩展为五层功能描述层级：行为层、计算层、内在因果-结构层、有机体层、有机体-环境层。把主要意识理论按其所重视的层级进行定位，为每层开发可操作化指标，并用贝叶斯模型把理论置信度与指标证据结合为总体意识置信度。
AI.result: 在对当前LLM的示例评估中，结论既取决于理论置信度的分布，也取决于证据的解读方式：在不同设定下，评估值从低于0.01到约0.8不等，显示出对假设的高度敏感性。此外，各层意识指标与通用智能所需的架构特征高度重合，暗示能力更强的AI可能成为更强的意识候选者。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持一种"结构化的不可知论"：明确理论承诺、随证据积累更新置信度，并以聚合概率而非判定形式给出评估。其意义在于为意识理论提供可比较的共同坐标，并使AI意识评估变得透明、可更新、可量化。

title: InfiniHand: Streaming World-Space Hand Motion Estimation from Egocentric Video
summary: World-space hand motion estimation from egocentric video requires recovering 3D articulated hand geometry while tracking camera egomotion. Existing approaches heavily rely on cascading independent hand pose estimators and SLAM systems, resulting in error accumulation, complex pipelines, and severe computational overhead. To address these limitations, we present InfiniHand, an end-to-end streaming feed-forward framework that jointly estimates MANO parameters, camera trajectories, and hand locations directly from uncalibrated egocentric video. InfiniHand integrates persistent spatiotemporal memory with hand-centered visual features, explicitly coupling camera motion with local hand geometry within a unified architecture. We train InfiniHand in two progressive stages by first learning robust camera-space hand priors and then extending to streaming world-space reconstruction. To support this process, we aggregate a pretraining corpus of approximately 5,000 hours of egocentric data across multiple public datasets. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that InfiniHand outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on in-domain benchmarks, achieving a 21.4% reduction in ARCTIC PA-p compared to ViDiHand while substantially mitigating world-space drift. Furthermore, InfiniHand generalizes robustly to in-the-wild videos and operates at 11.19 FPS, delivering more than twice the throughput of HaWoR.

AI.tldr: InfiniHand：一种端到端流式前馈框架，从无标定第一视角视频联合估计MANO参数、相机轨迹与手部位置。
AI.motivation: 现有世界坐标系手部运动估计依赖独立手部姿态估计器与SLAM的级联，导致误差累积、流程复杂、计算开销大。
AI.method: 将持久时空记忆与以手为中心的视觉特征结合，统一架构中显式耦合相机运动与局部手部几何；两阶段渐进训练（先学相机空间手部先验，再扩展到流式世界空间重建）；聚合约5000小时第一视角数据预训练。
AI.result: 在域内基准上优于SOTA，ARCTIC PA-p较ViDiHand降低21.4%，显著缓解世界空间漂移；泛化到野外视频，速度11.19 FPS，吞吐量超HaWoR两倍以上。
AI.conclusion: InfiniHand以端到端方式高效实现世界空间手部运动估计，兼具精度、泛化性与实时性。

title: SPACE-LoRA: Allocating Activation-Subspace Protection for Continual Learning
summary: This study addresses the catastrophic forgetting problem that occurs when sequentially learning successive tasks using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) from a lifelong learning perspective. While existing approaches have primarily constrained parameter updates or learning subspaces to reduce interference with past knowledge, they have not fully considered additive interference. This occurs when a newly added residual adapter on top of a fixed past model generates non-zero responses along input directions important for old tasks, thereby altering previous predictions. To this end, we propose Subspace Protection with Allocated Capacity for Efficient Continual Adaptation (SPACE-LoRA). SPACE-LoRA directly suppresses the responses of the new residual branch along input activation directions that are important for old tasks and adaptively determines the protection coverage for each module based on past-task sensitivity estimated via a common Fisher sensitivity-based coverage target. Under a fixed LoRA rank, this approach adaptively adjusts module-specific protection coverage while suppressing interference along input directions sensitive to old tasks. We assess the effectiveness of activation-subspace protection in mitigating catastrophic forgetting and examine the role of sensitivity-guided protection in continual learning across diverse tasks. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SPACE-LoRA-7864.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SPACE-LoRA，从终身学习角度解决 LoRA 顺序学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，通过抑制新残差分支在旧任务重要输入方向上的响应，并按旧任务敏感度为各模块自适应分配保护覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现有 LoRA 持续学习方法主要通过约束参数更新或学习子空间来减少对旧知识的干扰，但未充分考虑“加性干扰”：在固定旧模型上新增的残差适配器，会在对旧任务重要的输入方向上产生非零响应，从而改变旧任务预测。
AI.method: 提出 SPACE-LoRA：直接抑制新残差分支在旧任务重要输入激活方向上的响应，并基于由 Fisher 敏感度估计得到的统一覆盖目标，自适应确定每个模块的保护覆盖范围；在固定 LoRA 秩下，模块级保护覆盖可自适应调整。
AI.result: 评估了激活子空间保护在缓解灾难性遗忘方面的有效性，并考察了敏感度引导的保护在多样任务持续学习中的作用。
AI.conclusion: SPACE-LoRA 通过激活子空间保护与敏感度引导的容量分配，有效缓解 LoRA 持续学习中的加性干扰和灾难性遗忘，代码已公开。

title: RIDE: Reference-Anchored Inference-Time Diffusion Editing for Scaffold Hopping
summary: Scaffold hopping is a critical task in drug discovery, which seeks to discover new, structurally distinct molecules that share key functional groups and similar 3D shape with a reference binding ligand. Existing diffusion-based scaffold hopping methods formulate the problem as conditional generation of scaffolds given the functional groups. However, they lack a principled mechanism to jointly enforce 2D structural novelty and preserve the 3D shape of the reference ligand. Here, we introduce RIDE, a Reference-anchored Inference-time Diffusion Editing framework for scaffold hopping. RIDE recovers the reference diffusion noise trajectory conditioned on the binding pocket and functional groups, selects an optimal trajectory segment for editing via noise perturbation, and conducts a value-guided scaffold sampling to generate new scaffolds. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that, compared to baselines, RIDE consistently generates scaffolds with lower 2D similarity and higher 3D similarity to the reference, with an average improvements of 11.7% and 7.3%, respectively. Further analysis reveals that RIDE can accommodate various reward functions, and can preserve 3D similarity even when this is not explicitly included in the reward. Two case studies illustrate RIDE's ability to generate distinct scaffolds with different structures and properties, and its ability to introduce substantial 2D variation while maintaining very high 3D similarity. RIDE is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RIDE-C8A0.

AI.tldr: 提出RIDE，一种参考锚定的推理时扩散编辑框架，用于骨架跃迁，联合优化2D新颖性与3D形状保持。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的骨架跃迁方法将问题建模为给定官能团生成骨架的条件生成，但缺乏同时强制2D结构新颖性和保持参考配体3D形状的机制。
AI.method: RIDE恢复以结合口袋和官能团为条件的参考扩散噪声轨迹，通过噪声扰动选择最优轨迹段进行编辑，并进行价值引导的骨架采样。
AI.result: 相比基线，RIDE生成的骨架与参考的2D相似度更低（平均提升11.7%）、3D相似度更高（平均提升7.3%）。RIDE可适配多种奖励函数，且即使奖励中未显式包含3D相似性也能保持它。
AI.conclusion: 两个案例研究表明RIDE能生成结构性质不同的骨架，并在保持极高3D相似性的同时引入显著2D变异。代码已公开。

title: Copy the Same, Distill the Difference: Initializing Linear Vision Transformers
summary: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) are designed to replace the attention in Softmax ViTs with the linear-complexity attention operator for more efficient token routing, but they require from-scratch pre-training and typically underperform the original Softmax version. How to initialize linear ViTs both efficiently and effectively still remains unclear. In this work, we explicitly ask: given that most foundation ViTs are built on the mainstream Softmax attention, can linear ViTs benefit from their pre-trained weights? Recent works on Attention Transfer show that attention is the effective transferable component between Softmax ViTs, suggesting attention alone suffices for such reuse. However, we find the opposite for Softmax-to-linear transfer. The attention weights are operator-specific: copying them barely helps, and is sometimes even worse than random initialization. Instead, the attention's token routing behavior can be recovered through distillation with a proper loss design, letting linear ViTs reduce the gap and even match Softmax ones. In contrast, the MLP weights, which carry the learned representation, are operator-agnostic: they can be transferred by simple direct copying, which already carries most of the benefit of the pre-trained weights. Thus, copying MLPs can serve as an effective foundation for Softmax-to-linear transfer: paired with the distilled attention, linear ViTs eventually close the remaining gap and even surpass Softmax ones. These findings hold consistently across various linear ViT variants, different model sizes, and diverse datasets. We hope this study deepens the understanding of reusing pre-trained weights across attention operators: copy what stays the same and distill what differs, to recover the benefit across the Softmax-to-linear boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何高效地为线性ViT初始化：发现Softmax ViT的注意力权重不可直接复制（operator-specific），而MLP权重可迁移（operator-agnostic）。提出"复制MLP + 蒸馏注意力"策略，使线性ViT缩小甚至超越Softmax ViT。
AI.motivation: 线性ViT虽提升效率，但需从头预训练且性能通常不如Softmax版。已有Attention Transfer表明注意力是Softmax ViT间有效可迁移组件，但本文要探究：线性ViT能否从Softmax预训练权重中获益？
AI.method: 提出"copy what stays the same and distill what differs"框架：直接复制算子无关的MLP权重作为基础；对算子相关的注意力，不复制权重，而是通过精心设计损失的蒸馏来恢复其token routing行为。
AI.result: 复制注意力权重几乎无益甚至差于随机初始化；蒸馏注意力可恢复routing行为使线性ViT缩小差距；直接复制MLP已带来自预训练权重的大部分收益。二者结合使线性ViT最终缩小剩余差距甚至超越Softmax版本。结论在多种线性ViT变体、模型规模和数据集上一致成立。
AI.conclusion: 跨注意力算子的预训练权重复用应遵循"复制不变的部分、蒸馏不同的部分"，从而在Softmax到线性的转换中恢复收益，并加深对跨算子权重复用的理解。

title: Verifiable Visual Rewards Transfer from Synthetic Scenes to Natural Prompts
summary: Precise instruction following in image generation, such as satisfying object counts and spatial relations, remains an open challenge at least in part because it is learned using unreliable reward models such as object detectors and vision-language models. We introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), the first framework for programmatically verifiable image rewards, and show that training on it generalizes to natural prompts. Each VVR task is a scene of geometric objects and relations among them, from which we derive both the prompt and a deterministic verifier, so tasks can be generated in any number and at any chosen complexity. We release VVRBench, with 10,000 tasks over 32 constraint types, and VVRBench-Challenge, with 720 more complex tasks; the strongest model we evaluate---GPT-Image-2.5---solves 21.4% of VVRBench-Challenge. Using VVR scores as rewards for reinforcement learning (RLVVR) raises the accuracy of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium on VVRBench from 2.8% to 28.3% and demonstrates consistent easy-to-hard generalization. These gains extend to out-of-domain benchmarks, and mixing VVR into existing objectives further improves overall performance and human preference, motivating the adoption of VVR into standard image generation post-training recipes.

AI.tldr: VVR提出首个可程序化验证的图像奖励框架，用确定性验证器生成任务并训练，使图像生成中的指令跟随能力大幅提升并具备泛化性。
AI.motivation: 图像生成中精确指令跟随（如物体数量、空间关系）仍是难题，部分原因在于依赖目标检测器、视觉语言模型等不可靠的奖励模型。
AI.method: VVR将每个任务设计为几何物体及其关系的场景，从中自动导出提示词与确定性验证器，可任意数量、任意复杂度生成任务；并以此作为强化学习奖励（RLVVR）训练模型。
AI.result: 发布VVRBench（10,000个任务、32种约束）和VVRBench-Challenge（720个更难任务）；最强模型GPT-Image-2.5仅解出21.4%；RLVVR将Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium准确率从2.8%提升至28.3%，并展现易到难泛化及跨域提升。
AI.conclusion: VVR可泛化到自然提示与域外基准，且与现有目标混合可进一步提升整体性能与人类偏好，建议纳入标准图像生成后训练流程。

title: Reliability-Gated Fusion of Consumer Head and Foot IMUs for Lower-Body 3D Pose
summary: Sparse inertial pose estimation promises camera-free motion capture from consumer devices, but consumer sensors are unreliable: firmware-fused orientations are biased, mounting varies between sessions, and streams drift or drop out. On a new 35-take single-subject benchmark pairing an earbud head inertial measurement unit (IMU) with two smart-insole foot IMUs (SAM-3D-Body pseudo-ground-truth labels), we show the reliability problem is channel-level: a channel ablation isolates foot acceleration as the most informative input (66.6 mm vs. 79.0 mm head-only) and the firmware-fused foot orientation as the liability that destroys the gain. We therefore let the model learn how much to trust each channel of each stream: one temporal gate per stream per channel block, trained with an auxiliary reliability objective on synthetically corrupted pretraining data. The channel-gated model is the most accurate of our learned fusion arms on clean data (69.4 mm vs. 83.7 static, 86.6 ungated) and under every simulated fault (bias in training; drift, dropout eval-only); its gates suppress the natively biased foot-orientation channels on clean real data without test-time supervision and flag dropout bursts at 0.92-0.999 AUROC. Two contrasts: dropping a channel known a priori to fail is flat across foot faults but collapses when an unanticipated stream fails (head dropout: 92.9 vs. 79.3 mm); and a fine-tuned HMD-Poser is more accurate on clean data (64.4 mm) and nominally under drift, with no significant paired difference under bias or dropout, but a larger worst-case degradation from clean (+16.1 vs. +3.5 mm, single seed). Learning to gate reliability instead of sensor count is the lever for deployable sparse inertial capture. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/reliability-gated-imu-fusion.

AI.tldr: 稀疏惯性姿态估计受消费级传感器不可靠性影响，本文提出按通道学习可靠性门控的融合方法，在干净与故障数据上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 消费级惯性传感器不可靠：固件融合朝向有偏、佩戴方式多变、数据流漂移或丢失。作者认为可靠性问题是通道级的，需要模型自行判断每条流的每个通道可信度，而非依赖传感器数量或先验剔除。
AI.method: 构建35段单人基准，耳机头部IMU加两只智能鞋垫足部IMU（SAM-3D-Body伪真值标签）。通过通道消融定位关键输入与有害通道。方法为每条流每通道块设置时间门控，在合成损坏数据上用辅助可靠性目标预训练。对比静态融合、无门控融合、先验剔除通道及微调HMD-Poser。
AI.result: 通道消融显示足部加速度信息量最大（66.6mm vs 仅头部79.0mm），固件融合足部朝向是破坏增益的负担。通道门控模型在干净数据最准（69.4mm vs 静态83.7、无门控86.6），在所有模拟故障下最优；门控自动抑制原生有偏的足部朝向通道，无需测试时监督，并以0.92-0.999 AUROC标记丢包。对比：先验剔除失败通道在足部故障下持平，但头部丢包时崩溃（92.9 vs 79.3mm）；微调HMD-Poser干净数据更准（64.4mm）且漂移下名义更好，但偏差/丢包下无显著配对差异，最坏情况退化更大（+16.1 vs +3.5mm，单种子）。
AI.conclusion: 学习门控可靠性而非依赖传感器数量，是实现可部署稀疏惯性动作捕捉的关键。

title: PhysioTRACE: Provenance-Aware Stress Tests for Physiological Foundation Models
comment: Main text: 10 pages, 4 figures. Appendix: 31 pages with full protocol details, per-seed results, and sensitivity analysis
summary: Physiological foundation models encode how a signal was recorded alongside the physiology it reflects. When recording conditions are associated with diagnosis, this acquisition provenance can become a shortcut, yet the usual evidence, shifted transfer and provenance decodability, does not show whether a predictor uses it. We introduce PhysioTRACE, a four-axis behavioral audit for frozen encoders that separates what a probe can decode from what a fixed task head relies on. Recover scores how decodable provenance is; Stress reverses only the provenance-target association on the same held-out records; Intervene removes a train-localized provenance component; and Verify certifies that removal only if it beats matched random projections within a declared utility margin. Each audit thus ends in one of three verdicts: no reliance, or reliance with the remedy certified or refused. Across EEG and ECG, five training objectives, and five frozen foundation models, the relation between Recover's calibrated score and out-of-distribution utility changes sign between datasets, so neither can stand in for a reliance test. On paired EEG views where the shortcut is known by construction, the audit detects it (the exposed head loses about 0.2 AUROC when the association is reversed, while a control head is unaffected) and certifies removal of a rank-two component that restores control-level behavior without measurable utility loss, for both encoder objectives tested. On real ECG device metadata it returns all three verdicts: it certifies a remedy that removes 91% of one model's excess vulnerability, finds no reliance where device and diagnosis are barely associated, and refuses the remedy for a second model whose localized direction also carries task signal. Robustness to how inputs were recorded therefore needs a behavioral test, and PhysioTRACE provides one that can pass, fail, or refuse a remedy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PhysioTRACE，一个针对冻结生理信号编码器的四轴行为审计框架，用于区分"探针可解码"与"任务头实际依赖"的采集来源(provenance)捷径，并给出明确判定。
AI.motivation: 生理基础模型同时编码了记录条件(采集来源)与生理信息，当记录条件与诊断相关时，来源信息会变成捷径。但传统证据(迁移偏移、可解码性)无法证明预测器是否真正依赖该捷径，因此需要行为层面的依赖测试。
AI.method: 提出四轴审计：Recover 度量来源可解码性；Stress 在相同留出记录上仅反转来源-目标关联；Intervene 移除训练局部化的来源成分；Verify 仅在移除效果超过匹配随机投影且满足声明效用裕度时才认证。每次审计输出三种结论：无依赖、依赖且补救被认证、依赖但补救被拒绝。
AI.result: 在 EEG 与 ECG、五种训练目标、五个冻结基础模型上，Recover 校准分数与 OOD 效用的关系在数据集间变号，说明二者都不能代替依赖测试。已知捷径的配对 EEG 视图中审计成功检测(反转后暴露头 AUROC 降约 0.2，对照头不受影响)并认证了秩二成分移除，恢复对照水平且无效用损失。真实 ECG 设备元数据上三种结论均出现，包括移除某模型 91% 超额脆弱性、无关联时判定无依赖、以及因局部方向携带任务信号而拒绝补救。
AI.conclusion: 对输入记录方式的鲁棒性需要行为测试，PhysioTRACE 提供了可"通过、失败或拒绝补救"的检验方法。

title: Not All Thinking is Created Equal: Latent Reasoning Discovers a Recurrent Search Algorithm for Depth Generalization
summary: Large Language Models can perform multi-step reasoning and improve task performance through different forms of intermediate computation, from token-based traces to computation carried out in latent space. However, a question remains open: do these different forms of thinking rely on the same underlying mechanism? To address this, we train and compare five variants of the same GPTNeoX backbone from scratch on an extended multi-hop reasoning task (ProsQA-Ext): a vanilla model, a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) model, a Pause Token model, and two latent-reasoning models that are optimized end-to-end without intermediate reasoning traces. We find that, strong in-distribution (ID) performance does not guarantee depth generalization. Vanilla, CoT, and Pause Token models solve ID problems well, but rely largely on local graph features and generalize poorly to out-of-distribution (OOD) problems with longer hops. In contrast, latent variants generalize better and show internal dynamics consistent with forward reachability propagation on the graph. Causal interventions and circuit analysis localize this computation to a sparse recurrent search circuit in the bottleneck latent model: an attention head retrieves graph relations, an MLP and the residual stream update the reachability state across recurrent steps, while multiple attention heads together then do the candidate matching. Together, these results show that different thinking mechanisms can learn distinct computational solutions, even at similar ID performance. In this setting, latent recurrence supports a reusable forward-search algorithm that generalizes beyond the training depth.

AI.tldr: 不同"思考"形式（token痕迹 vs 潜空间计算）学习到不同计算机制；潜空间递归支持可泛化的前向搜索算法。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM中不同中间计算形式（token-based与latent space）是否依赖相同底层机制，尤其是其在多步推理中的泛化差异。
AI.method: 在同一GPTNeoX主干上从头训练五个变体（vanilla、CoT、Pause Token、两个端到端潜空间推理模型），在扩展多跳推理任务ProsQA-Ext上对比；采用因果干预与电路分析定位计算机制。
AI.result: ID性能强并不保证深度泛化：vanilla/CoT/Pause Token在ID上表现好但依赖局部图特征，OOD长跳泛化差；潜空间变体泛化更好，内部动态与前向可达性传播一致。电路分析定位到bottleneck潜空间模型中的稀疏递归搜索回路（注意力头检索关系、MLP与残差流更新可达性状态、多个注意力头做候选匹配）。
AI.conclusion: 不同思考机制即使在相似ID性能下也能学到不同的计算解；潜空间递归支持可复用前向搜索算法，可泛化超出训练深度。

title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
summary: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. Whether a revision helps is known only after it is rendered, so the reflection text and the image generation must be learned jointly, over the whole loop. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reflection trajectories gives a cold start but does not find the high-success repair paths, and naive RL that optimizes only the renderer or only one head leaves most of the gain untapped. We introduce UMM-Reflection, which applies reinforcement learning (RL) to complete reflection trajectories inside one unified model: sibling trajectories share one initial image, so the group-relative advantage compares reflection strategies, and one trajectory-level advantage updates both the reflection tokens and the flow-based revisions, avoiding the combinatorial blow-up of per-round credit assignment. Unlike single-round editing or pipelines with an external critic, credit flows across rounds and to both roles of the same model, and no verifier is needed at inference. On BAGEL, UMM-Reflection improves GenEval by 12.05 points over SFT, and the gains transfer to WISE (+10.97), OneIG-Bench (+3.48), and T2I-CompBench++ (+4.63), none of which is used in training.

AI.tldr: UMM-Reflection用强化学习在统一多模态模型内完成自反思修复轨迹，让一次轨迹级优势同时更新反思token与基于流的图像修订，从而提升生成修复成功率。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型理论上能自诊断、自修订图像，但修订是否有用需渲染后才知，因此反思文本与图像生成须在整个循环上联合学习；SFT冷启动无法找到高成功率修复路径，朴素RL只优化渲染器或单一头则收益有限。
AI.method: 将RL应用于统一模型内的完整反思轨迹：兄弟轨迹共享同一初始图像，用组相对优势比较不同反思策略；用一条轨迹级优势同时更新反思token与基于流的修订，避免逐轮信用分配的组合爆炸。信用跨轮次、跨同一模型的两种角色流动，推理时无需外部验证器。
AI.result: 在BAGEL上，GenEval比SFT提升12.05点；并迁移到未参与训练的WISE（+10.97）、OneIG-Bench（+3.48）和T2I-CompBench++（+4.63）。
AI.conclusion: 在统一多模态模型中对完整反思轨迹做强化学习，可有效打通反思与生成两种角色，实现无需外部验证器的自修复并带来跨基准泛化增益。

title: Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Policy Learning
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models point toward general-purpose robotic intelligence by unifying perception, instruction, and control. Despite impressive progress, existing VLA models often adapt poorly due to \emph{tri-modal misalignment} among vision, language, and action, which weakens action grounding and hurts generalization and fine-tuning efficiency. In this work, we present Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT), a novel framework that explicitly enforces tri-modal alignment through a dedicated alignment loss, bridging the representational gap across modalities and enhancing task adaptation. While prior research has predominantly emphasized bi-modal vision--language alignment, we systematically formalize and study tri-modal alignment in VLA models, and provide both ablations and analysis to isolate its role in improving adaptation and robustness. To further accelerate deployment, we adopt a flow-matching objective, enabling substantially fewer inference steps than diffusion-based policies while maintaining accuracy. Theoretically, we establish a quantitative connection between the tri-modal alignment gap and the optimization tightness of flow matching; empirically, experiments on the extensive benchmark show that AGFT achieves superior success rates and lower inference latency compared to SOTA baselines, underscoring tri-modal alignment as a key ingredient for scaling robust VLA manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出AGFT框架，通过专门的对齐损失显式强制视觉-语言-动作三模态对齐，结合流匹配目标实现高效VLA模型适配与推理。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型因视觉、语言、动作之间的三模态错位，导致动作接地能力弱、泛化差、微调效率低；以往研究多关注双模态视觉-语言对齐，缺乏对三模态对齐的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出Alignment-Guided Flow Transformer (AGFT)，通过专门的对齐损失显式强制三模态对齐，并采用流匹配目标加速推理；理论上建立三模态对齐差距与流匹配优化紧致性的定量联系，并通过消融与分析隔离其作用。
AI.result: 在广泛基准测试中，AGFT相比SOTA基线取得更高的成功率与更低的推理延迟，同时保持准确性。
AI.conclusion: 三模态对齐是扩展鲁棒VLA操作能力的关键要素。

title: PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents
summary: Mobile GUI agents operate through a perception--action loop: at each step they screenshot the device, invoke a vision--language model (VLM), and emit an action. It is slow, costly, and brittle, yet most of what it does is navigation---and everyday navigation is static, ordered, and endlessly repeated. We present PhoneCLI, which compiles an app's GUI navigation into callable commands, without any app-internal API, runtime instrumentation, or model training. Offline, PhoneCLI explores a target app from the outside and distills its screens, interactive elements, and navigation edges into a semantically annotated map; each screen yields one deterministic command: a replay sequence that reaches it. Online, the agent selects a command, verifies it before execution, and then executes it deterministically in sub-second time at zero VLM cost; open-ended interaction and every failure of the compiled path fall back to the embedded VLM interpreter, exactly the pure VLM agent, so compilation can only help. On AndroidLab, PhoneCLI improves the task success rate while reducing steps and token consumption, and it transfers to AndroidWorld's official M3A agent with consistent efficiency gains. What PhoneCLI compiles is the app's navigation rather than one run, so it serves new tasks, not only repeated ones.

AI.tldr: PhoneCLI将App的GUI导航编译为可调用命令，无需App内部API、运行时插桩或模型训练，离线探索构建语义地图，在线确定性执行命令，失败时回退到纯VLM代理，在AndroidLab和AndroidWorld上提升成功率并降低步骤与token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有移动GUI代理依赖"截图-VLM-动作"的感知-动作循环，速度慢、成本高且脆弱；而日常导航是静态、有序且高度重复的，大部分操作实为导航，纯VLM方式低效。
AI.method: 离线从外部探索目标App，将屏幕、交互元素和导航边蒸馏为语义标注地图，每个屏幕生成一条确定性命令（到达该屏幕的回放序列）；在线代理选择命令、执行前验证、以亚秒级零VLM成本确定性执行；开放式交互及编译路径失败时回退到内置VLM解释器。
AI.result: 在AndroidLab上提升任务成功率，同时减少步骤和token消耗；可迁移至AndroidWorld官方M3A代理并取得一致的效率提升。
AI.conclusion: PhoneCLI编译的是App的导航能力而非单次运行，因此能服务于新任务而不只是重复任务，且由于最差情况回退到纯VLM代理，编译只会带来帮助。

title: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models
summary: Modern video diffusion models require tens of denoising evaluations over long spatiotemporal token sequences. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) to just a few. However, DMD samples can degrade during training, exhibiting progressive oversaturation and artifacts. We trace this instability to critic errors, which enter successive student updates and accumulate over time. We introduce Projected Distribution Matching Distillation (PDMD) to filter critic errors. PDMD projects out the component of the DMD update parallel to the student-critic endpoint residual. At a fixed noisy query, we prove that this residual is an unbiased estimate of the critic's endpoint error. Under high-dimensional assumptions, this projection removes a constant fraction of critic error while discarding only a vanishing fraction of ideal DMD signal. Empirically, the projection stabilizes training and improves sample quality where DMD degrades and develops unnatural textures. PDMD requires only a one-line code change to DMD, with no extra loss, network, data, model pass, or multi-stage training. With Wan2.1, PDMD achieves a VBench total score of 83.73 at 4 NFE, surpassing matched DMD by 1.03 points. On MiniMax-H3 joint video-audio generation, PDMD achieves a VideoGen-Eval visual total score of 83.17, 0.41 points above the strongest distilled baseline. PDMD also achieves the best performance on all six audio metrics among the compared 4-NFE models. Qualitative comparisons and user studies favor PDMD over the distilled baselines in visual quality, motion, and audio quality. Code and models are available at https://pdmd2026.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出PDMD方法，过滤DMD训练中的critic误差累积，稳定视频扩散蒸馏并提升样本质量。
AI.motivation: DMD虽将NFE降至极少，但训练中样本退化（过饱和、伪影），根源在于critic误差在多次student更新中累积。
AI.method: PDMD将DMD更新中平行于student-critic端点残差的分量投影出去；证明该残差是critic端点误差的无偏估计，并在高维假设下证明投影去除恒定比例critic误差、仅丢弃可忽略的DMD信号。仅需一行代码修改。
AI.result: Wan2.1上4 NFE VBench总分83.73（超DMD 1.03）；MiniMax-H3视频音频生成VideoGen-Eval视觉总分83.17（超最强基线0.41），六项音频指标最优；定性对比与用户研究均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: PDMD以极小改动有效缓解DMD不稳定问题，显著提升视频及视频-音频生成的蒸馏质量。

title: Deep kernel hedging
summary: We introduce a deep kernel hedging framework that combines the flexibility of deep learning with the structural inductive bias of kernel methods. The hedging functional is restricted to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space whose kernel is parameterized through a neural network embedding of the input features. The framework minimizes a regularized empirical risk under convex loss functions and can accommodate path-dependent information through truncated time-augmented signature features. We derive a generalized representer theorem for the joint hedging problem, reducing the empirical optimization to a finite-dimensional problem. To further reduce the computational cost associated with large kernel matrices, we develop a scalable random Fourier feature approximation and establish convergence guarantees. The random Fourier parameters are sampled once and remain fixed throughout training, while the deep kernel adapts to market data through the learned neural representation. We evaluate the performance of the proposed deep kernel approach on both synthetic and real data and compare it with standard kernel methods and classical deep hedging architectures. Numerical results indicate competitive and robust hedging performance, particularly in low-data regimes, which highlights the benefits of combining expressive neural representations with the inductive bias of kernel methods.

AI.tldr: 提出深度核对冲框架，结合深度学习灵活性与核方法归纳偏置，用神经网络参数化RKHS核，并对大核矩阵做随机傅里叶特征近似。
AI.motivation: 深度对冲灵活但缺乏结构先验，核方法有归纳偏置但表达受限；希望融合二者优势，尤其在低数据场景下提升对冲性能。
AI.method: 将对冲泛函限制在由神经网络嵌入输入特征参数化的RKHS中；在凸损失下最小化正则化经验风险；通过截断时间增广签名特征引入路径依赖信息；推导广义表示定理将经验优化化为有限维问题；并用随机傅里叶特征近似降低成本，建立收敛保证。
AI.result: 推导出广义表示定理；开发可扩展随机傅里叶近似并给出收敛保证；RFF参数采样一次后固定，深度核通过学习的神经表示适应市场数据；在合成与真实数据上对比标准核方法和经典深度对冲架构，表现有竞争力且稳健，低数据场景尤佳。
AI.conclusion: 结合表达性神经表示与核方法归纳偏置的深度核对冲方法有效，尤其适合低数据场景，兼具灵活性与结构先验。

title: Verifier Errors in RLVR: Reward Hacking, Limits of Feedback, and Selective Control
summary: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), imperfect verifiers can reward incorrect responses, creating opportunities for reward hacking. Using gradient flow with a fixed verifier, we characterize the conditions under which reward rises while correctness falls. We then show that the observations available during RLVR are, in general, insufficient to detect or identify accepted errors, or to guarantee their reduction without sacrificing correct responses. To address this limit, we construct a correction using additional feedback about correctness from audits. This correction achieves \emph{selective control}: at the current policy, it lowers the probability of accepted errors and raises that of correct responses, provided it outweighs the pressure toward errors from verifier reward. Experiments with log linear and neural contextual bandits and with a language model support the analysis and show that selective control under partial auditing reduces accepted errors while increasing correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RLVR中不完美验证器导致的奖励欺骗问题，指出仅凭RLVR期间观测无法检测/识别被接受的错误或保证其减少，并提出利用审计反馈的校正方法实现"选择性控制"。
AI.motivation: 在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，不完美的验证器可能对错误回答给予奖励，从而产生奖励欺骗（reward hacking），即奖励上升但正确性下降。作者希望刻画这种现象发生的条件，并探究能否仅凭训练中可得的信息来检测或纠正此类错误。
AI.method: 使用固定验证器下的梯度流分析，刻画"奖励上升而正确性下降"的条件；论证RLVR期间可得观测一般不足以检测、识别被接受的错误或在不损害正确回答的前提下保证其减少；进而构造一个利用来自审计（audits）的额外正确性反馈的校正项，实现选择性控制（selective control）。
AI.result: 分析表明RLVR观测的固有局限；所提校正能在当前策略下降低被接受错误的概率并提高正确回答的概率，前提是校正压力超过验证器奖励带来的错误压力。在log-linear和神经上下文赌博机以及语言模型上的实验支持该分析，并显示部分审计下的选择性控制可减少被接受错误同时提升正确性。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠RLVR自带信息无法有效对抗奖励欺骗；引入部分审计反馈的校正可实现选择性控制，在减少被接受错误的同时提升正确性，为缓解RLVR中的reward hacking提供了可行方向。

title: FurE: Efficient Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction without Animal-Fur Datasets
comment: 14 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://toshi2k2.github.io/fure
summary: Realistic and editable animal fur reconstruction from multi-view images is challenging due to fine-scale detail, self-occlusion and obfuscation, and, unlike human hair, the lack of animal-fur datasets. Fur usually covers most of an animal's body, with large inter-species and intra-species variability. We present FurE, an efficient strand-based animal fur reconstruction method that recovers a per-strand, editable groom by optimizing a root-conditioned latent field, decoded into strand geometry via a PCA-based decoder. We reconstruct a defurred animal body using local fur-thickness cues from a surface-constrained Gaussian Frosting representation together with part-based priors. We further show that a PCA-based decoder learned from human-hair strand data can alleviate animal-data scarcity while enabling substantially faster optimization. FurE achieves a 10x speedup in strand training over current SOTA dense per-strand optimization while retaining strand fidelity and generalizing across synthetic and real-world sequences, with quantitative and qualitative validation despite the reduction in training time.

AI.tldr: FurE 提出一种基于发束的动物毛发重建方法，通过优化根条件潜场并结合 PCA 解码器实现高效、可编辑的毛发重建。
AI.motivation: 动物毛发重建面临细粒度细节、自遮挡与混淆，以及缺乏动物毛发数据集的挑战，且毛发覆盖大部分身体，物种间和种内差异大。
AI.method: 优化根条件潜场，通过基于 PCA 的解码器解码为发束几何；利用表面约束的 Gaussian Frosting 表示中的局部毛发厚度线索及部件先验重建去毛动物身体；从人类头发数据学习 PCA 解码器以缓解数据稀缺。
AI.result: 发束训练相比当前 SOTA 密集逐发束优化实现 10 倍加速，同时保持发束保真度，并泛化到合成和真实序列，经定量与定性验证。
AI.conclusion: FurE 是一种高效、可编辑的动物毛发重建方法，能在显著减少训练时间的同时保持重建质量并广泛泛化。

title: Causal Routing for Unlearning
summary: LLMs cannot forget the way we delete a file. Strangely, we are asked to remove something that was never put anywhere in particular. What the model took from a piece of text is now smeared across billions of weights. Existing methods rewrite all of them to change one thing, and none of them say which part produced that change. To address this, we introduce Causal Routing for Unlearning (CRU) by asking where the concept is expressed in the model and suppressing only that part. One untrained forward pass over the forget set ranks neurons by how their activations vary. Then, small routing modules on those neurons gate and suppress only the concepts that need to be forgotten. In CRU, the base model is frozen, and any change in behavior is caused only by the gated neurons; hence, why the routing is causal. Due to our parameter efficiency (only ~0.01% as many parameters as the base model), unlearning a concept costs 14 GiB, whereas the baselines require 71 GiB. On TOFU, CRU is indistinguishable from the retained model (p > 0.05, KS test) and is never Pareto-dominated, whereas every compared baseline matches its forgetting on the larger-forget batches only by collapsing utility. On RWKU, it achieves an adversarial-probe recall of 0.052, compared to 0.250 for the strongest baseline, meaning the knowledge is gone, not merely harder to reach. Thus, deciding on the intervention at query time, rather than fixing it beforehand, is the axis along which we argue that unlearning should proceed.

AI.tldr: 提出CRU（因果路由遗忘），通过定位并门控与概念相关的神经元实现参数高效的机器遗忘，仅改动极少量参数即可使知识真正消失而非难以访问。
AI.motivation: LLM的信息分散在数十亿权重中，无法像删文件一样遗忘；现有方法需重写全部权重，且无法说明哪部分导致了变化，存在参数与计算开销大、效用崩溃等问题。
AI.method: CRU先对遗忘集做一次未训练的前向传播，根据神经元激活变化程度对其排序；随后在这些神经元上添加小型路由模块，门控并抑制需遗忘的概念。基座模型保持冻结，行为改变仅由被门控神经元引起，因而具有因果性；且参数仅约基座模型的0.01%。
AI.result: 遗忘一个概念仅需14 GiB（基线需71 GiB）。在TOFU上，CRU与保留模型无显著差异（p>0.05，KS检验），且从不受帕累托支配；基线的较大遗忘批次则以效用崩溃换取遗忘。在RWKU上，对抗探针召回率仅0.052，最强基线为0.250，表明知识已被移除而非仅难以触及。
AI.conclusion: 应在查询时决定干预方式，而非事先固定干预，这是遗忘研究应遵循的方向。

title: Report: Progressive Disclosure of Agent Skills
summary: Users of Workday's deployed LLM-based agents often request features which can be addressed by defining named procedures, also known as skills, in the LLM context, effectively augmenting agents' capabilities. However, as an agent's skills library grows in size, so does the agent's operational cost. Progressive disclosure (lazy-loading) of skills as needed may reduce operational costs, but its impact on overall latency and skill-retrieval quality remains unclear. In this report, we investigate the impact empirically and find that progressive disclosure improves skill-retrieval quality but marginally degrades overall latency.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM智能体技能库的渐进式披露（懒加载）对延迟与技能检索质量的影响，发现其提升检索质量但略微增加总体延迟。
AI.motivation: Workday部署的LLM智能体通过定义命名技能（程序）扩展能力，但技能库增大导致运营成本上升，而渐进式披露对延迟和检索质量的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 对渐进式披露（懒加载）进行实证研究，按需加载技能并评估其对技能检索质量与总体延迟的影响。
AI.result: 渐进式披露提升了技能检索质量，但略微降低了总体延迟表现（即延迟略微增加）。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式披露可在可接受的延迟代价下改善技能检索质量，为降低运营成本提供了可行方案。

title: Learn Here, Move Less Elsewhere: Input-Conditioned Plasticity from Retained-Domain Activation Atlases
summary: Task-specific fine-tuning can rewrite a language model's answers beyond the training task, complicating updates that must preserve existing behavior. We introduce ATLAS, which turns retained-domain representations into an input-dependent rule for task adaptation. An activation atlas supplies local reference centers and directional filters to a shared low-rank residual. Target supervision learns the residual, while retained geometry shapes its action throughout training and inference. On Qwen3-8B, ATLAS achieves lower mean retained-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence than all seven published baselines at shared coding-performance requirements, with consistent advantages across multiple training seeds. Structural comparisons identify the contributions of retained reference states and directional conditioning, and answer-level analyses show fewer rewritten mathematical answers and more stable commonsense choices. Experiments spanning five backbones and two retained domains further demonstrate coding gains with reduced retained-output movement. With compact storage and modest decoding overhead, ATLAS provides a practical mechanism for acquiring specialized skills while maintaining continuity in existing responses.

AI.tldr: ATLAS 将保留域表征转化为输入相关的任务适配规则，在微调中获取新技能同时保持原有行为。
AI.motivation: 任务特定微调会改写模型在训练任务之外的回答，导致更新难以保留既有行为，需要在学习新技能时维持原有响应连续性。
AI.method: 构建激活图谱提供局部参考中心与方向滤波器，作用于共享低秩残差；目标监督学习残差，保留域几何在训练和推理全程塑造其作用。ATLAS 实现输入依赖的任务适配。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，相同编码性能要求下，ATLAS 的保留输出 KL 散度低于全部七个已发表基线，且跨多个训练种子一致；结构对比验证了保留参考状态与方向条件的作用；答案级分析显示数学答案改写更少、常识选择更稳定。跨五个骨干和两个保留域也验证了编码增益与保留输出变动降低。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS 存储紧凑、解码开销适中，为获取专业技能同时保持既有响应连续性提供实用机制。

title: Reasoning with Continuous Latent Diffusion
summary: Continuous diffusion generates complete reasoning solutions through iterative refinement in latent space. We introduce Latent Flow Reasoning Models (LFRMs), an ELF-based training and inference recipe. Our experiments show that accurate decoding alone does not ensure strong reasoning performance. We therefore learn compact representations from multiple layers of a strong autoregressive teacher. Their decomposition also enables asynchronous denoising at different rates. We show that prompt encodings need only preserve the information required for the correct text-conditional score, rather than exactly match teacher features, and use a staged curriculum to learn a compact prompt encoder that replaces the teacher Transformer at inference. We adapt DiffusionNFT to learned self-conditioning guidance and incorporate gold-solution endpoints to supplement sparse rewards. Our supervised models outperform reported results from recent continuous-diffusion baselines at comparable backbone scales on mathematical reasoning and HumanEval code generation. With a 638M-parameter denoising backbone and learned prompt conditioning, post-NFT LFRM-L achieves 63.74% pass@1 on GSM8K and 24.6% on MATH500 at 64 denoising steps, and 32.85% on HumanEval and 30.18% on HumanEval+ at 128 denoising steps. Code will be available at: https://github.com/chengxiang/LFRM

AI.tldr: 提出Latent Flow Reasoning Models (LFRMs)，基于ELF的训练与推理方案，用连续扩散在潜空间迭代精炼生成推理，性能优于近期连续扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散可生成完整推理方案，但仅靠准确解码不足以保证强推理性能，需改进表示学习与训练策略。
AI.method: 从强自回归教师的多层学习紧凑表示，支持异步去噪；提出仅需保留正确文本条件分数信息的提示编码，并用分阶段课程学习紧凑提示编码器替代教师Transformer；将DiffusionNFT适配到学习的自条件引导，并加入金标解端点补充稀疏奖励。
AI.result: 监督模型在数学推理与HumanEval代码生成上超过近期连续扩散基线。LFRM-L（638M去噪骨干）post-NFT在GSM8K达63.74% pass@1，MATH500达24.6%（64步）；HumanEval达32.85%，HumanEval+达30.18%（128步）。
AI.conclusion: LFRM验证了潜空间连续扩散结合分层表示、异步去噪与改进强化学习引导可有效提升推理性能，代码将开源。

title: FlexLoop: Depth-Elastic Looped Policies for Adaptive Test-Time Computation in Deep RL
summary: Looped architectures scale computation by reusing the same parameters across recurrent steps, and recent work shows that they substantially improve deep reinforcement learning policies on long-horizon tasks. Since recurrent depth directly controls computation, one may expect looped policies to naturally support elastic inference across recurrent depths. Surprisingly, we find that pretrained looped policies exhibit severe recurrent-depth specialization: reliable decisions are concentrated near the full trained depth, tying deployment computation to this depth even when less computation may suffice. Achieving depth elasticity, i.e., reliable decisions across recurrent depths with adaptive computation at deployment, therefore remains a key challenge. To address this, we propose FlexLoop, a novel post-training framework that converts pretrained fixed-depth looped policies into depth-elastic policies. FlexLoop keeps training on the original RL objective to preserve full-depth capability while performing adjacent-depth policy distillation to progressively transfer decision quality from deeper to shallower recurrent steps. The resulting policy supports reliable inference across recurrent depths and enables state-wise adaptive inference through recurrent-depth consistency. Experiments on $30$ online and offline long-horizon goal-conditioned environments show that FlexLoop preserves full-depth performance while making shallower depths effective. Keeping competitive performance, FlexLoop reduces average recurrent depth by up to $\bf{43\%}$ and achieves up to $\bf{1.34\times}$ wall-clock speedup in a stress test.

AI.tldr: 循环架构通过复用参数扩展计算，但预训练的循环策略存在严重的循环深度特化，决策质量集中在完整训练深度附近。作者提出FlexLoop，一种后训练框架，通过相邻深度策略蒸馏将固定深度循环策略转为深度弹性策略，在30个长时域任务上保持全深度性能的同时降低最多43%平均循环深度，实现1.34倍加速。
AI.motivation: 循环策略理论上应自然支持弹性推理，但实际发现预训练策略的可靠决策集中在完整训练深度附近，导致部署计算被绑定在该深度，即使更少计算可能已足够。因此需要实现深度弹性（跨循环深度的可靠决策与自适应计算）。
AI.method: 提出FlexLoop后训练框架：继续用原始RL目标训练以保留全深度能力，同时进行相邻深度策略蒸馏，将决策质量从较深循环步逐步迁移到较浅循环步，从而实现跨深度可靠推理及基于循环深度一致性的逐状态自适应推理。
AI.result: 在30个在线与离线长时域目标条件环境中，FlexLoop保持全深度性能，同时使较浅深度有效；在保持竞争性性能的前提下，平均循环深度最多降低43%，压力测试中实现最多1.34倍墙钟加速。
AI.conclusion: FlexLoop能有效解决循环策略的深度特化问题，实现深度弹性与自适应推理，在不牺牲性能的情况下显著减少部署计算并加速推理。

title: When Less Data Favors Smaller Teachers: Rethinking Teacher Capacity and Data Selection for Knowledge Distillation
summary: Data pruning reduces the training cost of knowledge distillation (KD). However, the preferred teacher capacity changes with the data budget: smaller teachers can outperform larger ones when limited training data are available. Understanding what drives this shift is important not only for teacher choice but also for identifying which samples are useful for distillation. We analyze teacher supervision by decomposing it into relational ordering---the ranking of classes---and score geometry---the magnitudes and margins of class probabilities---and show that the small-teacher advantage in the low-data regime arises not only from score geometry but also from relational ordering. Beyond understanding teacher capacity, our analysis reveals two properties of effective subsets: samples should match the difficulty appropriate for the available budget, and their relational signals should be diverse rather than redundant. Based on these findings, we propose DVA (Difficulty- and Volume-Aware data selection for KD), a training-dynamics-free method, which uses a small teacher as a proxy for budget-aware difficulty filtering and class-conditional relational volume maximization. Despite requiring no training dynamics statistics, our method remains competitive with training-dynamics-based methods while consistently outperforming training-dynamics-free baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文分析知识蒸馏中数据剪枝下教师容量与数据预算的关系，提出无需训练动态的DVA数据选择方法。
AI.motivation: 数据剪枝可降低知识蒸馏训练成本，但最优教师容量随数据预算变化：数据少时小教师可能优于大教师。理解这一转变的驱动因素，对选择教师和识别有用样本具有重要意义。
AI.method: 将教师监督分解为关系排序（类别排序）和分数几何（概率幅度与边际），分析低数据场景下小教师优势的来源；据此提出DVA方法，用小教师作为代理进行预算感知的难度过滤，并进行类别条件的关系体积最大化。
AI.result: 发现小教师优势不仅来自分数几何，也来自关系排序；有效子集应匹配预算难度，且关系信号应多样而非冗余。DVA无需训练动态统计，仍与基于训练动态的方法竞争力相当，并持续优于无训练动态基线。
AI.conclusion: 教师监督的关系排序与分数几何共同解释小教师优势，DVA为KD数据选择提供了高效且有效的无训练动态方案。

title: Failure-Transparent Agents: Benchmarking Post-Failure Reporting in Tool-Using Language Models
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2027)
summary: Tool-using agents can fail twice: a required tool can fail, and the agent can then report success without the evidence needed to justify it. Existing benchmarks often entangle this reporting failure with tool selection, recovery, and environment dynamics. We introduce Failure-Transparent Agents (FTA), a controlled benchmark that fixes the failed observation and required evidence state before generation, making post-failure claims directly auditable. FTA contains 100 tasks with deterministic failure traces spanning five failure families, a neutral control, and four user-pressure conditions, and evaluates unsupported claims alongside useful recovery. Across six models, three response policies, and 3,600 human-annotated responses, false-success rates are 22.8% under the baseline policy, 9.3% with a transparency instruction, and 0.8% with a structured evidence contract. Fabricated-detail rates decrease from 28.3% to 14.3% and 0.8%, while useful responses increase from 74.9% to 89.2% and 98.8%, respectively. The tested evidence-contract policy is associated with substantially lower post-failure reporting errors while useful-response rates remain high within this blocked-task benchmark.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FTA基准，将失败观察与证据状态固定，使工具失败后的虚报成功可直接审计。结果显示结构化证据契约能大幅降低伪成功与编造细节率，且有用回复率保持高位。
AI.motivation: 工具型智能体存在双重失败：工具本身失败，以及智能体在缺乏证据时仍报告成功。现有基准将这种报告失败与工具选择、恢复和环境动态混在一起，难以单独度量。
AI.method: 构建FTA受控基准：生成前固定失败观察与所需证据状态；含100个任务、确定性失败轨迹，覆盖五类失败族、一个中性对照和四种用户施压条件；评估不支持声明与有用恢复。测试六个模型、三种回复策略、3600条人工标注回复。
AI.result: 伪成功率：基线22.8%，透明指令9.3%，结构化证据契约0.8%；编造细节率从28.3%降至14.3%和0.8%；有用回复率从74.9%升至89.2%和98.8%。
AI.conclusion: 在该受阻任务基准中，证据契约策略与显著更低的事后报告错误相关，同时有用回复率仍保持很高。

title: M3OS: A Monte Carlo Graph Search-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM System for Evidence-Traced Molecular Optimization
summary: Small-molecule optimization integrates medicinal-chemistry reasoning and computational evidence through iterative, multi-objective decisions. When large language models (LLMs) reason over optimization histories stored primarily in conversational context, they must recover candidate identities, prior evaluations, and task constraints to guide subsequent decisions. We present M3OS, a multi-agent LLM system that decouples molecular-design reasoning from optimization-state management through Monte Carlo graph search. A persistent graph links evaluated candidates, parent-child transformations and evaluation evidence, while rewards and visit statistics guide LLM-assisted parent selection. Two branches combine tool-driven candidate generation with knowledge- and case-guided medicinal-chemistry editing. An execution harness controls graph updates through structured output extraction, molecular validation and task-bound evaluation. Agents receive role-specific contexts, while the graph preserves optimization trajectories beyond their active contexts. Across three molecular optimization benchmarks, M3OS achieves higher success rates than baselines, supporting the integration of persistent search state, specialized agents and controlled execution for multi-constraint optimization.

AI.tldr: M3OS是一个多智能体LLM系统，通过蒙特卡洛图搜索将分子设计推理与优化状态管理解耦，在三个分子优化基准上取得更高成功率。
AI.motivation: 当LLM在对话上下文中推理优化历史时，需恢复候选分子身份、先前评估和任务约束以指导后续决策，现有方式受限于上下文管理。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡洛图搜索：持久化图连接候选分子、父子变换与评估证据；奖励与访问统计指导LLM辅助父节点选择；两条分支结合工具驱动的候选生成与知识/案例引导的化学编辑；执行框架通过结构化输出提取、分子验证和任务约束评估控制图更新。
AI.result: 在三个分子优化基准上，M3OS的成功率高于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 验证了持久搜索状态、专用智能体和受控执行对多约束分子优化的有效集成。

title: LLN: Learnable Lens Networks for Parameter-Efficient Long-Horizon Dynamical Prediction
summary: Explicit residual connections of the form (x+f(x)), often combined with normalization layers, have become a standard strategy for training very deep neural networks. However, residual addition primarily provides an algebraic shortcut for gradient propagation, while leaving the evolution of feature geometry across layers largely unconstrained. We introduce Learnable Lens Networks (LLN), a physics-inspired architecture that replaces direct feature-space residual accumulation with learnable optical transport in an augmented position-angle phase space. Each layer alternates between free propagation, which provides an implicit transport path, and a learnable lens field that performs nonlinear trajectory transformation and focusing. Theoretically, we establish that LLN transport is globally invertible and volume-preserving for any differentiable lens field, with the implemented coordinate-wise Gaussian transport further satisfying symplecticity. Importantly, these structural constraints do not limit expressivity: with unrestricted embeddings and readouts, LLN retain universal approximation of continuous end-to-end maps. Experiments across diverse dynamical systems demonstrate that LLN improves long-horizon prediction while using substantially fewer parameters than same-depth comparators. Further analysis reveals stable depth-wise gradient transport and interpretable learned dynamics under the coupled propagation and refraction design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可学习透镜网络（LLN），用位置-角度相空间中的可学习光学传输替代传统残差累加，在保持全局可逆、保体积（及辛结构）约束下实现更优的长时程预测且参数更少。
AI.motivation: 传统残差连接 (x+f(x)) 主要提供梯度传播的代数捷径，但对特征几何随层演化缺乏约束，因此需要一种新的架构来更好地控制深度特征传输。
AI.method: LLN 受物理启发，在增广的位置-角度相空间中进行可学习光学传输；每层交替执行自由传播（隐式传输路径）与可学习透镜场（非线性轨迹变换与聚焦），替代直接的特征空间残差累加。
AI.result: 理论上证明 LLN 传输对任意可微透镜场全局可逆且保体积，坐标高斯传输还满足辛性，且不损失通用逼近能力；实验中在多种动力系统上提升长时程预测并显著减少参数量，同时呈现稳定的逐层梯度传输与可解释的学得动力学。
AI.conclusion: LLN 通过显式引入特征几何传输约束，在保持表达力与结构优势的同时，为深层网络提供更稳定、可解释且高效的学习范式。

title: FinAutoRubric: Expert-Guided Automatic Rubric Generation for Evaluating Financial Research Agents
summary: Evaluating finance research agents requires rubrics that reflect expert standards and fix the values correct as of an information cutoff. Expert-reviewed finance benchmarks rely on fixed, per-item rubrics, which are costly to extend and cannot encode each institution's own standard. In FinAutoRubric, experts specify reusable evaluation guidance, while agents and code carry out query-specific rubric generation, review, and validation. This expert guidance governs every agent, as prompts and as rules that code enforces, and a Task Bank of reusable criteria carries it across tasks. In long-horizon loops that follow the expert guidance, a writer agent researches every expected value and a reviewer agent verifies it, and failures escalate to a human. On three expert-authored finance benchmarks, its rubrics track expert scoring as closely as the strongest evaluated generator while stating the expert rubric's expected value for more criteria, their scores agree with human grading, and in-house analysts prefer them in a blind review. The released 100-query FinAutoRubric Benchmark, built from in-house analysts' key questions across 78 tasks and eight asset classes, shows that rubrics from an earlier model generation still leave headroom for a later one.

AI.tldr: FinAutoRubric 提出专家指导的可复用评测框架，用智能体自动生成、审查和验证金融研究评分量表，替代昂贵固定的逐项量表，并发布 100 查询基准。
AI.motivation: 专家评审的金融基准依赖固定逐项量表，扩展成本高，且无法编码各机构自身标准。
AI.method: 专家提供可复用评测指导，作为提示和代码规则约束所有智能体；通过 Task Bank 跨任务传递标准。长周期循环中，writer 智能体研究每个期望值，reviewer 智能体验证，失败升级至人工；实现查询特定量表的生成、审查与验证。
AI.result: 在三个专家撰写的金融基准上，其量表评分与最强基线生成器接近，且在更多标准上给出专家量表的期望值；评分与人工一致，内部分析师盲审中更偏好。发布的 100 查询基准覆盖 78 个任务、8 类资产，显示较早模型生成的量表仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 专家指导驱动的自动量表生成可贴近专家标准并支持机构定制，是金融研究智能体评测的可扩展方案。

title: QAMM: Adjoint MeanFlow Matching for Few-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Flow policies can model rich action distributions, but their iterative sampling limits decision speed. Adjoint matching uses the critic's action gradient to improve a flow policy without backpropagating through its sampling trajectory, yet its supervision is defined for instantaneous velocities. We propose QAMM, a method that turns the critic-derived adjoint signal into supervision for MeanFlow's average velocity. The resulting policy learns finite-interval transport directly and generates actions with few network evaluations. We derive the adjoint MeanFlow target, specify its gradient boundaries, and train it with an offline actor-critic. On ten HumanoidMaze tasks, QAMM produces effective two-call policies and achieves competitive performance against strong flow-policy baselines. These results show that adjoint-based Q optimization can be combined with average-velocity learning to obtain expressive offline policies with few-step action generation.

AI.tldr: QAMM将critic的adjoint信号转为MeanFlow平均速度监督，实现少步动作生成的离线策略。
AI.motivation: Flow策略能建模丰富动作分布，但迭代采样拖慢决策；Adjoint matching避免对采样轨迹反传，却只定义于瞬时速度。
AI.method: 将critic导出的adjoint信号转化为MeanFlow平均速度监督，推导adjoint MeanFlow目标并明确梯度边界，用离线actor-critic训练。
AI.result: 在十个HumanoidMaze任务上产生有效的two-call策略，性能与强flow策略基线相当。
AI.conclusion: adjoint-based Q优化可与平均速度学习结合，获得表达力强、少步生成动作的离线策略。

title: SciFlow-Bench: Evaluating Structure-Aware Scientific Diagram Generation via Inverse Parsing
summary: Scientific diagrams convey explicit structural information, yet modern text-to-image models often produce visually plausible but structurally incorrect results. Existing benchmarks either rely on image-centric or subjective metrics insensitive to structure, or evaluate intermediate symbolic representations rather than final rendered images, leaving pixel-based diagram generation underexplored. We introduce SciFlow-Bench, a structure-first benchmark for evaluating scientific diagram generation directly from pixel-level outputs. Built from real scientific PDFs, SciFlow-Bench pairs each source framework figure with a canonical ground-truth graph and evaluates models as black-box image generators under a closed-loop, round-trip protocol that inverse-parses generated diagram images back into structured graphs for comparison. This design enforces evaluation by structural recoverability rather than visual similarity alone, and is enabled by a hierarchical multi-agent system that coordinates planning, perception, and structural reasoning. Experiments show that preserving structural correctness remains a fundamental challenge, particularly for diagrams with complex topology, underscoring the need for structure-aware evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SciFlow-Bench，一个以结构为先的科学图表生成基准，直接从像素输出评估生成图表的结构正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型生成的科学图表视觉上合理但结构常出错；既有基准要么用对结构不敏感的图像/主观指标，要么评估中间符号表示而非最终渲染图像，导致像素级图表生成评估不足。
AI.method: 基于真实科学 PDF，将每张框架图与规范真值图配对；采用闭环往返协议，把生成图像反解析回结构化图再比较，以结构可恢复性评估黑盒模型；由层级多智能体系统协调规划、感知与结构推理。
AI.result: 实验表明保持结构正确性仍是根本挑战，尤其是复杂拓扑图表，凸显结构感知评估的必要性。
AI.conclusion: SciFlow-Bench 推动科学图表生成评估从视觉相似转向结构可恢复性，强调需发展结构感知的生成与评估方法。

title: Scalable GNN-based Knowledge Graph Representation Learning with Efficient Message Passing
comment: Accepted at the Posters and Demos Track of the International Semantic Web Conference (ISWC) 2026
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) excel at representation learning on Knowledge Graphs (KGs), achieving stateof-the-art performance on tasks like link prediction or entity classification. However, their high computational complexity, inherent to their user-defined message passing (MP) algorithm, still prohibits their widespread adoption, especially for large KGs. Current efforts to mitigate the scalability bottlenecks of GNNs on KGs, such as subgraph sampling, are often task- and model-specific, and do not reliably guarantee lossless (if applicable) runtime/space reductions. To address this, we extend Relational Sparse Matrix Multiplication (RSPMM), originally designed to losslessly lower the space complexity of composition-based MP with pointwise composition functions, to support more expressive functions (e.g., 2x2 block-diagonal matrix multiplication, Givens rotation, circular correlation). Our method delivers significant task-independent reductions in runtime and space for current GNNs on KGs and facilitates efficient re-implementations of GNNs that maintain near state-of-the-art performance on challenging KG tasks, for a fraction of computational costs.

AI.tldr: 扩展RSPMM以支持更具表达力的组合函数，从而在知识图谱GNN中实现与任务无关的运行时和空间缩减。
AI.motivation: GNN在知识图谱任务上表现优异，但其消息传递算法计算复杂度高，难以在大规模KG上推广。现有子图采样等方法往往依赖任务和模型，无法可靠保证无损的运行时/空间缩减。
AI.method: 将原本用于支持点式组合函数的RSPMM（关系稀疏矩阵乘法）扩展，以支持更具表达力的函数，如2x2块对角矩阵乘法、Givens旋转和循环相关。
AI.result: 该方法为KG上的GNN带来显著且与任务无关的运行时和空间缩减，并能高效重新实现GNN，在具挑战性的KG任务上以极低计算成本保持接近最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 扩展后的RSPMM可无损降低KG上GNN的计算开销，兼顾效率与性能。

title: Distribution-Conditioned Task Routing for Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Parameter-efficient adaptation enables continual learners to acquire task-specific knowledge through compact model updates while maintaining strong within-task performance. However, class-incremental inference requires each input to be classified among all classes seen so far without access to its task identity. For learners equipped with task-specific parameter-efficient modules, this introduces a critical task-routing challenge beyond catastrophic forgetting. We study post-hoc task routing without retraining the learner or introducing a separately trained router. Such training-free inference-time calibration remains comparatively underexplored in parameter-efficient class-incremental learning. We identify three sources of routing error (feature-level, task-level, and class-level misalignment) and propose Feature Distribution Calibration (FDC). Its three components address these misalignments: Task Subspace Filtering (TSF) suppresses feature components outside each task's principal subspace, Residual Likelihood Calibration (RLC) evaluates the typicality of its subspace residual, and Prototype Affinity Calibration (PAC) measures compatibility with the task's class prototypes. Experiments demonstrate plug-and-play applicability to eight parameter-efficient class-incremental methods using a shared encoder. With one component configuration selected per method across all five benchmarks, FDC improves final accuracy in all 40 method-dataset pairs by 4.39 percentage points on average. Enabling all components improves 35 of the 40 pairs, with an average gain of 4.45 points. When applied to a simple baseline, FDC achieves strong overall performance.

AI.tldr: 论文研究参数高效类增量学习中的免训练任务路由问题，提出特征分布校准（FDC）方法，通过三个组件解决特征、任务、类别层面的对齐偏差，在40个方法-数据集组合上平均提升4.39个百分点。
AI.motivation: 类增量推理时需在无任务身份的情况下对所有已见类别分类，使用任务特定参数高效模块的学习器面临任务路由挑战。现有方法多聚焦灾难性遗忘，而免训练的事后任务路由（不重训学习器、不引入单独路由器）在参数高效类增量学习中尚缺乏探索。
AI.method: 提出FDC（Feature Distribution Calibration），识别三类路由误差来源（特征级、任务级、类别级错位），并对应设计三个组件：任务子空间过滤（TSF）抑制任务主子空间外的特征成分；残差似然校准（RLC）评估其子空间残差的典型性；原型亲和度校准（PAC）测量与任务类原型的兼容性。
AI.result: 在共享编码器下，FDC可即插即用地应用于8种参数高效类增量方法，在全部5个基准上每种方法选一套组件配置，40个方法-数据集组合最终准确率平均提升4.39个百分点；启用全部组件在35/40组合上提升，平均提升4.45个百分点；应用于简单基线也能取得较强整体性能。
AI.conclusion: FDC是一种无需重训、即插即用的推理时校准方案，有效缓解参数高效类增量学习中的任务路由误差，具有广泛适用性和稳定增益。

title: KiT: A Foundation Model for Financial Time-Series Forecasting using DiffusionTransformers
summary: Financial candlestick forecasting is fundamental to quantitative investment, yet it remains exceptionally challenging due to extremely low signal-to-noise ratios and vast heterogeneity across markets and instruments. Existing approaches have largely attempted to introduce deep learning to capture hidden temporal features, but most adopt an auto-regressive formulation, which leads to error accumulation during inference. Meanwhile, general-purpose time-series foundation models are not tailored to the unique structure of k-line data and yield unsatisfactory performance on downstream candlestick forecasting tasks. To tackle these problems, we introduce KiT, a K-line Diffusion Transformer foundation model, and reformulate future prediction as conditional path generation via flow matching: given a historical context window, the model generates an ensemble of plausible future OHLCV trajectories. We pre-train KiT at multiple parameter scales on billions of candlestick bars spanning multiple markets and timescales. Across three markets and seven resolutions, KiT attains a mean return RankIC of 0.057 and a mean volatility RankIC of 0.66, leading at every timescale and outperforming both task-specific financial forecasters and general time-series foundation models. Code will be available at: https://github.com/Luciferbobo/KiT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KiT，一个K线扩散Transformer基础模型，将未来预测重构为基于流匹配的条件路径生成，生成未来OHLCV轨迹集合，在多市场多尺度上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 金融K线预测信噪比极低且市场异质性大；现有深度学习方法多采用自回归范式导致推理时误差累积，而通用时序基础模型未针对K线数据结构定制，下游表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出KiT（K-line Diffusion Transformer）基础模型，将未来预测重构为条件路径生成，采用flow matching，在给定历史上下文窗口下生成多组未来OHLCV轨迹；在跨多市场、多时间尺度的数十亿K线数据上以多种参数规模预训练。
AI.result: 在三个市场、七种分辨率上，KiT取得平均收益RankIC 0.057、平均波动率RankIC 0.66，在每个时间尺度上均领先，优于任务专用金融预测模型和通用时序基础模型。
AI.conclusion: KiT通过扩散/流匹配的生成式范式有效缓解误差累积问题，并针对K线数据定制，展示了作为金融K线预测基础模型的潜力。

title: HALO: Enhancing Time Series Generation via Hyperspherical Latents and Masked AutoregRessive Modeling
summary: Most existing time series generators rely on a two-stage modeling paradigm: the first stage learns discrete latent representations of time series; the second stage performs autoregressive modeling on these discrete latents through next token prediction. However, this paradigm suffers from two stage-specific limitations: the first stage can lead to information loss when discretizing continuous time series, while the second stage is prone to error accumulation during autoregressive generation. To address these limitations, our core idea is to perform generative modeling in a continuous latent space with a more efficient autoregressive framework. We propose HALO, which enhances time series generation via Hyperspherical Latents and Masked Autoregressive modeling to achieve this goal by tackling two key bottlenecks: (1) variance and scale heterogeneity of continuous latent representations; (2) the difficulty of balancing generation efficiency with temporal correlation modeling. HALO first introduces a hyperspherical VAE that constrains continuous latents to a fixed-radius hyperspherical shell, effectively stabilizing the numerical fluctuations of continuous latent representations. Secondly, we develop a masked autoregressive model that balances parallel decoding and temporal correlation learning, substantially reducing the number of inference steps required for generation and improving generation stability. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that HALO achieves state-of-the-art generation performance while offering significantly improved inference efficiency over existing advanced baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出HALO，用超球面隐变量和掩码自回归在连续隐空间中生成时间序列，解决离散化信息损失和误差累积问题。
AI.motivation: 现有两阶段范式：先学习离散隐表示，再做自回归下一token预测。局限在于：第一阶段离散化连续时间序列造成信息损失；第二阶段自回归生成易误差累积。
AI.method: 在连续隐空间进行生成建模，采用更高效的自回归框架。HALO针对两个瓶颈：(1)连续隐表示的方差与尺度异质性；(2)生成效率与时间相关性建模的平衡。方法包括超球面VAE，将连续隐变量约束到固定半径超球面壳上以稳定数值波动；以及掩码自回归模型，平衡并行解码与时间相关性学习。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HALO达到最先进生成性能，同时推理效率显著优于现有先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 在连续隐空间结合超球面约束与掩码自回归，可同时提升时间序列生成质量与推理效率。

title: Shallow Queries, Mature Values: Depth-Asynchronous Self-Speculation for Looped Transformers
summary: Looped Transformers reuse a shared block across recurrent depths, making autoregressive decoding expensive because every generated token requires many sequential recurrent passes. Self-speculative decoders reduce this cost by drafting at an early depth and verifying at full depth, but typically bind draft computation to prefix representations from the same recurrent depth. We find that queries and keys approach their final-depth representations earlier than values, and controlled prefix-channel interventions show that mature values substantially improve shallow draft predictions. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Depth-Asynchronous Self-Speculation (DAS), which decouples the depth of draft computation from the depth of verified-prefix representations it reads. Its Mature-V primitive lets shallow queries retrieve full-depth prefix values without additional recurrent computation. We further develop DAS-Wave, which combines depth-asynchronous prefix reads with carried parallel refinement, progressive block growth, and an independent full-depth verifier. Across four recurrent-model checkpoints and mathematics and code workloads, DAS-Wave achieves 4.00--6.96$\times$ mean throughput speedup over paired full-depth autoregressive decoding in the same inference stack. These results identify prefix-information depth as an effective design axis for recurrent self-speculation.

AI.tldr: 提出深度异步自推测(DAS)，解耦草稿计算深度与验证前缀表示深度，利用值(query/key更早成熟但value更晚)的不对称性，用Mature-V让浅层query读取全深度value，DAS-Wave在多种模型上实现4.00-6.96倍吞吐加速。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer复用共享块，自回归解码需多次串行循环，代价高昂。自推测解码虽能降本，但草稿计算通常绑定相同循环深度的前缀表示，未充分利用不同通道成熟时机的差异。
AI.method: 发现query和key比value更早接近最终深度表示，通过前缀通道干预证实成熟value能显著提升浅层草稿预测。据此提出DAS，解耦草稿深度与所读取的验证前缀表示深度；Mature-V原语使浅层query无需额外循环即可检索全深度前缀value。进一步提出DAS-Wave，结合深度异步前缀读取、携带式并行细化、渐进块增长及独立全深度验证器。
AI.result: 在四个循环模型检查点及数学与代码任务上，DAS-Wave相比同推理栈的全深度自回归解码取得4.00-6.96倍平均吞吐加速。
AI.conclusion: 前缀信息深度是循环自推测的一个有效设计维度，DAS验证了利用通道成熟度不对称可显著提升推理效率。

title: On Parameter Symmetries and Conservation Laws in Gradient Flow
summary: Parameter space symmetries and conservation laws play an important role in understanding the loss landscapes and implicit biases of neural networks. Inspired by Noether's theorem in physics, prior works have sought to derive conservation laws under gradient flow from parameter symmetries, but the scope and limitations of this connection remain unclear. We develop a unified geometric framework that clarifies the precise relationship between the two notions, including the conditions under which symmetries correspond to conservation laws. We introduce a notion of compositional identifiability and use it to establish a general inheritance principle for complete characterizations of symmetries and conservation laws in multilayer networks. We apply the framework to multi-head and grouped-query attention, polynomial neural networks, and square deep linear networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一几何框架，厘清神经网络参数对称性与梯度流守恒律的精确关系及对应条件，建立多层网络中对称性与守恒律的继承原理，并应用于多头/分组查询注意力、多项式网络与方形深度线性网络。
AI.motivation: 参数空间对称性与守恒律对理解神经网络的损失景观和隐式偏差很重要。受物理中Noether定理启发，已有工作尝试从参数对称性推导梯度流守恒律，但二者联系的范围与局限仍不清楚。
AI.method: 发展统一的几何框架，明确对称性与守恒律两概念间的精确关系及其对应条件；引入"组合可识别性"（compositional identifiability）概念，并据此建立多层网络中对称性与守恒律完全刻画的一般继承原理。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于多头注意力、分组查询注意力、多项式神经网络以及方形深度线性网络。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可系统刻画网络对称性与守恒律关系，并具普适性，能覆盖多种网络结构。

title: PulseInfer: I/O-Centric Sparse KV Cache Offloading for Efficient Long-Context LLM Decoding
summary:
Long-context LLM serving is increasingly bottlenecked by decode, where large KV caches limit batch size and underutilize GPUs. Sparse KV cache offloading expands effective capacity by storing most historical KV blocks in CPU DRAM and recalling only selected blocks on demand. However, we find that existing offloading systems shift the bottleneck to CPU-GPU recall I/O: recall volume varies widely across layers, decode steps and requests, while headwise sparse selection fragments recalls into many small PCIe transfers.
  This paper presents PulseInfer, an I/O-centric sparse KV cache offloading system. PulseInfer hides variable recall latency with interruptible layer-wise scheduling, adapts offloading decisions with IO-Adaptive Offloading Admission, and coalesces fragmented transfers using SoloHead sparse selection and a gather-scatter I/O engine. Implemented on SGLang, PulseInfer improves decode throughput by up to 4.7x over SGLang and 2.6x over the best existing offloading baseline, while reducing TPOT by up to 76% and preserving near-lossless accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出PulseInfer，一个以I/O为中心的稀疏KV缓存卸载系统，通过可中断分层调度、IO自适应卸载准入、SoloHead稀疏选择与gather-scatter I/O引擎解决CPU-GPU召回I/O瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM服务受decode瓶颈限制，大KV缓存限制batch size、GPU利用率低。现有稀疏KV缓存卸载系统将瓶颈转移至CPU-GPU召回I/O：召回量在层、decode步和请求间差异大，且headwise稀疏选择将召回碎片化为大量小PCIe传输。
AI.method: PulseInfer采用三项技术：1）可中断的分层调度隐藏可变召回延迟；2）IO-Adaptive Offloading Admission自适应调整卸载决策；3）SoloHead稀疏选择与gather-scatter I/O引擎合并碎片化传输。基于SGLang实现。
AI.result: 相比SGLang解码吞吐提升最高4.7x，相比最佳卸载基线提升2.6x；TPOT降低最高76%，并保持近乎无损的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以I/O为中心的稀疏KV缓存卸载可有效缓解长上下文LLM decode瓶颈，显著提升吞吐并降低延迟。

title: Brain-Conditioned Action Policies for Neural Motor Decoding
summary: Motor brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to decode motor intention, enabling people with paralysis to control external devices. Neural motor decoding typically learns task-specific mappings from neural activity to kinematics, yet remains constrained by scarce paired neural-action data. We propose BrainVLA, a framework that enables neural motor decoding by drawing on a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model through language-mediated alignment. BrainVLA mitigates reliance on scarce paired neural-action data by leveraging VLA policies. We first construct VLA-compatible datasets including paired neural activity, action signals, language instructions, and rendered visual observations. Then, we adapt the OpenVLA-OFT policy to the target action spaces through LoRA fine-tuning. To establish an effective interface through which neural activity can convey motor intention to adapted VLA policies and guide action generation, we train a neural encoder via neural-language alignment, using language representations as semantic targets to capture latent motor intent from neural activity. The resulting neural representations serve as an endogenous intention signal to guide VLA policies to generate executable actions, while visual observations provide complementary information about the evolving task state. BrainVLA is evaluated on two neural motor datasets with different action dimensionalities using causal rollout decoding. It outperforms the evaluated baselines in cross-session decoding $R^2$ and task success rate, while demonstrating high training data efficiency. These results establish a route for neural motor decoding to draw on large-scale robotic priors through brain-conditioned VLA policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 BrainVLA，通过语言中介对齐借用预训练 VLA 模型实现神经运动解码，缓解配对神经-动作数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 运动脑机接口需将神经活动解码为运动意图，但传统方法依赖任务特定的神经-运动学映射，受限于稀缺的配对神经-动作数据。
AI.method: 构建含配对神经活动、动作信号、语言指令与渲染视觉观测的 VLA 兼容数据集；用 LoRA 微调 OpenVLA-OFT 适配目标动作空间；通过神经-语言对齐训练神经编码器，以语言表示为语义目标捕捉潜在运动意图；神经表征作为内源意图信号引导 VLA 生成可执行动作，视觉观测提供任务状态补充。
AI.result: 在两个不同动作维度的神经运动数据集上采用因果 rollout 解码评估，跨会话解码 R² 和任务成功率均优于基线，且训练数据效率高。
AI.conclusion: 为神经运动解码通过脑条件 VLA 策略利用大规模机器人先验开辟了路径。

title: Single-Layer MeMo as a Randomized Hamming-Kernel Classifier
summary: MeMo (Zanzotto et al., 2025) is a recent language-model architecture that stores associations between token contexts and next tokens in a correlation matrix memory. In this work, we study its single-layer form and show that its ideal retrieval rule is a multiclass classifier based on the positional Hamming kernel. The MeMo architecture represents both the sequence features and the output labels with Gaussian random codes. Its score is therefore a doubly randomized sketch of the ideal classifier. Under independent input and output codebooks, we bound the errors introduced by context sketching and output decoding, characterize their dependence on model and data parameters, and give a margin-based guarantee for recovering the ideal prediction. Controlled simulations support the trends predicted by the analysis. On a restricted WikiText-2 next-token task, we compare single-layer MeMo with classical baselines and show that it can offer a useful trade-off among predictive accuracy, memory, and throughput, particularly on a GPU, where its matrix operations can be parallelized.

AI.tldr: 本文分析单层MeMo架构，证明其理想检索规则是基于位置汉明核的多分类器，并为随机草图误差提供理论界限。
AI.motivation: MeMo是一种将token上下文与下一token的关联存储在相关矩阵记忆中的语言模型架构，但其理论基础尚不清晰，需要理解其理想检索规则及随机编码带来的误差。
AI.method: 研究单层MeMo，用高斯随机码表示序列特征和输出标签，将其得分视为理想分类器的双重随机草图；在独立输入输出码本假设下推导误差界限，并进行受控仿真和WikiText-2受限下一token任务实验。
AI.result: 证明理想检索规则为基于位置汉明核的多分类器；给出了上下文草图与输出解码误差的界限及其对模型和数据参数的依赖；获得恢复理想预测的margin保证；仿真支持理论趋势；在GPU上相比经典基线在预测精度、内存与吞吐间提供有用权衡。
AI.conclusion: 单层MeMo具有清晰的理论解释，其随机草图误差可控，并在特定任务上提供精度、内存与吞吐的实用折衷，尤其在GPU可并行化时具有优势。

title: Retracing Hodgkin and Huxley: State Recovery Does Not Certify Mechanism
summary: Predicting observed dynamics does not establish recovery of the underlying physical mechanism. Can machine learning retrace the hidden-state reasoning behind the Hodgkin-Huxley (HH) model? We train structured latent models on simulated current and voltage, withholding gate identities and trajectories from training and model selection. We then test response prediction, state recovery, protocol transfer, and agreement with HH dynamics. Prediction error and its cross-seed spread both drop sharply at three latent dimensions under the tested protocols, while gate recovery under new protocols improves through five to six coordinates. State recovery depends on which observations the chart uses. Observed voltage improves current-clamp decoding relative to freely predicted voltage. Under voltage clamp, adding latent state to command voltage raises m-state $R^2$ from 0.976 to above 0.99, yet the transported field disagrees with HH on identical smooth samples. Known invertible HH coordinates achieve high fast-m field agreement under the same audit procedure. An exact HH identity decomposes the discrepancy into time-scale-weighted state error and a residual in the transported field; these terms can cancel or reinforce. These findings concern the tested models and charts. They support evaluating state and dynamics recovery separately, including chart inputs and transported-field agreement across interventions.

AI.tldr: 用结构化潜模型测试ML能否复现HH模型隐藏状态推理，发现预测精度不等于机制恢复，建议分开评估状态与动力学恢复。
AI.motivation: 预测观测动态不等于恢复底层物理机制，论文探究机器学习能否重溯Hodgkin-Huxley模型的隐藏状态推理。
AI.method: 在模拟电流-电压数据上训练结构化潜模型，训练与选模时隐藏门控身份与轨迹；测试响应预测、状态恢复、协议迁移及与HH动力学的吻合度。
AI.result: 预测误差及跨种子离散度在三个潜维度处骤降；新协议下门控恢复在5-6维改善；状态恢复依赖观测图；电压钳下加入潜状态使m态R²由0.976升至0.99以上，但输运场与HH平滑样本不一致；已知可逆HH坐标在执行审计时取得高m场一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅适用于所测模型与图；应分别评估状态与动力学恢复，并纳入图输入与跨干预的输运场一致性审计。

title: Compute Time Scaling with Recursive Models for Combinatorial Optimization
summary: We propose Tiny Recursive Models for Combinatorial Optimization (\ours{}), a general neural method for combinatorial optimization that scales both depth (how often we recursively invoke our network) and width (how much we sample in parallel). Both are fundamental for combinatorial optimization: hard instances demand a large amount of compute, while a small network is essential to avoid overfitting and capture the algorithmic essence of optimization. In particular, our method consists of a graph-aware tiny recursive model that iterates on a latent state with adaptive halting and needs only a lightweight problem-specific decoder. Compared with previous heatmap-based general neural solvers, it achieves a better balance between solution quality and inference speed on both the Traveling Salesman Problem~(TSP) and the Maximum Independent Set~(MIS) problem, and remains competitive with hybrid methods that combine neural components with heuristics specific to each problem. With the same backbone architecture for both tasks, \ours{} outperforms every diffusion-based solver on TSP from 500 to 10,000 cities at a lower inference cost, and on the standard Erdős--Rényi-[700-800] MIS benchmark it surpasses all neural solvers except those that only work well on MIS. We then explore self-relabeling for self-supervised training. We periodically replace the current set of training labels with the model's own better solutions, as an alternative training signal. Self-relabeling can, while forgoing supervision from near-optimal solutions, still result in on-par quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) 用于组合优化，通过递归缩放深度与宽度，用小型图感知网络在 TSP 和 MIS 上实现质量与速度的更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 组合优化难题需要大量计算，但网络过大会过拟合、难以捕捉算法本质。现有热图式通用神经求解器在解质量与推理速度间难以兼顾；扩散式求解器在大规模 TSP 上推理成本高。作者希望用小型网络配合递归缩放深度/宽度来平衡两者。
AI.method: 提出图感知的小型递归模型：在潜在状态上迭代，带自适应停止机制，仅需轻量级问题特定解码器。同时缩放递归深度（调用次数）与宽度（并行采样数）。通用骨干架构同时用于 TSP 与 MIS。另外探索自标注（self-relabeling）自监督训练：周期性用模型自身更优解替换训练标签作为替代信号。
AI.result: 在 TSP 与 MIS 上，解质量与推理速度的平衡优于以往热图类通用神经求解器，并与神经+启发式混合方法相当。相同骨干下，在 500–10000 城市 TSP 上以更低推理成本超越所有扩散式求解器；在 Erdős–Rényi-[700-800] MIS 基准上超越除 MIS 专用求解器外的所有神经求解器。自标注训练在无需近最优监督下仍达到相当质量。
AI.conclusion: 小型递归模型配合深度/宽度缩放可有效用于通用组合优化，兼顾质量与效率且骨干可跨任务复用；自标注可替代近最优监督实现相当性能。

title: Deep Weighted Bellman Residual Minimization for $Q^*$ Estimation
