We study how accurately these checkpoints can reconstruct the endpoint of a sequential reference with prescribed update strengths. Under a common local transition model, two checkpoint-index moment conditions characterize all convex merges that agree with this reference through second order. We then prove an information limit that for nondegenerate profiles, no algorithm using only a fixed-length gradient-descent (GD) history with step size $h$ can achieve $o(h^3)$ endpoint error uniformly over a fixed class of smooth, strongly convex losses. The lower bound follows from two losses with identical GD checkpoint histories but sequential reference endpoints separated by $Ω(h^3)$. \textbf{Quadratic-Accurate Merging} (QAM) achieves a matching uniform $O(h^3)$ endpoint error bound. Its explicit coefficients also define the unique profile-dependent merge that exactly matches the sequential GD reference across all fixed quadratic objectives. Across two public Adam checkpoint trajectories (SmolLM3-3B and OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B), three windows and three profiles per model, and 15 tasks, QAM shows mixed results for short windows and broader advantages over \textbf{Warmup-Stable and Merge} (WSM) for longer windows. Matched-moment GSM8K diagnostics further show that local consistency alone does not fully determine downstream scores. These results characterize the reconstruction limits of saved histories, provide a coefficient rule that attains the optimal rate, and assess its practical utility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究保存的checkpoint能否重建另一更新强度下场(sequential reference)的终点，证明存在$O(h^3)$信息极限，并提出达到该最优率的Quadratic-Accurate Merging (QAM)。
AI.motivation: 保存的checkpoint只记录某条训练轨迹的状态，通常无法确定在不同更新强度(schedule)下访问状态的更新，因此需要明确这些checkpoint重建参考终点的能力与极限。
AI.method: 在局部转移模型下，用两个checkpoint-index矩条件刻画与参考到二阶一致的凸合并；证明非退化情形下仅用固定长度GD历史(步长h)无法达到$o(h^3)$终点误差的统一下界；提出QAM给出匹配的$O(h^3)$误差，并推导其显式系数为在固定二次目标上精确匹配GD参考的唯一profile-dependent合并。
AI.result: 下界由两个具有相同GD checkpoint历史但序列参考终点相差$Ω(h^3)$的损失构造得到；QAM达到匹配的均匀$O(h^3)$界。在SmolLM3-3B与OpenEuroLLM-Prelude-9B上(各3窗口、3 profile、15任务)，短窗口结果混合，较长窗口相较WSM有更广优势；匹配矩的GSM8K诊断表明局部一致性不足以完全决定下游分数。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了保存历史的重建极限，给出达到最优率的系数规则，并评估了其实用性。

title: ProtoSeam: Lifting Classifier Training with Latent Gaussian Mixture Models
summary: We propose a lifted reformulation of supervised classification that improves the final accuracy of standard classifiers without changing the architecture at inference time. A network $N=N_2\circ N_1$ is split at a single semantic interface and one learnable prototype per class is inserted there. Training combines a quadratic consensus penalty that pulls $N_1(x)$ toward the prototype of its class with a classification loss of $N_2$ evaluated on samples drawn around the prototypes, whereat no gradient crosses the interface. At inference the prototypes are discarded and the unmodified network $N_2\circ N_1$ is used. Across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet with ResNet and vision transformer backbones, lifted training improves test accuracy by up to five percentage points over variants without lifting under a shared tuning protocol. Moreover, we provide theoretical justification of those results.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"提升式"监督分类重构方法：在网络的单一语义接口处插入可学习的类原型，通过二次共识惩罚与围绕原型的分类损失进行训练，推理时丢弃原型、使用未修改网络。在多个数据集与骨干网络上最高提升5个百分点，并给出理论证明。
AI.motivation: 标准分类器推理时结构固定，希望在"不改变推理架构"的前提下提升最终精度。核心动机是通过在训练阶段引入中间语义接口的类原型作为结构化信号，改善表征学习，而不增加推理开销。
AI.method: 将网络 N=N2∘N1 在单一语义接口处拆分，为每类插入一个可学习原型。训练损失由两部分组成：(1) 二次共识惩罚，将 N1(x) 拉向其类别原型；(2) 在原型周围采样样本上评估 N2 的分类损失。接口处无梯度回传（no gradient crosses the interface）；推理时丢弃原型，直接使用未修改的 N2∘N1。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 TinyImageNet 上，使用 ResNet 和视觉 Transformer 骨干网络测试，在统一调参协议下，提升式训练相比无提升版本将测试精度最高提升约 5 个百分点。此外作者提供了对该结果的理论解释。
AI.conclusion: 提升式训练可在不改变推理架构、不增加推理成本的情况下，通过训练期的原型共识机制显著提升标准分类器精度，且具有理论支撑，具备较好的通用性与实用性。

title: Subgroup Rank-1 Lattice for Practical High-dimensional Black-box Integral Approximation
summary: Estimating integrals of black-box, high-dimensional functions, from expectations and kernel mean embeddings to the softmax kernel in self-attention, is a basic subroutine in machine learning. Rank-1 lattice rules suit this setting: they query the integrand only at a fixed point set and need no gradients. When the $n$ points serve as a design matrix $X\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$ for a feature map, however, computing $Ψ(X)^\top v$ or $Ψ(X)w$ for an elementwise nonlinearity $Ψ$ costs $O(nd)$ time and memory for any standard quasi-Monte Carlo point set. We study subgroup rank-1 lattices, whose Korobov generator $(1,t,\dots,t^{d-1})$ uses a scalar $t$ of fixed multiplicative order $m$. Splitting $\mathbb{F}_n^\times$ into cosets of $\langle t\rangle$ reduces both maps to short cyclic correlations evaluated by FFT, giving exact results for arbitrary $Ψ$ in $O(n\log m)$ time and $O(n)$ memory, without forming $X$. Since fixing $m$ falls outside classical component-by-component theory, we prove convergence directly: via resultants with the cyclotomic polynomial $Φ_m$, the squared worst-case error in the Korobov space decays as $O(n^{-(α-1)/(m-1)})$ for prime $m\ge d+1$, and this threshold is exact. Using the splitting of $n$ in $\mathbb{Q}(ζ_m)$, averaging over the $m-1$ admissible generators improves the constant by a factor $Θ(m-1)$. Empirically, the subgroup lattice beats Gaussian and orthogonal random features and scrambled Sobol' and Halton points in 49 of 54 synthetic kernel-estimation settings and all 45 softmax-attention settings on nine real datasets, and builds a sample set with $d=2048$, $n\approx4.1\times10^7$ in 2.3 ms.

AI.tldr: 论文研究子群秩1格点，用Korobov生成元将核特征映射的两次矩阵乘法转化为FFT循环相关，实现O(n log m)时间O(n)内存，并给出收敛性证明与大量实验验证。
AI.motivation: 黑箱高维函数积分是机器学习的基础子程序，秩1格点规则只查询固定点集且无需梯度，但作为特征映射设计矩阵时，计算Ψ(X)^T v或Ψ(X)w对任意拟蒙特卡洛点集都需O(nd)时间和内存，成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 引入子群秩1格点，Korobov生成元(1,t,...,t^{d-1})使用固定乘法阶m的标量t；将乘法群F_n^×按⟨t⟩的陪集分解，把两个映射归约为短循环相关并用FFT求值，对任意Ψ精确得到O(n log m)时间和O(n)内存且无需构造X；通过结果式与分圆多项式Φ_m证明Korobov空间最坏情形误差平方以O(n^{-(α-1)/(m-1)})衰减，并对m-1个容许生成元平均改进常数Θ(m-1)。
AI.result: 理论上证明素数m≥d+1时收敛速率O(n^{-(α-1)/(m-1)})且阈值精确；实验上在54个合成核估计设置中49个、9个真实数据集全部45个softmax注意力设置中优于高斯与正交随机特征及加扰Sobol'和Halton点，并能在2.3ms内构造d=2048、n≈4.1×10^7的样本集。
AI.conclusion: 子群秩1格点是一种高效且精度优越的高维积分与核特征映射工具，兼具FFT加速、理论收敛保证和实际性能优势。

title: ConRAG: Lightweight inference of multi-hop relations
summary: Understanding how two entities are connected often requires tracing multi-hop relations across documents to identify intermediate entities and supporting evidence that explain a connection. This is a task that appears frequently in scientific research and other knowledge-intensive analyses. We formalise this setting as multi-hop relation inference: given two known endpoint entities, we aim to recover the bridge entities and evidence-grounded reasoning chains that connect them across a document corpus, and to generate an explanation grounded in the retrieved evidence. Existing multi-hop RAG systems typically seek an unknown answer entity rather than explicitly recovering the connection between two known endpoints and graph-based approaches often rely on costly LLM-extracted knowledge graphs that limit scalability to large document collections. We introduce ConRAG, which builds a lightweight entity-document graph from entity co-occurrence and LLM-based entity filtering. Its connective retrieval infers and semantically ranks paths between two endpoints. On MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA, ConRAG consistently improves bridge entity and reasoning chain recovery over strong RAG baselines, while reducing graph-indexing token cost by up to roughly 1.5 orders of magnitude. Our results show that endpoint-constrained path retrieval provides an effective and index-efficient approach to evidence-grounded relation discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ConRAG，将"连接两个已知实体的多跳关系推断"形式化，用轻量实体-文档图与连接性检索恢复桥接实体、推理链并生成证据支撑的解释，在降低建图成本的同时提升效果。
AI.motivation: 跨文档连接两个实体的多跳关系推断在科研和知识密集分析中很常见，但现有方法存在不足：多跳 RAG 系统通常寻找未知答案实体，而非显式恢复两个已知端点之间的联系；基于图的方法依赖 LLM 抽取知识图谱，成本高、难以扩展到大规模文档集。
AI.method: ConRAG 从实体共现构建轻量级实体-文档图，并结合基于 LLM 的实体过滤；其连接性检索（connective retrieval）推断两个端点之间的路径并进行语义排序，最终生成基于检索证据的解释。
AI.result: 在 MuSiQue 和 2WikiMultiHopQA 上，ConRAG 在桥接实体与推理链恢复方面持续优于强 RAG 基线，同时将图索引的 token 成本降低约最多 1.5 个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，端点约束的路径检索为证据支撑的关系发现有提供一种有效且索引高效的方法。

title: Adversarial Consistency-Guided Representation Learning for Multi-view Clustering
summary: Multi-view clustering aims to capture cross-view consistency while exploiting view-specific information. However, shared representations learned to capture cross-view consistency may still retain view-identifying information, potentially compromising the consistency of cross-view clustering structures. To address this issue, we propose ACGRL, an adversarial consistency-guided representation learning framework for multi-view clustering. ACGRL employs a gradient-reversal view discriminator to reduce view identifiability and obtain invariant reference representations. These representations are then frozen to provide fixed references for disentangling view-specific information from cross-view common information in the subsequent learning stage. The fixed reference representations are concatenated with the learned view-specific representations for reconstruction and clustering, with cross-view cluster alignment encouraging consistent clustering assignments. Experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior clustering performance of ACGRL compared with representative multi-view clustering methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACGRL框架，利用对抗一致性引导的表示学习提升多视图聚类性能。
AI.motivation: 多视图聚类中，为捕获跨视图一致性而学习的共享表示可能仍保留视图识别信息，从而损害跨视图聚类结构的一致性。
AI.method: ACGRL使用梯度反转的视图判别器降低视图可识别性，获得不变的参考表示，并将其冻结作为固定参考，用于在后续学习阶段将视图特定信息与跨视图共同信息解耦；固定参考表示与视图特定表示拼接用于重建和聚类，并通过跨视图聚类对齐促进一致的聚类分配。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验表明，ACGRL相比代表性多视图聚类方法具有更优的聚类性能。
AI.conclusion: ACGRL通过对抗一致性引导的表示学习有效降低视图可识别性并解耦视图特定与共享信息，从而提升多视图聚类的一致性。

title: Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Pretraining for Relational Deep Learning
summary: Relational deep learning models database rows and foreign-key links as a heterogeneous graph for prediction from record attributes and relational context. These graphs contain two distinct temporal signals: record age changes with the prediction cutoff, while intervals between observed records remain fixed. Prior work often treats time as a single signal or studies temporal representation and pretraining separately. We investigate how explicitly encoding both signals affects temporal pretraining for downstream tasks. Our framework combines Multi-scale Time Encoding, which captures record age using learnable time scales and type-specific projections, with Rotary Time Encoding, which represents signed inter-record intervals through rotary transformations during graph propagation. We pair these encodings with three self-supervised objectives: historical relation recovery, horizon-aware future relation activity prediction, and temporal subgraph contrast. All inputs respect their observation cutoffs. Pretraining proceeds in two stages: subgraph contrast first learns neighborhood representations, followed by refinement through either relation recovery or future activity prediction. We evaluate on five RelBench datasets across 11 classification and regression tasks using heterogeneous GNN and graph Transformer backbones. With both encodings, the best evaluated staged schedules improve over supervised training with the same encodings by 3.02% and 1.06% on the two backbones, respectively, and over controls without pretraining or either encoding by 3.24% and 2.37%.

AI.tldr: 本文研究关系型深度学习中如何显式编码"记录年龄"与"记录间间隔"两种时间信号，并提出多尺度时间编码与旋转时间编码，结合三种自监督目标分两阶段预训练，在RelBench上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 关系图包含两类不同时间信号：记录年龄随预测cutoff变化，而记录间间隔固定。以往工作常将时间视为单一信号，或将时间表示与预训练分开研究，未探究同时显式编码两种信号对预训练的影响。
AI.method: 框架结合Multi-scale Time Encoding（可学习时间尺度与类型特定投影刻画记录年龄）和Rotary Time Encoding（图传播中通过旋转变换表示带符号的记录间间隔）。配合三种自监督目标：历史关系恢复、horizon-aware未来关系活动预测、时间子图对比。所有输入尊重观测cutoff。预训练分两阶段：先子图对比学习邻域表示，再通过关系恢复或未来活动预测精调。
AI.result: 在5个RelBench数据集的11个分类与回归任务上，使用异构GNN与图Transformer骨干评估。同时使用两种编码时，最佳分阶段方案相比同编码监督训练分别提升3.02%和1.06%，相比无预训练或无编码的对照分别提升3.24%和2.37%。
AI.conclusion: 显式编码记录年龄与记录间间隔两类时间信号，并结合分阶段时间预训练，能有效提升关系型深度学习的下游预测性能。

title: Long-Horizon Scaling: How Model Capabilities Shape the Returns to Computation
summary: Long-horizon agents improve solutions through sustained interaction, execution, and task feedback. Scaling studies relate performance to resources and capabilities, yet how existing capabilities shape returns to extended interaction remains less understood. To address this gap, we analyze AutoLab and EdgeBench, two long-horizon benchmarks. We find that starting performance and subsequent growth are associated with different capabilities: within a task category, similar early scores can precede different later gains. To formalize this finding, we model capability-time scaling with category-specific logistic power laws shared across models. Fitted to early trajectories, these curves extrapolate the observed models' category-average scores to later computation. However, rising average scores mask narrowing improvement opportunities: later gains concentrate among fewer improving models. High final scores and continued improvement also have distinct capability profiles. Predicted mean gains estimate each model's fraction of improving tasks; averaging these estimates forecasts the average share of improving models. These uneven returns motivate deciding whether a specific run should continue. We therefore derive a continuation policy to save time and compute with limited score loss. The policy conditions growth predictions on the run's observed progress and weighs immediate and delayed gains against computation costs. In replay with training and price calibration based on other models' histories, the policy saves roughly one-third of full-run time, with relative score losses of 2.4% on AutoLab individual runs and 3.3% on EdgeBench published mean curves. Our repository is available at https://github.com/Chihaya-Anon-chan/long-horizon-scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文分析AutoLab和EdgeBench两个长时程基准，发现能力-时间尺度遵循类别特定的logistic幂律，并提出持续策略以节省计算。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体通过持续交互改进，但现有能力如何影响延长交互的回报尚不清楚，需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 分析两个基准，用类别特定logistic幂律建模能力-时间尺度，并推导基于进度与成本的继续策略。
AI.result: 曲线可外推类别平均分；高最终分与持续改进能力画像不同；策略节省约1/3时间，AutoLab损失2.4%，EdgeBench损失3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 长时程回报不均衡，该策略可在有限分数损失下节省大量时间与计算。

title: Disentangling Lung-Cancer CT/LDCT AI: A Systematic Evidence Map of Clinical Tasks, Evidence Chains, and Translational Gaps
summary: Artificial-intelligence studies using computed tomography (CT) for lung cancer are often broadly labelled "prediction" despite addressing clinically distinct tasks. We systematically mapped CT/low-dose CT (LDCT)-centered lung-cancer AI using five-database retrieval, full-text eligibility assessment, role-aware modality/omics extraction, clinical-task classification, and a Multi-Tier Evidence Graph (MTEG). The final corpus comprised 293 studies (2016-2026): 230 Detection, 8 future Risk-prediction, and 55 Other studies. Clinical variables (96.2%), 3D CT/LDCT (73.0%), and radiomics (63.5%) predominated, whereas external validation (29.0%), calibration (20.5%), decision-curve analysis (13.0%), longitudinal CT (17.7%), and saliency/attribution XAI (21.5%) were less frequent. The MTEG comprised 377 nodes and 3,444 edges; only 31 studies (10.6%) completed the six-tier substantive evidence chain, with greatest attrition at reasoning/explanation. Overall, the literature is detection-dominated, genuine future risk prediction remains uncommon, and complete translational evidence chains are rare.

AI.tldr: 系统梳理293篇(2016-2026)CT/LDCT肺癌AI研究：多数实为检出任务，真正的未来风险预测很少，完整转化证据链罕见。
AI.motivation: 肺癌CT的AI研究常被笼统称为"预测"，但实际对应临床任务差异很大，需要系统区分与评估。
AI.method: 采用五数据库检索、全文纳排评估、角色感知的模态/组学抽取、临床任务分类，并构建多层证据图(MTEG)。
AI.result: 纳入293篇：230篇检出、8篇未来风险预测、55篇其他。临床变量96.2%、3D CT/LDCT 73.0%、影像组学63.5%为主；外部验证29.0%、校准20.5%、决策曲线13.0%、纵向CT 17.7%、显著性XAI 21.5%较少。MTEG含377节点、3444边，仅31篇(10.6%)完成六级证据链，断点最多在推理/解释环节。
AI.conclusion: 该领域以检出为主导，真正的未来风险预测不常见，完整转化证据链稀缺。

title: AIM-ZO: Activation-Informed Subspace Maintenance for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a memory-efficient alternative for LLM fine-tuning by estimating updates only from forward evaluations of perturbed parameters, without backpropagation or activation storage. However, in billion-parameter LLMs, isotropic perturbations often waste many forward evaluations on weakly informative directions. To make these evaluations more informative, existing ZO methods restrict perturbations to low-dimensional subspaces. Yet the quality of these subspaces is critical: overly compressed or poorly maintained spaces can miss useful update directions. To obtain a high-quality subspace for ZO updates, this paper proposes AIM-ZO, a ZO fine-tuning method based on Activation-Informed Subspace Maintenance. AIM-ZO uses forward activations as local directional information and continuously integrates them into a broad, evolving subspace over training. To access broader gradient-relevant structure while keeping individual perturbations low-dimensional, AIM-ZO activates only a smaller set of shared and sampled directions, decoupling the maintained width from the active width. We evaluate AIM-ZO across 5 LLMs and 11 downstream tasks under matched forward-evaluation budgets; its six-task average exceeds the strongest fully evaluated ZO baseline by 1.26 percentage points on OPT-2.7B and MeZO by 2.85 percentage points on OPT-30B. Our code is available at https://github.com/EkkoXy/AIM-ZO

AI.tldr: AIM-ZO通过引入前向激活信息构建并持续维护高质量子空间，提升零阶大模型微调效率，在多模型多任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化虽节省显存，但在十亿参数级LLM中各向同性扰动浪费大量前向评估。现有限制于低维子空间的方法，其子空间质量关键，过度压缩或维护不佳会丢失有效更新方向。
AI.method: 提出AIM-ZO，基于激活信息子空间维护的零阶微调方法：用前向激活作为局部方向信息，持续整合进宽广且演化的子空间；仅激活较小一组共享与采样子方向，将维护宽度与激活宽度解耦，以保持扰动低维同时获取更广梯度结构。
AI.result: 在5个LLM和11个下游任务、相同前向评估预算下评估，六任务平均在OPT-2.7B上超过最强完全评估ZO基线1.26个百分点，在OPT-30B上超MeZO 2.85个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 利用激活信息维护高质量子空间可显著提升零阶微调性能，且通过解耦维护与激活宽度兼顾效率与有效性。

title: On-Policy or Off-Policy Learning? A Systematic Study of Distillation Dynamics
summary: On-policy learning has been argued to reduce catastrophic forgetting, produce sparser parameter updates, and improve generalisation. However, existing comparisons between supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning vary many factors simultaneously, making the contribution of rollout policy difficult to isolate. We study the effect of rollout policy in a controlled strong-to-weak distillation setting, by independently varying rollout policy, token-level KL direction, and learning rate across the Llama3 and Qwen2.5 model families and reasoning tasks spanning scientific, medical, and arithmetic domains. Our analysis reveals a nuanced picture of distillation dynamics in which rollout policy does not necessarily play a central role. Instead, token-level KL direction more clearly shapes task performance and output coverage, while learning rate governs forgetting and update sparsity. Analysis of KL gradients and experiments along a continuous student-teacher rollout-policy spectrum explain this pattern: forward KL is remarkably robust to rollout policy, with its performance stable and strong despite changes to the rollout policy, whereas reverse KL is substantially more sensitive and favours student-generated rollouts. On-policy data nevertheless improves generalisation to harder variants of the Countdown arithmetic task under both KL directions, although this advantage does not reliably persist after subsequent RLVR. Our broader conclusions remain robust to removing gradient clipping, using sampled KL estimators, and training on tasks requiring longer reasoning chains. Overall, our results challenge the view that on-policy rollouts are inherently preferable and show that their value depends critically on the objective, evaluation setting, and optimisation hyperparameters.

AI.tldr: 本文在受控强到弱蒸馏设定下研究rollout策略的影响，发现其并非核心因素：token级KL方向主导任务性能，学习率主导遗忘与更新稀疏性；前向KL对rollout策略稳健，反向KL更敏感并偏好学生生成rollout；on-policy数据在困难变体上提升泛化但不稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有监督微调与强化学习的对比同时改变多个因素，难以单独分离rollout策略的贡献，作者希望在控制变量的强到弱蒸馏设定中厘清rollout策略的真实作用。
AI.method: 在Llama3与Qwen2.5模型族及科学、医学、算术推理任务上，独立变化rollout策略、token级KL方向和学习率，进行蒸馏实验；分析KL梯度，并开展连续学生-教师rollout谱实验及鲁棒性检验（去除梯度裁剪、采样KL估计、更长推理链）。
AI.result: rollout策略并非必然核心；token级KL方向更明显影响任务性能与输出覆盖，学习率主导遗忘与更新稀疏性；前向KL对rollout策略稳健且表现强，反向KL敏感并偏好学生rollout；on-policy数据在Countdown困难变体提升泛化但后续RLVR后优势不持续。
AI.conclusion: on-policy rollout并非天生更优，其价值取决于目标函数、评估设定与优化超参数，挑战了on-policy数据固有优越的既有观点。

title: Latency and accuracy tradeoffs in Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Spiking neural networks are attractive for low-power speech command recognition, yet their latency has received far less attention than their energy efficiency, and their multi-timestep execution is widely assumed to make them slower than quantized neural networks. This paper challenges the assumption that more local timesteps necessarily imply higher network latency. By overlapping computation across adjacent layers at the timestep level, SNNs may complete execution in less time than comparable bit-serial QNNs. However, this overlap relies on spikes firing on incomplete inputs, and a spike once generated cannot be withdrawn, so its error persists and reduces accuracy. Waiting for more input before firing would seem to improve accuracy at the cost of reduced overlap. Yet we find and prove that this intuition fails at some layers, where even a small increase in waiting can change spike timing and downstream computation, making the network both slower and less accurate. We therefore propose a Pipeline Delay Search method which selects each layer's delay by balancing task-level accuracy gains against added network latency. We then adapt the selected configurations through spike-based quantization-aware training and bounded tuning of firing thresholds and initial membrane potentials. Together, these steps form Falcon, a framework for Fine-grained Analysis of Latency and Controlled firing which systematically analyzes and optimizes SNN latency under a spatial analog compute-in-memory mapping with shared digital engines. We evaluate Falcon on GSCV2 and SSC, achieving competitive accuracies of 96.31 and 83.02 at modeled network-core latencies of 119.64 and 124.00us, respectively. Together, our analysis and results show that SNNs can compute more yet finish faster, and wait longer yet predict worse, highlighting why Falcon matters for both latency and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Falcon框架，通过跨层流水线延迟搜索与脉冲量化训练，在模拟存内计算映射下系统优化SNN延迟，证明SNN可比等效量化网络更快且更准。
AI.motivation: SNN被视为低功耗语音命令识别方案，但其延迟关注不足，且普遍假设多时间步执行使其慢于量化神经网络。
AI.method: 挑战“更多局部时间步必然更高延迟”的假设，利用相邻层在时间步级重叠计算；提出Pipeline Delay Search按任务精度增益与延迟代价权衡选择每层延迟；再通过脉冲量化感知训练及对发放阈值与初始膜电位的有界调优适配配置，形成Falcon框架，可在共享数字引擎的空间模拟存内计算映射下分析优化延迟。
AI.result: 在GSCV2和SSC上分别达到96.31和83.02的竞争性精度，建模网络核心延迟为119.64us和124.00us。
AI.conclusion: SNN可以计算更多却更快完成，等待更久反而预测更差，Falcon对延迟与精度均具重要意义。

title: SpikeCredit: Temporal Credit Carrier for Reinforcement Learning with Sparse Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse rewards is challenging because delayed outcomes provide little guidance about which intermediate computations caused success or failure. We argue that reliable credit assignment requires policy dynamics that preserve and expose credit-relevant information over time, a role we formalize as Temporal Credit Carriers (TCCs) and that spiking neural networks (SNNs) naturally fulfill through graded membrane traces and event-driven spikes. Based on this hypothesis, we propose SpikeCredit, an SNN-based framework for RL with sparse rewards that first performs task-adaptive TCC selection and then closes the loop between a fast TCC-reading pathway, where self-motion feedback constraint uses local behavior-grounded cues to constrain transition-level credit recovery, and a slow TCC-writing pathway, where credit-targeted trace alignment feeds recovered credit back into the actor to make future TCC dynamics more credit-readable. Across sparse-reward MuJoCo tasks, SpikeCredit improves Last10 return over sparse SNN baselines by +1169% on Ant, +953% on Hopper, +723% on Swimmer, and +1781% on Walker2d, and exceeds the dense-reward baseline on Swimmer by +113%. Mechanistic analyses further show substantially stronger alignment with dense rewards than the sparse SNN baseline. These results position spiking dynamics as credit-preserving substrates for sparse-reward RL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SpikeCredit，基于脉冲神经网络(SNN)的稀疏奖励强化学习框架，通过时间信用载体(TCC)实现可靠的信用分配。
AI.motivation: 稀疏奖励RL因延迟结果难以指导中间计算的信用分配而具有挑战性。作者认为可靠信用分配需要能随时间保留并暴露信用相关信息的策略动态，即时间信用载体(TCC)，而SNN通过分级膜电位轨迹和事件驱动脉冲天然满足这一需求。
AI.method: 提出SpikeCredit框架：先进行任务自适应的TCC选择，再闭合快慢双通路——快速TCC读取通路（用自运动反馈约束，借助局部行为相关线索约束转移级信用恢复）与慢速TCC写入通路（信用导向的迹对齐，将恢复的信用回馈给actor）。
AI.result: 在稀疏奖励MuJoCo任务上，Last10回报相较稀疏SNN基线提升：Ant +1169%、Hopper +953%、Swimmer +723%、Walker2d +1781%；在Swimmer上超过密集奖励基线+113%。机制分析显示其与密集奖励的对齐显著强于稀疏SNN基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明脉冲动态可作为稀疏奖励RL中信用保留的基质。

title: Multi-Attractor GNNs: Set-Valued Expressivity Beyond Unique Equilibria
summary:
Recurrent and equilibrium graph neural networks (GNNs) often enforce a unique fixed point or use one training target per graph. Yet many combinatorial and scientific problems admit multiple valid solutions, with no preferred one. A designated target can then impose an arbitrary selection rule. For tasks invariant to node relabeling, a symmetric graph may have a symmetric solution set but no symmetric solution.
  We show that multiple equilibria enable one weight-tied message-passing GNN to represent set-valued equivariant maps: different initializations approach different valid solutions. Under stated regularity assumptions, we first construct globally Lipschitz, permutation-equivariant dynamics that converge almost surely to valid solutions and reach every solution branch with positive probability. We then establish approximate realization by recurrent message passing with continuous component maps, with arbitrarily small update and limiting errors and arbitrarily high probability. This goes beyond standard universality arguments: although message passing alone cannot distinguish symmetric nodes, the evolving state keeps nodes distinguishable at every finite step without auxiliary node identifiers. Such dynamics can be learned without solution labels using problem-specific energies. On Ising ground states, structural module detection in protein graphs, and chemical reaction steady states, the learned updates produce multiple high-quality predictions with high numerical convergence rates. They achieve better average solution quality than the tested unique-equilibrium, single-target, and feedforward baselines, while remaining competitive with much larger diffusion-based solvers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用多平衡点消息传递GNN表示集值等变映射，不同初始化收敛到不同有效解，无需解标签，在多任务上优于单目标基线。
AI.motivation: 主流递归/平衡GNN强制唯一不动点或每图单一目标，但许多组合与科学问题存在多个同样有效的解，指定单一目标会引入任意选择规则；对节点重标号不变任务，对称图可能解集对称却无对称解。
AI.method: 构建全局Lipschitz、置换等变的动力学，使其几乎必然收敛到有效解并以正概率到达每个解分支；再用连续分量映射的递归消息传递近似实现，更新误差与极限误差任意小、概率任意高；基于问题特定能量函数，无需解标签即可学习，且无需辅助节点标识符。
AI.result: 在Ising基态、蛋白质图结构模块检测和化学反应稳态任务上，学习到的更新产生多个高质量预测且数值收敛率高，平均解质量优于唯一平衡、单目标和前馈基线，并与更大的扩散求解器相竞争。
AI.conclusion: 多平衡点使一个权重共享的消息传递GNN能表示集值等变映射，突破标准通用性论证的限制，在无解标签下学习到能覆盖多个解分支的动力学。

title: LionMuon: Alternating Spectral and Sign Descent for Efficient Training
summary: Pretraining a language model takes enormous compute, and the right optimizer can save a good part of it. Muon's spectral step gives a stronger direction than a sign step, but it is expensive. Every step runs Newton-Schulz iterations on the full matrix and, in distributed training, an extra all-reduce. Sign steps, as in Lion and Signum, are cheap and stay local to each device. We propose LionMuon, which takes one Muon step every $P$ iterations and Lion steps in between, with a single dual-EMA momentum buffer shared by both. Muon's compute and communication are paid once per $P$ steps, and the optimizer state is half of AdamW's. A single-EMA variant, SignMuon, already improves on Muon. We prove complexity bounds under heavy-tailed noise in which the period sets an interpolation between Muon's and Lion's smoothness and noise constants, and which say when LionMuon is faster than both. On 124M and 355M models trained on FineWeb, LionMuon with $P=2$ and $P=5$ reaches a lower loss than Muon, AdamW, Lion and Signum at the same number of tokens. Under 4-GPU data-parallel training it reaches Muon's final loss with a third less wall-clock on PCIe, and it beats the communication-efficient Muon variants Dion and MuonBP on loss at no more exposed communication, while keeping the exact gradient. Code: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/lion-muon

AI.tldr: LionMuon提出每P步执行一次Muon的谱步，其余步用Lion符号步，共享单一双EMA动量缓冲区，兼顾Muon的方向质量与Lion的低计算/通信开销。
AI.motivation: Muon的谱步方向比符号步更强，但每步需全矩阵Newton-Schulz迭代及分布式额外all-reduce，代价高昂；Lion/Signum的符号步廉价且本地化。目标是在保留Muon优势的同时降低计算与通信成本。
AI.method: LionMuon每P次迭代执行一次Muon步，其间执行Lion步，二者共享一个双EMA动量缓冲区；优化器状态为AdamW的一半。另提出单EMA变体SignMuon。并在重尾噪声下给出复杂度界，周期P在Muon与Lion的平滑与噪声常数间插值。
AI.result: 在FineWeb上训练的124M和355M模型中，P=2和P=5的LionMuon在相同token数下损失低于Muon、AdamW、Lion和Signum。4-GPU数据并行下，PCIe上以少三分之一的墙钟时间达到Muon最终损失；在无更多暴露通信下损失优于通信高效的Dion与MuonBP，并保持精确梯度。
AI.conclusion: LionMuon通过周期性混合谱步与符号步，在精度、计算/通信效率及内存占用上取得更优权衡，是可替代Muon的高效预训练优化器。

title: When Should a Satellite Estimate Be Changed? Stress-Testing Neural Corrections for Evapotranspiration
summary: Neural residuals can improve satellite evapotranspiration (ET) estimates, but selectors must predict when a correction helps and reject unsupported inputs. We evaluate ten-member models on 16,366 flux-tower observations from 151 stations paired with OpenET, across nine rolling years and five spatial folds. At one held-out station, Gain accepted corrections on all 32 physically invalid records: it predicted a mean benefit of 0.83 mm/day, but the corrections increased mean absolute error by 21.6 mm/day versus OpenET. On spatially held-out unit errors, SupportGain reduced station-macro MAE versus Gain by 0.148 mm/day under wind x3.6 (simultaneous 95% interval, 0.070 to 0.226), with 9.3% acceptance versus Gain's 51.8%; on clean inputs, its 0.006 mm/day advantage had an interval that includes zero. These fault analyses are exploratory; none of 40 preplanned temporal comparisons passed Holm correction, while a separate predeclared cropland contrast found 0.041 mm/day lower station-macro MAE with crop-only training (95% interval, 0.009 to 0.079).

AI.tldr: 本文评估神经残差选择器在卫星蒸散发估计中的可靠性，重点关注其能否在无效输入下拒绝修正。
AI.motivation: 神经残差可改进卫星ET估计，但选择器需判断何时修正有益并拒绝不支持的输入，这是保证可靠性的关键。
AI.method: 在151个站点的16,366个通量塔观测上与OpenET配对，跨九个滚动年和五个空间折叠，评估十个成员模型，并比较Gain与SupportGain等选择器。
AI.result: 在留出站点，Gain对所有32条物理无效记录接受修正，预测平均收益0.83 mm/day，却使MAE增加21.6 mm/day；空间留出单位误差下，SupportGain在wind x3.6时较Gain降低站点宏MAE 0.148 mm/day（95%区间0.070–0.226），接受率9.3% vs Gain的51.8%；干净输入下其0.006 mm/day优势区间含零。40项预计划时间比较均未通过Holm校正，另一预声明农田对比显示仅作物训练站点宏MAE低0.041 mm/day（95%区间0.009–0.079）。
AI.conclusion: 选择器可显著减少无效输入下的错误修正，但故障分析属探索性，时间比较未通过多重校正；作物训练有较小但稳健的改善。

title: Collaborative Principle Evolution via Evidence Transfer for Scientific Discovery
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents promise to automate scientific discovery, yet exploring the vast hypothesis space remains costly. Existing principle-evolution methods accelerate this loop, but operate sequentially, which caps exploration breadth and wastes wall-clock time on challenging problems. To address this, we formulate collaborative scientific discovery as evidence transfer between parallel principle-evolution branches. We present COEVOLVE, which realizes this transfer through a coordination core over parallel branches. By integrating value-of-information-gated routing and context-discounted likelihood injection, COEVOLVE enables branches to collaborate through shared measurements while keeping their principle posteriors separate. Across six scientific-discovery tasks under a matched evaluation budget, COEVOLVE attains a mean solution quality of 66.5% versus 57.0% for single-branch principle evolution, with a 1.80x mean wall-clock speedup on the GPT-5.6-Terra backbone; on five auto-research tasks delegated to an autonomous research harness, it is the only arm whose mean stays above the published SOTA anchor on every task. These results establish when evidence sharing accelerates parallel discovery and when transfer safeguards are necessary to limit negative or inert transfers

AI.tldr: 提出COEVOLVE，将科学发现建模为并行原则演化分支间的证据迁移，通过信息价值门控路由与上下文折扣似然注入实现协作，提升解质量并加速。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体有望自动化科学发现，但假设空间庞大、探索成本高。现有原则演化方法为串行执行，限制了探索广度，且在难题上浪费大量墙钟时间。
AI.method: 将协作式科学发现形式化为并行原则演化分支间的证据迁移；COEVOLVE通过协调核心实现该迁移，整合价值信息（VoI）门控路由与上下文折扣似然注入，使各分支在共享测量的同时保持各自的原则后验独立。
AI.result: 在六项科学发现任务、匹配评估预算下，平均解质量66.5%（单分支为57.0%），GPT-5.6-Terra主干上平均墙钟加速1.80倍；在五项自主研究任务中，是唯一在所有任务上均值均高于已发表SOTA基线的方案。
AI.conclusion: 结果明确了证据共享何时能加速并行发现，以及何时需要迁移保护机制以限制负面或无效迁移。

title: Teacher-Student Gaps Are Not Enough: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Autonomous Agents
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense teacher supervision. Recent work on OPD for multi-turn autonomous agents often treats large teacher-student token-level distributional gaps as promising intervention points, linking larger gaps to a greater need for correction. Yet, our empirical analysis reveals a supervision-benefit mismatch: large gaps can be benign, while small gaps can be outcome-critical. Teacher-student gaps capture differences at the current turn, whereas the benefit of teacher guidance depends on how the current student interacts with the environment afterward. The student may still succeed despite choosing an action that differs from the teacher's, while a teacher-preferred action may lead to a state from which the student cannot complete the task. Local gaps alone are therefore not enough to determine whether teacher guidance benefits the current student. Effective supervision should instead emphasize guidance that the current student can translate into better final task outcomes. Accordingly, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD), which applies trajectory-relative weighting to teacher supervision and calibrates these weights using final task outcomes from paired student continuations. This calibration selectively strengthens supervision on the student's original trajectories at turns where teacher guidance benefits the current student. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, OG-OPD consistently outperforms baselines under diverse settings. It improves task success rates by 3.6-17.7 percentage points over vanilla OPD and by up to 7.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Outcome-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OG-OPD)，通过轨迹相对加权和基于最终任务结果的校准来改进多轮智能体的在线策略蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD方法将大的师生token级分布差距视为需要纠正的信号，但作者发现监督收益与差距大小不匹配：大差距可能无害，小差距可能关键。其原因在于局部差距只反映当前轮次差异，而教师指导的收益取决于学生后续与环境的交互。
AI.method: OG-OPD对教师监督施加轨迹相对加权，并利用成对学生延续的最终任务结果校准这些权重。该校准有针对性地加强学生原始轨迹上那些教师指导确实有益轮次的监督。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop上，OG-OPD在多种设置下一致优于基线，相比vanilla OPD任务成功率提升3.6-17.7个百分点，相比最强基线最高提升7.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 有效的监督应强调学生能转化为更好最终任务结果的指导，而非仅依据局部师生差距。

title: Weighting Schedules Govern What and When Score-Based Generative Models Learn from Multimodal Data
comment: Main text : 9 pages / 5 figures Supplemental : 21 pages / 1 figure
summary: Score-based generative models generate new samples by integrating a time-dependent drift that carries Gaussian noise onto the target distribution. In practice this drift is modeled by a neural network, trained on a loss integrated over time $t$ with a weighting schedule $w(t)$. Along the backward dynamics, and for multi-modal distributions, trajectories commit to modes of the target within a narrow time window, the \textit{speciation time}. In this work, focusing on high-dimensional data, we decompose the integrated loss into its single-time contributions and analyze each at fixed signal-to-noise ratio $Λ(t)$: we show that $Λ(t)$ sets the rate at which each feature of a multimodal target - the mode directions and their relative weights - is acquired during training. Crucially, at high $Λ(t)$ all mode directions are acquired together, on a single timescale insensitive to their amplitudes, while the relative weights are not learned at all. Only near the speciation time, where $Λ(t)$ becomes of order one, do all features become learnable, each on its own timescale: the weights are acquired jointly with the directions, and the directions at rates set by their relative amplitudes. For models trained on time-integrated objectives, the learning dynamics is then governed by how much of the weighting effectively sits near the speciation time, which provides insights on $w(t)$ design choices. These results follow from an exact high-dimensional analysis of the training dynamics of unbalanced and hierarchical Gaussian mixtures. Numerical experiments on image and human genome haplotype generation recover the predicted hierarchy of learning timescales in more complex settings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高维精确分析，揭示了基于分数的生成模型在训练中如何分阶段学习多模态分布的特征，强调了信噪比Λ(t)和物种形成时间的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 基于分数的生成模型在训练时使用时间加权的损失函数，但加权schedule w(t)如何影响多模态分布（尤其是高维数据）的学习动力学尚不清晰，尤其是模式方向和相对权重在不同时间尺度上的学习机制有待研究。
AI.method: 将积分损失分解为固定信噪比Λ(t)下的单时间贡献，对不平衡和层次化高斯混合模型进行高维训练动力学的精确分析，研究Λ(t)如何控制模式方向和相对权重的学习速率。
AI.result: 高Λ(t)时所有模式方向在同一时间尺度被学习（与幅度无关），而相对权重完全不学；仅在物种形成时间附近（Λ(t)~1）所有特征才可学，权重与方向联合学习，方向学习速率由相对幅度决定。时间积分目标的学习动力学取决于加权在物种形成时间附近的有效占比。
AI.conclusion: 研究为w(t)设计提供理论见解，并在图像和人类基因组单倍型生成实验中验证了预测的学习时间尺度层次。

title: Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Algorithm Distillation
summary: Algorithm Distillation (AD) has demonstrated the remarkable ability of Transformers to perform in-context reinforcement learning without explicit weight updates. However, capturing long-term learning progress necessitates expansive context windows, which incur prohibitive memory costs and limit scalability in complex, long-horizon tasks. To address this bottleneck, we propose Recurrent Algorithm Distillation (RAD). RAD employs a dual-component architecture: a Compression Transformer that distills extended interaction histories into compact latent tokens, and an AD Transformer that auto-regressively generates actions using a hybrid context of these compressed memories and recent transitions. By maintaining a fixed-size latent buffer, RAD decouples the effective history length from computational complexity, functionally providing the model with a long-horizon memory. Empirical evaluations across diverse environments demonstrate that RAD matches the asymptotic performance of standard AD with significantly reduced context window sizes, offering a scalable solution for efficient in-context decision-making.

AI.tldr: RAD通过双组件架构（压缩Transformer+AD Transformer）将长交互历史压缩为固定大小的潜在token，解耦历史长度与计算复杂度，在减少上下文窗口的同时匹配标准AD的性能。
AI.motivation: 标准算法蒸馏(AD)需扩展上下文窗口来捕捉长期学习进展，带来高昂内存成本和可扩展性瓶颈，难以应用于复杂长时程任务。
AI.method: 提出循环算法蒸馏(RAD)，包含双组件：压缩Transformer将长交互历史蒸馏为紧凑潜在token；AD Transformer基于压缩记忆与近期转移的混合上下文自回归生成动作；通过固定大小的潜在缓冲实现长时程记忆。
AI.result: 在多种环境上的实验表明，RAD在显著减小上下文窗口的情况下达到与标准AD相当的渐近性能。
AI.conclusion: RAD为高效上下文内决策提供了一种可扩展方案，缓解了长时程任务中的内存与计算瓶颈。

title: Large Language Models for Automated Cross-Domain Machine Learning Task Type Identification: A Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation
summary: Machine learning task type identification is essential for constructing valid ML pipelines, yet in practice it is typically specified manually. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can infer both the data domain and the downstream prediction task directly from dataset-level information when only the target feature is provided by the user. Together with our LLM-based system we also release an annotated benchmark comprising 625 public tabular and time series datasets. We evaluate the proposed approach in three settings: (i) tabular datasets in comparison with established AutoML heuristics, (ii) cross-domain evaluation across tabular and time series datasets, and (iii) a practical deployment scenario using smaller local models. The results show consistent advantages for LLM-based task type identification, with increasing difficulty in heterogeneous and resource-constrained settings. LLM-based approaches outperform AutoGluon in the tabular setting, reaching 0.98 F1 macro compared to 0.93. In the cross-domain setting, the best model achieves 0.90 F1 macro, while smaller locally deployable models reach 0.75, indicating a trade-off between deployment feasibility and accuracy.

AI.tldr: 研究用LLM从数据集级信息推断数据领域与下游预测任务，发布625个数据集的基准，三种设定下LLM均优于AutoML启发式。
AI.motivation: 机器学习任务类型识别对构建有效ML流水线至关重要，但实际中通常需要人工指定。作者探究在用户仅提供目标特征时，LLM能否直接从数据集级信息推断数据领域与下游预测任务。
AI.method: 提出基于LLM的系统，发布含625个公开表格与时间序列数据集的标注基准。在三种设定下评估：(i)表格数据对比现有AutoML启发式；(ii)表格与时间序列跨领域评估；(iii)使用较小本地模型的部署场景。
AI.result: LLM方法持续占优。表格设定下超过AutoGluon，F1 macro 0.98 vs 0.93；跨领域最佳模型达0.90；本地可部署小模型为0.75。
AI.conclusion: LLM在任务类型识别上具一致优势，但在异构与资源受限场景下难度增加，本地小模型存在部署可行性与精度之间的权衡。

title: NeuronDiscover: Agent-in-Twin for Mechanistic Discovery in Neuronal Microenvironments with World Action Models
summary: Mechanistic discovery in neuronal microenvironments requires interventions and measurements that separate competing explanations of solute transport and neuronal response. Predictive accuracy cannot settle the question: a real mechanistic change and an error in the computational twin leave the same signature in sparse observations. We formalize this twin confounding and reason over a joint mechanism--discrepancy belief, designing experiments that separate the two. NeuronDiscover is an Agent-in-Twin framework whose shared, mechanism-grounded World Action Model (WAM) couples prediction, intervention proposals, and observation design; independently adjudicated outcomes revise a scoped Mechanism--Intervention--Observation--Outcome (MIOY) graph, whose supported relations compile into executable programs carrying discrepancy-adjusted acceptance bounds. We evaluate on simulated brain-fluid tracer-transport worlds adjudicated by an independently frozen finer-mesh reference solver, and on donor-disjoint public current-clamp recordings of cortical neurons. Counting only relations that reach a certified terminal status, and scoring abstentions as unresolved for every method, at a matched budget of 16 experiments over 32 source units NeuronDiscover resolves 4.0 relations per assigned world against 3.4 for the strongest baseline and 3.2 without graph revision, at 5% false support and 82% scope accuracy. Joint mechanism--discrepancy acquisition resolves 3.8 relations versus 2.9 for plug-in expected information gain; discrepancy-adjusted verification lowers accepted-program failure from 15% to 9% at 60% acceptance coverage; and transfer to the recordings yields 1.94 versus 1.53 relations per assigned world. Correctness is adjudicated within declared model worlds and archival recordings.

AI.tldr: NeuronDiscover是一个"Agent-in-Twin"框架，通过机制驱动的世界行动模型(WAM)联合预测、干预和观测设计，用MIOY图分离机制改变与计算孪生误差这 twins confounding，在模拟示踪输运与神经元记录中优于基线。
AI.motivation: 神经微环境机制发现需要能区分"真实机制改变"与"计算孪生误差"的干预和测量，但稀疏观测下两者留下相同印记，预测精度无法区分，作者将这一"孪生混淆"形式化。
AI.method: 提出Agent-in-Twin框架NeuronDiscover：共享的机制驱动World Action Model(WAM)耦合预测、干预提议与观测设计；独立裁定的结果修正作用域化的MIOY(机制-干预-观测-结果)图，支持关系编译为携带"偏差调整接受界"的可执行程序。在精细网格参考求解器裁定的模拟脑液示踪输运世界和供体不相交的公开皮层神经元电流钳记录上评估。
AI.result: 匹配预算16次实验/32源单元下，每世界解析4.0关系 vs 最强基线3.4、无图修正3.2，假支持率5%、作用域准确率82%。联合机制-偏差获取解析3.8 vs 插件期望信息增益2.9；偏差调整验证将接受程序失败从15%降至9%(60%接受覆盖)；迁移到记录数据得1.94 vs 1.53关系/世界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效分离机制改变与孪生误差，提升关系解析数与程序可靠性，并在声明模型世界与归档记录内被裁定为正确。

title: Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token. This routing decides which specialist teaches, but not how strongly its feedback moves the shared student. In Qwen3.5 models at three sizes, we find that MOPD's student does not beat one taught by the best single specialist and gains little of the mathematics specialist's advantage. The feedback is unbalanced: instruction-following feedback is several times more spread out than mathematics feedback and dominates the student's updates. We propose Domain-Normalized MOPD (DN-MOPD), which keeps the routing and rescales each domain's feedback by its measured spread. On six public benchmarks, DN-MOPD improves the average score over MOPD at every size, across three random seeds and under two answer-length limits, and recovers most of the lost mathematics gain. Controls with fixed domain weights show that the gain comes mainly from turning down instruction-following feedback rather than turning up mathematics alone, and that fixed weights close to those DN-MOPD measures perform comparably. Combining specialists therefore requires deciding not only which one teaches, but also how strongly its feedback counts.

AI.tldr: 提出 DN-MOPD，通过按各领域反馈的实测离散度对各领域反馈重新缩放，解决多教师在线策略蒸馏中指令跟随反馈主导学生更新的问题。
AI.motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）用领域路由让专家教同一个学生模型，但路由只决定"谁教"，不决定该专家反馈的"影响强度"。在 Qwen3.5 三种规模上，MOPD 学生既不如最好的单专家，也没学到数学专家的优势，因为指令跟随反馈的离散度远大于数学反馈，主导了更新。
AI.method: 保留 MOPD 的领域路由，测量每个领域反馈的离散度（spread），并据此对每个领域的反馈进行归一化缩放，使各领域对学生更新的贡献更均衡。用固定领域权重的对照实验验证增益来源。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准、三个随机种子、两种答案长度限制下，DN-MOPD 在各规模上均优于 MOPD，并恢复大部分数学收益。对照实验表明增益主要来自降低指令跟随反馈的权重，而非单纯提高数学权重；与 DN-MOPD 实测权重接近的固定权重也能取得相当效果。
AI.conclusion: 合并多个专家不仅需要决定"由谁教"，还需要决定"其反馈算多重"。按领域归一化反馈强度是一种简单有效的多教师蒸馏改进方案。

title: From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data
summary: Estimating probability densities from a finite set of samples typically requires dataset-specific model fitting. We introduce PRODiGI, a pretrained data-to-program model that infers an explicit, executable generative program in a single forward pass. Pretrained on synthetic datasets paired with their ground-truth programs, PRODiGI accommodates diverse generative families and data dimensionalities through template prediction and non-autoregressive program parameter decoding. Its inferred programs support direct sampling, density and score evaluation, and inspection independently of the pretrained model. We further introduce program-space fine-tuning, which refines differentiable program parameters by matching generated and empirical samples while keeping model parameters intact. Experiments show that PRODiGI achieves lower average density and score MAE than existing pretrained models, while offering multi-fold speedups over its closest competitors. Program-space fine-tuning further reduces generation MMD by 84%. By turning empirical data into explicit, reusable programs, PRODiGI introduces a new direction for fast, interpretable tabular generative modeling.

AI.tldr: PRODiGI 是一个预训练的数据到程序模型，单次前向即可从样本推断可执行的显式生成程序，支持采样、密度/分数评估，性能优于现有预训练模型且速度更快。
AI.motivation: 从有限样本估计概率密度通常需要针对特定数据集做模型拟合，效率低且缺乏通用性，本文希望用预训练模型直接推断显式生成程序。
AI.method: 在合成数据集与其真实程序配对上预训练；通过模板预测与非自回归程序参数解码适应多种生成族和数据维度；提出程序空间微调，仅优化可微程序参数以匹配生成与经验样本，保持模型参数不变。
AI.result: 密度与分数 MAE 低于现有预训练模型，速度快数倍；程序空间微调使生成 MMD 降低 84%。
AI.conclusion: PRODiGI 将经验数据转化为显式可复用程序，为快速、可解释的表格生成建模开辟了新方向。

title: Quasi Linear Kernel Attention with Infinite Capacity
summary: The evaluation cost of transformers with softmax attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Kernel attention addresses this by replacing softmax with a more general kernel function. In this paper, we aim to identify kernels that retain the expressivity of attention while enabling quasi linear computation. To quantify expressivity, we introduce a capacity for each kernel, measuring the maximum sequence length for which the attention matrix can approximate the identity. A higher capacity thus indicates greater expressivity. We show that expressive kernels like softmax, Gauss, and Laplace have infinite capacity. In contrast, common quasi linear kernels, such as those derived from finite dimensional feature maps, exhibit finite capacity. As a solution, we propose additive kernels constructed from univariate spline and polynomial exponential kernels. We prove that these maintain infinite capacity while allowing quasi linear computation via sorting. Finally, we implement additive sorting kernels efficiently and benchmark them against modern softmax backends, demonstrating advantages for long sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"容量"概念衡量核注意力表达能力，设计加性样条/多项式指数核，兼顾无限容量与准线性计算。
AI.motivation: Softmax注意力计算复杂度随序列长度平方增长；现有核注意力虽实现准线性计算，但有限维特征映射导出的核表达能力受限。
AI.method: 引入"容量"度量，定义为注意力矩阵能逼近单位阵的最大序列长度。分析各类核容量后，提出由一元样条和多项式指数核构成的加性核，证明其无限容量，并通过排序实现准线性计算。
AI.result: Softmax、Gauss、Laplace等核容量无限；有限维特征映射核容量有限；加性样条/多项式指数核容量无限且可准线性计算。高效实现后在长序列上优于现代softmax后端。
AI.conclusion: 加性排序核在保持注意力表达能力的同时实现准线性复杂度，为长序列建模提供高效方案。

title: Interference Beyond Geometry in Concept Extraction
summary: Interference is commonly treated as geometric overlap between learned features. We introduce effective interference, which combines feature geometry and code statistics to capture realized interactions, distinguishing constructive from destructive interference and frequent weak interactions from rare strong ones. Under local fixed-support assumptions, we characterize how architectural constraints shape interference through four mechanisms: feature orthogonalization, bias compensation, gain adaptation, and encoder-decoder separation. Experiments with sparse autoencoders show that constrained architectures selectively reduce overlap among co-active features, while bias, gain, and encoder freedom allow constructive cross-contributions to remain. Together, these results show that interference in learned representations depends not only on feature geometry, but also on how features are used and on the architecture that produces their codes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"有效干扰"(effective interference)概念，结合特征几何与编码统计来刻画实际发生的交互，区分建设性与破坏性干扰、频繁弱交互与罕见强交互。
AI.motivation: 传统上将干扰视为学习特征间的几何重叠，但这忽略了特征被"使用"的方式。作者希望更准确地理解架构约束如何塑造实际干扰。
AI.method: 在局部固定支撑假设下，分析四种架构机制对干扰的影响：特征正交化、偏置补偿、增益适应、编码器-解码器分离；并用稀疏自编码器进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，受约束的架构会选择性地减少共激活特征间的重叠，而偏置、增益与编码器自由度允许建设性交叉贡献保留下来。
AI.conclusion: 学习表征中的干扰不仅取决于特征几何，还取决于特征如何被使用以及产生其编码的架构。

title: Fiona: Accelerating FHE Inference with Packing-Aware Ternary Weights
summary:
Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables neural network inference directly on encrypted inputs, but it remains orders of magnitude slower than plaintext in- ference. Applying the server's plaintext weights to encrypted activations involves plaintext-ciphertext multiplications (PMult) and accounts for more than half of inference time in recent systems. Ternary quantization can replace these multipli- cations with additions and subtractions, but the savings rarely materialize under packed execution. A single PMult applies a weight group fixed by the packing layout and can be avoided only when all its weights share the same ternary value. Ternarizing all groups, however, largely degrades accuracy.
  We present FIONA, an offline optimizer that selectively ternarizes weights within a given packing layout based on the estimated effect of ternary conversion on the model's performance. FIONA encourages a shared ternary value within each weight group and retains full-precision weights for sensitive groups, so ternar- ized and full-precision paths coexist within a layer. It then compiles these hybrid operators exactly, applying common scaling factors once to accumulated inputs and reusing sums across outputs. Weight ternarization can also narrow the input ranges of downstream polynomials. FIONA fits lower-degree replacements under a cumulative accuracy budget, reducing multiplicative depth and bootstrapping. On VGG11, ViT, and BERT, FIONA reduces PMult operations by 53.4-79.5% and accelerates end-to-end encrypted inference by 2.38x, 1.68x, and 1.84x, re- spectively, with less than 1% accuracy loss across all three models.

AI.tldr: FIONA是一个离线优化器，通过选择性ternarizing权重减少FHE神经网络推理中的明文-密文乘法（PMult），在保持精度的情况下显著加速加密推理。
AI.motivation: FHE下神经网络推理比明文慢几个数量级，而PMult占推理时间一半以上。三值量化虽可将乘法替换为加减法，但在packed执行下收益难以实现，因为只有当整个权重组共享相同三值时才能避免一次PMult，而全组三值化会大幅降低精度。
AI.method: FIONA基于ternary转换对模型性能的估计影响，在给定packing布局下选择性ternarize权重：鼓励组内共享三值，对敏感组保留全精度，使混合精度路径共存。它精确编译混合算子，将公共缩放因子一次性应用于累积输入并复用求和；利用ternarization缩小下游多项式输入范围，在累积精度预算下拟合低阶替换，降低乘法深度和bootstrapping。
AI.result: 在VGG11、ViT和BERT上，PMult减少53.4-79.5%，端到端加密推理分别加速2.38x、1.68x和1.84x，三个模型精度损失均小于1%。
AI.conclusion: FIONA通过选择性三值化和混合精度编译，有效减少FHE推理中的PMult开销，在几乎不损失精度的情况下实现显著加速。

title: d-OPD: Future-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) typically generate text autoregressively (AR), predicting one token at a time. Block diffusion language models (dLLMs) instead generate blocks sequentially while denoising multiple tokens in parallel within each block, offering a promising way to accelerate generation. Rather than training such models from scratch, recent work adapts strong pretrained AR models into block dLLMs through distillation. On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely used for LLM training because it supervises the student on states generated by its current policy, rather than only on fixed offline trajectories. By training on the states the student actually visits, it reduces the mismatch between training and generation and can provide more relevant supervision as the student evolves. Recent work has extended this idea to AR-to-block-diffusion conversion. However, this setting introduces a fundamental mismatch in supervision: the block-diffusion student and the causal AR teacher condition on different information at the same training state. The student predicts from the entire partially denoised block, including visible future context, whereas the standard AR teacher target is defined only from the causal prefix. As a result, the teacher distribution used for distillation is not fully aligned with the information available to the student. We therefore introduce d-OPD, a future-aware on-policy distillation method that corrects the AR teacher distribution to better align with the student-visible state by incorporating visible future information within each block, providing supervision that better matches the information used by the student. Across Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B, d-OPD improves the six-benchmark average by up to $4.0$ points over OPDLM and reduces training time by $1.35$-$1.58\times$. The code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/d-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出d-OPD，一种面向块扩散语言模型的未来感知在线蒸馏方法，通过校正AR教师分布以对齐学生可见信息，提升性能并降低训练时间。
AI.motivation: 将预训练AR模型蒸馏为块扩散语言模型时，存在根本性的监督错配：块扩散学生从整个部分去噪的块（包括可见的未来上下文）进行预测，而标准AR教师目标是仅基于因果前缀定义的，导致教师分布与学生实际可用信息不完全对齐。
AI.method: 提出d-OPD（未来感知在线蒸馏），通过在每个块内融入可见的未来信息来校正AR教师分布，使其与学生可见状态更好地对齐，从而提供与学生所用信息相匹配的监督信号。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型（0.6B至8B）上，d-OPD相较OPDLM在六个基准的平均分上提升最多4.0分，并将训练时间减少1.35–1.58倍。
AI.conclusion: d-OPD有效解决了AR到块扩散蒸馏中的监督错配问题，在多种模型规模上均带来性能提升与训练加速。

title: Do Temporal Link Predictors Need Learned Memory? A Smoothed-Count Baseline with a Handful of Parameters
summary: Many temporal link predictors summarize past interactions through learned node representations. We examine whether simple counts of recurring interaction patterns can provide competitive predictions without learning these representations. We propose a temporal link predictor based on statistical language modelling. It pools transition and co-occurrence counts across sources to predict links that a source has never formed. We smooth sparse estimates using destination frequencies or Kneser-Ney continuation counts. A shared log-linear rule combines these estimates with popularity, source history, and recency, without node embeddings. In our main evaluation, the model achieves the highest MRR among the compared methods on 7 out of 16 datasets from TGB and TGB-Seq. It also outperforms EdgeBank and Base3 on all 16 datasets and the heuristic family on 14. These gains extend to datasets designed to limit repeated edges. With only 9--13 learned parameters, our model provides a simple and competitive baseline for evaluating future neural temporal link predictors.

AI.tldr: 提出基于统计语言模型的时序链路预测器，通过跨源池化转移/共现计数，无需节点嵌入，在16个数据集上以极少参数取得竞争性MRR。
AI.motivation: 检验简单重复交互模式计数能否在不学习节点表示的情况下，提供有竞争力的时序链路预测。
AI.method: 基于统计语言建模：跨源池化转移和共现计数以预测源未形成过的链接；用目的地频率或Kneser-Ney延续计数平滑稀疏估计；以共享对数线性规则结合流行度、源历史和时序新近性，不使用节点嵌入。
AI.result: 在TGB和TGB-Seq的16个数据集中，7个数据集MRR最高；在全部16个数据集上优于EdgeBank和Base3，在14个上优于启发式方法族；优势也延伸到限制重复边的数据集；仅需9–13个学习参数。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为未来神经时序链路预测器提供了一个简单且有竞争力的评估基线。

title: First Learn, Then Memorize: The Spectral Bias of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models trained on a finite dataset first learn to generate novel, high-quality samples and only much later collapse onto their training set. We identify the mechanism behind this separation of timescales and the object that probes it. The training dynamics of the score function are governed---exactly, and at any width---by the Gram matrix of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) evaluated on the noisy training data, so the timescales of generalization and of memorization must be encoded in its spectrum. We show that they are, and that the structure responsible has no analogue in standard kernel settings. The use of multiple noise realizations per sample ($m$ noised copies at a fixed noise level) in the score-matching loss is what restructures the Gram matrix spectrum into two distinct parts. The first, of large eigenvalues, carries the global features of the target distribution and is present already for $m=1$. The second, which the repeated noising creates, consists of the smallest eigenvalues and is supported on eigenvectors aligned with the sample-specific noise directions; it sets a memorization timescale parametrically larger in the training set size $n$. We establish this picture on two fronts. Analytically, we solve the spectrum in the lazy high-dimensional limit for both linear ($n \asymp d$) and polynomial ($n \asymp d^k$) sample complexities, and prove through a bias--variance decomposition that the first bulk minimizes the approximation error while the second drives the error associated with memorization. Empirically, we show the same two-bulk structure in Convolutional NTKs on CelebA and in finite-width U-Nets trained well beyond the lazy regime, and we make the link causal: truncating the Gram matrix at rank $r$ tunes the generalization--memorization transition, and an $L_2$ penalty targeting the second bulk suppresses memorization in feature-learning U-Nets.

AI.tldr: 扩散模型训练中"先泛化后记忆"的分离时标由NTK Gram矩阵谱结构决定，多次加噪（m个副本）将谱分成两部分：大特征值携带全局特征，小特征值导致记忆。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在有限数据集上先学会生成新颖高质量样本，很久之后才坍缩到训练集。作者想揭示这种泛化与记忆时标分离的机制及探测对象。
AI.method: 作者指出score函数训练动态（任意宽度下精确地）由噪声训练数据上NTK的Gram矩阵支配。在lazy高维极限下解析求解谱（线性n≍d与多项式n≍d^k复杂度），并做bias-variance分解；经验上在CelebA的卷积NTK和超越lazy的有限宽度U-Net中验证。
AI.result: 谱分成两个bulk：大特征值部分（m=1即存在）携带目标分布全局特征；重复加噪产生的小特征值部分支撑在与样本特定噪声方向对齐的特征向量上，设定记忆时标，参数上比n大得多。截断Gram矩阵秩r可调控泛化-记忆转变；针对第二bulk的L2惩罚抑制U-Net中的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 多次加噪重构Gram矩阵谱是泛化与记忆时标分离的根源，第一bulk最小化近似误差，第二bulk驱动记忆误差，且该结构因果性地控制泛化-记忆转变。

title: Identifying Neural Source Dynamics from Unknown Local Interventions
comment: 11 pages main text, 52 pages total including references and appendices; 3 figures
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) records mixtures of brain-source activity. Even with a known anatomical forward model, experiments that excite only part of the source-state space leave the dynamics unidentified, and repetition cannot resolve the ambiguity. We show that unknown local mechanism changes can supply the missing information. We consider linear dynamics among fixed anatomical sources with known source-state initialization patterns. Changing one source's update rule for one transition leaves a rank-one, source-specific signature in subsequent EEG: subtracting matched baseline responses isolates it, and the forward model identifies the source and calibrates its response history. Combining these histories with initialization responses recovers source interactions without baseline reachability and without first identifying the intervention coefficients. We establish sufficient recovery conditions, a direct estimator, and a noise-sensitivity bound conditional on correct source labels. Simulated EEG on anatomy derived from magnetic resonance imaging confirms the information gain: with baseline excitation confined to four of twelve source coordinates, eight unknown changes recover all dynamics in 32/32 systems, whereas baseline realization, baseline regression through an invertible forward model, and changes that leave the tested states unexposed all fail, and explicitly constructed alternative dynamics reproduce every baseline mean. Where baseline information suffices, direct reconstruction is also more reliable than a matched-information spectral estimator. Nonlocal changes and forward-model error limit accuracy even when source labels are correct.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明，在EEG源动力系统识别中，未知的局部机制变化可提供缺失信息，从而在基线不可达条件下恢复全部源间交互动力学，并给出估计器与噪声敏感性分析。
AI.motivation: EEG记录的是脑源活动的混合信号；即使已知解剖前向模型，若实验仅激发部分源状态空间，源动力学仍不可辨识，且重复实验无法消除这种歧义。因此需要寻找额外信息源来实现动力学恢复。
AI.method: 考虑固定解剖源之间的线性动力学，源状态初始化模式已知。改变某一源在某一次转移中的更新规则，会在后续EEG中留下秩一、源特异性的签名；通过减去匹配的基线响应可将其分离，再利用前向模型识别源并校准其响应历史。结合这些历史与初始化响应，可在不要求基线可达、也无需先识别干预系数的情况下恢复源交互。作者建立了充分恢复条件、直接估计器和在源标签正确条件下的噪声敏感性界，并用基于MRI解剖的仿真EEG验证。
AI.result: 在12个源坐标中仅4个被基线激发的设定下，8个未知变化可在32/32个系统中恢复全部动力学；而基线实现、通过可逆前向模型的基线回归、以及未暴露被测状态的变化均失败，且可显式构造出能复现所有基线均值的替代动力学。当基线信息足够时，直接重建也比匹配信息的谱估计器更可靠。但非局部变化和前向模型误差会在源标签正确时仍限制精度。
AI.conclusion: 未知的局部机制变化能够补充EEG源动力学识别所需的缺失信息，实现无需基线可达的交互恢复；但方法仍受非局部变化与前向模型误差制约。

title: Inductive Feedback for Mixed-Policy Distillation
summary: Verbal feedback can identify errors and prescribe corrections, providing rich supervision for language-model post-training even when reliable programmatic verifiers are unavailable. Such feedback, often generated by a capable model, can be used to condition the teacher in on-policy distillation, which trains the student to match the teacher's predictions on student-generated rollouts. However, this approach can transfer teacher preferences that the feedback did not motivate, while leaving much of the feedback's guidance unused. We find that both problems come from the standard on-policy distillation objective, specifically the divergence it minimizes and the distribution it uses as its target. Our proposed method addresses both limitations. First, to isolate the information conveyed by the feedback from the teacher's inherent preferences, we treat verbal feedback as evidence for or against the hypothesis that a particular token comes next at a given prefix. We then adopt a probabilistic confirmation framework which uniquely determines an ordering over the vocabulary based on the teacher's predictions before and after it receives feedback. Using a confirmation score consistent with this ordering, we construct a target distribution within a trust region of the student. Second, to learn from guidance that student rollouts can leave unused, we derive a simple shared-rollout estimator of a symmetric divergence between the student and target distributions over rollouts, reusing student and feedback-conditioned teacher rollouts in both directions through importance weighting. Empirical evaluations show that our method outperforms the common on-policy distillation recipe and a recent contrastive variant on knowledge-based and agentic benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的on-policy蒸馏方法，利用语言反馈作为证据，通过概率确认框架构建目标分布，并用共享rollout估计器训练学生模型，在知识与智能体基准上优于标准蒸馏和对比变体。
AI.motivation: 标准on-policy蒸馏存在两个问题：会迁移反馈并未激发的教师固有偏好，且反馈中的大量指导信息未被充分利用。作者将这两个问题归因于标准目标函数所最小化的散度及其目标分布的选择。
AI.method: 1) 将语言反馈视为对"某token在给定前缀下是否接续"这一假设的证据，采用概率确认框架，根据教师收到反馈前后预测唯一确定词表排序，用与排序一致的确认分数在学生信任区域内构造目标分布；2) 推导一个简单共享rollout估计器，用于估计学生与目标分布在rollout上的对称散度，通过重要性权重双向复用学生与反馈条件教师rollout。
AI.result: 在知识型与智能体（agentic）基准上，该方法优于常见的on-policy蒸馏配方以及近期的一种对比变体方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新设计目标分布与散度估计方式，可以更有效地利用语言反馈进行蒸馏，避免迁移无关偏好并充分利用反馈指导。

title: The Hidden Ratio in Adam: Stable Structure, Compression, and Sign Dynamics
summary: Adam is the default optimizer for training modern deep neural networks, yet its adaptive behavior remains poorly understood due to the complex interaction between its first- and second-moment exponential moving averages (EMAs). We study Adam in the tied-$β$ regime, where the two EMA decay rates are equal, and show that its adaptive dynamics can be expressed through a transformed ratio with approximately scale-stable behavior. Empirically, this transformed ratio exhibits a stable, heavy-tailed distribution across tasks, model scales, and training stages, in contrast to the variability of raw moment magnitudes. This empirical stability has both practical and conceptual consequences. First, we derive a recurrence for the transformed ratio, yielding a reparameterization of Adam that replaces the second moment with a compressible state. Leveraging its stable distribution, we show that a fixed 4-bit codebook is sufficient in our experiments to store this state without auxiliary scaling, achieving performance competitive with full-precision Adam. Second, the transformed ratio view clarifies Adam's connection to sign-based methods: Adam reduces to sign-based momentum modulated by the transformed ratio, and replacing it with a constant recovers Signum as a limiting case. This perspective further provides a simple rule for transferring learning rates between the two methods. Together, these results suggest that tied-$β$ Adam admits a simple and approximately stable ratio structure underlying its adaptive behavior and demonstrate its utility for both analysis and efficient implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 tied-β 设定下的 Adam，发现其自适应动态可表示为具有近似尺度稳定性的变换比率，该比率呈稳定重尾分布，并据此实现 4-bit 状态压缩及与 Signum 的理论联系。
AI.motivation: Adam 是深度网络默认优化器，但其一阶与二阶动量 EMA 的复杂交互使其自适应行为难以理解，缺乏简洁的理论刻画。
AI.method: 在 tied-β（两个 EMA 衰减率相等）下，将 Adam 动态表达为变换比率；推导该比率的递推式，得到用可压缩状态替代二阶动量的重参数化，并用固定 4-bit 码本存储该状态；同时从比率视角分析其与 sign-based 方法的联系。
AI.result: 变换比率在不同任务、模型规模和训练阶段呈稳定重尾分布，而原始动量幅值变化较大；固定 4-bit 码本无需辅助缩放即可达到接近全精度 Adam 的性能；Adam 可视为由变换比率调制的 sign-based 动量，比率取常数即退化为 Signum，并给出两者学习率转换规则。
AI.conclusion: tied-β Adam 的自适应行为背后存在简单且近似稳定的比率结构，该结构兼具分析价值与高效实现价值。

title: Persistent Partners Raise Prices Among Learning Agents
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. Pre-registered on OSF (https://osf.io/98bx5, under embargo). Under review
summary: When pricing agents meet repeatedly on a platform, the platform decides who faces whom. We ask whether that choice moves the prices the agents learn, and whether a rise comes with learned punishment. In a pre-registered randomised experiment in the Bertrand duopoly of Calvano et al., each agent's price is set by a tabular Q-learning module, not by the small language model attached to it, and we randomise whether each agent keeps its partner, sees its rival's prices and can send messages. Keeping the same partner raises the level of profits, averaged over training, by 0.27 of the gap between competitive and monopoly profit (95% CI 0.20 to 0.35, all twenty paired runs positive), our registered primary result, and the resting price by 0.17 of the Nash-to-monopoly range (post hoc). A plain tabular learner reproduces the effect in all 25 further blocks, and there one permanent partner raises the level more than about three do (+0.23 against +0.05, exploratory). Where rival prices are hidden, the price-setting module cannot see a cut, so cannot punish it, yet the resting price rises as much and the rise lasts to the end of training, while with visible rivals it shrinks with longer training (post hoc). Where the rival is visible, a static best responder accounts for a third to a half of what a forced-deviation probe reads as punishment, on the starts where the rival can see the cut, and net of it the registered test of learned punishment is inconclusive. A test that looks only for punishment would thus miss the rise where the rival is hidden, while a check for profitable deviations flags most of those prices (post hoc). In an exploratory extension, untrained Qwen2.5 7B and 14B models under one prompt show the effect when the rival's price is left out of the prompt and inconsistently when it is shown, the 7B result replicating on fresh blocks, while two other model families show none.

AI.tldr: 在预注册实验中发现，重复配对提升Q学习定价智能体的价格与利润；隐藏对手价格时无法“惩罚”却仍抬价，说明价格上升不完全依赖学习性惩罚。
AI.motivation: 研究平台决定重复配对对象是否会改变智能体学到的价格，以及价格上升是否伴随“学习到的惩罚”机制，并考察大语言模型的类似表现。
AI.method: 在Calvano等BERTRAND双寡头中预注册随机实验，用表格Q-learning决定价格，随机化是否保持同一伙伴、是否可见对手价格、能否发消息；并扩展到25个额外区块、强制偏离探针，以及未训练Qwen2.5 7B/14B等模型。
AI.result: 保持同一伙伴使训练平均利润提高0.27（95% CI 0.20–0.35），静息价格提高0.17；普通表格学习器在25个区块均复现；隐藏对手价格时价格仍上升且持续；可见对手时静态最优反应解释1/3至1/2的“惩罚”；注册的惩罚检验结论不确定。
AI.conclusion: 仅检测惩罚会漏掉隐藏对手情形下的价格上升；平台配对策略显著影响学习到的定价；未训练LLM在不同提示下表现不一致，部分模型可复现该效应。

title: ReSPO: Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization for Gradient Starvation in Off-Policy Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) frequently reuses rollouts across multiple policy updates, increasing the mismatch between the current policy and the data-generating policy. We identify a sign-dependent gradient starvation problem in clipped policy optimization: clipping suppresses under-generated positive responses at the low-importance-weight tail while permitting severely over-generated negative responses to dominate the high-weight tail. To address this, we propose ReSPO (Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization), which replaces clipping with a smooth, two-branch sequence-level kernel derived from an $α$-divergence variational objective and an exponential variance-control tilt. The positive branch preserves a nonzero gradient weight for under-generated positive responses, while the negative branch suppresses heavily over-generated negative responses. We demonstrate that ReSPO effectively learns from long positive reasoning trajectories during early training, even when accumulated policy drift relegates them to the low-importance-weight tail. On dense and MoE Qwen3 models, ReSPO accelerates early optimization, improves final training scores, and achieves higher held-out benchmark performance under a rollout reuse, validating our approach on importance-weight tail control in off-policy learning.

AI.tldr: 提出ReSPO，用平滑双分支序列级核替代裁剪，解决RLVR中裁剪优化导致的符号相关梯度饥饿问题，改善离策略学习。
AI.motivation: RLVR中rollouts常被多次复用，加剧当前策略与数据生成策略的偏差。裁剪策略优化存在"符号相关梯度饥饿"：低重要性权重尾部抑制欠生成的正样本，而高权重尾部让严重过生成的负样本主导。
AI.method: ReSPO用平滑的两分支序列级核替代clipping，该核源自α散度变分目标与指数方差控制倾斜。正样本分支为欠生成的正响应保留非零梯度权重；负样本分支抑制严重过生成的负响应。
AI.result: 在dense与MoE Qwen3模型上，ReSPO加速早期优化、提升最终训练分数，并在rollout复用下获得更高的留出基准表现。ReSPO能在早期训练中有效学习长正推理轨迹，即使策略漂移将其推至低重要性权重尾部。
AI.conclusion: 验证了离策略学习中重要性权重尾部控制的有效性，为RLVR的稳健优化提供了新方向。

title: SOLO: Pretraining Billion-Parameter Language Models with Shared-Output Local Learning
summary: Large language models are trained with backpropagation, whose global gradient coordinates all layers but forces each to hold its activations and wait for the gradient to pass back through every deeper layer. Conventional local learning removes this update locking by training each module to predict the target through its own readout, but has not scaled to billion-parameter pretraining. We identify these private readouts as a key weakness, since they leave each module without information from deeper modules. We propose Shared-Output LOcal learning (SOLO), which replaces them with a shared, read-only copy of the final module's readout, the only one trained on the output of the whole network. Taken from the previous step, the copy transmits information from the final module without passing gradients between modules or reintroducing update locking. SOLO approaches backpropagation on Transformers of 340M to 2B parameters pretrained on 15B tokens, staying within one point in average zero-shot accuracy with a perplexity gap that narrows with scale. Readout ablations attribute SOLO's improvement over private readouts to sharing. Without update locking, each of p pipeline stages holds activations for O(1) micro-batches instead of O(p). The freed memory permits larger micro-batches, which reach up to 1.44x the best measured throughput of pipeline backpropagation on the same partition. To our knowledge, SOLO is the first local learning method to show such memory and throughput gains in billion-parameter language-model pretraining. Local learning thus becomes a practical alternative to backpropagation for large-scale pretraining.

AI.tldr: SOLO提出共享输出局部学习，用最终模块只读读出头副本替代私有读出头，在不引入更新锁定的情况下接近反向传播效果，并在十亿参数预训练中实现内存和吞吐增益。
AI.motivation: 反向传播需全局梯度协调各层，导致每层必须保存激活并等待梯度回传，存在更新锁定；传统局部学习虽消除锁定，但私有读出头缺乏深层模块信息，难以扩展到十亿参数预训练。
AI.method: SOLO将各模块的私有读出头替换为共享的、只读的最终模块读出头副本；该副本取自上一训练步，仅传递最终模块信息，不跨模块传梯度，也不重新引入更新锁定。
AI.result: 在340M至2B参数、15B token预训练的Transformer上，SOLO平均零样本准确率与反向传播差距在1个百分点内，困惑度差距随规模缩小；消融表明提升来自共享；每阶段仅需保存O(1)而非O(p)个微批次激活，吞吐量最高达流水线反向传播的1.44倍。
AI.conclusion: SOLO是首个在十亿参数语言模型预训练中展现内存与吞吐优势的局部学习方法，使局部学习成为大规模预训练中反向传播的实用替代方案。

title: Riccati State Space Models: Non-iterative Parallelization for Nonlinear Sequence Modeling
summary: State space models (SSMs) achieve efficient sequence processing because their affine state updates are closed under composition and can therefore be evaluated with an associative parallel scan. Nonlinear recurrent models can provide richer, state-dependent dynamics, but generally lose this compositional structure: parallel evaluation then requires iterative methods that repeatedly linearize and scan the recurrence. We ask, what state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can be designed to remain exactly composable? We answer by introducing RiccatiSSM, a nonlinear SSM, in which each state dimension follows an input-conditioned Riccati differential equation. Its quadratic state dependence makes the local Jacobian explicitly state-dependent, while its exact per-step flow under piecewise-constant inputs is a Möbius transformation. Since Möbius maps are closed under composition and compose through $2\times 2$ matrix multiplication, the complete nonlinear state trajectory can be evaluated exactly with a single associative parallel scan, without iterative linearization. We further derive a constrained parameterization that ensures bounded, contractive dynamics, and avoids poles in the fractional-linear state update. Across long-sequence classification, regression, and forecasting tasks, RiccatiSSM achieves competitive predictive performance while reducing runtime by $22{-}33\%$ compared to the nonlinear LrcSSM under matched architectures. These results demonstrate that state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can retain exact composability and be evaluated efficiently within a single parallel scan.

AI.tldr: RiccatiSSM 是一种非线性状态空间模型，通过输入条件化 Riccati 微分方程，使每步流为 Möbius 变换，从而保持精确可组合性并支持单次并行扫描。
AI.motivation: 线性 SSM 因仿射状态更新可组合而高效，但非线性循环模型虽具更丰富的状态依赖动态，却失去组合结构，需反复线性化与迭代扫描，效率低。作者希望设计既具状态依赖非线性、又能精确组合的动态。
AI.method: 提出 RiccatiSSM：每个状态维度遵循输入条件化的 Riccati 微分方程。二次状态依赖使局部 Jacobian 显式状态依赖，而分段常数输入下的精确单步流为 Möbius 变换。由于 Möbius 映射在复合下封闭且可通过 2×2 矩阵乘法组合，整个非线性轨迹可用单次关联并行扫描精确计算，无需迭代线性化。还推导了受限参数化以保证有界、收缩动态并避免极点。
AI.result: 在长序列分类、回归和预测任务中，RiccatiSSM 在匹配架构下取得有竞争力的预测性能，相比非线性 LrcSSM 运行时减少 22–33%。
AI.conclusion: 状态依赖的非线性动态可以保留精确可组合性，并在单次并行扫描中高效评估。

title: NeuronSifter: Intervention Planning in CNS Microenvironments
summary: Prioritizing central nervous system (CNS) interventions requires predicting how a dose, route, and schedule act on a partially observed microenvironment, then choosing the measurement that would change the decision. Action-conditioned predictors reduce a regimen to an identity token or a scalar exposure, discarding where and when the target is engaged; handing a point estimate to a separate planner then discards the joint uncertainty that makes a measurement worth running. We therefore treat decision quality as a property of the intervention interface, not of controller placement. NeuronSifter compiles regimens into state-conditional target-occupancy fields with support masks, propagates them through microenvironment dynamics with an occupancy-conditioned diffusion operator, and selects measurements by their expected reduction in intervention loss, assimilating typed outcomes into the same posterior. In a declared synthetic Alzheimer's disease (AD) evaluation over 64 paired scenario blocks, occupancy conditioning lowers trajectory continuous ranked probability score from 0.165 to 0.110 and raises intervention ordering accuracy from 0.760 to 0.880, and every paired benchmark contrast remains separated after Holm correction. Decision-directed acquisition attains terminal risk 0.160 against 0.166 for a matched numerical Bayesian experimental design planner, and reaches the target risk at 0.796 $[0.732,0.873]$ of an earlier design control's cost, while the corresponding ratio against the matched planner, 0.963 $[0.907,1.025]$, is not separated from equality; point-state and dependence-ablated interfaces instead raise risk to 0.220 and 0.199, and a full-posterior external controller ties exactly. Published AD trials supply a separate retrospective endpoint bridge.

AI.tldr: 提出 NeuronSifter，将给药方案编译为状态条件下的目标占据场，用占据条件扩散算子推演微环境动力学，并按干预损失的期望下降选择测量，把决策质量视为干预接口的属性。
AI.motivation: CNS 干预优先级排序需要预测剂量/途径/疗程如何作用于部分可观测的微环境，并选出能改变决策的测量；现有"动作条件预测器"把方案压缩为标识符或标量暴露，丢失了靶点被作用的地点与时间，且点估计加独立规划器丢弃了使测量有价值的联合不确定性。
AI.method: NeuronSifter：把方案编译为带支撑掩码的状态条件目标占据场；用占据条件扩散算子在该场中传播微环境动力学；以干预损失的期望下降为准则选择测量，并将分类型的观测结果纳入同一后验。
AI.result: 在声明的合成 AD 评测（64 个配对场景块）中，占据条件化将轨迹 CRPS 从 0.165 降至 0.110，干预排序准确率从 0.760 升至 0.880，所有配对对比经 Holm 校正后仍显著。决策导向采集终末风险 0.160（匹配的数值贝叶斯实验设计规划器为 0.166），达到目标风险的成本仅为早期对照的 0.796 [0.732,0.873]，而与匹配规划器的比值 0.963 [0.907,1.025] 无法拒绝相等。点状态与依赖消融接口将风险升至 0.220 和 0.199，全后验外部控制器完全打平。已发表 AD 试验提供独立的回顾性终点桥接。
AI.conclusion: 决策质量应归因于干预接口而非控制器位置；保留占据条件化与联合不确定性可显著改善预测、排序与采集效率，并具备与真实 AD 试验对照的回顾性可行性。

title: Manifold-Stable Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching (FM) learns generative dynamics through velocity regression. Geometric FM variants commonly assume a prior supported on the data manifold, requiring geometric knowledge that is often unavailable. Without such knowledge, low regression error alone does not guarantee manifold adherence. Adherence keeps generated samples within valid configurations and is empirically associated with better task performance. We introduce manifold-stable flow matching (MSFM), which can start from an arbitrary ambient prior, not necessarily supported on the manifold. Using tools from nonlinear dynamics, namely contraction theory, MSFM combines learned tangential transport with prescribed normal contraction. The construction uses analytical projectors for known manifolds and local affine proxies estimated by principal component analysis for unknown data geometry. By implementing contraction theory in both cases of known and unknown manifolds, we guarantee manifold invariance and transverse convergence to the manifold within a desired time window (e.g., one second). We derive a family of compatible probability paths and decompose the training loss into a learnable tangential term and a normal residual. An ellipse experiment attains a mean terminal off-manifold error of order $10^{-6}$. In Push-T robotic experiments, MSFM raises success from $74\%$ to $82\%$. In the Robomimic Square task, success increases from $60\%$ to $72\%$, while rotation-manifold deviation decreases from order $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-7}$. The MSFM terminal geometric errors are controlled by the chosen numerical tolerance. These results demonstrate stronger geometric adherence and higher observed task performance, supporting prescribed normal contraction as a complement to learned generative transport.

AI.tldr: MSFM通过结合切向传输与预设法向收缩，从任意环境先验出发保证流匹配的流形不变性与收敛。
AI.motivation: 几何流匹配通常假设先验位于数据流形上，但该几何知识往往不可得；缺少它时，低回归误差并不能保证样本贴合流形，而流形贴合影响任务表现。
AI.method: 利用非线性动力学中的收缩理论，MSFM将学习的切向传输与预设法向收缩结合；对已知流形用解析投影，对未知数据几何用PCA估计局部仿射代理，并推导相容概率路径、将损失分解为可学切向项与法向残差。
AI.result: 椭圆实验终端离流形误差约10^-6；Push-T成功率74%→82%；Robomimic Square成功率60%→72%，旋转流形偏差从10^-2降至10^-7。
AI.conclusion: MSFM实现了更强的几何贴合和更高任务表现，证明预设法向收缩可作为学习生成传输的有效补充。

title: Tetra: Serving Leech-Lattice Quantized LLMs at 2.7 Bits per Parameter
